Localization.Title: Tobal No. 1
Localization.Description: Tobal No. 1 is a fighting game for the PlayStation developed by DreamFactory and published by Square in 1996. The game was DreamFactory's first release, as well as Square's first release on the CD-based console. Tobal No.

Localization.Title: Tobal No. 1
Localization.Description: Disponible sur Playstation, Tobal No 1 est un jeu de combat se déroulant dans un futur proche dans lequel un tournoi est mis en place pour décider du contrôle d'une énergie puissante et rare appelée Molmoran.

Localization.Title: Tobal No. 1
Localization.Description: Tobal No 1 auf der Playstation ist ein Kampfspiel, das in der nahen Zukunft spielt und in dem es um die Kontrolle über eine mächtige und seltene Energie namens Molmoran geht.

Localization.Title: Tobal No. 1
Localization.Description: Lucha hasta el final en una arena donde la fuerza bruta se mide contra habilidades salvajes. Ágiles humanos contra formas de vida alienígenas, todos listos para convertirse en el mejor luchador del universo.

Localization.Title: Tobal No. 1
Localization.Description: Tobal No. 1 is a fighting game for the PlayStation developed by DreamFactory and published by Square in 1996. The game was DreamFactory's first release, as well as Square's first release on the CD-based console. Tobal No.

Localization.Title: Tobal No. 1
Localization.Description: Oito guerreiros de diferentes origens, motivados por razões pessoais e sonhos de glória, viajam de várias partes da galáxia para competir no torneio. Entre eles está Chuji Wu, um jovem e talentoso lutador de uma família de praticantes de artes marciais.

Localization.Title: King's Field
Localization.Description: King's Field II is the second game in the King's Field role-playing video game series. Like both its successors and predecessor, the game is played through first person view in a dark and mysterious, medieval fantasy setting.

Localization.Title: King's Field
Localization.Description: King's Field sur Playstation est un jeu de rôle en vue à la première personne. Comme toujours dans la série, il s'agit d'arpenter moult donjons à la recherche de monstres à trucider, le tout dans un univers heroic-fantasy assez classique.

Localization.Title: King's Field
Localization.Description: In der Rolle von Alexander, dem Favoriten am Königshof, hast Du Dich bereiterklärt, eine Gruppe von Männern nach Melanat zu führen, um das Schwert zurückzuholen. Das Schiff ist jedoch kurz vor der Insel auf Grund gelaufen und versunken.

Localization.Title: King's Field
Localization.Description: King's Field es un videojuego de rol y acción de fantasía heroica, considerado uno de los primeros juegos de rol en primera persona para videoconsolas.

Localization.Title: King's Field
Localization.Description: King's Field II is the second game in the King's Field role-playing video game series. Like both its successors and predecessor, the game is played through first person view in a dark and mysterious, medieval fantasy setting.

Localization.Title: King's Field
Localization.Description: King's Field II is the second game in the King's Field role-playing video game series. Like both its successors and predecessor, the game is played through first person view in a dark and mysterious, medieval fantasy setting.

Localization.Title: Real Bout Fatal Fury
Localization.Description: 'Real Bout Fatal Fury' is a 1995 fighting game released by SNK for the Neo-Geo arcade and home platforms. It is the fifth installment in the Fatal Fury series, following Fatal Fury 3: Road to the Final Victory.

Localization.Title: Real Bout Fatal Fury
Localization.Description: Real Bout Fatal Fury" est un jeu de combat sorti en 1995 par SNK pour les salles d'arcade et les plateformes familiales type Néo-Géo. C'est le cinquième volet de la série Fatal Fury, après Fatal Fury 3 : Road to the Final Victory.

Localization.Title: Real Bout Fatal Fury
Localization.Description: Real Bout Fatal Fury ist ein Kampfspiel aus dem Jahr 1995, das von SNK für die Neo-Geo Arcade- und Home-Plattformen veröffentlicht wurde. Es ist der fünfte Teil der Fatal Fury Serie nach Fatal Fury 3: Road to the Final Victory.

Localization.Title: Real Bout Fatal Fury
Localization.Description: Real Bout Fatal Fury es un juego de lucha lanzado en 1995 por SNK para las plataformas arcade y domésticas Neo-Geo. Es la quinta entrega de la serie Fatal Fury, y continúa los acontecimientos de Fatal Fury 3: Road to the Final Victory.

Localization.Title: Real Bout Fatal Fury
Localization.Description: 'Real Bout Fatal Fury' is a 1995 fighting game released by SNK for the Neo-Geo arcade and home platforms. It is the fifth installment in the Fatal Fury series, following Fatal Fury 3: Road to the Final Victory.

Localization.Title: Real Bout Fatal Fury
Localization.Description: 'Real Bout Fatal Fury' is a 1995 fighting game released by SNK for the Neo-Geo arcade and home platforms. It is the fifth installment in the Fatal Fury series, following Fatal Fury 3: Road to the Final Victory.

Localization.Title: The King of Fighters '95
Localization.Description: The King of Fighters, officially abbreviated KOF, is a series of fighting games by SNK Playmore, formerly SNK.

Localization.Title: The King of Fighters '95
Localization.Description: The King of Fighters '95 est un jeu de combat 2D tournant sur Playstation. Ici 26 personnages aux styles différents s'affrontent pour obtenir le titre de "King of Fighters".

Localization.Title: The King of Fighters '95
Localization.Description: The King of Fighters, offiziell abgekürzt KOF, ist eine Reihe von Kampfspielen von SNK Playmore, ehemals SNK.

Localization.Title: The King of Fighters '95
Localization.Description: The King of Fighters, abreviado oficialmente KOF, es una serie de juegos de lucha de SNK Playmore, anteriormente SNK.

Localization.Title: The King of Fighters '95
Localization.Description: The King of Fighters, officially abbreviated KOF, is a series of fighting games by SNK Playmore, formerly SNK.

Localization.Title: The King of Fighters '95
Localization.Description: A primeira sequência da série King of Fighters chega um ano após o final do primeiro torneio. Mais uma vez, lutadores de todo o mundo recebem um misterioso convite para um torneio de luta baseado em equipe.

Localization.Title: Samurai Shodown III
Localization.Description: The third incarnation of the 2D fighting game Samurai Shodown is now available on the PlayStation with the release of Samurai Shodown III: Blades of Blood. The game revolves around the evil Zankuro Minazuki.

Localization.Title: Samurai Shodown III
Localization.Description: Samurai Shodown III sur Playstation est le troisième opus de la série produite par SNK. Ce jeu de combat se déroule au Japon, lors du moyen-Age.

Localization.Title: Samurai Shodown III
Localization.Description: Samurai Shodown III für Playstation ist der dritte Teil der von SNK produzierten Serie. Dieses Kampfspiel spielt im Japan des Mittelalters.

Localization.Title: Samurai Shodown III
Localization.Description: Samurai Shodown III: Blades of Blood es un videojuego de lucha desarrollado por SNK como parte de la popular serie Samurai Shodown.

Localization.Title: Samurai Shodown III
Localization.Description: The third incarnation of the 2D fighting game Samurai Shodown is now available on the PlayStation with the release of Samurai Shodown III: Blades of Blood. The game revolves around the evil Zankuro Minazuki.

Localization.Title: Samurai Shodown III
Localization.Description: The third incarnation of the 2D fighting game Samurai Shodown is now available on the PlayStation with the release of Samurai Shodown III: Blades of Blood. The game revolves around the evil Zankuro Minazuki.

Localization.Title: Jet Rider
Localization.Description: Developed by SingleTrac, Jet Moto blends futuristic motocross racing with hazard ridden tracks. Rather than using traditional cars or motorcycles, these vehicles are a cross between jet skis and hovercrafts.

Localization.Title: Jet Rider
Localization.Description: Jet Rider est un jeu de courses sur Playstation où vous conduirez des motos futuristes aussi bien sur la terre que sur l'eau. Confrontez-vous à 19 autres pilotes sur 10 circuits différents.

Localization.Title: Jet Rider
Localization.Description: Jet Moto wurde von SingleTrac entwickelt und verbindet futuristische Motocross-Rennen mit gefährlichen Strecken. Anstatt herkömmliche Autos oder Motorräder zu verwenden, sind diese Fahrzeuge eine Mischung aus Jetskis und Luftkissenfahrzeugen.

Localization.Title: Jet Rider
Localization.Description: Jet Rider es un juego de carreras arcade en el que conducirás motos futuristas tanto por tierra como por agua. Compite contra otros 19 pilotos en 10 circuitos diferentes.

Localization.Title: Jet Rider
Localization.Description: Developed by SingleTrac, Jet Moto blends futuristic motocross racing with hazard ridden tracks. Rather than using traditional cars or motorcycles, these vehicles are a cross between jet skis and hovercrafts.

Localization.Title: Jet Rider
Localization.Description: Developed by SingleTrac, Jet Moto blends futuristic motocross racing with hazard ridden tracks. Rather than using traditional cars or motorcycles, these vehicles are a cross between jet skis and hovercrafts.

Localization.Title: Twisted Metal: World Tour
Localization.Description: Twisted Metal features destructive car combat, playable either as a complete tournament or a single match The action takes place in 8 different locations around the world, on differing surfaces, many featuring destructible buildings and landmarks.

Localization.Title: Twisted Metal : World Tour
Localization.Description: Twisted Metal 2 sur Playstation se déroule 1 an après le premier. Cette fois-ci le tournoi n'a pas lieu à Los Angeles mais dans plusieurs autres grandes villes du monde.

Localization.Title: Twisted Metal: World Tour
Localization.Description: Es gibt eine neue Welt zum Zerstören, mit neuen Autos, neuen Schlachtfeldern und neuer Kampf-Action. Jetzt mit intelligenteren, tödlicheren, tieferen Kämpfen für kreative Fahrzeug-Schlachten in der ganzen Welt.

Localization.Title: Twisted Metal: World Tour
Localization.Description: en Twisted Metal2 la acción tiene lugar en 8 lugares diferentes de todo el mundo, en diferentes superficies, muchas de ellas con edificios destruibles y monumentos históricos.

Localization.Title: Twisted Metal: World Tour
Localization.Description: Twisted Metal offre combattimenti tra auto distruttivi, giocabili sia come torneo completo che come partita singola.

Localization.Title: Twisted Metal: World Tour
Localization.Description: Twisted Metal 2 apresenta um combate de carros destrutivo, jogável tanto como um torneio completo quanto como uma única partida.

Localization.Title: Cool Boarders
Localization.Description: The first title in the long-running PlayStation snowboarding series. Imagine riding down the slopes, avoiding the trees and trying to hit the jumps. When you catch enough air, you grab your board, twist, and land a perfect trick.

Localization.Title: Cool Boarders
Localization.Description: Cool Boarders est un jeu de glisse sur Playstation. Dévalez les pentes enneigées de différents spots pour montrer que vous êtes bien le roi du snowboard.

Localization.Title: Cool Boarders
Localization.Description: Vier Extreme-Pisten mit Sprungschanzen, Gefällen, Tunneln, Eis und Pulverschnee. Auf Alpin- und Free-Style-Boards erreichen Sie halsbrecherische Geschwindigkeiten und können die verrücktesten Stunts ausführen.

Localization.Title: Cool Boarders
Localization.Description: ¡Un juego de carreras de snowboard que es lo último en diversión sobre nieve! Presenta cuatro pistas de saltos, caídas, túneles, hielo y nieve en polvo.

Localization.Title: Cool Boarders
Localization.Description: The first title in the long-running PlayStation snowboarding series. Imagine riding down the slopes, avoiding the trees and trying to hit the jumps. When you catch enough air, you grab your board, twist, and land a perfect trick.

Localization.Title: Cool Boarders
Localization.Description: The first title in the long-running PlayStation snowboarding series. Imagine riding down the slopes, avoiding the trees and trying to hit the jumps. When you catch enough air, you grab your board, twist, and land a perfect trick.

Localization.Title: Soul Blade
Localization.Description: In the 16th century, a sword surfaces that is so powerful, so evil that warriors from all over the globe seek it out. It is Soul Edge, a demon blade. From America to Europe to Japan, these warriors fight each other for the chance to obtain it.

Localization.Title: Soul Blade
Localization.Description: Soul Blade sur Playstation est un jeu de combat en 3D dans lequel chaque combattant utilise une arme différente.

Localization.Title: Soul Blade
Localization.Description: Namco, Schöpfer der Tekken-Serie, präsentiert die fortschrittlichste Waffen-Kampfsimulation aller Zeiten! Wilde Schwertkämpfe mit Teilnehmern aus der ganzen Welt – ein episches Spiel exklusiv für die PlayStation!

Localization.Title: Soul Blade
Localization.Description: La historia se centra en la mítica espada maldita Soul Edge, que promete un gran poder a quien la blanda, pero que también domina las mentes de sus portadores y se alimenta de las almas de sus vencidos.

Localization.Title: Soul Blade
Localization.Description: Nel XVI secolo emerge una spada così potente, così malvagia che i guerrieri di tutto il mondo la cercano. È Soul Edge, una lama demoniaca. Dall'America all'Europa al Giappone, questi guerrieri si combattono per avere la possibilità di ottenerlo.

Localization.Title: Soul Blade
Localization.Description: No século 16, uma espada surge tão poderosa, tão má que os guerreiros de todo o mundo a procuram. É Soul Edge, uma lâmina demoníaca. Da América à Europa e ao Japão, esses guerreiros lutam entre si pela chance de obtê-lo.

Localization.Title: Nightmare Creatures
Localization.Description: Adam Crowley, a once-respected scientist, now turned to black magic, has released a demonic contagion onto the streets of 1834 London.

Localization.Title: Nightmare Creatures
Localization.Description: Nightmare Creatures est un survival-horror sur Playstation. Le monde entier semble avoir sombré dans l'obscurité et l'horreur. A vous donc de défier le sorcier maléfique afin de l'empêcher de mener à bien ses plans machiavéliques.

Localization.Title: Nightmare Creatures
Localization.Description: Adam Crowley, ein einstmals respektierter Wissenschaftler, hat sich der schwarzen Magie zugewandt und eine höllische Brut an Monstern und Dämonen erschaffen und diese auf die Straßen Londons von 1834 losgelassen.

Localization.Title: Nightmare Creatures
Localization.Description: Nightmare Creatures es una aventura de acción situada en tercera persona con temas de horror, esto te permite elegir entre dos personajes para luchar contra el mal que está corrompiendo a la ciudad de Londres gracias a los experimentos del alquimista Adá

Localization.Title: Nightmare Creatures
Localization.Description: Adam Crowley, uno scienziato un tempo rispettato, ora rivolto alla magia nera, ha rilasciato un contagio demoniaco nelle strade della Londra del 1834.

Localization.Title: Nightmare Creatures
Localization.Description: Adam Crowley, a once-respected scientist, now turned to black magic, has released a demonic contagion onto the streets of 1834 London.

game.Developer: Krisalis Software Ltd / The Bitmap Brothers

Localization.Title: Z
Localization.Description: Z is a real-time strategy game with a difference: you fight for control of the sectors, some of which contains factories which can gain you additional units. Touch the "flag" in the sector and it's yours.

Localization.Title: Z
Localization.Description: Z sur PS1 est un jeu de stratégie en temps réel un peu particulier : vous ne construisez pas de base, vous devez capturer des zones avec des usines de production d'unités.

Localization.Title: Z
Localization.Description: Z ist ein Echtzeit-Strategie-Kriegsspiel in einer Free-Roaming-Umgebung. Treten Sie in einem haarsträubenden Rennen um Territorium und Ressourcen gegeneinander an, während Sie versuchen, Ihren Gegner zu vernichten, bevor er Sie überwältigt.

Localization.Title: Z
Localization.Description: Z es un videojuego de estrategia en tiempo real en 2D desarrollado por The Bitmap Brothers y comercializado en 1996, cuyo argumento se basa en la lucha entre dos ejércitos de robots (rojo y azul) por la conquista de distintos planetas.

Localization.Title: Z
Localization.Description: Z è un gioco di strategia in tempo reale con una differenza: combatti per il controllo dei settori, alcuni dei quali contengono fabbriche che possono farti ottenere unità aggiuntive. Tocca la "bandiera" nel settore ed è tuo.

Localization.Title: Total NBA '97
Localization.Description: One of the first few games to be developed by SCEE's internal studio, this official basketball simulation is endorsed by the NBA, and features all of the teams from the '97 season. The game features real player likenesses, names and stats.

Localization.Title: Total NBA '97
Localization.Description: Disponible sur Playstation, Total NBA 97 est un jeu de basket-ball incluant tous les joueurs et équipes de la saison 97 de la NBA.

Localization.Title: Total NBA '97
Localization.Description: Total NBA 97 ist auf Playstation erhältlich und ein Basketballspiel mit allen Spielern und Teams der NBA-Saison 1997.

Localization.Title: Total NBA '97
Localization.Description: Uno de los primeros juegos desarrollados por el estudio interno de SCEE, esta simulación oficial de baloncesto cuenta con el respaldo de la NBA y presenta a todos los equipos de la temporada '97.

Localization.Title: Total NBA '97
Localization.Description: One of the first few games to be developed by SCEE's internal studio, this official basketball simulation is endorsed by the NBA, and features all of the teams from the '97 season. The game features real player likenesses, names and stats.

Localization.Title: Total NBA '97
Localization.Description: One of the first few games to be developed by SCEE's internal studio, this official basketball simulation is endorsed by the NBA, and features all of the teams from the '97 season. The game features real player likenesses, names and stats.

Localization.Title: Rage Racer
Localization.Description: The third Ridge Racer game again features three tracks, with each of the courses beginning with the same starting line to emerge into a completely distinctive course.

Localization.Title: Rage Racer
Localization.Description: Rage Racer est le troisième épisode de la série Ridge Race sur Playstation. Dans ce jeu de courses, vous roulerez dans trois environnements différents, avec de nombreux tracés à travers villes, tunnels, champs...

Localization.Title: Rage Racer
Localization.Description: Das dritte Ridge Racer-Spiel enthält wieder drei Strecken, wobei jede Strecke mit derselben Startlinie beginnt, um zu einer völlig unterschiedlichen Strecke zu werden.

Localization.Title: Rage Racer
Localization.Description: El tercer juego de Ridge Racer presenta nuevamente tres pistas, con cada una de las pistas tiene la misma línea de partida para terminar en una pista completamente distinta.

Localization.Title: Rage Racer
Localization.Description: Il terzo gioco Ridge Racer presenta ancora tre tracce, con ciascuno dei corsi che inizia con la stessa linea di partenza per emergere in un percorso completamente diverso.

Localization.Title: Rage Racer
Localization.Description: O terceiro jogo Ridge Racer novamente apresenta três pistas, com cada um dos percursos começando com a mesma linha de partida para emergir em um percurso completamente distinto.

Localization.Title: Time Crisis
Localization.Description: As Richard Miller, your primary objective is to eliminate all moving targets and save the girl; if you accept this mission, there will be lots of carnage and death following in your wake.

Localization.Title: Time Crisis
Localization.Description: Time Crisis est un jeu de tir utilisant un pistolet comme accessoire sur Playstation. Vous faites parti d'un commando d'élite et devez suivre les ordres de vos supérieurs pour une multitude d'interventions.

Localization.Title: Time Crisis
Localization.Description: Übernehmen Sie die Rolle des Geheimagenten Richard Miller in diesem spannenden Arcade-Abenteuer. Erleben Sie den Original-Hit aus der Spielhalle mit einer ganz neuen Mission für den besten Agenten der Welt.

Localization.Title: Time Crisis
Localization.Description: Time Crisis es un shooter tridimensional en primera persona sobre raíles similar a Virtua Cop en el cual el jugador sostiene una pistola de luz y dispara a enemigos que aparecen en la pantalla.

Localization.Title: Time Crisis
Localization.Description: Nei panni di Richard Miller, il tuo obiettivo principale è eliminare tutti i bersagli mobili e salvare la ragazza; se accetti questa missione, ci saranno un sacco di carneficina e morte che seguiranno sulla tua scia.

Localization.Title: Time Crisis
Localization.Description: Como Richard Miller, seu objetivo principal é eliminar todos os alvos móveis e salvar a garota; se você aceitar esta missão, haverá muita carnificina e morte em seu rastro.

Localization.Title: Nightmare Creatures
Localization.Description: Adam Crowley, a once-respected scientist, now turned to black magic, has released a demonic contagion onto the streets of 1834 London.

Localization.Title: Nightmare Creatures
Localization.Description: Nightmare Creatures est un survival-horror sur Playstation. Le monde entier semble avoir sombré dans l'obscurité et l'horreur. A vous donc de défier le sorcier maléfique afin de l'empêcher de mener à bien ses plans machiavéliques.

Localization.Title: Nightmare Creatures
Localization.Description: Adam Crowley, ein einstmals respektierter Wissenschaftler, hat sich der schwarzen Magie zugewandt und eine höllische Brut an Monstern und Dämonen erschaffen und diese auf die Straßen Londons von 1834 losgelassen.

Localization.Title: Nightmare Creatures
Localization.Description: Nightmare Creatures es una aventura de acción situada en tercera persona con temas de horror, esto te permite elegir entre dos personajes para luchar contra el mal que está corrompiendo a la ciudad de Londres gracias a los experimentos del alquimista Adá

Localization.Title: Nightmare Creatures
Localization.Description: Adam Crowley, uno scienziato un tempo rispettato, ora rivolto alla magia nera, ha rilasciato un contagio demoniaco nelle strade della Londra del 1834.

Localization.Title: Nightmare Creatures
Localization.Description: Adam Crowley, a once-respected scientist, now turned to black magic, has released a demonic contagion onto the streets of 1834 London.

Localization.Title: Ace Combat 2
Localization.Description: Ace Combat 2 is the sequel to Namco's PSX combat flight simulator Air Combat. Ace Combat 2 puts you back in the cockpit as a mercenary pilot out to foil a world-threatening terrorist plot.

Localization.Title: Ace Combat 2
Localization.Description: Ace Combat 2 sur Playstation est le deuxième opus du jeu qui vous place aux commandes d'un avion de chasse. Vous incarnez ici un mercenaire engagé par des gouvernements pour lutter contre des terroristes.

Localization.Title: Ace Combat 2
Localization.Description: Fliegen Sie das modernste Kampfflugzeug der Welt in mehr als 30 Missionen der realistischsten Luftkampfsimulation, die Sie je gesehen haben! Komplette Einsatzbesprechungen und die Riesenauswahl an Waffen, Einsatzzielen und Schauplätzen in 3D verschlagen

Localization.Title: Ace Combat 2
Localization.Description: Ace Combat 2 es la secuela del simulador de vuelo de combate PSC de Namco, Air Combat. Ace Combat 2 te pone de nuevo en la cabina como un piloto de mercenarios para frustrar un complot terrorista que amenaza el mundo.

Localization.Title: Ace Combat 2
Localization.Description: Ace Combat 2 per Playstation è il secondo capitolo del gioco che vi mette ai comandi di un aereo da combattimento. Qui assumete il ruolo di un mercenario ingaggiato dai governi per combattere i terroristi.

Localization.Title: Ace Combat 2
Localization.Description: Ace Combat 2 é a sequela do simulador de voo de combate PSC da Namco, o Air Combat. Ace Combat 2 coloca você de volta no cockpit como um piloto mercenário para frustrar uma trama terrorista que ameaça o mundo.

Localization.Title: Battle Arena Toshinden 3
Localization.Description: The third installment in the classic series of 3D fighting games for the Playstation, Battle Arena Toshinden 3 adds new characters, new special moves, and new play modes to the formula.

Localization.Title: Battle Arena Toshinden 3
Localization.Description: Battle Arena Toshinden 3 sur Playstation est le troisième épisode d'une série de jeux de combat. Choisissez parmi les trente-deux combattants proposés et utilisez leurs lances, épées et autres pistolets pour massacrer vos ennemis.

Localization.Title: Battle Arena Toshinden 3
Localization.Description: Der dritte Teil der klassischen Reihe von 3D-Kampfspielen für die Playstation, Battle Arena Toshinden 3, fügt der Formel neue Charaktere, neue Spezialbewegungen und neue Spielmodi hinzu.

Localization.Title: Battle Arena Toshinden 3
Localization.Description: Battle Arena Toshinden 3 es el tercer juego de la serie clásica de juegos de pelea para la PlayStation. Battle Arena Toshinden 3 añade nuevos personajes, nuevos movimientos especiales y nuevos modos de jugar a la formula.

Localization.Title: Battle Arena Toshinden 3
Localization.Description: Il terzo capitolo della classica serie di giochi di combattimento 3D per Playstation, Battle Arena Toshinden 3 aggiunge nuovi personaggi, nuove mosse speciali e nuove modalità di gioco alla formula.

Localization.Title: Battle Arena Toshinden 3
Localization.Description: A terceira parte da série Toshinden. Após a derrota da Sociedade Secreta no Arena de Batalha Toshinden 2 surge um novo grupo de bandidos.

Localization.Title: Namco Museum Vol. 4

Localization.Description: Namco Museum Vol. 4 disponible sur le Playstation est une compilation qui regroupe les titres suivants : Pac-Land, Assault, Ordyne, The Return of Ishtar, Genpei ToumaDen et Assault Plus en tant que jeu caché.

Localization.Title: Namco Museum Vol. 4
Localization.Description: Manco Museum Vol. 4 beinhaltet: Pac-Land (1984), Assault (1988), Ordyne (1988), The Return of Ishtar (1986) - the sequel to The Tower of Druaga, Genpei ToumaDen (1986) - renamed Genji and the Heike Clans, Assault Plus (1988) - als verstecktes Spiel.

Localization.Description: Set your time machine. Namco Museum Vol. 5 whisks you back to an era when big collars were cool, big hair was hip and big fun was only a quarter away. Includes Metro-Cross, Baraduke, Dragon Spirit, Pac-Mania, and The Legend of Valkyrie.

Localization.Title: Namco Museum Vol. 5
Localization.Description: Namco Museum vol. 5 sur Playstation est une compilation de 5 jeux d'arcade de Namco.

Localization.Title: Namco Museum Vol. 5
Localization.Description: Enthält Metro-Cross, Baraduke, Dragon Spirit, Pac-Mania und The Legend of Valkyrie.

Localization.Title: Namco Museum Vol. 5
Localization.Description: .Configura tu máquina del tiempo. Namco Museum vol. 5 te transporta a una época en la que los collares grandes eran geniales, el cabello grande era moderno y la diversión estaba a solo un cuarto de distancia.

Localization.Description: In Xevious 3-D/G+, you pilot a sleek Solvalou space fighter blasting and bombing your way through an overwhelming alien invasion force consisting of airborne attackers, ground defenses, and enormous "boss" motherships.

Localization.Title: Xevious 3D/G+
Localization.Description: Xevious 3D sur Playstation est un remake de Xevious, paru à l'origine sur Amiga. Il s'agit toujours d'un jeu de tir à défilement vertical, où les power-up vous aideront à débarrasser la Terre de la vermine galactique qui tente de s'y installer.

Localization.Title: Xevious 3D/G+
Localization.Description: Xevious 3D für Playstation ist ein Remake von Xevious, das ursprünglich auf dem Amiga veröffentlicht wurde.

Localization.Title: Xevious 3D/G+
Localization.Description: Xevious 3D-G+ es una nueva versión de Xevious, sigue siendo un Shoot'em Up de desplazamiento vertical en el que controlas una nave espacial llamada Solvalou, esta puede obtener power-ups que son esenciales para enfrentarse a los desafíos más difíciles de

Localization.Description: In Xevious 3-D/G+, you pilot a sleek Solvalou space fighter blasting and bombing your way through an overwhelming alien invasion force consisting of airborne attackers, ground defenses, and enormous "boss" motherships.

Localization.Title: Xevious 3D/G+
Localization.Description: Em Xevious 3-D / G +, você pilota um elegante caça espacial Solvalou explodindo e bombardeando seu caminho através de uma força de invasão alienígena avassaladora que consiste em atacantes aerotransportados, defesas terrestres e enormes naves-mãe "chefes

Localization.Title: Ray Tracers
Localization.Description: Ray Tracers is an arcade racing game where you have crash into others cars to destroy them. It is a spiritual successor to Chase H.Q. with some differences like a nitro boost system, four cars to choose from and more variety in end bosses.

Localization.Title: Ray Tracers
Localization.Description: Ray Tracers sur Playstation est un jeu de voiture orienté arcade où vous devez vous crasher dans d'autres véhicules pour les détruire. Plusieurs modes de jeu sont proposés et des gros boss de fin de niveau sont présents.

Localization.Title: Ray Tracers
Localization.Description: Ray Tracers für Playstation ist ein Arcade-Autospiel, bei dem Sie gegen andere Fahrzeuge prallen müssen, um sie zu zerstören. Es werden mehrere Spielmodi angeboten und große Endbosse sind vorhanden.

Localization.Title: Ray Tracers
Localization.Description: Ray Tracers es un juego de carreras de arcade en el que chocas contra otros autos para destruirlos. Es un sucesor espiritual de Chase H.Q. con algunas diferencias como un sistema nitro boost, cuatro autos para elegir y más variedad en jefes finales.

Localization.Title: RayStorm
Localization.Description: RayStorm is a shoot'em-up game created for the arcades, later ported to the Playstation and Saturn home consoles. Although there is no story connection, it is often thought of as the spiritual successor to RayForce, which had similar gameplay.

Localization.Title: RayStorm
Localization.Description: Raystorm est un jeu de tir sur Playstation. Dans un univers futuriste, le joueur doit piloter un "R-Gray" spatial et abattre les différents vaisseaux et véhicules ennemis pour empêcher les forces rebelles de la Fédération Secilia de détruire la Terre.

Localization.Title: RayStorm
Localization.Description: RayStorm ist ein Shoot'em-up-Spiel, das für die Spielhallen entwickelt und später auf die Playstation- und Saturn-Heimkonsolen portiert wurde.

Localization.Title: RayStorm
Localization.Description: RayStorm es un juego de shoot'em-up de recreativa (arcade), posteriormente adaptado a las consolas domésticas Playstation y Saturn.

Localization.Title: RayStorm
Localization.Description: O RayStorm é um jogo de shoot'em-up de arcada, posteriormente portado para as consolas domésticas Playstation e Saturn.

Localization.Title: PaRappa the Rapper: The Hip Hop Hero
Localization.Description: The rapping pup, PaRappa, dreams of impressing his friend, the beautiful Sunny Funny, and going out on a date with her.

Localization.Title: PaRappa the Rapper : The Hip Hop Hero
Localization.Description: Parappa the Rapper est un jeu de rythme sur Playstation dans lequel vous incarnez un jeune chien qui trouvera confiance en lui grâce au hip-hop.

Localization.Title: PaRappa the Rapper: The Hip Hop Hero
Localization.Description: In der Rolle des Comic-Charakters Parappa muß der Spieler in verschiedenen Situationen seine Rap-Skills unter Beweis stellen.

Localization.Title: PaRappa the Rapper: The Hip Hop Hero
Localization.Description: El cachorro de rap, PaRappa, sueña con impresionar a su amiga, la hermosa Sunny Funny, y salir en una cita con ella.

Localization.Title: PaRappa the Rapper: The Hip Hop Hero
Localization.Description: Il cucciolo rap PaRappa sogna di impressionare la sua amica, la bellissima Sunny Funny, e di uscire con lei.

Localization.Title: Broken Sword II: The Smoking Mirror
Localization.Description: Follow the breathtaking tale of George Stobbard as he circles the globe trying to rescue Nico, his investigative reporter girlfriend.

Localization.Title: Broken Sword II : The Smoking Mirror
Localization.Description: Suite des Chevaliers de Baphomet premier du nom, Les Boucliers de Quetzalcoatl sur Playstation replonge le joueur dans une nouvelle aventure de Georges Stobbart et de Nico Collard, dans une trame sous fond de conspiration en pays Maya.

Localization.Title: Broken Sword II: The Smoking Mirror
Localization.Description: Verfolgen Sie die atemberaubende Geschichte von George Stobbard, der um die Welt reist und versucht, Nico, seine Freundin als investigativer Reporter, zu retten.

Localization.Title: Broken Sword II: The Smoking Mirror
Localization.Description: George vuelve a parís tras pasar unos meses en EEUU cuidando de su padre enfermo, para encontrarse con que Nico tiene planes inmediatos para él.

Localization.Title: Broken Sword II: The Smoking Mirror
Localization.Description: Un seguito dei Cavalieri del Baphomet, il primo del suo genere, Les Boucliers de Quetzalcoatl su Playstation riporta il giocatore in una nuova avventura di Georges Stobbart e Nico Collard, ambientata sullo sfondo di una cospirazione nel paese maya.

Localization.Title: Broken Sword II: The Smoking Mirror
Localization.Description: Siga a história de tirar o fôlego de George Stobbard enquanto ele viaja o mundo tentando resgatar Nico, sua namorada, uma repórter investigativa.

Localization.Title: Armored Core
Localization.Description: You play the role of a Raven mercenary, piloting a powerful Mech called "Armored Core". You only work for profit, as the money you make goes towards upgrades and repaires to your mech.

Localization.Title: Armored Core
Localization.Description: Armored Core sur Playstation est un jeu d'action vous mettant aux commandes d'un robot géant qui participe à une guerre entre les deux plus grandes cités restantes sur Terre : Chrome et Murakumo Millenium.

Localization.Title: Armored Core
Localization.Description: Armored Core ist ein Third-Person-Shooter-Mecha-Videospiel, das von FromSoftware entwickelt und 1997 veröffentlicht wurde. Das Spiel ist das erste in der Armored Core-Serie.

Localization.Title: Armored Core
Localization.Description: Tomas el papel de un mercenario Raven, pilotando un poderoso Mecha llamado "Armored Core". Sólo trabajas para obtener beneficios, invirtiendo el dinero en mejoras y reparaciones del Mecha.

Localization.Title: Armored Core
Localization.Description: You play the role of a Raven mercenary, piloting a powerful Mech called "Armored Core". You only work for profit, as the money you make goes towards upgrades and repaires to your mech.

Localization.Title: Armored Core
Localization.Description: Armored Core é um jogo de ação e tiro em terceira pessoa com temática mecha, lançado para PlayStation em 1997 e primeiro título da série criada pela FromSoftware.

Localization.Title: Treasures of the Deep
Localization.Description: Treasures of the Deep is an underwater adventure. The player controls an underwater explorer and ex-Navy Seal Jack Runyan, who is approached by the Underwater Mercenary Agency to carry out highly dangerous missions.

Localization.Title: Treasures of the Deep
Localization.Description: Disponible sur Playstation, le jeu d'action Treasures of the Deep vous entraîne dans les aventures de Jack Runyan, un explorateur sous-marin et ex-Navy Seal.

Localization.Title: Treasures of the Deep
Localization.Description: Auf der Jagd nach verlorenen Schätzen der Geschichte entdecken sie versunkene Schiffe, kämpfen gegen Meeresungeheuer und fordern Terroristen heraus.

Localization.Title: Treasures of the Deep
Localization.Description: El jugador asume el papel de un buzo que debe explorar el fondo del mar en busca de tesoros ocultos y enfrentarse a diversas amenazas submarinas.

Localization.Title: Treasures of the Deep
Localization.Description: Treasures of the Deep is an underwater adventure. The player controls an underwater explorer and ex-Navy Seal Jack Runyan, who is approached by the Underwater Mercenary Agency to carry out highly dangerous missions.

Localization.Title: Treasures of the Deep
Localization.Description: Treasures of the Deep is an underwater adventure. The player controls an underwater explorer and ex-Navy Seal Jack Runyan, who is approached by the Underwater Mercenary Agency to carry out highly dangerous missions.

Localization.Title: Kurushi
Localization.Description: Intelligent Qube is a classic puzzle game for the PlayStation. It is known as Kurushi in Europe and Australia. In the game, the player controls a character who must run around a platform made of cubes, capturing certain cubes as they approach.

Localization.Title: Kurushi
Localization.Description: Kurushi sur Playstation est un puzzle-game. Réflexion est le mot d'ordre dans ce jeu où vous devez détruire des blocs pour survivre. Le but est d'arriver à agrandir votre plate-forme, si vous faites des erreurs celle-ci rétrécira.

Localization.Title: Kurushi
Localization.Description: Das 3D-Puzzle Kurushi ist eine Prüfung, ein Intelligenztest, der von einer höheren Macht entwickelt wurde. Sie sehen sich gewaltigen Würfeln gegenüber, die erbarmungslos auf Sie zurollen.

Localization.Title: Kurushi
Localization.Description: ¿Crees que eres inteligente? Este adictivo tornado cerebral 3D pone tus habilidades de pensamiento estratégico y reflejos al límite. Destruye los terrores geométricos que se aproximan antes de que te empujen sobre el borde o que te aplasten.

Localization.Title: Kurushi
Localization.Description: Intelligent Qube è un classico gioco rompicapo per PlayStation. In Europa e Australia è conosciuto con il nome di Kurushi.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy VII (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Set in a dystopian world, Final Fantasy VII's story centers on mercenary Cloud Strife who joins with several others to stop the megacorporation Shinra, which is draining the life of the planet to use as an energy source.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy VII (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: La Corporation Shinra pompe toute l'énergie de notre planète.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy VII (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Die Shinra Corporation entzieht unserem Planeten alle Lebensenergie. Cloud ein eiskalter Söldner, übernimmt einen Auftrag von einer Gruppe von Öko-Kriegern.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy VII (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: La corporación Shinra está agotando los recursos vitales de nuestro planeta.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy VII (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Ambientato in un mondo distopico, la storia di Final Fantasy VII è incentrata sul mercenario Cloud Strife che si unisce ad altri compagni per fermare la Shinra Corporation, che sta prosciugando la vita del pianeta, utilizzato come fonte di energia.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy VII (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: A história segue Cloud Strife, um mercenário que junta-se a uma organização ecoterrorista a fim de impedir que megacorporação Shinra use a essência vital do planeta como uma fonte de energia.

Localization.Title: Spice World
Localization.Description: Spice World has you directing the spirited, girl-powered pop group in a custom music video. Starring Chibi versions of all five members of the U.K. band, Spice World's gameplay is divided into four phases.

Localization.Title: Spice World
Localization.Description: Spice World est un jeu dédié au groupe des Spice Girls sur Playstation alors qu'elles étaient au sommet de leur gloire. Choisissez votre Spice Girl et créez votre propre tube avec des samples fournis.

Localization.Title: Spice World
Localization.Description: Spice World ist ein Spiel, das der Spice Girls-Gruppe auf der Playstation gewidmet ist, als sie auf dem Höhepunkt ihres Ruhms war. Wählen Sie Ihr Spice Girl und kreieren Sie Ihren eigenen Hit mit den bereitgestellten Samples.

Localization.Title: Spice World
Localization.Description: Spice World has you directing the spirited, girl-powered pop group in a custom music video. Starring Chibi versions of all five members of the U.K. band, Spice World's gameplay is divided into four phases.

Localization.Title: Spice World
Localization.Description: Spice World è un gioco dedicato al gruppo delle Spice Girls su Playstation quando erano all'apice della loro gloria. Scegliete la vostra Spice Girl e create la vostra hit con i campioni forniti.

Localization.Title: Spice World
Localization.Description: Spice World has you directing the spirited, girl-powered pop group in a custom music video. Starring Chibi versions of all five members of the U.K. band, Spice World's gameplay is divided into four phases.

Localization.Title: Point Blank
Localization.Description: Point Blank is a light gun arcade game, in which players shoots targets in a wide variety of stages. The Playstation version uses the G-Con gun, for action similar to Time Crisis, also by Namco.

Localization.Title: Point Blank
Localization.Description: Disponible sur Playstation, Point Blank est un jeu de tir mettant en scène les deux compères Dr. Don et Dr. Dan.

Localization.Title: Point Blank
Localization.Description: Point Blank ist ein Ballerspiel mit den beiden Freunden Dr. Don und Dr. Dan, das auf der Playstation erhältlich ist.

Localization.Title: Point Blank
Localization.Description: Point Blank es un juego de arcade que usa el light gun para playstation, en el que los jugadores disparan a objetivos en una amplia variedad de etapas. La versión de Playstation utiliza el arma G-Con, es un juego similar a Time Crisis, también de Namco.

Localization.Title: Point Blank
Localization.Description: Point Blank è un gioco arcade con pistole leggere, in cui i giocatori sparano ai bersagli in un'ampia varietà di livelli. La versione per Playstation utilizza la pistola G-Con, per un'azione simile a Time Crisis, sempre di Namco.

Localization.Title: Point Blank
Localization.Description: Prepare-se para testar sua mira e reflexos em Point Blank, o clássico de tiro para PlayStation.

Localization.Title: Disney's Action Game featuring Hercules
Localization.Description: The game follows the same storyline from the animated film. Hercules, son of Zeus, is stripped of his godhood and must prove that he is a true hero in order to regain his immortality, and join Zeus and the other gods on Mount Olympus.

Localization.Title: Disney's Action Game featuring Hercules
Localization.Description: Hercule est un jeu d'action sur Playstation basé sur l'univers du dessin animé de Walt Disney. Vous incarnez Hercule qui tente de passer de zéro à héros pour sauver sa dulcinée.

Localization.Title: Disney's Action Game featuring Hercules
Localization.Description: Ein sagenumwobenes Abenteuer von Disney Interactive. Eine epische Reise durch 3 Welten und zehn riesige Level voller atemberaubender Action mit Liedern, Animationen und Ausschnitten aus dem Disney-Erfolgsfilm! hast du das Zeug zum wahren Helden?...

Localization.Title: Disney's Action Game featuring Hercules
Localization.Description: Una legendaria aventura de Disney Interactive. Una búsqueda épica a través de 3 mundos y diez gigantescos niveles de acción palpitante, con canciones, animación y secuencias de uno de los grandes filmes clásicos de Disney.

Localization.Title: Disney's Action Game featuring Hercules
Localization.Description: Il gioco segue la stessa trama del film d'animazione. Ercole, figlio di Zeus, viene spogliato della sua divinità e deve dimostrare di essere un vero eroe per riguadagnare la sua immortalità e unirsi a Zeus e agli altri dei sul Monte Olimpo.

Localization.Title: Bushido Blade
Localization.Description: The Bushido code of honor governs the actions of the Samurai and sets a code of ethics for use in fighting.

Localization.Title: Bushido Blade
Localization.Description: Bushido Blade est un jeu de combat réalisé entièrement en 3D sur Playstation. Le soft propose un combat en un contre un armé. Chaque joueur a des caractéristiques de combat différentes et nécessite une parfaite maîtrise.

Localization.Title: Bushido Blade
Localization.Description: "Bushido" ist die Seele Japans - ein uralter Ehrenkodex, dem Samurai-Krieger seit Jahrhunderten folgen. Tauche in reale Kämpfe in riesigen 3D-Umgebungen ein, die du ausführen, in Scheiben schneiden und durchbrechen kannst.

Localization.Title: Bushido Blade
Localization.Description: El código de honor del Bushido rige las acciones de los samuráis y establece un código de ética para su uso en la lucha.

Localization.Title: Bushido Blade
Localization.Description: Il codice d'onore Bushido regola le azioni dei Samurai e stabilisce un codice etico da usare nei combattimenti.

Localization.Title: Bushido Blade
Localization.Description: Bushido Blade é um jogo desenvolvido pela Light Weight e publicado pela Square e pela Sony Computer Entertainment para a PlayStation. O jogo apresenta combate armado de um contra um. Seu nome refere-se ao código de honra do guerreiro japonês Bushid?.

Localization.Title: Ace Combat 2
Localization.Description: Ace Combat 2 is the sequel to Namco's PSX combat flight simulator Air Combat. Ace Combat 2 puts you back in the cockpit as a mercenary pilot out to foil a world-threatening terrorist plot.

Localization.Title: Ace Combat 2
Localization.Description: Ace Combat 2 sur Playstation est le deuxième opus du jeu qui vous place aux commandes d'un avion de chasse. Vous incarnez ici un mercenaire engagé par des gouvernements pour lutter contre des terroristes.

Localization.Title: Ace Combat 2
Localization.Description: Fliegen Sie das modernste Kampfflugzeug der Welt in mehr als 30 Missionen der realistischsten Luftkampfsimulation, die Sie je gesehen haben! Komplette Einsatzbesprechungen und die Riesenauswahl an Waffen, Einsatzzielen und Schauplätzen in 3D verschlagen

Localization.Title: Ace Combat 2
Localization.Description: Ace Combat 2 es la secuela del simulador de vuelo de combate PSC de Namco, Air Combat. Ace Combat 2 te pone de nuevo en la cabina como un piloto de mercenarios para frustrar un complot terrorista que amenaza el mundo.

Localization.Title: Ace Combat 2
Localization.Description: Ace Combat 2 per Playstation è il secondo capitolo del gioco che vi mette ai comandi di un aereo da combattimento. Qui assumete il ruolo di un mercenario ingaggiato dai governi per combattere i terroristi.

Localization.Title: Ace Combat 2
Localization.Description: Ace Combat 2 é a sequela do simulador de voo de combate PSC da Namco, o Air Combat. Ace Combat 2 coloca você de volta no cockpit como um piloto mercenário para frustrar uma trama terrorista que ameaça o mundo.

Localization.Title: Pac-Man World: 20th Anniversary
Localization.Description: Twenty years after Pac-Man's first adventure in Pac-Land, Pac-Man returns one day to his house only to find it deserted. Toc-Man and his ghosts have kidnapped Pac-Man's friends, Ms. Pac-Man, Pac Jr.

Localization.Title: Pac-Man World : 20th Anniversary
Localization.Description: Pac-Man World est un jeu de plates-formes sur Playstation vous permettant de jouer avec la plus célèbre petite boule jaune de l'univers vidéoludique dans des décors en 3D.

Localization.Title: Pac-Man World: 20th Anniversary
Localization.Description: Die beliebteste Spielfigur aller Zeiten kehrt für ein neues Abenteuer zurück - nur auf der PlayStation und diesmal in 3D.

Localization.Title: Pac-Man World: 20th Anniversary
Localization.Description: Lanzado durante el 20º aniversario de la creación del popular juego de arcade Pac-Man.

Localization.Title: Pac-Man World: 20th Anniversary
Localization.Description: Il più famoso personaggio di videogiochi di tutti i tempi ritorna in un'avventura in esclusiva per la PlayStation stavolta in versione tridimensionale.

Localization.Title: Pac-Man World: 20th Anniversary
Localization.Description: Twenty years after Pac-Man's first adventure in Pac-Land, Pac-Man returns one day to his house only to find it deserted. Toc-Man and his ghosts have kidnapped Pac-Man's friends, Ms. Pac-Man, Pac Jr.

Localization.Title: Klonoa: Door to Phantomile
Localization.Description: Klonoa: Door to Phantomile is a side-scrolling platform game viewed from a "2.5D" perspective. The player moves the protagonist, Klonoa, along a path in a two-dimensional fashion, but the game is rendered in three dimensions.

Localization.Title: Klonoa : Door to Phantomile
Localization.Description: Klonoa : Door to Phantomile sur Playstation est un titre de plates-formes dans lequel vous contrôlez Klonoa, un être aux oreilles ailées dans un monde où personne ne peut se souvenir de ses rêves, sauf vous.

Localization.Title: Klonoa: Door to Phantomile
Localization.Description: Machen Sie sich mit Klonoa auf zu einer abenteuerlichen Reise durch eine magische Welt, in der Träume und Realität auf wundersame Art eins werden.

Localization.Title: Klonoa: Door to Phantomile
Localization.Description: Un día, una nave, se estrella contra una montaña cerca de la aldea de Klonoa. En él viaja un espíritu malvado llamado Ghadius, que planea formar la pesadilla perfecta y para ello rapta a la Diva Lefisa (Lephise).

Localization.Title: Klonoa: Door to Phantomile
Localization.Description: Klonoa: Door to Phantomile è un gioco di piattaforme a scorrimento laterale visto da una prospettiva "2.5D". Il giocatore muove il protagonista, Klonoa, lungo un percorso bidimensionale, ma il gioco è reso in tre dimensioni.

Localization.Title: Klonoa: Door to Phantomile
Localization.Description: Klonoa: Door to Phantomile é um jogo de plataforma com rolagem lateral apresentado em uma perspectiva 2,5D.

Localization.Title: Crash Bandicoot 2: Cortex Strikes Back
Localization.Description: After his defeat, Dr. Neo Cortex discovers the crystals that keep the world in balance. However, something is wrong: some of the crystals are missing. When the planets align, the chaotic flux created by the event will destroy the world.

Localization.Title: Crash Bandicoot 2 : Cortex Strikes Back
Localization.Description: Le terrible Dr. Neo Cortex est de retour...

Localization.Title: Crash Bandicoot 2: Cortex Strikes Back
Localization.Description: Die neuen Abenteuer von Crash Bandicoot, der die Welt wieder vor den mutierten Kreaturen des irren Wissenschaftlers retten muß.

Localization.Title: Crash Bandicoot 2: Cortex Strikes Back
Localization.Description: Después de haber sido derrotado por Crash Bandicoot en el juego anterior, el Dr. Neo Cortex encuentra por accidente un extraño cristal que parece albergar un gran poder.

Localization.Title: Crash Bandicoot 2: Cortex Strikes Back
Localization.Description: Dopo la sua sconfitta, il dottor Neo Cortex scopre i cristalli che mantengono il mondo in equilibrio. Tuttavia, qualcosa non va: mancano alcuni cristalli. Quando i pianeti si allineano, il flusso caotico creato dall'evento distruggerà il mondo.

Localization.Title: Crash Bandicoot 2: Cortex Strikes Back
Localization.Description: Após sua derrota, Dr. Neo Cortex descobre os cristais que mandem o equilíbrio do mundo. Porém, algo está errado: Alguns dos cristais estão faltando. Quando os planetas se alinharem, o fluxo caótico criado pelo evento irá destruir o mundo.

Localization.Title: Gran Turismo
Localization.Description: Gran Turismo si basa fondamentalmente sul genere del simulatore di corse. Il giocatore deve manovrare un'automobile per competere contro piloti artificialmente intelligenti su vari circuiti.

Localization.Title: Kula World
Localization.Description: In Kula World, the player controls a beach ball navigating a series of cubic-grid labyrinths suspended high above various locales. The objective of each level is to collect all of the keys scattered throughout to unlock the exit.

Localization.Title: Kula World
Localization.Description: Dans Kula World sur Playstation vous n'êtes pas n'importe qui, ou plutôt n'importe quoi : vous incarnez un ballon. Dans ce jeu de réflexion, vous devez rouler et trouver les clés vous permettant d'atteindre les niveaux suivants.

Localization.Title: Kula World
Localization.Description: Mit ihrem Kula-Beachball schweben Sie durch 200 3D-Labyrinthe - kilometerweit über dem Erdboden! Sammeln Sie alle Schätze, und finden Sie alle Schlüssel. Nur so gelangen Sie in die Freiheit.

Localization.Title: Kula World
Localization.Description: En Kula World, el jugador controla una pelota de playa navegando por una serie de laberintos de cuadrículas cúbicas suspendidos por encima de varios lugares. El objetivo de cada nivel es recopilar todas las claves dispersas para desbloquear la salida.

Localization.Title: Kula World
Localization.Description: Con la vostra palla da spiaggia Kula galleggiate attraverso 200 labirinti 3D - a miglia da terra! Raccogli tutti i tesori e trova tutte le chiavi. Questo è l'unico modo per raggiungere la libertà. Ma attenzione, in fondo non vogliono cadere nel baratro.

Localization.Title: The Granstream Saga
Localization.Description: Als die Polkappen schmelzten und die Welt kurz vor dem Untergang war. Haben 4 Weise Männer einen Weg gefunden ihre Heimatkontinente mit Hilfe von Magie zum Schweben zu bringen. So waren Sie vorerst vor dem steigenden Wasserspiegel sicher.

Localization.Title: The Granstream Saga

Localization.Title: Wild Arms
Localization.Description: Ein Kämpfer, eine Prinzessin und ein Vagabund ziehen durch das verwüstete Filgaia. Sie suchen nach uralten Relikten, die ihre schöne neue Welt retten könnten - eine Welt, in der Legenden Wirklichkeit werden.

Localization.Title: Klonoa: Door to Phantomile
Localization.Description: Klonoa: Door to Phantomile is a side-scrolling platform game viewed from a "2.5D" perspective. The player moves the protagonist, Klonoa, along a path in a two-dimensional fashion, but the game is rendered in three dimensions.

Localization.Title: Klonoa : Door to Phantomile
Localization.Description: Klonoa : Door to Phantomile sur Playstation est un titre de plates-formes dans lequel vous contrôlez Klonoa, un être aux oreilles ailées dans un monde où personne ne peut se souvenir de ses rêves, sauf vous.

Localization.Title: Klonoa: Door to Phantomile
Localization.Description: Machen Sie sich mit Klonoa auf zu einer abenteuerlichen Reise durch eine magische Welt, in der Träume und Realität auf wundersame Art eins werden.

Localization.Title: Klonoa: Door to Phantomile
Localization.Description: Un día, una nave, se estrella contra una montaña cerca de la aldea de Klonoa. En él viaja un espíritu malvado llamado Ghadius, que planea formar la pesadilla perfecta y para ello rapta a la Diva Lefisa (Lephise).

Localization.Title: Klonoa: Door to Phantomile
Localization.Description: Klonoa: Door to Phantomile è un gioco di piattaforme a scorrimento laterale visto da una prospettiva "2.5D". Il giocatore muove il protagonista, Klonoa, lungo un percorso bidimensionale, ma il gioco è reso in tre dimensioni.

Localization.Description: Spice World has you directing the spirited, girl-powered pop group in a custom music video. Starring Chibi versions of all five members of the U.K. band, Spice World's gameplay is divided into four phases.

Localization.Title: Spice World
Localization.Description: Spice World è un gioco dedicato al gruppo delle Spice Girls su Playstation quando erano all'apice della loro gloria. Scegliete la vostra Spice Girl e create la vostra hit con i campioni forniti.

Localization.Title: Spice World
Localization.Description: Spice World has you directing the spirited, girl-powered pop group in a custom music video. Starring Chibi versions of all five members of the U.K. band, Spice World's gameplay is divided into four phases.

Localization.Title: Tekken 3
Localization.Description: An ancient evil force has reawakened, attacking in secret and feeding on the souls of mighty warriors. To lure it out of hiding will take the greatest fighting contest the world has ever seen... Tekken 3.

Localization.Title: Tekken 3
Localization.Description: Fin du King of Iron Fist Tournament 2. Heihachi a vaincu Kazuya et reprend la tête de Mishima Zaibatsu. Un jour, il entend parler d'un ancien dieu mexicain, Ogre, qui serait attiré par les âmes fortes.

Localization.Title: Tekken 3
Localization.Description: Eine uralte böse Macht ist erwacht, die heimlich angreift und sich von den Seelen mächtiger Kriegern ernährt. Um Sie aus dem Versteck zu locken, wird es das größte Kampfturnier geben, das die Welt je gesehen hat ... Tekken 3.

Localization.Title: Tekken 3
Localization.Description: Una vez más, el destino une a todos aquellos dispuestos a escuchar la llamada... Una nueva generación de guerreros. Gráficos alucinantes de alta resolución. Modalidades Tekken Force y Tekken Ball completamente nuevas.

Localization.Title: Tekken 3
Localization.Description: Fine del Torneo del Pugno del Re di Ferro 2. Heihachi ha sconfitto Kazuya ed è tornato in vantaggio per Mishima Zaibatsu. Un giorno, sente parlare di un antico dio messicano, Ogre, che si dice sia attratto da anime forti.

Localization.Title: Tekken 3
Localization.Description: Lute por Sua Vida! A força ancestral do mal acordou, atacando em segredo e se alimentando das almas de bravos heróis. Para ser libertada, participará do maior torneio de luta que o mundo já viu... Tekken 3. Alguns lutam por vingança, outros por honra.

Localization.Title: Dead or Alive
Localization.Description: The first in the Dead or Alive series, and features many of the same features that has made the DoA series so popular today; somewhat realistic combat, good character design, and scantily clad women whose breasts bounce a lot.

Localization.Title: Dead or Alive
Localization.Description: Plastique généreuse des combattantes, technicité, intensité des affrontements. Voici ce qui caractérise Dead or Alive sur Playstation, jeu de baston faisant office de figure de proue du genre.

Localization.Title: Dead or Alive
Localization.Description: Durch umfangreiche Wahlmöglichkeiten der Kämpfer, tausende von Schlag- und Bewegungskombinationen und hohe Spielschnelligkeit, hat Dead or Alive eine hohe Langzeitmotivation.

Localization.Title: Dead or Alive
Localization.Description: Dead or Alive es un videojuego de lucha de 1996 de Tecmo y el primero de la serie Dead or Alive (DoA) de Team Ninja. Fue lanzado primero en salas recreativas, y luego porteado para Sega Saturn en Japón, y más tarde para PlayStation en todas las regiones.

Localization.Title: Dead or Alive
Localization.Description: Il primo della serie Dead or Alive e presenta molte delle stesse funzionalità che hanno reso la serie DoA così popolare oggi; Combattimenti un po' realistici, buon design dei personaggi e donne seminude i cui seni rimbalzano molto.

Localization.Title: Dead or Alive
Localization.Description: O primeiro da série Dead or Alive e apresenta muitos dos mesmos recursos que tornaram a série DoA tão popular hoje em dia; Lutas um tanto realistas, bom design de personagens e mulheres seminuas cujos seios saltam muito.

Localization.Title: The Fifth Element
Localization.Description: Based on a movie by the same name, The Fifth Element is a third-person adventure wherein you take on the persona of one of two characters.

Localization.Title: The Fifth Element
Localization.Description: Le Cinquième Elément est un jeu d'action sur Playstation. Vous incarnez tour à tour Korben ou Leeloo, dans pas moins de 16 niveaux dans lesquels vous aurez l'occasion de rechercher des indices ou de combattre des ennemis.

Localization.Title: The Fifth Element
Localization.Description: Endlich gibt es Luc Bessons atemberaubendes futuristisches Abenteuer für die Playstation. Übernehmen Sie in dieser actiongeladenen Rolle des Taxifahrers Korben Dallas oder der mysteriösen Leeloo.

Localization.Title: The Fifth Element
Localization.Description: Basada en la película del mismo nombre de 1997.

Localization.Title: The Fifth Element
Localization.Description: Tratto dall'omonimo film, The Fifth Element è un'avventura in terza persona in cui si assume la personalità di uno dei due personaggi.

Localization.Title: The Fifth Element
Localization.Description: Baseado em um filme de mesmo nome, O Quinto Elemento é uma aventura em terceira pessoa onde você assume a personalidade de um dos dois personagens.

Localization.Title: Zero Divide 2: The Secret Wish
Localization.Description: In Zero Divide 2 the eight robotic fighters from Zero Divide (Zero, Tau, Wild 3, IO, Eos, Cygnus, Draco, and Nereid) are back, joined by nurse bot Pixel, the crab-like Cancer, "cyber trooper" Nox, and Eve, a female version of the last game's boss.

Localization.Title: Zero Divide 2 : The Secret Wish
Localization.Description: Tout comme son aîné, Zero Divide 2 sur Playstation est un jeu de combat de robots. Cette épisode ajoute des combattants, des arènes et les robots admettent désormais des parties destructibles.

Localization.Title: Devil Dice
Localization.Description: Using Devils to wipe out rows of dice, play one-to-one challenges or take on four friends in a frenetic battle for survival in this devilishly fiendish multi-player puzzle game.

Localization.Title: Devil Dice
Localization.Description: Devil Dice est un puzzle-game sorti sur Playstation. L'objectif de Devil Dice est de faire rouler les dés jusqu'à ce que la bonne face soit affichée afin de les faire disparaître au fur et à mesure.

Localization.Title: Devil Dice
Localization.Description: Vernichte in diesem teuflisch teuflischen Mehrspieler-Puzzlespiel mit Teufeln Reihen von Würfeln, spiele Eins-zu-Eins-Herausforderungen oder nimm es mit vier Freunden in einem frenetischen Kampf ums Überleben auf.

Localization.Title: Devil Dice
Localization.Description: Devil Dice es un juego de rompecabezas multijugador. Usa a los demonios para eliminar filas de dados, juega desafíos uno a uno o enfréntate a cuatro amigos en una frenética batalla por la supervivencia.

Localization.Title: Devil Dice
Localization.Description: Using Devils to wipe out rows of dice, play one-to-one challenges or take on four friends in a frenetic battle for survival in this devilishly fiendish multi-player puzzle game.

Localization.Title: Devil Dice
Localization.Description: Using Devils to wipe out rows of dice, play one-to-one challenges or take on four friends in a frenetic battle for survival in this devilishly fiendish multi-player puzzle game.

Localization.Title: Bust-A-Groove
Localization.Description: Match the moves shown on-screen in this Simon-like game to dance. Keep up with the continuing commands and your persona will be able to do combos and other fancy moves.

Localization.Title: Bust-A-Groove
Localization.Description: Bust A Groove est un jeu de rythme sur Playstation. Vous êtes dans la peau de l'un des dix meilleurs danseurs du monde et vous devez défier vos homologues dans des duels dansant. Si vous avez le rythme dans le sang, la victoire est quasiment assurée !

Localization.Title: Bust-A-Groove
Localization.Description: Ein Spiel wie kein anderes. Wie bei den besten Kampfspielen wetteifern hier die besten Tänzer der Welt um den Titel des "Ultimate Dancing Champion".

Localization.Title: Bust-A-Groove
Localization.Description: Bust A Groove es un juego de ritmo de Playstation. Estás en la piel de uno de los diez mejores bailarines del mundo y tienes que desafiar a tus homólogos en duelos de baile. Si tienes ritmo en la sangre, ¡la victoria está casi asegurada!

Localization.Title: Bust-A-Groove
Localization.Description: Match the moves shown on-screen in this Simon-like game to dance. Keep up with the continuing commands and your persona will be able to do combos and other fancy moves.

Localization.Title: Bust-A-Groove
Localization.Description: Match the moves shown on-screen in this Simon-like game to dance. Keep up with the continuing commands and your persona will be able to do combos and other fancy moves.

Localization.Title: The Granstream Saga
Localization.Description: One hundred years ago, the planet of Granstream was ravaged by a war between the Imperial Wizardry and the Allied Spirit Army.

Localization.Title: The Granstream Saga
Localization.Description: The Granstream Saga est un jeu de rôle/action sur Playstation. Vous incarnez Eon, un jeune garçon orphelin recueilli par Valos son père adoptif. Ses vrais parents lui avaient remis un sceptre mystérieux qui lui donne pour mission de sauver le monde.

Localization.Title: The Granstream Saga
Localization.Description: Als die Polkappen schmelzten und die Welt kurz vor dem Untergang war. Haben 4 Weise Männer einen Weg gefunden ihre Heimatkontinente mit Hilfe von Magie zum Schweben zu bringen. So waren Sie vorerst vor dem steigenden Wasserspiegel sicher.

Localization.Title: The Granstream Saga
Localization.Description: Asume el papel de la única esperanza del joven guerrero Eon Granstream para evitar que sus continentes se hundan en el mar.

Localization.Title: Tombi!
Localization.Description: Aside from sporting a wacky pink hairdo, Tomba! offers a long and brain twisting experience that mixes the traditional 2D side scrolling action/platformer with the elements of a role-playing game.

Localization.Title: Tombi!
Localization.Description: Tombi! prend place dans un archipel d'îles perdues au milieu de l'océan. Ces îles étaient un havre de paix jusqu'à l'arrivée des Vilains Cochons, qui utilisèrent leurs pouvoirs afin de mettre l'île sans dessus dessous.

Localization.Title: Tombi!
Localization.Description: Tombi, ein kleiner Junge aus der Wildnis mit pinken Haaren und zerrissener Hose, hat einen goldenen Armreif von seinem Großvater geschenkt bekommen.

Localization.Title: Tombi!
Localization.Description: ¡Acompaña a Tombi a través de un mundo de magia y misterio y ayúdale a resolver complicados acertijos y a salvar el mundo de los Cerdiablos Komabuta!. Una combinación exclusiva de aventura y juego de rol de Whoope Camp.

Localization.Title: Tombi!
Localization.Description: Tombi è un ragazzo selvaggio dai capelli rosa.

Localization.Title: Tiny Tank
Localization.Description: In a future world, an army of steel robots are out to destroy the human race. Our only hope is a little yellow tank armed with some mighty big guns.

Localization.Title: Tiny Tank
Localization.Description: Tiny Tank est un jeu d'action sur Playstation. Passez aux commandes de Tiny Tank, un petit char hargneux qui n'a pas peur de s'attaquer à plus gros que lui.

Localization.Title: Tiny Tank
Localization.Description: Tiny Tank ist ein Actionspiel für Playstation. Übernimm die Kontrolle über Tiny Tank, einen knurrenden kleinen Panzer, der keine Angst davor hat, etwas Größeres als sich selbst in Angriff zu nehmen.

Localization.Title: Tiny Tank
Localization.Description: Tiny Tank es una mezcla única de acción en tercera persona y plataformas. Controlas a Tiny Tank mientras atraviesa niveles llenos de enemigos, obstáculos y trampas mortales.

Localization.Title: Tiny Tank
Localization.Description: In a future world, an army of steel robots are out to destroy the human race. Our only hope is a little yellow tank armed with some mighty big guns.

Localization.Title: Pet in TV
Localization.Description: Pet in TV is an original (and quite bizzare) PlayStation game, where the user takes control of a virtual pet. (A more complex version of the Tamagotchi.) The player can choose from a selection of PiTs and name it.

Localization.Title: Pet in TV
Localization.Description: Pet in Tv sur Playstation a pour principe d'élever une petite bestiole virtuelle et la voir évoluer à l'écran. Sur le même principe que les Tamagotchis, vous serez amené à le nourrir, jouer avec lui etc...

Localization.Title: Pet in TV
Localization.Description: Pet in TV ist ein originelles (und ziemlich bizarres) PlayStation-Spiel, bei dem der Benutzer die Kontrolle über ein virtuelles Haustier übernimmt. (Eine komplexere Version des Tamagotchi.

Localization.Title: Pet in TV
Localization.Description: Pet in TV is an original (and quite bizzare) PlayStation game, where the user takes control of a virtual pet. (A more complex version of the Tamagotchi.) The player can choose from a selection of PiTs and name it.

Localization.Title: Pet in TV
Localization.Description: Pet in TV is an original (and quite bizzare) PlayStation game, where the user takes control of a virtual pet. (A more complex version of the Tamagotchi.) The player can choose from a selection of PiTs and name it.

Localization.Title: Pet in TV
Localization.Description: Pet in TV é um jogo PlayStation original, onde o usuário toma o controle de um animal de estimação virtual. (Uma versão mais complexa do Tamagotchi.)nnO jogador pode escolher entre uma seleção de PiTs e nomeá-lo.

Localization.Title: Crash Bandicoot 3: Warped
Localization.Description: After defeating Dr. Neo Cortex, Crash and his sister, Coco, take a well-deserved vacation. However, their friend, Aku Aku, has a bad feeling, and as usual, he is right. Aku's evil twin, Uka Uka, was the person behind all of Dr. Cortex's schemes.

Localization.Title: Crash Bandicoot 3 : Warped
Localization.Description: Plongés dans des décors inédits et aux commandes de tout nouveaux véhicules, des personnages détraqués rejoignent Crash Bandicoot dans une course à travers le temps pour sauver le monde!

Localization.Title: Crash Bandicoot 3: Warped
Localization.Description: Crash Bandicot kehrt zurück... Er begibt sich diesmal auf eine Zeitreise, die ihn unter anderem in das Alte Ägypten, Rom und England führt. Sogar in die vorgeschichtliche Zeit reist Crash, dort reitet er auf einem Dinosaurier.

Localization.Title: Crash Bandicoot 3: Warped
Localization.Description: Tras el fracaso del plan del Dr. Neo Cortex y la caída de su base espacial sobre la jungla, la malvada máscara Uka Uka es finalmente liberada.

Localization.Title: Crash Bandicoot 3: Warped
Localization.Description: Con le animazioni tutte nuove e i tantissimi nuovi veicoli, un folle cast di personaggi si unisce a Crash Bandicoot in una gara nel tempo per salvare il destino dell'intero universo!

Localization.Title: Crash Bandicoot 3: Warped
Localization.Description: Após o Dr Nitrus Brio e Crash Bandicoot terem destruído a estação de Cortex, um dos pedaços foi parar na Terra.

Localization.Title: LiberoGrande
Localization.Description: Libero Grande is the first football game that really allows a player to become a key member of the team and experience the thrill of playing on the pitch.

Localization.Title: LiberoGrande
Localization.Description: Libero Grande est un jeu de foot sur Playstation. Dans ce soft, vous avez la possibilité de ne contrôler qu'un seul joueur par équipe. Après avoir choisi votre équipe et le joueur que vous souhaitez incarner, lancez-vous vers la victoire.

Localization.Title: LiberoGrande
Localization.Description: Bei Libero Grande, der perfekten Umsetzung von Namco's originaler Arcade-Version, verlassen Sie die Beobachterkabine und stehen selbst als Starspieler auf dem Platz. Da fühlt man sich wie ein echter Fußballprofi.

Localization.Title: LiberoGrande
Localization.Description: Libero Grande es el primer juego de fútbol que realmente permite a un jugador convertirse en un miembro clave del equipo y experimentar la emoción de jugar en el campo.

Localization.Title: LiberoGrande
Localization.Description: Libero Grande is the first football game that really allows a player to become a key member of the team and experience the thrill of playing on the pitch.

Localization.Title: LiberoGrande

Localization.Title: Disney's Tarzan
Localization.Description: Disney's animated film TARZAN gets the videogame treatment and makes his way to the PlayStation. The game follows the plot of the movie: you must help Tarzan grow from a boy to an adult in the span of 14 levels of action.

Localization.Title: Disney's Tarzan
Localization.Description: Tarzan est un jeu de plates-formes sur Playstation. Enfilez votre fidèle slip en peau de bête car tarzan est de retour et c'est à vous que revient le privilège de le contrôler.

Localization.Title: Disney's Tarzan
Localization.Description: Tarzan erzählt die Geschichte eines Babys, dass im afrikanischen Dschungel von einer liebevollen Affenfamilie aufgezogen wird.

Localization.Title: Disney's Tarzan
Localization.Description: Únete a Tarzán y a sus amigos en una emocionante aventura repleta de acción.

Localization.Title: Disney's Tarzan

Localization.Title: Spyro the Dragon
Localization.Description: Spyro the Dragon is a platform game developed by Insomniac Games for the PlayStation. It stars the title character, a young purple dragon named Spyro and his dragonfly friend, Sparx, and is the first game in the Spyro the Dragon series.

Localization.Title: Spyro the Dragon
Localization.Description: La terre des Dragons a été envahie par Gnasty Gnorc et son armée de Gnorcs. Tous les dragons ont été transformés en statues de cristal, seul Spyro a été épargné.

Localization.Title: Spyro the Dragon
Localization.Description: Spyro ist ein süßer, lila Drache, der in der Klemme steckt. Alle Drachenfreunde von Spyro sind dem bösen Gnasty Gnorc zum Opfer gefallen, der sie in Kristalle verwandelt hat.

Localization.Title: Spyro the Dragon
Localization.Description: Gnasty Gnorc y su ejército Gnorc han conquistado los mundos de los dragones, y los han convertido a todos en estatuas de cristal... excepto a Spyro.

Localization.Title: Spyro the Dragon
Localization.Description: Spyro the Dragon è un gioco platform sviluppato da Insomniac Games per PlayStation. Ha come protagonisti il ​​personaggio del titolo, un giovane drago viola di nome Spyro e il suo amico libellula, Sparx, ed è il primo gioco della serie Spyro the Dragon.

Localization.Title: Spyro the Dragon
Localization.Description: Spyro The Dragon é um jogo de plataforma no Playstation. O mago maligno Gnasty Gnorc quer conquistar o mundo. Para isso, ele colocou fora de perigo todos os dragões por statufiant em cristal.

Localization.Title: Blood Lines
Localization.Description: Somewhere along the line, Bloodlines was the name substituted for Tribal, perhaps because it sounded more gutsy and the game has nothing really do with tribes.

Localization.Title: Blood Lines
Localization.Description: Dans un futur où les sports de compétition sont interdits, les meilleurs athlètes poursuivent clandestinement leur passion en formant des clans inspirés des anciennes nations.

Localization.Title: Blood Lines
Localization.Description: In a future where competitive sports have been outlawed, the world's greatest athletes continue their passion underground by forming clans inspired by ancient nations.

Localization.Title: Blood Lines
Localization.Description: Somewhere along the line, Bloodlines was the name substituted for Tribal, perhaps because it sounded more gutsy and the game has nothing really do with tribes.

Localization.Title: Jackie Chan Stuntmaster
Localization.Description: Jackie Chan's grandfather has been kidnapped and it is up to you to help save him! Midway's action-platform game, Jackie Chan Stuntmaster lets you experience some of what it takes to be the internationally known martial arts actor and stunt performer.

Localization.Title: Jackie Chan Stuntmaster
Localization.Description: Jackie Chan Stuntmaster est un jeu d'action beat'em all mettant en vedette Jackie Chan. L'histoire débute par l'enlèvement du grand-père sous les yeux de Jackie. Une course-poursuite s'engage mais les ravisseurs se dispersent dans la ville.

Localization.Title: Jackie Chan Stuntmaster
Localization.Description: Schlüpfen sie in die Rolle des weltgrößten Actionfilmstars in einer einzigartigen Mischung aus Kung-Fu-Kampfkunst, rasantem Abenteuer und Humor.

Localization.Title: Jackie Chan Stuntmaster
Localization.Description: El abuelo de Jackie (Fredrick) ha sido secuestrado y Jackie necesita rescatarlo. Esto significa abrirse paso a través de la ciudad de Nueva York para llegar hasta el.

Localization.Title: Jackie Chan Stuntmaster
Localization.Description: Il nonno di Jackie Chan è stato rapito e tocca a te aiutarlo a salvarlo! Il gioco platform d'azione di Midway, Jackie Chan Stuntmaster, ti permette di sperimentare un po' di ciò che serve per essere un attore di arti marziali e stuntman di fama internazi

Localization.Title: Jackie Chan Stuntmaster
Localization.Description: O jogo conta a história de um jovem entregador (Jackie Chan) que teve a missão de entregar um pacote em um templo de artes marciais chamado Temple of the Shaolin (Templo Shaolin).

Localization.Title: Disney/Pixar A Bug's Life
Localization.Description: The ultimate movie fun comes to the PlayStation game console. Get ready for a Bug's-eye-view and experience the most incredible adventure ever.

Localization.Title: Disney/Pixar A Bug's Life
Localization.Description: A Bug's Life est un jeu de plates-formes sorti sur Playstation. Retrouvez l'ambiance et les personnages du film en images de synthèse sur votre machine.

Localization.Title: Disney/Pixar A Bug's Life
Localization.Description: Das Spiel ist ein Third Person-Actionspiel mit jeweils verschiedenen Zielen in den insgesamt 15 Leveln. Um diese Level zu bestehen, agiert der Spieler zum Teil mit der Fauna. So springt man beispielsweise mithilfe von Fliegenpilzen über Schluchten.

Localization.Title: Disney/Pixar A Bug's Life
Localization.Description: Una aventura completamente nueva en 3D, basada en la película de dibujos animados Bichos, una aventura en miniatura.

Localization.Title: Disney/Pixar A Bug's Life
Localization.Description: Il massimo del divertimento cinematografico arriva sulla console di gioco PlayStation. Preparati per una visuale dall'alto e vivi l'avventura più incredibile di sempre.

Localization.Title: Disney/Pixar A Bug's Life
Localization.Description: Uma aventura completamente nova em 3D, baseada no filme de animação Vida de Inseto, uma aventura em miniatura.

Localization.Title: NFL Xtreme
Localization.Description: Like NFL Blitz, NFL Xtreme is football without rules, and features exaggerated tackles, late hits, and high-scoring affairs.

Localization.Title: NFL Xtreme
Localization.Description: NFL Xtreme est une simulation de football américain sur Playstation qui propose plusieurs modes de jeu : Exhibition, Playoff et un mode Carrière pour faire une saison complète. Vous pouvez échanger des joueurs entre chaque équipe.

Localization.Title: NFL Xtreme
Localization.Description: Wie NFL Blitz ist NFL Xtreme Football ohne Regeln und bietet übertriebene Tackles, späte Treffer und torgefährliche Affären.
