Localization.Title: MediEvil
Localization.Description: The Evil Wizard Zarok has returned from the dead to wreak havoc on a peaceful land, and it is up to the centuries-dead hero, Sir Daniel Fortesque, to rise from his grave and defeat the very nemesis that put him in that grave.

Localization.Title: MediEvil
Localization.Description: Perdue dans les limbes temporelles, l'histoire de Gallowmere est celle du pays où la magie a pris le pas sur la science et où Zarok, le sorcier à l'âme torturée, exploite ses pouvoirs les plus sombres.

Localization.Title: MediEvil
Localization.Description: Vom Winde der Zeit verweht, ist die Geschichte von Gallowmere, einem Land in dem Magie mehr gilt als Wissenschaft und in dem ein Hexer - der finstere Zarok - ihre dunkelsten Mächte an sich gerissen hat.

Localization.Title: MediEvil
Localization.Description: En el reino de Gallowmere, año 1286, el poderoso mago Zarok, desterrado por nigromancia, reunió a un numeroso ejército de zombis, demonios y otros monstruos con la intención de conquistar el reino al que pertenecía y vengarse de la familia real.

Localization.Title: MediEvil
Localization.Description: Il malvagio mago Zarok è tornato dalla morte per devastare una terra pacifica, e spetta all'eroe morto da secoli, Sir Daniel Fortesque, risorgere dalla sua tomba e sconfiggere la stessa nemesi che lo ha messo in quella tomba.

Localization.Title: MediEvil
Localization.Description: Medievil é um jogo de ação / aventura no Playstation. Um mago chamado Zarok quer fazer tudo para dominar o mundo.

Localization.Description: Uma aventura completamente nova em 3D, baseada no filme de animação Vida de Inseto, uma aventura em miniatura.

Localization.Title: X Games Pro Boarder
Localization.Description: X-Games: Pro Boarder is a snowboarding game with several game modes including downhill and half pipe.

Localization.Title: X Games Pro Boarder
Localization.Description: X-Games : Pro Boarder sur PSone est un jeu de snowboard dans lequel, il vous est offert de rider à la fois dans des half pipe, mais aussi sur pistes.

Localization.Title: X Games Pro Boarder
Localization.Description: Leben Sie wie einer der weltbesten Profi-Snowboarder. Messen Sie sich mit den Snowboardern, die diesen Sport beherrschen und geprägt haben. Stellen Sie sich der enormen Herausforderung von XGAMESPROBOARDER

Localization.Title: X Games Pro Boarder
Localization.Description: X-Games: Pro Boarder para PSone es un juego de snowboard donde puedes deslizarte por halfpipes y pistas. En las pistas, tu objetivo es terminar la carrera lo más rápido posible mientras recolectas diversos objetos repartidos por el recorrido.

Localization.Title: X Games Pro Boarder
Localization.Description: X-Games: Pro Boarder is a snowboarding game with several game modes including downhill and half pipe.

Localization.Title: Ape Escape
Localization.Description: A boisterous band of baboons carry out a daring zoo escape.

Localization.Title: Ape Escape
Localization.Description: Ape Escape est un jeu de plates-formes sorti sur Playstation. Spike est un jeune garçon espiègle qui se retrouve projeté dans le passé à cause du grand singe Specter. Vous devrez retrouver tous les singes disparus dans le passé et les attraper.

Localization.Title: Ape Escape
Localization.Description: Ein superintelligenter Affe klaut eine Zeitmaschine, um seine dümmlichen Artgenossen auf die Menschheitshistorie loszulassen und den Lauf der Geschichte zu verändern.

Localization.Title: Ape Escape
Localization.Description: Specter, una atracción popular en el parque de atracciones, se ha transformado en un mono inteligente.

Localization.Title: Ape Escape
Localization.Description: Ape Escape è un gioco platform pubblicato su Playstation. Spike è un ragazzino dispettoso che si ritrova catapultato nel passato dalla grande scimmia Spectre. Dovrai trovare tutte le scimmie scomparse nel passato e catturarle.

Localization.Title: Ape Escape
Localization.Description: Specter, uma atração popular no parque de diversões, tornou-se um macaco inteligente.

Localization.Title: Cool Boarders 3
Localization.Description: The third release in the Cool Boarders series, the sequel to the highly respected and best-selling Cool Boarders 2. This game was the first of the snowboarding franchise to be developed by 989 Studios.

Localization.Title: Cool Boarders 3
Localization.Description: Cool Boarders 3 est un jeu de snowboard disponible sur Playstation. Préparez-vous à dévaler de nombreuses pentes et pistes enneigées dans ce jeu de glisse.

Localization.Title: Cool Boarders 3
Localization.Description: Mehr Strecken, mehr Tricks, mehr Realismus - extreme Snowboard-Action! - 34 neue Rennstrecken mit haarscharfen Kurven, gewagten Sprüngen und vielen Extras - 20 todesmutige Snowboarder mit unterschiedlichen Fähigkeiten, Stärken und Schwächen - 6 Weltklass

Localization.Title: Cool Boarders 3
Localization.Description: El tercer lanzamiento en la serie Cool Boarders. La mecánica de juego y los sistemas de control son significativamente diferentes de los precuelas, pero la estructura básica del juego sigue siendo similar.

Localization.Title: Cool Boarders 3
Localization.Description: The third release in the Cool Boarders series, the sequel to the highly respected and best-selling Cool Boarders 2. This game was the first of the snowboarding franchise to be developed by 989 Studios.

Localization.Title: G-Police: Weapons of Justice
Localization.Description: Taking place only ten days after the events in the original G-Police, the sequel G-Police: Weapons of Justice centers around a group of small gangs in Callisto.

Localization.Title: G-Police : Weapons of Justice
Localization.Description: G-police : Weapons Of Justice est un jeu d'action et de simulation sorti sur Playstation. L'action de G-Police 2 se déroule dix jours exactement après la fin du premier épisode.

Localization.Title: G-Police: Weapons of Justice
Localization.Description: Die Fortsetzung G-Police: Weapons of Justice spielt nur zehn Tage nach den Ereignissen im ursprünglichen G-Police und dreht sich um eine Gruppe kleiner Banden in Callisto.

Localization.Title: G-Police: Weapons of Justice
Localization.Description: La guerra de las corporaciones ha terminado, pero el terror continúa asolando las calles de Callisto. Ahora que la G-Police está siendo investigada, el objetivo es superar los problemas para siempre.

Localization.Title: G-Police: Weapons of Justice
Localization.Description: G-police - Weapons Of Justice è ambientato appena dieci giorni dopo gli eventi del G-Police originale e ruota attorno a un gruppo di piccole bande criminali di Callisto.

Localization.Title: G-Police: Weapons of Justice
Localization.Description: G-Police - Weapons of Justice se passa apenas dez dias após os eventos do G-Police original e gira em torno de um grupo de gangues criminosas de pequena monta em Callisto.

Localization.Title: Running Wild
Localization.Description: This original take on racing sets you up as a bipedal animal, jumping over all sorts of obstacles in an attempt to speed past your wild competition.

Localization.Title: Running Wild
Localization.Description: Disponible sur Playstation, Running Wild est un jeu de courses impliquant des animaux de la jungle.

Localization.Title: Rally Cross 2
Localization.Description: The sequel to the chaotic off-road rally racing game, Rally Cross. The lead programmer, Mark Lyons, and the lead artist, Scott Atkins, from Rally Cross had left Sony and formed a new company, Idol Minds.

Localization.Title: Rally Cross 2
Localization.Description: Rally Cross 2 sur Playstation, reprend le concept de courses chaotiques de son prédécesseur en proposant cette fois-ci plus d'options de personnalisation de sa voiture, comme les suspensions ou autre.

Localization.Title: Rally Cross 2
Localization.Description: Rally Cross 2 für Playstation greift das Konzept der chaotischen Rennen des Vorgängers auf und bietet dieses Mal mehr Optionen zur Fahrzeuganpassung, wie z. B. Federungen oder anderes.

Localization.Title: Rally Cross 2
Localization.Description: La secuela de Rally Cross programada por Idol Minds, conservó el espíritu arcade de la primera entrega, con unos buenos gráficos, el juego ya no permitía jugar hasta 4 jugadores gracias al multitap, como ocurría en la primera parte, pero si se mantuvo el

Localization.Title: Rally Cross 2
Localization.Description: Il sequel del caotico gioco di corse fuoristrada Rally Cross. Il capo programmatore, Mark Lyons, e l'artista principale, Scott Atkins, di Rally Cross avevano lasciato la Sony e avevano formato una nuova società, Idol Minds.

Localization.Title: Rally Cross 2
Localization.Description: The sequel to the chaotic off-road rally racing game, Rally Cross. The lead programmer, Mark Lyons, and the lead artist, Scott Atkins, from Rally Cross had left Sony and formed a new company, Idol Minds.

Localization.Title: Kingsley's Adventure
Localization.Description: Kingsley's Adventure is a 3D Action/Adventure game for the PlayStation in a similar vein as The Legend of Zelda. In the game, you play an orphaned fox called Kingsley who was adopted by the king and queen of the Fruit Kingdom.

Localization.Title: Kingsley's Adventure
Localization.Description: Kingsley's Adventure est un jeu d'aventure plates-formes sorti sur Playstation. Incarnez Kingsley un jeune renard adopté par le Roi et la Reine Carotte.

Localization.Title: Kingsley's Adventure
Localization.Description: Das Reich der Früchte gerät in Gefahr: der finstere Zauberer Übel-Pudding hat die Verteidiger des Landes in dunkle Ritter verwandelt unter deren Joch das Reich erzittert. Nur der kleine Fuchs Kingsley hat den Mut, sich gegen das Böse zu stellen.

Localization.Title: Kingsley's Adventure
Localization.Description: Kingsley's Adventure es un juego de plataformas de aventura lanzado para Playstation. Juega como Kingsley, un joven zorro adoptado por el Rey y la Reina Zanahoria. Bad Cream, el antiguo rey del castillo busca venganza por su destierro.

Localization.Description: Recrée la légende de Mulan grâce aux jeux, aux activités et autres de cette aventure enchanteresse! habille Mulan et Mushu, crée tes propres histoires grâce a l'impérial inventeur d'histoires et chante avec tous tes personnages préférés.

Localization.Description: Sie sind eingeladen, die Charaktere Mulan und Mushu auf ihrer Lebensreise zu begleiten.

Localization.Title: Dragon Valor (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Dragon Valor is a hack-and-slash medieval action game with some light rpg and puzzle-solving touches.

Localization.Title: Dragon Valor (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Dragon Valor est un jeu de rôle orienté action sur Playstation. Vous incarnez Clovis, un jeune homme qui cherche à se venger du dragon qui a tué sa soeurette. Pour cela, il dispose de nombreux power-up et d'une puissante épée nommée Dragon Valor.

Localization.Title: Dragon Valor (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Dragon Valor ist ein mittelalterliches Hack-and-Slash-Actionspiel mit leichten RPG- und Rätsel-Lösungselementen.

Localization.Title: Dragon Valor (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Dragon Valor es un juego de acción medieval de hack-and-slash con algunos elementos ligeros de RPG y algunos toques de rompecabezas.

Localization.Title: Dragon Valor (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Molte leggende narrano di una formidabile creatura magica: il drago. La fredda pelle a scaglie, lo sguardo crudele e i denti simili a pugnali d'avorio terrorizzano anche gli uomini piú coraggiosi.

Localization.Title: Dragon Valor (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Dragon Valor is a hack-and-slash medieval action game with some light rpg and puzzle-solving touches.

Localization.Title: Ridge Racer Type 4
Localization.Description: Powering beyond RIDGE and RAGE RACER, high-speed control and advanced dynamics accekerate the rush of a first class victory.

Localization.Title: Ridge Racer Type 4
Localization.Description: Ridge Racer Type 4 sur Playstation est un jeu de courses totalement arcade. Vous démarrez avec 8 voitures au choix mais pouvez en débloquer beaucoup plus (un peu plus de 300) en tournant sur les 8 circuits présents et sur leur 8 versions miroir.

Localization.Title: Ridge Racer Type 4
Localization.Description: R4 Ridge Racer Type 4 kombiniert die Arcade-Fahraction seiner Vorgänger mit Elementen im Simulationsstil wie Custom Cars und der Teilnahme an einer kompletten Rennsaison.

Localization.Title: Ridge Racer Type 4
Localization.Description: Disfruta todavía más de la alta velocidad y la avanzada dinámica de Ridge Racer y Rage Racer, para conseguir victorias aún más emocionantes. El juego se basa en competir en el Real Racing Roots '99 (RRR), que consta de ocho carreras entre Japón y los EE.

Localization.Title: Ridge Racer Type 4
Localization.Description: Superando RIDGE e RAGE RACER, il controllo ad alta velocità e le dinamiche avanzate accekerano l'entusiasmo di una vittoria di prima classe.

Localization.Title: Ridge Racer Type 4
Localization.Description: O Ridge Racer Type 4 na Playstation é um jogo de corridas arcade. Comece com 8 carros à escolha, desbloqueando muitos mais correndo nas 8 pistas disponíveis e também nas suas versões espelhadas.

Localization.Title: Star Ixiom
Localization.Description: Star Ixiom is a remake of the classic 1985 game Star Luster. You play the role of a pilot for The United Galaxy Space Force, fighting alien invaders with the help of the strategic mobile battle unit "Team Gaia".

Localization.Title: Star Ixiom
Localization.Description: Star Ixiom est un jeu de tir sur Playstation. Il s'agit du remake de Star Luster, un titre sorti en 1985 sur Nes. Vous incarnez un membre de la Team Gaïa, chargée de défendre l'univers humain en cas d'attaque.

Localization.Title: Star Ixiom
Localization.Description: Star Ixiom ist ein Ballerspiel für die Playstation. Dies ist das Remake von Star Lustre, einem Titel, der 1985 auf Nes veröffentlicht wurde.

Localization.Title: Star Ixiom
Localization.Description: Star Ixiom es un remake del clásico juego de 1985 Star Luster. Juegas en el papel de un piloto de la Fuerza Espacial de la Galaxia Unida, luchando contra invasores alienígenas con la ayuda de la unidad de batalla móvil estratégica «Equipo Gaia».

Localization.Title: Star Ixiom
Localization.Description: Star Ixiom is a remake of the classic 1985 game Star Luster. You play the role of a pilot for The United Galaxy Space Force, fighting alien invaders with the help of the strategic mobile battle unit "Team Gaia".

Localization.Title: Star Ixiom
Localization.Description: Star Ixiom é um remake do clássico jogo de 1985 Star Luster. Você desempenha o papel de um piloto pela The United Galaxy Space Force, lutando contra invasores alienígenas com a ajuda da unidade estratégica de batalha móvel "Team Gaia".

Localization.Title: NHL FaceOff 99
Localization.Description: NHL FaceOff 99 improves upon its predecessor by upping the number of polygons by 20% and doubling the amount of textures.

Localization.Title: NHL FaceOff 99
Localization.Description: Dans le jeu de hockey sur glace NHL FaceOff 99 sur Playstation, vivez soixante minutes de sport extrême à vous couper le souffle.

Localization.Title: NHL FaceOff 99
Localization.Description: Erleben Sie im Eishockeyspiel NHL FaceOff 99 auf der Playstation 60 Minuten atemberaubenden Extremsport.

Localization.Title: NHL FaceOff 99
Localization.Description: En el juego de hockey sobre hielo NHL FaceOff 99 para Playstation, experimenta sesenta minutos de impresionantes deportes extremos.

Localization.Title: NHL FaceOff 99
Localization.Description: NHL FaceOff 99 improves upon its predecessor by upping the number of polygons by 20% and doubling the amount of textures.

Localization.Title: NHL FaceOff 99

Localization.Title: Disney/Pixar Små-kryp
Localization.Description: Disney's Pixar - A Bug's Life - Activity Center is one of the activity centers from Disney, in the game the kids have a great time exploring ant island and playing games with Flik, Dot and Francis.

Localization.Title: Disney/Pixar Små-kryp
Localization.Description: Disney's Pixar - A Bug's Life - Activity Center est l'un des centres d'activités de Disney. Dans ce jeu, les enfants s'amusent à explorer l'île aux fourmis et à jouer avec Flik, Dot et Francis.

Localization.Title: Disney/Pixar Små-kryp
Localization.Description: Disney's Pixar - A Bug's Life - Activity Center ist eines der Aktivitätszentren von Disney. Im Spiel haben die Kinder viel Spaß beim Erkunden der Ameiseninsel und beim Spielen mit Flik, Dot und Francis.

Localization.Title: Disney/Pixar Små-kryp
Localization.Description: Disney's Pixar - A Bug's Life - Activity Center es uno de los centros de actividades de Disney, en el juego los niños se divierten mucho explorando la isla de las hormigas y jugando con Flik, Dot y Francis.

Localization.Title: Disney/Pixar Små-kryp
Localization.Description: Disney's Pixar - A Bug's Life - Activity Center è uno dei centri di attività della Disney, nel gioco i bambini si divertono moltissimo ad esplorare l'isola delle formiche e giocare con Flik, Dot e Francis.

Localization.Title: Disney/Pixar Små-kryp
Localization.Description: Disney's Pixar - A Bug's Life - Activity Center is one of the activity centers from Disney, in the game the kids have a great time exploring ant island and playing games with Flik, Dot and Francis.

Localization.Title: Legend of Legaia
Localization.Description: After creating a massive world with vast oceans, landscapes and an infinite universe, God instituted human beings to keep his creation in order.

Localization.Title: Legend of Legaia
Localization.Description: Legend of Legaia est un jeu de rôle sur Playstation dans lequel une étrange brume transforme les êtres vivants en sinistres mutants. Le seul espoir ? Raviver les arbres de la genèse.

Localization.Title: Legend of Legaia
Localization.Description: Ein unheimlicher Nebel bedeckt die Welt von Legaia in Legend of Legaia für PS1. Allen, die mit ihm in Berührung kamen, brachte er Wahnsinn und Verderben. Um zu überleben, hat sich die Bevölkerung an den Rand ihrer Zivilisation zurückgezogen.

Localization.Title: Legend of Legaia
Localization.Description: La historia nos narra que en la antigüedad fueron creados unos seres llamados Seru. Los seru eran una especie de estatuas que al acoplarse con un humano multiplicaban sus habilidades por 10.

Localization.Title: Legend of Legaia
Localization.Description: Dopo aver creato un mondo enorme con vasti oceani, paesaggi e un universo infinito, Dio ha istituito gli esseri umani per mantenere in ordine la sua creazione.

Localization.Title: Legend of Legaia
Localization.Description: After creating a massive world with vast oceans, landscapes and an infinite universe, God instituted human beings to keep his creation in order.

Localization.Title: Um Jammer Lammy
Localization.Description: Introducing Lammy, a totally rockin' guitarist.

Localization.Title: Um Jammer Lammy
Localization.Description: Um Jammer Lammy est un jeu musical sur Playstation. Vous devez suivre une rythmique imposée par la chanson en appuyant quand il le faut sur les bonnes touches et dans le bon rythme quand les icônes s'affichent en haut de l'écran.

Localization.Title: Um Jammer Lammy
Localization.Description: Um Jammer Lammy ist ein Musikspiel auf der Playstation. Sie müssen einem vom Lied vorgegebenen Rhythmus folgen, indem Sie bei Bedarf und im richtigen Rhythmus die richtigen Tasten drücken, wenn die Symbole oben auf dem Bildschirm erscheinen.

Localization.Title: Um Jammer Lammy
Localization.Description: Presentamos a Lammy, un guitarrista rockero que en la vida cotidiana, es bastante tímida.

Localization.Title: Um Jammer Lammy
Localization.Description: Introducing Lammy, a totally rockin' guitarist.

Localization.Title: Um Jammer Lammy
Localization.Description: Introducing Lammy, a totally rockin' guitarist.

Localization.Title: R-Type Delta
Localization.Description: The Bydo Empire has returned to Earth with a vengeance. This time, they will not accept defeat so easily. Earth however, is ready for them... Three R-Class ships: the R-9, the R-13, and the prototype R-X, are your weapons in this war.

Localization.Title: R-Type Delta
Localization.Description: R-Type Delta est un jeu de tir sur Playstation. Les aliens décident que notre vieille Terre est intéressante et ils y construisent un camp de vacances permanent.

Localization.Title: R-Type Delta
Localization.Description: R-Type Delta ist die letzte Folge von Irem's Klassiker Serie der Weltraum Shoot'em up's. Durch die hervorragende 3D-Engine der Play Station kommt dieser Klassiker in einer Brillanz auf den Schirm, die ihresgleichen sucht.

Localization.Title: R-Type Delta
Localization.Description: El Imperio Bydo ha regresado a la Tierra con ganas de venganza. Esta vez, no van a aceptar la derrota tan fácilmente. Sin embargo, en la Tierra, están preparados para ellos ...

Localization.Title: R-Type Delta
Localization.Description: L'Impero Bydo è tornato sulla Terra con una vendetta. Questa volta non accetteranno la sconfitta così facilmente. La Terra, tuttavia, è pronta per loro... Tre navi di Classe R: la R-9, la R-13 e il prototipo R-X, saranno le tue armi in questa guerra.

Localization.Title: R-Type Delta
Localization.Description: O Império Bydo retornou à Terra com uma vingança. Desta vez, eles não aceitarão a derrota tão facilmente. Terra, no entanto, está pronta para eles ... Três navios da classe R: o R-9, o R-13 e o protótipo R-X são suas armas nesta guerra.

Localization.Title: Speed Freaks
Localization.Description: Speed Freaks is a fast go-cart game in a cartoony setting, featuring six different characters and twelve different tracks. The game can be played in four different single-player modes or in multi-player mode with up to four people.

Localization.Title: Speed Freaks
Localization.Description: Speed Freaks est un jeu de courses sur Playstation qui propose les modes de jeu classiques tels que la Course simple, Contre-la-montre, Championnat, et multijoueur.

Localization.Title: Speed Freaks
Localization.Description: Speed ​​​​Freaks ist ein Rennspiel für Playstation, das klassische Spielmodi wie Einzelrennen, Zeitfahren, Meisterschaft und Mehrspielermodus bietet. Sechs Piloten sind am Start: Montgomery, Tabatha, Buster & Wedgie, Monica, Brains und Tempest.

Localization.Title: Speed Freaks
Localization.Description: Speed Freaks es un juego de carrera de karts en un entorno cartoon, con seis personajes diferentes y doce pistas diferentes. El juego se puede jugar en cuatro modos de un solo jugador o en modo multijugador con hasta cuatro personas.

Localization.Title: Speed Freaks
Localization.Description: Speed Freaks is a fast go-cart game in a cartoony setting, featuring six different characters and twelve different tracks. The game can be played in four different single-player modes or in multi-player mode with up to four people.

Localization.Title: Speed Freaks
Localization.Description: Speed Freaks is a fast go-cart game in a cartoony setting, featuring six different characters and twelve different tracks. The game can be played in four different single-player modes or in multi-player mode with up to four people.

Localization.Title: Destrega
Localization.Description: .... Over a 1000 years ago when the Strega suddenly appeared in Zamu'el, a small country located on the edge of the continent. These Strega possessed mysterious powers, and so they were revered and respected by the men and women of Zamu'el.

Localization.Title: Destrega
Localization.Description: Destrega est un jeu d'action sorti sur Playstation. Il y a plus de 1000 ans les Strega apparurent, chargés de pouvoirs magiques et offrirent ces pouvoirs aux hommes sous forme de pierres : les Jeno.

Localization.Title: Destrega
Localization.Description: .... Vor über 1000 Jahren, als die Strega plötzlich in Zamu'el auftauchten, einem kleinen Land am Rande des Kontinents. Diese Strega besaßen mysteriöse Kräfte und wurden daher von den Männern und Frauen von Zamu'el verehrt und respektiert.

Localization.Title: Destrega
Localization.Description: Destrega es uno de los primeros juegos de pelea en enfocarse mas en ataques de largo alcance y usar fondos interactivos en lugar de ataques de corto alcance La historia se desarrolla en torno a la batalla por el control de las reliquias dejadas hace un m

Localization.Description: A sequel to the popular Smash Court Tennis series, this time endorsed and starring Russia's tennis minx, Anna Kournikova. Anna Kournikova is here to show you how its done.

Localization.Title: Anna Kournikova's Smash Court Tennis
Localization.Description: Anna Kournikova's Smash Court Tennis est un jeu de sport sorti sur Playstation. La grande championne parraine ce jeu de tennis où tous les coups classiques sont possibles, ainsi qu'un mode entraînement qui vous permet de vous préparez avant les tournois.

Localization.Title: Anna Kournikova's Smash Court Tennis
Localization.Description: Namcos klassisches, fesselndes Gameplay und der Tennisstar von Weltrang bietet Multiplayer-Spaß vom Feinsten - nur für die Play Station. Lernen Sie richtig Tennis zu spielen. Üben Sie im umfassenden Trainingsmodus. Verschiedene Spielmodie wie z.B.

Localization.Title: Anna Kournikova's Smash Court Tennis
Localization.Description: Una secuela de la popular serie Smash Court Tennis de Namco, esta vez protagonizada por la estrella de tenis rusa, Anna Kournikova en la versión pal del juego.

Localization.Description: A sequel to the popular Smash Court Tennis series, this time endorsed and starring Russia's tennis minx, Anna Kournikova. Anna Kournikova is here to show you how its done.

Localization.Title: This Is Football
Localization.Description: This Is Football is a football (soccer) video game series of Sony Computer Entertainment Europe (SCEE) by London Studio. It first appeared on the PlayStation in 1999.

Localization.Title: This Is Football
Localization.Description: Le Monde Des Bleus est un jeu de sport sorti sur Playstation. A vous les joies de la balle au pied dans ce jeu centré sur l'Equipe de France.

Localization.Title: This Is Football
Localization.Description: This Is Football ist ein Sportspiel, das auf der Playstation veröffentlicht wurde. In diesem Spiel, bei dem die französische Mannschaft im Mittelpunkt steht, können Sie die Freude am Ball genießen.

Localization.Title: This Is Football
Localization.Description: Esto es fútbol es una serie de videojuegos de fútbol de Sony Computer Entertainment Europe (SCEE) realizada por London Studio. Apareció por primera vez en la PlayStation en 1999.

Localization.Title: This Is Football
Localization.Description: This Is Football is a football (soccer) video game series of Sony Computer Entertainment Europe (SCEE) by London Studio. It first appeared on the PlayStation in 1999.

Localization.Title: Wip3out
Localization.Description: A futuristic racing game where the player pilots a high speed hover craft around a series of themed circuits, competing against a number of aggressive opponents.

Localization.Title: Wip3out
Localization.Description: Avec Wip3out sur Playstation faites monter votre adrénaline au plus haut sur des circuits complètement déjantés à bord de vaisseaux défiant les lois de la gravité et de la vitesse. Les premières places du podium se gagnent grâce à un arsenal dévastateur.

Localization.Title: Wip3out
Localization.Description: Das atemberaubende Anti-Gravitations-Rennen geht in die dritte Runde. Noch schneller, noch spannender und noch adrenalintreibender als je zuvor.

Localization.Title: Wip3out
Localization.Description: Juego de carreras futurista donde el jugador pilota una nave a alta velocidad a través de diferentes circuitos, compitiendo con agresivos oponentes.

Localization.Title: Wip3out
Localization.Description: A futuristic racing game where the player pilots a high speed hover craft around a series of themed circuits, competing against a number of aggressive opponents.

Localization.Title: Wip3out
Localization.Description: Com o Wip3out em Playstation, ponha a sua adrenalina a bombear em pistas loucas a bordo de navios que desafiam as leis da gravidade e da velocidade. Os primeiros lugares no pódio são conquistados graças a um arsenal devastador.

Localization.Title: Syphon Filter
Localization.Description: Gabriel Logan, one of the government's top covert agents, must neutralize the terrorists that threaten Washington D.C. and destroy a biological weapon that has been built to end the lives of millions of innocent people.

Localization.Title: Syphon Filter
Localization.Description: Les services de renseignements ont découvert qu'une organisation terroriste internationale développe des armes biologiques.

Localization.Title: Syphon Filter
Localization.Description: Der Geheimdienst hat die Machenschaften einer internationalen Terroristenorganisation aufgedeckt, die biologische Kampfwaffen entwickelt. Nun ist Ihr Einsatz gefragt, um ein weltweites Blutbad zu verhindern.

Localization.Title: Syphon Filter
Localization.Description: Objetivo: erradicar el virus Syphon Filter. El Servicio de Inteligencia ha descubierto que una organización internacional, está desarrollando armas biológicas.

Localization.Title: Syphon Filter
Localization.Description: Obiettivo: debellare il virus Syphon Filter. I servizi segreti hanno scoperto che un'organizzazione internazionale sta sviluppando armi biologiche.

Localization.Title: Syphon Filter
Localization.Description: Syphon Filter é um jogo de ação e aventura no Playstation. O terrorista Eric Rhoemer decidiu erradicar os humanos espalhando no planeta um vírus mortal, o Syphon Filter. Apenas dois agentes antiterrorismo podem detê-lo: Gabe Logan e Lian Xing.

Localization.Description: Gabriel Logan, one of the government's top covert agents, must neutralize the terrorists that threaten Washington D.C. and destroy a biological weapon that has been built to end the lives of millions of innocent people.

Localization.Title: Syphon Filter
Localization.Description: Les services de renseignements ont découvert qu'une organisation terroriste internationale développe des armes biologiques.

Localization.Title: Syphon Filter
Localization.Description: Der Geheimdienst hat die Machenschaften einer internationalen Terroristenorganisation aufgedeckt, die biologische Kampfwaffen entwickelt. Nun ist Ihr Einsatz gefragt, um ein weltweites Blutbad zu verhindern.

Localization.Title: Syphon Filter
Localization.Description: Objetivo: erradicar el virus Syphon Filter. El Servicio de Inteligencia ha descubierto que una organización internacional, está desarrollando armas biológicas.

Localization.Title: Syphon Filter
Localization.Description: Obiettivo: debellare il virus Syphon Filter. I servizi segreti hanno scoperto che un'organizzazione internazionale sta sviluppando armi biologiche.

Localization.Title: Syphon Filter
Localization.Description: Syphon Filter é um jogo de ação e aventura no Playstation. O terrorista Eric Rhoemer decidiu erradicar os humanos espalhando no planeta um vírus mortal, o Syphon Filter. Apenas dois agentes antiterrorismo podem detê-lo: Gabe Logan e Lian Xing.

Localization.Title: G-Police: Weapons of Justice
Localization.Description: Taking place only ten days after the events in the original G-Police, the sequel G-Police: Weapons of Justice centers around a group of small gangs in Callisto.

Localization.Title: G-Police : Weapons of Justice
Localization.Description: G-police : Weapons Of Justice est un jeu d'action et de simulation sorti sur Playstation. L'action de G-Police 2 se déroule dix jours exactement après la fin du premier épisode.

Localization.Title: G-Police: Weapons of Justice
Localization.Description: Die Fortsetzung G-Police: Weapons of Justice spielt nur zehn Tage nach den Ereignissen im ursprünglichen G-Police und dreht sich um eine Gruppe kleiner Banden in Callisto.

Localization.Title: G-Police: Weapons of Justice
Localization.Description: La guerra de las corporaciones ha terminado, pero el terror continúa asolando las calles de Callisto. Ahora que la G-Police está siendo investigada, el objetivo es superar los problemas para siempre.

Localization.Title: G-Police: Weapons of Justice
Localization.Description: G-police - Weapons Of Justice è ambientato appena dieci giorni dopo gli eventi del G-Police originale e ruota attorno a un gruppo di piccole bande criminali di Callisto.

Localization.Title: G-Police: Weapons of Justice
Localization.Description: G-Police - Weapons of Justice se passa apenas dez dias após os eventos do G-Police original e gira em torno de um grupo de gangues criminosas de pequena monta em Callisto.

Localization.Title: Rollcage Stage II
Localization.Description: Rollcage Stage II is an arcade-style racing game for PlayStation & Microsoft Windows developed by Attention to Detail, and published by Psygnosis. It is the sequel to Rollcage and was released in 2000.

Localization.Title: Rollcage Stage II
Localization.Description: Rollcage : Stage 2 est un jeu de courses futuriste sur Playstation. La principale originalité du jeu se trouve au niveau des voitures.

Localization.Title: Rollcage Stage II
Localization.Description: Rollcage Stage II ist ein Rennspiel im Arcade-Stil für PlayStation und Microsoft Windows, das von Attention to Detail entwickelt und von Psygnosis veröffentlicht wurde. Es ist die Fortsetzung von Rollcage und wurde im Jahr 2000 veröffentlicht.

Localization.Title: Rollcage Stage II
Localization.Description: Rollcage Stage II es un juego de carreras estilo arcade para PlayStation y Microsoft Windows desarrollado por Attention to Detail y publicado por Psygnosis. Rollcage y fue lanzado en el 2000.

Localization.Title: Rollcage Stage II

Localization.Title: Team Buddies
Localization.Description: One fine and sunny day in the land that Buddies roam, there was a great and mighty disco in a tent. This tent would bob up and down with the music.

Localization.Title: Team Buddies
Localization.Description: Team Buddies est un jeu de plates-formes et de stratégie sur Playstation. Tout est paisible dans Buddieland mais tout change le jour où arrive une grosse éclipse qui fait tomber des caisses sur le pays.

Localization.Title: Team Buddies
Localization.Description: Team Buddies ist ein Plattform- und Strategiespiel für Playstation. In Buddieland ist alles friedlich, aber alles ändert sich, als eine große Sonnenfinsternis eintritt und Kisten auf das Land fallen.

Localization.Title: Team Buddies
Localization.Description: Colores brillantes y un estilo de dibujos animados caracterizan a este shooter en tercera persona.

Localization.Title: Team Buddies
Localization.Description: One fine and sunny day in the land that Buddies roam, there was a great and mighty disco in a tent. This tent would bob up and down with the music.

Localization.Title: Team Buddies
Localization.Description: Num belo dia de sol, na terra por onde os Buddies vagueiam, houve uma grande e poderosa discoteca numa tenda. Esta tenda balançava para cima e para baixo com a música.

Localization.Title: Colony Wars: Red Sun
Localization.Description: Colony Wars: Red Sun (called Colony Wars III: Red Sun in North America) is a space combat simulator video game for the PlayStation developed and released by Psygnosis in 2000.

Localization.Title: Colony Wars : Red Sun
Localization.Description: Colony Wars : Red Sun est un jeu d'action sur Playstation. Aux commandes d'un vaisseau spatial, vous avez le choix entre une vue à la première ou à la troisième personne.

Localization.Title: Colony Wars: Red Sun
Localization.Description: In Colony Wars: Red Sun geht es erneut in den Weltraum. Doch diesmal ist mein kein Pilot der Navy oder der Liga. Sondern ein Söldner namens Alexander Valdemar, der als Minenarbeiter sein Geld verdient.

Localization.Title: Colony Wars: Red Sun
Localization.Description: La lucha por salvar a la humanidad ha empezado... Con Vengeance Wars el combate está en pleno apogeo en los lugares más recónditos de la galaxia.

Localization.Title: Colony Wars: Red Sun
Localization.Description: Colony Wars: Red Sun (chiamato Colony Wars III: Red Sun in Nord America) è un videogioco simulatore di combattimento spaziale per PlayStation sviluppato e pubblicato da Psygnosis nel 2000.

Localization.Title: Colony Wars: Red Sun
Localization.Description: Colony Wars: Red Sun (called Colony Wars III: Red Sun in North America) is a space combat simulator video game for the PlayStation developed and released by Psygnosis in 2000.

Localization.Title: Legend of Legaia
Localization.Description: After creating a massive world with vast oceans, landscapes and an infinite universe, God instituted human beings to keep his creation in order.

Localization.Title: Legend of Legaia
Localization.Description: Legend of Legaia est un jeu de rôle sur Playstation dans lequel une étrange brume transforme les êtres vivants en sinistres mutants. Le seul espoir ? Raviver les arbres de la genèse.

Localization.Title: Legend of Legaia
Localization.Description: Ein unheimlicher Nebel bedeckt die Welt von Legaia in Legend of Legaia für PS1. Allen, die mit ihm in Berührung kamen, brachte er Wahnsinn und Verderben. Um zu überleben, hat sich die Bevölkerung an den Rand ihrer Zivilisation zurückgezogen.

Localization.Title: Legend of Legaia
Localization.Description: La historia nos narra que en la antigüedad fueron creados unos seres llamados Seru. Los seru eran una especie de estatuas que al acoplarse con un humano multiplicaban sus habilidades por 10.

Localization.Title: Legend of Legaia
Localization.Description: Dopo aver creato un mondo enorme con vasti oceani, paesaggi e un universo infinito, Dio ha istituito gli esseri umani per mantenere in ordine la sua creazione.

Localization.Title: Formula One 99
Localization.Description: An UK developed racing game based on 1999's Formula One Season. Every team and pilot is registered, as well as all 16 courses including the new (at the time) Sepang track at Malaysia.

Localization.Title: Formula One 99
Localization.Description: Formula One 99 est une simulation de courses de F1 sur Playstation. Elle propose 16 circuits officiels de la saison 1999 dont le circuit malaisien de Kuala Lumpur. Les pilotes et écuries correspondantes sont aussi de la partie.

Localization.Title: Formula One 99
Localization.Description: Ein in Großbritannien entwickeltes Rennspiel, das auf der Formel-1-Saison 1999 basiert. Jedes Team und jeder Pilot ist registriert, ebenso wie alle 16 Kurse, einschließlich der (damals) neuen Sepang-Strecke in Malaysia.

Localization.Title: Formula One 99
Localization.Description: Un juego de carreras desarrollado en el Reino Unido y basado en la temporada de Fórmula 1 de 1999. Todos los equipos y pilotos están registrados, así como los 16 circuitos, incluido el nuevo (en aquella época) circuito de Sepang, en Malasia.

Localization.Title: Formula One 99
Localization.Description: An UK developed racing game based on 1999's Formula One Season. Every team and pilot is registered, as well as all 16 courses including the new (at the time) Sepang track at Malaysia.

Localization.Title: Tiny Toon Adventures: Buster and the Beanstalk
Localization.Description: From the Warner Bros. animated series Steven Spielberg Presents TINY TOON ADVENTURES comes a point-and-click treasure hunt game for your PlayStation.

Localization.Title: Tiny Toon Adventures : Buster and the Beanstalk
Localization.Description: Tiny Toon Adventures : Buster and the Beanstalk est un jeu d'aventure sur Playstation. Ce jeu revisite des comptines populaires et les remet au goût du jour en les adaptant au style des dessins animés classiques Warner Bros.

Localization.Title: Tiny Toon Adventures: Buster and the Beanstalk
Localization.Description: Tiny Toon Adventures: Die große Bohnenstange ist das erste Tiny Toon Adventures-Spiel, das auf der PlayStation veröffentlicht wurde. Es wurde von Terraglyph Interactive Studios entwickelt und am 27. Oktober 1998 von NewKidCo veröffentlicht.

Localization.Title: Tiny Toon Adventures: Buster and the Beanstalk
Localization.Description: El juego es esencialmente una adaptación del clásico cuento de hadas, "Jack y las Habichuelas Mágicas" sólo que con Buster y Plucky cubriendo los papeles.

Localization.Title: Tiny Toon Adventures: Buster and the Beanstalk
Localization.Description: Dalla serie animata Warner Bros. Steven Spielberg Presents TINY TOON ADVENTURES arriva una caccia al tesoro punta e clicca per la tua PlayStation.

Localization.Title: Tiny Toon Adventures: Buster and the Beanstalk
Localization.Description: From the Warner Bros. animated series Steven Spielberg Presents TINY TOON ADVENTURES comes a point-and-click treasure hunt game for your PlayStation.

Localization.Title: Muppet RaceMania
Localization.Description: Muppet Race Mania lets you race go-karts with the Jim Henson critters, in a game with nods to Super Mario Kart.

Localization.Title: Muppet RaceMania
Localization.Description: Muppet RaceMania est un jeu de courses sur Playstation. Les célèbres personnages du Muppet Show font maintenant la course.

Localization.Title: Muppet RaceMania
Localization.Description: Und nun heißt es endlich Vorhang auf für Kermit und Co. zu ihrem PlayStation Debüt.

Localization.Title: Muppet RaceMania
Localization.Description: Muppet Race Mania lets you race go-karts with the Jim Henson critters, in a game with nods to Super Mario Kart.

Localization.Title: Muppet RaceMania
Localization.Description: Muppet Race Mania ti permette di correre sui go-kart con le creature di Jim Henson, in un gioco che fa cenno a Super Mario Kart.

Localization.Title: Kurushi Final
Localization.Description: Times are hard for puzzle games. In the high-stress, multi-tasking, Ritalin-craving lifestyle of a majority of game consumers, there is little room for amusement of the purely analytical persuasion. Puzzle game creators do however persevere.

Localization.Title: Kurushi Final
Localization.Description: Kurushi Final sur Playstation est un jeu de réflexion dans lequel votre personnage se retrouve coincé sur une plate-forme avec des cubes qui avancent inexorablement vers lui. Son but et de les faire disparaître pour ne pas être écrasé.

Localization.Title: Kurushi Final
Localization.Description: Kurushi Final ist ein Intelligenztest der besonderen Art. Der Spieler sieht sich riesigen Würfeln gegenüber stehen, die unaufhaltsam auf ihn zu rollen.

Localization.Title: Kurushi Final
Localization.Description: Dando un nuevo significado a la frase "bloqueo mental", "Kurushi Final: Mental Blocks" lo desafía a poner a prueba su inteligencia contra un poder superior, 9 etapas de estiramiento de la mente, más modo de supervivencia para 2 jugadores, 100 desafíos ad

Localization.Title: Kurushi Final
Localization.Description: Sono tempi difficili per i giochi rompicapo. Nello stile di vita stressante, multitasking e dipendente dal Ritalin della maggior parte dei consumatori di videogiochi, c'è poco spazio per il divertimento puramente analitico.

Localization.Title: Disney/Pixar A Bug's Life: Disney's Activity Centre
Localization.Description: Disney's Pixar - A Bug's Life - Activity Center is one of the activity centers from Disney, in the game the kids have a great time exploring ant island and playing games with Flik, Dot and Francis.

Localization.Title: Disney/Pixar A Bug's Life : Disney's Activity Centre
Localization.Description: Disney's Pixar - A Bug's Life - Activity Center est l'un des centres d'activités de Disney. Dans ce jeu, les enfants s'amusent à explorer l'île aux fourmis et à jouer avec Flik, Dot et Francis.

Localization.Title: Disney/Pixar A Bug's Life: Disney's Activity Centre
Localization.Description: Disney's Pixar - A Bug's Life - Activity Center ist eines der Aktivitätszentren von Disney. Im Spiel haben die Kinder viel Spaß beim Erkunden der Ameiseninsel und beim Spielen mit Flik, Dot und Francis.

Localization.Title: Disney/Pixar A Bug's Life: Disney's Activity Centre
Localization.Description: Disney's Pixar - A Bug's Life - Activity Center es uno de los centros de actividades de Disney, en el juego los niños se divierten mucho explorando la isla de las hormigas y jugando con Flik, Dot y Francis.

Localization.Title: Disney/Pixar A Bug's Life: Disney's Activity Centre
Localization.Description: Disney's Pixar - A Bug's Life - Activity Center è uno dei centri di attività della Disney, nel gioco i bambini si divertono moltissimo ad esplorare l'isola delle formiche e giocare con Flik, Dot e Francis.

Localization.Title: Destruction Derby Raw
Localization.Description: Though not a product of Psygnosis, Destruction Derby Raw retains the same emphasis on wanton vehicular destruction as its forebears. "Wreckin' Racing," "Battle," "Smash 4 $," are the three main modes of play, each offering additional sub-modes.

Localization.Title: Destruction Derby Raw
Localization.Description: Destruction Derby Raw est un jeu de courses orienté destruction massive sur Playstation.

Localization.Title: Destruction Derby Raw
Localization.Description: Die zerschmetternde Fortsetzung für den König der Zerstörung! Progressive Fahrzeugschäden mit realistischer Physik. Bis zu 4 Spieler für maximale Zerstörung! Acht verschiedene Spielmodi.

Localization.Title: Destruction Derby Raw
Localization.Description: El tercer título de Destruction Derby en PSX trae todas las nuevas acciones a la pista de carreras.

Localization.Title: Destruction Derby Raw

Localization.Title: Ace Combat 3 : Electrosphere
Localization.Description: Ace Combat 3 : Electrosphere est un jeu d'avion orienté arcade sur Playstation. Dans le futur proche, deux entreprises supranationales se livrent une guerre économique sans merci... jusqu'à ce que le champ de bataille devienne bien réel.

Localization.Title: Ace Combat 3: Electrosphere
Localization.Description: In der gar nicht weit entfernten Zukunft liegt die Macht in den Händen zweier Unternehmen. Militär und Technologie stehen einander gegenüber. In Ihrer Rolle als Pilot einer Friedenssicherungsorganisation müssen Sie diesen Konflikt eindämmen.

Localization.Title: Ace Combat 3: Electrosphere
Localization.Description: Em Ace Combat 3: Electrosphere o jogador toma o lugar de um piloto de caça ace que trabalha para uma organização chamada "UPEO" e tem que realizar várias missões, por exemplo, tirar um porta-aviões especial ou tirar sistemas de satélite inimigos em órbit

Localization.Title: Tiny Tank
Localization.Description: In a future world, an army of steel robots are out to destroy the human race. Our only hope is a little yellow tank armed with some mighty big guns.

Localization.Title: Tiny Tank
Localization.Description: Tiny Tank est un jeu d'action sur Playstation. Passez aux commandes de Tiny Tank, un petit char hargneux qui n'a pas peur de s'attaquer à plus gros que lui.

Localization.Title: Tiny Tank
Localization.Description: Tiny Tank ist ein Actionspiel für Playstation. Übernimm die Kontrolle über Tiny Tank, einen knurrenden kleinen Panzer, der keine Angst davor hat, etwas Größeres als sich selbst in Angriff zu nehmen.

Localization.Title: Tiny Tank
Localization.Description: Tiny Tank es una mezcla única de acción en tercera persona y plataformas. Controlas a Tiny Tank mientras atraviesa niveles llenos de enemigos, obstáculos y trampas mortales.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy VIII (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: A member of an elite military team, Squall is forced into a conflict beyond imagination. To survive, he must contend with a desperate rival, a powerful sorceress, and his own mysterious dreams.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy VIII (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Squall fait partie d'un escadron militaire d'élite et se voit obligé de participer à un conflit dépassant les limites de l'imagination.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy VIII (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: In Final Fantasy VIII schlüpfst du in die Rolle von Squall, einem Mitglied einer Elite-Militärtruppe, der in einen Konflikt mit einem rivalisierenden Gegner, einer mächtigen Hexe und seinen eigenen mysteriösen Träumen verwickelt wird.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy VIII (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Squall, un miembro de un cuerpo de élite del ejército, se ve forzado a entrar en un conflicto que traspasa los límites de la imaginación. Para sobrevivir, debe enfrentarse a un rival desesperado, una poderosa hechicera y a sus propios sueños misteriosos.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy VIII (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Membro di una squadra militare d'élite, Squall è costretto a un conflitto oltre ogni immaginazione. Per sopravvivere, deve lottare con un rivale disperato, una potente strega e con i suoi sogni misteriosi.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy VIII (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: A história se passa em um mundo que mistura elementos de fantasia e ficção científica, seguindo um grupo de jovens mercenários liderados por Squall Leonhart e que trabalham para uma organização chamada SeeD.

Localization.Title: Shadow Madness (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Something is going wrong in the land of Arkose: cities destroy themselves, monsters attack innocent citizens, diseases spread among the people. A giant blast has destroyed a whole town, only a young guy named Stinger narrowly escaped death.

Localization.Title: Shadow Madness (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Shadow Madness est un jeu de rôle sur Playstation. Vous êtes Stinger, un jeune garçon qui a échappé à la destruction de sa ville dans une gigantesque explosion. Avec l'aide de la femme elfe Widleaf et du robot Harv-5, il tente de se venger.

Localization.Title: Shadow Madness (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Shadow Madness ist ein Rollenspiel für Playstation. Du bist Stinger, ein kleiner Junge, der der Zerstörung seiner Stadt durch eine gigantische Explosion entkommen ist. Mit Hilfe der Elfenfrau Widleaf und des Roboters Harv-5 versucht er sich zu rächen.

Localization.Title: Shadow Madness (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Algo anda mal en la tierra de Arkose: las ciudades se destruyen a sí mismas, los monstruos atacan a ciudadanos inocentes, las enfermedades se propagan entre la gente.

Localization.Title: Shadow Madness (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Qualcosa non va nella terra di Arkose: le città si distruggono da sole, i mostri attaccano cittadini innocenti, le malattie si diffondono tra la gente.

Localization.Title: CTR: Crash Team Racing
Localization.Description: It's a multi-player kart racing game starring your favorite bandicoot CRASH and a host of his friends...and foes! The stakes are high and the competition is fierce. Ready...Set...GO!!!

Localization.Title: CTR : Crash Team Racing
Localization.Description: Que le meilleur gagne! Dans ce jeu, amis et ennemis s'affrontent sur la piste pour remporter le prix suprême: la planète Terre!! Face à Nitros Oxide, son plus grand ennemi à ce jour, Crash Bandicoot est obligé de demander l'aide des ses vieux ennemis.

Localization.Title: CTR: Crash Team Racing
Localization.Description: Neo Cortex ist leider nicht der einzige geisteskranke Erfinder auf den drei Inseln, die Crash bewohnt. Dr. Nitros Oxide hat in seiner verrückten Art eine ganz eigene Vorstellung, wie er die Weltherrschaft an sich reißen kann.

Localization.Title: CTR: Crash Team Racing
Localization.Description: La historia del juego gira en torno a un malvado extraterrestre llamado Nitrous Oxide, el cual ha viajado por toda la galaxia pregonándose a sí mismo como el corredor más rápido.

Localization.Title: CTR: Crash Team Racing
Localization.Description: La storia del gioco ruota attorno a un alieno malvagio di nome Nitrous Oxide, che ha viaggiato per l'intera galassia sbandierandosi come il corridore più veloce.

Localization.Title: CTR: Crash Team Racing
Localization.Description: O famoso marsupial laranja retorna para o quarto e final jogo no PlayStation, desta vez entre rodas de kart.

Localization.Title: Omega Boost
Localization.Description: AlphaCore, the world's first sentient cyber-organism, has begun to mistrust its human masters. Slowly, it begins to spread, expanding its capabilities into neighboring systems.

Localization.Title: Omega Boost
Localization.Description: Omega Boost sur Playstation est un jeu d'action qui vous place aux commandes d'un gigantesque exosquelette. Vous avez pour mission de sauver le monde d'un virus informatique qui a tout infecté.

Localization.Title: Omega Boost
Localization.Description: Omega Boost für Playstation ist ein Actionspiel, bei dem Sie die Kontrolle über ein gigantisches Exoskelett übernehmen. Ihre Mission ist es, die Welt vor einem Computervirus zu retten, der alles infiziert hat.

Localization.Title: Omega Boost
Localization.Description: Tendrás que repeler ataques que te lloverán desde todos los flancos en inmensos escenarios de batalla en 3D con OMEGA BOOST, la sobrecogedora aventura del futuro que llega de la mano de los creadores de Gran Turismo.

Localization.Title: Omega Boost
Localization.Description: AlphaCore, the world's first sentient cyber-organism, has begun to mistrust its human masters. Slowly, it begins to spread, expanding its capabilities into neighboring systems.

Localization.Title: Everybody's Golf 2
Localization.Description: Everybody's Golf 2 (GOLF2 Minna no Golf 2?) (Hot Shots Golf 2 in North America) is the second game in the Everybody's Golf series and the second game released for PlayStation.

Localization.Title: Everybody's Golf 2
Localization.Description: Everybody's Golf 2 est un jeu de golf accessible sur Playstation. En solo, il est possible d'opter pour un tutorial puis de se lancer dans un tournoi (qui débloque des parcours) ou un mode Versus (qui débloque de nouveaux personnages).

Localization.Title: Everybody's Golf 2
Localization.Description: Everybody's Golf 2 (GOLF2 Minna no Golf 2?) (Hot Shots Golf 2 in Nordamerika) ist das zweite Spiel der Everybody's Golf-Reihe und das zweite Spiel, das für PlayStation veröffentlicht wurde. Es wurde am 29. Juli 1999 in Japan, am 29.

Localization.Title: Everybody's Golf 2
Localization.Description: Juego de golf, al igual que el original, hay varios personajes para elegir y muchos más para desbloquear a lo largo del juego.

Localization.Title: Everybody's Golf 2
Localization.Description: Gioco di golf, come l'originale, ci sono diversi personaggi tra cui scegliere e molti altri da sbloccare durante il gioco.

Localization.Title: Everybody's Golf 2
Localization.Description: Everybody's Golf 2 (GOLF2 Minna no Golf 2?) (Hot Shots Golf 2 in North America) is the second game in the Everybody's Golf series and the second game released for PlayStation.

Localization.Title: Tombi! 2
Localization.Description: Explore an all new 3D world. Use your trusty fire hammer, ice boomerang or or blackjack to turn the evil pigs into bacon. Throw on super-duds like a flying squirrel suit or high speed turbo pants. There's no limit to the stuff you can do.

Localization.Title: Tombi! 2
Localization.Description: Tombi! 2 est un jeu d'action et de plates-formes sur Playstation. Les cochons frappeurs ont encore décidé de frapper mais Tombi ne les laissera pas faire.

Localization.Title: Tombi! 2
Localization.Description: Tombi und seine Freunde Zippo sind auf der Suche nach Tombis Freundin Tabby.

Localization.Title: Tombi! 2
Localization.Description: Tombi regresa a nuestra PlayStation en una genial aventura donde el 3D toma mayor protagonismo que en el anterior capítulo. Esta vez sin comerlo ni beberlo se ve envuelto en la situación de que han raptado a su novia Tabby.

Localization.Title: Tombi! 2
Localization.Description: Tombi ha sconfitto i Maiali Cattivi e ora si rilassa, in compagnia del suo amico, lo scimmiotto Charles. Un giorno, trovandosi nel Villaggio di Tutti gli Esordi, si imbatte in alcuni Maiali Koma.

Localization.Title: Tombi! 2
Localization.Description: Explore um mundo 3D totalmente novo. Use seu confiável martelo de fogo, bumerangue de gelo ou blackjack para transformar os porcos malvados em bacon. Vista roupas super insucessos, como uma roupa de esquilo voador ou calças turbo de alta velocidade.

Localization.Title: In Cold Blood (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: In Cold Blood is adventure and infiltration on Playstation. Seven of the nine missions offered are in fact flashbacks.

Localization.Title: In Cold Blood (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: De Sang Froid, c'est de l'aventure et de l'infiltration sur Playstation. Sept des neuf missions proposées sont en fait des flash-back.

Localization.Title: In Cold Blood (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Ort des Geschehens ist ein Staat in der nahen Zukunft, der die Unabhängigkeit von Rußland erklärt hat.

Localization.Title: In Cold Blood (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: A sangre fría se situa en un futuro cercano donde la amenaza de una nueva guerra mundial entre EE.UU. y China es inminente.

Localization.Title: In Cold Blood (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: In Cold Blood sei schierato nei panni dell'agente M16 John Cord dai servizi segreti britannici per risolvere il mistero della scomparsa di un amico spia americano.

Localization.Title: Magical Tetris Challenge
Localization.Description: Magical Tetris Challenge featuring Mickey is a wonderful puzzle game for the whole family. With the intricate puzzles of Tetris and the magical appeal of Mickey Mouse, Capcom has created a game that families can enjoy together.

Localization.Title: Magical Tetris Challenge
Localization.Description: Défi au Tetris Magique sur Playstation est une version Disney du célèbrissime Tetris. Mickey, Donald, Minnie, Dingo... Tous s'intègrent dans le mode Scénario.

Localization.Title: Magical Tetris Challenge
Localization.Description: Donald Duck hat beim Angeln einen rätselhaften violetten Stein gefunden. Micky Maus ist sicher, daß der nicht von dieser Welt stammt.

Localization.Title: Magical Tetris Challenge
Localization.Description: El pato Donald ha encontrado una misteriosa piedra de color escarlata en el extremo de su caña de pescar. Mickey piensa que proviene de otro mundo.

Localization.Title: Magical Tetris Challenge
Localization.Description: Sfida al Tetris Magico è un fantastico gioco rompicapo per tutta la famiglia. Con gli intricati puzzle di Tetris e il fascino magico di Topolino, Capcom ha creato un gioco che le famiglie possono divertirsi a giocare insieme.

Localization.Title: Magical Tetris Challenge

Localization.Title: Star Ocean: The Second Story (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Star Ocean: The Second Story is a world of magic, science, space travel and deadly demons! Enter a world where love knows no bounds, the evil is neverending and good can overcome all if the heart is just and true.

Localization.Title: Star Ocean : The Second Story (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Star Ocean : The Second Story est un jeu de rôle sur Playstation. Téléporté par erreur sur une planète au bord du chaos, le jeune Claude va devoir trouver un moyen de rentrer chez lui tout en venant en aide aux autochtones.

Localization.Title: Star Ocean: The Second Story (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: In einem endlosen Sternenmeer am Rande des Universums steht eine einzelne, schicksalhafte Begegnung bevor.

Localization.Title: Star Ocean: The Second Story (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: De las acciones de dos héroes dependerá el destino del universo. Escoge a Rena o Claude y guíalos a través de diversas aventuras con tal de que no se cumpla la fatal profecía.

Localization.Title: Star Ocean: The Second Story (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Star Ocean: The Second Story è un gioco di ruolo per Playstation. Teletrasportato per errore su un pianeta sull'orlo del caos, il giovane Claude dovrà trovare un modo per tornare a casa aiutando gli indigeni.

Localization.Title: Star Ocean: The Second Story (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Star Ocean: A segunda história é um mundo de magia, ciência, viagens espaciais e demônios mortais! Entre em um mundo onde o amor não conhece limites, o mal não tem fim e o bem pode superar tudo se o coração for justo e verdadeiro.

Localization.Title: Point Blank 2
Localization.Description: Point Blank 2 is the sequel to the now classic arcade game Point Blank, which was converted to the PlayStation in 1998.

Localization.Title: Point Blank 2
Localization.Description: Point Blank 2 est un jeu d'action sorti sur Playstation. Vous vous amuserez à tirer sur des cibles classiques ou sur des ennemis apparaissant dans un décor.

Localization.Title: Point Blank 2
Localization.Description: Point Blank 2 ist ein Actionspiel, das auf der Playstation veröffentlicht wurde. Sie werden Spaß daran haben, auf klassische Ziele oder auf in einer Umgebung auftauchende Feinde zu schießen.

Localization.Title: Point Blank 2
Localization.Description: Point Blank 2, es la secuela de Point Blank. Usa la GunCon (pistola de luz similar a la del arcade) de Namco, ofrece 70 nuevas galerías de tiro, diferentes modos y un modo para un solo jugador.

Localization.Title: Point Blank 2
Localization.Description: Point Blank 2 è il sequel dell'ormai classico gioco arcade Point Blank, che è stato convertito in PlayStation nel 1998.

Localization.Title: Point Blank 2
Localization.Description: Point Blank 2 is the sequel to the now classic arcade game Point Blank, which was converted to the PlayStation in 1998.

Localization.Title: Disneys Tarzan
Localization.Description: Disney's animated film TARZAN gets the videogame treatment and makes his way to the PlayStation. The game follows the plot of the movie: you must help Tarzan grow from a boy to an adult in the span of 14 levels of action.

Localization.Title: Disneys Tarzan
Localization.Description: Tarzan est un jeu de plates-formes sur Playstation. Enfilez votre fidèle slip en peau de bête car tarzan est de retour et c'est à vous que revient le privilège de le contrôler.

Localization.Title: Disneys Tarzan
Localization.Description: Tarzan erzählt die Geschichte eines Babys, dass im afrikanischen Dschungel von einer liebevollen Affenfamilie aufgezogen wird.

Localization.Title: Disneys Tarzan
Localization.Description: Únete a Tarzán y a sus amigos en una emocionante aventura repleta de acción.

Localization.Title: Disneys Tarzan
Localization.Description: Prendi parte con Tarzan e i suoi amici ad un'avventura emozionante e ricca di azione.

Localization.Title: Disneys Tarzan
Localization.Description: Tarzan é um jogo de plataforma para Playstation. Tarzan está de volta e cabe a você controlá-lo, você terá que atravessar muitos níveis, evitando todos os obstáculos que estão em seu caminho.

Localization.Description: Únete a Tarzán y a sus amigos en una emocionante aventura repleta de acción.

Localization.Title: Disney's Tarzan
Localization.Description: Prendi parte con Tarzan e i suoi amici ad un'avventura emozionante e ricca di azione.

Localization.Title: Disney's Tarzan
Localization.Description: Tarzan é um jogo de plataforma para Playstation. Tarzan está de volta e cabe a você controlá-lo, você terá que atravessar muitos níveis, evitando todos os obstáculos que estão em seu caminho.

Localization.Title: Formula One 99
Localization.Description: An UK developed racing game based on 1999's Formula One Season. Every team and pilot is registered, as well as all 16 courses including the new (at the time) Sepang track at Malaysia.

Localization.Title: Formula One 99
Localization.Description: Formula One 99 est une simulation de courses de F1 sur Playstation. Elle propose 16 circuits officiels de la saison 1999 dont le circuit malaisien de Kuala Lumpur. Les pilotes et écuries correspondantes sont aussi de la partie.

Localization.Title: Formula One 99
Localization.Description: Ein in Großbritannien entwickeltes Rennspiel, das auf der Formel-1-Saison 1999 basiert. Jedes Team und jeder Pilot ist registriert, ebenso wie alle 16 Kurse, einschließlich der (damals) neuen Sepang-Strecke in Malaysia.

Localization.Title: Formula One 99
Localization.Description: Un juego de carreras desarrollado en el Reino Unido y basado en la temporada de Fórmula 1 de 1999. Todos los equipos y pilotos están registrados, así como los 16 circuitos, incluido el nuevo (en aquella época) circuito de Sepang, en Malasia.

Localization.Title: This Is Soccer
Localization.Description: This Is Football is a football (soccer) video game series of Sony Computer Entertainment Europe (SCEE) by London Studio. It first appeared on the PlayStation in 1999.

Localization.Title: This Is Soccer
Localization.Description: Le Monde Des Bleus est un jeu de sport sorti sur Playstation. A vous les joies de la balle au pied dans ce jeu centré sur l'Equipe de France.

Localization.Title: This Is Soccer
Localization.Description: This Is Football ist ein Sportspiel, das auf der Playstation veröffentlicht wurde. In diesem Spiel, bei dem die französische Mannschaft im Mittelpunkt steht, können Sie die Freude am Ball genießen.

Localization.Title: This Is Soccer
Localization.Description: Esto es fútbol es una serie de videojuegos de fútbol de Sony Computer Entertainment Europe (SCEE) realizada por London Studio. Apareció por primera vez en la PlayStation en 1999.

Localization.Title: Pac-Man World: 20th Anniversary
Localization.Description: Twenty years after Pac-Man's first adventure in Pac-Land, Pac-Man returns one day to his house only to find it deserted. Toc-Man and his ghosts have kidnapped Pac-Man's friends, Ms. Pac-Man, Pac Jr.

Localization.Title: Pac-Man World : 20th Anniversary
Localization.Description: Pac-Man World est un jeu de plates-formes sur Playstation vous permettant de jouer avec la plus célèbre petite boule jaune de l'univers vidéoludique dans des décors en 3D.

Localization.Title: Pac-Man World: 20th Anniversary
Localization.Description: Die beliebteste Spielfigur aller Zeiten kehrt für ein neues Abenteuer zurück - nur auf der PlayStation und diesmal in 3D.

Localization.Title: Pac-Man World: 20th Anniversary
Localization.Description: Lanzado durante el 20º aniversario de la creación del popular juego de arcade Pac-Man.

Localization.Title: Pac-Man World: 20th Anniversary
Localization.Description: Il più famoso personaggio di videogiochi di tutti i tempi ritorna in un'avventura in esclusiva per la PlayStation stavolta in versione tridimensionale.

Localization.Title: Cool Boarders 4
Localization.Description: The fourth title in the popular PlayStation snowboarding franchise. This time, choose from 16 pro-riders and 34 boards (or create your own rider and board).

Localization.Title: Cool Boarders 4
Localization.Description: Cool Boarders 4 est un jeu de snowboard sur Playstation doté de cinq circuits. 16 sportifs célèbres ont été modélisés tels que Jim Rippey, J.P. Walker, Michele Taggart ou Noah Salasnek.

Localization.Title: Cool Boarders 4
Localization.Description: Wirbeln sie den Pulverschnee auf! Fahren sie mit 16 Weltklasse-Snowboard-Profis. Große Namen, heiße Boards und irre Tricks.

Localization.Title: Cool Boarders 4
Localization.Description: El cuarto título de la popular franquicia de snowboard de PlayStation. Esta vez, elige entre 16 snowboarders profesionales y 34 tablas (o crea tu propio snowboarder y tabla).

Localization.Title: Cool Boarders 4

Localization.Title: Syphon Filter 2 (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: The sequel to the previous year's Syphon Filter, Syphon Filter 2 adds new features such as a two player mode, new locations, new weapons, and more. The game compares to Goldeneye on the N64. It's a shooter, but you must also use strategy.

Localization.Title: Syphon Filter 2 (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Gabe Logan et Lian Xing sont les deux meilleurs éléments de l'Agence. Ils sont efficaces. Intelligents. Courageux. ... mais ils en savent trop et l'Agence veut les éliminer.

Localization.Title: Syphon Filter 2 (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Siphon Filter 2, die Fortsetzung des letztjährigen Siphon Filter, bietet neue Funktionen wie einen Zwei-Spieler-Modus, neue Orte, neue Waffen und mehr. Das Spiel lässt sich mit Goldeneye auf dem N64 vergleichen.

Localization.Title: Syphon Filter 2 (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Gabe Logan y Lian Xing son los mejores agentes secretos de la Agencia. Son inteligentes, están entregados a su trabajo y se mantienen en plena forma física. Pero la Agencia opiina que saben demasiado, y hay que eliminarlos...

Localization.Title: Syphon Filter 2 (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Il sequel del Syphon Filter dell'anno precedente, Syphon Filter 2 aggiunge nuove funzionalità come una modalità a due giocatori, nuove posizioni, nuove armi e altro ancora. Il gioco è paragonabile a Goldeneye sull'N64.

Localization.Title: Space Debris
Localization.Description: This third-person perspective space shooter casts the player as UED pilot James Bryant, the brash young adventurer who is humanity's last hope. Gameplay takes place across 10 levels with 6 different attack ships to pilot.

Localization.Title: Space Debris
Localization.Description: Space Debris est un jeu d'action sur Playstation.

Localization.Title: Space Debris
Localization.Description: Space Debris ist ein Actionspiel für Playstation.

Localization.Title: Space Debris
Localization.Description: Este shooter espacial de perspectiva en tercera persona arroja al jugador como piloto de la UED, James Bryant, el joven aventurero impetuoso que es la última esperanza de la humanidad.

Localization.Title: Barbie: Race & Ride
Localization.Description: Barbie makes her first appearance on the PlayStation with BARBIE RACE AND RIDE. Help Barbie take care of a stable of horses; groom the horses or feed them a variety of foods including apples, carrots, strawberries, and sugar cubes.

Localization.Title: Barbie : Race & Ride
Localization.Description: Dans Barbie : Aventure Equestre sur Playstation, aidez la poupée à s'occuper d'un haras. Apportez les soins quotidiens aux cheveux, nourrissez-les et profitez d'eux pour vous promener.

Localization.Title: Barbie: Race & Ride
Localization.Description: Barbie hat ihren ersten Auftritt auf der PlayStation mit BARBIE RACE AND RIDE. Hilf Barbie dabei, sich um einen Pferdestall zu kümmern.

Localization.Title: Barbie: Race & Ride
Localization.Description: Barbie hace su primera aparición en PlayStation con BARBIE RACE AND RIDE. Ayuda a Barbie a cuidar un establo de caballos; Acicale a los caballos o aliméntelos con una variedad de alimentos, incluyendo manzanas, zanahorias, fresas y terrones de azúcar.

Localization.Title: Barbie: Race & Ride
Localization.Description: Barbie fa la sua prima apparizione su PlayStation con BARBIE RACE AND RIDE. Aiuta Barbie a prendersi cura di una stalla di cavalli; cura i cavalli o dai loro da mangiare una varietà di cibi tra cui mele, carote, fragole e zollette di zucchero.

Localization.Title: Barbie: Race & Ride
Localization.Description: Barbie faz sua primeira aparição no PlayStation com BARBIE RACE AND RIDE. Ajude Barbie a cuidar de um estábulo de cavalos; escove os cavalos ou alimente-os com uma variedade de alimentos, incluindo maçãs, cenouras, morangos e cubos de açúcar.

Localization.Title: Gran Turismo 2 (Disc 1) (Arcade Mode)
Localization.Description: Gran Turismo 2 is fundamentally based on the racing game genre. The player must maneuver an automobile to compete against artificially intelligent drivers on various race tracks. The game uses two different modes: arcade and simulation.

Localization.Title: Gran Turismo 2 (Disc 1) (Arcade Mode)
Localization.Description: Le stade ultime de la simulation de course. 600 voitures conçues par 33 des plus grands constructeurs automobile au monde... Trouvez le réglage parfait de vos véhicules. 28 circuits dont le célèbre Laguna Seca.

Localization.Title: Gran Turismo 2 (Disc 1) (Arcade Mode)
Localization.Description: „Gran Turismo 2“ kehrt zurück mit über 500 Wagenmodellen und mehr als 20 Strecken. Das Spiel bringt realistische Fahrphysik, detaillierte Streckensimulationen und DUALSHOCK-Vibration für ein authentisches Rennerlebnis.

Localization.Title: Gran Turismo 2 (Disc 1) (Arcade Mode)
Localization.Description: Gran Turismo 2 tiene 22 circuitos, 6 licencias, 600 coches, 6 circuitos de rendimiento y eventos de rally.

Localization.Title: Gran Turismo 2 (Disc 1) (Arcade Mode)
Localization.Description: Gran Turismo 2 ha 22 piste, 6 licenze, 600 auto, 6 piste di performance ed eventi di rally.

Localization.Title: Gran Turismo 2 (Disc 1) (Arcade Mode)
Localization.Description: Gran Turismo 2 é essencialmente um jogo de corrida no qual o jogador deve conduzir um automóvel e competir contra adversários controlados pela inteligência artificial em diferentes pistas. O jogo oferece dois modos distintos: Arcade e Simulação.

Localization.Title: Muppet Monster Adventure
Localization.Description: Muppet Monster Adventure is a action platform game, best compared with Spyro but with Muppet characters and a Halloween or ghost house setting. The story starts with the Muppets attending the reading of Dr. Honeydew recently deceased uncle's will.

Localization.Title: Muppet Monster Adventure
Localization.Description: Muppet Monster Adventure est un jeu d'action/plates-formes sur Playstation.

Localization.Title: Muppet Monster Adventure
Localization.Description: Es ist Halloween im Gruselschloss Honigtau und einige deiner Lieblingsmuppets wurden in groteske Gestalten des Bösen verwandelt. Als Kermits kleiner Neffe Robin musst du Onkel Kermit und seine flauschigen Freunde retten.

Localization.Title: Muppet Monster Adventure
Localization.Description: Muppet Monster Adventure es un juego de plataformas de acción. La historia comienza con los Muppets que asisten a la lectura del testamento del tío del Dr. Honeydew.

Localization.Title: NHL FaceOff 2000
Localization.Description: NHL FaceOff 2000 ist ein Sportspiel auf der Playstation. Sie haben die Wahl zwischen einer Vielzahl von Eishockey-Ausrüstungen und einem Schlag auf dem Eis. Kreieren Sie und nehmen Sie an Ihrem eigenen Team teil.

Localization.Title: NHL FaceOff 2000
Localization.Description: NHL FaceOff 2000 es un juego de deportes para Playstation. Elige entre una multitud de equipos de hockey sobre hielo. Crea y entrena tu propio equipo. Intercambia, devuelve o recluta jugadores.

Localization.Title: Ghoul Panic
Localization.Description: Ghoul Panic is a comedy adventure game, set in a haunted mansion. Using a PlayStation light-gun, take on the might of vampires, monsters, mummies, skeletons and spooks to open the locked doors and uncover hidden bonuses.

Localization.Title: Ghoul Panic
Localization.Description: Ghoul Panic sur Playstation est un jeu de tir prévu pour être joué avec un pistolet en plastique. L'histoire se déroule dans une maison hantée.

Localization.Title: Ghoul Panic
Localization.Description: Ghoul Panic ist ein Comedy-Abenteuerspiel, das in einem Spukhaus spielt.

Localization.Title: Ghoul Panic
Localization.Description: Ghoul Panic es un juego de aventuras y comedia, ambientado en una mansión embrujada. Usando la PlayStation light-gun puedes enfrentarte a vampiros, monstruos, momias, esqueletos y fantasmas, descubre bonificaciones al abrir las puertas cerradas ocultas.

Localization.Title: Ghoul Panic
Localization.Description: Ghoul Panic è un gioco d'avventura comico ambientato in una villa infestata dai fantasmi. Usando una pistola ottica PlayStation, affronta vampiri, mostri, mummie, scheletri e fantasmi per aprire le porte chiuse e scoprire bonus nascosti.

Localization.Title: Ghoul Panic
Localization.Description: Ghoul Panic é um jogo de aventura de comédia, ambientado em uma mansão assombrada. Usando uma PlayStation light-gun, assuma o poder de vampiros, monstros, múmias, esqueletos e espiões para abrir as portas trancadas e descobrir bônus escondidos.

Localization.Title: MediEvil 2
Localization.Description: 16, May 1886 There will be many stories concerning the events that took place in 1886 or as most have come to call it, the Autumn of Death. They have all been dismissed as mere hallucinations, the prattling of drunks or some stage of a sickness.

Localization.Title: MediEvil 2
Localization.Description: Londres au 19ème siècle: la ville est entre les mains du diabolique Lord Palethorn. Il a fait sortir les morts de leur tombe et une horde de démons se déchaîne dans les rues.

Localization.Title: MediEvil 2
Localization.Description: Das London des 19. Jahrhundert wird von dem satanischen Lord Palethorn beherrscht, der die Toten aus ihren Gräbern gezerrt und eine wilde Horde geifernder Dämonen auf die Straßen losgelassen hat.

Localization.Title: MediEvil 2
Localization.Description: En 1386 el poderoso nigromante Zarok, al que se creía muerto, invadió Gallowmere con un ejército de zombis y demonios.

Localization.Title: MediEvil 2
Localization.Description: Nel 1386 il potente negromante Zarok, ritenuto morto, invase Gallowmere con un esercito di zombi e demoni.

Localization.Title: MediEvil 2
Localization.Description: Medievil 2 é um jogo de ação no Playstation que acontece na era vitoriana. O demoníaco Lorde Palethorn começou a criar um exército de mortos-vivos e você deve impedi-lo de dominar o mundo.

Localization.Description: Dragon Valor is a hack-and-slash medieval action game with some light rpg and puzzle-solving touches.

Localization.Title: Colony Wars: Red Sun
Localization.Description: Colony Wars: Red Sun (called Colony Wars III: Red Sun in North America) is a space combat simulator video game for the PlayStation developed and released by Psygnosis in 2000.

Localization.Title: Colony Wars: Red Sun
Localization.Description: In Colony Wars: Red Sun geht es erneut in den Weltraum. Doch diesmal ist mein kein Pilot der Navy oder der Liga. Sondern ein Söldner namens Alexander Valdemar, der als Minenarbeiter sein Geld verdient.

Localization.Title: Colony Wars: Red Sun
Localization.Description: La lucha por salvar a la humanidad ha empezado... Con Vengeance Wars el combate está en pleno apogeo en los lugares más recónditos de la galaxia.

Localization.Title: Tombi! 2
Localization.Description: Explore an all new 3D world. Use your trusty fire hammer, ice boomerang or or blackjack to turn the evil pigs into bacon. Throw on super-duds like a flying squirrel suit or high speed turbo pants. There's no limit to the stuff you can do.

Localization.Title: Tombi! 2
Localization.Description: Tombi! 2 est un jeu d'action et de plates-formes sur Playstation. Les cochons frappeurs ont encore décidé de frapper mais Tombi ne les laissera pas faire.

Localization.Title: Tombi! 2
Localization.Description: Tombi und seine Freunde Zippo sind auf der Suche nach Tombis Freundin Tabby.

Localization.Title: Tombi! 2
Localization.Description: Tombi regresa a nuestra PlayStation en una genial aventura donde el 3D toma mayor protagonismo que en el anterior capítulo. Esta vez sin comerlo ni beberlo se ve envuelto en la situación de que han raptado a su novia Tabby.

Localization.Title: Tombi! 2
Localization.Description: Tombi ha sconfitto i Maiali Cattivi e ora si rilassa, in compagnia del suo amico, lo scimmiotto Charles. Un giorno, trovandosi nel Villaggio di Tutti gli Esordi, si imbatte in alcuni Maiali Koma.

Localization.Title: Tombi! 2
Localization.Description: Explore um mundo 3D totalmente novo. Use seu confiável martelo de fogo, bumerangue de gelo ou blackjack para transformar os porcos malvados em bacon. Vista roupas super insucessos, como uma roupa de esquilo voador ou calças turbo de alta velocidade.
