Localization.Description: Mr Driller is a real-time puzzle game that relies solely on quick-thinking and a bit of planning.

Localization.Title: Mr. Driller
Localization.Description: Mr. Driller sur Playstation est un jeu de puzzle-game qui requiert rapidité de réflexion, car le héros dispose d'une quantité d'oxygène limitée pour exécuter sa tâche.

Localization.Title: Mr. Driller
Localization.Description: Mr Driller ist ein Echtzeit-Puzzlespiel, das sich ausschließlich auf schnelles Denken und etwas Planung stützt.

Localization.Title: Mr. Driller
Localization.Description: Mr Driller es un juego de rompecabezas en tiempo real que se basa únicamente en el pensamiento rápido y un poco de planificación.

Localization.Title: Mr. Driller
Localization.Description: Il mondo di Mr. Driller è stato ricoperto da misteriosi blocchi.

Localization.Title: Mr. Driller
Localization.Description: O mundo do Mr Driller foi coberto por blocos misteriosos.

Localization.Title: Time Crisis: Project Titan
Localization.Description: Players take on the role of the sharp-shooting Richard Miller for another episode of international intrigue and duck-and-shoot action in Time Crisis: Project Titan.

Localization.Title: Time Crisis : Project Titan
Localization.Description: Time Crisis : Project Titan est un jeu de tir sur Playstation.

Localization.Title: Time Crisis: Project Titan
Localization.Description: In Time Crisis: Project Titan übernehmen die Spieler die Rolle des scharfsinnigen Richard Miller in einer weiteren Episode internationaler Intrigen und Duck-and-Shoot-Action.

Localization.Title: Time Crisis: Project Titan
Localization.Description: Los jugadores asumen el papel del francotirador Richard Miller para otro episodio de intriga internacional y acción. Time Crisis: Project Titan es el tercer juego se la serie de Namco y el primero desarrollado exclusivamente para la consola PlayStation.

Localization.Title: Time Crisis: Project Titan
Localization.Description: I giocatori assumono il ruolo del tiratore acuto Richard Miller per un altro episodio di intrighi internazionali e azione di schivata in Time Crisis: Project Titan.

Localization.Title: Time Crisis: Project Titan
Localization.Description: Players take on the role of the sharp-shooting Richard Miller for another episode of international intrigue and duck-and-shoot action in Time Crisis: Project Titan.

Localization.Title: Formula One 2000
Localization.Description: Formula One 2000 is an officially licensed Formula One racing game. The game is the 5th in Psygnosis/Sony series of Formula One racing games. All tracks, teams, cars and drivers from the 2000 season are in the game and can be selected.

Localization.Title: Formula One 2000
Localization.Description: Formula One 2000 sur Playstation est un jeu de courses, plus précisément de Formule 1. A votre disposition les véhicules et pilotes ayant participé à la saison 2000.

Localization.Title: Formula One 2000
Localization.Description: Formula One 2000 ist ein offiziell lizenziertes Formel-1-Rennspiel. Das Spiel ist das fünfte in der Psygnosis/Sony-Reihe von Formel-1-Rennspielen. Alle Strecken, Teams, Autos und Fahrer der Saison 2000 sind im Spiel und können ausgewählt werden.

Localization.Title: Chase the Express (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: The French ambassador Pierre Simon and his family are travelling from Saint Petersburg to Paris aboard the Blue Harvest, a military NATO-developed train, when it is hijacked by terrorists known as the Knights of the Apocalypse.

Localization.Title: Chase the Express (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Chase the Express est un jeu d'action/infiltration à la troisième personne sur Playstation. L'histoire met en scène une organisation terroriste portant le doux nom de Chevaliers de l'Apocalypse.

Localization.Title: Chase the Express (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Nach einem Staatsbesuch in St. Petersburg befindet sich der französiche Botschafter samt Familie in einem Hochsicherheitszug auf dem Weg in die Heimat. Doch mitten im frostigen Russland wird der Express von eienr Terroristengruppe gestürmt.

Localization.Title: Chase the Express (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Chase The Express cuenta la historia de un soldado de las fuerzas de la OTAN, Jack Morton, cuya principal misión era proteger al embajador francés y su familia que viaja en un tren especial, llamado 'Blue Harvest', mientras durase este trayecto.

Localization.Title: Chase the Express (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: L'ambasciatore francese Pierre Simon e la sua famiglia stanno viaggiando da San Pietroburgo a Parigi a bordo del Blue Harvest, un treno militare sviluppato dalla NATO, quando viene dirottato da terroristi noti come i Cavalieri dell'Apocalisse.

Localization.Description: Chase the Express est un jeu d'action/infiltration à la troisième personne sur Playstation. L'histoire met en scène une organisation terroriste portant le doux nom de Chevaliers de l'Apocalypse.

Localization.Title: Chase the Express (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Nach einem Staatsbesuch in St. Petersburg befindet sich der französiche Botschafter samt Familie in einem Hochsicherheitszug auf dem Weg in die Heimat. Doch mitten im frostigen Russland wird der Express von eienr Terroristengruppe gestürmt.

Localization.Title: Chase the Express (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Chase The Express cuenta la historia de un soldado de las fuerzas de la OTAN, Jack Morton, cuya principal misión era proteger al embajador francés y su familia que viaja en un tren especial, llamado 'Blue Harvest', mientras durase este trayecto.

Localization.Title: Crash Bash
Localization.Description: Crash and his friends are back in a knockdown, drag-out arena rumble. Get ready to ride, race, jump, throw, and battle it out to the finish in frantic, head-to-head battles, and heart-pumping chases.

Localization.Title: Crash Bash
Localization.Description: Crash Bash est un party game sur Playstation reprenant l'univers de Crash Bandicoot. Très orienté multijoueur, le titre permet à quatre amis de s'affronter simultanément.

Localization.Title: Crash Bash
Localization.Description: Die Mächte des Guten und des Bösen kämpfen wieder einamal um die Vorherrschaft.

Localization.Title: Crash Bash
Localization.Description: Las fuerzas del bien y del mal vuelven a encontrarse para hacerse con el control. Aku-Aku invita a su viejo amigo Crash Bandicoot para que se una a él en la batalla definitiva...

Localization.Title: Crash Bash
Localization.Description: Crash e i suoi amici sono tornati in un'arena abbattuta e trascinata. Preparati a cavalcare, correre, saltare, lanciare e combattere fino al traguardo in frenetiche battaglie testa a testa e inseguimenti adrenalinici.

Localization.Title: Crash Bash
Localization.Description: Crash Bash é um jogo do mundo de Crash Bandicoot. Multiplayer orientado, o jogo permite que quatro amigos para competir simultaneamente.

Localization.Title: Spyro: Year of the Dragon
Localization.Description: Thieves have kidnapped a brood of dragon eggs, while, elsewhere in the Dragon Lands, a gateway to the Forgotten World has been uncovered.

Localization.Title: Spyro : Year of the Dragon
Localization.Description: Des voleurs ont kidnappé une couvée d'œufs de dragon. Pendant ce temps, au pays des dragons, une porte vers le Monde Oublié a été découverte.

Localization.Title: Spyro: Year of the Dragon
Localization.Description: Diebe haben ein Nest mit Dracheneiern entführt, während gleichzeitig in einem anderen Teil der Drachenwelt ein Tor zu vergessenen Welt entdeckt wurde. Spyro der Drache muss die Eier zurückerobern.

Localization.Title: Spyro: Year of the Dragon
Localization.Description: Unos ladrones han robado una nidada de huevos de dragón, mientras que en otro lugar en las Tierras del Dragón, una puerta al Mundo Olvidado ha aparecido.

Localization.Title: Spyro: Year of the Dragon
Localization.Description: I ladri hanno rapito una nidiata di uova di drago, mentre altrove nelle Terre dei Draghi è stato scoperto un portale per il Mondo Dimenticato.

Localization.Title: Spyro: Year of the Dragon
Localization.Description: Thieves have kidnapped a brood of dragon eggs, while, elsewhere in the Dragon Lands, a gateway to the Forgotten World has been uncovered.

Localization.Title: Terracon
Localization.Description: Terracon is a thirdperson action game for the PlayStation. When a terraforming machine malfunctions you (Xed) are the only surviving member of you race.

Localization.Title: Terracon
Localization.Description: Terracon est un jeu d'action sur Playstation dans lequel l'abominable Terracon est en train de détruire sans pitié la galaxie toute entière planète après planète.

Localization.Title: Terracon
Localization.Description: Terracon ist ein Actionspiel für Playstation, in dem der abscheuliche Terracon gnadenlos die gesamte Galaxie zerstört, Planet für Planet.

Localization.Title: Terracon
Localization.Description: Terracon es un juego de acción en tercera persona para PlayStation. Cuando una máquina de terraformación falla, tú (Xed) eres el único miembro superviviente de tu raza.

Localization.Title: Monster Rancher
Localization.Description: Monster Rancher 2 is at heart an arena fighting game with a lot of ancillary game play thrown in. As a trainer of a fighting monster you have to train, reward, punish, cajole and bribe your minion to build up its statistics.

Localization.Title: Monster Rancher
Localization.Description: Monster Rancher 2 est au fond un jeu de combat d'arène avec beaucoup de jeux auxiliaires.

Localization.Title: Monster Rancher
Localization.Description: Monster Rancher 2 ist im Grunde ein Arena-Kampfspiel mit viel Zusatzspiel. Als Trainer eines kämpfenden Monsters musst du sie trainieren, belohnen, bestrafen, beschwören und bestechen, um seine Statistiken aufzubauen.

Localization.Title: Monster Rancher
Localization.Description: Monster Rancher 2 es, en esencia, un juego de lucha en una arena con un montón de elementos de juego adicionales.

Localization.Title: Vib-Ribbon
Localization.Description: Your rabbity character, Vibri, is composed of some fairly basic geometric shapes. Vibri skips around along the eponymous vib ribbon and you have to control Vibri until the end, dodging obstacles to rack up as many points as you can.

Localization.Title: Vib-Ribbon
Localization.Description: Vib-Ribbon est un jeu d'action sur Playstation. On accompagne Vibri au travers de plusieurs stages pour les trois niveaux de difficulté.

Localization.Title: Vib-Ribbon
Localization.Description: Vib Ribbon ist ein wirklich einzigartiges Spielkonzept, bei dem Vibri, das tanzende Kaninchen, die Bühne betritt. Während Vibri auf einer unendlich langen Linie – dem „Vib Ribbon“ – hüpft und springt, hört er Musik, die ihm hilft, in Bewegung zu bleiben.

Localization.Title: Vib-Ribbon
Localization.Description: Vib-Ribbon es un juego musical. La banda japonesa Laugh and Peace ofrece este juego con parte de su banda sonora. La banda sonora se utiliza para generar los niveles de juego.

Localization.Title: Grind Session
Localization.Description: Grind Session translates the spirit and thrill of hard-core boarding into arcade-style action. Gamers compete in street and tournament competitions, flow on the halfpipe, and freestyle it for the covers of the big skating magazines.

Localization.Title: Grind Session
Localization.Description: Grind Session est un jeu de skateboard sur Playstation. Parmi les modes, on découvre le solitaire, le tournoi, le skate libre, l'endurance et l'entraînement.

Localization.Title: Grind Session
Localization.Description: Grind Session übersetzt den Geist und Nervenkitzel des Hardcore-Boardings in Action im Arcade-Stil.

Localization.Title: Grind Session
Localization.Description: Grind Session es un juego de skateboard para Playstation. Tiene varios modos de juego: solitario, torneo, estilo libre, resistencia y entrenamiento.

Localization.Title: Team Buddies
Localization.Description: One fine and sunny day in the land that Buddies roam, there was a great and mighty disco in a tent. This tent would bob up and down with the music.

Localization.Title: Team Buddies
Localization.Description: Team Buddies est un jeu de plates-formes et de stratégie sur Playstation. Tout est paisible dans Buddieland mais tout change le jour où arrive une grosse éclipse qui fait tomber des caisses sur le pays.

Localization.Title: Team Buddies
Localization.Description: Team Buddies ist ein Plattform- und Strategiespiel für Playstation. In Buddieland ist alles friedlich, aber alles ändert sich, als eine große Sonnenfinsternis eintritt und Kisten auf das Land fallen.

Localization.Title: Team Buddies
Localization.Description: Colores brillantes y un estilo de dibujos animados caracterizan a este shooter en tercera persona.

Localization.Title: Team Buddies
Localization.Description: One fine and sunny day in the land that Buddies roam, there was a great and mighty disco in a tent. This tent would bob up and down with the music.

Localization.Title: Team Buddies
Localization.Description: Num belo dia de sol, na terra por onde os Buddies vagueiam, houve uma grande e poderosa discoteca numa tenda. Esta tenda balançava para cima e para baixo com a música.

Localization.Title: Disney's Aladdin in Nasira's Revenge
Localization.Description: Disney's Aladdin in Nasira's Revenge is set after the events of The Return of Jafar, during the television series and before Aladdin and the King of Thieves.

Localization.Title: Disney's Aladdin in Nasira's Revenge
Localization.Description: Aladdin : La Revanche de Nasira est un jeu d'action et de plates-formes en 3D sur Playstation. L'histoire prend place après la défaite du sorcier Jafar. Sa soeur Nasira tente alors de ressusciter son démoniaque frérot pour tenter de s'emparer du pouvoir.

Localization.Title: Disney's Aladdin in Nasira's Revenge
Localization.Description: Aladdin steht vor seinem bisher größten Abenteuer.

Localization.Title: Disney's Aladdin in Nasira's Revenge
Localization.Description: Aladdín va a enfrentarse a la mayor de sus aventuras.

Localization.Title: Disney's Aladdin in Nasira's Revenge
Localization.Description: Aladdin: Nasira's Revenge è un platform d'azione 3D per Playstation. La storia si svolge dopo la sconfitta dello stregone Jafar. Sua sorella Nasira cerca quindi di resuscitare suo fratello demone per cercare di prendere il potere.

Localization.Title: Disney's Aladdin in Nasira's Revenge
Localization.Description: Aladdin: Nasira's Revenge é um jogo de ação e plataforma em 3D para Playstation. A história se passa após a derrota do feiticeiro Jafar. Sua irmã Nasira então tenta ressuscitar seu irmão demônio para tentar tomar o poder.

Localization.Title: Disney's The Emperor's New Groove
Localization.Description: Take the role of the jaded Incan Emperor, Kuzco, in The Emperor's New Groove. Unfortunately, Kuzco has been turned into a llama.

Localization.Title: Disney's The Emperor's New Groove
Localization.Description: Kuzco, l'Empereur Mégalo est un jeu de plates-formes sur Playstation. Le grand Empereur Kuzco est soudainement transformé en lama par une mystérieuse potion magique.

Localization.Title: Disney's The Emperor's New Groove
Localization.Description: König Kusco hat's wirklich schwer. Eben war er noch wie gewohnt am Regieren, und plötzlich hat er ausgerechnet die Gestalt eines Lamas angenommen.

Localization.Title: Disney's The Emperor's New Groove
Localization.Description: No es nada fácil ser el poderosísimo emperador Kuzco. Tan pronto estás dando órdenes a diestro y siniestro, como al rato te ves convertido en una miserable llama...

Localization.Title: Disney's The Little Mermaid II
Localization.Description: Based upon both episodes of the popular The Little Mermaid movies, Disney's The Little Mermaid II is an action-adventure game in which players take control of Ariel and her daughter Melody through 3D environments found in the films.

Localization.Title: Disney's The Little Mermaid II
Localization.Description: Dans La Petite Sirène 2 sur Playstation, rejoignez Mélodie, Ariel et leurs fidèles amis, Sébastien et Polochon, et découvrez des lieux enchantés et des fabuleuses activités sous-marines ! Aux côtés de Mélodie, explorez l'océan à la recherche de trésors c

Localization.Title: Disney's The Little Mermaid II
Localization.Description: Arielle, die Meerjungfrau, und ihre Tochter Melody erkunden Meere und Küsten in diesem neuen Abenteuerspiel, das auf den beiden Disney-Klassikern mit der Meerjungfrau Arielle basiert.

Localization.Title: Disney's The Little Mermaid II
Localization.Description: Basado en los dos episodios de las populares películas The Little Mermaid, The Little Mermaid II de Disney es un juego de acción y aventuras en el que los jugadores toman el control de Ariel y su hija Melody a través de entornos 3D que se encuentran en l

Localization.Title: Disney's The Little Mermaid II
Localization.Description: Based upon both episodes of the popular The Little Mermaid movies, Disney's The Little Mermaid II is an action-adventure game in which players take control of Ariel and her daughter Melody through 3D environments found in the films.

Localization.Title: Disney's The Little Mermaid II
Localization.Description: Based upon both episodes of the popular The Little Mermaid movies, Disney's The Little Mermaid II is an action-adventure game in which players take control of Ariel and her daughter Melody through 3D environments found in the films.

Localization.Title: Moto Racer World Tour
Localization.Description: Moto Racer World Tour is the third part of the Moto Racer series for the PlayStation. The game offers you to race on 34 different bikes in both dirt and street bike category. Each bike's settings can be manually adjusted.

Localization.Title: Moto Racer World Tour
Localization.Description: Moto Racer World Tour est un jeu de courses sur Playstation. Au programme un mode Arcade des plus classiques, où le fun prime sur le réalisme et qui permet d'enchaîner les courses les unes derrière les autres.

Localization.Title: Moto Racer World Tour
Localization.Description: Erkunden Sie in Moto Racer World Tour die Top-Motorradrennen der Welt, begeben Sie sich auf die bekanntesten Grand Prix Rennstrecken.

Localization.Title: Moto Racer World Tour
Localization.Description: Moto Racer World Tour es la tercera entrega de la serie Moto Racer para PlayStation. Hay 34 motos diferentes en la categoría de tierra o asfalto. La configuración de cada moto se puede ajustar manualmente.

Localization.Title: Moto Racer World Tour
Localization.Description: Moto Racer World Tour è la terza parte della serie Moto Racer per PlayStation. Il gioco ti offre la possibilità di correre su 34 biciclette diverse sia nella categoria dirt che in quella da strada.

Localization.Title: Moto Racer World Tour
Localization.Description: Moto Racer World Tour é a terceira parte da série Moto Racer para o PlayStation. O jogo oferece-lhe a possibilidade de correr em 34 motos diferentes na categoria de dirt a street bike. As configurações de cada moto podem ser ajustadas manualmente.

Localization.Title: The Legend of Dragoon (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Ten thousand years ago, the Divine Tree brought forth all living races. Among them were the powerful Dragons, the resilient humans, and the magical Winglies.

Localization.Title: The Legend of Dragoon (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: The Legend of Dragoon est un jeu de rôle sur Playstation. Incarnez Dart, un jeune héros valeureux.

Localization.Title: The Legend of Dragoon (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Vier Jahre sind vergangen seit Dart seine Heimat verließ und sich auf die Suche nach dem Schwarzen Monster machte, das seine Eltern und seinen Geburtsort Neet vernichtet hat.

Localization.Title: The Legend of Dragoon (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Dart, un guerrero valiente y leal, ha jurado vengar la muerte de sus padres a manos de un misterioso monstruo negro. Para motivos desconocidos, el Imperio de Sandora quema su pueblo y encarcela a su amiga de la infancia, Shana.

Localization.Title: The Legend of Dragoon (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Sono passati quattro anni da quando Dart ha lasciato la sua casa ed è andato alla ricerca del mostro nero che ha distrutto i suoi genitori e il suo luogo di nascita Neet.

Localization.Title: The Legend of Dragoon (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: O jogo conta a história de Dart, um jovem guerreiro que busca vingança contra o "Black Monster" que destruiu sua vila e matou seus pais.

Localization.Title: Ms. Pac-Man Maze Madness
Localization.Description: Ms. Pac-Man Maze Madness is a combination of classic Pac-Man (or in this case, Ms. Pac-Man) action, maze exploration and Sokoban-like puzzle elements. Players take on the role of Ms. Pac-Man and have to save Pac-Land once again.

Localization.Title: Ms. Pac-Man Maze Madness
Localization.Description: Ms. Pac-Man Maze Madness combine l'action classique de Pac-Man (ou dans ce cas, Ms. Pac-Man), l'exploration de labyrinthes et des éléments de puzzle de type Sokoban. Les joueurs incarnent Ms. Pac-Man et doivent sauver Pac-Land une fois de plus.

Localization.Title: Ms. Pac-Man Maze Madness
Localization.Description: Ein brandneues Abenteuer mit der Originalheldin des Videospiels: Ms. Pac-Man! Neuer 4-Spieler-Modus und knallharte Labyrinth-Duelle. Die Modi "Bombe fangen" und "Zeithüpfung" sorgen für ein ausgewogenes Verhältnis von Retro- und modernem Gameplay.

Localization.Title: Ms. Pac-Man Maze Madness
Localization.Description: Ms. Pac-Man: Maze Madness es un juego de rompecabezas de acción con vista isométrica en 3D. Juegas como la Sra. Pac-Man y debes navegar por los laberintos mientras evitas a los monstruos.

Localization.Title: Ms. Pac-Man Maze Madness
Localization.Description: Ms. Pac-Man Maze Madness is a combination of classic Pac-Man (or in this case, Ms. Pac-Man) action, maze exploration and Sokoban-like puzzle elements. Players take on the role of Ms. Pac-Man and have to save Pac-Land once again.

Localization.Title: Ms. Pac-Man Maze Madness

Localization.Title: Muppet Monster Adventure
Localization.Description: Muppet Monster Adventure is a action platform game, best compared with Spyro but with Muppet characters and a Halloween or ghost house setting. The story starts with the Muppets attending the reading of Dr. Honeydew recently deceased uncle's will.

Localization.Title: Muppet Monster Adventure
Localization.Description: Muppet Monster Adventure est un jeu d'action/plates-formes sur Playstation.

Localization.Title: Muppet Monster Adventure
Localization.Description: Es ist Halloween im Gruselschloss Honigtau und einige deiner Lieblingsmuppets wurden in groteske Gestalten des Bösen verwandelt. Als Kermits kleiner Neffe Robin musst du Onkel Kermit und seine flauschigen Freunde retten.

Localization.Title: Muppet Monster Adventure
Localization.Description: Muppet Monster Adventure es un juego de plataformas de acción. La historia comienza con los Muppets que asisten a la lectura del testamento del tío del Dr. Honeydew.

Localization.Title: Grind Session
Localization.Description: Grind Session translates the spirit and thrill of hard-core boarding into arcade-style action. Gamers compete in street and tournament competitions, flow on the halfpipe, and freestyle it for the covers of the big skating magazines.

Localization.Title: Grind Session
Localization.Description: Grind Session est un jeu de skateboard sur Playstation. Parmi les modes, on découvre le solitaire, le tournoi, le skate libre, l'endurance et l'entraînement.

Localization.Title: Grind Session
Localization.Description: Grind Session übersetzt den Geist und Nervenkitzel des Hardcore-Boardings in Action im Arcade-Stil.

Localization.Title: Grind Session
Localization.Description: Grind Session es un juego de skateboard para Playstation. Tiene varios modos de juego: solitario, torneo, estilo libre, resistencia y entrenamiento.

Localization.Title: This Is Football 2
Localization.Description: The sequel to 'This Is Football', attempts to make a realistic yet enjoyable football game.

Localization.Title: This Is Football 2
Localization.Description: Le Monde Des Bleus 2 est un jeu de football sur Playstation. Grâce aux licences officielles, les noms des joueurs de toutes les équipes nationales sont disponibles ainsi que les compétitions officielles.

Localization.Title: This Is Football 2
Localization.Description: This is Football 2 ist ein Fußballspiel auf der Playstation. Dank der offiziellen Lizenzen sind die Namen der Spieler aller Nationalmannschaften sowie die offiziellen Wettbewerbe verfügbar.

Localization.Title: This Is Football 2
Localization.Description: La secuela de "Esto es Fútbol", intenta hacer un juego de fútbol realista y a la vez divertido.

Localization.Title: Liberogrande International
Localization.Description: Libero Grande International is the sequel to Libero Grande a conversion of an arcade game.

Localization.Title: Liberogrande International
Localization.Description: Libero Grande International est un jeu de foot sur Playstation. Dans ce soft, vous avez la possibilité de contrôler qu'un seul joueur par équipe. Après avoir choisi votre équipe et le joueur que vous souhaitez incarner, lancez-vous vers la victoire.

Localization.Title: Liberogrande International
Localization.Description: Libero Grande International ist die Fortsetzung von Libero Grande, einer Umsetzung eines Arcade-Spiels.

Localization.Title: Liberogrande International
Localization.Description: Gracias a las ventas de la primera edición, Namco lanzó una segunda parte para el mercado japonés y europeo en el año 2000, llamado Libero Grande International.

Localization.Title: Liberogrande International
Localization.Description: Libero Grande International è il seguito di Libero Grande, un adattamento del gioco arcade.

Localization.Title: Liberogrande International
Localization.Description: Libero Grande International é um jogo de futebol para Playstation. Neste jogo você tem a possibilidade de controlar apenas um jogador por equipe. Depois de escolher o seu time e o jogador com quem quer jogar, parta para a vitória.

Localization.Title: C-12: Final Resistance
Localization.Description: C-12: Final Resistance is set in the aftermath of a hostile ground invasion of Earth by ravaging alien forces.

Localization.Title: C-12 : Final Resistance
Localization.Description: Vaughan, ex-lieutenant de l'armée, tente de sauver la terre envahie par les aliens dans le jeu d'action (c-12) : Final Resistance sur Playstation.

Localization.Title: C-12: Final Resistance
Localization.Description: C-12: Final Resistance spielt nach einer feindlichen Bodeninvasion der Erde durch verheerende außerirdische Kräfte.

Localization.Title: C-12: Final Resistance
Localization.Description: Los alienígenas han invadido la tierra. Ningún organismo vivo está a salvo de la tropa alienígena invasora, que pretende apoderarse de todas las fuentes de carbono de la tierra.

Localization.Title: Point Blank 3
Localization.Description: The escapades of Namco's Dr. Dan and Dr. Don continue in Point Blank 3, the third edition of the irreverent, mini-game based light-gun series.

Localization.Title: Point Blank 3
Localization.Description: Point Blank 3 est un jeu de tir sur Playstation. Choisissez parmi les différents modes de jeu, notamment Arcade, Training et Versus, et déchaînez-vous dans les différents niveaux disponibles.

Localization.Title: Point Blank 3
Localization.Description: Point Blank 3 ist ein Ballerspiel für die Playstation. Wählen Sie aus den verschiedenen Spielmodi, darunter Arcade, Training und Versus, und toben Sie sich in den verschiedenen verfügbaren Levels aus.

Localization.Title: Point Blank 3
Localization.Description: El tercer episodio de la serie de Point Blank ahora tiene hasta 8 jugadores compitiendo en el nuevo modo Team Battle, donde se turnan para luchar y ganar tantos juegos como sea posible.

Localization.Title: Point Blank 3
Localization.Description: Le avventure del Dr. Dan e del Dr. Don di Namco continuano in Point Blank 3, la terza edizione dell'irriverente serie di pistole leggere basata su minigiochi.

Localization.Title: Point Blank 3

Localization.Title: Disney's Atlantis: The Lost Empire
Localization.Description: Disney's Atlantis is an action platformer based on the 2001 animated movie. As in the movie, the game tells the tale of a group of heroic adventurers that brave treacherous ocean waters and caves to locate the lost city of Atlantis.

Localization.Title: Disney's Atlantis : The Lost Empire
Localization.Description: Atlantide : L'Empire Perdu sur Playstation permet de contrôler plusieurs personnages à tour de rôle pour résoudre des objectifs précis qui permettent d'avancer dans le jeu.

Localization.Title: Disney's Atlantis: The Lost Empire
Localization.Description: Das auf Disneys neuestem Zeichentrickfilm basierende Atlantis: The Lost Empire entführt einen in die Tiefen des Meeres, in riesige "unterseeische" Höhlen und in die Gesellschaft einer Reihe mythischer Ungeheuer.

Localization.Title: Disney's Atlantis: The Lost Empire
Localization.Description: Únete a Milo Thatch y a su pandilla de intrépidos exploradores en la búsqueda de los misterios que oculta la Atlántida.

Localization.Title: Adibou et l'Ombre Verte
Localization.Description: A real star of 4-7 years old, Adibou lands in 2001 on Playstation. Coktel offers on this occasion a more adventure-oriented game, without forgeting the bases that made the success of the series.

Localization.Title: Adibou et l'Ombre Verte
Localization.Description: Véritable star des 4-7 ans, Adibou arrive en 2001 sur Playstation. Coktel propose à cette occasion un jeu plus orienté vers l'aventure, sans pour autant négliger les bases qui ont fait le succès de la série.

Localization.Title: Adibou et l'Ombre Verte
Localization.Description: Adibou, ein echter Star für 4-7-Jährige, landet 2001 auf der Playstation. Coktel bietet diesmal ein mehr auf Abenteuer ausgerichtetes Spiel an, ohne dabei die Grundlagen zu vergessen, die den Erfolg der Serie ausmachten.

Localization.Title: Adibou et l'Ombre Verte
Localization.Description: Una verdadera estrella de 4-7 años, Adibou aterriza en 2001 para Playstation. Coktel ofrece en esta ocasión un juego más orientado a la aventura, sin olvidar las bases que hicieron el éxito de la serie.

Localization.Title: Adibou et l'Ombre Verte
Localization.Description: A real star of 4-7 years old, Adibou lands in 2001 on Playstation. Coktel offers on this occasion a more adventure-oriented game, without forgeting the bases that made the success of the series.

Localization.Title: Adibou et l'Ombre Verte
Localization.Description: Uma verdadeira estrela de 4-7 anos, Adibou aterra em 2001 na Playstation. Coktel oferece nesta ocasião um jogo mais orientado para a aventura, sem esquecer as bases que fizeram o sucesso da série.

Localization.Title: Syphon Filter 3
Localization.Description: Gabe and Lian are back -- however, this time, "The Agency" has put Lian and Gabe on trial for crimes they did not commit while they secretly plot to distribute Syphon Filter, a deadly virus, throughout the population.

Localization.Title: Syphon Filter 3
Localization.Description: Accusés de trahison et soupçonnés d'avoir conspiré pour répandre le virus Syphon Filter dans le monde entier, les agents Gabe Logan et Lian Xing doivent désormais répondre de leurs actes.

Localization.Title: Syphon Filter 3
Localization.Description: Die beiden Spezial-Agenten Gabe Logan und Lian King werden beschuldigt, den todbringenden Syphon-Filter-Virus über die ganze Welt verteilt zu haben. Die Spur des Verrats führt jedoch direkt zum früheren Arbeitgeber der beiden - der Agentur.

Localization.Title: Syphon Filter 3
Localization.Description: A los agentes especiales Gabe Logan y Lian Xing se les acusa de propagar el virus mortal Syphon Filter por todo el mundo.

Localization.Title: Syphon Filter 3
Localization.Description: Gabe e Lian sono tornati - tuttavia, questa volta, "The Agency" ha processato Lian e Gabe per crimini che non hanno commesso mentre complottano segretamente per distribuire il Syphon Filter, un virus mortale, a tutta la popolazione.

Localization.Title: Disney/Pixar Monsters, Inc.: Scare Island
Localization.Description: What would you say if you found out that the scary monsters hiding in children's closet were all part of a corporate conspiracy? Well, that's the premise of the 2001 Disney or Pixar film, Monsters, Inc.

Localization.Title: Disney/Pixar Monsters, Inc. : Scare Island
Localization.Description: Monstres & Cie : L'Ile de l'Epouvante est un jeu de plates-formes sorti sur Playstation. Retrouvez toute l'ambiance du film d'animation de Pixar et Disney dans cette adaptation qui vous permettra d'incarner Sully, le gros monstre poilu.

Localization.Title: Disney/Pixar Monsters, Inc.: Scare Island
Localization.Description: Die Schreihälse brauchen Dich! Werde Schreck-Meister an der Monster-Akademie. Nach Abschluss der Monster-Akademie überreicht dir Henry J. Waternoose, Präsident der Monster AG, dein Diplom.

Localization.Title: Disney/Pixar Monsters, Inc.: Scare Island

Localization.Title: Alfred Chicken

Localization.Title: Stuart Little 2
Localization.Description: Based on the same-titled movie, Stuart Little 2 for PlayStation is a 3D adventure played out over seven levels and features Stuart, Snowbell, and their flirtatious feathered friend, Miss Margalo.

Localization.Description: Stuart Little 2 est un jeu de plates-formes sur Playstation dans lequel il faudra retrouver des bijoux volés par faucon. Stuart vous donne l'occasion de traverser de nombreux stages inspirés du film (la maison, Central Park, les égouts etc).

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy VI
Localization.Description: Set in a fantasy world with a technology level equivalent to that of the Second Industrial Revolution, the game's story focuses on a group of rebels as they seek to overthrow an imperial dictatorship.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy VI
Localization.Description: Comprendre l'héritage du passé. Plusieurs siècles se sont écoulés depuis la guerre de la magie. Le monde s'est reconstruit et a donné naissance à la civilisation de l'acier, des machines et de la technologie.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy VI
Localization.Description: Der Kampf der Zauberer liegt viele Jahrhunderte zurück. Mit Eisen, Maschinen und moderner Technik wurden Zivilisationen wiederaufgebaut.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy VI
Localization.Description: Miles de años atrás, convivían en un mismo mundo dos razas: los humanos y los Espers, seres dotados de grandes poderes mágicos, pues su propia esencia tenía origen en la magia.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy VI
Localization.Description: Ambientato in un mondo fantastico con un livello tecnologico equivalente a quello della Seconda Rivoluzione Industriale, la storia del gioco si concentra su un gruppo di ribelli che cercano di rovesciare una dittatura imperiale.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy VI
Localization.Description: Situado num mundo de fantasia com um nível de tecnologia equivalente ao da Segunda Revolução Industrial, a história do jogo se concentra em um grupo de rebeldes que procuram derrubar uma ditadura imperial.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy Anthology: European Edition: Final Fantasy IV
Localization.Description: This classic adventure includes 18 towns and castles, dozens of magical spells, and hundreds of monsters, weapons, and items to help players on their quests.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy Anthology : European Edition : Final Fantasy IV
Localization.Description: Final Fantasy IV est la réédition sur Playstation du jeu de rôle sorti sur Super Nintendo. De puissants cristaux ont été cachés pour éviter qu'ils ne tombent entre de mauvaises mains.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy Anthology: European Edition: Final Fantasy IV
Localization.Description: Der Dunkle Ritter Cecil hat von seinem König den Befehl erhalten, dessen fiese Pläne umzusetzen. Cecil jedoch legt seine Loyalität ab, um dem wahnsinnigen Treiben des Monarchen ein Ende zu setzen.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy Anthology: European Edition: Final Fantasy IV
Localization.Description: Esta aventura clásica incluye 18 pueblos y castillos, docenas de hechizos mágicos, y cientos de monstruos, armas, e itemes que ayudaran al jugador en su aventura.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy Anthology: European Edition: Final Fantasy IV
Localization.Description: Il cavaliere oscuro Cecil ha ricevuto un ordine dal suo re per attuare i suoi cattivi piani. Cecil, tuttavia, rinuncia alla sua lealtà per porre fine alle folli vicende del monarca.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy Anthology: European Edition: Final Fantasy IV
Localization.Description: This classic adventure includes 18 towns and castles, dozens of magical spells, and hundreds of monsters, weapons, and items to help players on their quests.

rom.name: Final Fantasy Anthology - European Edition - Final Fantasy IV (Europe, Australia).cue

Localization.Description: Welcome to the Firebugs racing season, where teams of different worlds send their best racer to compete for fame and glory.

Localization.Description: Firebugs est un jeu de courses sorti sur Playstation. Propulsez-vous dans des courses frénétiques à bord d'engins anti-gravité filant à plus de 600 km/h. Vous aurez le choix entre gagner la compétition Firebugs ou affronter un de vos amis.

Localization.Title: Firebugs

Localization.Title: WRC: FIA World Rally Championship Arcade
Localization.Description: WRC Arcade ist ein Rallye-Rennspiel auf der Playstation, mit dem Sie Fahrer von Citroën, Ford, Peugeot oder auch Subaru sowie 14 WRC-Spezialautos spielen können. Das Spiel, mit dem Sie in verschiedenen Ländern reisen können.

Localization.Title: WRC: FIA World Rally Championship Arcade
Localization.Description: WRC Arcade es un juego de carreras de rally para PlayStation que te permite ponerte al volante de vehículos Citroën, Ford, Peugeot y Subaru, además de 14 coches especiales del WRC. El juego te llevará de viaje por diversos países.

Localization.Title: WRC: FIA World Rally Championship Arcade

Localization.Description: Jinx is a 3D platformer for the PlayStation in the vein of other 3D platformers like Spyro the Dragon.

Localization.Title: Jinx
Localization.Description: Jinx est un jeu de plates-formes sorti sur Playstation. Jouez le bouffon de la cour de la planète Ploog qui devra retrouver les pirates maléfiques qui ont enlevé la famille royale.

Localization.Title: Jinx

Localization.Title: Jinx
Localization.Description: Jinx, el bufón de la corte, ha entretenido a la familia real del planeta Ploog durante años con sus chistes, bromas y malabares.

Localization.Title: Klonoa Beach Volleyball
Localization.Description: Klonoa Beach Volleyball is a volleyball game with a twist. Apart from being able to play on other numerous courts. The game is so addictive and theres so much things to unlock that you will keep on coming back for another game.

Localization.Title: Klonoa Beach Volleyball
Localization.Description: Klonoa Beach Volleyball est, comme son nom pourrait le laisser deviner, un jeu de Volleyball. Sorti sur Playstation, ce titre a la particularité de prendre l'option de parties fun.

Localization.Title: Klonoa Beach Volleyball
Localization.Description: Ein Arcade-Volleyballspiel, mit Charakteren des Klonoa-Franchise. Sie treten in 2-gegen-2-Matches an, in der Hoffnung, das 5-Match-Turnier zu gewinnen, das in jedem Spiel an mehreren Orten ausgetragen wird.

Localization.Title: Klonoa Beach Volleyball
Localization.Description: ¡Invita a tus amigos a participar en la partida de volley playa más calurosa y divertida! Juega en el papel de Klonoa, Popka, Heart Mao, Lolo e incluso Jokai.

Localization.Title: Klonoa Beach Volleyball
Localization.Description: Klonoa Beach Volleyball è un gioco di pallavolo con una svolta. Oltre a poter giocare su altri numerosi campi. Il gioco è così avvincente e ci sono così tante cose da sbloccare che continuerai a tornare per un altro gioco.

Localization.Title: Klonoa Beach Volleyball
Localization.Description: Klonoa Beach Volleyball is a volleyball game with a twist. Apart from being able to play on other numerous courts. The game is so addictive and theres so much things to unlock that you will keep on coming back for another game.

Localization.Title: Disney's Treasure Planet
Localization.Description: Treasure Planet is the adaptation of an animated Disney movie. The game follows the adventures of Jim Hawkins, a young boy on a quest to locate a mythical planet called Treasure Planet.

Localization.Description: Folge Jim Hawkins bei seiner abenteuerlichen Suche nach der Beute aus den Tausend Welten.

Localization.Title: Novastorm (Disc 2)
Localization.Description: The game takes place some time in the distant future. Humans have left earth in several huge arks containing Earth's ecosystem, in search of a new paradise.

Localization.Title: Novastorm (Disc 2)
Localization.Description: Novastorm sur Playstation est un shoot'em up spatial dans lequel le joueur pilote son vaisseau alors que la caméra est en vue de dos. Le but est de détruire tous les ennemis qui se présentent tout en évitant les différents obstacles de l'environnement.

Localization.Title: Novastorm (Disc 2)
Localization.Description: Das Spiel spielt irgendwann in ferner Zukunft. Auf der Suche nach einem neuen Paradies haben Menschen die Erde in mehreren riesigen Archen verlassen, in denen sich das Ökosystem der Erde befindet.

Localization.Title: Novastorm (Disc 2)
Localization.Description: El sueño de todo francotirador con perspectiva en primera persona: Hacer explotar a los enemigos contra un telón de fondo cinematográfico. ¡Mata a los luchadores controlados por computadora antes de que se apoderen del mundo!

Localization.Title: Novastorm (Disc 2)
Localization.Description: The game takes place some time in the distant future. Humans have left earth in several huge arks containing Earth's ecosystem, in search of a new paradise.

Localization.Title: Novastorm (Disc 2)
Localization.Description: Novastorm é um jogo de tiro espacial para Playstation. O jogo se passa em algum momento no futuro distante. Os humanos deixaram a Terra em várias arcas enormes contendo o ecossistema da Terra, em busca de um novo paraíso.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy VII (Disc 2)
Localization.Description: Set in a dystopian world, Final Fantasy VII's story centers on mercenary Cloud Strife who joins with several others to stop the megacorporation Shinra, which is draining the life of the planet to use as an energy source.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy VII (Disc 2)
Localization.Description: La Corporation Shinra pompe toute l'énergie de notre planète.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy VII (Disc 2)
Localization.Description: Die Shinra Corporation entzieht unserem Planeten alle Lebensenergie. Cloud ein eiskalter Söldner, übernimmt einen Auftrag von einer Gruppe von Öko-Kriegern.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy VII (Disc 2)
Localization.Description: La corporación Shinra está agotando los recursos vitales de nuestro planeta.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy VII (Disc 2)
Localization.Description: Ambientato in un mondo distopico, la storia di Final Fantasy VII è incentrata sul mercenario Cloud Strife che si unisce ad altri compagni per fermare la Shinra Corporation, che sta prosciugando la vita del pianeta, utilizzato come fonte di energia.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy VII (Disc 2)
Localization.Description: A história segue Cloud Strife, um mercenário que junta-se a uma organização ecoterrorista a fim de impedir que megacorporação Shinra use a essência vital do planeta como uma fonte de energia.

Localization.Title: Dragon Valor (Disc 2)
Localization.Description: Dragon Valor is a hack-and-slash medieval action game with some light rpg and puzzle-solving touches.

Localization.Title: Dragon Valor (Disc 2)
Localization.Description: Dragon Valor est un jeu de rôle orienté action sur Playstation. Vous incarnez Clovis, un jeune homme qui cherche à se venger du dragon qui a tué sa soeurette. Pour cela, il dispose de nombreux power-up et d'une puissante épée nommée Dragon Valor.

Localization.Title: Dragon Valor (Disc 2)
Localization.Description: Dragon Valor ist ein mittelalterliches Hack-and-Slash-Actionspiel mit leichten RPG- und Rätsel-Lösungselementen.

Localization.Title: Dragon Valor (Disc 2)
Localization.Description: Dragon Valor es un juego de acción medieval de hack-and-slash con algunos elementos ligeros de RPG y algunos toques de rompecabezas.

Localization.Title: Dragon Valor (Disc 2)
Localization.Description: Molte leggende narrano di una formidabile creatura magica: il drago. La fredda pelle a scaglie, lo sguardo crudele e i denti simili a pugnali d'avorio terrorizzano anche gli uomini piú coraggiosi.

Localization.Title: Dragon Valor (Disc 2)
Localization.Description: Dragon Valor is a hack-and-slash medieval action game with some light rpg and puzzle-solving touches.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy VIII (Disc 2)
Localization.Description: A member of an elite military team, Squall is forced into a conflict beyond imagination. To survive, he must contend with a desperate rival, a powerful sorceress, and his own mysterious dreams.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy VIII (Disc 2)
Localization.Description: Squall fait partie d'un escadron militaire d'élite et se voit obligé de participer à un conflit dépassant les limites de l'imagination.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy VIII (Disc 2)
Localization.Description: In Final Fantasy VIII schlüpfst du in die Rolle von Squall, einem Mitglied einer Elite-Militärtruppe, der in einen Konflikt mit einem rivalisierenden Gegner, einer mächtigen Hexe und seinen eigenen mysteriösen Träumen verwickelt wird.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy VIII (Disc 2)
Localization.Description: Squall, un miembro de un cuerpo de élite del ejército, se ve forzado a entrar en un conflicto que traspasa los límites de la imaginación. Para sobrevivir, debe enfrentarse a un rival desesperado, una poderosa hechicera y a sus propios sueños misteriosos.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy VIII (Disc 2)
Localization.Description: Membro di una squadra militare d'élite, Squall è costretto a un conflitto oltre ogni immaginazione. Per sopravvivere, deve lottare con un rivale disperato, una potente strega e con i suoi sogni misteriosi.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy VIII (Disc 2)
Localization.Description: A história se passa em um mundo que mistura elementos de fantasia e ficção científica, seguindo um grupo de jovens mercenários liderados por Squall Leonhart e que trabalham para uma organização chamada SeeD.

Localization.Title: Shadow Madness (Disc 2)
Localization.Description: Something is going wrong in the land of Arkose: cities destroy themselves, monsters attack innocent citizens, diseases spread among the people. A giant blast has destroyed a whole town, only a young guy named Stinger narrowly escaped death.

Localization.Title: Shadow Madness (Disc 2)
Localization.Description: Shadow Madness est un jeu de rôle sur Playstation. Vous êtes Stinger, un jeune garçon qui a échappé à la destruction de sa ville dans une gigantesque explosion. Avec l'aide de la femme elfe Widleaf et du robot Harv-5, il tente de se venger.

Localization.Title: Shadow Madness (Disc 2)
Localization.Description: Shadow Madness ist ein Rollenspiel für Playstation. Du bist Stinger, ein kleiner Junge, der der Zerstörung seiner Stadt durch eine gigantische Explosion entkommen ist. Mit Hilfe der Elfenfrau Widleaf und des Roboters Harv-5 versucht er sich zu rächen.

Localization.Title: Shadow Madness (Disc 2)
Localization.Description: Algo anda mal en la tierra de Arkose: las ciudades se destruyen a sí mismas, los monstruos atacan a ciudadanos inocentes, las enfermedades se propagan entre la gente.

Localization.Title: Shadow Madness (Disc 2)
Localization.Description: Qualcosa non va nella terra di Arkose: le città si distruggono da sole, i mostri attaccano cittadini innocenti, le malattie si diffondono tra la gente.

Localization.Description: In Cold Blood is adventure and infiltration on Playstation. Seven of the nine missions offered are in fact flashbacks.

Localization.Description: De Sang Froid, c'est de l'aventure et de l'infiltration sur Playstation. Sept des neuf missions proposées sont en fait des flash-back.

Localization.Title: In Cold Blood (Disc 2)
Localization.Description: Ort des Geschehens ist ein Staat in der nahen Zukunft, der die Unabhängigkeit von Rußland erklärt hat.

Localization.Title: In Cold Blood (Disc 2)
Localization.Description: A sangre fría se situa en un futuro cercano donde la amenaza de una nueva guerra mundial entre EE.UU. y China es inminente.

Localization.Title: In Cold Blood (Disc 2)
Localization.Description: In Cold Blood sei schierato nei panni dell'agente M16 John Cord dai servizi segreti britannici per risolvere il mistero della scomparsa di un amico spia americano.

Localization.Title: Star Ocean: The Second Story (Disc 2)
Localization.Description: Star Ocean: The Second Story is a world of magic, science, space travel and deadly demons! Enter a world where love knows no bounds, the evil is neverending and good can overcome all if the heart is just and true.

Localization.Title: Star Ocean : The Second Story (Disc 2)
Localization.Description: Star Ocean : The Second Story est un jeu de rôle sur Playstation. Téléporté par erreur sur une planète au bord du chaos, le jeune Claude va devoir trouver un moyen de rentrer chez lui tout en venant en aide aux autochtones.

Localization.Title: Star Ocean: The Second Story (Disc 2)
Localization.Description: In einem endlosen Sternenmeer am Rande des Universums steht eine einzelne, schicksalhafte Begegnung bevor.

Localization.Title: Star Ocean: The Second Story (Disc 2)
Localization.Description: De las acciones de dos héroes dependerá el destino del universo. Escoge a Rena o Claude y guíalos a través de diversas aventuras con tal de que no se cumpla la fatal profecía.

Localization.Title: Star Ocean: The Second Story (Disc 2)
Localization.Description: Star Ocean: The Second Story è un gioco di ruolo per Playstation. Teletrasportato per errore su un pianeta sull'orlo del caos, il giovane Claude dovrà trovare un modo per tornare a casa aiutando gli indigeni.

Localization.Title: Star Ocean: The Second Story (Disc 2)
Localization.Description: Star Ocean: A segunda história é um mundo de magia, ciência, viagens espaciais e demônios mortais! Entre em um mundo onde o amor não conhece limites, o mal não tem fim e o bem pode superar tudo se o coração for justo e verdadeiro.

Localization.Title: Syphon Filter 2 (Disc 2)
Localization.Description: The sequel to the previous year's Syphon Filter, Syphon Filter 2 adds new features such as a two player mode, new locations, new weapons, and more. The game compares to Goldeneye on the N64. It's a shooter, but you must also use strategy.

Localization.Title: Syphon Filter 2 (Disc 2)
Localization.Description: Gabe Logan et Lian Xing sont les deux meilleurs éléments de l'Agence. Ils sont efficaces. Intelligents. Courageux. ... mais ils en savent trop et l'Agence veut les éliminer.

Localization.Title: Syphon Filter 2 (Disc 2)
Localization.Description: Siphon Filter 2, die Fortsetzung des letztjährigen Siphon Filter, bietet neue Funktionen wie einen Zwei-Spieler-Modus, neue Orte, neue Waffen und mehr. Das Spiel lässt sich mit Goldeneye auf dem N64 vergleichen.

Localization.Title: Syphon Filter 2 (Disc 2)
Localization.Description: Gabe Logan y Lian Xing son los mejores agentes secretos de la Agencia. Son inteligentes, están entregados a su trabajo y se mantienen en plena forma física. Pero la Agencia opiina que saben demasiado, y hay que eliminarlos...

Localization.Title: Syphon Filter 2 (Disc 2)
Localization.Description: Il sequel del Syphon Filter dell'anno precedente, Syphon Filter 2 aggiunge nuove funzionalità come una modalità a due giocatori, nuove posizioni, nuove armi e altro ancora. Il gioco è paragonabile a Goldeneye sull'N64.

Localization.Description: Siphon Filter 2, die Fortsetzung des letztjährigen Siphon Filter, bietet neue Funktionen wie einen Zwei-Spieler-Modus, neue Orte, neue Waffen und mehr. Das Spiel lässt sich mit Goldeneye auf dem N64 vergleichen.

Localization.Title: Syphon Filter 2 (Disc 2)
Localization.Description: Gabe Logan y Lian Xing son los mejores agentes secretos de la Agencia. Son inteligentes, están entregados a su trabajo y se mantienen en plena forma física. Pero la Agencia opiina que saben demasiado, y hay que eliminarlos...

Localization.Title: Gran Turismo 2 (Disc 2) (Gran Turismo Mode)
Localization.Description: Gran Turismo 2 is fundamentally based on the racing game genre. The player must maneuver an automobile to compete against artificially intelligent drivers on various race tracks. The game uses two different modes: arcade and simulation.

Localization.Title: Gran Turismo 2 (Disc 2) (Gran Turismo Mode)
Localization.Description: Le stade ultime de la simulation de course. 600 voitures conçues par 33 des plus grands constructeurs automobile au monde... Trouvez le réglage parfait de vos véhicules. 28 circuits dont le célèbre Laguna Seca.

Localization.Title: Gran Turismo 2 (Disc 2) (Gran Turismo Mode)
Localization.Description: „Gran Turismo 2“ kehrt zurück mit über 500 Wagenmodellen und mehr als 20 Strecken. Das Spiel bringt realistische Fahrphysik, detaillierte Streckensimulationen und DUALSHOCK-Vibration für ein authentisches Rennerlebnis.

Localization.Title: Gran Turismo 2 (Disc 2) (Gran Turismo Mode)
Localization.Description: Gran Turismo 2 tiene 22 circuitos, 6 licencias, 600 coches, 6 circuitos de rendimiento y eventos de rally.

Localization.Title: Gran Turismo 2 (Disc 2) (Gran Turismo Mode)
Localization.Description: Gran Turismo 2 si basa fondamentalmente sul genere dei giochi di corse. Il giocatore deve manovrare un'automobile per competere contro piloti artificialmente intelligenti su vari circuiti. Il gioco utilizza due diverse modalità: arcade e simulazione.

Localization.Title: Gran Turismo 2 (Disc 2) (Gran Turismo Mode)
Localization.Description: Gran Turismo 2 se baseia fundamentalmente no gênero de corrida de carros. O jogador deve dirigir um automóvel para competir contra pilotos artificialmente inteligentes em várias pistas. O jogo utiliza dois modos: Arcade e Simulação.

Localization.Title: Dragon Valor (Disc 2)
Localization.Description: Dragon Valor is a hack-and-slash medieval action game with some light rpg and puzzle-solving touches.

Localization.Title: Dragon Valor (Disc 2)
Localization.Description: Dragon Valor est un jeu de rôle orienté action sur Playstation. Vous incarnez Clovis, un jeune homme qui cherche à se venger du dragon qui a tué sa soeurette. Pour cela, il dispose de nombreux power-up et d'une puissante épée nommée Dragon Valor.

Localization.Title: Dragon Valor (Disc 2)
Localization.Description: Dragon Valor ist ein mittelalterliches Hack-and-Slash-Actionspiel mit leichten RPG- und Rätsel-Lösungselementen.

Localization.Title: Dragon Valor (Disc 2)
Localization.Description: Dragon Valor es un juego de acción medieval de hack-and-slash con algunos elementos ligeros de RPG y algunos toques de rompecabezas.

Localization.Title: Dragon Valor (Disc 2)
Localization.Description: Molte leggende narrano di una formidabile creatura magica: il drago. La fredda pelle a scaglie, lo sguardo crudele e i denti simili a pugnali d'avorio terrorizzano anche gli uomini piú coraggiosi.

Localization.Title: Chase the Express (Disc 2)
Localization.Description: The French ambassador Pierre Simon and his family are travelling from Saint Petersburg to Paris aboard the Blue Harvest, a military NATO-developed train, when it is hijacked by terrorists known as the Knights of the Apocalypse.

Localization.Title: Chase the Express (Disc 2)
Localization.Description: Chase the Express est un jeu d'action/infiltration à la troisième personne sur Playstation. L'histoire met en scène une organisation terroriste portant le doux nom de Chevaliers de l'Apocalypse.

Localization.Title: Chase the Express (Disc 2)
Localization.Description: Nach einem Staatsbesuch in St. Petersburg befindet sich der französiche Botschafter samt Familie in einem Hochsicherheitszug auf dem Weg in die Heimat. Doch mitten im frostigen Russland wird der Express von eienr Terroristengruppe gestürmt.

Localization.Title: Chase the Express (Disc 2)
Localization.Description: Chase The Express cuenta la historia de un soldado de las fuerzas de la OTAN, Jack Morton, cuya principal misión era proteger al embajador francés y su familia que viaja en un tren especial, llamado 'Blue Harvest', mientras durase este trayecto.

Localization.Title: Chase the Express (Disc 2)
Localization.Description: L'ambasciatore francese Pierre Simon e la sua famiglia stanno viaggiando da San Pietroburgo a Parigi a bordo del Blue Harvest, un treno militare sviluppato dalla NATO, quando viene dirottato da terroristi noti come i Cavalieri dell'Apocalisse.

Localization.Title: The Legend of Dragoon (Disc 2)
Localization.Description: Ten thousand years ago, the Divine Tree brought forth all living races. Among them were the powerful Dragons, the resilient humans, and the magical Winglies.

Localization.Title: The Legend of Dragoon (Disc 2)
Localization.Description: The Legend of Dragoon est un jeu de rôle sur Playstation. Incarnez Dart, un jeune héros valeureux.

Localization.Title: The Legend of Dragoon (Disc 2)
Localization.Description: Vier Jahre sind vergangen seit Dart seine Heimat verließ und sich auf die Suche nach dem Schwarzen Monster machte, das seine Eltern und seinen Geburtsort Neet vernichtet hat.

Localization.Title: The Legend of Dragoon (Disc 2)
Localization.Description: Dart, un guerrero valiente y leal, ha jurado vengar la muerte de sus padres a manos de un misterioso monstruo negro. Para motivos desconocidos, el Imperio de Sandora quema su pueblo y encarcela a su amiga de la infancia, Shana.

Localization.Title: The Legend of Dragoon (Disc 2)
Localization.Description: Sono passati quattro anni da quando Dart ha lasciato la sua casa ed è andato alla ricerca del mostro nero che ha distrutto i suoi genitori e il suo luogo di nascita Neet.

Localization.Title: The Legend of Dragoon (Disc 2)
Localization.Description: O jogo conta a história de Dart, um jovem guerreiro que busca vingança contra o "Black Monster" que destruiu sua vila e matou seus pais.

Localization.Description: Dart, un guerrero valiente y leal, ha jurado vengar la muerte de sus padres a manos de un misterioso monstruo negro. Para motivos desconocidos, el Imperio de Sandora quema su pueblo y encarcela a su amiga de la infancia, Shana.

Localization.Title: The Legend of Dragoon (Disc 2)
Localization.Description: Sono passati quattro anni da quando Dart ha lasciato la sua casa ed è andato alla ricerca del mostro nero che ha distrutto i suoi genitori e il suo luogo di nascita Neet.

Localization.Title: The Legend of Dragoon (Disc 2)
Localization.Description: O jogo conta a história de Dart, um jovem guerreiro que busca vingança contra o "Black Monster" que destruiu sua vila e matou seus pais.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy Anthology: European Edition: Final Fantasy V
Localization.Description: The Elemental Crystals...the life source of the planet. With them, gentle winds blow, the seas are active, fire burns bright, and the earth is full of life.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy Anthology : European Edition : Final Fantasy V
Localization.Description: Final Fantasy V est la réédition sur Playstation du deuxième épisode de la célèbre saga de Squaresoft à être sorti sur Super Nintendo.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy Anthology: European Edition: Final Fantasy V
Localization.Description: Begleite Bartz, seinen befreundeten Choboco, die junge Prinzessin Lenna, den amnesiekranken Galuf und den Piratenkapitän Faris auf eine spannende Abenteuerreise. Es gilt, die Zerstörung der vier Kristalle zu verhindern, die ihre Welt zusammen halten.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy Anthology: European Edition: Final Fantasy V
Localization.Description: El ciclo entero de la vida en el mundo es limitado por cuatro cristales, cada uno abastece de su propia fuente energía a la humanidad; del viento que sopla a través de tierras para regar fluyendo a través de los mares, dando vida, dando el fuego caliente

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy Anthology: European Edition: Final Fantasy V
Localization.Description: I cristalli elementali ... la fonte di vita del pianeta. Con loro soffiano venti gentili, i mari sono attivi, il fuoco arde luminoso e la terra è piena di vita.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy Anthology: European Edition: Final Fantasy V
Localization.Description: Final Fantasy V é a reedição para Playstation do segundo episódio da famosa saga Squaresoft a ser lançado no Super Nintendo. Os quatro cristais que representam os quatro elementos governam o equilíbrio do mundo, até que um meteorito chegue à Terra.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy VII (Disc 3)
Localization.Description: Set in a dystopian world, Final Fantasy VII's story centers on mercenary Cloud Strife who joins with several others to stop the megacorporation Shinra, which is draining the life of the planet to use as an energy source.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy VII (Disc 3)
Localization.Description: La Corporation Shinra pompe toute l'énergie de notre planète.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy VII (Disc 3)
Localization.Description: Die Shinra Corporation entzieht unserem Planeten alle Lebensenergie. Cloud ein eiskalter Söldner, übernimmt einen Auftrag von einer Gruppe von Öko-Kriegern.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy VII (Disc 3)
Localization.Description: La corporación Shinra está agotando los recursos vitales de nuestro planeta.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy VII (Disc 3)
Localization.Description: Ambientato in un mondo distopico, la storia di Final Fantasy VII è incentrata sul mercenario Cloud Strife che si unisce ad altri compagni per fermare la Shinra Corporation, che sta prosciugando la vita del pianeta, utilizzato come fonte di energia.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy VII (Disc 3)
Localization.Description: A história segue Cloud Strife, um mercenário que junta-se a uma organização ecoterrorista a fim de impedir que megacorporação Shinra use a essência vital do planeta como uma fonte de energia.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy VIII (Disc 3)
Localization.Description: A member of an elite military team, Squall is forced into a conflict beyond imagination. To survive, he must contend with a desperate rival, a powerful sorceress, and his own mysterious dreams.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy VIII (Disc 3)
Localization.Description: Squall fait partie d'un escadron militaire d'élite et se voit obligé de participer à un conflit dépassant les limites de l'imagination.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy VIII (Disc 3)
Localization.Description: In Final Fantasy VIII schlüpfst du in die Rolle von Squall, einem Mitglied einer Elite-Militärtruppe, der in einen Konflikt mit einem rivalisierenden Gegner, einer mächtigen Hexe und seinen eigenen mysteriösen Träumen verwickelt wird.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy VIII (Disc 3)
Localization.Description: Squall, un miembro de un cuerpo de élite del ejército, se ve forzado a entrar en un conflicto que traspasa los límites de la imaginación. Para sobrevivir, debe enfrentarse a un rival desesperado, una poderosa hechicera y a sus propios sueños misteriosos.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy VIII (Disc 3)
Localization.Description: Membro di una squadra militare d'élite, Squall è costretto a un conflitto oltre ogni immaginazione. Per sopravvivere, deve lottare con un rivale disperato, una potente strega e con i suoi sogni misteriosi.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy VIII (Disc 3)
Localization.Description: A história se passa em um mundo que mistura elementos de fantasia e ficção científica, seguindo um grupo de jovens mercenários liderados por Squall Leonhart e que trabalham para uma organização chamada SeeD.

Localization.Title: The Legend of Dragoon (Disc 3)
Localization.Description: Ten thousand years ago, the Divine Tree brought forth all living races. Among them were the powerful Dragons, the resilient humans, and the magical Winglies.

Localization.Title: The Legend of Dragoon (Disc 3)
Localization.Description: The Legend of Dragoon est un jeu de rôle sur Playstation. Incarnez Dart, un jeune héros valeureux.

Localization.Title: The Legend of Dragoon (Disc 3)
Localization.Description: Vier Jahre sind vergangen seit Dart seine Heimat verließ und sich auf die Suche nach dem Schwarzen Monster machte, das seine Eltern und seinen Geburtsort Neet vernichtet hat.

Localization.Title: The Legend of Dragoon (Disc 3)
Localization.Description: Dart, un guerrero valiente y leal, ha jurado vengar la muerte de sus padres a manos de un misterioso monstruo negro. Para motivos desconocidos, el Imperio de Sandora quema su pueblo y encarcela a su amiga de la infancia, Shana.

Localization.Title: The Legend of Dragoon (Disc 3)
Localization.Description: Sono passati quattro anni da quando Dart ha lasciato la sua casa ed è andato alla ricerca del mostro nero che ha distrutto i suoi genitori e il suo luogo di nascita Neet.

Localization.Title: The Legend of Dragoon (Disc 3)
Localization.Description: O jogo conta a história de Dart, um jovem guerreiro que busca vingança contra o "Black Monster" que destruiu sua vila e matou seus pais.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy VIII (Disc 4)
Localization.Description: A member of an elite military team, Squall is forced into a conflict beyond imagination. To survive, he must contend with a desperate rival, a powerful sorceress, and his own mysterious dreams.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy VIII (Disc 4)
Localization.Description: Squall fait partie d'un escadron militaire d'élite et se voit obligé de participer à un conflit dépassant les limites de l'imagination.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy VIII (Disc 4)
Localization.Description: In Final Fantasy VIII schlüpfst du in die Rolle von Squall, einem Mitglied einer Elite-Militärtruppe, der in einen Konflikt mit einem rivalisierenden Gegner, einer mächtigen Hexe und seinen eigenen mysteriösen Träumen verwickelt wird.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy VIII (Disc 4)
Localization.Description: Squall, un miembro de un cuerpo de élite del ejército, se ve forzado a entrar en un conflicto que traspasa los límites de la imaginación. Para sobrevivir, debe enfrentarse a un rival desesperado, una poderosa hechicera y a sus propios sueños misteriosos.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy VIII (Disc 4)
Localization.Description: Membro di una squadra militare d'élite, Squall è costretto a un conflitto oltre ogni immaginazione. Per sopravvivere, deve lottare con un rivale disperato, una potente strega e con i suoi sogni misteriosi.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy VIII (Disc 4)
Localization.Description: A história se passa em um mundo que mistura elementos de fantasia e ficção científica, seguindo um grupo de jovens mercenários liderados por Squall Leonhart e que trabalham para uma organização chamada SeeD.

Localization.Title: The Legend of Dragoon (Disc 4)
Localization.Description: Ten thousand years ago, the Divine Tree brought forth all living races. Among them were the powerful Dragons, the resilient humans, and the magical Winglies.

Localization.Title: The Legend of Dragoon (Disc 4)
Localization.Description: The Legend of Dragoon est un jeu de rôle sur Playstation. Incarnez Dart, un jeune héros valeureux.

Localization.Title: The Legend of Dragoon (Disc 4)
Localization.Description: Vier Jahre sind vergangen seit Dart seine Heimat verließ und sich auf die Suche nach dem Schwarzen Monster machte, das seine Eltern und seinen Geburtsort Neet vernichtet hat.

Localization.Title: The Legend of Dragoon (Disc 4)
Localization.Description: Dart, un guerrero valiente y leal, ha jurado vengar la muerte de sus padres a manos de un misterioso monstruo negro. Para motivos desconocidos, el Imperio de Sandora quema su pueblo y encarcela a su amiga de la infancia, Shana.

Localization.Title: The Legend of Dragoon (Disc 4)
Localization.Description: Sono passati quattro anni da quando Dart ha lasciato la sua casa ed è andato alla ricerca del mostro nero che ha distrutto i suoi genitori e il suo luogo di nascita Neet.

Localization.Title: The Legend of Dragoon (Disc 4)
Localization.Description: O jogo conta a história de Dart, um jovem guerreiro que busca vingança contra o "Black Monster" que destruiu sua vila e matou seus pais.

Localization.Title: Arc the Lad

Localization.Title: Arc the Lad

Localization.Title: Arc the Lad

Localization.Title: I.Q: Intelligent Qube

Localization.Description: After his defeat, Dr. Neo Cortex discovers the crystals that keep the world in balance. However, something is wrong: some of the crystals are missing. When the planets align, the chaotic flux created by the event will destroy the world.

Localization.Title: Crash Bandicoot 2 : Cortex no Gyakushuu!
Localization.Description: Le terrible Dr. Neo Cortex est de retour...

Localization.Title: Crash Bandicoot 2: Cortex no Gyakushuu!

Localization.Title: Crash Bandicoot 2: Cortex no Gyakushuu!

Localization.Title: MDK

Localization.Title: Legaia Densetsu
Localization.Description: After creating a massive world with vast oceans, landscapes and an infinite universe, God instituted human beings to keep his creation in order.

Localization.Title: Legaia Densetsu
Localization.Description: Legend of Legaia est un jeu de rôle sur Playstation dans lequel une étrange brume transforme les êtres vivants en sinistres mutants. Le seul espoir ? Raviver les arbres de la genèse.

Localization.Title: Legaia Densetsu
Localization.Description: Ein unheimlicher Nebel bedeckt die Welt von Legaia in Legend of Legaia für PS1. Allen, die mit ihm in Berührung kamen, brachte er Wahnsinn und Verderben. Um zu überleben, hat sich die Bevölkerung an den Rand ihrer Zivilisation zurückgezogen.

Localization.Title: Legaia Densetsu
Localization.Description: La historia nos narra que en la antigüedad fueron creados unos seres llamados Seru. Los seru eran una especie de estatuas que al acoplarse con un humano multiplicaban sus habilidades por 10.

Localization.Title: Legaia Densetsu
Localization.Description: Dopo aver creato un mondo enorme con vasti oceani, paesaggi e un universo infinito, Dio ha istituito gli esseri umani per mantenere in ordine la sua creazione.

Localization.Title: Legaia Densetsu
Localization.Description: After creating a massive world with vast oceans, landscapes and an infinite universe, God instituted human beings to keep his creation in order.

Localization.Title: Rapid Racer
Localization.Description: From the same team that developed Porsche Challenge for the PlayStation, this is a high-speed racer where the user controls a number of adrenaline-pumping speedboats.

Localization.Title: Rapid Racer
Localization.Description: Rapid Racer sur Playstation est un jeu de courses de bateaux très rapide. Choisissez votre équipe et votre véhicule avant de vous lancer à fond sur les pistes aquatiques, mais attention, un bateau n'est pas aussi facile à conduire qu'une voiture.

Localization.Title: Rapid Racer
Localization.Description: Rapid Racer, in Nordamerika unter dem Namen Turbo Prop Racing bekannt, ist ein Rennvideospiel, das von Sony Computer Entertainment Europe entwickelt und 1997 für PlayStation veröffentlicht wurde.

Localization.Title: Rapid Racer
Localization.Description: Del mismo equipo que desarrolló Porsche Challenge para PlayStation, este es un juego de carreras de alta velocidad en el que controla una serie de lanchas rápidas que bombean adrenalina.

Localization.Title: Rapid Racer
Localization.Description: Rapid Racer, noto come Turbo Prop Racing in Nord America, è un videogioco di corse sviluppato da Sony Computer Entertainment Europe e pubblicato per PlayStation nel 1997.

Localization.Title: Rapid Racer
Localization.Description: From the same team that developed Porsche Challenge for the PlayStation, this is a high-speed racer where the user controls a number of adrenaline-pumping speedboats.

Localization.Title: KulaQuest
Localization.Description: In Kula World, the player controls a beach ball navigating a series of cubic-grid labyrinths suspended high above various locales. The objective of each level is to collect all of the keys scattered throughout to unlock the exit.

Localization.Title: KulaQuest
Localization.Description: Dans Kula World sur Playstation vous n'êtes pas n'importe qui, ou plutôt n'importe quoi : vous incarnez un ballon. Dans ce jeu de réflexion, vous devez rouler et trouver les clés vous permettant d'atteindre les niveaux suivants.

Localization.Title: KulaQuest
Localization.Description: Mit ihrem Kula-Beachball schweben Sie durch 200 3D-Labyrinthe - kilometerweit über dem Erdboden! Sammeln Sie alle Schätze, und finden Sie alle Schlüssel. Nur so gelangen Sie in die Freiheit.

Localization.Title: KulaQuest
Localization.Description: En Kula World, el jugador controla una pelota de playa navegando por una serie de laberintos de cuadrículas cúbicas suspendidos por encima de varios lugares. El objetivo de cada nivel es recopilar todas las claves dispersas para desbloquear la salida.

Localization.Title: KulaQuest
Localization.Description: Con la vostra palla da spiaggia Kula galleggiate attraverso 200 labirinti 3D - a miglia da terra! Raccogli tutti i tesori e trova tutte le chiavi. Questo è l'unico modo per raggiungere la libertà. Ma attenzione, in fondo non vogliono cadere nel baratro.

Localization.Title: KulaQuest
Localization.Description: In Kula World, the player controls a beach ball navigating a series of cubic-grid labyrinths suspended high above various locales. The objective of each level is to collect all of the keys scattered throughout to unlock the exit.

Localization.Title: G-Police (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: After a violent interstellar resource war, mega-corporations seize power from the remnants of Earth's governments and lead humanity's way into the colonization of space.

Localization.Title: G-Police (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: G-police est un jeu Playstation dans lequel vous incarnez un agent de police dans un monde futuriste. Votre but est de combattre la criminalité dans les villes et les colonies, et ce à bord d'un hélicoptère de combat.

Localization.Title: G-Police (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Im Jahr 2089 versinken die Städte auf der Erde und ihre Außenposten auf anderen Planeten in einem Sumpf aus Habgier, Korruption und Gewalt.

Localization.Title: I.Q Final
Localization.Description: Intelligent Qube is a classic puzzle game for the PlayStation. It is known as Kurushi in Europe and Australia. In the game, the player controls a character who must run around a platform made of cubes, capturing certain cubes as they approach.

Localization.Title: I.Q Final
Localization.Description: Kurushi sur Playstation est un puzzle-game. Réflexion est le mot d'ordre dans ce jeu où vous devez détruire des blocs pour survivre. Le but est d'arriver à agrandir votre plate-forme, si vous faites des erreurs celle-ci rétrécira.

Localization.Title: I.Q Final
Localization.Description: Das 3D-Puzzle Kurushi ist eine Prüfung, ein Intelligenztest, der von einer höheren Macht entwickelt wurde. Sie sehen sich gewaltigen Würfeln gegenüber, die erbarmungslos auf Sie zurollen.

Localization.Title: I.Q Final
Localization.Description: ¿Crees que eres inteligente? Este adictivo tornado cerebral 3D pone tus habilidades de pensamiento estratégico y reflejos al límite. Destruye los terrores geométricos que se aproximan antes de que te empujen sobre el borde o que te aplasten.

Localization.Title: I.Q Final
Localization.Description: Intelligent Qube è un classico gioco rompicapo per PlayStation. In Europa e Australia è conosciuto con il nome di Kurushi.

Localization.Title: I.Q Final
Localization.Description: Intelligent Qube is a classic puzzle game for the PlayStation. It is known as Kurushi in Europe and Australia. In the game, the player controls a character who must run around a platform made of cubes, capturing certain cubes as they approach.

Localization.Description: After defeating Dr. Neo Cortex, Crash and his sister, Coco, take a well-deserved vacation. However, their friend, Aku Aku, has a bad feeling, and as usual, he is right. Aku's evil twin, Uka Uka, was the person behind all of Dr. Cortex's schemes.

Localization.Title: Crash Bandicoot 3 : Buttobi! Sekai Isshuu
Localization.Description: Plongés dans des décors inédits et aux commandes de tout nouveaux véhicules, des personnages détraqués rejoignent Crash Bandicoot dans une course à travers le temps pour sauver le monde!

Localization.Title: Crash Bandicoot 3: Buttobi! Sekai Isshuu
Localization.Description: Crash Bandicot kehrt zurück... Er begibt sich diesmal auf eine Zeitreise, die ihn unter anderem in das Alte Ägypten, Rom und England führt. Sogar in die vorgeschichtliche Zeit reist Crash, dort reitet er auf einem Dinosaurier.

Localization.Title: Crash Bandicoot 3: Buttobi! Sekai Isshuu
Localization.Description: Tras el fracaso del plan del Dr. Neo Cortex y la caída de su base espacial sobre la jungla, la malvada máscara Uka Uka es finalmente liberada.

Localization.Title: Crash Bandicoot 3: Buttobi! Sekai Isshuu
Localization.Description: Con le animazioni tutte nuove e i tantissimi nuovi veicoli, un folle cast di personaggi si unisce a Crash Bandicoot in una gara nel tempo per salvare il destino dell'intero universo!

Localization.Title: Crash Bandicoot 3: Buttobi! Sekai Isshuu
Localization.Description: Após o Dr Nitrus Brio e Crash Bandicoot terem destruído a estação de Cortex, um dos pedaços foi parar na Terra.

Localization.Title: MediEvil: Yomigaetta Gallowmere no Yuusha
Localization.Description: The Evil Wizard Zarok has returned from the dead to wreak havoc on a peaceful land, and it is up to the centuries-dead hero, Sir Daniel Fortesque, to rise from his grave and defeat the very nemesis that put him in that grave.

Localization.Title: MediEvil : Yomigaetta Gallowmere no Yuusha
Localization.Description: Perdue dans les limbes temporelles, l'histoire de Gallowmere est celle du pays où la magie a pris le pas sur la science et où Zarok, le sorcier à l'âme torturée, exploite ses pouvoirs les plus sombres.

Localization.Title: MediEvil: Yomigaetta Gallowmere no Yuusha
Localization.Description: Vom Winde der Zeit verweht, ist die Geschichte von Gallowmere, einem Land in dem Magie mehr gilt als Wissenschaft und in dem ein Hexer - der finstere Zarok - ihre dunkelsten Mächte an sich gerissen hat.

Localization.Title: MediEvil: Yomigaetta Gallowmere no Yuusha
Localization.Description: En el reino de Gallowmere, año 1286, el poderoso mago Zarok, desterrado por nigromancia, reunió a un numeroso ejército de zombis, demonios y otros monstruos con la intención de conquistar el reino al que pertenecía y vengarse de la familia real.

Localization.Title: MediEvil: Yomigaetta Gallowmere no Yuusha
Localization.Description: Il malvagio mago Zarok è tornato dalla morte per devastare una terra pacifica, e spetta all'eroe morto da secoli, Sir Daniel Fortesque, risorgere dalla sua tomba e sconfiggere la stessa nemesi che lo ha messo in quella tomba.

Localization.Title: MediEvil: Yomigaetta Gallowmere no Yuusha
Localization.Description: Medievil é um jogo de ação / aventura no Playstation. Um mago chamado Zarok quer fazer tudo para dominar o mundo.
