Localization.Title: Spyro the Dragon (Shokai Genteiban)
Localization.Description: Spyro the Dragon is a platform game developed by Insomniac Games for the PlayStation. It stars the title character, a young purple dragon named Spyro and his dragonfly friend, Sparx, and is the first game in the Spyro the Dragon series.

Localization.Title: Spyro the Dragon (Shokai Genteiban)
Localization.Description: La terre des Dragons a été envahie par Gnasty Gnorc et son armée de Gnorcs. Tous les dragons ont été transformés en statues de cristal, seul Spyro a été épargné.

Localization.Title: Spyro the Dragon (Shokai Genteiban)
Localization.Description: Spyro ist ein süßer, lila Drache, der in der Klemme steckt. Alle Drachenfreunde von Spyro sind dem bösen Gnasty Gnorc zum Opfer gefallen, der sie in Kristalle verwandelt hat.

Localization.Title: Spyro the Dragon (Shokai Genteiban)
Localization.Description: Gnasty Gnorc y su ejército Gnorc han conquistado los mundos de los dragones, y los han convertido a todos en estatuas de cristal... excepto a Spyro.

Localization.Title: Alundra 2: Mashinka no Nazo
Localization.Description: Du bist Flint, ein abtrünniger Schwertkämpfer, der angeheuert wird, um das Königreich Varuna aus den Klauen eines grausamen Herrschers zu befreien.

Localization.Title: Alundra 2: Mashinka no Nazo
Localization.Description: En las lejanas tierras del reino de Vanilla ha aparecido un misterioso ser en la región de Doru, que es capaz de variar a su antojo la evolución del reino animal, forzando una evolución mágica.

Localization.Title: Alundra 2: Mashinka no Nazo
Localization.Description: Alundra 2 è un gioco di ruolo/avventura ispirato alla fantasia su Playstation. Con l'aiuto di uno stregone e di pirati, un malvagio barone ha imprigionato il monarca del regno di Varuna. Uno spadaccino di nome Flint decide di opporsi a lui...

Localization.Title: Alundra 2: Mashinka no Nazo
Localization.Description: Nas terras distantes do reino de Baunilha surgiu um ser misterioso na região de Doru, que é capaz de variar à vontade a evolução do reino animal, forçando uma evolução mágica.

Localization.Title: Gran Turismo 2 (Disc 1) (Arcade)
Localization.Description: Gran Turismo 2 is fundamentally based on the racing game genre. The player must maneuver an automobile to compete against artificially intelligent drivers on various race tracks. The game uses two different modes: arcade and simulation.

Localization.Title: Gran Turismo 2 (Disc 1) (Arcade)
Localization.Description: Le stade ultime de la simulation de course. 600 voitures conçues par 33 des plus grands constructeurs automobile au monde... Trouvez le réglage parfait de vos véhicules. 28 circuits dont le célèbre Laguna Seca.

Localization.Title: Gran Turismo 2 (Disc 1) (Arcade)
Localization.Description: „Gran Turismo 2“ kehrt zurück mit über 500 Wagenmodellen und mehr als 20 Strecken. Das Spiel bringt realistische Fahrphysik, detaillierte Streckensimulationen und DUALSHOCK-Vibration für ein authentisches Rennerlebnis.

Localization.Title: Gran Turismo 2 (Disc 1) (Arcade)
Localization.Description: Gran Turismo 2 tiene 22 circuitos, 6 licencias, 600 coches, 6 circuitos de rendimiento y eventos de rally.

Localization.Title: Gran Turismo 2 (Disc 1) (Arcade)
Localization.Description: Gran Turismo 2 ha 22 piste, 6 licenze, 600 auto, 6 piste di performance ed eventi di rally.

Localization.Title: Gran Turismo 2 (Disc 1) (Arcade)
Localization.Description: Gran Turismo 2 é essencialmente um jogo de corrida no qual o jogador deve conduzir um automóvel e competir contra adversários controlados pela inteligência artificial em diferentes pistas. O jogo oferece dois modos distintos: Arcade e Simulação.

Localization.Title: Gran Turismo 2 (Disc 2) (Gran Turismo)
Localization.Description: Gran Turismo 2 is fundamentally based on the racing game genre. The player must maneuver an automobile to compete against artificially intelligent drivers on various race tracks. The game uses two different modes: arcade and simulation.

Localization.Title: Gran Turismo 2 (Disc 2) (Gran Turismo)
Localization.Description: Le stade ultime de la simulation de course. 600 voitures conçues par 33 des plus grands constructeurs automobile au monde... Trouvez le réglage parfait de vos véhicules. 28 circuits dont le célèbre Laguna Seca.

Localization.Description: „Gran Turismo 2“ kehrt zurück mit über 500 Wagenmodellen und mehr als 20 Strecken. Das Spiel bringt realistische Fahrphysik, detaillierte Streckensimulationen und DUALSHOCK-Vibration für ein authentisches Rennerlebnis.

Localization.Title: Gran Turismo 2 (Disc 2) (Gran Turismo)
Localization.Description: Gran Turismo 2 tiene 22 circuitos, 6 licencias, 600 coches, 6 circuitos de rendimiento y eventos de rally.

Localization.Title: Gran Turismo 2 (Disc 2) (Gran Turismo)
Localization.Description: Gran Turismo 2 si basa fondamentalmente sul genere dei giochi di corse. Il giocatore deve manovrare un'automobile per competere contro piloti artificialmente intelligenti su vari circuiti. Il gioco utilizza due diverse modalità: arcade e simulazione.

Localization.Title: Gran Turismo 2 (Disc 2) (Gran Turismo)
Localization.Description: Gran Turismo 2 se baseia fundamentalmente no gênero de corrida de carros. O jogador deve dirigir um automóvel para competir contra pilotos artificialmente inteligentes em várias pistas. O jogo utiliza dois modos: Arcade e Simulação.

Localization.Title: The Legend of Dragoon (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Ten thousand years ago, the Divine Tree brought forth all living races. Among them were the powerful Dragons, the resilient humans, and the magical Winglies.

Localization.Title: The Legend of Dragoon (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: The Legend of Dragoon est un jeu de rôle sur Playstation. Incarnez Dart, un jeune héros valeureux.

Localization.Title: The Legend of Dragoon (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Vier Jahre sind vergangen seit Dart seine Heimat verließ und sich auf die Suche nach dem Schwarzen Monster machte, das seine Eltern und seinen Geburtsort Neet vernichtet hat.

Localization.Title: The Legend of Dragoon (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Dart, un guerrero valiente y leal, ha jurado vengar la muerte de sus padres a manos de un misterioso monstruo negro. Para motivos desconocidos, el Imperio de Sandora quema su pueblo y encarcela a su amiga de la infancia, Shana.

Localization.Title: The Legend of Dragoon (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Sono passati quattro anni da quando Dart ha lasciato la sua casa ed è andato alla ricerca del mostro nero che ha distrutto i suoi genitori e il suo luogo di nascita Neet.

Localization.Title: The Legend of Dragoon (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: O jogo conta a história de Dart, um jovem guerreiro que busca vingança contra o "Black Monster" que destruiu sua vila e matou seus pais.

Localization.Description: Pachamama is the leader of a democratic movement and is returning to her country Meruza for an election. Naturally the tyrannical dictator will want to prevent her at all costs. A bomb is planted on the plane that she is travelling.

Localization.Title: Destruction Derby 2
Localization.Description: Strap in, hold on, hit the gas, and you're off on a quest for destructive points in Destruction Derby 2, the smashing sequel to the original demolition derby game from Reflections Interactive and Psygnosis.

Localization.Title: Destruction Derby 2
Localization.Description: Destruction Derby 2 est un jeu de courses musclées sur Playstation. Vous pouvez conduire de nombreux véhicules qui seront réduits à néant lors des courses puisque dans ce jeu personne ne vous fera de cadeau.

Localization.Title: Destruction Derby 2
Localization.Description: Setz dich ans Steuer deines frisierten Wagens und zeig es deinen Gegnern – entweder indem du sie überholst oder indem du ihre Fahrzeuge in Einzelteile zerlegst.

Localization.Title: Destruction Derby 2
Localization.Description: Abróchese el cinturón, sujétese, pise el acelerador y comenzara una búsqueda de puntos de destrucción en Destruction Derby 2, la espectacular continuación del juego demolition derby original de Reflections Interactive y Psygnosis.

Localization.Title: Destruction Derby 2

Localization.Title: Destruction Derby 2

Localization.Title: Wipeout XL
Localization.Description: WipEout XL is set in the year 2097, around four decades after its predecessor. Instead of the F3600 anti-gravity racing competition, the game features an even faster and more dangerous tournament: the F5000 AG league.

Localization.Title: Wipeout XL

Localization.Title: Suikoden

Localization.Title: Suikoden

Localization.Title: Dead or Alive
Localization.Description: As you wake up from your slumber in a cryogenic tube, you begin to wonder who you are, where you are, and how you arrived at this unknown place.

Localization.Title: Dead or Alive
Localization.Description: OverBlood est considéré comme l'un des tout premiers survival horror utilisant des décors et un environnement en trois dimensions. Lars Karcy se réveille d'un caisson cryogénique sans savoir qui il est ni où il se trouve.

Localization.Title: Dead or Alive
Localization.Description: Wenn Sie aus Ihrem Schlaf in einer Kryoröhre erwachen, beginnen Sie sich zu fragen, wer Sie sind, wo Sie sind und wie Sie an diesen unbekannten Ort gelangt sind.

Localization.Title: Dead or Alive
Localization.Description: Te despiertas de un sueño criogénico sin memoria, comienzas a preguntarte quién eres, dónde estás y cómo llegaste a este lugar desconocido, a través de una base subterránea, descubres que un virus maligno corre por tus venas. Debes encontrar un antídoto.

Localization.Title: Dead or Alive
Localization.Description: Quando ti svegli dal tuo sonno in un tubo criogenico, inizi a chiederti chi sei, dove sei e come sei arrivato in questo luogo sconosciuto. Grazie ai gadget che ti circondano, la domanda sulla tua identità avrà una risposta rapida: tu sei Raz Karcy.

Localization.Title: Dead or Alive
Localization.Description: As you wake up from your slumber in a cryogenic tube, you begin to wonder who you are, where you are, and how you arrived at this unknown place.

Localization.Title: Castlevania: Symphony of the Night
Localization.Description: As a descendant of Dracula, you must end the vampire bloodline. Can you rid the world of this unspeakable terror? Uncover the mystery of Castlevania and challenge an adventure as legendary as its name.

Localization.Title: Castlevania : Symphony of the Night
Localization.Description: Retour de la légende. Réveillé de son sommeil éternel par la réapparition de Castlevania, Alucard doit une fois de plus affronter les laquais malfaisants du Prince des ténèbres.

Localization.Title: Castlevania: Symphony of the Night
Localization.Description: Die Legende kehrt zurück Alucard wird durch das Wiedererscheinen von Castlevania aus seinem ewigen Schlummer erweckt und muss wieder einmal gegen die Knechte der Finsternis antreten.

Localization.Title: Castlevania: Symphony of the Night
Localization.Description: Vuelve la leyenda. Despertando de su eterno reposo por la aparición de Castlevania, Alucard debe enfrentarse de nuevo a las malvadas criaturas de la noche.

Localization.Title: Castlevania: Symphony of the Night
Localization.Description: Come discendente di Dracula, devi porre fine alla stirpe dei vampiri. Riuscirai a liberare il mondo da questo indicibile terrore? Scopri il mistero di Castlevania e sfida un'avventura leggendaria come il suo nome.

Localization.Title: Castlevania: Symphony of the Night
Localization.Description: Quatro anos após a batalha entre Richter Belmont e Dracula, a escuridão reaparece. O fantasma do sacerdote das trevas Shaft, morto por Richter uma vez, ressurge com um novo plano de ressuscitar seu mestre.

Localization.Title: G Darius
Localization.Description: G-Darius revolves around a conflict between the humanoids of Amnelia and cyborg/chimera biovessels known as the "Thiima" (meant to mean simply "bringers of death"). The Thiima had been aroused by the Amnelian army's use of the weapon A.N.

Localization.Title: G Darius
Localization.Description: G-Darius est un jeu de tir sur Playstation. Vous pouvez apprécier le soft avec ses dessins superbes en 2D ainsi que les décors entièrement réalisés en 3D. Plongez-vous dans un univers d'action non-stop ainsi que 15 niveaux gigantesques.

Localization.Title: G Darius
Localization.Description: G-Darius dreht sich um einen Konflikt zwischen den Humanoiden von Amnelia und Cyborg/Chimären-Bioschiffen, die als „Thiima“ bekannt sind (was einfach „Todesbringer“ bedeuten soll). Die Thiima waren durch den Einsatz der Waffe A.N.

Localization.Title: G Darius
Localization.Description: G Darius narra la historia de la estrella Darius y de los héroes que la protegen del mal. Tu mision es luchar contra las fuerzas del mal en una nave tecnologicamente muy avanzada, la unica esperanza de la humanidad en estos momentos. G.

Localization.Title: G Darius
Localization.Description: G-Darius ruota attorno a un conflitto tra gli umanoidi di Amnelia e i biovascelli cyborg/chimera noti come "Thiima" (che significa semplicemente "portatori di morte").

Localization.Title: Tekken 3
Localization.Description: An ancient evil force has reawakened, attacking in secret and feeding on the souls of mighty warriors. To lure it out of hiding will take the greatest fighting contest the world has ever seen... Tekken 3.

Localization.Title: Tekken 3
Localization.Description: Fin du King of Iron Fist Tournament 2. Heihachi a vaincu Kazuya et reprend la tête de Mishima Zaibatsu. Un jour, il entend parler d'un ancien dieu mexicain, Ogre, qui serait attiré par les âmes fortes.

Localization.Title: Tekken 3
Localization.Description: Eine uralte böse Macht ist erwacht, die heimlich angreift und sich von den Seelen mächtiger Kriegern ernährt. Um Sie aus dem Versteck zu locken, wird es das größte Kampfturnier geben, das die Welt je gesehen hat ... Tekken 3.

Localization.Title: Tekken 3
Localization.Description: Una vez más, el destino une a todos aquellos dispuestos a escuchar la llamada... Una nueva generación de guerreros. Gráficos alucinantes de alta resolución. Modalidades Tekken Force y Tekken Ball completamente nuevas.

Localization.Title: Tekken 3
Localization.Description: Fine del Torneo del Pugno del Re di Ferro 2. Heihachi ha sconfitto Kazuya ed è tornato in vantaggio per Mishima Zaibatsu. Un giorno, sente parlare di un antico dio messicano, Ogre, che si dice sia attratto da anime forti.

Localization.Title: Tekken 3
Localization.Description: Lute por Sua Vida! A força ancestral do mal acordou, atacando em segredo e se alimentando das almas de bravos heróis. Para ser libertada, participará do maior torneio de luta que o mundo já viu... Tekken 3. Alguns lutam por vingança, outros por honra.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy V
Localization.Description: The Elemental Crystals...the life source of the planet. With them, gentle winds blow, the seas are active, fire burns bright, and the earth is full of life.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy V
Localization.Description: Final Fantasy V est la réédition sur Playstation du deuxième épisode de la célèbre saga de Squaresoft à être sorti sur Super Nintendo.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy V
Localization.Description: Begleite Bartz, seinen befreundeten Choboco, die junge Prinzessin Lenna, den amnesiekranken Galuf und den Piratenkapitän Faris auf eine spannende Abenteuerreise. Es gilt, die Zerstörung der vier Kristalle zu verhindern, die ihre Welt zusammen halten.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy V
Localization.Description: El ciclo entero de la vida en el mundo es limitado por cuatro cristales, cada uno abastece de su propia fuente energía a la humanidad; del viento que sopla a través de tierras para regar fluyendo a través de los mares, dando vida, dando el fuego caliente

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy V
Localization.Description: I cristalli elementali ... la fonte di vita del pianeta. Con loro soffiano venti gentili, i mari sono attivi, il fuoco arde luminoso e la terra è piena di vita.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy V
Localization.Description: Final Fantasy V é a reedição para Playstation do segundo episódio da famosa saga Squaresoft a ser lançado no Super Nintendo. Os quatro cristais que representam os quatro elementos governam o equilíbrio do mundo, até que um meteorito chegue à Terra.

Localization.Title: R4: Ridge Racer Type 4
Localization.Description: Powering beyond RIDGE and RAGE RACER, high-speed control and advanced dynamics accekerate the rush of a first class victory.

Localization.Title: R4 : Ridge Racer Type 4
Localization.Description: Ridge Racer Type 4 sur Playstation est un jeu de courses totalement arcade. Vous démarrez avec 8 voitures au choix mais pouvez en débloquer beaucoup plus (un peu plus de 300) en tournant sur les 8 circuits présents et sur leur 8 versions miroir.

Localization.Title: R4: Ridge Racer Type 4
Localization.Description: R4 Ridge Racer Type 4 kombiniert die Arcade-Fahraction seiner Vorgänger mit Elementen im Simulationsstil wie Custom Cars und der Teilnahme an einer kompletten Rennsaison.

Localization.Title: R4: Ridge Racer Type 4
Localization.Description: Disfruta todavía más de la alta velocidad y la avanzada dinámica de Ridge Racer y Rage Racer, para conseguir victorias aún más emocionantes. El juego se basa en competir en el Real Racing Roots '99 (RRR), que consta de ocho carreras entre Japón y los EE.

Localization.Title: R4: Ridge Racer Type 4
Localization.Description: Superando RIDGE e RAGE RACER, il controllo ad alta velocità e le dinamiche avanzate accekerano l'entusiasmo di una vittoria di prima classe.

Localization.Title: R4: Ridge Racer Type 4
Localization.Description: O Ridge Racer Type 4 na Playstation é um jogo de corridas arcade. Comece com 8 carros à escolha, desbloqueando muitos mais correndo nas 8 pistas disponíveis e também nas suas versões espelhadas.

Localization.Title: Ridge Racer: High Spec Ver. & Namco Catalogue '98
Localization.Description: Ridge Racer is an arcade racer that puts the emphasis on speed and fun rather than on realistic driving simulation.

Localization.Title: Ridge Racer : High Spec Ver. & Namco Catalogue '98
Localization.Description: Ridge Racer est un jeu de courses sur Playstation.

Localization.Title: Ridge Racer: High Spec Ver. & Namco Catalogue '98
Localization.Description: Mit quietschenden Reifen in Turbogeschwndigkeit rast Du mit, in einem heißen Rennen im absoluten Arcade-Feeling, Ridge Racer - unglaublich realistische Renn-Action, auf die Ihr garantiert voll abfährst!...

Localization.Title: Ridge Racer: High Spec Ver. & Namco Catalogue '98
Localization.Description: Ridge Racer es un juego de carreras arcade que pone más énfasis en la velocidad y la diversión, que en la simulación realista de conducción.

Localization.Title: Ridge Racer: High Spec Ver. & Namco Catalogue '98
Localization.Description: Ridge Racer è un gioco di corse arcade che pone maggiormente l'accento sulla velocità e sul divertimento rispetto alla simulazione di guida realistica.

Localization.Title: Ridge Racer: High Spec Ver. & Namco Catalogue '98
Localization.Description: Ridge Racer é um jogo de corridas de arcada que coloca a ênfase na velocidade e no divertimento em vez de na simulação realista de condução.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy VIII (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: A member of an elite military team, Squall is forced into a conflict beyond imagination. To survive, he must contend with a desperate rival, a powerful sorceress, and his own mysterious dreams.

Localization.Description: Squall fait partie d'un escadron militaire d'élite et se voit obligé de participer à un conflit dépassant les limites de l'imagination.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy VI
Localization.Description: Set in a fantasy world with a technology level equivalent to that of the Second Industrial Revolution, the game's story focuses on a group of rebels as they seek to overthrow an imperial dictatorship.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy VI
Localization.Description: Comprendre l'héritage du passé. Plusieurs siècles se sont écoulés depuis la guerre de la magie. Le monde s'est reconstruit et a donné naissance à la civilisation de l'acier, des machines et de la technologie.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy VI
Localization.Description: Der Kampf der Zauberer liegt viele Jahrhunderte zurück. Mit Eisen, Maschinen und moderner Technik wurden Zivilisationen wiederaufgebaut.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy VI
Localization.Description: Miles de años atrás, convivían en un mismo mundo dos razas: los humanos y los Espers, seres dotados de grandes poderes mágicos, pues su propia esencia tenía origen en la magia.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy VI
Localization.Description: Ambientato in un mondo fantastico con un livello tecnologico equivalente a quello della Seconda Rivoluzione Industriale, la storia del gioco si concentra su un gruppo di ribelli che cercano di rovesciare una dittatura imperiale.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy VI
Localization.Description: Situado num mundo de fantasia com um nível de tecnologia equivalente ao da Segunda Revolução Industrial, a história do jogo se concentra em um grupo de rebeldes que procuram derrubar uma ditadura imperial.

Localization.Title: Spyro the Dragon (Shokai Genteiban)
Localization.Description: Spyro the Dragon is a platform game developed by Insomniac Games for the PlayStation. It stars the title character, a young purple dragon named Spyro and his dragonfly friend, Sparx, and is the first game in the Spyro the Dragon series.

Localization.Title: Spyro the Dragon (Shokai Genteiban)
Localization.Description: La terre des Dragons a été envahie par Gnasty Gnorc et son armée de Gnorcs. Tous les dragons ont été transformés en statues de cristal, seul Spyro a été épargné.

Localization.Title: Spyro the Dragon (Shokai Genteiban)
Localization.Description: Spyro ist ein süßer, lila Drache, der in der Klemme steckt. Alle Drachenfreunde von Spyro sind dem bösen Gnasty Gnorc zum Opfer gefallen, der sie in Kristalle verwandelt hat.

Localization.Title: Spyro the Dragon (Shokai Genteiban)
Localization.Description: Gnasty Gnorc y su ejército Gnorc han conquistado los mundos de los dragones, y los han convertido a todos en estatuas de cristal... excepto a Spyro.

Localization.Title: Spyro the Dragon (Shokai Genteiban)
Localization.Description: Spyro the Dragon è un gioco platform sviluppato da Insomniac Games per PlayStation. Ha come protagonisti il ​​personaggio del titolo, un giovane drago viola di nome Spyro e il suo amico libellula, Sparx, ed è il primo gioco della serie Spyro the Dragon.

Localization.Title: Spyro the Dragon (Shokai Genteiban)
Localization.Description: Spyro The Dragon é um jogo de plataforma no Playstation. O mago maligno Gnasty Gnorc quer conquistar o mundo. Para isso, ele colocou fora de perigo todos os dragões por statufiant em cristal.

Localization.Title: Racing Lagoon
Localization.Description: Racing Lagoon is a Racing-RPG. Your earn experience for your various car parts and racing points by challenging other cars on streets modeled after the actual roadmaps of Yokohama, Japan.

Localization.Title: Racing Lagoon
Localization.Description: Racing Lagoon sous-titré High Speed Driving RPG est un titre totalement passé inaperçu, sorti en 1999 sur Playstation 1 au Japon, made in Squaresoft.

Localization.Title: Racing Lagoon
Localization.Description: Racing Lagoon is a Racing-RPG. Your earn experience for your various car parts and racing points by challenging other cars on streets modeled after the actual roadmaps of Yokohama, Japan.

Localization.Title: Racing Lagoon
Localization.Description: Racing Lagoon es un RPG de carreras. Obtienes experiencia para las distintas piezas de tu coche y puntos de carrera desafiando a otros autos en calles modeladas a partir de rutas reales en Yokohama, Japón.

Localization.Title: Racing Lagoon
Localization.Description: Racing Lagoon è un gioco di ruolo di corsa. Guadagni esperienza per le varie parti di automobili e i punti di gara sfidando altre auto su strade modellate sulle reali mappe stradali di Yokohama, in Giappone.

Localization.Title: Racing Lagoon
Localization.Description: Racing Lagoon é um RPG de corrida. Você ganha experiência para as várias peças do seu carro e pontos de corrida ao desafiar outros carros em ruas modeladas com base nos roteiros reais de Yokohama, no Japão.

Localization.Title: Garou Densetsu: Wild Ambition
Localization.Description: A long standing vendetta culminates with excitement in Fatal Fury: Wild Ambition. With vindictive rage, one fighter searches for truth and redemption against the ruthless crime lord who murdered his father.

Localization.Title: Garou Densetsu : Wild Ambition
Localization.Description: Fatal Fury : Wild Ambition raconte à nouveau l'histoire du combat de Terry et Andy Bogard pour venger la mort de leur père aux mains de Geese Howard.

Localization.Title: Garou Densetsu: Wild Ambition
Localization.Description: In Fatal Fury: Wild Ambition findet ein langjähriger Rachefeldzug seinen Höhepunkt. Mit rachsüchtiger Wut sucht ein Kämpfer nach Wahrheit und Erlösung gegen den skrupellosen Verbrecherboss, der seinen Vater ermordet hat.

Localization.Title: Garou Densetsu: Wild Ambition
Localization.Description: Fatal Fury: Wild Ambition cuenta una vez más la historia de la lucha de Terry y Andy Bogard para vengar la muerte de su padre a manos de Geese Howard.

Localization.Title: Garou Densetsu: Wild Ambition
Localization.Description: Una vendetta di lunga data culmina con grande suspense in Fatal Fury: Wild Ambition. Con rabbia vendicativa, un combattente cerca la verità e la redenzione contro lo spietato signore del crimine che ha ucciso suo padre.

Localization.Title: Garou Densetsu: Wild Ambition
Localization.Description: A long standing vendetta culminates with excitement in Fatal Fury: Wild Ambition. With vindictive rage, one fighter searches for truth and redemption against the ruthless crime lord who murdered his father.

Localization.Title: Gran Turismo 2 (Disc 1) (Arcade)
Localization.Description: Gran Turismo 2 is fundamentally based on the racing game genre. The player must maneuver an automobile to compete against artificially intelligent drivers on various race tracks. The game uses two different modes: arcade and simulation.

Localization.Title: Gran Turismo 2 (Disc 1) (Arcade)
Localization.Description: Le stade ultime de la simulation de course. 600 voitures conçues par 33 des plus grands constructeurs automobile au monde... Trouvez le réglage parfait de vos véhicules. 28 circuits dont le célèbre Laguna Seca.

Localization.Title: Gran Turismo 2 (Disc 1) (Arcade)
Localization.Description: „Gran Turismo 2“ kehrt zurück mit über 500 Wagenmodellen und mehr als 20 Strecken. Das Spiel bringt realistische Fahrphysik, detaillierte Streckensimulationen und DUALSHOCK-Vibration für ein authentisches Rennerlebnis.

Localization.Title: Gran Turismo 2 (Disc 1) (Arcade)
Localization.Description: Gran Turismo 2 tiene 22 circuitos, 6 licencias, 600 coches, 6 circuitos de rendimiento y eventos de rally.

Localization.Title: Gran Turismo 2 (Disc 1) (Arcade)
Localization.Description: Gran Turismo 2 ha 22 piste, 6 licenze, 600 auto, 6 piste di performance ed eventi di rally.

Localization.Title: Gran Turismo 2 (Disc 1) (Arcade)
Localization.Description: Gran Turismo 2 é essencialmente um jogo de corrida no qual o jogador deve conduzir um automóvel e competir contra adversários controlados pela inteligência artificial em diferentes pistas. O jogo oferece dois modos distintos: Arcade e Simulação.

Localization.Title: Gran Turismo 2 (Disc 2) (Gran Turismo)
Localization.Description: Gran Turismo 2 is fundamentally based on the racing game genre. The player must maneuver an automobile to compete against artificially intelligent drivers on various race tracks. The game uses two different modes: arcade and simulation.

Localization.Title: Gran Turismo 2 (Disc 2) (Gran Turismo)
Localization.Description: Le stade ultime de la simulation de course. 600 voitures conçues par 33 des plus grands constructeurs automobile au monde... Trouvez le réglage parfait de vos véhicules. 28 circuits dont le célèbre Laguna Seca.

Localization.Title: Gran Turismo 2 (Disc 2) (Gran Turismo)
Localization.Description: „Gran Turismo 2“ kehrt zurück mit über 500 Wagenmodellen und mehr als 20 Strecken. Das Spiel bringt realistische Fahrphysik, detaillierte Streckensimulationen und DUALSHOCK-Vibration für ein authentisches Rennerlebnis.

Localization.Title: Gran Turismo 2 (Disc 2) (Gran Turismo)
Localization.Description: Gran Turismo 2 tiene 22 circuitos, 6 licencias, 600 coches, 6 circuitos de rendimiento y eventos de rally.

Localization.Title: Gran Turismo 2 (Disc 2) (Gran Turismo)
Localization.Description: Gran Turismo 2 si basa fondamentalmente sul genere dei giochi di corse. Il giocatore deve manovrare un'automobile per competere contro piloti artificialmente intelligenti su vari circuiti. Il gioco utilizza due diverse modalità: arcade e simulazione.

Localization.Title: Gran Turismo 2 (Disc 2) (Gran Turismo)
Localization.Description: Gran Turismo 2 se baseia fundamentalmente no gênero de corrida de carros. O jogador deve dirigir um automóvel para competir contra pilotos artificialmente inteligentes em várias pistas. O jogo utiliza dois modos: Arcade e Simulação.

Localization.Title: The Legend of Dragoon (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Ten thousand years ago, the Divine Tree brought forth all living races. Among them were the powerful Dragons, the resilient humans, and the magical Winglies.

Localization.Title: The Legend of Dragoon (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: The Legend of Dragoon est un jeu de rôle sur Playstation. Incarnez Dart, un jeune héros valeureux.

Localization.Title: The Legend of Dragoon (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Vier Jahre sind vergangen seit Dart seine Heimat verließ und sich auf die Suche nach dem Schwarzen Monster machte, das seine Eltern und seinen Geburtsort Neet vernichtet hat.

Localization.Title: The Legend of Dragoon (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Dart, un guerrero valiente y leal, ha jurado vengar la muerte de sus padres a manos de un misterioso monstruo negro. Para motivos desconocidos, el Imperio de Sandora quema su pueblo y encarcela a su amiga de la infancia, Shana.

Localization.Title: The Legend of Dragoon (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Sono passati quattro anni da quando Dart ha lasciato la sua casa ed è andato alla ricerca del mostro nero che ha distrutto i suoi genitori e il suo luogo di nascita Neet.

Localization.Title: The Legend of Dragoon (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: O jogo conta a história de Dart, um jovem guerreiro que busca vingança contra o "Black Monster" que destruiu sua vila e matou seus pais.

Localization.Title: Kenkaku Ibunroku: Yomigaerishi Souku no Yaiba: Samurai Spirits Shinshou
Localization.Description: A story about legendary swords. "Riten-Kyo", located on a lone island near the coastline of Edo, is now a lawless zone where underground conspiracies are forming.

Localization.Title: Kenkaku Ibunroku : Yomigaerishi Souku no Yaiba : Samurai Spirits Shinshou
Localization.Description: Warriors Rage est le septième jeu de Samurai Shodown. Les événements du jeu ont lieu vingt ans après ceux décrits dans l'Hyper Neo Geo 64 Arcade précédents.

Localization.Title: Kenkaku Ibunroku: Yomigaerishi Souku no Yaiba: Samurai Spirits Shinshou
Localization.Description: Warriors Rage ist das siebte Spiel in Samurai Shodown. Die Ereignisse des Spiels finden zwanzig Jahre nach denen im vorherigen Hyper Neo Geo 64 Arcade statt.

Localization.Title: Kenkaku Ibunroku: Yomigaerishi Souku no Yaiba: Samurai Spirits Shinshou
Localization.Description: Una historia sobre espadas legendarias. «Riten-Kyo», situada en una isla solitaria cerca de la costa de Edo, es ahora una zona sin ley donde se están formando conspiraciones clandestinas.

Localization.Title: Kenkaku Ibunroku: Yomigaerishi Souku no Yaiba: Samurai Spirits Shinshou

Localization.Title: Parasite Eve II (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Aya Brea is back in a new game. This time there are fewer RPG elements than the first game, and the game plays more like Resident Evil. Battles are now in real-time, and a new range of weapons are available.

Localization.Title: Parasite Eve II (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Parasite Eve II est un jeu d'action sur Playstation. Dans la peau de la belle Aya, le soft ne vous invite pas à un cours de cytologie, mais vous jette sur les traces des affreuses créatures pour mettre à jour une terrible affaire.

Localization.Title: Parasite Eve II (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Eine böse Art von Neo-Mitochondrien-Kreaturen hat den Akropolis-Turm erobert und jeden eliminiert, der sich ihnen in den Weg stellte. Die Situation gerät außer Kontrolle.

Localization.Title: Parasite Eve II (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Una especie malévola de las Criaturas Neomitocondriales ha tomado la Torre Akropolis, eliminando a todos los que se interpongan en su camino. Esta situación amenazante y la Policía de Los Ángeles necesitan tu ayuda desesperadamente.

Localization.Title: Parasite Eve II (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Una specie malevola di Creature Neo mitocondriali ha preso il controllo della Torre di Akropolis, eliminando tutti coloro che si frappongono sulla loro strada.

Localization.Title: Parasite Eve II (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Aya Brea está de volta em um novo jogo. Desta vez, há menos elementos de RPG do que o primeiro jogo, e o jogo é mais parecido com Resident Evil. As batalhas estão agora em tempo real e uma nova gama de armas está disponível.

Localization.Title: Vib-Ribbon
Localization.Description: Your rabbity character, Vibri, is composed of some fairly basic geometric shapes. Vibri skips around along the eponymous vib ribbon and you have to control Vibri until the end, dodging obstacles to rack up as many points as you can.

Localization.Title: Vib-Ribbon
Localization.Description: Vib-Ribbon est un jeu d'action sur Playstation. On accompagne Vibri au travers de plusieurs stages pour les trois niveaux de difficulté.

Localization.Title: Vib-Ribbon
Localization.Description: Vib Ribbon ist ein wirklich einzigartiges Spielkonzept, bei dem Vibri, das tanzende Kaninchen, die Bühne betritt. Während Vibri auf einer unendlich langen Linie – dem „Vib Ribbon“ – hüpft und springt, hört er Musik, die ihm hilft, in Bewegung zu bleiben.

Localization.Title: Vib-Ribbon
Localization.Description: Vib-Ribbon es un juego musical. La banda japonesa Laugh and Peace ofrece este juego con parte de su banda sonora. La banda sonora se utiliza para generar los niveles de juego.

Localization.Title: Chase the Express (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: The French ambassador Pierre Simon and his family are travelling from Saint Petersburg to Paris aboard the Blue Harvest, a military NATO-developed train, when it is hijacked by terrorists known as the Knights of the Apocalypse.

Localization.Title: Chase the Express (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Chase the Express est un jeu d'action/infiltration à la troisième personne sur Playstation. L'histoire met en scène une organisation terroriste portant le doux nom de Chevaliers de l'Apocalypse.

Localization.Title: Chase the Express (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Nach einem Staatsbesuch in St. Petersburg befindet sich der französiche Botschafter samt Familie in einem Hochsicherheitszug auf dem Weg in die Heimat. Doch mitten im frostigen Russland wird der Express von eienr Terroristengruppe gestürmt.

Localization.Title: Chase the Express (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Chase The Express cuenta la historia de un soldado de las fuerzas de la OTAN, Jack Morton, cuya principal misión era proteger al embajador francés y su familia que viaja en un tren especial, llamado 'Blue Harvest', mientras durase este trayecto.

Localization.Title: Chase the Express (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: L'ambasciatore francese Pierre Simon e la sua famiglia stanno viaggiando da San Pietroburgo a Parigi a bordo del Blue Harvest, un treno militare sviluppato dalla NATO, quando viene dirottato da terroristi noti come i Cavalieri dell'Apocalisse.

Localization.Description: Valendra is a land that had undergone civil war. The end of which had birthed the parliament and several organizations to control the balance of power.

Localization.Title: Vagrant Story
Localization.Description: L'UNION SACRÉE... - Incarnez Ashley Riot, agent au service des forces royales et tentez de lever le voile sur les terribles secrets que recèlent la cité maudite de Léa Mundis.

Localization.Title: Vagrant Story
Localization.Description: Als Ashley Lionet, Agent der Spezialeinheit "Riskbreaker", ist es Ihre Aufgabe die Stadt der Schatten, Le Monde, zu infiltrieren.

Localization.Title: Vagrant Story
Localization.Description: Como el agente especial Ashley Riot, tu misión es infiltrartte en la ciudad de la maldad, Leá monde.

Localization.Title: Vagrant Story

Localization.Title: The King of Fighters '99
Localization.Description: The King of Fighters '99: Millennium Battle is a 1999 head-to-head fighting game by SNK released for the Neo Geo arcade and home platform. It is the sixth installment in the company's The King of Fighters series.

Localization.Title: The King of Fighters '99
Localization.Description: King of Fighters '99 est un jeu de combat sur Playstation. Incarnez l'un des 32 combattants au choix dans un tournoi sanglant. Cet opus permet d'intégrer dans son équipe un quatrième combattant qui prend le rôle de "Striker".

Localization.Title: The King of Fighters '99
Localization.Description: King of Fighters '99 ist ein Kampfspiel für Playstation. Spielen Sie als einer von 32 Kämpfern in einem blutigen Turnier. Dieses Werk ermöglicht die Integration eines vierten Kämpfers in sein Team, der die Rolle des „Stürmers“ übernimmt.

Localization.Title: The King of Fighters '99
Localization.Description: The King of Fighters '99: Millennium Battle es un juego de lucha cuerpo a cuerpo de 1999 de SNK lanzado para Neo Geo arcade y su plataforma de origen. Es la sexta entrega de la serie The King of Fighters de la compañía.

Localization.Title: The King of Fighters '99

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy IX (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Corruption -- the root of all evil. Alexandria's Queen Brahne was once presented as a noble and caring ruler, who would throw lavish festivals to show appreciation for her supporters.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy IX (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Grâce à sa main mise sur un armement magique extrêmement puissant, la reine Branet d'Alexandrie terrorise les royaumes voisins. Sa fille, la princesse Grenat, décide de s'enfuir du château et devient l'arme d'un groupe de bandits au grand cœur.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy IX (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Zidane, ein Mitglied einer Räuberbande, muss an einem schönen Abend die Prinzessin entführen. Dummerweise schnappt ihr euch auch noch ihren Bodyguard mit.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy IX (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: La reina Brahne de Alexandria ha empezado a utilizar armas mágicas muy avanzadas para aterrorizar los reinos vecinos.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy IX (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Corruzione: la radice di tutti i mali. La regina Brahne di Alessandria una volta fu presentata come una sovrana nobile e premurosa, che organizzava feste sontuose per mostrare apprezzamento per i suoi sostenitori.

Localization.Description: Klonoa Beach Volleyball is a volleyball game with a twist. Apart from being able to play on other numerous courts. The game is so addictive and theres so much things to unlock that you will keep on coming back for another game.

Localization.Title: Klonoa Beach Volley : Saikyou Team Ketteisen!
Localization.Description: Klonoa Beach Volleyball est, comme son nom pourrait le laisser deviner, un jeu de Volleyball. Sorti sur Playstation, ce titre a la particularité de prendre l'option de parties fun.

Localization.Title: Klonoa Beach Volley: Saikyou Team Ketteisen!
Localization.Description: Ein Arcade-Volleyballspiel, mit Charakteren des Klonoa-Franchise. Sie treten in 2-gegen-2-Matches an, in der Hoffnung, das 5-Match-Turnier zu gewinnen, das in jedem Spiel an mehreren Orten ausgetragen wird.

Localization.Title: Klonoa Beach Volley: Saikyou Team Ketteisen!
Localization.Description: ¡Invita a tus amigos a participar en la partida de volley playa más calurosa y divertida! Juega en el papel de Klonoa, Popka, Heart Mao, Lolo e incluso Jokai.

Localization.Title: Klonoa Beach Volley: Saikyou Team Ketteisen!
Localization.Description: Klonoa Beach Volleyball è un gioco di pallavolo con una svolta. Oltre a poter giocare su altri numerosi campi. Il gioco è così avvincente e ci sono così tante cose da sbloccare che continuerai a tornare per un altro gioco.

Localization.Title: Arc the Lad
Localization.Description: In a village where a sacred flame has long imprisoned a dangerous spirit, Kukuru agrees to extinguish it in order to escape an arranged marriage.

Localization.Title: Arc the Lad
Localization.Description: Dans un village où une flamme sacrée retient depuis des années un esprit dangereux, Kukuru accepte de l'éteindre afin d'échapper à un mariage imposé. L'esprit libéré menace alors le monde.

Localization.Title: Arc the Lad
Localization.Description: Ein Mädchen namens Kukuru lebt in einem Dorf, das vom Heiligen Stamm kontrolliert wird – Menschen, die eine uralte Flamme bewachen, die einen mächtigen Geist enthält, der vor vielen Jahren darin versiegelt wurde.

Localization.Title: Arc the Lad
Localization.Description: Arc the Lad comienza un viaje de tres partes a través de un mundo mágico al borde de la destrucción y poblado por un elenco único de personajes de rol, cada uno con armas, atributos y agendas específicas.

Localization.Title: Crash Bandicoot 2: Cortex no Gyakushuu!

Localization.Title: Crash Bandicoot 2: Cortex no Gyakushuu!
Localization.Description: Após sua derrota, Dr. Neo Cortex descobre os cristais que mandem o equilíbrio do mundo. Porém, algo está errado: Alguns dos cristais estão faltando. Quando os planetas se alinharem, o fluxo caótico criado pelo evento irá destruir o mundo.

Localization.Title: Gran Turismo

Localization.Title: Arc the Lad
Localization.Description: In a village where a sacred flame has long imprisoned a dangerous spirit, Kukuru agrees to extinguish it in order to escape an arranged marriage.

Localization.Title: Arc the Lad

Localization.Title: Arc the Lad
Localization.Description: Ein Mädchen namens Kukuru lebt in einem Dorf, das vom Heiligen Stamm kontrolliert wird – Menschen, die eine uralte Flamme bewachen, die einen mächtigen Geist enthält, der vor vielen Jahren darin versiegelt wurde.

Localization.Title: Arc the Lad
Localization.Description: Arc the Lad comienza un viaje de tres partes a través de un mundo mágico al borde de la destrucción y poblado por un elenco único de personajes de rol, cada uno con armas, atributos y agendas específicas.

Localization.Description: Dopo la sua sconfitta, il dottor Neo Cortex scopre i cristalli che mantengono il mondo in equilibrio. Tuttavia, qualcosa non va: mancano alcuni cristalli. Quando i pianeti si allineano, il flusso caotico creato dall'evento distruggerà il mondo.

Localization.Title: Crash Bandicoot 2: Cortex no Gyakushuu!
Localization.Description: Após sua derrota, Dr. Neo Cortex descobre os cristais que mandem o equilíbrio do mundo. Porém, algo está errado: Alguns dos cristais estão faltando. Quando os planetas se alinharem, o fluxo caótico criado pelo evento irá destruir o mundo.

Localization.Title: Arc the Lad II
Localization.Description: This direct sequel to "Arc the Lad" continues the unfinished story of the first game, but starts from a totally different perspective. You control a bounty-hunter named Elk, who suffers from amnesia.

Localization.Description: Arc the Lad II est un jeu de rôle sur Playstation. Le scénario reprend l'histoire incomplète du premier jeu mais en vous mettant dans la peau d'un autre personnage, Elk.

Localization.Description: Die Geschichte, die in Arc the Lad begann, wird in Arc the Lad II zur Legende. Erzählt werden die Abenteuer des Jägers Elc.

Localization.Title: I.Q Final
Localization.Description: Intelligent Qube is a classic puzzle game for the PlayStation. It is known as Kurushi in Europe and Australia. In the game, the player controls a character who must run around a platform made of cubes, capturing certain cubes as they approach.

Localization.Title: I.Q Final
Localization.Description: Kurushi sur Playstation est un puzzle-game. Réflexion est le mot d'ordre dans ce jeu où vous devez détruire des blocs pour survivre. Le but est d'arriver à agrandir votre plate-forme, si vous faites des erreurs celle-ci rétrécira.

Localization.Title: I.Q Final
Localization.Description: Das 3D-Puzzle Kurushi ist eine Prüfung, ein Intelligenztest, der von einer höheren Macht entwickelt wurde. Sie sehen sich gewaltigen Würfeln gegenüber, die erbarmungslos auf Sie zurollen.

Localization.Title: I.Q Final
Localization.Description: ¿Crees que eres inteligente? Este adictivo tornado cerebral 3D pone tus habilidades de pensamiento estratégico y reflejos al límite. Destruye los terrores geométricos que se aproximan antes de que te empujen sobre el borde o que te aplasten.

Localization.Title: I.Q Final
Localization.Description: Intelligent Qube è un classico gioco rompicapo per PlayStation. In Europa e Australia è conosciuto con il nome di Kurushi.

Localization.Title: Crash Bandicoot 3: Buttobi! Sekai Isshuu
Localization.Description: After defeating Dr. Neo Cortex, Crash and his sister, Coco, take a well-deserved vacation. However, their friend, Aku Aku, has a bad feeling, and as usual, he is right. Aku's evil twin, Uka Uka, was the person behind all of Dr. Cortex's schemes.

Localization.Title: Crash Bandicoot 3 : Buttobi! Sekai Isshuu
Localization.Description: Plongés dans des décors inédits et aux commandes de tout nouveaux véhicules, des personnages détraqués rejoignent Crash Bandicoot dans une course à travers le temps pour sauver le monde!

Localization.Title: Crash Bandicoot 3: Buttobi! Sekai Isshuu
Localization.Description: Crash Bandicot kehrt zurück... Er begibt sich diesmal auf eine Zeitreise, die ihn unter anderem in das Alte Ägypten, Rom und England führt. Sogar in die vorgeschichtliche Zeit reist Crash, dort reitet er auf einem Dinosaurier.

Localization.Title: Crash Bandicoot 3: Buttobi! Sekai Isshuu
Localization.Description: Tras el fracaso del plan del Dr. Neo Cortex y la caída de su base espacial sobre la jungla, la malvada máscara Uka Uka es finalmente liberada.

Localization.Title: Crash Bandicoot 3: Buttobi! Sekai Isshuu
Localization.Description: Con le animazioni tutte nuove e i tantissimi nuovi veicoli, un folle cast di personaggi si unisce a Crash Bandicoot in una gara nel tempo per salvare il destino dell'intero universo!

Localization.Title: Crash Bandicoot 3: Buttobi! Sekai Isshuu
Localization.Description: Após o Dr Nitrus Brio e Crash Bandicoot terem destruído a estação de Cortex, um dos pedaços foi parar na Terra.

Localization.Description: Tomarunner est un jeu de course à pied où vos adversaires sont un robot, un kappa, un ange, un patineur masqué et un garçon avec des cheveux Big Boy.

Localization.Description: ¡El sueño finalmente se ha hecho realidad con la ayuda de L'Arc en Ciel! ¡Cada fan debe tener esto! Y, por supuesto, hay diversión con este juego. Este verano, ¿por qué no pruebas la experiencia Tomarunner por ti mismo?

Localization.Title: Wild Arms: 2nd Ignition (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: "Wild Arms 2" isn't really a sequel to Sony's original title. Your hero, a young soldier Ashley, is transformed to a demon. Ashley is determined to purge the evil from his body. He meets Brad, a criminal and a war-hero, and Lilka, a female magician.

Localization.Title: Gran Turismo 2 (Disc 1) (Arcade)
Localization.Description: Gran Turismo 2 is fundamentally based on the racing game genre. The player must maneuver an automobile to compete against artificially intelligent drivers on various race tracks. The game uses two different modes: arcade and simulation.

Localization.Title: Gran Turismo 2 (Disc 1) (Arcade)
Localization.Description: Le stade ultime de la simulation de course. 600 voitures conçues par 33 des plus grands constructeurs automobile au monde... Trouvez le réglage parfait de vos véhicules. 28 circuits dont le célèbre Laguna Seca.

Localization.Title: Gran Turismo 2 (Disc 1) (Arcade)
Localization.Description: „Gran Turismo 2“ kehrt zurück mit über 500 Wagenmodellen und mehr als 20 Strecken. Das Spiel bringt realistische Fahrphysik, detaillierte Streckensimulationen und DUALSHOCK-Vibration für ein authentisches Rennerlebnis.

Localization.Title: Gran Turismo 2 (Disc 1) (Arcade)
Localization.Description: Gran Turismo 2 tiene 22 circuitos, 6 licencias, 600 coches, 6 circuitos de rendimiento y eventos de rally.

Localization.Description: Gran Turismo 2 ha 22 piste, 6 licenze, 600 auto, 6 piste di performance ed eventi di rally.

Localization.Description: Gran Turismo 2 é essencialmente um jogo de corrida no qual o jogador deve conduzir um automóvel e competir contra adversários controlados pela inteligência artificial em diferentes pistas. O jogo oferece dois modos distintos: Arcade e Simulação.

Localization.Title: Battle Arena Toshinden
Localization.Description: Battle Arena Toshinden is a fighting game for the PlayStation.

Localization.Title: Battle Arena Toshinden
Localization.Description: Battle Arena Toshinden est un jeu de combat 3D sur Playstation. Les 8 karatékas disponibles ont tous des armes et des techniques qui leur sont propres. Un mode Tournoi est présent qui vous permet d'affronter chaque adversaire.

Localization.Title: Battle Arena Toshinden
Localization.Description: DIES IST IHRE EINLADUNG...zum Kampf des Jahrhunderts! Die größten Martial-Arts-Experten haben sich versammelt, um einen Wettkampf auf Leben und Tod auszutragen.

Localization.Title: Battle Arena Toshinden
Localization.Description: Ocho guerreros errantes, provenientes de distintos rincones del mundo, se dan cita en un misterioso torneo de lucha llamado Battle Arena Toshinden, organizado por una oscura organización llamada Secret Society.

Localization.Title: Battle Arena Toshinden
Localization.Description: QUESTO È IL TUO INVITO ... alla lotta del secolo! I più grandi esperti di arti marziali si sono riuniti per combattere un incontro tra la vita e la morte.

Localization.Title: Battle Arena Toshinden
Localization.Description: Battle Arena Toshinden foi um dos primeiros jogos da Playstation a apresentar personagens poligonais numa arena de batalha em 3D, em vez do tradicional espaço de luta lado a lado que tinha sido popular desde o Street Fighter II.

Localization.Title: Kileak: The DNA Imperative
Localization.Description: Scientist Dr. Kim has taken his experiments in genetic engineering one step too far. A strike team of the International Peace Keeping Forces is dispatched to his south pole base but is shot down before landing.

Localization.Title: Kileak : The DNA Imperative
Localization.Description: Kileak The Blood sur Playstation est un jeu de tir en vue à la première personne futuriste. Vous incarnez un membre de l'équipe internationale de la Peace Keeping Forces.

Localization.Title: Kileak: The DNA Imperative

Localization.Description: Sie werden geschickt, um einen strahlenbedingten Ausbruch an Bord der Raumstation Icarus zu untersuchen, aber sobald Sie an Bord sind, wird Ihnen klar, dass Ihr Hauptziel Ihre geringste Sorge ist.

Localization.Title: The City of Lost Children

Localization.Title: Epidemic
Localization.Description: The sequel to Kileak: The DNA Imperative, Epidemic drops players into a world plagued by a deadly disease: The Gigari virus. Having spread across the globe, it has forced the remnants of human civilization into hiding underground.

Localization.Title: Epidemic
Localization.Description: Epidemic est un jeu d'action sur Playstation. En l'an 2065 l'humanité a été exterminée par un virus. Les survivants ont trouvé refuge dans une ville souterraine grâce à un homme nommé Byflos.

Localization.Title: Epidemic
Localization.Description: Epidemic, die Fortsetzung von Kileak: The DNA Imperative, entführt Spieler in eine Welt, die von einer tödlichen Krankheit heimgesucht wird: dem Gigari-Virus.

Localization.Title: Crash Bandicoot 2: Cortex Strikes Back
Localization.Description: After his defeat, Dr. Neo Cortex discovers the crystals that keep the world in balance. However, something is wrong: some of the crystals are missing. When the planets align, the chaotic flux created by the event will destroy the world.

Localization.Title: Crash Bandicoot 2 : Cortex Strikes Back
Localization.Description: Le terrible Dr. Neo Cortex est de retour...

Localization.Title: Crash Bandicoot 2: Cortex Strikes Back
Localization.Description: Die neuen Abenteuer von Crash Bandicoot, der die Welt wieder vor den mutierten Kreaturen des irren Wissenschaftlers retten muß.

Localization.Title: Crash Bandicoot 2: Cortex Strikes Back
Localization.Description: Después de haber sido derrotado por Crash Bandicoot en el juego anterior, el Dr. Neo Cortex encuentra por accidente un extraño cristal que parece albergar un gran poder.

Localization.Title: Crash Bandicoot 2: Cortex Strikes Back
Localization.Description: Dopo la sua sconfitta, il dottor Neo Cortex scopre i cristalli che mantengono il mondo in equilibrio. Tuttavia, qualcosa non va: mancano alcuni cristalli. Quando i pianeti si allineano, il flusso caotico creato dall'evento distruggerà il mondo.

Localization.Title: Crash Bandicoot 2: Cortex Strikes Back
Localization.Description: Após sua derrota, Dr. Neo Cortex descobre os cristais que mandem o equilíbrio do mundo. Porém, algo está errado: Alguns dos cristais estão faltando. Quando os planetas se alinharem, o fluxo caótico criado pelo evento irá destruir o mundo.

Localization.Title: Cardinal Syn
Localization.Description: For decades, the clans of Bloodland were locked in a never-ending war; then the Wanderer arrived with the Book of Knowledge. He divided the book and gave each clan a piece, hoping the clans would come to rely on each other's newly acquired knowledge.

Localization.Title: Cardinal Syn
Localization.Description: Cardinal Syn est un jeu de combat sur Playstation. Au menu : 8 personnages disponibles dès le début du jeu ainsi que 5 modes de jeu, à savoir Tournoi, Versus, Team battle, Survival et un mode Entraînement.

Localization.Title: Cardinal Syn
Localization.Description: Jahrzehntelang waren die Clans von Bloodland in einen nie endenden Krieg verwickelt; dann kam der Wanderer mit dem Buch des Wissens.

Localization.Title: Cardinal Syn
Localization.Description: Durante décadas, los clanes de Bloodland se vieron envueltos en una guerra sin fin; luego llegó el Errante con el Libro del Conocimiento.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy VII (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Set in a dystopian world, Final Fantasy VII's story centers on mercenary Cloud Strife who joins with several others to stop the megacorporation Shinra, which is draining the life of the planet to use as an energy source.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy VII (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: La Corporation Shinra pompe toute l'énergie de notre planète.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy VII (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Die Shinra Corporation entzieht unserem Planeten alle Lebensenergie. Cloud ein eiskalter Söldner, übernimmt einen Auftrag von einer Gruppe von Öko-Kriegern.

Localization.Description: La corporación Shinra está agotando los recursos vitales de nuestro planeta.

Localization.Description: Ambientato in un mondo distopico, la storia di Final Fantasy VII è incentrata sul mercenario Cloud Strife che si unisce ad altri compagni per fermare la Shinra Corporation, che sta prosciugando la vita del pianeta, utilizzato come fonte di energia.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy VII (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: A história segue Cloud Strife, um mercenário que junta-se a uma organização ecoterrorista a fim de impedir que megacorporação Shinra use a essência vital do planeta como uma fonte de energia.

Localization.Description: Die Shinra Corporation entzieht unserem Planeten alle Lebensenergie. Cloud ein eiskalter Söldner, übernimmt einen Auftrag von einer Gruppe von Öko-Kriegern.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy VII (Square Soft on PlayStation Previews)
Localization.Description: La corporación Shinra está agotando los recursos vitales de nuestro planeta.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy VII (Square Soft on PlayStation Previews)
Localization.Description: Ambientato in un mondo distopico, la storia di Final Fantasy VII è incentrata sul mercenario Cloud Strife che si unisce ad altri compagni per fermare la Shinra Corporation, che sta prosciugando la vita del pianeta, utilizzato come fonte di energia.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy VII (Square Soft on PlayStation Previews)
Localization.Description: A história segue Cloud Strife, um mercenário que junta-se a uma organização ecoterrorista a fim de impedir que megacorporação Shinra use a essência vital do planeta como uma fonte de energia.

rom.name: Final Fantasy VII (USA) (Square Soft on PlayStation Previews).cue

Localization.Title: Bushido Blade
Localization.Description: The Bushido code of honor governs the actions of the Samurai and sets a code of ethics for use in fighting.

Localization.Title: Bushido Blade
Localization.Description: Bushido Blade est un jeu de combat réalisé entièrement en 3D sur Playstation. Le soft propose un combat en un contre un armé. Chaque joueur a des caractéristiques de combat différentes et nécessite une parfaite maîtrise.

Localization.Title: Bushido Blade
Localization.Description: "Bushido" ist die Seele Japans - ein uralter Ehrenkodex, dem Samurai-Krieger seit Jahrhunderten folgen. Tauche in reale Kämpfe in riesigen 3D-Umgebungen ein, die du ausführen, in Scheiben schneiden und durchbrechen kannst.

Localization.Title: Bushido Blade
Localization.Description: El código de honor del Bushido rige las acciones de los samuráis y establece un código de ética para su uso en la lucha.

Localization.Title: Bushido Blade
Localization.Description: Il codice d'onore Bushido regola le azioni dei Samurai e stabilisce un codice etico da usare nei combattimenti.

Localization.Title: Bushido Blade
Localization.Description: Bushido Blade é um jogo desenvolvido pela Light Weight e publicado pela Square e pela Sony Computer Entertainment para a PlayStation. O jogo apresenta combate armado de um contra um. Seu nome refere-se ao código de honra do guerreiro japonês Bushid?.

Localization.Title: I.Q: Intelligent Qube
Localization.Description: Intelligent Qube is a classic puzzle game for the PlayStation. It is known as Kurushi in Europe and Australia. In the game, the player controls a character who must run around a platform made of cubes, capturing certain cubes as they approach.

Localization.Title: I.Q : Intelligent Qube
Localization.Description: Kurushi sur Playstation est un puzzle-game. Réflexion est le mot d'ordre dans ce jeu où vous devez détruire des blocs pour survivre. Le but est d'arriver à agrandir votre plate-forme, si vous faites des erreurs celle-ci rétrécira.

Localization.Title: I.Q: Intelligent Qube
Localization.Description: Das 3D-Puzzle Kurushi ist eine Prüfung, ein Intelligenztest, der von einer höheren Macht entwickelt wurde. Sie sehen sich gewaltigen Würfeln gegenüber, die erbarmungslos auf Sie zurollen.

Localization.Title: I.Q: Intelligent Qube
Localization.Description: ¿Crees que eres inteligente? Este adictivo tornado cerebral 3D pone tus habilidades de pensamiento estratégico y reflejos al límite. Destruye los terrores geométricos que se aproximan antes de que te empujen sobre el borde o que te aplasten.

Localization.Title: I.Q: Intelligent Qube
Localization.Description: Intelligent Qube è un classico gioco rompicapo per PlayStation. In Europa e Australia è conosciuto con il nome di Kurushi.

Localization.Title: Armored Core
Localization.Description: You play the role of a Raven mercenary, piloting a powerful Mech called "Armored Core". You only work for profit, as the money you make goes towards upgrades and repaires to your mech.

Localization.Title: Armored Core
Localization.Description: Armored Core sur Playstation est un jeu d'action vous mettant aux commandes d'un robot géant qui participe à une guerre entre les deux plus grandes cités restantes sur Terre : Chrome et Murakumo Millenium.

Localization.Title: Armored Core
Localization.Description: Armored Core ist ein Third-Person-Shooter-Mecha-Videospiel, das von FromSoftware entwickelt und 1997 veröffentlicht wurde. Das Spiel ist das erste in der Armored Core-Serie.

Localization.Title: Armored Core
Localization.Description: Tomas el papel de un mercenario Raven, pilotando un poderoso Mecha llamado "Armored Core". Sólo trabajas para obtener beneficios, invirtiendo el dinero en mejoras y reparaciones del Mecha.

Localization.Title: Armored Core
Localization.Description: You play the role of a Raven mercenary, piloting a powerful Mech called "Armored Core". You only work for profit, as the money you make goes towards upgrades and repaires to your mech.

Localization.Title: Armored Core
Localization.Description: Armored Core é um jogo de ação e tiro em terceira pessoa com temática mecha, lançado para PlayStation em 1997 e primeiro título da série criada pela FromSoftware.

Localization.Title: PaRappa the Rapper
Localization.Description: The rapping pup, PaRappa, dreams of impressing his friend, the beautiful Sunny Funny, and going out on a date with her.

Localization.Title: PaRappa the Rapper
Localization.Description: Parappa the Rapper est un jeu de rythme sur Playstation dans lequel vous incarnez un jeune chien qui trouvera confiance en lui grâce au hip-hop.

Localization.Title: PaRappa the Rapper
Localization.Description: In der Rolle des Comic-Charakters Parappa muß der Spieler in verschiedenen Situationen seine Rap-Skills unter Beweis stellen.

Localization.Description: El cachorro de rap, PaRappa, sueña con impresionar a su amiga, la hermosa Sunny Funny, y salir en una cita con ella.

Localization.Description: Porsche Challenge is the first release from the European division at Sony Computer Entertainment. Based on the Porsche Boxster, fans can test drive as well as race one of Porsche's most spectacular looking vehicles to date.

Localization.Title: Porsche Challenge
Localization.Description: Disponible sur Playstation, Porsche Challenge est un jeu de courses automobiles exclusivement tourné vers le cabriolet Porsche Boxster.

Localization.Title: Porsche Challenge
Localization.Description: Mit Porsches neuestem Rennsporttriumph, dem Boxster, über anspruchsvolle Rennstrecken rasen. Mit diesem Game wirst Du direkt an das Steuer eines Wahnsinnswagens gesetzt. Es erwartet Dich ein einzigartiges Fahrerlebnis. Gib Gas!

Localization.Title: Porsche Challenge
Localization.Description: Porsche Challenge es el primer lanzamiento de la división europea de Sony Computer Entertainment. Basado en el Porsche Boxster, los jugadores pueden probar y competir con uno de los vehículos de aspecto más espectacular de Porsche hasta la fecha.

Localization.Description: Hai mai desiderato giocare a golf senza essere infastidito da aspetti di simulazione come vento e traiettorie? Se hai risposto sì alla domanda precedente, allora abbiamo un gioco per te! Piuttosto che concentrarsi su una curva di apprendimento, Everybody

Localization.Title: Gran Turismo
Localization.Description: Gran Turismo puts you behind the wheel in realistic races against AI opponents, collecting cars, credits, and trophies.

Localization.Title: Gran Turismo
Localization.Description: Gran Turismo sur Playstation fait figure de référence en matière de simulation automobile. Passez vos licences vous ouvrant l'accès aux compétitions, trouvez-vous une bonne occase, et c'est parti pour la gloire.

Localization.Title: Gran Turismo
Localization.Description: In Gran Turismo trittst du in realistisch simulierten Rennen gegen KI-Gegner an und sammelst Fahrzeuge, Geld und Trophäen.

Localization.Title: Gran Turismo
Localization.Description: El primer juego de la serie Gran Turismo de simulación de carreras. Se puede elegir entre la versión arcade (con vehículos clásicos como el Aston Martin) o la simulación, siendo este el verdadero corazón del juego.

Localization.Title: Gran Turismo
Localization.Description: Gran Turismo si basa fondamentalmente sul genere del simulatore di corse. Il giocatore deve manovrare un'automobile per competere contro piloti artificialmente intelligenti su vari circuiti.

Localization.Title: Gran Turismo
Localization.Description: Gran Turismo é uma popular e aclamada série de videojogos de corrida automóvel produzida pela Polyphony Digital, um estúdio que com o passar do tempo se dedicou a desenvolver basicamente somente este titulo.

Localization.Title: Bloody Roar
Localization.Description: BLOODY ROAR pits eight fighters with unique "Spirit Animals" against each other.

Localization.Title: Bloody Roar
Localization.Description: Bloody Roar est un jeu de combat sur Playstation qui vous met dans la peau de personnages qui ont la faculté de se transformer en animal comme par exemple : Bakuryu en taupe, Alice en lapin, Long en tigre ou Gado en lion pour ne citer qu'eux.

Localization.Title: Bloody Roar
Localization.Description: Am Ende des 20. Jahrhunderts wird die Welt von einer nahen Katastrophe bedroht, die die gesamte Menschheit mit Angst erfüllt. Inmitten dieser Krise tauchen plötzlich Personen mit außergewöhnlichen Fähigkeiten auf.

Localization.Title: Bloody Roar
Localization.Description: A diferencia de otros juegos de pelea, Bloddy Roar tiene un toque único. Al presionar un botón tu personaje se transforma en una bestia de habilidades y fuerza únicas respecto a los ataques normales del personaje.

Localization.Title: Bloody Roar
Localization.Description: Alla fine del 20° secolo, il mondo è pervaso da un crescente senso di crisi: l'ansia che si respira si fa ogni giorno maggiore.

Localization.Title: Bloody Roar
Localization.Description: Bloody Roar coloca oito lutadores com "Espíritos Animais" para lutar entre si.

Localization.Title: Battle Arena Toshinden
Localization.Description: Battle Arena Toshinden is a fighting game for the PlayStation.

Localization.Title: Battle Arena Toshinden
Localization.Description: Battle Arena Toshinden est un jeu de combat 3D sur Playstation. Les 8 karatékas disponibles ont tous des armes et des techniques qui leur sont propres. Un mode Tournoi est présent qui vous permet d'affronter chaque adversaire.

Localization.Title: Battle Arena Toshinden
Localization.Description: DIES IST IHRE EINLADUNG...zum Kampf des Jahrhunderts! Die größten Martial-Arts-Experten haben sich versammelt, um einen Wettkampf auf Leben und Tod auszutragen.

Localization.Title: Battle Arena Toshinden
Localization.Description: Ocho guerreros errantes, provenientes de distintos rincones del mundo, se dan cita en un misterioso torneo de lucha llamado Battle Arena Toshinden, organizado por una oscura organización llamada Secret Society.

Localization.Title: Battle Arena Toshinden
Localization.Description: QUESTO È IL TUO INVITO ... alla lotta del secolo! I più grandi esperti di arti marziali si sono riuniti per combattere un incontro tra la vita e la morte.

Localization.Title: Battle Arena Toshinden
Localization.Description: Battle Arena Toshinden foi um dos primeiros jogos da Playstation a apresentar personagens poligonais numa arena de batalha em 3D, em vez do tradicional espaço de luta lado a lado que tinha sido popular desde o Street Fighter II.

Localization.Title: Mortal Kombat 3
Localization.Description: Unclear as to what happened at the end of Mortal Kombat II? The answer is: more Komabt! Mortal Kombat 3 is the third gruesome installment of the game infuriating congressmen everywhere.

Localization.Title: Mortal Kombat 3
Localization.Description: Shao Kahn est sorti vainqueur du précédent Mortal Kombat. Le Royaume de la Terre n'est plus. Vous devrez dans Mortal Kombat 3, affronter à nouveau les poulains de Shang Tsung, ainsi qu'une redoutable adversaire, la Reine Sindel.

Localization.Title: Mortal Kombat 3
Localization.Description: Mortal Kombat 3 (MK3) ist ein Kampfvideospiel, das von Midway / Atari Games entwickelt und 1995 als drittes Spiel in der Mortal Kombat-Reihe erstmals in den Arcades veröffentlicht wurde.

Localization.Title: Mortal Kombat 3
Localization.Description: ¿No está claro qué sucedió al final de Mortal Kombat II? La respuesta es: más Kombat! Mortal Kombat 3 es la tercera entrega del juego que enfurece a los congresistas de todas partes.

Localization.Title: Mortal Kombat 3
Localization.Description: Non è chiaro cosa sia successo alla fine di Mortal Kombat II? La risposta è: più Komabt! Mortal Kombat 3 è il terzo raccapricciante capitolo del gioco che fa infuriare i membri del Congresso di tutto il mondo.

Localization.Title: Mortal Kombat 3
Localization.Description: Não está claro sobre o que aconteceu no final de Mortal Kombat II? A resposta é: mais Komabt! Mortal Kombat 3 é a terceira parte horrível do jogo que enfurece os congressistas em todos os lugares.

Localization.Title: Spawn: The Eternal
Localization.Description: After a horrible death by burning, Al Simmons finds himself in the eighth sphere of Hell; making deals with a head honcho named Malebolgia.

Localization.Title: Spawn : The Eternal
Localization.Description: Al Simmons est mort...

Localization.Title: Spawn: The Eternal
Localization.Description: Al Simmons ist tot...

Localization.Title: Spawn: The Eternal
Localization.Description: Al Simmons está muerto... Aparece el héroe de la venganza desde las tinieblas. Obligado a trabajar para el ejército del diablo, Al Simmons se convierte en Spawn, un ser que debe luchar con todas sus fuerzas para cumplir con su venganza.

Localization.Title: Spawn: The Eternal
Localization.Description: Dopo un'orribile morte per rogo, Al Simmons si ritrova nell'ottava sfera dell'Inferno; fare affari con un capo di nome Malebolgia.

Localization.Title: Spawn: The Eternal
Localization.Description: After a horrible death by burning, Al Simmons finds himself in the eighth sphere of Hell; making deals with a head honcho named Malebolgia.

Localization.Title: The King of Fighters '95
Localization.Description: The King of Fighters, officially abbreviated KOF, is a series of fighting games by SNK Playmore, formerly SNK.

Localization.Title: The King of Fighters '95
Localization.Description: The King of Fighters '95 est un jeu de combat 2D tournant sur Playstation. Ici 26 personnages aux styles différents s'affrontent pour obtenir le titre de "King of Fighters".

Localization.Title: The King of Fighters '95
Localization.Description: The King of Fighters, offiziell abgekürzt KOF, ist eine Reihe von Kampfspielen von SNK Playmore, ehemals SNK.

Localization.Title: The King of Fighters '95
Localization.Description: The King of Fighters, abreviado oficialmente KOF, es una serie de juegos de lucha de SNK Playmore, anteriormente SNK.

Localization.Title: The King of Fighters '95
Localization.Description: The King of Fighters, officially abbreviated KOF, is a series of fighting games by SNK Playmore, formerly SNK.

Localization.Title: The King of Fighters '95
Localization.Description: A primeira sequência da série King of Fighters chega um ano após o final do primeiro torneio. Mais uma vez, lutadores de todo o mundo recebem um misterioso convite para um torneio de luta baseado em equipe.

Localization.Title: Samurai Shodown III: Blades of Blood
Localization.Description: The third incarnation of the 2D fighting game Samurai Shodown is now available on the PlayStation with the release of Samurai Shodown III: Blades of Blood. The game revolves around the evil Zankuro Minazuki.

Localization.Title: Samurai Shodown III : Blades of Blood
Localization.Description: Samurai Shodown III sur Playstation est le troisième opus de la série produite par SNK. Ce jeu de combat se déroule au Japon, lors du moyen-Age.

Localization.Title: Samurai Shodown III: Blades of Blood
Localization.Description: Samurai Shodown III für Playstation ist der dritte Teil der von SNK produzierten Serie. Dieses Kampfspiel spielt im Japan des Mittelalters.

Localization.Title: Samurai Shodown III: Blades of Blood
Localization.Description: Samurai Shodown III: Blades of Blood es un videojuego de lucha desarrollado por SNK como parte de la popular serie Samurai Shodown.

Localization.Title: Samurai Shodown III: Blades of Blood
Localization.Description: The third incarnation of the 2D fighting game Samurai Shodown is now available on the PlayStation with the release of Samurai Shodown III: Blades of Blood. The game revolves around the evil Zankuro Minazuki.

Localization.Title: Tobal No. 1
Localization.Description: Tobal No. 1 is a fighting game for the PlayStation developed by DreamFactory and published by Square in 1996. The game was DreamFactory's first release, as well as Square's first release on the CD-based console. Tobal No.

Localization.Title: Tobal No. 1
Localization.Description: Disponible sur Playstation, Tobal No 1 est un jeu de combat se déroulant dans un futur proche dans lequel un tournoi est mis en place pour décider du contrôle d'une énergie puissante et rare appelée Molmoran.

Localization.Title: Tobal No. 1
Localization.Description: Tobal No 1 auf der Playstation ist ein Kampfspiel, das in der nahen Zukunft spielt und in dem es um die Kontrolle über eine mächtige und seltene Energie namens Molmoran geht.

Localization.Title: Tobal No. 1
Localization.Description: Lucha hasta el final en una arena donde la fuerza bruta se mide contra habilidades salvajes. Ágiles humanos contra formas de vida alienígenas, todos listos para convertirse en el mejor luchador del universo.

Localization.Title: Tobal No. 1
Localization.Description: Tobal No. 1 is a fighting game for the PlayStation developed by DreamFactory and published by Square in 1996. The game was DreamFactory's first release, as well as Square's first release on the CD-based console. Tobal No.

Localization.Title: Tobal No. 1
Localization.Description: Oito guerreiros de diferentes origens, motivados por razões pessoais e sonhos de glória, viajam de várias partes da galáxia para competir no torneio. Entre eles está Chuji Wu, um jovem e talentoso lutador de uma família de praticantes de artes marciais.
