Localization.Title: Final Fantasy Tactics
Localization.Description: Final Fantasy Tactics is a tactical role-playing game developed and published by Square (now Square Enix) for the Sony PlayStation video game console.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy Tactics
Localization.Description: Final Fantasy Tactics est un jeu de rôle tactique sur Playstation.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy Tactics
Localization.Description: Führe epische Schlachten in einer neuen Final Fantasy Welt. Verrat und dunkle Intrigen erwarten dich in Square Softs Kriegsspiel.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy Tactics
Localization.Description: La historia se desarrolla en el ficticio reino de Ivalice, un lugar donde los castillos y fuertes son el hogar de los nobles, la iglesia es un importante factor político social, y diversas facciones se disputan el dominio sobre el reino.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy Tactics
Localization.Description: Final Fantasy Tactics è un gioco di ruolo tattico sviluppato e pubblicato da Square (ora Square Enix) per la console per videogiochi Sony PlayStation.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy Tactics
Localization.Description: O primeiro jogo da subsérie Final Fantasy Tactics, combina elementos temáticos da série Final Fantasy com um motor de jogo e sistema de batalha diferente do que havia sido feito anteriormente na franquia.

Localization.Title: MediEvil
Localization.Description: The Evil Wizard Zarok has returned from the dead to wreak havoc on a peaceful land, and it is up to the centuries-dead hero, Sir Daniel Fortesque, to rise from his grave and defeat the very nemesis that put him in that grave.

Localization.Title: MediEvil
Localization.Description: Perdue dans les limbes temporelles, l'histoire de Gallowmere est celle du pays où la magie a pris le pas sur la science et où Zarok, le sorcier à l'âme torturée, exploite ses pouvoirs les plus sombres.

Localization.Title: MediEvil
Localization.Description: Vom Winde der Zeit verweht, ist die Geschichte von Gallowmere, einem Land in dem Magie mehr gilt als Wissenschaft und in dem ein Hexer - der finstere Zarok - ihre dunkelsten Mächte an sich gerissen hat.

Localization.Title: MediEvil
Localization.Description: En el reino de Gallowmere, año 1286, el poderoso mago Zarok, desterrado por nigromancia, reunió a un numeroso ejército de zombis, demonios y otros monstruos con la intención de conquistar el reino al que pertenecía y vengarse de la familia real.

Localization.Title: MediEvil
Localization.Description: Il malvagio mago Zarok è tornato dalla morte per devastare una terra pacifica, e spetta all'eroe morto da secoli, Sir Daniel Fortesque, risorgere dalla sua tomba e sconfiggere la stessa nemesi che lo ha messo in quella tomba.

Localization.Title: MediEvil
Localization.Description: Medievil é um jogo de ação / aventura no Playstation. Um mago chamado Zarok quer fazer tudo para dominar o mundo.

Localization.Title: Spyro the Dragon
Localization.Description: Spyro the Dragon is a platform game developed by Insomniac Games for the PlayStation. It stars the title character, a young purple dragon named Spyro and his dragonfly friend, Sparx, and is the first game in the Spyro the Dragon series.

Localization.Title: Spyro the Dragon
Localization.Description: La terre des Dragons a été envahie par Gnasty Gnorc et son armée de Gnorcs. Tous les dragons ont été transformés en statues de cristal, seul Spyro a été épargné.

Localization.Title: Spyro the Dragon
Localization.Description: Spyro ist ein süßer, lila Drache, der in der Klemme steckt. Alle Drachenfreunde von Spyro sind dem bösen Gnasty Gnorc zum Opfer gefallen, der sie in Kristalle verwandelt hat.

Localization.Title: Spyro the Dragon
Localization.Description: Gnasty Gnorc y su ejército Gnorc han conquistado los mundos de los dragones, y los han convertido a todos en estatuas de cristal... excepto a Spyro.

Localization.Title: Spyro the Dragon
Localization.Description: Spyro the Dragon è un gioco platform sviluppato da Insomniac Games per PlayStation. Ha come protagonisti il ​​personaggio del titolo, un giovane drago viola di nome Spyro e il suo amico libellula, Sparx, ed è il primo gioco della serie Spyro the Dragon.

Localization.Title: Spyro the Dragon
Localization.Description: Spyro The Dragon é um jogo de plataforma no Playstation. O mago maligno Gnasty Gnorc quer conquistar o mundo. Para isso, ele colocou fora de perigo todos os dragões por statufiant em cristal.

Localization.Title: Turbo Prop Racing
Localization.Description: From the same team that developed Porsche Challenge for the PlayStation, this is a high-speed racer where the user controls a number of adrenaline-pumping speedboats.

Localization.Title: Turbo Prop Racing
Localization.Description: Rapid Racer sur Playstation est un jeu de courses de bateaux très rapide. Choisissez votre équipe et votre véhicule avant de vous lancer à fond sur les pistes aquatiques, mais attention, un bateau n'est pas aussi facile à conduire qu'une voiture.

Localization.Title: Turbo Prop Racing
Localization.Description: Rapid Racer, in Nordamerika unter dem Namen Turbo Prop Racing bekannt, ist ein Rennvideospiel, das von Sony Computer Entertainment Europe entwickelt und 1997 für PlayStation veröffentlicht wurde.

Localization.Title: Turbo Prop Racing
Localization.Description: Del mismo equipo que desarrolló Porsche Challenge para PlayStation, este es un juego de carreras de alta velocidad en el que controla una serie de lanchas rápidas que bombean adrenalina.

Localization.Title: Turbo Prop Racing
Localization.Description: Rapid Racer, noto come Turbo Prop Racing in Nord America, è un videogioco di corse sviluppato da Sony Computer Entertainment Europe e pubblicato per PlayStation nel 1997.

Localization.Title: Turbo Prop Racing
Localization.Description: From the same team that developed Porsche Challenge for the PlayStation, this is a high-speed racer where the user controls a number of adrenaline-pumping speedboats.

Localization.Title: SaGa Frontier
Localization.Description: Saga Frontier is a fantasy / sci-fi anime style RPG. It's set in a huge world (30 zones).

Localization.Title: SaGa Frontier
Localization.Description: SaGa Frontier est un jeu de rôle sur Playstation qui adopte un système novateur : vous avez le choix entre sept personnages différents au début du jeu, chacun avec leurs propres aptitudes et scénario respectif à suivre.

Localization.Title: SaGa Frontier
Localization.Description: Saga Frontier ist ein Fantasy-/Science-Fiction-Rollenspiel im Anime-Stil. Es spielt in einer riesigen Welt (30 Zonen).

Localization.Title: SaGa Frontier
Localization.Description: Saga Frontier es un RPG de fantasía / ciencia ficción estilo anime. Está ambientado en un mundo enorme (30 zonas).

Localization.Title: SaGa Frontier
Localization.Description: Saga Frontier is a fantasy / sci-fi anime style RPG. It's set in a huge world (30 zones).

Localization.Title: 3Xtreme
Localization.Description: In the game, the player can choose some characters that are divided into modalities such as Skates, Bicycle and Skateboarding.

Localization.Title: 3Xtreme
Localization.Description: 3xtreme sur Playstation est un nouvel opus du jeu de courses vous laissant la possibilité d'utiliser plusieurs véhicules de glisse (skateboard, roller, snowboard, BMX) avec un seul but : arriver premier dans une compétition où tout est permis.

Localization.Title: 3Xtreme
Localization.Description: Im Spiel kann der Spieler einige Charaktere auswählen, die in Modalitäten wie Skaten, Fahrradfahren und Skateboarden unterteilt sind.

Localization.Title: 3Xtreme
Localization.Description: Este juego de carreras extremo viene con cuatro modos de juego diferentes. El modo principal es el modo Temporada, que permite al jugador correr a través de tres circuitos de varias carreras cada uno.

Localization.Title: 3Xtreme
Localization.Description: Nel gioco, il giocatore può scegliere alcuni personaggi divisi in modalità come Pattini, Bicicletta e Skateboard.

Localization.Title: 3Xtreme
Localization.Description: No jogo, o jogador pode escolher alguns personagens que estão divididos em modalidades como à de Patins, Bicicleta e Skate.

Localization.Title: MLB 99
Localization.Description: Sony's MLB 99 offers a number of options to set it apart from most games based on the national pastime. The first advancement is a Spring Training mode.

Localization.Title: MLB 99
Localization.Description: MLB 99 sur Playstation est un jeu de base-ball qui reprend la saison de 1999. Les équipes et les stades propres à la Major Ligue Baseball répondent présents pour refaire les matches mémorables.

Localization.Title: MLB 99
Localization.Description: Sonys MLB 99 bietet eine Reihe von Optionen, die es von den meisten Spielen, die auf dem nationalen Zeitvertreib basieren, abheben. Die erste Weiterentwicklung ist ein Frühlingstrainingsmodus.

Localization.Title: MLB 99
Localization.Description: Un simulador de béisbol actualizado para la temporada de 1999 con el Salón de la Fama de la emisora Vin Scully comentando cada juego. El juego ofrece varias modalidades incluyendo exhibición, temporada, los play-offs, y el derby del home-run.

Localization.Title: MLB 99
Localization.Description: Sony's MLB 99 offers a number of options to set it apart from most games based on the national pastime. The first advancement is a Spring Training mode.

Localization.Title: NFL GameDay 99
Localization.Description: As the sequel to 1997's #1 selling football game for the Sony PlayStation, NFL GameDay 99 offers several new features designed to improve the gameplay as well as the presentation.

Localization.Title: NFL GameDay 99
Localization.Description: NFL Gameday 99 est une simulation de football américain sur Playstation qui contient toutes les équipes NFL de la saison 99 et inclut une nouvelle liste de tactiques de jeu.

Localization.Title: NFL GameDay 99
Localization.Description: NFL Gameday 99 ist eine American-Football-Simulation auf der Playstation, die alle NFL-Teams der Saison 99 enthält und eine neue Liste von Spieltaktiken beinhaltet. Mehrere Spielmodi stehen auf dem Programm: Saison, Training, Turnier und Manager.

Localization.Description: NHL FaceOff 99 improves upon its predecessor by upping the number of polygons by 20% and doubling the amount of textures.

Localization.Title: NHL FaceOff 99
Localization.Description: Dans le jeu de hockey sur glace NHL FaceOff 99 sur Playstation, vivez soixante minutes de sport extrême à vous couper le souffle.

Localization.Title: NHL FaceOff 99
Localization.Description: Erleben Sie im Eishockeyspiel NHL FaceOff 99 auf der Playstation 60 Minuten atemberaubenden Extremsport.

Localization.Title: NHL FaceOff 99

Localization.Title: Tomba!
Localization.Description: Aside from sporting a wacky pink hairdo, Tomba! offers a long and brain twisting experience that mixes the traditional 2D side scrolling action/platformer with the elements of a role-playing game.

Localization.Title: Tomba!
Localization.Description: Tombi! prend place dans un archipel d'îles perdues au milieu de l'océan. Ces îles étaient un havre de paix jusqu'à l'arrivée des Vilains Cochons, qui utilisèrent leurs pouvoirs afin de mettre l'île sans dessus dessous.

Localization.Title: Tomba!
Localization.Description: Tombi, ein kleiner Junge aus der Wildnis mit pinken Haaren und zerrissener Hose, hat einen goldenen Armreif von seinem Großvater geschenkt bekommen.

Localization.Title: Tomba!
Localization.Description: ¡Acompaña a Tombi a través de un mundo de magia y misterio y ayúdale a resolver complicados acertijos y a salvar el mundo de los Cerdiablos Komabuta!. Una combinación exclusiva de aventura y juego de rol de Whoope Camp.

Localization.Title: Tomba!
Localization.Description: Tombi è un ragazzo selvaggio dai capelli rosa.

Localization.Title: Syphon Filter
Localization.Description: Gabriel Logan, one of the government's top covert agents, must neutralize the terrorists that threaten Washington D.C. and destroy a biological weapon that has been built to end the lives of millions of innocent people.

Localization.Title: Syphon Filter
Localization.Description: Les services de renseignements ont découvert qu'une organisation terroriste internationale développe des armes biologiques.

Localization.Title: Syphon Filter
Localization.Description: Der Geheimdienst hat die Machenschaften einer internationalen Terroristenorganisation aufgedeckt, die biologische Kampfwaffen entwickelt. Nun ist Ihr Einsatz gefragt, um ein weltweites Blutbad zu verhindern.

Localization.Title: Syphon Filter
Localization.Description: Objetivo: erradicar el virus Syphon Filter. El Servicio de Inteligencia ha descubierto que una organización internacional, está desarrollando armas biológicas.

Localization.Title: Syphon Filter
Localization.Description: Obiettivo: debellare il virus Syphon Filter. I servizi segreti hanno scoperto che un'organizzazione internazionale sta sviluppando armi biologiche.

Localization.Title: Syphon Filter
Localization.Description: Syphon Filter é um jogo de ação e aventura no Playstation. O terrorista Eric Rhoemer decidiu erradicar os humanos espalhando no planeta um vírus mortal, o Syphon Filter. Apenas dois agentes antiterrorismo podem detê-lo: Gabe Logan e Lian Xing.

Localization.Title: Einhänder
Localization.Description: In 2192, a new city, Selene, is built on the moon. Over the years, Selene grows larger, more powerful, and more independent of the Earth - to the point that the moon and Earth battle in a war that winds down without a definite victory for either side.

Localization.Title: Einhänder
Localization.Description: Entrez dans une guerre entre les habitants de la Terre et ceux de la Lune grâce au shoot'em up Einhänder sur Playstation. Le soft vous propose 3 vaisseaux à piloter ainsi que de nombreuses armes pour détruire les ennemis qui se mettent sur votre passage.

Localization.Title: Einhänder
Localization.Description: Steuere den technologisch fortschrittlichsten Shooter aller Zeiten. Du bist ein Kamikazepilot im entscheidenden Kampf um die Erde. Schlage dich durch Horden feindlicher Kämpfer und bezwinge die furchteinflößendsten Bosse, die jemals erschaffen wurden.

Localization.Title: Einhänder
Localization.Description: El juego entero está centrado en un futuro ficticio durante una guerra entre la Tierra y una colonia Lunar llamada Selene.

Localization.Title: Einhänder
Localization.Description: Entra in una guerra tra gli abitanti della Terra e quelli della Luna grazie allo sparatutto Einhänder su Playstation. Il software ti offre 3 navi da pilotare e numerose armi per distruggere i nemici che ti ostacolano.

Localization.Title: Einhänder
Localization.Description: Em 2192, uma nova cidade, Selene, é construída na lua.

Localization.Title: Crash Bandicoot: Warped
Localization.Description: After defeating Dr. Neo Cortex, Crash and his sister, Coco, take a well-deserved vacation. However, their friend, Aku Aku, has a bad feeling, and as usual, he is right. Aku's evil twin, Uka Uka, was the person behind all of Dr. Cortex's schemes.

Localization.Title: Crash Bandicoot : Warped
Localization.Description: Plongés dans des décors inédits et aux commandes de tout nouveaux véhicules, des personnages détraqués rejoignent Crash Bandicoot dans une course à travers le temps pour sauver le monde!

Localization.Title: Crash Bandicoot: Warped
Localization.Description: Crash Bandicot kehrt zurück... Er begibt sich diesmal auf eine Zeitreise, die ihn unter anderem in das Alte Ägypten, Rom und England führt. Sogar in die vorgeschichtliche Zeit reist Crash, dort reitet er auf einem Dinosaurier.

Localization.Title: Crash Bandicoot: Warped
Localization.Description: Tras el fracaso del plan del Dr. Neo Cortex y la caída de su base espacial sobre la jungla, la malvada máscara Uka Uka es finalmente liberada.

Localization.Title: Crash Bandicoot: Warped
Localization.Description: Con le animazioni tutte nuove e i tantissimi nuovi veicoli, un folle cast di personaggi si unisce a Crash Bandicoot in una gara nel tempo per salvare il destino dell'intero universo!

Localization.Title: Crash Bandicoot: Warped
Localization.Description: Após o Dr Nitrus Brio e Crash Bandicoot terem destruído a estação de Cortex, um dos pedaços foi parar na Terra.

Localization.Title: NFL Xtreme
Localization.Description: Like NFL Blitz, NFL Xtreme is football without rules, and features exaggerated tackles, late hits, and high-scoring affairs.

Localization.Title: NFL Xtreme
Localization.Description: NFL Xtreme est une simulation de football américain sur Playstation qui propose plusieurs modes de jeu : Exhibition, Playoff et un mode Carrière pour faire une saison complète. Vous pouvez échanger des joueurs entre chaque équipe.

Localization.Title: NFL Xtreme
Localization.Description: Wie NFL Blitz ist NFL Xtreme Football ohne Regeln und bietet übertriebene Tackles, späte Treffer und torgefährliche Affären.

Localization.Description: NCAA GAMEBREAKER '99 continues this series' tradition of realistic college football simulations. You'll get features like the Customize Play option, which lets you design your own plays and really makes the possibilities almost endless.

Localization.Title: Rally Cross 2
Localization.Description: The sequel to the chaotic off-road rally racing game, Rally Cross. The lead programmer, Mark Lyons, and the lead artist, Scott Atkins, from Rally Cross had left Sony and formed a new company, Idol Minds.

Localization.Title: Rally Cross 2
Localization.Description: Rally Cross 2 sur Playstation, reprend le concept de courses chaotiques de son prédécesseur en proposant cette fois-ci plus d'options de personnalisation de sa voiture, comme les suspensions ou autre.

Localization.Title: Rally Cross 2
Localization.Description: Rally Cross 2 für Playstation greift das Konzept der chaotischen Rennen des Vorgängers auf und bietet dieses Mal mehr Optionen zur Fahrzeuganpassung, wie z. B. Federungen oder anderes.

Localization.Title: Rally Cross 2
Localization.Description: La secuela de Rally Cross programada por Idol Minds, conservó el espíritu arcade de la primera entrega, con unos buenos gráficos, el juego ya no permitía jugar hasta 4 jugadores gracias al multitap, como ocurría en la primera parte, pero si se mantuvo el

Localization.Title: Rally Cross 2
Localization.Description: Il sequel del caotico gioco di corse fuoristrada Rally Cross. Il capo programmatore, Mark Lyons, e l'artista principale, Scott Atkins, di Rally Cross avevano lasciato la Sony e avevano formato una nuova società, Idol Minds.

Localization.Title: Twisted Metal III
Localization.Description: In an apocalyptic future, the mysterious and powerful Calypso offers one wish to the winner of the Twisted Metal competition.

Localization.Title: Twisted Metal III
Localization.Description: Twisted Metal 3 est un jeu d'action dans lequel vous avez une batterie d'armes en tout genre pour détruire les véhicules de vos adversaires. L'objectif est simple : soyez le dernier survivant.

Localization.Title: Twisted Metal III
Localization.Description: Twisted Metal 3 spielt im Jahr 2008, zwei Jahre nach dem Vorgänger Twisted Metal 2. Die Erde ist zunehmend verfallen und zahlreiche Metropolen sind verwüstet.

Localization.Title: Twisted Metal III
Localization.Description: En un futuro apocalíptico, el poderoso y misterioso Calypso ofrece un deseo al ganador del torneo Twisted Metal.

Localization.Title: Twisted Metal III
Localization.Description: In an apocalyptic future, the mysterious and powerful Calypso offers one wish to the winner of the Twisted Metal competition.

Localization.Title: Twisted Metal III
Localization.Description: Em um futuro apocalíptico, o misterioso e poderoso Calypso oferece um desejo ao vencedor da competição Twisted Metal.

Localization.Title: Cool Boarders 3
Localization.Description: The third release in the Cool Boarders series, the sequel to the highly respected and best-selling Cool Boarders 2. This game was the first of the snowboarding franchise to be developed by 989 Studios.

Localization.Title: Cool Boarders 3
Localization.Description: Cool Boarders 3 est un jeu de snowboard disponible sur Playstation. Préparez-vous à dévaler de nombreuses pentes et pistes enneigées dans ce jeu de glisse.

Localization.Title: Cool Boarders 3
Localization.Description: Mehr Strecken, mehr Tricks, mehr Realismus - extreme Snowboard-Action! - 34 neue Rennstrecken mit haarscharfen Kurven, gewagten Sprüngen und vielen Extras - 20 todesmutige Snowboarder mit unterschiedlichen Fähigkeiten, Stärken und Schwächen - 6 Weltklass

Localization.Title: Cool Boarders 3
Localization.Description: El tercer lanzamiento en la serie Cool Boarders. La mecánica de juego y los sistemas de control son significativamente diferentes de los precuelas, pero la estructura básica del juego sigue siendo similar.

Localization.Title: Legend of Legaia
Localization.Description: After creating a massive world with vast oceans, landscapes and an infinite universe, God instituted human beings to keep his creation in order.

Localization.Title: Legend of Legaia
Localization.Description: Legend of Legaia est un jeu de rôle sur Playstation dans lequel une étrange brume transforme les êtres vivants en sinistres mutants. Le seul espoir ? Raviver les arbres de la genèse.

Localization.Title: Legend of Legaia
Localization.Description: Ein unheimlicher Nebel bedeckt die Welt von Legaia in Legend of Legaia für PS1. Allen, die mit ihm in Berührung kamen, brachte er Wahnsinn und Verderben. Um zu überleben, hat sich die Bevölkerung an den Rand ihrer Zivilisation zurückgezogen.

Localization.Title: Legend of Legaia
Localization.Description: La historia nos narra que en la antigüedad fueron creados unos seres llamados Seru. Los seru eran una especie de estatuas que al acoplarse con un humano multiplicaban sus habilidades por 10.

Localization.Title: Legend of Legaia
Localization.Description: Dopo aver creato un mondo enorme con vasti oceani, paesaggi e un universo infinito, Dio ha istituito gli esseri umani per mantenere in ordine la sua creazione.

Localization.Title: Legend of Legaia

Localization.Title: Gran Turismo (Demo)
Localization.Description: Gran Turismo puts you behind the wheel in realistic races against AI opponents, collecting cars, credits, and trophies.

Localization.Title: Gran Turismo (Demo)
Localization.Description: Gran Turismo sur Playstation fait figure de référence en matière de simulation automobile. Passez vos licences vous ouvrant l'accès aux compétitions, trouvez-vous une bonne occase, et c'est parti pour la gloire.

Localization.Title: Gran Turismo (Demo)
Localization.Description: In Gran Turismo trittst du in realistisch simulierten Rennen gegen KI-Gegner an und sammelst Fahrzeuge, Geld und Trophäen.

Localization.Title: Gran Turismo (Demo)
Localization.Description: El primer juego de la serie Gran Turismo de simulación de carreras. Se puede elegir entre la versión arcade (con vehículos clásicos como el Aston Martin) o la simulación, siendo este el verdadero corazón del juego.

Localization.Title: Gran Turismo (Demo)
Localization.Description: Gran Turismo si basa fondamentalmente sul genere del simulatore di corse. Il giocatore deve manovrare un'automobile per competere contro piloti artificialmente intelligenti su vari circuiti.

Localization.Title: Gran Turismo (Demo)
Localization.Description: Gran Turismo é uma popular e aclamada série de videojogos de corrida automóvel produzida pela Polyphony Digital, um estúdio que com o passar do tempo se dedicou a desenvolver basicamente somente este titulo.

Localization.Title: Bust A Groove
Localization.Description: Match the moves shown on-screen in this Simon-like game to dance. Keep up with the continuing commands and your persona will be able to do combos and other fancy moves.

Localization.Title: Bust A Groove
Localization.Description: Bust A Groove est un jeu de rythme sur Playstation. Vous êtes dans la peau de l'un des dix meilleurs danseurs du monde et vous devez défier vos homologues dans des duels dansant. Si vous avez le rythme dans le sang, la victoire est quasiment assurée !

Localization.Title: Bust A Groove
Localization.Description: Ein Spiel wie kein anderes. Wie bei den besten Kampfspielen wetteifern hier die besten Tänzer der Welt um den Titel des "Ultimate Dancing Champion".

Localization.Title: Bust A Groove
Localization.Description: Bust A Groove es un juego de ritmo de Playstation. Estás en la piel de uno de los diez mejores bailarines del mundo y tienes que desafiar a tus homólogos en duelos de baile. Si tienes ritmo en la sangre, ¡la victoria está casi asegurada!

Localization.Title: Cardinal Syn (Demo)
Localization.Description: For decades, the clans of Bloodland were locked in a never-ending war; then the Wanderer arrived with the Book of Knowledge. He divided the book and gave each clan a piece, hoping the clans would come to rely on each other's newly acquired knowledge.

Localization.Description: Cardinal Syn est un jeu de combat sur Playstation. Au menu : 8 personnages disponibles dès le début du jeu ainsi que 5 modes de jeu, à savoir Tournoi, Versus, Team battle, Survival et un mode Entraînement.

Localization.Title: Cardinal Syn (Demo)
Localization.Description: Jahrzehntelang waren die Clans von Bloodland in einen nie endenden Krieg verwickelt; dann kam der Wanderer mit dem Buch des Wissens.

Localization.Title: Cardinal Syn (Demo)
Localization.Description: Durante décadas, los clanes de Bloodland se vieron envueltos en una guerra sin fin; luego llegó el Errante con el Libro del Conocimiento.

Localization.Description: Por décadas, os clãs de Bloodland estiveram presos em uma guerra sem fim; então o Andarilho chegou com o Livro do Conhecimento.

Localization.Description: Like NFL Blitz, NFL Xtreme is football without rules, and features exaggerated tackles, late hits, and high-scoring affairs.

Localization.Description: NFL Xtreme est une simulation de football américain sur Playstation qui propose plusieurs modes de jeu : Exhibition, Playoff et un mode Carrière pour faire une saison complète. Vous pouvez échanger des joueurs entre chaque équipe.

Localization.Title: NFL GameDay 99 (Demo)
Localization.Description: As the sequel to 1997's #1 selling football game for the Sony PlayStation, NFL GameDay 99 offers several new features designed to improve the gameplay as well as the presentation.

Localization.Title: NFL GameDay 99 (Demo)
Localization.Description: NFL Gameday 99 est une simulation de football américain sur Playstation qui contient toutes les équipes NFL de la saison 99 et inclut une nouvelle liste de tactiques de jeu.

Localization.Title: NFL GameDay 99 (Demo)
Localization.Description: NFL Gameday 99 ist eine American-Football-Simulation auf der Playstation, die alle NFL-Teams der Saison 99 enthält und eine neue Liste von Spieltaktiken beinhaltet. Mehrere Spielmodi stehen auf dem Programm: Saison, Training, Turnier und Manager.

Localization.Title: Disney/Pixar A Bug's Life
Localization.Description: The ultimate movie fun comes to the PlayStation game console. Get ready for a Bug's-eye-view and experience the most incredible adventure ever.

Localization.Title: Disney/Pixar A Bug's Life
Localization.Description: A Bug's Life est un jeu de plates-formes sorti sur Playstation. Retrouvez l'ambiance et les personnages du film en images de synthèse sur votre machine.

Localization.Title: Disney/Pixar A Bug's Life
Localization.Description: Das Spiel ist ein Third Person-Actionspiel mit jeweils verschiedenen Zielen in den insgesamt 15 Leveln. Um diese Level zu bestehen, agiert der Spieler zum Teil mit der Fauna. So springt man beispielsweise mithilfe von Fliegenpilzen über Schluchten.

Localization.Title: Disney/Pixar A Bug's Life
Localization.Description: Una aventura completamente nueva en 3D, basada en la película de dibujos animados Bichos, una aventura en miniatura.

Localization.Title: Disney/Pixar A Bug's Life
Localization.Description: Il massimo del divertimento cinematografico arriva sulla console di gioco PlayStation. Preparati per una visuale dall'alto e vivi l'avventura più incredibile di sempre.

Localization.Title: Disney/Pixar A Bug's Life
Localization.Description: Uma aventura completamente nova em 3D, baseada no filme de animação Vida de Inseto, uma aventura em miniatura.

Localization.Title: Spyro the Dragon (Demo)
Localization.Description: Spyro the Dragon is a platform game developed by Insomniac Games for the PlayStation. It stars the title character, a young purple dragon named Spyro and his dragonfly friend, Sparx, and is the first game in the Spyro the Dragon series.

Localization.Title: Spyro the Dragon (Demo)
Localization.Description: La terre des Dragons a été envahie par Gnasty Gnorc et son armée de Gnorcs. Tous les dragons ont été transformés en statues de cristal, seul Spyro a été épargné.

Localization.Title: Spyro the Dragon (Demo)
Localization.Description: Spyro ist ein süßer, lila Drache, der in der Klemme steckt. Alle Drachenfreunde von Spyro sind dem bösen Gnasty Gnorc zum Opfer gefallen, der sie in Kristalle verwandelt hat.

Localization.Title: Spyro the Dragon (Demo)
Localization.Description: Gnasty Gnorc y su ejército Gnorc han conquistado los mundos de los dragones, y los han convertido a todos en estatuas de cristal... excepto a Spyro.

Localization.Title: Spyro the Dragon (Demo)
Localization.Description: Spyro the Dragon è un gioco platform sviluppato da Insomniac Games per PlayStation. Ha come protagonisti il ​​personaggio del titolo, un giovane drago viola di nome Spyro e il suo amico libellula, Sparx, ed è il primo gioco della serie Spyro the Dragon.

Localization.Title: Spyro the Dragon (Demo)
Localization.Description: Spyro The Dragon é um jogo de plataforma no Playstation. O mago maligno Gnasty Gnorc quer conquistar o mundo. Para isso, ele colocou fora de perigo todos os dragões por statufiant em cristal.

Localization.Title: MediEvil (Demo)
Localization.Description: The Evil Wizard Zarok has returned from the dead to wreak havoc on a peaceful land, and it is up to the centuries-dead hero, Sir Daniel Fortesque, to rise from his grave and defeat the very nemesis that put him in that grave.

Localization.Title: MediEvil (Demo)
Localization.Description: Perdue dans les limbes temporelles, l'histoire de Gallowmere est celle du pays où la magie a pris le pas sur la science et où Zarok, le sorcier à l'âme torturée, exploite ses pouvoirs les plus sombres.

Localization.Title: MediEvil (Demo)
Localization.Description: Vom Winde der Zeit verweht, ist die Geschichte von Gallowmere, einem Land in dem Magie mehr gilt als Wissenschaft und in dem ein Hexer - der finstere Zarok - ihre dunkelsten Mächte an sich gerissen hat.

Localization.Title: MediEvil (Demo)
Localization.Description: En el reino de Gallowmere, año 1286, el poderoso mago Zarok, desterrado por nigromancia, reunió a un numeroso ejército de zombis, demonios y otros monstruos con la intención de conquistar el reino al que pertenecía y vengarse de la familia real.

Localization.Title: MediEvil (Demo)
Localization.Description: Il malvagio mago Zarok è tornato dalla morte per devastare una terra pacifica, e spetta all'eroe morto da secoli, Sir Daniel Fortesque, risorgere dalla sua tomba e sconfiggere la stessa nemesi che lo ha messo in quella tomba.

Localization.Title: MediEvil (Demo)
Localization.Description: Medievil é um jogo de ação / aventura no Playstation. Um mago chamado Zarok quer fazer tudo para dominar o mundo.

Localization.Title: Contender
Localization.Description: Victory Boxing Contender / Contender 2 is an arcade-style boxing game. It does not claim to be a realistic simulation in any way. It is meant to be easy to pick up and learn.

Localization.Title: Contender
Localization.Description: Contender est un jeu de boxe sur Playstation. Ce jeu de boxe très orienté arcade permet une prise en main rapide qui offre aux novices du genre la possibilité de s'amuser rapidement.

Localization.Title: Contender
Localization.Description: Bei Victory Boxing Contender ist der Sieg nicht alles, sondern das ein und Alles! Sind Sie ein Kämpfer, der sich der anstehenden Herausforderung als würdig erweißt? In der brutalen und gnadenlosen Welt von Boxing Contender werden Ihre Fähigkeiten und Ihr

Localization.Title: Contender
Localization.Description: Victory Boxing Contender es un juego de boxeo para PlayStation. Este juego de boxeo de estilo arcade es fácil de aprender y jugar, lo que permite que incluso quienes se inician en el género se diviertan al instante.

Localization.Title: Ridge Racer
Localization.Description: Ridge Racer is an arcade racer that puts the emphasis on speed and fun rather than on realistic driving simulation.

Localization.Title: Ridge Racer
Localization.Description: Ridge Racer est un jeu de courses sur Playstation.

Localization.Title: Ridge Racer
Localization.Description: Mit quietschenden Reifen in Turbogeschwndigkeit rast Du mit, in einem heißen Rennen im absoluten Arcade-Feeling, Ridge Racer - unglaublich realistische Renn-Action, auf die Ihr garantiert voll abfährst!...

Localization.Title: Ridge Racer
Localization.Description: Ridge Racer es un juego de carreras arcade que pone más énfasis en la velocidad y la diversión, que en la simulación realista de conducción.

Localization.Title: Ridge Racer
Localization.Description: Ridge Racer è un gioco di corse arcade che pone maggiormente l'accento sulla velocità e sul divertimento rispetto alla simulazione di guida realistica.

Localization.Title: Ridge Racer
Localization.Description: Ridge Racer é um jogo de corridas de arcada que coloca a ênfase na velocidade e no divertimento em vez de na simulação realista de condução.

Localization.Title: Wipeout
Localization.Description: Wipeout is a futuristic racing game set in the year 2052. Racing for one of four teams, the player competes in the F3600 Anti-Gravity Racing League on six tracks. Each team's hovercraft racer has different ratings in speed, acceleration and turning.

Localization.Title: Wipeout
Localization.Description: WipEout est un jeu de courses sur Playstation. En 2057, rejoignez une des sept équipes de courses existantes et participez à des courses de véhicules anti-gravité à des vitesses extrêmes.

Localization.Title: Wipeout
Localization.Description: Wipeout ist ein futuristisches Rennspiel, das im Jahr 2052 spielt. Als Fahrer für eines von vier Teams nimmt der Spieler an der F3600 Anti-Gravity Racing League auf sechs Strecken teil.

Localization.Title: Wipeout
Localization.Description: WipEout es un juego de carreras futurista ambientado en el año 2052. Compitiendo para uno de los cuatro equipos, el jugador compite en la F3600 Anti-Gravity Racing League en seis pistas.

Localization.Description: Wipeout é um jogo de corridas futuristas ambientado no ano de 2052. Correndo para uma de quatro equipas, o jogador compete na F3600 Anti-Gravity Racing League em seis pistas.

Localization.Description: Destruction Derby est assez atypique pour un jeu de voitures : c'est un jeu de stock-car pur, dans lequel la course passe au second plan derrière l'action, et dans ce domaine, tout est permis ! Vous faites carrière de ligue en ligue pour atteindre la pre

Localization.Description: In Destruction Derby 1 für PS1 hast Du nur eine Mission, die zählt: Zerstören! Stoße so lange mit den anderen zusammen und fahre sie über den Haufen, bis ihr Wagen den Geister aufgibt.

Localization.Description: Probabilmente ti senti come un manichino da crash test quando giochi a questo gioco: non è solo un gioco di corse, ma ottieni punti per aver distrutto i tuoi nemici! La quantità di punti che ottieni dipende da come li colpisci ... ad es.

Localization.Title: Krazy Ivan
Localization.Description: In the early 21st century, the Earth is under attack by aliens. In five areas of the planet, they have erected energy generators, creating a field that slowly encompasses the entire planet surface. They have also taken hundreds of humans prisoner.

Localization.Title: Krazy Ivan
Localization.Description: Au début du 21e siècle, la Terre est attaquée par des extraterrestres. Ils ont érigé des générateurs d'énergie, créant un champ qui englobe lentement toute la surface de la planète. Ils ont également fait prisonniers des centaines d'humains.

Localization.Title: Krazy Ivan
Localization.Description: Im frühen 21. Jahrhundert wird die Erde von Außerirdischen angegriffen. In fünf Bereichen des Planeten haben sie Energiegeneratoren errichtet und ein Feld geschaffen, das langsam die gesamte Planetenoberfläche umfasst.

Localization.Title: Krazy Ivan
Localization.Description: A principios del siglo XXI, la Tierra está siendo atacada por alienígenas. Han erigido generadores de energía, creando un campo que lentamente abarca toda la superficie del planeta. También han hecho prisioneros a cientos de humanos.

Localization.Title: Krazy Ivan
Localization.Description: All'inizio del XXI secolo, la Terra è attaccata dagli alieni. Hanno eretto dei generatori di energia, creando un campo che lentamente ingloba l'intera superficie del pianeta. Hanno anche fatto prigionieri centinaia di umani.

Localization.Title: Krazy Ivan
Localization.Description: No início do século XXI, a Terra está a ser atacada por alienígenas. Eles ergueram geradores de energia, criando um campo que abrange lentamente toda a superfície do planeta. Fizeram também centenas de humanos prisioneiros.

Localization.Title: Twisted Metal
Localization.Description: The original classic! Choose from 12 different vehicles ranging from a rig to a bike and try to win the Twisted Metal contest.

Localization.Title: Twisted Metal
Localization.Description: Twisted Metal sur Playstation est un jeu de courses et de stock-cars puisque le joueur pourra utiliser toutes sortes de projectiles balistiques.

Localization.Title: Twisted Metal
Localization.Description: Machen Sie sich startklar für die Fahrt Ihres Lebens, wenn Los Angeles zur Arena benzinschluckender, schwerbewaffneter Monster wird, die die Straßen unsicher machen. Den Asphalt kann nur einer regieren. Sind dieser eine Sie?

Localization.Title: Twisted Metal
Localization.Description: ¡El clásico original! Elija entre 12 vehículos diferentes que van desde una plataforma a una moto y trata de ganar el torneo de Twisted Metal.

Localization.Title: Twisted Metal
Localization.Description: The original classic! Choose from 12 different vehicles ranging from a rig to a bike and try to win the Twisted Metal contest.

Localization.Title: Twisted Metal
Localization.Description: O clássico original! Escolha entre 12 veículos diferentes, desde um equipamento a uma bicicleta, e tente vencer o concurso Twisted Metal.

Localization.Title: Warhawk: The Red Mercury Missions
Localization.Description: Warhawk is an action/simulation game built around a futuristic VTOL craft. The player maneuvers with 360 degrees of flight control through 6 unique levels.

Localization.Title: Warhawk : The Red Mercury Missions
Localization.Description: Dans ce jeu d'action sur PlayStation, vous dirigez votre hélicoptère futuriste et devez défaire vos ennemis dans des décors qui font beaucoup penser au grand canyon.

Localization.Title: Warhawk: The Red Mercury Missions
Localization.Description: In diesem Actionspiel auf der PlayStation führst du deinen futuristischen Helikopter aus und musst dich in den Dekorationen verstecken, die du an Grand Canyon denkst.

Localization.Title: Warhawk: The Red Mercury Missions
Localization.Description: Warhawk es un juego de acción/simulación creado en torno a una nave VTOL futurista. Tiene total control de vuelo a través de 6 niveles únicos.

Localization.Title: Warhawk: The Red Mercury Missions
Localization.Description: Warhawk is an action/simulation game built around a futuristic VTOL craft. The player maneuvers with 360 degrees of flight control through 6 unique levels.

Localization.Title: Twisted Metal 2
Localization.Description: Twisted Metal features destructive car combat, playable either as a complete tournament or a single match The action takes place in 8 different locations around the world, on differing surfaces, many featuring destructible buildings and landmarks.

Localization.Title: Twisted Metal 2
Localization.Description: Twisted Metal 2 sur Playstation se déroule 1 an après le premier. Cette fois-ci le tournoi n'a pas lieu à Los Angeles mais dans plusieurs autres grandes villes du monde.

Localization.Title: Twisted Metal 2
Localization.Description: Es gibt eine neue Welt zum Zerstören, mit neuen Autos, neuen Schlachtfeldern und neuer Kampf-Action. Jetzt mit intelligenteren, tödlicheren, tieferen Kämpfen für kreative Fahrzeug-Schlachten in der ganzen Welt.

Localization.Title: Twisted Metal 2

Localization.Title: Bogey Dead 6
Localization.Description: The player takes the role of an air pilot who is part of an elite first strike air unit. This unit is tasked with putting a stop to an international crime organization that is building up a military sized force.

Localization.Description: Aufrüstung pur: Das tödliche Inferno hat einen name: Joey Major Disaster Tenka. Und Sie sind am Abzug… Knallharte Action mit Dutzenden van intelligenten Gegnern. 28 hochexplosive Missionen - 3D-Spannung wie niet zuvor.

Localization.Title: Bogey Dead 6

Localization.Title: Jet Moto
Localization.Description: Developed by SingleTrac, Jet Moto blends futuristic motocross racing with hazard ridden tracks. Rather than using traditional cars or motorcycles, these vehicles are a cross between jet skis and hovercrafts.

Localization.Description: Jet Rider est un jeu de courses sur Playstation où vous conduirez des motos futuristes aussi bien sur la terre que sur l'eau. Confrontez-vous à 19 autres pilotes sur 10 circuits différents.

Localization.Title: Jet Moto

Localization.Title: Destruction Derby 2
Localization.Description: Strap in, hold on, hit the gas, and you're off on a quest for destructive points in Destruction Derby 2, the smashing sequel to the original demolition derby game from Reflections Interactive and Psygnosis.

Localization.Title: Destruction Derby 2
Localization.Description: Destruction Derby 2 est un jeu de courses musclées sur Playstation. Vous pouvez conduire de nombreux véhicules qui seront réduits à néant lors des courses puisque dans ce jeu personne ne vous fera de cadeau.

Localization.Title: Destruction Derby 2
Localization.Description: Setz dich ans Steuer deines frisierten Wagens und zeig es deinen Gegnern – entweder indem du sie überholst oder indem du ihre Fahrzeuge in Einzelteile zerlegst.

Localization.Title: Destruction Derby 2
Localization.Description: Abróchese el cinturón, sujétese, pise el acelerador y comenzara una búsqueda de puntos de destrucción en Destruction Derby 2, la espectacular continuación del juego demolition derby original de Reflections Interactive y Psygnosis.

Localization.Title: Destruction Derby 2
Localization.Description: Allaccia le cinture, resisti, colpisci il gas e parti alla ricerca di punti distruttivi in ​​Destruction Derby 2, il sequel strepitoso del gioco del demolition derby originale di Reflections Interactive e Psygnosis.

Localization.Title: Destruction Derby 2
Localization.Description: Destruction Derby 2 é um jogo de corrida no Playstation. Você pode dirigir muitos veículos que serão destruídos durante as corridas porque neste jogo ninguém lhe dará um presente.

Localization.Title: Wipeout XL
Localization.Description: WipEout XL is set in the year 2097, around four decades after its predecessor. Instead of the F3600 anti-gravity racing competition, the game features an even faster and more dangerous tournament: the F5000 AG league.

Localization.Title: Wipeout XL
Localization.Description: WipEout 2097 sur Playstation installe le joueur aux commandes de vaisseaux de courses ultra-rapides le long de circuits complètement déjantés où la première place ne s'obtient qu'à coups de missiles et autres armes destructrices.

Localization.Title: Wipeout XL
Localization.Description: Ein Anti-Gravitation-Rennen, das der Konkurrenz um Lichtjahre voraus ist! Der Vorgänger hat die Spielwelt in Brand gesteckt und wurde sofort zu einem Klassiker. Jetzt kommt eine brutale neue Generation von Anti-Schwerkraft-Rennen.

Localization.Title: Wipeout XL
Localization.Description: Wipeout es un juego de carreras futurista que transcurre cuarenta años después de su predecesor. Entra en la liga F5000 AG, más rápida, competitiva y peligrosa que nunca.

Localization.Title: Wipeout XL
Localization.Description: WipEout 2097 per Playstation mette il giocatore ai comandi di navi da corsa ultraveloci lungo circuiti completamente folli dove il primo posto si ottiene solo con missili e altre armi distruttive.

Localization.Title: Wipeout XL
Localization.Description: WipEout 2097 em Playstation coloca o jogador aos comandos de navios de corrida ultra-rápidos ao longo de circuitos loucos onde o primeiro lugar só é alcançado por mísseis e outras armas destrutivas.

Localization.Description: Star Ocean: The Second Story is a world of magic, science, space travel and deadly demons! Enter a world where love knows no bounds, the evil is neverending and good can overcome all if the heart is just and true.

Localization.Title: Star Ocean : The Second Story (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Star Ocean : The Second Story est un jeu de rôle sur Playstation. Téléporté par erreur sur une planète au bord du chaos, le jeune Claude va devoir trouver un moyen de rentrer chez lui tout en venant en aide aux autochtones.

Localization.Description: In einem endlosen Sternenmeer am Rande des Universums steht eine einzelne, schicksalhafte Begegnung bevor.

Localization.Description: A boisterous band of baboons carry out a daring zoo escape.

Localization.Title: Ape Escape
Localization.Description: Ape Escape est un jeu de plates-formes sorti sur Playstation. Spike est un jeune garçon espiègle qui se retrouve projeté dans le passé à cause du grand singe Specter. Vous devrez retrouver tous les singes disparus dans le passé et les attraper.

Localization.Title: Ape Escape
Localization.Description: Ein superintelligenter Affe klaut eine Zeitmaschine, um seine dümmlichen Artgenossen auf die Menschheitshistorie loszulassen und den Lauf der Geschichte zu verändern.

Localization.Title: Ape Escape
Localization.Description: Specter, una atracción popular en el parque de atracciones, se ha transformado en un mono inteligente.

Localization.Description: Ape Escape è un gioco platform pubblicato su Playstation. Spike è un ragazzino dispettoso che si ritrova catapultato nel passato dalla grande scimmia Spectre. Dovrai trovare tutte le scimmie scomparse nel passato e catturarle.

Localization.Title: Ape Escape
Localization.Description: Specter, uma atração popular no parque de diversões, tornou-se um macaco inteligente.

Localization.Title: Bloody Roar II
Localization.Description: Bloody Roar is back with this sequel. Among the new and improved features are seven new characters (along with four original fighters) complete with new moves and looks.

Localization.Title: Bloody Roar II
Localization.Description: Dans la série Bloody Roar, vos combattants peuvent se transformer en versions animales d'eux-mêmes : des hybrides humains-animaux assoiffés de violence.

Localization.Title: Bloody Roar II
Localization.Description: Ein Mensch wird schneller zur gnadenlosen Bestie als man denkt. Bei Bloody Roar 2 - Bringer Of The New Age treten 10 Menschen ins Rampenlicht, die mit einer besonderen Begabung ausgestattet sind.

Localization.Title: Bloody Roar II
Localization.Description: En la serie Bloody Roar, tus luchadores pueden transformarse en versiones animales de sí mismos: híbridos humano-animales con sed de violencia.

Localization.Description: La lotta degli esseri metà umani e metà animali di "Bloody Roar" finì con il crollo della gigantesca multinazionale Tylon Company, la responsabile della creazione di mutanti umani artificiali transgenici, chiamati "bestie semiumane", L'Amministrazione di

Localization.Description: Batalhe e transforme-se no híbrido humano-animal neste jogo clássico de luta em 3D! Bote suas habilidades a teste e lute para atingir o topo! O "quê" da série Bloody Roar é a capacidade de seus combatentes se transformarem em versões animalescas de si --

Localization.Title: Spyro 2: Ripto's Rage!
Localization.Description: Ripto's Rage is the second game in the Spyro the Dragon series, which started with Spyro the Dragon in 1998. The protagonist of the series, Spyro, is placed in the land of Avalar, rather than the Dragon Worlds, where the previous installment was set.

Localization.Title: Spyro 2 : Ripto's Rage!
Localization.Description: Le pays d'Avalar est tombé sous le joug du tyrannique sorcier Ripto et de ses acolytes, Crush et Gulp. Le peuple d'Avalar a besoin d'aide et fait appel au pays des Dragons...

Localization.Title: Spyro 2: Ripto's Rage!
Localization.Description: Der lebhafte kleine Drache ist wieder da, und zwar in einem Nachfolger, der dem Original weit überlegen ist. Spyro-Fans, aber auch solche, die das erste Spiel nicht kennen, werden von der Grandiosität von Spyro 2: Ripto's Rage begeistert sein.

Localization.Title: Spyro 2: Ripto's Rage!
Localization.Description: Únete a Spyro y a su mejor amigo Sparx para ayudar a los habitantes de Avalar a poner fin al régimen tiránico de Ripto.

Localization.Title: Spyro 2: Ripto's Rage!
Localization.Description: Ripto's Rage è il secondo gioco della serie Spyro the Dragon, iniziata con Spyro the Dragon nel 1998. Il protagonista della serie, Spyro, è ambientato nella terra di Avalar, anziché nei Mondi dei Draghi, dove era ambientato il capitolo precedente.

Localization.Title: Spyro 2: Ripto's Rage!
Localization.Description: Ripto's Rage é o segundo jogo da série Spyro the Dragon, que começou com Spyro the Dragon em 1998. O protagonista da série, Spyro, é colocado na terra de Avalar, em vez dos Dragon Worlds, onde a edição anterior foi ambientada. .

Localization.Title: CTR: Crash Team Racing
Localization.Description: It's a multi-player kart racing game starring your favorite bandicoot CRASH and a host of his friends...and foes! The stakes are high and the competition is fierce. Ready...Set...GO!!!

Localization.Title: CTR : Crash Team Racing
Localization.Description: Que le meilleur gagne! Dans ce jeu, amis et ennemis s'affrontent sur la piste pour remporter le prix suprême: la planète Terre!! Face à Nitros Oxide, son plus grand ennemi à ce jour, Crash Bandicoot est obligé de demander l'aide des ses vieux ennemis.

Localization.Title: CTR: Crash Team Racing
Localization.Description: Neo Cortex ist leider nicht der einzige geisteskranke Erfinder auf den drei Inseln, die Crash bewohnt. Dr. Nitros Oxide hat in seiner verrückten Art eine ganz eigene Vorstellung, wie er die Weltherrschaft an sich reißen kann.

Localization.Title: CTR: Crash Team Racing
Localization.Description: La historia del juego gira en torno a un malvado extraterrestre llamado Nitrous Oxide, el cual ha viajado por toda la galaxia pregonándose a sí mismo como el corredor más rápido.

Localization.Title: CTR: Crash Team Racing
Localization.Description: La storia del gioco ruota attorno a un alieno malvagio di nome Nitrous Oxide, che ha viaggiato per l'intera galassia sbandierandosi come il corridore più veloce.

Localization.Title: CTR: Crash Team Racing
Localization.Description: O famoso marsupial laranja retorna para o quarto e final jogo no PlayStation, desta vez entre rodas de kart.

Localization.Title: Tiny Tank
Localization.Description: In a future world, an army of steel robots are out to destroy the human race. Our only hope is a little yellow tank armed with some mighty big guns.

Localization.Title: Tiny Tank
Localization.Description: Tiny Tank est un jeu d'action sur Playstation. Passez aux commandes de Tiny Tank, un petit char hargneux qui n'a pas peur de s'attaquer à plus gros que lui.

Localization.Title: Tiny Tank
Localization.Description: Tiny Tank ist ein Actionspiel für Playstation. Übernimm die Kontrolle über Tiny Tank, einen knurrenden kleinen Panzer, der keine Angst davor hat, etwas Größeres als sich selbst in Angriff zu nehmen.

Localization.Title: Tiny Tank
Localization.Description: Tiny Tank es una mezcla única de acción en tercera persona y plataformas. Controlas a Tiny Tank mientras atraviesa niveles llenos de enemigos, obstáculos y trampas mortales.

Localization.Title: Spyro the Dragon (Demo)
Localization.Description: Spyro the Dragon is a platform game developed by Insomniac Games for the PlayStation. It stars the title character, a young purple dragon named Spyro and his dragonfly friend, Sparx, and is the first game in the Spyro the Dragon series.

Localization.Title: Spyro the Dragon (Demo)
Localization.Description: La terre des Dragons a été envahie par Gnasty Gnorc et son armée de Gnorcs. Tous les dragons ont été transformés en statues de cristal, seul Spyro a été épargné.

Localization.Title: Spyro the Dragon (Demo)
Localization.Description: Spyro ist ein süßer, lila Drache, der in der Klemme steckt. Alle Drachenfreunde von Spyro sind dem bösen Gnasty Gnorc zum Opfer gefallen, der sie in Kristalle verwandelt hat.

Localization.Title: Spyro the Dragon (Demo)
Localization.Description: Gnasty Gnorc y su ejército Gnorc han conquistado los mundos de los dragones, y los han convertido a todos en estatuas de cristal... excepto a Spyro.

Localization.Title: Spyro the Dragon (Demo)
Localization.Description: Spyro the Dragon è un gioco platform sviluppato da Insomniac Games per PlayStation. Ha come protagonisti il ​​personaggio del titolo, un giovane drago viola di nome Spyro e il suo amico libellula, Sparx, ed è il primo gioco della serie Spyro the Dragon.

Localization.Title: Spyro the Dragon (Demo)
Localization.Description: Spyro The Dragon é um jogo de plataforma no Playstation. O mago maligno Gnasty Gnorc quer conquistar o mundo. Para isso, ele colocou fora de perigo todos os dragões por statufiant em cristal.

Localization.Title: Um Jammer Lammy
Localization.Description: Introducing Lammy, a totally rockin' guitarist.

Localization.Title: Um Jammer Lammy
Localization.Description: Um Jammer Lammy est un jeu musical sur Playstation. Vous devez suivre une rythmique imposée par la chanson en appuyant quand il le faut sur les bonnes touches et dans le bon rythme quand les icônes s'affichent en haut de l'écran.

Localization.Title: Um Jammer Lammy
Localization.Description: Um Jammer Lammy ist ein Musikspiel auf der Playstation. Sie müssen einem vom Lied vorgegebenen Rhythmus folgen, indem Sie bei Bedarf und im richtigen Rhythmus die richtigen Tasten drücken, wenn die Symbole oben auf dem Bildschirm erscheinen.

Localization.Title: Um Jammer Lammy
Localization.Description: Presentamos a Lammy, un guitarrista rockero que en la vida cotidiana, es bastante tímida.

Localization.Title: Um Jammer Lammy
Localization.Description: Introducing Lammy, a totally rockin' guitarist.

Localization.Title: Omega Boost
Localization.Description: AlphaCore, the world's first sentient cyber-organism, has begun to mistrust its human masters. Slowly, it begins to spread, expanding its capabilities into neighboring systems.

Localization.Title: Omega Boost
Localization.Description: Omega Boost sur Playstation est un jeu d'action qui vous place aux commandes d'un gigantesque exosquelette. Vous avez pour mission de sauver le monde d'un virus informatique qui a tout infecté.

Localization.Title: Omega Boost
Localization.Description: Omega Boost für Playstation ist ein Actionspiel, bei dem Sie die Kontrolle über ein gigantisches Exoskelett übernehmen. Ihre Mission ist es, die Welt vor einem Computervirus zu retten, der alles infiziert hat.

Localization.Title: Omega Boost
Localization.Description: Tendrás que repeler ataques que te lloverán desde todos los flancos en inmensos escenarios de batalla en 3D con OMEGA BOOST, la sobrecogedora aventura del futuro que llega de la mano de los creadores de Gran Turismo.

Localization.Title: Omega Boost
Localization.Description: AlphaCore, the world's first sentient cyber-organism, has begun to mistrust its human masters. Slowly, it begins to spread, expanding its capabilities into neighboring systems.

Localization.Title: Syphon Filter 2 (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: The sequel to the previous year's Syphon Filter, Syphon Filter 2 adds new features such as a two player mode, new locations, new weapons, and more. The game compares to Goldeneye on the N64. It's a shooter, but you must also use strategy.

Localization.Title: Syphon Filter 2 (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Gabe Logan et Lian Xing sont les deux meilleurs éléments de l'Agence. Ils sont efficaces. Intelligents. Courageux. ... mais ils en savent trop et l'Agence veut les éliminer.

Localization.Title: Syphon Filter 2 (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Siphon Filter 2, die Fortsetzung des letztjährigen Siphon Filter, bietet neue Funktionen wie einen Zwei-Spieler-Modus, neue Orte, neue Waffen und mehr. Das Spiel lässt sich mit Goldeneye auf dem N64 vergleichen.

Localization.Title: Syphon Filter 2 (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Gabe Logan y Lian Xing son los mejores agentes secretos de la Agencia. Son inteligentes, están entregados a su trabajo y se mantienen en plena forma física. Pero la Agencia opiina que saben demasiado, y hay que eliminarlos...

Localization.Title: Syphon Filter 2 (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Il sequel del Syphon Filter dell'anno precedente, Syphon Filter 2 aggiunge nuove funzionalità come una modalità a due giocatori, nuove posizioni, nuove armi e altro ancora. Il gioco è paragonabile a Goldeneye sull'N64.

Localization.Title: Syphon Filter 2 (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: The sequel to the previous year's Syphon Filter, Syphon Filter 2 adds new features such as a two player mode, new locations, new weapons, and more. The game compares to Goldeneye on the N64. It's a shooter, but you must also use strategy.

Localization.Title: SuperCross Circuit
Localization.Description: Supercross Circuit is a motorcycle racing game with both supercross and motocross tracks. In addition to the handful of fictional "local" tracks there are 9 tracks that are modeled after actual national event courses.

Localization.Title: SuperCross Circuit
Localization.Description: Supercross Circuit sur Playstation est une simulation de courses de motos. Au programme de ce soft, 9 circuits modélisés d'après certains existants, 15 pilotes professionnels différents ainsi que de nombreux modes de jeu.

Localization.Title: SuperCross Circuit
Localization.Description: Supercross Circuit auf Playstation ist eine Motorrad-Rennsimulation. Auf dem Programm dieser Software stehen 9 Strecken, die einigen bestehenden nachempfunden sind, 15 verschiedene Profipiloten sowie viele Spielmodi.

Localization.Title: SuperCross Circuit
Localization.Description: Supercross Circuit is a motorcycle racing game with both supercross and motocross tracks. In addition to the handful of fictional "local" tracks there are 9 tracks that are modeled after actual national event courses.

Localization.Title: SuperCross Circuit
Localization.Description: Supercross Circuit is a motorcycle racing game with both supercross and motocross tracks. In addition to the handful of fictional "local" tracks there are 9 tracks that are modeled after actual national event courses.

Localization.Title: SuperCross Circuit
Localization.Description: Supercross Circuit is a motorcycle racing game with both supercross and motocross tracks. In addition to the handful of fictional "local" tracks there are 9 tracks that are modeled after actual national event courses.

Localization.Title: Tomba! 2: The Evil Swine Return
Localization.Description: Explore an all new 3D world. Use your trusty fire hammer, ice boomerang or or blackjack to turn the evil pigs into bacon. Throw on super-duds like a flying squirrel suit or high speed turbo pants. There's no limit to the stuff you can do.

Localization.Title: Tomba! 2 : The Evil Swine Return
Localization.Description: Tombi! 2 est un jeu d'action et de plates-formes sur Playstation. Les cochons frappeurs ont encore décidé de frapper mais Tombi ne les laissera pas faire.

Localization.Title: Tomba! 2: The Evil Swine Return
Localization.Description: Tombi und seine Freunde Zippo sind auf der Suche nach Tombis Freundin Tabby.

Localization.Title: Tomba! 2: The Evil Swine Return
Localization.Description: Tombi regresa a nuestra PlayStation en una genial aventura donde el 3D toma mayor protagonismo que en el anterior capítulo. Esta vez sin comerlo ni beberlo se ve envuelto en la situación de que han raptado a su novia Tabby.

Localization.Title: Tomba! 2: The Evil Swine Return
Localization.Description: Tombi ha sconfitto i Maiali Cattivi e ora si rilassa, in compagnia del suo amico, lo scimmiotto Charles. Un giorno, trovandosi nel Villaggio di Tutti gli Esordi, si imbatte in alcuni Maiali Koma.

Localization.Title: Tomba! 2: The Evil Swine Return
Localization.Description: Explore um mundo 3D totalmente novo. Use seu confiável martelo de fogo, bumerangue de gelo ou blackjack para transformar os porcos malvados em bacon. Vista roupas super insucessos, como uma roupa de esquilo voador ou calças turbo de alta velocidade.

Localization.Title: Gran Turismo 2 (Arcade Mode)
Localization.Description: Gran Turismo 2 is fundamentally based on the racing game genre. The player must maneuver an automobile to compete against artificially intelligent drivers on various race tracks. The game uses two different modes: arcade and simulation.

Localization.Title: Gran Turismo 2 (Arcade Mode)
Localization.Description: Le stade ultime de la simulation de course. 600 voitures conçues par 33 des plus grands constructeurs automobile au monde... Trouvez le réglage parfait de vos véhicules. 28 circuits dont le célèbre Laguna Seca.

Localization.Title: Gran Turismo 2 (Arcade Mode)
Localization.Description: „Gran Turismo 2“ kehrt zurück mit über 500 Wagenmodellen und mehr als 20 Strecken. Das Spiel bringt realistische Fahrphysik, detaillierte Streckensimulationen und DUALSHOCK-Vibration für ein authentisches Rennerlebnis.

Localization.Title: Gran Turismo 2 (Arcade Mode)
Localization.Description: Gran Turismo 2 tiene 22 circuitos, 6 licencias, 600 coches, 6 circuitos de rendimiento y eventos de rally.

Localization.Title: Gran Turismo 2 (Arcade Mode)
Localization.Description: Gran Turismo 2 ha 22 piste, 6 licenze, 600 auto, 6 piste di performance ed eventi di rally.

Localization.Title: Gran Turismo 2 (Arcade Mode)
Localization.Description: Gran Turismo 2 é essencialmente um jogo de corrida no qual o jogador deve conduzir um automóvel e competir contra adversários controlados pela inteligência artificial em diferentes pistas. O jogo oferece dois modos distintos: Arcade e Simulação.

Localization.Title: Disney's Tarzan
Localization.Description: Disney's animated film TARZAN gets the videogame treatment and makes his way to the PlayStation. The game follows the plot of the movie: you must help Tarzan grow from a boy to an adult in the span of 14 levels of action.

Localization.Title: Disney's Tarzan
Localization.Description: Tarzan est un jeu de plates-formes sur Playstation. Enfilez votre fidèle slip en peau de bête car tarzan est de retour et c'est à vous que revient le privilège de le contrôler.

Localization.Title: Disney's Tarzan
Localization.Description: Tarzan erzählt die Geschichte eines Babys, dass im afrikanischen Dschungel von einer liebevollen Affenfamilie aufgezogen wird.

Localization.Title: Disney's Tarzan
Localization.Description: Únete a Tarzán y a sus amigos en una emocionante aventura repleta de acción.

Localization.Title: Disney's Tarzan
Localization.Description: Prendi parte con Tarzan e i suoi amici ad un'avventura emozionante e ricca di azione.

Localization.Title: Disney's Tarzan
Localization.Description: Tarzan é um jogo de plataforma para Playstation. Tarzan está de volta e cabe a você controlá-lo, você terá que atravessar muitos níveis, evitando todos os obstáculos que estão em seu caminho.

Localization.Title: Grandia (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Grandia is a Japanese-style console RPG, with big-eyed anime style characters, that was first released on the Sega Saturn in 1997. It centers around the story of a young hero named Justin who possesses a mysterious artifact known as the 'Spirit Stone'.

Localization.Title: Grandia (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Grandia est un jeu de rôle sur Playstation. Le bout du monde, frontière inaccessible qui sépare le monde de Grandia en deux parties, l'une habitée pas les humains, l'autre par une race sauvage préférant la magie à la technologie.

Localization.Title: Grandia (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Begleite Justin und seine Freunde auf einer abenteuerlichen Reise durch gewaltige Polygon-Welten von Grandia.

Localization.Title: Grandia (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Grandia está ambientado en un mundo de fantasía de emergente tecnología y exploración. Un joven chico llamado Justin hereda una piedra mágica que le lleva a tomar un viaje alrededor del mundo para descubrir el misterio que rodea una antigua civilización.

Localization.Title: Grandia (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Grandia è un gioco di ruolo su Playstation. La fine del mondo, il confine inaccessibile che separa il mondo di Grandia in due parti, una abitata dagli umani, l'altra da una razza selvaggia che preferisce la magia alla tecnologia.

Localization.Title: Grandia (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: A trama gira em torno de Justin, um apaixonado por aventuras que decide sair de sua cidade natal em uma jornada para desvendar o mistério do conhecimento herdado de uma civilização antiga.

Localization.Title: Spyro 2: Ripto's Rage! (Demo)
Localization.Description: Ripto's Rage is the second game in the Spyro the Dragon series, which started with Spyro the Dragon in 1998. The protagonist of the series, Spyro, is placed in the land of Avalar, rather than the Dragon Worlds, where the previous installment was set.

Localization.Title: Spyro 2 : Ripto's Rage! (Demo)
Localization.Description: Le pays d'Avalar est tombé sous le joug du tyrannique sorcier Ripto et de ses acolytes, Crush et Gulp. Le peuple d'Avalar a besoin d'aide et fait appel au pays des Dragons...

Localization.Title: Spyro 2: Ripto's Rage! (Demo)
Localization.Description: Der lebhafte kleine Drache ist wieder da, und zwar in einem Nachfolger, der dem Original weit überlegen ist. Spyro-Fans, aber auch solche, die das erste Spiel nicht kennen, werden von der Grandiosität von Spyro 2: Ripto's Rage begeistert sein.

Localization.Title: Spyro 2: Ripto's Rage! (Demo)
Localization.Description: Únete a Spyro y a su mejor amigo Sparx para ayudar a los habitantes de Avalar a poner fin al régimen tiránico de Ripto.

Localization.Title: Spyro 2: Ripto's Rage! (Demo)
Localization.Description: Ripto's Rage è il secondo gioco della serie Spyro the Dragon, iniziata con Spyro the Dragon nel 1998. Il protagonista della serie, Spyro, è ambientato nella terra di Avalar, anziché nei Mondi dei Draghi, dove era ambientato il capitolo precedente.

Localization.Title: Spyro 2: Ripto's Rage! (Demo)
Localization.Description: Ripto's Rage é o segundo jogo da série Spyro the Dragon, que começou com Spyro the Dragon em 1998. O protagonista da série, Spyro, é colocado na terra de Avalar, em vez dos Dragon Worlds, onde a edição anterior foi ambientada. .

Localization.Title: Spyro: Year of the Dragon
Localization.Description: Thieves have kidnapped a brood of dragon eggs, while, elsewhere in the Dragon Lands, a gateway to the Forgotten World has been uncovered.

Localization.Title: Spyro : Year of the Dragon
Localization.Description: Des voleurs ont kidnappé une couvée d'œufs de dragon. Pendant ce temps, au pays des dragons, une porte vers le Monde Oublié a été découverte.

Localization.Title: Spyro: Year of the Dragon
Localization.Description: Diebe haben ein Nest mit Dracheneiern entführt, während gleichzeitig in einem anderen Teil der Drachenwelt ein Tor zu vergessenen Welt entdeckt wurde. Spyro der Drache muss die Eier zurückerobern.

Localization.Title: Spyro: Year of the Dragon
Localization.Description: Unos ladrones han robado una nidada de huevos de dragón, mientras que en otro lugar en las Tierras del Dragón, una puerta al Mundo Olvidado ha aparecido.

Localization.Title: Spyro: Year of the Dragon
Localization.Description: I ladri hanno rapito una nidiata di uova di drago, mentre altrove nelle Terre dei Draghi è stato scoperto un portale per il Mondo Dimenticato.

Localization.Title: Spyro: Year of the Dragon
Localization.Description: Thieves have kidnapped a brood of dragon eggs, while, elsewhere in the Dragon Lands, a gateway to the Forgotten World has been uncovered.

Localization.Title: Colin McRae Rally
Localization.Description: From the makers of Touring Car Championship comes Colin McRae Rally, a rally title hoping to knock V-Rally over. Codemasters has included an collection of fifty two tracks set over five countries including Greece, United Kingdom, Sweden and Australia.

Localization.Title: Colin McRae Rally
Localization.Description: Colin McRae Rally est un jeu de courses sorti sur Playstation. Si les circuits ne sont pas votre fort et que la ville vous agace, alors vous allez adorer les circuits de rallye de ce jeu sponsorisé par le célèbre champion Colin McRae.

Localization.Title: Colin McRae Rally
Localization.Description: Rasen Sie mit halsbrecherischem Tempo durch abwechslungsreichste Landschaften, ihre Gegner sind die Zeit und Naturgewalten.

Localization.Title: Colin McRae Rally
Localization.Description: De los creadores del juego Touring Car Championship viene Colin McRae Rally, un título de rally con la esperanza de destronar a V-Rally.

Localization.Title: Colin McRae Rally
Localization.Description: Dai creatori del Touring Car Championship arriva Colin McRae Rally, un titolo di rally che spera di sconfiggere V-Rally. Codemasters ha incluso una raccolta di cinquantadue brani ambientati in cinque paesi tra cui Grecia, Regno Unito, Svezia e Australia.

Localization.Title: Colin McRae Rally
Localization.Description: Colin McRae Rally é um jogo de corridas que a Codemasters lançou na Playstation, incluiu uma coleção de cinquenta e duas pistas distribuídas por cinco países, incluindo a Grécia, Reino Unido, Suécia e Austrália.

Localization.Title: Hot Shots Golf 2
Localization.Description: Everybody's Golf 2 (GOLF2 Minna no Golf 2?) (Hot Shots Golf 2 in North America) is the second game in the Everybody's Golf series and the second game released for PlayStation.

Localization.Title: Hot Shots Golf 2
Localization.Description: Everybody's Golf 2 est un jeu de golf accessible sur Playstation. En solo, il est possible d'opter pour un tutorial puis de se lancer dans un tournoi (qui débloque des parcours) ou un mode Versus (qui débloque de nouveaux personnages).

Localization.Title: Hot Shots Golf 2
Localization.Description: Everybody's Golf 2 (GOLF2 Minna no Golf 2?) (Hot Shots Golf 2 in Nordamerika) ist das zweite Spiel der Everybody's Golf-Reihe und das zweite Spiel, das für PlayStation veröffentlicht wurde. Es wurde am 29. Juli 1999 in Japan, am 29.

Localization.Title: Hot Shots Golf 2
Localization.Description: Juego de golf, al igual que el original, hay varios personajes para elegir y muchos más para desbloquear a lo largo del juego.

Localization.Title: Hot Shots Golf 2
Localization.Description: Gioco di golf, come l'originale, ci sono diversi personaggi tra cui scegliere e molti altri da sbloccare durante il gioco.

Localization.Title: Hot Shots Golf 2
Localization.Description: Everybody's Golf 2 (GOLF2 Minna no Golf 2?) (Hot Shots Golf 2 in North America) is the second game in the Everybody's Golf series and the second game released for PlayStation.

Localization.Title: MLB 2001
Localization.Description: This baseball game is an update to MLB 2000. The game contains depictions of the real teams, stadiums, stats, and players that reflect their real life counterparts.

Localization.Title: MLB 2001
Localization.Description: MLB 2001 est un jeu de sport sur Playstation. Choisissez votre équipe de base-ball préférée et partez affronter vos adversaires. Différentes possibilités de jeu comme des tournois, championnats et matches simples vous sont offert.

Localization.Title: MLB 2001
Localization.Description: Sein Baseballspiel ist ein Update zu MLB 2000. Das Spiel enthält Darstellungen der echten Teams, Stadien, Statistiken und Spieler, die ihre realen Gegenstücke widerspiegeln.

Localization.Title: Wild Arms 2 (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: "Wild Arms 2" isn't really a sequel to Sony's original title. Your hero, a young soldier Ashley, is transformed to a demon. Ashley is determined to purge the evil from his body. He meets Brad, a criminal and a war-hero, and Lilka, a female magician.

Localization.Title: Wild Arms 2 (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Wild Arms 2 est un jeu de rôle sur Playstation qui vous met dans la peau d'Ashley, un jeune soldat qui se voit transformé en démon.

Localization.Title: Wild Arms 2 (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Wild Arms 2 ist nicht wirklich eine Fortsetzung von Sony Originaltitel. Dein Held, der junge Soldat Ashley, wird in einen Dämon verwandelt. Ashley ist entschlossen, das Böse aus seinem Körper zu reinigen.

Localization.Title: Wild Arms 2 (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Wild Arms 2, secuela de Wild Arms pero independiente de ella, es un JRPG con combate por turnos que se desarrolla en el mundo de Filgaia, en el que tres personajes que poco tienen que ver unos con otros se encuentran por manos del destino.

Localization.Title: Wild Arms 2 (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: "Wild Arms 2" non è realmente un sequel del titolo originale di Sony. Il tuo eroe, un giovane soldato Ashley, si trasforma in un demone. Ashley è determinata a eliminare il male dal suo corpo.

Localization.Title: Wild Arms 2 (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: "Wild Arms 2" isn't really a sequel to Sony's original title. Your hero, a young soldier Ashley, is transformed to a demon. Ashley is determined to purge the evil from his body. He meets Brad, a criminal and a war-hero, and Lilka, a female magician.

Localization.Title: Gran Turismo 2 (Simulation Mode)
Localization.Description: Gran Turismo 2 se baseia fundamentalmente no gênero de corrida de carros. O jogador deve dirigir um automóvel para competir contra pilotos artificialmente inteligentes em várias pistas. O jogo utiliza dois modos: Arcade e Simulação.

Localization.Title: Ape Escape (Demo)
Localization.Description: A boisterous band of baboons carry out a daring zoo escape.

Localization.Title: Ape Escape (Demo)
Localization.Description: Ape Escape est un jeu de plates-formes sorti sur Playstation. Spike est un jeune garçon espiègle qui se retrouve projeté dans le passé à cause du grand singe Specter. Vous devrez retrouver tous les singes disparus dans le passé et les attraper.

Localization.Title: Ape Escape (Demo)
Localization.Description: Ein superintelligenter Affe klaut eine Zeitmaschine, um seine dümmlichen Artgenossen auf die Menschheitshistorie loszulassen und den Lauf der Geschichte zu verändern.

Localization.Title: Ape Escape (Demo)
Localization.Description: Specter, una atracción popular en el parque de atracciones, se ha transformado en un mono inteligente.

Localization.Title: Ape Escape (Demo)
Localization.Description: Ape Escape è un gioco platform pubblicato su Playstation. Spike è un ragazzino dispettoso che si ritrova catapultato nel passato dalla grande scimmia Spectre. Dovrai trovare tutte le scimmie scomparse nel passato e catturarle.

Localization.Title: Ape Escape (Demo)
Localization.Description: Specter, uma atração popular no parque de diversões, tornou-se um macaco inteligente.

Localization.Title: The Legend of Dragoon (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Ten thousand years ago, the Divine Tree brought forth all living races. Among them were the powerful Dragons, the resilient humans, and the magical Winglies.

Localization.Title: The Legend of Dragoon (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: The Legend of Dragoon est un jeu de rôle sur Playstation. Incarnez Dart, un jeune héros valeureux.

Localization.Title: The Legend of Dragoon (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Vier Jahre sind vergangen seit Dart seine Heimat verließ und sich auf die Suche nach dem Schwarzen Monster machte, das seine Eltern und seinen Geburtsort Neet vernichtet hat.

Localization.Title: The Legend of Dragoon (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Dart, un guerrero valiente y leal, ha jurado vengar la muerte de sus padres a manos de un misterioso monstruo negro. Para motivos desconocidos, el Imperio de Sandora quema su pueblo y encarcela a su amiga de la infancia, Shana.

Localization.Title: The Legend of Dragoon (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Sono passati quattro anni da quando Dart ha lasciato la sua casa ed è andato alla ricerca del mostro nero che ha distrutto i suoi genitori e il suo luogo di nascita Neet.

Localization.Title: The Legend of Dragoon (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: O jogo conta a história de Dart, um jovem guerreiro que busca vingança contra o "Black Monster" que destruiu sua vila e matou seus pais.

Localization.Title: Syphon Filter 2 (Disc 2)
Localization.Description: The sequel to the previous year's Syphon Filter, Syphon Filter 2 adds new features such as a two player mode, new locations, new weapons, and more. The game compares to Goldeneye on the N64. It's a shooter, but you must also use strategy.

Localization.Title: Crash Bash

Localization.Title: Crash Bash
Localization.Description: Die Mächte des Guten und des Bösen kämpfen wieder einamal um die Vorherrschaft.

Localization.Title: Crash Bash

Localization.Title: The Legend of Dragoon (Disc 2)
Localization.Description: Ten thousand years ago, the Divine Tree brought forth all living races. Among them were the powerful Dragons, the resilient humans, and the magical Winglies.

Localization.Title: The Legend of Dragoon (Disc 2)
Localization.Description: The Legend of Dragoon est un jeu de rôle sur Playstation. Incarnez Dart, un jeune héros valeureux.

Localization.Title: The Legend of Dragoon (Disc 2)
Localization.Description: Vier Jahre sind vergangen seit Dart seine Heimat verließ und sich auf die Suche nach dem Schwarzen Monster machte, das seine Eltern und seinen Geburtsort Neet vernichtet hat.

Localization.Title: The Legend of Dragoon (Disc 2)
Localization.Description: Dart, un guerrero valiente y leal, ha jurado vengar la muerte de sus padres a manos de un misterioso monstruo negro. Para motivos desconocidos, el Imperio de Sandora quema su pueblo y encarcela a su amiga de la infancia, Shana.

Localization.Title: The Legend of Dragoon (Disc 2)
Localization.Description: Sono passati quattro anni da quando Dart ha lasciato la sua casa ed è andato alla ricerca del mostro nero che ha distrutto i suoi genitori e il suo luogo di nascita Neet.

Localization.Title: The Legend of Dragoon (Disc 2)
Localization.Description: O jogo conta a história de Dart, um jovem guerreiro que busca vingança contra o "Black Monster" que destruiu sua vila e matou seus pais.
