Localization.Title: Terry Pratchett's Discworld
Localization.Description: This game is based on the Discworld novel series created by Terry Pratchett. You play Rincewind, a wizard with of little courage or talent in the occult. A dragon is ravaging Ankh-Morpork, the city Rincewind the wizard lives in.

Localization.Title: Galaxy Fight
Localization.Description: A number of legends exist throughout the planets of our galaxy that say the Divine Being appears once every millennium. The time is upon us now, and many have converged on the Denius system to greet the Divine Being.

Localization.Title: Galaxy Fight
Localization.Description: Sur toutes les planètes de notre galaxie, il existe un certain nombre de légendes selon lesquelles l'Être divin apparaît une fois par millénaire.

Localization.Title: Galaxy Fight
Localization.Description: Auf den Planeten unserer Galaxie gibt es eine Reihe von Legenden, die besagen, dass das göttliche Wesen alle Jahrtausende erscheint. Die Zeit ist jetzt gekommen und viele haben sich dem Denius-System angeschlossen, um das göttliche Wesen zu begrüßen.

Localization.Title: Galaxy Fight
Localization.Description: Existen varias leyendas en los planetas de nuestra galaxia que dicen que el Ser Divino aparece una vez cada milenio. Ha llegado el momento y muchos se han reunido en el sistema Denius para saludar al Ser Divino.

Localization.Title: Galaxy Fight
Localization.Description: Esistono numerose leggende in tutti i pianeti della nostra galassia secondo cui l'Essere Divino appare una volta ogni millennio. Il momento è ormai alle porte e molti sono confluiti sul sistema Denius per salutare l'Essere Divino.

Localization.Title: Resident Evil
Localization.Description: After receiving a distress call from the Bravo Team, an elite group from S.T.A.R.S (Special Tactics And Rescue Squad) flew into the desolate Raccoon City.

Localization.Title: Resident Evil
Localization.Description: Maîtrisez votre peur... et lancez vous dans l'expérience la plus terrifiante de votre vie. Zombies assoiffés de sang. Animaux mutants. Serpents monstrueux. De dangereux mystères vous menacent à chaque tournant.

Localization.Title: Resident Evil
Localization.Description: Umbrella Corporation, ein geheimnisumwobener Pharmakonzern in der Nähe der Kleinstadt Raccoon City.

Localization.Title: Resident Evil
Localization.Description: Enfréntate a tus miedos... En la experiencia de suspense y terror definitiva. Zombies sedientos de sangre. Bestias mutantes. Serpientes monstruosas. Misterios ocultos acechan en cada esquina. La pesadilla reside en este premiado juego de survival horror.

Localization.Title: Resident Evil
Localization.Description: Dopo aver ricevuto una chiamata di soccorso dal Bravo Team, un gruppo d'élite di S.T.A.R.S (Special Tactics And Rescue Squad) è volato nella desolata Raccoon City.

Localization.Title: Resident Evil
Localization.Description: Resident Evil: Director's Cut é um horror de sobrevivência no Playstation. Esta é uma versão sem censura do Resident Evil 1. Comparado com o último, o aplicativo é diferenciado por novas cenas, novos ângulos de visão, cenas adicionais e novos trajes.

Localization.Title: Pitball
Localization.Description: Set in the 23rd century, Pitball is the only sport left in existence. There are no rules in this violent battle -- your objective is simply to score as many goals as possible while destroying the other team.

Localization.Description: Conrad may have thought he escaped from the alien Morphs, but he thought wrong. After fighting his way through their world the first time, in a game called Flashback, he went into a cryogenic sleep aboard his little space vessel.

Localization.Description: Das Jahr 2190. Das Sonnensystem ist in den Fängen einer außerirdischen Rasse, die nicht aufzuhalten ist: Morphs. Ohne feste Oberfläche sind sie in der Lage, jede beliebige Form zu imitieren.

Localization.Title: Fade to Black
Localization.Description: Esta es la secuela de Flashback. Tomas el control de Conrad, que ha sido encarcelado por su antiguo enemigo, los Morphs.

Localization.Title: Alien Trilogy

Localization.Title: Alien Trilogy
Localization.Description: Acosada por los recuerdos, esperas que ha algún pequeño detalle que ha pasado inadvertido... algunos problemas de comunicación de poca importancia, pero la verdad es que, en el fondo, sabes que ... ¡HAN VUELTO!...

Localization.Title: Firo & Klawd
Localization.Description: Firo And Klawd sur Playstation se déroule dans la ville de New York. Vous incarnez Firo le singe et Klawd le chat, tous deux policiers, qui s'entendent comme chien et chat.

Localization.Title: Firo & Klawd
Localization.Description: Lernen Sie Klawd kennen, einen straßengewandten, gut sprechenden Gassenkater, der schnell auf den Pfoten ist. In den letzten sechs Monaten bestand sein Alltag darin, Pakete für einen Dollar auszuliefern, ohne zu wissen, was sie enthielten.

Localization.Title: Firo & Klawd
Localization.Description: Firo, un orangután policía desencantado y con gatillo fácil, y Klawd, un gato callejero ingenioso y desempleado, se ven obligados a colaborar para salvar sus propios pellejos peludos. ¡Es hora de cobrar venganza!

Localization.Title: Firo & Klawd
Localization.Description: Incontra Klawd, un gatto randagio parlante e saggio che è veloce sulle sue zampe. La sua routine quotidiana negli ultimi sei mesi consisteva nel consegnare pacchi per un dollaro senza alcuna conoscenza di ciò che contenevano.

Localization.Title: Firo & Klawd
Localization.Description: Meet Klawd, a street-wise, smooth talking alley cat that's quick on his paws. His day to day routine for the last six months consisted of delivering packages for a dollar without any knowledge of what they contained.

Localization.Title: Alien Trilogy (Demo)
Localization.Description: Alien Trilogy ist ein Ego-Shooter, der auf den ersten drei Teilen der Alien-Filmreihe basiert. Das Spiel erschien 1996 im Vertrieb von Acclaim Entertainment für Sony PlayStation, Sega Saturn und etwas später auch für DOS-PCs.

Localization.Title: Alien Trilogy (Demo)
Localization.Description: Acosada por los recuerdos, esperas que ha algún pequeño detalle que ha pasado inadvertido... algunos problemas de comunicación de poca importancia, pero la verdad es que, en el fondo, sabes que ... ¡HAN VUELTO!...

Localization.Title: Alien Trilogy (Demo)

Localization.Title: Alien Trilogy (Demo)
Localization.Description: Assombrado por memórias, você espera que haja apenas uma pequena supervisão... um simples problema de comunicação, mas você sabe, no fundo, no fundo de sua mente.... ELES ESTÃO DE VOLTA!!!!.....

Localization.Title: Dragon Ball Z: Ultimate Battle 22

Localization.Description: Dragon Ball Z Ultimate Battle 22 sur Playstation est un jeu de combat basé sur la célèbre franchise. Découvrez un univers mêlant 2D et 3D et regroupant 22 combattants, d'où le titre.

Localization.Title: Dragon Ball Z: Ultimate Battle 22
Localization.Description: Dragon Ball Z: Ultimate Battle 22 ist ein Videospiel, das auf dem fiktiven Manga Dragon Ball Z basiert. Es wird von den Fans als "Ultimate Battle 22" oder "UB22" bezeichnet, da es 22 spielbare Charaktere aus der Serie enthält.

Localization.Title: Dragon Ball Z: Ultimate Battle 22

Localization.Title: Dragon Ball Z: Ultimate Battle 22

Localization.Title: Dragon Ball Z: Ultimate Battle 22
Localization.Description: O game possui esse nome por causa dos 22 personagens jogáveis. Contudo, 5 personagens adicionais podem ser desbloqueados, o que faz com que a tela mude e o jogo seja renomeado para "Ultimate Battle 27".

Localization.Title: Crypt Killer
Localization.Description: Crypt Killer is a horror-themed lightgun shooter. As a tireless adventurer, you are looking for the "Eyes of Guidance", ancient crystals of mysterious power. To find them, you have to shoot your way through hordes of monsters.

Localization.Title: Crypt Killer

Localization.Title: Street Racer

Localization.Description: WipEout XL is set in the year 2097, around four decades after its predecessor. Instead of the F3600 anti-gravity racing competition, the game features an even faster and more dangerous tournament: the F5000 AG league.

Localization.Title: Wipeout 2097
Localization.Description: WipEout 2097 sur Playstation installe le joueur aux commandes de vaisseaux de courses ultra-rapides le long de circuits complètement déjantés où la première place ne s'obtient qu'à coups de missiles et autres armes destructrices.

Localization.Title: Wipeout 2097
Localization.Description: Ein Anti-Gravitation-Rennen, das der Konkurrenz um Lichtjahre voraus ist! Der Vorgänger hat die Spielwelt in Brand gesteckt und wurde sofort zu einem Klassiker. Jetzt kommt eine brutale neue Generation von Anti-Schwerkraft-Rennen.

Localization.Title: Wipeout 2097
Localization.Description: Wipeout es un juego de carreras futurista que transcurre cuarenta años después de su predecesor. Entra en la liga F5000 AG, más rápida, competitiva y peligrosa que nunca.

Localization.Title: Wipeout 2097
Localization.Description: WipEout 2097 per Playstation mette il giocatore ai comandi di navi da corsa ultraveloci lungo circuiti completamente folli dove il primo posto si ottiene solo con missili e altre armi distruttive.

Localization.Title: Wipeout 2097
Localization.Description: WipEout 2097 em Playstation coloca o jogador aos comandos de navios de corrida ultra-rápidos ao longo de circuitos loucos onde o primeiro lugar só é alcançado por mísseis e outras armas destrutivas.

Localization.Title: Fade to Black
Localization.Description: Conrad may have thought he escaped from the alien Morphs, but he thought wrong. After fighting his way through their world the first time, in a game called Flashback, he went into a cryogenic sleep aboard his little space vessel.

Localization.Title: Fade to Black

Localization.Title: Fade to Black
Localization.Description: Das Jahr 2190. Das Sonnensystem ist in den Fängen einer außerirdischen Rasse, die nicht aufzuhalten ist: Morphs. Ohne feste Oberfläche sind sie in der Lage, jede beliebige Form zu imitieren.

Localization.Title: Fade to Black
Localization.Description: Esta es la secuela de Flashback. Tomas el control de Conrad, que ha sido encarcelado por su antiguo enemigo, los Morphs.

Localization.Title: MechWarrior 2: 31st Century Combat: Arcade Combat Edition

Localization.Title: TOCA Touring Car Championship

Localization.Description: Tetris Plus is a puzzle video game developed by Natsume and published by Jaleco for arcades exclusively in Japan in 1996, and was ported to the Game Boy, Sega Saturn, and PlayStation later that year.

Localization.Title: Tetris Plus
Localization.Description: Tetris Plus is a puzzle video game developed by Natsume and published by Jaleco for arcades exclusively in Japan in 1996, and was ported to the Game Boy, Sega Saturn, and PlayStation later that year.

Localization.Title: Invasion
Localization.Description: The game begins in 17-October-2093 when an alien army (the Keseits) enter the solar system and in a brief battle they defeated the Earth armies.

Localization.Title: Invasion
Localization.Description: Le jeu commence le 17-octobre-2093 lorsqu'une armée extraterrestre (les Keseits) entre dans le système solaire et dans une brève bataille, ils ont vaincu les armées de la Terre.

Localization.Title: Invasion
Localization.Description: Das Spiel beginnt am 17. Oktober 2093, als eine außerirdische Armee (die Keseits) in das Sonnensystem eindringt und in einer kurzen Schlacht die Erdarmeen besiegt.

Localization.Title: Invasion
Localization.Description: El juego comienza el 17 de octubre de 2093 cuando un ejército alienígena (los Keseits) entran en el sistema solar y en una breve batalla derrotan a los ejércitos de la Tierra.

Localization.Description: Die Hard Trilogy is split into three games, each game representing one of the movies, obviously. Die Hard 1 is a third person shooter in a style similar to Tomb Raider.

Localization.Title: Die Hard Trilogy
Localization.Description: Die Hard Trilogy sur Playstation est un jeu d'action divisé en trois parties distinctes, une pour chacun des premiers films de la série Die Hard.

Localization.Title: Die Hard Trilogy
Localization.Description: Die Hard Trilogy teilt sich in drei Abschnitte, in denen Ihr die drei ersten "Stirb langsam"-Filme nachspielt. Durch die Stockwerke des Wolkenkratzers aus Teil 1 ballert Ihr Euch in Third-Person-Shooter-Manier.

Localization.Title: Die Hard Trilogy
Localization.Description: Die Hard Trilogy se divide en tres juegos, cada juego que representa una de las películas, obviamente. Die Hard 1 es un shooter en tercera persona con un estilo similar al de Tomb Raider.

Localization.Title: Killing Zone
Localization.Description: In a mythical realm, in some unheard of dimension, all of the world's greatest monsters and mythological creatures have gathered to battle it out through this one-on-one 3D fighting game.

Localization.Title: Killing Zone
Localization.Description: Killing Zone sur playstation est un jeu de combat. Il met en scène un tournoi à mort entre les champions de sept créatures différentes emblématiques des films d'horreur.

Localization.Title: Killing Zone
Localization.Description: In einem mythischen Reich, in einer noch nie dagewesenen Dimension, haben sich alle größten Monster und mythologischen Kreaturen der Welt versammelt, um in diesem Eins-gegen-Eins-3D-Kampfspiel gegeneinander anzutreten.

Localization.Title: Killing Zone
Localization.Description: Killing Zone para playstation es un juego de lucha. Se trata de un torneo a muerte entre los campeones de siete criaturas emblemáticas diferentes de películas de terror.

Localization.Title: NFL Quarterback Club '97
Localization.Description: NFL Quarterback Club '97 from Acclaim makes a splash on the PlayStation console. Everything you'd expect from a football title can be found in NFL Quarterback Club '97. You have all the standard gameplay options: exhibition, season, quick play.

Localization.Title: NFL Quarterback Club '97
Localization.Description: NFL Quarterback Club 97 est une simulation de football américain sur Playstation. Cette mouture apporte son lot d'innovations comme la T-meter. Le jeu propose également de nouvelles tactiques de jeu misent au point par le célèbre Brett Favre.

Localization.Title: NFL Quarterback Club '97
Localization.Description: NFL Quarterback Club '97 von Acclaim sorgt auf der PlayStation-Konsole für Furore. Alles, was Sie von einem Football-Titel erwarten, finden Sie im NFL Quarterback Club '97. Sie haben alle Standardspieloptionen: Ausstellung, Saison, Schnellspiel.

Localization.Title: Lomax
Localization.Description: Lomax's friends are in trouble, and it's up to you to save them from the sinister villain, Evil Ed. Using a magical spell, the fiend has kidnapped them and is forcing them to do whatever he instructs.

Localization.Title: Lomax
Localization.Description: Lomax est un jeu de plates-formes sur Playstation qui a la particularité d'opter pour une jouabilité 2D dans des décors en 3D, l'action se déroulant sur plusieurs plans.

Localization.Title: Lomax
Localization.Description: Lomax ist ein Plattformspiel für die Playstation, das die Besonderheit hat, sich für ein 2D-Gameplay in 3D-Umgebungen zu entscheiden, wobei die Action auf mehreren Ebenen stattfindet.

Localization.Title: Lomax
Localization.Description: Lomax es un juego de plataformas para Playstation que tiene la distinción de ser un juego en 2D con fondos en 3D, la acción que tiene lugar en varios niveles. Controlas un Lemmings, último sobreviviente contra el terrible Evil Ed que tienes que vencer.

Localization.Title: Lomax
Localization.Description: Gli amici di Lomax sono nei guai e tocca a te salvarli dal sinistro cattivo, Evil Ed. Usando un incantesimo magico, il demone li ha rapiti e li sta costringendo a fare tutto ciò che istruisce.

Localization.Title: Lomax
Localization.Description: As Aventuras de Lomax(conhecido na Europa simplesmente por Lomax) é um spin-off da série de vídeo game Lemmings. O jogador controla Lomax, um lemming que tem por objetivo salvar seus amigos e os animais do doutor malvado.

Localization.Title: Robo Pit
Localization.Description: The year is 2042 AD and all forms of physical violence against organic lifeforms have been outlawed. For entertainment the Robo Pit battles have been created. Large corporations can acquire prestige and profit by developing successful robots and weapons.

Localization.Title: Robo Pit
Localization.Description: Robo Pit est un jeu d'acton sur Playstation. Vous construisez votre robot et devez combattre d'autres machines armées jusqu'aux dents dans des matches à mort. Les combats sont scénarisés et s'inscrivent dans une aventure construite.

Localization.Title: Robo Pit
Localization.Description: Wir schreiben das Jahr 2042 n. Chr. und alle Formen körperlicher Gewalt gegen organische Lebensformen sind verboten. Zur Unterhaltung wurden die Robo-Pit-Kämpfe erstellt.

Localization.Description: The villainous Zaurer has usurped control of the floating lands and at his behest, vile creatures have overrun the seven worlds, terrorizing the inhabitants and generally running amok.

Localization.Title: Floating Runner
Localization.Description: Floating Runner: Quest for the 7 Crystals est l'un des premiers jeux d'action pour plates-formes conçu pour la PlayStation. Le jeu consiste à lancer des orbes colorés sur les ennemis, pour gagner des gemmes, et à trouver des coffres.

Localization.Title: Floating Runner
Localization.Description: Der bösartige Zaurer hat die Kontrolle über die schwebenden Länder an sich gerissen und auf seinen Befehl hin haben abscheuliche Kreaturen die sieben Welten überrannt, die Bewohner terrorisiert und im Allgemeinen Amok gelaufen.

Localization.Title: X2: No Relief
Localization.Description: X2 is the sequel only released on Playstation of one of the best shooters on Commodore Amiga: Project-X. Project-X is a scrolling shooter game for the Amiga computer released in 1992. It was also ported to DOS.

Localization.Title: X2 : No Relief
Localization.Description: X2 sur Playstation est un jeu de tir avec défilement horizontal, parfois vertical. Le soft ne comporte aucun scénario, le but est de détruire un maximum d'aliens avant qu'ils ne vous écrasent.

Localization.Title: X2: No Relief
Localization.Description: X2 für die PlayStation ist ein Shooter mit horizontalem – und gelegentlich vertikalem – Scrolling. Das Spiel besitzt keine Handlung; das Ziel ist es, so viele Außerirdische wie möglich zu vernichten, bevor sie einen selbst zerstören.

Localization.Title: X2: No Relief
Localization.Description: X2: No Relief es la secuela de Project-X para hasta dos jugadores. Al igual que su predecesor de 'Amiga', es un Shoot'em Up horizontal (y, a veces vertical).

Localization.Title: X2: No Relief
Localization.Description: X2 is the sequel only released on Playstation of one of the best shooters on Commodore Amiga: Project-X. Project-X is a scrolling shooter game for the Amiga computer released in 1992. It was also ported to DOS.

Localization.Title: Apocalypse
Localization.Description: Doomsday is steadily approaching the planet Earth; it is a time of war and hatred, a time where madmen rule the streets. The madman in this case is the Reverend and his Four Horsemen: Death, Plague, War, and the Beast.

Localization.Title: Apocalypse
Localization.Description: Dans ce jeu d'action vous incarnez le rôle de Trey Kincaid, un nano-physicien joué par la star d'action hollywoodienne Bruce Willis.

Localization.Title: Apocalypse
Localization.Description: Apocalypse spielt in einer düsteren Zukunft, in der ein selbsternannter Prophet gestohlene Nanotechnologie dazu missbraucht, die vier apokalyptischen Reiter heraufzubeschwören. Das Ende der Welt ist nah.

Localization.Title: Apocalypse
Localization.Description: El final del mundo es inminente. Interpreta a Bruce Willis en el papel de Trey Kincaid, un físico que está sólo para defender el mundo entero. Tu misión consiste en derrotar a los cuatro jinetes antes de que la humanidad desaparezca.

Localization.Title: Apocalypse

Localization.Title: Apocalypse
Localization.Description: O Dia do Juízo Final está se aproximando constantemente do planeta Terra; é uma época de guerra e ódio, uma época em que os loucos dominam as ruas. O louco neste caso é o Reverendo e seus Quatro Cavaleiros: Morte, Peste, Guerra e a Besta.

Localization.Title: Heart of Darkness (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: The eternally delayed Heart of Darkness has finally made its way to the PlayStation gaming console! One day, as Andy was in the park with his dog Whiskey, strange things started to happen.

Localization.Title: Heart of Darkness (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Heart of Darkness est un jeu de plates-formes sur Playstation. Dans un univers ténébreux et terrifiant le jeune Andy est venu délivrer son chien Whisky qui est retenu prisonnier par le méchant Maître qui règne sur les Ténèbres.

Localization.Title: Heart of Darkness (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Der junge Andy ist ein typischer Junge, er hasst die Schule, hat sein eigenes Baumhaus und will am liebsten seine Freizeit mit seinem Hund Whisky verbringen.

Localization.Title: Heart of Darkness (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: En el corazón de las Tinieblas se esconde un mundo aterrador. En él reina el Señor del Mal con un poder y una crueldad sin límites.

Localization.Title: Heart of Darkness (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: L'eternamente ritardato Heart of Darkness è finalmente arrivato sulla console di gioco PlayStation! Un giorno, mentre Andy era nel parco con il suo cane Whisky, iniziarono a succedere cose strane.

Localization.Title: Moto Racer
Localization.Description: An arcade motorcycle racer in which both superbike and motocross events are available.

Localization.Title: Moto Racer
Localization.Description: Moto Racer sur Playstation est un jeu de courses pour tous les fans de deux-roues. Diverses disciplines sont représentées : Superbike, Traffic, Trial, Supercross, Motocross et Freestyle.

Localization.Title: Moto Racer
Localization.Description: Ein ultraschnelles Motorrad-Spektakel mit einer opulenten Streckenauswahl, kraftvollen Straßenmaschinen und robusten Cross-Rädern. Vor dem Rennen sollten einige Übungsrunden gefahren werden, um die PS-Monster zu beherrschen.

Localization.Title: Moto Racer
Localization.Description: Un juego arcade de carreras de motos, en el cual tanto motocross como superbikes están disponibles.

Localization.Title: Moto Racer
Localization.Description: Un motociclista arcade in cui sono disponibili eventi sia di superbike che di motocross.

Localization.Title: Moto Racer
Localization.Description: An arcade motorcycle racer in which both superbike and motocross events are available.

Localization.Title: SimCity 2000
Localization.Description: SimCity 2000 is the successor to the ground breaking city simulation game Sim City. You are once again the mayor, but this time you can fully customize the terrain before building your city.

Localization.Title: SimCity 2000
Localization.Description: SimCity 2000 est la suite sur Playstation de SimCity sorti en 1989. Comme dans le précédent opus, vous incarnez le maire d'une ville que vous devez construire et gérer.

Localization.Title: SimCity 2000
Localization.Description: SimCity 2000 ist hauptsächlich ein 'Aufbau'-Spiel, in dem die Herausforderung darin besteht, Städte zu erschaffen und wachsen zu lassen. Natürlich gibt es auch Gelegenheiten, Dinge zu zerstören, von Bulldozern über Erdbeben bis hin zu Flugzeugabstürzen.

Localization.Title: SimCity 2000
Localization.Description: SimCity 2000 es el sucesor del juego de simulación de ciudad Sim City. Usted es una vez más el alcalde, pero esta vez puede personalizar completamente el terreno antes de construir su ciudad.

Localization.Title: SimCity 2000
Localization.Description: SimCity 2000 is the successor to the ground breaking city simulation game Sim City. You are once again the mayor, but this time you can fully customize the terrain before building your city.

Localization.Title: SimCity 2000
Localization.Description: SimCity 2000 é a sequela do SimCity's Playstation lançado em 1989. Como na obra anterior, encarna-se o presidente da câmara de uma cidade que se tem de construir e gerir.

Localization.Title: Riot
Localization.Description: A combination of ice hockey, basketball, and bare-knuckle fighting, Professional Underground League of Pain is a futuristic sports game with few rules and loads of violence.

Localization.Title: Riot
Localization.Description: Riot est un jeu de sport futuriste. Le cadre est une pièce semblable à un terrain de basket, mais le panier est au centre. Le but est de tirer une balle énergétique chargée dans le panier.

Localization.Title: Riot
Localization.Description: Riot ist ein futuristisches Sportspiel. Der Rahmen ähnelt einem Basketballfeld, der Korb befindet sich jedoch in der Mitte. Ziel ist es, einen geladenen Energieball in den Korb zu schießen.

Localization.Title: Riot
Localization.Description: Riot es un juego de deportes futurista. El escenario es una sala similar a un campo de baloncesto, pero la canasta está en el centro. El objetivo es lanzar una bola de energía cargada en la canasta.

Localization.Title: Riot
Localization.Description: A combination of ice hockey, basketball, and bare-knuckle fighting, Professional Underground League of Pain is a futuristic sports game with few rules and loads of violence.

Localization.Title: Riot

Localization.Title: Agent Armstrong
Localization.Description: Agent Armstrong is a 3D side-scrolling single-player-shooter released in the early days of the PSX. Set in 1930, Armstrong must battle across 4 continents and deep underwater as the Syndicate attempt to control the world.

Localization.Title: Agent Armstrong
Localization.Description: Agent Armstrong sur Playstation est un jeu de plates-formes/action. Vous incarnez ici le brave agent Armstrong qui luttera grâce à son panel d'armes à travers 30 niveaux contre un syndicat qui veut conquérir le monde.

Localization.Title: Agent Armstrong
Localization.Description: Bereiten sie sich auf ein Showdown der Superlative zwischen Spatrs Falconetti und Agent Armstrong vor. Dieses 3D-Action Adventure mit über 30 Missionen, einem gigantischen Waffenarsenal und einem kinoreifen Soundtrack, wird das Abenteuers Ihres Lebens.

Localization.Title: Agent Armstrong

Localization.Description: Dopo un'impressionante uscita con FIFA Soccer, EA torna in questa stagione con la sua linea calcistica continua, FIFA Soccer 97. Tutto è stato rifatto per garantire ai giocatori il massimo dal loro investimento.

Localization.Title: FIFA 97
Localization.Description: After an impressive outing with FIFA Soccer, EA is back this season with their continuous soccer lineup, FIFA Soccer 97. Everything has been redone to make sure that gamers get the most for their money.

Localization.Title: FIFA 97
Localization.Description: FIFA 97 est un jeu de football sur Playstation. Cette version amène une animation plus poussée, basée sur la façon de bouger de David Ginola. Il est possible de choisir un mode Arcade ou Simulation et de jouer à six contre six en intérieur.

Localization.Title: FIFA 97
Localization.Description: FIFA 97 ist ein Videospiel, das von EA Canada entwickelt und von Electronic Arts basierend auf dem Fußballspiel veröffentlicht wurde. 4 Spielarten, Passwort-Möglichkeit, verbesserte Grafik und detaillierte Spieler-, Mannschafts- und Spielstatistiken.

Localization.Title: Soviet Strike
Localization.Description: In 1991, the U.S.S.R. (Union of Soviet Socialist Republics) boasting the largest military force in history, suddenly and unexpectedly collapsed. Since that time the fallen empire has lain lifeless -- a rich corpse waiting to be picked clean.

Localization.Title: Soviet Strike
Localization.Description: En 1991, l'U.R.S.S., qui revendiquait alors avoir les plus puissantes troupes armées au monde, s'écroule subitement.

Localization.Title: Soviet Strike
Localization.Description: Schauplatz sind die ehemaligen Ostblock-Staaten. Ein Ex-KGB-Mann nutzt die Führungsschwäche Russlands skrupellos aus, baut sich hinter den Kulissen eine schlagkräftige Söldnertruppe auf und versucht nun mit allen Mitteln die Macht an sich zu reißen.

Localization.Title: Soviet Strike
Localization.Description: Tras la caida de la URRS en 1991 debes embarcarde un poderoso helicóptero Apache para repeler las facciones terroristas y los sectores reaccionarios afines al antiguo régimen sovietico.

Localization.Title: International Superstar Soccer Deluxe
Localization.Description: This is the sequel to International Superstar Soccer, Konami's saga of soccer games. This Deluxe version was published first to the SNES, then the Mega Drive and Playstation. ISS Deluxe has realistic animations and player sprites.

Localization.Title: International Superstar Soccer Deluxe
Localization.Description: International Superstar Soccer Deluxe est la version revue de International Superstar Soccer sur Playstation. Outre l'amélioration des menus et des animations, trente-six équipes nationales sont désormais jouables.

Localization.Title: International Superstar Soccer Deluxe
Localization.Description: Dies ist die Fortsetzung von International Superstar Soccer, Konamis Saga von Fußballspielen. Diese Deluxe-Version wurde zuerst für das SNES, dann für Mega Drive und Playstation veröffentlicht. ISS Deluxe hat realistische Animationen und Spieler-Sprites.

Localization.Title: International Superstar Soccer Deluxe
Localization.Description: Esta es la secuela de International Superstar Soccer, la saga de juegos de fútbol de Konami. Esta versión Deluxe se publicó primero para SNES, luego para Mega Drive y PlayStation. ISS Deluxe cuenta con animaciones realistas y sprites de jugadores.

Localization.Title: International Superstar Soccer Deluxe
Localization.Description: This is the sequel to International Superstar Soccer, Konami's saga of soccer games. This Deluxe version was published first to the SNES, then the Mega Drive and Playstation. ISS Deluxe has realistic animations and player sprites.

Localization.Description: This is the sequel to International Superstar Soccer, Konami's saga of soccer games. This Deluxe version was published first to the SNES, then the Mega Drive and Playstation. ISS Deluxe has realistic animations and player sprites.

Localization.Title: NHL 98
Localization.Description: Grâce à NHL 98 sur Playstation, les fans de hockey peuvent vivre l'intégral de la saison 1998 du championnat en compagnie de toutes les équipes et de tous les joueurs. Plusieurs niveaux de difficulté et modes de jeu sont proposés.

Localization.Title: NHL 98
Localization.Description: Mit NHL 98 auf der Playstation können Eishockeyfans die gesamte Meisterschaftssaison 1998 mit allen Teams und allen Spielern erleben. Es werden mehrere Schwierigkeitsgrade und Spielmodi angeboten.

Localization.Title: NBA Live 97
Localization.Description: With a solid reputation preceding it, the NBA Live series is one of the most respected in the video game industry. After a solid showing on the Super NES and Genesis, EA Sports took to the latest hardware, the Sony Playstation.

Localization.Title: NBA Live 97
Localization.Description: Voici venue l'édition 97 du championnat nord-américain de basket-ball avec NBA Live 97 sur Playstation. Comme dans les versions précédentes, vous pouvez jouer avec les 29 équipes officielles du championnat professionnel et effectuer une saison complète.

Localization.Title: NBA Live 97
Localization.Description: Mit einem guten Ruf ist die NBA Live-Serie eine der angesehensten in der Videospielbranche. Nach einem soliden Auftritt auf dem Super NES und Genesis wechselte EA Sports zur neuesten Hardware, der Sony Playstation.

Localization.Title: NBA Live 97
Localization.Description: NBA Live 97 es el tercer lanzamiento de la serie de videojuegos NBA Live. La portada muestra a Mitch Richmond de los Sacramento Kings. El juego fue desarrollado por EA Sports y lanzado en Noviembre de 1996.

Localization.Title: NBA Live 97
Localization.Description: With a solid reputation preceding it, the NBA Live series is one of the most respected in the video game industry. After a solid showing on the Super NES and Genesis, EA Sports took to the latest hardware, the Sony Playstation.

Localization.Title: NBA Live 97
Localization.Description: With a solid reputation preceding it, the NBA Live series is one of the most respected in the video game industry. After a solid showing on the Super NES and Genesis, EA Sports took to the latest hardware, the Sony Playstation.

Localization.Title: The Raven Project (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Sci-fi shooter with gameplay similar to the Rebel Assault series. Divided into missions, you get to play in ship-to-ship combat, mechanised warrior battles, surface-planetary warfare and tail-gunning, according to the developers.

Localization.Title: The Raven Project (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Disponible sur Playstation, The Raven Project est un jeu d'action futuriste dans lequel vous serez amené à piloter différents véhicules de combat, du simple vaisseau spatial au mécha robotisé.

Localization.Title: The Raven Project (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: The Raven Project ist auf der Playstation erhältlich und ein futuristisches Actionspiel, in dem Sie verschiedene Kampffahrzeuge steuern müssen, von einfachen Raumschiffen bis hin zu Roboter-Mechs.

Localization.Title: Blood Omen: Legacy of Kain
Localization.Description: Blood Omen is a top-down game where the player controls the vampiric Kain. As a vampire, Kain is able to withstand sunlight, but is harmed by water.

Localization.Title: Blood Omen : Legacy of Kain
Localization.Description: Blood Omen : Legacy of Kain est un jeu de rôle et d'action sur Playstation. Vous y incarnez Kain, fraîchement transformé en vampire par le nécromancien Mortanius qui souhaite se servir de lui pour ses sombres desseins.

Localization.Title: Blood Omen: Legacy of Kain
Localization.Description: Einmal Vampir sein und nie sterben. Auferstanden von den Toten, schlüpfen Sie in die Rolle des Antihelden Kain, der sich auf den Weg gemacht hat, grausame Rache zu nehmen und den unstillbaren Durst nach Blut zu befriedigen.

Localization.Title: Blood Omen: Legacy of Kain
Localization.Description: Siglos antes del nacimiento de Kain, la tierra de Nosgoth era protegida por el círculo de Los Nueve, un grupo de hechiceros que protegían los pilares de Nosgoth, nueve pilares sagrados que mantenían la armonía y la vida en el mundo.

Localization.Title: Blood Omen: Legacy of Kain
Localization.Description: Blood Omen: Legacy of Kain è un gioco di ruolo e di azione su Playstation. Tu interpreti nei panni di Kain, appena trasformato in vampiro dal negromante Mortanius che vuole usarlo per i suoi scopi oscuri.

Localization.Title: Blood Omen: Legacy of Kain
Localization.Description: Blood Omen é um jogo de cima para baixo onde o jogador controla o vampiro Kain. Como vampiro, Kain é capaz de resistir à luz solar, mas é prejudicado pela água.

Localization.Title: Castlevania: Symphony of the Night
Localization.Description: As a descendant of Dracula, you must end the vampire bloodline. Can you rid the world of this unspeakable terror? Uncover the mystery of Castlevania and challenge an adventure as legendary as its name.

Localization.Title: Castlevania : Symphony of the Night
Localization.Description: Retour de la légende. Réveillé de son sommeil éternel par la réapparition de Castlevania, Alucard doit une fois de plus affronter les laquais malfaisants du Prince des ténèbres.

Localization.Title: Castlevania: Symphony of the Night
Localization.Description: Die Legende kehrt zurück Alucard wird durch das Wiedererscheinen von Castlevania aus seinem ewigen Schlummer erweckt und muss wieder einmal gegen die Knechte der Finsternis antreten.

Localization.Title: Castlevania: Symphony of the Night
Localization.Description: Vuelve la leyenda. Despertando de su eterno reposo por la aparición de Castlevania, Alucard debe enfrentarse de nuevo a las malvadas criaturas de la noche.

Localization.Title: Castlevania: Symphony of the Night
Localization.Description: Come discendente di Dracula, devi porre fine alla stirpe dei vampiri. Riuscirai a liberare il mondo da questo indicibile terrore? Scopri il mistero di Castlevania e sfida un'avventura leggendaria come il suo nome.

Localization.Title: Castlevania: Symphony of the Night
Localization.Description: Quatro anos após a batalha entre Richter Belmont e Dracula, a escuridão reaparece. O fantasma do sacerdote das trevas Shaft, morto por Richter uma vez, ressurge com um novo plano de ressuscitar seu mestre.

Localization.Title: Batman Forever: The Arcade Game
Localization.Description: Batman Forever - The Arcade Game is a Final-Fight/Double-Dragon style game which features the Caped Crusader and his sidekick Robin in a traditional beat-em-up.

Localization.Title: Batman Forever : The Arcade Game
Localization.Description: Batman Forever : The Arcade Game sur Playstation est l'adaptation du film sorti en 1995. Vos ennemis sont l'Homme Mystère et Double-Face que vous rencontrerez à plusieurs reprises dans le jeu.

Localization.Title: Batman Forever: The Arcade Game
Localization.Description: Batman Forever: Das Arcade-Spiel basiert auf dem gleichnamigen Film. Ein oder zwei Spieler, die als Batman und Robin spielen, kämpfen gegen Two-Face, den Riddler und zahlreiche Handlanger.

Localization.Title: Batman Forever: The Arcade Game
Localization.Description: Batman Forever - The Arcade Game es un juego de estilo Final-Fight/Double-Dragon que presenta al Caped Crusader y su compañero Robin en un tradicional beat-em-up.

Localization.Title: Batman Forever: The Arcade Game
Localization.Description: Batman Forever - The Arcade Game is a Final-Fight/Double-Dragon style game which features the Caped Crusader and his sidekick Robin in a traditional beat-em-up.

Localization.Title: Batman Forever: The Arcade Game
Localization.Description: Batman Forever: O Arcade Game no Playstation é a adaptação do filme lançado em 1995. Seus inimigos são Charada e Duas Caras que você irá encontrar várias vezes no jogo.

Localization.Title: Pandemonium!
Localization.Description: The young sorceress Nikki, the court jester Fargus, and his side-kick Sid the puppet are the three main protagonists of this 3D platform game.

Localization.Title: Pandemonium!
Localization.Description: Pandemonium! est un jeu de plates-formes sorti sur Playstation. Incarnez la sorcière Nikki, aidée par ses acolytes Fargus et Sid dans une aventure en 2,5D tourbillonnante. Les niveaux sont en effet très alambiqués et peuvent parfois donner le tournis !

Localization.Title: Pandemonium!
Localization.Description: Das unglaublich schnelle 3-D Jump&Run! Eine bewegliche Kamera zeigt die riesigen 3-D Welten in ihrem ganzen Detailreichtum.

Localization.Title: Pandemonium!
Localization.Description: La joven hechicera Nikki, el bufón de la corte Fargus y su acompañante Sid la marioneta, son los tres protagonistas de este juego de plataformas en 3D.

Localization.Title: Pandemonium!
Localization.Description: The young sorceress Nikki, the court jester Fargus, and his side-kick Sid the puppet are the three main protagonists of this 3D platform game.

Localization.Title: Pandemonium!
Localization.Description: A jovem feiticeira Nikki, o bobo da corte Fargus e seu chute lateral Sid, o fantoche, são os três principais protagonistas deste jogo de plataforma 3D.

Localization.Title: Suikoden
Localization.Description: Loosely based on the classic medieval Chinese novel "Water Margins" (Shuihuzhuan) by Shi Nai'an. The game is a fantasy RPG set in an imaginary universe, its main theme being political struggle.

Localization.Title: Suikoden
Localization.Description: Suikoden est un jeu de rôle sur Playstation. Le soft est inspiré du roman chinois au bord de l'eau.

Localization.Title: Suikoden
Localization.Description: Im "Reich des scharlachroten Mondes" geht der Verrat um. Ist das Imperium korrupt oder verhält sich das Volk illoyal? Nur Sie können das herausfinden. Übernehmen Sie in diesem Epos um Treuebruch, Neid und Ehre die Rolle des Reichwächters.

Localization.Title: Suikoden
Localization.Description: Suikoden nos pone en la piel de Tir Mc Dohl, hijo del General Teo Mc Dohl del Imperio de la Luna Escarlata. Tir se alista en el ejército siguiendo los pasos de su padre, pero pronto descubrirá que el Imperio esta corrupto y que el pueblo sufre.

Localization.Title: Suikoden
Localization.Description: Liberamente basato sul classico romanzo cinese medievale "Water Margins" (Shuihuzhuan) di Shi Nai'an. Il gioco è un gioco di ruolo fantasy ambientato in un universo immaginario, il cui tema principale è la lotta politica.

Localization.Title: Suikoden
Localization.Description: Vagamente baseado no clássico romance medieval chinês "Water Margins" (Shuihuzhuan) de Shi Nai'an. O jogo é um RPG de fantasia ambientado em um universo imaginário, cujo tema principal é a luta política.

Localization.Title: Mortal Kombat Trilogy
Localization.Description: All the characters from the first three Mortal Kombat games return for the ultimate battle.

Localization.Title: Mortal Kombat Trilogy
Localization.Description: Mortal Kombat Trilogy sur Playstation regroupe les trois premiers titres de la célèbre série de baston. Retrouvez 30 personnages célèbres de la série des Mortal Kombat dans des affrontements extrêmement violents.

Localization.Title: Mortal Kombat Trilogy
Localization.Description: Mortal Kombat Trilogy ist ein Kampfspiel, das von Midway 1996 als eigenständiges Update von Ultimate Mortal Kombat 3 für PlayStation veröffentlicht wurde.

Localization.Title: Mortal Kombat Trilogy
Localization.Description: El segundo juego de Mortal Kombat en PlayStation combina personajes, etapas y movimientos de entregas anteriores en la violenta serie de combates.

Localization.Title: Mortal Kombat Trilogy
Localization.Description: Il secondo gioco di Mortal Kombat su PlayStation combina personaggi, livelli e movimenti delle puntate precedenti della violenta serie di combattimenti.

Localization.Title: Mortal Kombat Trilogy
Localization.Description: Todos os personagens dos primeiros três jogos do Mortal Kombat retornaram para a batalha final.

Localization.Title: NBA Jam Extreme
Localization.Description: Acclaim's over-the-top, two-on-two basketball series moves into the 3D realm with NBA Jam Extreme.

Localization.Title: NBA Jam Extreme
Localization.Description: NBA Jam Extreme est un jeu de basketball rigolo sur Playstation. A l'inverse d'une simulation, ce NBA Jam mise tout sur le fun.

Localization.Title: NBA Jam Extreme
Localization.Description: NBA Jam Extreme ist ein unterhaltsames Basketballspiel für Playstation. Im Gegensatz zu einer Simulation geht es bei diesem NBA Jam vor allem um Spaß.

Localization.Title: NBA Jam Extreme
Localization.Description: NBA Jam Extreme es un videojuego de baloncesto arcade, ahora se incluyen a todos los equipos de la NBA de ese momento, lo que aumenta la selección de equipos disponibles.

Localization.Title: NBA Jam Extreme
Localization.Description: Acclaim's over-the-top, two-on-two basketball series moves into the 3D realm with NBA Jam Extreme.

Localization.Title: Herc's Adventures
Localization.Description: Ahhh...ancient Greece. A fertile land, full of wine, women, and some of the best gyros you'll ever taste. Thanks to Persephone, the Greek goddess of spring and fertility, Greece is a wonderful paradise.

Localization.Title: Herc's Adventures
Localization.Description: Herc's Adventures est un jeu d'action sur Playstation. Hades a Kidnappé Persephone la déesse du printemps. Ayant peur que la Grèce reste coincée dans l'hiver pour l'éternité, Zeus fait appel à 3 héros : Hercules, Atlanta et Jason pour sauver Persephone.

Localization.Title: Herc's Adventures
Localization.Description: Herc's Adventures ist ein Actionspiel. Hades hat Persephone, die Göttin des Frühlings, entführt. Aus Angst, dass Griechenland für immer im Winter stecken bleibt, sendet Zeus drei Helden aus um Persephone zu retten: Hercules, Atlanta und Jason.

Localization.Title: Herc's Adventures
Localization.Description: Herc´s adventures es un videojuego de acción y aventura lanzado para PlayStation y Saturn por LucasArts en 1997.

Localization.Title: Herc's Adventures
Localization.Description: Ahhh...Antica Grecia. Una terra fertile, piena di vino, donne e alcuni dei migliori gyros che tu abbia mai assaggiato. Grazie a Persefone, la dea greca della primavera e della fertilità, la Grecia è un meraviglioso paradiso.

Localization.Title: Herc's Adventures
Localization.Description: Ahhh...Grécia antiga. Uma terra fértil, cheia de vinho, mulheres e alguns dos melhores giroscópios que você já provou. Graças a Perséfone, a deusa grega da primavera e da fertilidade, a Grécia é um paraíso maravilhoso.

Localization.Description: Four alien species -- the Zaltecs, Thilibies, Mandalars, and Kraytons -- had been at war for a long time. In order to end the bloodshed the aliens signed a treaty that created a new sport, BallBlazer.

Localization.Title: BallBlazer Champions
Localization.Description: Ballblazer Champions sur Playstation est un jeu d'action mêlé à du sport puisque vous dirigez un robot dans un duel sportif. Votre but est de mettre une balle volante dans le camp de l'adversaire en la portant ou en lui tirant dessus.

Localization.Description: Vier außerirdische Arten – die Zalteken, Thilibies, Mandalars und Kraytons – befanden sich schon seit langer Zeit im Krieg. Um das Blutvergießen zu beenden, unterzeichneten die Außerirdischen einen Vertrag, der eine neue Sportart schuf: BallBlazer.

Localization.Description: In Croc, you play Croc (ironically enough), a lively crocodile who was raised by the Gobbos. Jealous of their happiness, the evil Baron Dante took over the Gobbos Valley and enslaved all of them.

Localization.Title: Croc : Legend of the Gobbos
Localization.Description: Croc est un jeu de plates-formes en 3D sur Playstation dans lequel vous incarnez Croc le crocodile dont les amis gobelins ont été enlevés par l'ignoble Dante Baron.

Localization.Title: Croc: Legend of the Gobbos
Localization.Description: No todo está bien en el mundo de Croc. Sus amigos, los Gobbos, han sido capturados por el malvado Barón Dante. Su misión en este juego de plataformas 3D es buscar en 42 niveles diferentes para salvar a todos sus amigos antes de que sea demasiado tarde.

Localization.Title: Croc: Legend of the Gobbos
Localization.Description: Croc è un gioco di piattaforma 3D su Playstation in cui si gioca nei panni di Croc il coccodrillo i cui amici folletti sono stati rapiti dallo spregevole Barone Dante. Cerca i tuoi amici nei 42 livelli per trovarli prima che sia troppo tardi.

Localization.Title: Croc: Legend of the Gobbos
Localization.Description: Em Croc, você interpreta Croc (ironicamente), um crocodilo animado que foi criado pelos Gobbos. Com ciúmes de sua felicidade, o malvado Barão Dante assumiu o controle do Vale Gobbos e escravizou todos eles.

Localization.Title: Gex 3D: Enter the Gecko
Localization.Description: "Is it just me, or am I engulfed in flames?" is one of the many one-liners uttered by Gex, a wise cracking gecko who should check himself into television rehab; he's addicted to it.

Localization.Description: Gex : Enter the Gecko est un jeu de plates-formes en 3D sur Playstation. Le terrible Rez est sur le point de détruire le royaume de la télévision et Gex est le seul à pouvoir l'en empêcher.

Localization.Title: MDK
Localization.Description: Plündernde Streamrider surfen auf der Suche nach reichen Planeten durchs Universum, und Gunter Glut, der fieseste Streamrider von allen, hat gerade die Erde entdeckt...

Localization.Description: Burst right into the feverish puzzle action that combines irresistable, addictive fun with famous Capcom characters. Beat your opponent to the punch by stacking block after block in strategic patterns and color combinations.

Localization.Description: Super Puzzle Fighter II Turbo sur Playstation est un casse-tête coloré. Des pièces tombent de l'écran et il faut les faire disparaître en les associant par couleur. Chaque disparition entraînant un combat entre deux petits personnages au centre du jeu.

Localization.Title: Super Puzzle Fighter II Turbo
Localization.Description: Super Puzzle Fighter II Turbo für Playstation ist ein farbenfrohes Puzzlespiel. Teile fallen vom Bildschirm und Sie müssen sie verschwinden lassen, indem Sie sie farblich zuordnen.

Localization.Title: Super Puzzle Fighter II Turbo
Localization.Description: Un juego de rompecabezas similar a Tetris con personajes populares de muchos juegos de Capcom. Las gemas de colores caen de la parte superior de la pantalla en parejas, pero esta vez alineando las del mismo color no es suficiente.

Localization.Title: Pro Pinball: Timeshock!
Localization.Description: Pro Pinball Timeshock is the follow-up to The Web features a single but a very complex table. You have a 3D view of the table, with 4 different viewpoints. Your ultimate point-scoring goal is to travel through time by collecting crystals.

Localization.Title: Pro Pinball : Timeshock!
Localization.Description: Suite du célèbre The Web, Pro Pinball : Timeshock ! sur Playstation nous gratifie d'une table de flipper mais une des plus complexes. Vous aurez une vue en 3D de 4 points de vue différents.

Localization.Title: Pro Pinball: Timeshock!
Localization.Description: Pro Pinball - Timeshock! So realistisch, daß er den Vergleich mit einem echten Flipper nicht scheuen muß! Pro Pinball - Timeshock! Dynamische Kugel- und Kellenphysik inklusive ultra-echter Bumper stellen sicher, daß sich Ereignisse nie wiederholen.

Localization.Title: Pro Pinball: Timeshock!
Localization.Description: Pro Pinball Timeshock es la continuación de The Web que presenta una única pero muy compleja tabla. Tienes una vista en 3D de la tabla, con 4 puntos de vista diferentes. Tu objetivo final es viajar a través del tiempo recolectando cristales.

Localization.Title: Pro Pinball: Timeshock!
Localization.Description: Pro Pinball Timeshock è il seguito di The Web caratterizzato da una tabella unica ma molto complessa. Hai una vista 3D del tavolo, con 4 diversi punti di vista. Il tuo obiettivo finale per segnare punti è viaggiare nel tempo raccogliendo cristalli.

Localization.Title: Pro Pinball: Timeshock!
Localization.Description: Pro Pinball Timeshock is the follow-up to The Web features a single but a very complex table. You have a 3D view of the table, with 4 different viewpoints. Your ultimate point-scoring goal is to travel through time by collecting crystals.

Localization.Title: Independence Day: The Game
Localization.Description: Independence Day envelops you in an interstellar war against resource hungry alien forces.

Localization.Title: Independence Day : The Game
Localization.Description: Independance Day est un jeu d'action/simulation sur Playstation. Basé sur le film éponyme, le jeu consiste à piloter un jet afin de détruire les vaisseaux spatiaux gargantuesques qui s'en prennent aux villes du monde entier.

Localization.Title: Independence Day: The Game
Localization.Description: Independence Day entführt Sie in einen interstellaren Krieg gegen ressourcenhungrige außerirdische Kräfte. Übernehmen Sie die Kontrolle über einen erfolgreichen Kampfpiloten und seinen Flügelmann Steve Hiller.

Localization.Title: Independence Day: The Game

Localization.Description: Aliens have infested the earth once more, and all is lost unless you step into the fray and take action against these otherworldly inhabitants.

Localization.Description: Contra: Legacy Of War ist ein Third-Person-Shooter auf Playstation, mit dem Sie als Roboter gegen eine Horde Aliens kämpfen, um die Menschheit zu retten. Mit vielen Power-Ups in jedem Level kannst du deine Feuerkraft erhöhen.

Localization.Title: Contra: Legacy of War
Localization.Description: Los extraterrestres han infestado la tierra una vez más, y todo está perdido a menos que entres en la refriega y actúes contra estos invasores de otro mundo.

Localization.Title: Jonah Lomu Rugby
Localization.Description: Jonah Lomu Rugby is a computer and video game released in 1997. It was developed by Codemasters and published by Rage Software. It was released on the PC, PlayStation and Sega Saturn. Its title is a reference to noted All Blacks winger Jonah Lomu.

Localization.Title: Jonah Lomu Rugby
Localization.Description: Jonah Lomu Rugby est un jeu de simulation de rugby sur Playstation. Le soft propose les actions les plus rapides et les plus rudes de l'ailier le plus puissant du monde. De plus, les 32 meilleures équipes internationales sont présentes.

Localization.Title: Jonah Lomu Rugby
Localization.Description: Jonah Lomu Rugby ist ein 1997 veröffentlichtes Computer- und Videospiel. Es wurde von Codemasters entwickelt und von Rage Software veröffentlicht. Es wurde auf dem PC, der PlayStation und Sega Saturn veröffentlicht.

Localization.Title: Jonah Lomu Rugby

Localization.Title: Darkstone
Localization.Description: In “Darkstone,” you are the Chosen One tasked with stopping Draak's plan to plunge the world into darkness.

Localization.Title: Darkstone
Localization.Description: Darkstone est un hack and slash dans un univers médiéval fantastique sur Playstation. Avec plus de 30 types d'armes et 32 sorts à votre disposition, vous partez à la chasse du terrible dragon Draak.

Localization.Title: Darkstone
Localization.Description: In „Darkstone“ bist du der Auserwählte, der Draaks Plan verhindern muss, die Welt in Dunkelheit zu stürzen.

Localization.Title: Darkstone
Localization.Description: En Darkstone, eres el elegido para evitar el plan de Draak de sumergir al mundo en una nueva Era de Oscuridad. Las elecciones de personajes se hacen a partir de cuatro clases (mago/hechicera, asesino/ladrón, guerrero/amazonas o monje/sacerdotisa).

Localization.Title: Darkstone
Localization.Description: In Darkstone, sei tu il prescelto per contrastare il piano di Draak di immergere il mondo in una nuova Age of Darkness.

Localization.Title: Darkstone
Localization.Description: Em Darkstone, você é o escolhido para contrariar o plano de Draak de mergulhar o mundo em uma nova Era das Trevas.

Localization.Description: Abe's Oddysee begins with the eponymous protagonist as a prisoner in RuptureFarms, from which he narrates his story. He and many other Mudokons are slaves to Molluck the Glukkon, the owner of RuptureFarms: "the biggest meat-processing plant on Oddworld".

Localization.Title: Oddworld : Abe's Oddysee
Localization.Description: Jusqu'ici, vous n'étiez qu'un simple esclave travaillant dans une usine de viande infernale...

Localization.Title: Oddworld: Abe's Oddysee
Localization.Description: Abe ist ein Wesen aus dem Volk der Mudokaner und eigentlich ein Anti-Held. Wie viele seines Volkes ist er ein Sklave des Fleischproduzenten Molluck aus dem Volk der Glukkons.

Localization.Title: Oddworld: Abe's Oddysee
Localization.Description: Abe es un miembro de la raza Mudokon, una de las tantas que habitan el planeta remoto conocido como Oddworld.

Localization.Title: Oddworld: Abe's Oddysee
Localization.Description: Abe è un membro della razza Mudokon, una delle tante che abitano il remoto pianeta noto come Oddworld. Lavora al fianco dei suoi colleghi come operaio e schiavo nelle Rupture Farms, una potente azienda di lavorazione della carne.

Localization.Title: Oddworld: Abe's Oddysee
Localization.Description: Oddworld - Abe's Oddysee é um jogo de ação / aventura no Playstation. Você joga como Abe e você tem que salvar sua pele em um universo cheio de perigos do mal, onde todo mundo tenta te devorar vivo.

Localization.Description: The Future Is About To Become History EXCALIBUR 2555 AD A totally unique and ground-breaking adventure, combining the best graphical elements of Tomb Raider and the atmosphere, depth and playability of The Legend of Zelda.

Localization.Title: Little Big Adventure
Localization.Description: The game is set on Twinsun, a planet stabilized between two suns. The planet is divided into two hemispheres by a huge mountain range running along its equator.

Localization.Title: Little Big Adventure
Localization.Description: Little Big Adventure est un jeu d'aventure sur Playstation. Vous incarnez Twinsen, et vivez avec votre fiancée Zoé sur l'Île de la Citadelle.

Localization.Title: Little Big Adventure
Localization.Description: Begleiten Sie Twinsen, den prophetischen Helden, auf seinem Abenteuer durch fantastische Welten und retten Sie mit ihm seinen Heimatplaneten Twinsum. Treffen Sie seltsame Wesen, lösen Rätsel und besiegen Sie böse kleine Kreaturen.

Localization.Title: Little Big Adventure
Localization.Description: Little Big Adventure es un extraño y misterioso viaje a través de un surrealista y peligroso mundo. tomas el papel de Twinsen un joven atrapado en un sueño por la Diosa Sendell para poder rescatar tu mundo.

Localization.Title: Little Big Adventure

Localization.Title: Little Big Adventure
Localization.Description: Você joga como Twinsen, um novo homem que vive no estranho mundo de Twinsun (dois sol). O planeta está entre dois sóis, daí o seu nome. Você é um membro da raça chamada Quetch, ou "humanóides" como nós os chamaríamos.

Localization.Title: Duke Nukem
Localization.Description: In “Duke Nukem,” you must save Earth from alien invaders who are abducting and imprisoning women. You battle mutated enemies like Pig Cops as well as reptilian and jellyfish-like creatures.

Localization.Title: Duke Nukem
Localization.Description: Duke Nukem : Total Meltdown est un contenu supplémentaire pour Duke Nukem 3D sur Playstation. On trouve comme principaux ajouts plus de 500 nouveaux niveaux, de nouvelles animations et musiques ainsi que de nouveaux personnages.

Localization.Title: Duke Nukem
Localization.Description: In „Duke Nukem“ musst du die Erde vor außerirdischen Invasoren retten, die Frauen entführen und gefangen halten. Du kämpfst gegen mutierte Feinde wie die Pig Cops sowie gegen reptilien- und quallenähnliche Kreaturen.

Localization.Title: Duke Nukem

Localization.Title: Duke Nukem
Localization.Description: In Duke Nukem, devi salvare la Terra dagli invasori alieni che rapiscono e imprigionano le donne. Combatti contro nemici mutati come Pig Cops e creature simili a rettili e meduse.

Localization.Title: Duke Nukem
Localization.Description: Alienígenas pousaram na futurista Los Angeles e cabe ao Duke trazer a dor e mostrar-lhes a porta.

Localization.Title: Frogger
Localization.Description: Frogger sur Playstation est un jeu d'action dans lequel le but est de diriger des grenouilles pour les ramener chez elle tout en évitant les obstacles qui se dressent sur votre chemin.

Localization.Title: Frogger
Localization.Description: Frogger, der freche Frosch der schon zu Beginn der Videospiel-Ära versuchte, heil über die Straße zu kommen ist zurück. Hinterlistig, gemein und verrückt macht er sich auf Wanderschaft. 10 gefährliche Welten mit knapp 50 Stages erwarten ihn.

Localization.Description: Aspects of the classic game, like building armies and seizing territories, are brought to life through animation and graphics.

Localization.Title: Risk
Localization.Description: Disponible sur PC, Risk est un jeu de stratégie tiré du célèbre jeu de société. Votre but est de conquérir les territoires limitrophes afin de faire régner votre suprématie sur les pays adverses.

Localization.Title: Risk
Localization.Description: Ein Strategiespiel für alle, die das Risiko und den Zweikampf suchen. Interaktive Schlachten und exzellent gerenderte Kampfszenen sorgen für extremen Spielspaß. Verhandlungsgeschick und mutige Entscheidungen führen zum Erfolg - oder auch nicht.

Localization.Description: Based on the TV show, Beast Wars: Transformers puts you in control of one of several transformers, allied with either the Maximals or the Predacons. The game includes five original and one hidden transformers for each team, all from the show.

Localization.Title: Beast Wars : Transformers
Localization.Description: Beast Wars est un jeu de tir à la troisième personne sur Playstation. L'histoire est basée sur les célèbres Transformers.

Localization.Title: Beast Wars: Transformers
Localization.Description: Bekannt aus der gleichnamigen Fernsehserie. In 24 Power-Leveln übernehmen Sie die Rolle einer der zehn Beast Wars Transformers. Sie können wahlweise in die Rolle der bösartigen Predators oder der guten Maximals schlüpfen.

Localization.Title: Beast Wars: Transformers
Localization.Description: La guerra de las bestias no ha hecho más que empezar... ¡Toma el mando de la máquina de guerra más avanzada y entra en acción! Elige entre 10 Transformers en 3D y prepárate para la batalla.

Localization.Description: The story of Tomb Raider II surrounds the mythical Dagger of Xian, a weapon which was used by an Emperor of China to command his army. By plunging the weapon into its owner's heart, the weapon has the power to turn its bearer into a dragon.

Localization.Title: Tomb Raider II : Starring Lara Croft
Localization.Description: Lara Croft est de retour. Elle part à la découverte du secret de la Dague de Xian. D'après une mystérieuse légende, celui qui découvrira cette dague mythique gagnera le pouvoir du dragon... à condition qu'il ait le courage de la plonger dans son cœur.

Localization.Title: Tomb Raider II: Starring Lara Croft
Localization.Description: Lara Croft ist zurück! In ihrem neuesten Abenteuer begibt sich die Archäologin auf die Spur des Dolches von Xian. Wer diese mystische Waffe entdeckt, bekommt einem alten chinesischen Glauben zufolge eine unvorstellbare Macht verliehen...

Localization.Title: Tomb Raider II: Starring Lara Croft
Localization.Description: Lara croft regresa en Tomb Raider II para descubrir los secretos de la Daga de Xian.

Localization.Title: Tomb Raider II: Starring Lara Croft
Localization.Description: Lara Croft è tornata. Va a scoprire il segreto del Pugnale di Xian. Secondo una misteriosa leggenda, chi scopre questo mitico pugnale otterrà il potere del drago... purché abbia il coraggio di affondarlo nel suo cuore.

Localization.Title: Tomb Raider II: Starring Lara Croft
Localization.Description: Tomb Raider II, estrelado por Lara Croft é um jogo de ação / aventura no Playstation. A bela Lara Croft está de volta. Ao seu lado você está fora para descobrir o segredo da Adaga de Xian.

Localization.Description: Following on from the hugely successful Super Karts and Manic Karts games, Formula Karts Special Edition sits you in a motorized sled which is capable of propelling you around 9 miniature race circuits at speeds over 70 mph.

Localization.Title: Forsaken
Localization.Description: Earth has been rendered largely uninhabitable by an explosion caused by a bungled experiment. Few would dare to brave its unstable and searing environments - only those determined to grab a little of its remaining gold.

Localization.Title: Forsaken
Localization.Description: Forsaken est un jeu d'action sur Playstation. Le soft vous plonge dans un univers post-apocalyptique sur la Terre.

Localization.Title: Forsaken
Localization.Description: Die Erde wurde durch eine Explosion, die auf ein misslungenes Experiment zurückzuführen war, weitgehend unbewohnbar gemacht.

Localization.Title: Forsaken
Localization.Description: La Tierra se ha vuelto en gran parte inhabitable por una explosión causada por un experimento fallido. Pocos se atreverían a desafiar sus entornos inestables y abrasadores, solo aquellos decididos a apoderarse de un poco del oro restante.

Localization.Title: Forsaken
Localization.Description: Forsaken è un gioco d'azione su Playstation. Il software vi immerge in un mondo post-apocalittico sulla Terra. Come spazzino su una motocicletta, si viaggia attraverso installazioni militari, centrali nucleari e molti altri ambienti variegati.

Localization.Title: Forsaken
Localization.Description: Forsaken é um jogo de ação para Playstation. O software mergulha você em um universo pós-apocalíptico na Terra. Assim, na pele de um catador de motocicleta, você atravessa instalações militares, usinas nucleares e muitos outros ambientes variados.

Localization.Title: Ian Livingstone's Deathtrap Dungeon
Localization.Description: Deathtrap Dungeon is an action-adventure game released in 1998 for the PlayStation and Microsoft Windows. It is based on the adventure gamebook of the same name.

Localization.Title: Ian Livingstone's Deathtrap Dungeon
Localization.Description: Deathtrap Dungeon est un jeu d'action sur Playstation. L'ignoble baron Sukumvit a construit un gigantesque labyrinthe au coeur de la montagne.

Localization.Title: Ian Livingstone's Deathtrap Dungeon
Localization.Description: Faszination und Gefahr liegen nah beieinander in Deathtrap Dungeon. Atmosphärisches 3D-Spielvergnügen, Licht und Schatten reagieren auf jede Bewegung in den 16 großangelegten Labyrinthen mit 55 aufwendig gestalteten Gegnern.

Localization.Description: Deathtrap Dungeon es un juego de acción en tercera persona. Eligiendo a Red Lotus o Bandog, el jugador maneja al personaje desde atrás con un modo de cámara como en Tomb Raider.

Localization.Description: Trouble in Mega-City One: An unidentified perpetrator has taken hostages, including the mayor. Attempts to apprehend him have already lead to the loss of 17 Judges. He states that only one man is allowed to come near: Judge Dredd.

Localization.Description: Judge Dredd sur Playstation est inspiré du comics book éponyme. Le maire de Mega-City One est pris en otage par un homme non identifié, il ne réclame qu'une chose : Judge Dredd.

Localization.Description: Ärger in Mega-City One: Ein unbekannter Täter hat Geiseln genommen, darunter den Bürgermeister. Versuche, ihn festzunehmen, führten bereits zum Verlust von 17 Richtern. Er gibt an, dass nur ein Mann in die Nähe kommen darf: Richter Dredd.

Localization.Title: Viva Football
Localization.Description: Absolute Football est un jeu de sport sorti sur Playstation. Vous vous en doutez au titre mais Absolute Football ne parle pas de curling ou nascar mais bien de balle au pied.

Localization.Title: Viva Football
Localization.Description: Absolute Football ist ein Sportspiel, das auf der Playstation veröffentlicht wurde. Sie können es sich anhand des Titels vorstellen, aber bei „Absolute Football“ geht es nicht um Curling oder NASCAR, sondern um den Ball am Fuß.

Localization.Title: Viva Football
Localization.Description: Viva Football de Virgin Interactive contiene más de 1.000 equipos de las Copas del Mundo pasadas.

Localization.Title: Viva Football
Localization.Description: Il gioco presenta tutte le squadre internazionali tra la Coppa del Mondo del 1958 e la Coppa del Mondo del 1998, un totale di 1035 squadre e oltre 16.000 giocatori della vita reale.

Localization.Title: Viva Football
Localization.Description: O jogo apresenta todos os times internacionais entre a Copa do Mundo de 1958 e a Copa do Mundo de 1998, um total de 1035 times e mais de 16.000 jogadores da vida real.

Localization.Title: Air Race
Localization.Description: Dans ce jeu de course aérienne, les joueurs pilotent différents avions et tentent de franchir la ligne d'arrivée en tête. Chaque appareil possède ses propres caractéristiques de vitesse, d'accélération et de maniabilité.

Localization.Title: Air Race
Localization.Description: Jeder kann auf dem Boden Rennen fahren ...

Localization.Title: Air Race
Localization.Description: En este juego de carreras aéreas, compite en los cielos por ser el primero en llegar a la meta. Cada avión tiene sus propias cualidades como velocidad, aceleración y manejo, hay una gran variedad de aviones pero algunos son desbloquebles.

Localization.Title: WCW vs. the World
Localization.Description: WCW vs. the World (known in Japan as Virtual Pro-Wrestling) is a professional wrestling video game released in 1997 for the PlayStation video game console.

Localization.Title: WCW vs. the World
Localization.Description: Dans ce jeu de catch sur Playstation, vous avez le choix entre une soixantaine de catcheurs, qui n'attendent qu'une chose : pouvoir se casser les membres dans l'une des dix arènes proposées par le jeu. Chaque catcheur possède entre 30 et 40 coups !

Localization.Title: WCW vs. the World
Localization.Description: In diesem Wrestling-Spiel auf der Playstation haben Sie die Wahl zwischen sechzig Wrestlern, die nur auf eines warten: sich in einer der zehn Arenen, die das Spiel bietet, die Gliedmaßen brechen zu können. Jeder Wrestler hat zwischen 30 und 40 Schläge!

Localization.Title: WCW vs. the World
Localization.Description: WCW vs. the World es un videojuego de lucha libre profesional. Uno de los aspectos destacados de WCW vs. the World es su extenso roster de luchadores, que incluye a estrellas famosas de la época como Hulk Hogan, Ric Flair, Sting, Lex Luger y muchas más.

Localization.Title: WCW vs. the World
Localization.Description: WCW vs. the World (known in Japan as Virtual Pro-Wrestling) is a professional wrestling video game released in 1997 for the PlayStation video game console.

Localization.Title: WCW vs. the World
Localization.Description: Neste jogo de luta livre para Playstation, você pode escolher entre cerca de sessenta lutadores, que esperam por uma coisa: poder partir os membros numa das dez arenas que o jogo oferece. Cada lutador tem entre 30 e 40 tiros!

Localization.Title: NASCAR 98
Localization.Description: Racing at a speed of over 200 miles per hour isn't legal on the interstate. But you can do it all you want on your television screen in NASCAR 98. There are 24 top NASCAR drivers present in this game, each driving his signature car.

Localization.Title: NASCAR 98
Localization.Description: Nascar Racing 98 sur Playstation permet de revivre la compétition automobile "Nascar" célèbre aux Etats-Unis, où de puissants bolides s'affrontent sur des circuits ovales à des vitesses vertigineuses. Le jeu retrace la saison 1998 de ce sport.

Localization.Title: NASCAR 98
Localization.Description: Rennen mit einer Geschwindigkeit von mehr als 200 Meilen pro Stunde sind auf der Autobahn nicht erlaubt. Aber Sie können in NASCAR 98 auf Ihrem Fernsehbildschirm alles tun, was Sie wollen.

Localization.Title: NASCAR 98
Localization.Description: Correr a una velocidad de más de 200 millas por hora no es legal en la interestatal. Pero puede hacerlo todo lo que quiera en la pantalla de su televisor en NASCAR 98. Elije 24 pilotos de NASCAR en este juego, cada uno conduciendo su auto característico.

Localization.Title: OverBlood
Localization.Description: As you wake up from your slumber in a cryogenic tube, you begin to wonder who you are, where you are, and how you arrived at this unknown place.

Localization.Title: OverBlood
Localization.Description: OverBlood est considéré comme l'un des tout premiers survival horror utilisant des décors et un environnement en trois dimensions. Lars Karcy se réveille d'un caisson cryogénique sans savoir qui il est ni où il se trouve.

Localization.Title: OverBlood
Localization.Description: Wenn Sie aus Ihrem Schlaf in einer Kryoröhre erwachen, beginnen Sie sich zu fragen, wer Sie sind, wo Sie sind und wie Sie an diesen unbekannten Ort gelangt sind.

Localization.Title: OverBlood
Localization.Description: Te despiertas de un sueño criogénico sin memoria, comienzas a preguntarte quién eres, dónde estás y cómo llegaste a este lugar desconocido, a través de una base subterránea, descubres que un virus maligno corre por tus venas. Debes encontrar un antídoto.

Localization.Title: OverBlood
Localization.Description: Quando ti svegli dal tuo sonno in un tubo criogenico, inizi a chiederti chi sei, dove sei e come sei arrivato in questo luogo sconosciuto. Grazie ai gadget che ti circondano, la domanda sulla tua identità avrà una risposta rapida: tu sei Raz Karcy.

Localization.Title: Frenzy!
Localization.Description: The evil scientist, calling himself Count Von Toten, is busy building a secret army which he will use to take over the world (what else!?). Only one man can stop him, being the super hero pilot that you are, it should be a breeze.

Localization.Title: Frenzy!
Localization.Description: Frenzy est un jeu de tir sur Playstation qui vous met dans la peau d'un pilote intrépide. Dans un style très cartoon, vous affrontez vos ennemis dans des mondes variés et colorés. Empêchez le vil baron et ses sbires de conquérir le Monde.

Localization.Title: Frenzy!
Localization.Description: Der böse Wissenschaftler, der sich Graf von Toten nennt, ist damit beschäftigt, eine Geheimarmee aufzubauen, mit der er die Welt erobern will (was sonst!?). Nur ein Mann kann ihn aufhalten.

Localization.Title: Poy Poy
Localization.Description: In Poy Poy, contestants from all over the land come together to compete for big cash prizes and the honor of being crowned the Poy Poy Cup champion. To become champion you have to beat three rounds on each of the six stages.

Localization.Title: Poy Poy
Localization.Description: Poy Poy est un jeu d'action sur Playstation où 4 joueurs peuvent s'affronter simultanément dans des environnements en 3D pour gagner des prix incroyables et peut-être se voir attribuer le titre de Champion de la Coupe Poy Poy.

Localization.Title: Poy Poy
Localization.Description: In Poy Poy treffen sich Teilnehmer aus dem ganzen Land, um um große Geldpreise und die Ehre, zum Poy Poy Cup-Champion gekrönt zu werden, zu kämpfen. Um Meister zu werden, muss man auf jeder der sechs Etappen drei Runden gewinnen.

Localization.Title: Poy Poy
Localization.Description: Poy Poy es un juego de acción para varios jugadores en la tradición de 'Bomberman', un llamado 'programa de juegos locos y divertidos' en el que arrojas bombas, rocas e incluso a tus oponentes para lograr la victoria.

Localization.Title: Poy Poy
Localization.Description: In Poy Poy, concorrenti provenienti da tutto il paese si riuniscono per competere per grandi premi in denaro e l'onore di essere incoronato campione della Poy Poy Cup. Per diventare campione devi battere tre round in ciascuna delle sei fasi.

Localization.Title: Poy Poy
Localization.Description: In Poy Poy, contestants from all over the land come together to compete for big cash prizes and the honor of being crowned the Poy Poy Cup champion. To become champion you have to beat three rounds on each of the six stages.

Localization.Title: Magic: The Gathering: BattleMage
Localization.Description: Magic: The Gathering - Battlemage is the real-time adaptation of the popular Magic collectible card game.

Localization.Title: Magic : The Gathering : BattleMage
Localization.Description: Sans une stratégie d'ensemble, tu n'es que poussière.... Une guerre dévastatrice d'arpenteurs fait rage sur le continent de Corondor. Le mage de combat Ravidel est devenu fou de chagrin et de trahison.

Localization.Title: Magic: The Gathering: BattleMage
Localization.Description: Magic: The Gathering – Battlemage ist die Echtzeitadaption des beliebten Magic-Sammelkartenspiels.

Localization.Title: Magic: The Gathering: BattleMage
Localization.Description: En BattleMage, eres un Planeswalker, un poderoso mago que puede invocar criaturas y lanzar hechizos utilizando cartas mágicas.

Localization.Title: Discworld II: Missing Presumed...!?
Localization.Description: Discworld II casts players again in the role of Rincewind, from the first game. Death, the grim reaper, who normally ushers the Discworld inhabitants into the afterlife, is on an extended vacation.

Localization.Title: Discworld II : Missing Presumed...!?
Localization.Description: Malheur sur le Disque-Monde, suite à un attentat contre sa personne la Mort refuse de reprendre le travail et décide de prendre des vacances bien méritées ! Vous, Rincevent, sorcier raté accompagné de votre fidèle Bagage, êtes chargé de ramener la Fauche

Localization.Title: Discworld II: Missing Presumed...!?
Localization.Description: Discworld II versetzt die Spieler ab dem ersten Spiel erneut in die Rolle von Rincewind.Der Tod, der Sensenmann, der die Bewohner der Scheibenwelt normalerweise ins Jenseits führt, ist auf einem längeren Urlaub.

Localization.Title: Discworld II: Missing Presumed...!?
Localization.Description: Al igual que su predecesor, Discworld II presenta una historia completamente nueva llena de humor y personajes excéntricos.

Localization.Title: Discworld II: Missing Presumed...!?
Localization.Description: Discworld II lancia di nuovo i giocatori nel ruolo di Scuotivento, dal primo gioco. La morte, il triste mietitore, che normalmente introduce gli abitanti del Discworld nell'aldilà, è in vacanza prolungata.

Localization.Title: N2O
Localization.Description: N2o est un jeu de tir à la première personne sur Playstation. A bord de votre vaisseau blindé, pénétrez dans un monde psychédélique composé de 30 niveaux successifs.

Localization.Title: N2O
Localization.Description: Irgendwo tief in der Zukunft befindet sich unsere Galaxie im Krieg. Auf dem nahe gelegenen Planeten Neptun haben Mächte des Bösen ihre neuen Pläne zur Invasion der Erde ins Leben gerufen.

Localization.Title: N2O
Localization.Description: En algún lugar profundo en el futuro, nuestra Galaxia está en guerra. En el cercano planeta Neptuno, las fuerzas del mal han iniciado sus nuevos planes para invadir la Tierra.

Localization.Title: Machine Hunter
Localization.Description: At the end of the 20th century, the planet Mars was the subject of numerous tests. Scientists believed human life could exist on the planet, which was great news to everyone because the Earth was slowly running out of natural resources.

Localization.Title: Machine Hunter
Localization.Description: Machine Hunter est un jeu d'action sur Playstation. Vous devez sauver des civils des griffes de robots et d'aliens. Lorsqu'un robot est abattu, le joueur reçoit l'armement dudit robot.

Localization.Title: Machine Hunter
Localization.Description: At the end of the 20th century, the planet Mars was the subject of numerous tests. Scientists believed human life could exist on the planet, which was great news to everyone because the Earth was slowly running out of natural resources.

Localization.Title: Machine Hunter
Localization.Description: Un shooter clásico pero con un nuevo giro. Los extraterrestres han invadido las colonias marcianas y han reprogramado a los robots mineros en asesinos despiadados. La Tierra, temiendo una invasión, crea a los Cazadores de Máquinas.

Localization.Title: Machine Hunter
Localization.Description: Alla fine del XX secolo, il pianeta Marte è stato oggetto di numerosi test. Gli scienziati ritenevano che la vita umana potesse esistere sul pianeta, il che era un'ottima notizia per tutti perché la Terra stava lentamente esaurendo le risorse naturali.
