Localization.Title: Apocalypse
Localization.Description: Doomsday is steadily approaching the planet Earth; it is a time of war and hatred, a time where madmen rule the streets. The madman in this case is the Reverend and his Four Horsemen: Death, Plague, War, and the Beast.

Localization.Title: Apocalypse
Localization.Description: Dans ce jeu d'action vous incarnez le rôle de Trey Kincaid, un nano-physicien joué par la star d'action hollywoodienne Bruce Willis.

Localization.Title: Apocalypse
Localization.Description: Apocalypse spielt in einer düsteren Zukunft, in der ein selbsternannter Prophet gestohlene Nanotechnologie dazu missbraucht, die vier apokalyptischen Reiter heraufzubeschwören. Das Ende der Welt ist nah.

Localization.Title: Apocalypse
Localization.Description: El final del mundo es inminente. Interpreta a Bruce Willis en el papel de Trey Kincaid, un físico que está sólo para defender el mundo entero. Tu misión consiste en derrotar a los cuatro jinetes antes de que la humanidad desaparezca.

Localization.Title: Oddworld: L'Odyssée d'Abe
Localization.Description: Abe's Oddysee begins with the eponymous protagonist as a prisoner in RuptureFarms, from which he narrates his story. He and many other Mudokons are slaves to Molluck the Glukkon, the owner of RuptureFarms: "the biggest meat-processing plant on Oddworld".

Localization.Title: Oddworld : L'Odyssée d'Abe
Localization.Description: Jusqu'ici, vous n'étiez qu'un simple esclave travaillant dans une usine de viande infernale...

Localization.Title: Oddworld: L'Odyssée d'Abe
Localization.Description: Abe ist ein Wesen aus dem Volk der Mudokaner und eigentlich ein Anti-Held. Wie viele seines Volkes ist er ein Sklave des Fleischproduzenten Molluck aus dem Volk der Glukkons.

Localization.Title: Oddworld: L'Odyssée d'Abe
Localization.Description: Abe es un miembro de la raza Mudokon, una de las tantas que habitan el planeta remoto conocido como Oddworld.

Localization.Title: Oddworld: L'Odyssée d'Abe
Localization.Description: Abe è un membro della razza Mudokon, una delle tante che abitano il remoto pianeta noto come Oddworld. Lavora al fianco dei suoi colleghi come operaio e schiavo nelle Rupture Farms, una potente azienda di lavorazione della carne.

Localization.Title: Oddworld: L'Odyssée d'Abe
Localization.Description: Oddworld - Abe's Oddysee é um jogo de ação / aventura no Playstation. Você joga como Abe e você tem que salvar sua pele em um universo cheio de perigos do mal, onde todo mundo tenta te devorar vivo.

Localization.Title: Spec Ops: Stealth Patrol
Localization.Description: The original Spec Ops for PC was one of the first realistic military tactical combat simulators to be released. After its limited success it spawned many rehashes, pseudo-sequels, and mission packs all bearing the same name.

Localization.Title: Spec Ops : Stealth Patrol
Localization.Description: Spec Ops : Stealth Patrol est un jeu d'action et de stratégie. Choisissez d'opérer dans l'ombre ou menez votre équipe de Rangers au coeur d'une guerre sans merci contre la vague de terrorisme qui menace le monde.

Localization.Title: Spec Ops: Stealth Patrol
Localization.Description: Spec Ops: Stealth Patrol ist ein Action- und Strategiespiel. Entscheide dich dafür, im Verborgenen zu operieren oder dein Ranger-Team mitten in einen umfassenden Krieg gegen die Welle des Terrorismus zu führen, die die Welt bedroht.

Localization.Title: Spec Ops: Stealth Patrol
Localization.Description: Spec Ops: Stealth Patrol es un juego de acción y estrategia. Elija operar en las sombras o dirija a su equipo de Rangers al corazón de una guerra total contra la ola de terrorismo que amenaza al mundo.

Localization.Title: Spec Ops: Stealth Patrol
Localization.Description: The original Spec Ops for PC was one of the first realistic military tactical combat simulators to be released. After its limited success it spawned many rehashes, pseudo-sequels, and mission packs all bearing the same name.

Localization.Title: Spec Ops: Stealth Patrol
Localization.Description: The original Spec Ops for PC was one of the first realistic military tactical combat simulators to be released. After its limited success it spawned many rehashes, pseudo-sequels, and mission packs all bearing the same name.

Localization.Title: Blaze & Blade: Eternal Quest
Localization.Description: Adventurers come across an ancient lithograph during their travels, supposedly very valuable, and desire to verify the authenticity of this artifact.

Localization.Title: Blaze & Blade : Eternal Quest
Localization.Description: Legend of Foresia : La Contrée Interdite sur Playstation est un jeu de rôle/action. Le titre a la particularité d'être multijoueur ce qui permet d'affronter les adversaires et de progresser dans cet univers médiéval à plusieurs.

Localization.Title: Blaze & Blade: Eternal Quest
Localization.Description: Nur eine Gruppe entschlossener Helden kann das verwunschene Reich Foresia von den dämonischen Besatzern befreien.

Localization.Title: Blaze & Blade: Eternal Quest
Localization.Description: Blaze & Blade: Eternal Quest es un juego de rol de acción en el que controlas a un grupo de cuatro personajes. La creación de personajes te permite definir el comportamiento del jugador, así como sus capacidades.

Localization.Title: Blaze & Blade: Eternal Quest
Localization.Description: Adventurers come across an ancient lithograph during their travels, supposedly very valuable, and desire to verify the authenticity of this artifact.

Localization.Title: Blaze & Blade: Eternal Quest
Localization.Description: Os aventureiros encontram durante suas viagens uma litografia antiga, supostamente muito valiosa, e desejam verificar a autenticidade deste artefato.

Localization.Title: V-Ball: Beach Volley Heroes
Localization.Description: V-Ball - Beach Volley Heroes is the sequel to the NES game Super Spike V'Ball, an arcade game that deals with beach volleyball in a very special way.

Localization.Title: V-Ball : Beach Volley Heroes
Localization.Description: V-Ball - Beach Volley Heroes est la suite du jeu NES Super Spike V'Ball, un jeu d'arcade qui traite du beach-volley d'une manière très particulière. Vous pouvez choisir parmi plusieurs équipes, comme les soldats, les ninjas, les footballeurs, etc.

Localization.Title: V-Ball: Beach Volley Heroes
Localization.Description: V-Ball - Beach Volley Heroes ist die Fortsetzung des NES-Spiels Super Spike V'Ball, einem Arcade-Spiel, das sich auf ganz besondere Weise mit Beachvolleyball beschäftigt. Sie können aus mehreren Teams wählen, z. B. Soldaten, Ninjas, Fußballern usw.

Localization.Title: V-Ball: Beach Volley Heroes
Localization.Description: V-Ball - Beach Volley Heroes es la secuela del juego de NES Super Spike V'Ball, un juego arcade que ofrece una perspectiva única del vóley playa.

Localization.Title: V-Ball: Beach Volley Heroes
Localization.Description: V-Ball - Beach Volley Heroes è il sequel del gioco per NES Super Spike V'Ball, un gioco arcade che si occupa di beach volley in un modo molto speciale.

Localization.Title: V-Ball: Beach Volley Heroes
Localization.Description: V-Ball - Beach Volley Heroes is the sequel to the NES game Super Spike V'Ball, an arcade game that deals with beach volleyball in a very special way.

Localization.Title: No Fear Downhill Mountain Biking
Localization.Description: Pedal power meets polygons in this no-holds-barred cycling experience. Not just another racing game, this title successfully captures the essence and devil-may-care style of competition mountain bike racing.

Localization.Title: No Fear Downhill Mountain Biking
Localization.Description: No Fear Downhill Mountain Biking est un jeu de courses sorti sur Playstation.

Localization.Title: No Fear Downhill Mountain Biking
Localization.Description: Vergiss deine Ängste! Deine Fähigkeiten, Deine Balance und Deine Nerven werden auf eine Zerreißprobe gestellt. Rase im Kamikaze Style dem Tal entgegen. Shredde hart am Abgrund entlang. Du bist allein auf Dich gestellt, gegen die Natur und Deine Gegner.

Localization.Title: No Fear Downhill Mountain Biking
Localization.Description: No Fear Downhill Mountain Biking es un juego de simulador de carreras de bicicletas de montaña en la que gráficos, sonido y jugabilidad son las claves para conseguir una experiencia de simulación muy conseguida.

Localization.Title: No Fear Downhill Mountain Biking
Localization.Description: Dimentica le tue paure! Le tue capacità, il tuo equilibrio ei tuoi nervi saranno messi a dura prova. Corri verso la valle in stile kamikaze. Taglia forte lungo il bordo. Sei da solo, contro la natura e contro i tuoi avversari. Devi farlo.

Localization.Title: No Fear Downhill Mountain Biking
Localization.Description: Pedal power meets polygons in this no-holds-barred cycling experience. Not just another racing game, this title successfully captures the essence and devil-may-care style of competition mountain bike racing.

Localization.Title: Hard Boiled
Localization.Description: Hard Boiled is based on the Dark Horse comic book of the same name by Frank Miller and Geof Darrow. The comic was regarded as the most violent according to Wikipedia.

Localization.Title: Hard Boiled
Localization.Description: Hard Boiled est basé sur la bande dessinée Dark Horse du même nom de Frank Miller et Geof Darrow. La bande dessinée était considérée comme la plus violente selon Wikipédia.

Localization.Title: Hard Boiled
Localization.Description: „Hard Boiled“ basiert auf dem gleichnamigen Comic „Dark Horse“ von Frank Miller und Geof Darrow. Der Comic galt laut Wikipedia als der gewalttätigste.

Localization.Title: G-Police (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: After a violent interstellar resource war, mega-corporations seize power from the remnants of Earth's governments and lead humanity's way into the colonization of space.

Localization.Title: G-Police (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: G-police est un jeu Playstation dans lequel vous incarnez un agent de police dans un monde futuriste. Votre but est de combattre la criminalité dans les villes et les colonies, et ce à bord d'un hélicoptère de combat.

Localization.Title: G-Police (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Im Jahr 2089 versinken die Städte auf der Erde und ihre Außenposten auf anderen Planeten in einem Sumpf aus Habgier, Korruption und Gewalt.

Localization.Title: G-Police (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Despega con tu helicóptero de combate Destructor perfectamente equipado. Vuela 35 formidables misiones por las ciudades corruptas de Callisto y demuestra tu destreza en este increíble juego estratégico de acción en tres dimensiones

Localization.Title: G-Police (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: G-Police è uno sparatutto in stile arcade ambientato all'interno delle cupole coloniali di Callisto.

Localization.Title: Adidas Power Soccer 2
Localization.Description: adidas Power Soccer 2 is the second main game in the Psygnosis series and was made by a different development studio.

Localization.Title: Adidas Power Soccer 2
Localization.Description: Adidas Power Soccer 2 est un jeu de football orienté arcade sur Playstation. En tout, 200 équipes de la saison 1997/1998 sont disponibles.

Localization.Title: Adidas Power Soccer 2
Localization.Description: Diese Fortsetzung des frühen PlayStation-Bestsellers adidas Power Soccer erweitert die Anzahl der verfügbaren Ligen (von 3 auf 5, wobei Spanien und Italien zu den englischen, französischen und deutschen Ligen hinzukommen) und eine „Top 20“-Division mit e

Localization.Title: Adidas Power Soccer 2
Localization.Description: adidas Power Soccer 2 es el segundo juego principal de la serie Psygnosis y fue realizado por un estudio de desarrollo diferente.

Localization.Title: Adidas Power Soccer 2

Localization.Title: Adidas Power Soccer 2

Localization.Title: Rascal
Localization.Description: In Rascal, you must rescue your kidnapped father, a professor, from the clutches of the evil Chronon. Chronon is using Rascal's father to perfect time travel for his evil plans and it's up to you to stop him.

Localization.Title: Rascal
Localization.Description: Rascal est un jeu d'aventure/plates-formes sur Playstation. Dans la peau de Rascal vous êtes chargé de parcourir six mondes différents dans le but de sauver votre père retenu prisonnier par un méchant nommé Chronos.

Localization.Title: Rascal
Localization.Description: Rascal der freche Strolch wühlt Tag für Tag in den Forschungsergebnissen seines Vaters herum. Bis er eines Tages einen glänzenden Blechzylinder mit lauter bunten Hebeln entdeckt.

Localization.Title: Rascal
Localization.Description: En Rascal, debes rescatar a tu padre secuestrado, un profesor, de las garras del malvado Chronon. Chronon está usando al padre de Rascal para viajar en el tiempo y cumplir con sus malvados planes y depende de ti el detenerlo.

Localization.Title: Rascal
Localization.Description: In Rascal, you must rescue your kidnapped father, a professor, from the clutches of the evil Chronon. Chronon is using Rascal's father to perfect time travel for his evil plans and it's up to you to stop him.

Localization.Title: Rascal
Localization.Description: In Rascal, you must rescue your kidnapped father, a professor, from the clutches of the evil Chronon. Chronon is using Rascal's father to perfect time travel for his evil plans and it's up to you to stop him.

Localization.Title: Formula 1 97
Localization.Description: In Formula 1: Championship Edition, players select from 13 Formula 1 teams, 17 different circuits, and a variety of spec cars.

Localization.Title: Formula 1 97
Localization.Description: Formula 1 97 est un jeu de simulation de F1 sur Playstation. Il s'agit d'une version améliorée du premier jeu Formula One édité par Psygnosis. Le titre comporte cette fois les pistes, coureurs et voitures de la saison 1997.

Localization.Title: Formula 1 97
Localization.Description: Realismus wird bei F1'97 ebenso wie Detailtreue großgeschrieben.

Localization.Title: Formula 1 97
Localization.Description: En Formula 1: Championship Edition, los jugadores seleccionan entre 13 equipos de Fórmula 1, 17 circuitos diferentes y una variedad de autos especiales.

Localization.Title: Formula 1 97
Localization.Description: In Formula 1: Championship Edition, players select from 13 Formula 1 teams, 17 different circuits, and a variety of spec cars.

Localization.Title: Formula 1 97
Localization.Description: Fórmula 1 97 é um jogo de simulação de F1 em Playstation. É uma versão melhorada do primeiro jogo de Fórmula 1 publicada pela Psygnosis. O título apresenta desta vez as pistas (17), corredores (13 equipas) e carros da época de 1997.

Localization.Title: Colony Wars (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Since 3095, the Earth Empire has spread throughout the universe, taking what it wants and destroying the rest - all in the name of sustaining life on Earth. To the Empire, expansion is of the utmost importance, even above famine, drought and death.

Localization.Title: Colony Wars (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Colony Wars est un jeu d'action sur Playstation. Vous voilà aux commandes d'un vaisseau spatial pour livrer de nombreuses batailles et mener à bien beaucoup de missions dans l'espace.

Localization.Title: Colony Wars (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Seit dem Jahr 3095 hat die Koloniale Navy damit begonnen, sich alles im Universum zunehmen was sie wollen und den Rest zu vernichten - und dass alles zum Wohle der Menschheit.

Localization.Title: Colony Wars (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Desde el año 3095, el Imperio de la Tierra se ha extendido por el universo, tomando todo lo que quiere y destruyendo el resto, todo por mantener la vida en la Tierra.

Localization.Title: Overboard!
Localization.Description: Overboard! (Shipwreckers! in North America) is a top-down adventure game, released by Psygnosis in October 1997. The player controls a pirate ship, shown to be manned by three pirates in cutscenes.

Localization.Title: Overboard!
Localization.Description: Overboard ! est un jeu d'action sur Playstation.

Localization.Title: Overboard!
Localization.Description: In Overboard sucht Ihr gezielt nach Flaschenpost mit den darin enthaltenen Bruchstücken von insgesamt fünf verschollenen Weltkarten.

Localization.Title: Overboard!
Localization.Description: Publicado en 1997 nada menos que por Psygnosis, 'Overboard!' nos ofrecía una propuesta totalmente original, tanto que probablemente no haya habido otro juego igual en toda la historia.

Localization.Title: Overboard!
Localization.Description: Overboard! (Shipwreckers! in North America) è un gioco di avventura top-down, pubblicato da Psygnosis nell'ottobre 1997. Il giocatore controlla una nave pirata, che nei filmati mostra essere presidiata da tre pirati.

Localization.Title: Overboard!
Localization.Description: Overboard! (Shipwreckers! in North America) is a top-down adventure game, released by Psygnosis in October 1997. The player controls a pirate ship, shown to be manned by three pirates in cutscenes.

Localization.Title: Clock Tower
Localization.Description: Jennifer and her friends are adopted by a nice lady named Mary one day. They expect to be going to a wonderful new home, at the Barrows Mansion. There they will live with Mary and Mr. Barrows.

Localization.Title: Clock Tower
Localization.Description: Clock Tower (ou Clock Tower 2 au Japon) sur Playstation est un survival-horror dans lequel vous devez échapper au terrible Scissorman. Armé d'une énorme paire de ciseaux, ce dernier est lancé à votre poursuite pour vous tuer.

Localization.Title: Clock Tower
Localization.Description: Clock Tower ist ein Survival-Horror-Point-and-Click-Adventure, das 1995 von Human Entertainment für den Super Famicom entwickelt und veröffentlicht wurde. Es ist der erste Teil der Clock Tower-Serie.

Localization.Title: Clock Tower
Localization.Description: Un día, Jennifer y sus amigos son adoptados por una agradable dama llamada Mary. Esperan ir a un nuevo hogar maravilloso, en la Mansión Barrows. Allí vivirán con Mary y el Sr. Barrows.

Localization.Title: Broken Helix
Localization.Description: Broken Helix puts you in the boots of an armed marine of a special forces team. You are sent in to a military base which has been taken over by terrorists for unknown reasons. The main character is voiced by Bruce Campbell, star of the Evil Dead movies.

Localization.Title: Broken Helix
Localization.Description: Broken Helix est un jeu d'action à la troisième personne sorti sur Playstation dans lequel vous devez incarner Jack, un marine qui a pour mission de désamorcer une bombe posée par un scientifique dans la très célèbre Zone 51.

Localization.Title: Broken Helix
Localization.Description: Broken Helix versetzt Sie in die Rolle eines bewaffneten Marines einer Spezialeinheit. Sie werden auf eine Militärbasis geschickt, die aus unbekannten Gründen von Terroristen übernommen wurde.

Localization.Title: Broken Helix
Localization.Description: Bruce Campbell es la voz del personaje principal Jake Burton, experto en explosivos. Habla con los personajes y elige tu actitud con más de 95 minutos de diálogo de voz interactiva.

Localization.Title: Broken Helix
Localization.Description: Broken Helix puts you in the boots of an armed marine of a special forces team. You are sent in to a military base which has been taken over by terrorists for unknown reasons. The main character is voiced by Bruce Campbell, star of the Evil Dead movies.

Localization.Title: Bugriders: The Race of Kings
Localization.Description: The King of Entymion, Leptus, is about to die. Rather than hold elections or keep the tradition of primogeniture, the next king will be chosen with a race. Not just any race, but a race in which the participants ride on giant bugs.

Localization.Title: Bugriders : The Race of Kings
Localization.Description: Bugriders : The Race of Kings est un jeu de courses Playstation. Choisissez votre monture insectoïde parmi les 8 proposées et mettez vos concurrents au défi sur les 6 pistes que comporte le titre pour devenir le nouvel Empereur d'Entymion.

Localization.Title: Bugriders: The Race of Kings
Localization.Description: Der König von Entymion, Leptus, steht kurz vor dem Tod. Anstatt Wahlen abzuhalten oder die Tradition der Erstgeburt beizubehalten, wird der nächste König durch ein Rennen gewählt.

Localization.Title: Bugriders: The Race of Kings
Localization.Description: The King of Entymion, Leptus, is about to die. Rather than hold elections or keep the tradition of primogeniture, the next king will be chosen with a race. Not just any race, but a race in which the participants ride on giant bugs.

Localization.Title: Bugriders: The Race of Kings
Localization.Description: Il re di Entymion, Leptus, sta per morire. Piuttosto che tenere elezioni o mantenere la tradizione della primogenitura, il prossimo re sarà scelto con una gara. Non una gara qualsiasi, ma una gara in cui i partecipanti cavalcano su insetti giganti.

Localization.Title: Bugriders: The Race of Kings

Localization.Title: WarCraft II: The Dark Saga
Localization.Description: Warcraft II: The Dark Saga brings the successful Warcraft series to the console world, delivering medieval orc vs. human combat to those that haven't been able to enjoy the PC version.

Localization.Title: WarCraft II : The Dark Saga
Localization.Description: Warcraft II : The Dark Saga est un jeu de stratégie en temps réel sur Playstation. Le titre est en fait une réunion de Warcraft II : Tides of Darkness et son extension Beyond The Dark Portal.

Localization.Title: WarCraft II: The Dark Saga
Localization.Description: Warcraft II: The Dark Saga ist ein Echtzeit-Strategiespiel für Playstation. Der Titel ist eigentlich eine Wiedervereinigung von Warcraft II: Tides of Darkness und seiner Erweiterung Beyond The Dark Portal.

Localization.Title: WarCraft II: The Dark Saga
Localization.Description: Warcraft II: The Dark Saga es un juego de estrategia en tiempo real para Playstation. El título es en realidad una fusión de Warcraft II: Tides of Darkness y su extensión Beyond The Dark Portal.

Localization.Title: WarCraft II: The Dark Saga

Localization.Title: WarCraft II: The Dark Saga
Localization.Description: Warcraft II: The Dark Saga é um jogo de estratégia em tempo real no Playstation. O título é na verdade uma reunião de Warcraft II: Tides of Darkness e sua extensão Beyond The Dark Portal.

Localization.Title: NASCAR 98
Localization.Description: Racing at a speed of over 200 miles per hour isn't legal on the interstate. But you can do it all you want on your television screen in NASCAR 98. There are 24 top NASCAR drivers present in this game, each driving his signature car.

Localization.Title: NASCAR 98
Localization.Description: Nascar Racing 98 sur Playstation permet de revivre la compétition automobile "Nascar" célèbre aux Etats-Unis, où de puissants bolides s'affrontent sur des circuits ovales à des vitesses vertigineuses. Le jeu retrace la saison 1998 de ce sport.

Localization.Title: NASCAR 98
Localization.Description: Rennen mit einer Geschwindigkeit von mehr als 200 Meilen pro Stunde sind auf der Autobahn nicht erlaubt. Aber Sie können in NASCAR 98 auf Ihrem Fernsehbildschirm alles tun, was Sie wollen.

Localization.Title: NASCAR 98
Localization.Description: Correr a una velocidad de más de 200 millas por hora no es legal en la interestatal. Pero puede hacerlo todo lo que quiera en la pantalla de su televisor en NASCAR 98. Elije 24 pilotos de NASCAR en este juego, cada uno conduciendo su auto característico.

Localization.Title: NASCAR 98
Localization.Description: Racing at a speed of over 200 miles per hour isn't legal on the interstate. But you can do it all you want on your television screen in NASCAR 98. There are 24 top NASCAR drivers present in this game, each driving his signature car.

Localization.Description: Racing at a speed of over 200 miles per hour isn't legal on the interstate. But you can do it all you want on your television screen in NASCAR 98. There are 24 top NASCAR drivers present in this game, each driving his signature car.

Localization.Title: Dynasty Warriors
Localization.Description: Dynasty Warriors is a 3D-based fighting game developed by an in-house development studio within Koei. Koei is better known for its third century China war simulations. This is their first crack at the whip with a PlayStation fighting game.

Localization.Title: Dynasty Warriors
Localization.Description: Une curiosité pour Koei (du moins au moment de sa sortie) - un jeu de combat en 3D rempli d'action.

Localization.Title: Dynasty Warriors
Localization.Description: Dynasty Warriors ist ein 3D-basiertes Kampfspiel, das von einem hauseigenen Entwicklungsstudio innerhalb von Koei entwickelt wurde. Koei ist vor allem für seine China-Kriegssimulationen aus dem dritten Jahrhundert bekannt.

Localization.Title: Dynasty Warriors
Localization.Description: Una curiosidad de Koei (al menos en el momento de su lanzamiento): un juego de lucha en 3D lleno de acción.

Localization.Title: Dynasty Warriors
Localization.Description: Dynasty Warriors is a 3D-based fighting game developed by an in-house development studio within Koei. Koei is better known for its third century China war simulations. This is their first crack at the whip with a PlayStation fighting game.

Localization.Title: Dynasty Warriors
Localization.Description: Dynasty Warriors é um jogo de luta baseado em 3D desenvolvido por um estúdio de desenvolvimento interno da Koei. A Koei é mais conhecida por suas simulações de guerra na China do século III.

Localization.Title: F1 World Grand Prix: 1999 Season
Localization.Description: F1 World Grand Prix: 1999 Season from Eidos Interactive is a Formula One racing game that is based on the 1999 world championship racing event. The game puts you in the seat of the 22nd participant in the races.

Localization.Title: F1 World Grand Prix : 1999 Season
Localization.Description: F1 World Grand Prix est une simulation de courses de Formule 1 sur Playstation. Le jeu se base sur le championnat de 1998 et inclut les pilotes et écuries officiels. Les modes classiques Championship, Time Trial et Single Race sont présents.

Localization.Title: F1 World Grand Prix: 1999 Season
Localization.Description: F1 World Grand Prix: 1999 Season von Eidos Interactive ist ein Formel-1-Rennspiel, das auf dem Weltmeisterschafts-Rennereignis 1999 basiert. Das Spiel versetzt Sie auf den Platz des 22. Teilnehmers der Rennen.

Localization.Title: F1 World Grand Prix: 1999 Season
Localization.Description: F1 World Grand Prix: 1999 Season de Eidos Interactive es un juego de carreras de Fórmula Uno basado en el evento de carreras del campeonato mundial de 1999. El juego te pone en el asiento del 22º participante en las carreras.

Localization.Title: F1 World Grand Prix: 1999 Season
Localization.Description: F1 World Grand Prix: 1999 Season di Eidos Interactive è un gioco di corse di Formula 1 basato sull'evento di corse del campionato mondiale del 1999. Il gioco ti mette al posto del 22esimo partecipante alle gare.

Localization.Title: F1 World Grand Prix: 1999 Season
Localization.Description: F1 World Grand Prix: 1999 Season from Eidos Interactive is a Formula One racing game that is based on the 1999 world championship racing event. The game puts you in the seat of the 22nd participant in the races.

Localization.Title: Shadow Master
Localization.Description: Trading ships have not been reaching your planet recently. It is feared that ships passing through a an outer area get caught in a war between two distant alien races.

Localization.Title: Shadow Master
Localization.Description: Dans Shadow Master, vous incarnez un puissant vaisseau tout-terrain envoyé sur une planète pour détruire les armées de Shadow Master qui menacent le monde. Ce jeu d'action sur Playstation vous propose des graphismes entièrement en 3D.

Localization.Title: Shadow Master
Localization.Description: In Shadow Master schlüpfen Sie in die Rolle eines mächtigen Geländeschiffs, das zu einem Planeten geschickt wird, um die Armeen des Shadow Master zu vernichten, die die Welt bedrohen. Dieses Actionspiel auf der Playstation bietet vollständig 3D-Grafik.

Localization.Title: Shadow Master
Localization.Description: En un universo futurista las fuerzas de Shadow Master están atacando tu planeta. Estás a los mandos de un poderoso vehículo blindado todo terreno y debes destruir a sus enemigos en un mundo tridimensional.

Localization.Title: Shadow Master
Localization.Description: Le navi commerciali non hanno raggiunto il tuo pianeta di recente. Si teme che le navi che attraversano un'area esterna vengano coinvolte in una guerra tra due lontane razze aliene.

Localization.Title: Shadow Master
Localization.Description: Trading ships have not been reaching your planet recently. It is feared that ships passing through a an outer area get caught in a war between two distant alien races.

Localization.Title: The Last Report
Localization.Description: Evidence : The Last Report est un jeu d'aventure à la troisième personne sur Playstation.

Localization.Title: The Last Report
Localization.Description: Evidence: The Last Report ist ein Third-Person-Abenteuerspiel für Playstation. Ihr Name ist Daniel Singer, ein Reporter für Channel Z, und Ihre Ex-Freundin wurde direkt nach Ihrer Trennung ermordet, was Sie zum Hauptverdächtigen macht.

Localization.Title: The Last Report
Localization.Description: Evidence: The Last Report es una aventura detectivesca en la que encarnas a Daniel Singer, reportero de Channel Z.

Localization.Description: The Lost World: Jurassic Park is a 3D action video game released in 1997 for the Sega Saturn and Sony PlayStation.

Localization.Title: The Lost World : Jurassic Park
Localization.Description: Disponible sur Playstation, The Lost World est un jeu d'action dans lequel vous retournerez sur le fameux "Site B" de l'île infestée de dinosaures d'Isla Sorna.

Localization.Title: The Lost World: Jurassic Park
Localization.Description: Jagen Sie oder Sie werden gejagt auf dieser wilden, von Dinosauriern beherrschten Insel - der "Vergessenen Welt".

Localization.Title: The Lost World: Jurassic Park
Localization.Description: Caza o sé cazado en la isla salvaje de El Mundo Perdido gobernada por dinosaurios. Acecha, persigue y lucha en entornos 3D donde la selección natural es la única ley. Controla 5 personajes diferentes incluyendo el feroz T-Rez. 40 niveles emocionantes.

Localization.Title: The Lost World: Jurassic Park

Localization.Description: Madden NFL 98 est un jeu de football américain sur Playstation. Retrouvez plus de 120 équipes officielles de la saison en cours mais également des équipes de légende.

Localization.Title: Madden NFL 98
Localization.Description: Erlebe mit Madden NFL 98 die Welt des Profi-Football! Spiele mit den größten Teams und erobere das Spielfeld. 30 NFL Stadien stehen dir für spannende Matches zur Verfügung.

Localization.Description: La jugabilidad es muy similar a las otras ediciones, con la temporada completa, así como los playoffs y el Superbowl. Todo se presenta en estilo televisivo, con análisis y comentarios.

Localization.Title: NBA Live 98
Localization.Description: NBA Live 98 ist ein Basketball-Videospiel, das auf der National Basketball Association und dem vierten Teil der NBA Live-Serie basiert. Das Cover zeigt Tim Hardaway von der Miami Heat. Das Spiel wurde von EA Sports entwickelt und 1997 veröffentlicht.

Localization.Description: PGA Tour 98 ups the ante for PlayStation golf games with five actual PGA Tour courses, including Pebble Beach, Colonial Country Club, TPC of Scottsdale, the Bay Hill Club and TPC at Sawgrass.

Localization.Description: Le PGA Tour 98 relève la barre des jeux de golf sur PlayStation avec cinq parcours réels du PGA Tour, dont Pebble Beach, Colonial Country Club, TPC of Scottsdale, Bay Hill Club et TPC at Sawgrass.

Localization.Title: Auto Destruct
Localization.Description: Auto Destruct involves mission-based car combat. Unlike similar titles such as Destruction Derby and Twisted Metal, this doesn't focus on arena-type face-offs with multiple opponents.

Localization.Title: Auto Destruct
Localization.Description: Auto Destruct est un jeu d'action sur Playstation. Dans un futur plus ou moins proche, votre famille a été tuée par un mystérieux culte religieux. Pour les venger, vous vous engagez dans une organisation clandestine, destinée à détruire ledit culte.

Localization.Title: Auto Destruct
Localization.Description: Der dunkle, kalte Geist eines mystischen Kults vergiftet langsam die Städte der Welt.

Localization.Title: Auto Destruct
Localization.Description: Auto Destruct involucra combate de autos basado en la misión. A diferencia de títulos similares como Destruction Derby y Twisted Metal, esto no se enfoca en enfrentamientos de tipo arena con múltiples oponentes.

Localization.Title: Road Rash 3D
Localization.Description: Road Rash 3-D is a 3D installment of the motorcycle racing game in which participants utilize violent tactics to win.

Localization.Title: Road Rash 3D
Localization.Description: Road Rash 3-D sur Playstation est un jeu de motos en 3D qui sort des sentiers battus. Vous disputez des courses sur le continent américain, le plus souvent sur route, où vous avez la possibilité d'infliger les pires crasses à vos opposants.

Localization.Title: Road Rash 3D
Localization.Description: Rasen Sie mit Road Rash 3D durch eine völlig neue 3D-Welt und erleben Sie Hunderte von Kilometern atemberaubende Action auf mörderischem Asphalt.

Localization.Title: Road Rash 3D
Localization.Description: Por primera vez, Road Rash está ahora en pleno 3-D, con el mismo juego que hizo las versiones anteriores adictivas desde el primer juego Road Rash que fue lanzado en 1991 !.

Localization.Title: Road Rash 3D
Localization.Description: Road Rash 3-D è una versione 3D del gioco di corse motociclistiche in cui i partecipanti utilizzano tattiche violente per vincere.

Localization.Title: Road Rash 3D
Localization.Description: Road Rash 3-D is a 3D installment of the motorcycle racing game in which participants utilize violent tactics to win.

Localization.Title: FIFA : Road to World Cup 98
Localization.Description: FIFA 98 est un jeu de football sorti sur Playstation. Les professionnels de la balle au pied se retrouvent encore sur le gazon pour se disputer l'honneur d'être les premiers à mettre le cuir au fond du filet.

Localization.Title: FIFA: Road to World Cup 98
Localization.Description: ...die WM Qualifikation Fußball hautnah. Wählen Sie unter 172 Nationen und bringen Sie Ihr Team zur WM 98 nach Frankreich.

Localization.Title: FIFA: Road to World Cup 98
Localization.Description: FIFA 98 es un juego de fútbol lanzado para Playstation. Los profesionales del balón se encuentran en la hierba para competir por el honor de ser el primero en poner el cuero en la red. Se puede jugar con tus amigos en el modo multijugador.

Localization.Title: FIFA: Road to World Cup 98
Localization.Description: FIFA 98 è un gioco di calcio rilasciato per Playstation. I professionisti del pallone si incontrano sull'erba per contendersi l'onore di essere i primi a mettere la palla in rete. Puoi giocare con i tuoi amici in modalità multiplayer.

Localization.Title: Nuclear Strike
Localization.Description: Having fought in the Middle East, South America, within the United States, and in the former U.S.S.R, your path has now lead you to the heart of Asia. You follow the trail of Colonel LeMonde, who has terrorized South East Asia.

Localization.Title: Nuclear Strike

Localization.Description: Xako and Mia live for one thing and one thing only: to catch serious air performing mind-blowing stunts on their hoverdeks. A hoverdek is best described as a hovering skateboard, it works the same way but there are no wheels and it's constantly floating.

Localization.Description: With no stat tweaking and no licenses, Tennis Arena is arcade-style tennis at its most fundamental. What you have here is single-match or tournament play for up to four players with wacky characters and a few different courts to play on.

Localization.Title: Tennis Arena
Localization.Description: Disponible sur Playstation, Tennis Arena vous plongera dans le monde de la balle jaune, de façon fun et intuitive. Au lieu de trouver des joueurs connus, vous pourrez choisir des personnages originaux et hauts en couleur aux techniques délirantes.

Localization.Title: Tennis Arena
Localization.Description: Tennis Arena ist auf der Playstation verfügbar und lässt Sie auf unterhaltsame und intuitive Weise in die Welt des gelben Balls eintauchen.

Localization.Title: Warzone 2100

Localization.Title: Shadow Man
Localization.Description: Sei l'Uomo Ombra, una persona che può passare dal mondo dei morti a quello dei vivi. In Shadow Man la tua missione è impedire a 5 serial killer di portare l'armageddon totale. Nel mondo dei vivi, sei mortale e hai armi convenzionali.

Localization.Title: Test Drive 4
Localization.Description: Test Drive 4 is a racing game featuring ten different cars - five modern supercars such as the Jaguar XJ220 and TVR Cerbera, and five vintage muscle cars including three Chevrolet models. Each car has its own realistic physics, with challenging handling.

Localization.Title: Command & Conquer: Red Alert (Disc 1) (Allies)
Localization.Description: Command & Conquer: Red Alert for the PlayStation is a conversion of the hit computer game of the same name. The game involves commanding either the Soviets or Allies through 14 different missions, which vary depending on the side you choose.

Localization.Title: Command & Conquer : Red Alert (Disc 1) (Allies)
Localization.Description: Command & Conquer : Alerte Rouge est un jeu de stratégie sorti sur Playstation. La Seconde Guerre mondiale n'a jamais eu lieu et l'URSS est devenue aussi puissante que les Etats-Unis.

Localization.Title: Command & Conquer: Red Alert (Disc 1) (Allies)
Localization.Description: Alles hört auf Ihr Kommando. Ein ganzes Arsenal an High-Tech Waffen steht Ihnen zur Verfügung. Aber Vorsicht: Ihre Gegner schlafen nicht. Verteidigen Sie Ihre Basis mit Tesla-Spulen, Flak-Geschützen, Tarnbunkern und Wachhunden.

Localization.Title: Command & Conquer: Red Alert (Disc 1) (Allies)
Localization.Description: Command & Conquer: Red Alert es un juego de estrategia lanzado para Playstation. La Segunda Guerra Mundial nunca tuvo lugar y la URSS se hizo tan poderosa como los Estados Unidos.

Localization.Title: Command & Conquer: Red Alert (Disc 1) (Allies)
Localization.Description: Command & Conquer: Red Alert for the PlayStation is a conversion of the hit computer game of the same name. The game involves commanding either the Soviets or Allies through 14 different missions, which vary depending on the side you choose.

Localization.Title: Command & Conquer: Red Alert (Disc 1) (Allies)
Localization.Description: Command & Conquer: Red Alert for the PlayStation is a conversion of the hit computer game of the same name. The game involves commanding either the Soviets or Allies through 14 different missions, which vary depending on the side you choose.

Localization.Title: NBA Live 98
Localization.Description: NBA Live '98 brings the furious action of 5 on 5 basketball to the Playstation. A fully licensed product, this title includes all 29 NBA teams from the 1997-'98 season.

Localization.Title: NBA Live 98
Localization.Description: NBA Live 98 permet aux fans de basket de vivre sur leur Playstation la saison intégrale du championnat américain de 1998 en compagnie de toutes les équipes et tous les joueurs officiels. Plusieurs niveaux de difficulté et modes de jeu sont proposés.

Localization.Title: NBA Live 98
Localization.Description: NBA Live 98 ist ein Basketball-Videospiel, das auf der National Basketball Association und dem vierten Teil der NBA Live-Serie basiert. Das Cover zeigt Tim Hardaway von der Miami Heat. Das Spiel wurde von EA Sports entwickelt und 1997 veröffentlicht.

Localization.Title: NBA Live 98
Localization.Description: NBA Live 98 permite a los fanáticos del baloncesto vivir en su Playstation la temporada completa del Campeonato Americano de 1998 con todos los equipos y todos los jugadores oficiales. Se ofrecen varios niveles de dificultad y modos de juego.

Localization.Title: Pax Corpus
Localization.Description: In the game you play an attractive female mercenary who knows little about her own past. You've been hired to discover the secrets surrounding Corporation Alcyon's Pax Corpus Project, and eliminate any threat it poses to the free world.

Localization.Title: Pax Corpus
Localization.Description: Pax Corpus sur Playstation est un jeu de tir à la 3ème personne qui vous propose d'incarner une mercenaire qui en connaît très peu sur son passé. Son contrat l'amène à enquêter sur une organisation et en découvrir les secrets.

Localization.Title: Pax Corpus
Localization.Description: Pax Corpus für Playstation ist ein Third-Person-Shooter, bei dem Sie als Söldnerin spielen können, die nur sehr wenig über ihre Vergangenheit weiß. Sein Auftrag führt ihn dazu, eine Organisation zu untersuchen und ihre Geheimnisse aufzudecken.

Localization.Title: Crime Killer
Localization.Description: Ever since the beginning of the 21st Century, crime has been getting worse and more severe. Criminals patrol the streets like everyday citizens looting valuables, murdering arch rivals, and speeding up and down city streets and highways.

Localization.Title: Crime Killer
Localization.Description: Crime Killer est un jeu d'action futuriste sur Playstation dans lequel vous incarnez un policier qui poursuit des criminels, les courses vous confrontent à eux tout en n'oubliant pas que les voitures sont armées, ce qui pimente les courses.

Localization.Title: Crime Killer
Localization.Description: Im Jahr 2115 haben sich Recht und Ordnung wieder mal rar gemacht. Chaos und Anarchie herrschen auf den Straßen.

Localization.Title: Crime Killer
Localization.Description: Desde principios del siglo XXI, la delincuencia se ha agravado y se ha vuelto cada vez peor.

Localization.Title: Broken Helix
Localization.Description: Broken Helix puts you in the boots of an armed marine of a special forces team. You are sent in to a military base which has been taken over by terrorists for unknown reasons. The main character is voiced by Bruce Campbell, star of the Evil Dead movies.

Localization.Title: Broken Helix
Localization.Description: Broken Helix est un jeu d'action à la troisième personne sorti sur Playstation dans lequel vous devez incarner Jack, un marine qui a pour mission de désamorcer une bombe posée par un scientifique dans la très célèbre Zone 51.

Localization.Title: Broken Helix
Localization.Description: Broken Helix versetzt Sie in die Rolle eines bewaffneten Marines einer Spezialeinheit. Sie werden auf eine Militärbasis geschickt, die aus unbekannten Gründen von Terroristen übernommen wurde.

Localization.Title: Broken Helix
Localization.Description: Bruce Campbell es la voz del personaje principal Jake Burton, experto en explosivos. Habla con los personajes y elige tu actitud con más de 95 minutos de diálogo de voz interactiva.

Localization.Title: Broken Helix
Localization.Description: Broken Helix puts you in the boots of an armed marine of a special forces team. You are sent in to a military base which has been taken over by terrorists for unknown reasons. The main character is voiced by Bruce Campbell, star of the Evil Dead movies.

Localization.Title: Broken Helix
Localization.Description: Broken Helix puts you in the boots of an armed marine of a special forces team. You are sent in to a military base which has been taken over by terrorists for unknown reasons. The main character is voiced by Bruce Campbell, star of the Evil Dead movies.

Localization.Title: Riven: The Sequel to Myst (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Riven is a sequel to Myst, and is very similar to its predecessor in gameplay style, controls, and visual presentation. The game world is presented as a series of computer-generated still screens; the player explores it in a point-and-click fashion.

Localization.Title: Riven : The Sequel to Myst (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Riven : La Suite de Myst est un jeu de réflexion/aventure sur Playstation. Vous êtes convoqué par Atrus qui a besoin de vous pour libérer sa femme Catherine.

Localization.Title: Riven: The Sequel to Myst (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Riven ist das Sequel zu Myst, und entspricht vom Gameplay eins zu eins dem Vorgänger. Die Welt wurde damals auf SCI Graphics Rechnern generiert, durch die sich der Spieler in Point and Click Manier klickt. Interaktion ist an diversen Hotspots möglich.

Localization.Title: Riven: The Sequel to Myst (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Riven es la secuela de Myst y es muy similar a su predecesor en estilo de juego, controles y presentación visual. El mundo del juego se presenta como una serie de pantallas fijas generadas por computadora; el jugador lo explora apuntando y haciendo clic.

Localization.Title: Riven: The Sequel to Myst (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Riven is a sequel to Myst, and is very similar to its predecessor in gameplay style, controls, and visual presentation. The game world is presented as a series of computer-generated still screens; the player explores it in a point-and-click fashion.

Localization.Title: Riven: The Sequel to Myst (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Riven é uma sequência de Myst e é muito semelhante ao seu antecessor em estilo de jogo, controles e apresentação visual.

Localization.Title: Dragon Ball: Final Bout
Localization.Description: After achieving cult hit status around the globe, Dragon Ball GT has finally arrived in the U.S. This polygon rendered fighting game features 10 of the best warriors from the animated television series going head-to-head in a no-holds-barred tournament.

Localization.Title: Dragon Ball : Final Bout
Localization.Description: Dragon Ball : Final Bout sur Playstation est un jeu de baston dans lequel les personnages créés par Akira Toriyama s'explosent en 3D. Selon votre technique de combat, vous pouvez améliorer vos compétences.

Localization.Title: Dragon Ball: Final Bout
Localization.Description: Dragon Ball GT: Final Bout ist ein Dragonball-Game und ist weiters in Japan, Nordamerika und Europa für die PlayStation erschienen. Ferner ist es das erste Spiel seiner Art, das vollständig in 3D gerendert wurde.

Localization.Title: Dragon Ball: Final Bout
Localization.Description: Dragon Ball: Final Bout, es un videojuego del género de lucha en 3D, basado en el universo de Dragon Ball, para PlayStation en 1997. Es el primer juego de Dragon Ball que tiene gráficos completamente poligonales.

Localization.Title: Dragon Ball: Final Bout
Localization.Description: Dragon Ball: Final Bout, è un gioco di combattimento 3D, basato sull'universo di Dragon Ball, per PlayStation nel 1997. È il primo gioco di Dragon Ball ad avere una grafica completamente poligonale.

Localization.Title: Dragon Ball: Final Bout
Localization.Description: Dragon Ball: Final Bout é um jogo de luta em que personagens criados por Akira Toriyama lutam em 3D. Dependendo da sua técnica de luta, você pode melhorar suas habilidades.

Localization.Title: Pandemonium 2
Localization.Description: In this sequel to Pandemonium, the player once again controls the young aspiring sorceress Nikki and the court jester Fargus with his puppet buddy Sid.

Localization.Title: Pandemonium 2
Localization.Description: Pandemonium 2 est un jeu de plates-formes sur Playstation. Vous devez tracer votre chemin à travers 19 niveaux, ayant chacun une mission différente.

Localization.Title: Pandemonium 2
Localization.Description: Pandemonium 2 ist ein Plattformspiel für Playstation. Sie müssen sich durch 19 Level kämpfen, jedes mit einer anderen Mission.

Localization.Title: Pandemonium 2
Localization.Description: Únete a Nikki, Fargus y Sid en su misión para capturar el Cometa de las Infinitas Posibilidades. Nikki, la sexy hechicera y Fargus, el pirómano arlequín, han crecido y desarrollado nuevos talentos.

Localization.Title: Pandemonium 2
Localization.Description: Unisciti a Nikki, Fargus e Sid nella loro missione per catturare la Cometa delle Infinite Possibilità. Nikki, la maga sexy, e Fargus, l'arlecchino incendiario, sono cresciuti e hanno sviluppato nuovi talenti.

Localization.Title: Pandemonium 2
Localization.Description: Nesta sequência de Pandemonium, o jogador controla mais uma vez a jovem aspirante a feiticeira Nikki e o bobo da corte Fargus com seu amigo fantoche Sid.

Localization.Title: Resident Evil: Director's Cut
Localization.Description: After receiving a distress call from the Bravo Team, an elite group from S.T.A.R.S (Special Tactics And Rescue Squad) flew into the desolate Raccoon City.

Localization.Title: Resident Evil : Director's Cut
Localization.Description: Maîtrisez votre peur... et lancez vous dans l'expérience la plus terrifiante de votre vie. Zombies assoiffés de sang. Animaux mutants. Serpents monstrueux. De dangereux mystères vous menacent à chaque tournant.

Localization.Title: Resident Evil: Director's Cut
Localization.Description: Umbrella Corporation, ein geheimnisumwobener Pharmakonzern in der Nähe der Kleinstadt Raccoon City.

Localization.Title: Resident Evil: Director's Cut
Localization.Description: Enfréntate a tus miedos... En la experiencia de suspense y terror definitiva. Zombies sedientos de sangre. Bestias mutantes. Serpientes monstruosas. Misterios ocultos acechan en cada esquina. La pesadilla reside en este premiado juego de survival horror.

Localization.Title: Resident Evil: Director's Cut
Localization.Description: Dopo aver ricevuto una chiamata di soccorso dal Bravo Team, un gruppo d'élite di S.T.A.R.S (Special Tactics And Rescue Squad) è volato nella desolata Raccoon City.

Localization.Title: Resident Evil: Director's Cut
Localization.Description: Resident Evil: Director's Cut é um horror de sobrevivência no Playstation. Esta é uma versão sem censura do Resident Evil 1. Comparado com o último, o aplicativo é diferenciado por novas cenas, novos ângulos de visão, cenas adicionais e novos trajes.

Localization.Title: Resident Evil 2 (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Resident Evil 2 takes place two months after the events of the first game and is set in Raccoon City, a Midwestern mountain community whose residents have been turned into zombies by the T-virus, a biological weapon developed by the pharmaceutical compan

Localization.Title: Resident Evil 2 (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Souvenez-vous, tout avait commencé dans le laboratoire d'un sinistre manoir, lieu de développement du Virus-T, une toxine capable de faire muter des gènes et qui devait servir à la fabrication d'armes biologiques.

Localization.Title: Resident Evil 2 (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Der Anfang allen Übels war ein Unfall im Versuchslabor eines Herrenhauses. Dieser Unfall hatte zur Folge, daß der T-Virus, ein bilogischer Kampfstoff der Umbrella Corporation, freigesetzt wurde.

Localization.Title: Resident Evil 2 (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: ¿Podrás sobrevivir al horror? Primero fue el desastre en la mansión. Umbrella Corp. desarrolló el T-Virus, una toxina de mutación genética destinada al armamento biológico. Después de su liberación, seres vivientes mutaron en criaturas putrefactas.

Localization.Title: Resident Evil 2 (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Resident Evil 2 è ambientato due mesi dopo gli eventi del primo gioco ed è ambientato a Raccoon City, una comunità montana del Midwest i cui residenti sono stati trasformati in zombi dal T-virus, un'arma biologica sviluppata dalla società farmaceutica Um

Localization.Title: Resident Evil 2 (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: O jogo se passa dois meses após os acontecimentos de Resident Evil, na cidade de Raccon City, localizada na região centro-oeste dos Estados Unidos.

Localization.Title: Bust-A-Move 3 DX

Localization.Title: Bust-A-Move 3 DX
Localization.Description: Así que crees que has dominado todos los juegos de rompecabezas del universo, ¿eh? Bueno, piénsalo de nuevo. Bust-a-Move 3 te hará comer un humilde pastel hasta que te duela el estómago.

Localization.Description: Following the success of the first Actua Soccer game, a sequel was likely. The game is fast-paced with more of an action than simulation feel, and an emphasis on ground play rather than heading.

Localization.Title: Actua Soccer 2
Localization.Description: Actua Soccer 2 est un jeu de football sur Playstation. Le soft vous propose de choisir une formation au sein de nombreuses équipes internationales. Les règles sont respectées pour une immersion plus réaliste.

Localization.Title: Actua Soccer 2
Localization.Description: Nach dem Erfolg des ersten Actua Soccer-Spiels war eine Fortsetzung wahrscheinlich. Das Spiel ist rasant, hat eher ein Action- als ein Simulationsgefühl und legt den Schwerpunkt eher auf das Bodenspiel als auf das Kopfballspiel.

Localization.Title: Actua Soccer 2
Localization.Description: Tras el éxito del primer juego de Actua Soccer, una secuela era lo más probable. El juego es rápido con más acción que sensación de simulación, y un énfasis en la estrategia de juego.

Localization.Title: DBZ: Dead Ball Zone
Localization.Description: This high speed futuristic sports game pits two teams of armed psychotics against each other in a brutal (and lethal) fight to launch a ball into the opponents net over, around, or through the opponent.

Localization.Title: DBZ : Dead Ball Zone
Localization.Description: Dead Ball Zone sur Playstation est un mix entre du football américain et du handball. Le jeu se déroule dans un futur proche, les joueurs portent des éxosquelettes qui permettent d'accroître leur puissance.

Localization.Title: DBZ: Dead Ball Zone
Localization.Description: In diesem futuristischen Hochgeschwindigkeitssportspiel treten zwei Teams bewaffneter Psychotiker in einem brutalen (und tödlichen) Kampf gegeneinander an, bei dem es darum geht, einen Ball über, um oder durch den Gegner ins gegnerische Netz zu schleuder

Localization.Title: DBZ: Dead Ball Zone
Localization.Description: Este juego deportivo futurista de alta velocidad enfrenta a dos equipos de psicóticos armados entre sí en una lucha brutal (y letal) para lanzar un balón a la red del oponente por encima, alrededor o a través del mismo.

Localization.Title: DBZ: Dead Ball Zone

Localization.Title: Hogs of War
Localization.Description: Hogs of War is a turn-based tactics video game developed by Infogrames Studios and published by Infogrames Europe. The game is set in a First World War-era where anthropomorphic pigs engage in combat.

Localization.Title: Hogs of War
Localization.Description: Hogs Of War est un jeu d'action/stratégie sur Playstation. Avec votre armée de fidèles gorets vous devez éliminer toute forme d'opposition pour conquérir les îles de la Poritanie.

Localization.Title: Hogs of War
Localization.Description: Der Spieler übernimmt die Kontrolle über Schweine in Soldatenuniform, die mit einer Vielzahl Waffen ausgerüstet sind. In jeder Runde können die Soldaten bewegt werden und einen Schuss abgeben. Das Ziel ist es, alle gegnerischen Soldaten auszulöschen.

Localization.Title: Hogs of War
Localization.Description: Marranos en Guerra es un juego de estrategia y acción basado en turnos. Si te gustó cualquier entrega de Worms, este juego ofrece un estilo similar pero en un entorno totalmente 3D.

Localization.Title: Hogs of War
Localization.Description: Il giocatore prende il controllo dei maiali in uniforme da soldato, che sono dotati di una varietà di armi. In ogni round i soldati possono essere spostati e sparare un colpo. L'obiettivo è spazzare via tutti i soldati nemici.

Localization.Title: Hogs of War
Localization.Description: O jogador assume o controle dos porcos em uniforme de soldado, que são equipados com uma variedade de armas. Em cada rodada os soldados podem ser movidos e disparar um tiro. O objetivo é acabar com todos os soldados inimigos.

Localization.Title: Actua Golf 3
Localization.Description: Actua Golf 3 is a golf simulation game featuring eight courses. You can completely customize your own character. With a new character you start with amateur tournaments until you have removed your handicap.

Localization.Title: Actua Golf 3
Localization.Description: Actua Golf 3 est une simulation de golf sur Playstation. Amateurs de plein air, de green, de birdy... Actua Golf 3 ne peut que vous plaire. Les quatre modes de jeu sont Pro Tour+, Rapide, Chrono et Drapeau.

Localization.Title: Actua Golf 3
Localization.Description: Actua Golf 3 ist ein Golfsimulationsspiel mit acht Golfplätzen. Sie können Ihren eigenen Charakter vollständig anpassen. Mit einem neuen Charakter beginnen Sie mit Amateurturnieren, bis Sie Ihr Handicap entfernt haben.

Localization.Title: Actua Golf 3
Localization.Description: Actua Golf 3 es una simulación de golf en PlayStation. amantes del aire libre, verde, birdy ... Actua Golf 3 sólo le puede complacer. Cuatro modos de juego Pro Tour + Fast, Chrono y la bandera. Mostrar su talento en más de 8 diferentes emocionante viaje.

Localization.Title: Actua Golf 3
Localization.Description: Actua Golf 3 è un gioco di simulazione di golf con otto campi. Puoi personalizzare completamente il tuo personaggio. Con un nuovo personaggio inizi con i tornei amatoriali fino a quando non hai rimosso il tuo handicap.

Localization.Title: Actua Golf 3
Localization.Description: Actua Golf 3 é um jogo de simulação de golfe com oito campos. Você pode personalizar completamente seu próprio personagem. Com um novo personagem você começa com torneios amadores até que você tenha removido seu handicap.

Localization.Title: Men in Black: The Game
Localization.Description: Now It's Your Turn - Men in Black: The Game. Protecting the Earth from the scum of the universe. They are the best kept secret in the universe.

Localization.Title: Men in Black : The Game
Localization.Description: Men in Black : The Game est un jeu d'action sur Playstation inspiré du célèbre blockbuster américain. Vous incarnez à tour de rôle les personnages interprétés par Will Smith, Tommy Lee Jones et Linda Fiorentino.

Localization.Title: Men in Black: The Game
Localization.Description: Jetzt sind Sie dran – Men in Black: Das Spiel. Die Erde vor dem Abschaum des Universums schützen. Sie sind das bestgehütete Geheimnis im Universum.

Localization.Title: Men in Black: The Game
Localization.Description: Es tu turno! Men in Black: The game. Debes proteger la tierra de la escoria del universo.

Localization.Title: Men in Black: The Game
Localization.Description: Now It's Your Turn - Men in Black: The Game. Protecting the Earth from the scum of the universe. They are the best kept secret in the universe.

Localization.Title: Men in Black: The Game
Localization.Description: Agora é sua vez - Homens de Preto: O Jogo. Protegendo a Terra da escória do universo. Eles são o segredo mais bem guardado do universo.

Localization.Title: Sentinel Returns
Localization.Description: Enter a surreal world where you must battle the Sentinel and his sentries over 650 chequered, 3D landscapes. Energy and movement are completely redefined in this unique blend of arcade and strategy elements.

Localization.Title: Sentinel Returns
Localization.Description: Sentinel Returns est un jeu d'aventure/réflexion sur Playstation. La Sentinel observe tous vos faits et gestes. Vous êtes entré dans son monde et elle le sait. La Sentinel espère se venger et se nourrit de vos erreurs.

Localization.Title: Sentinel Returns
Localization.Description: Sentinel Returns ist ein Abenteuer-/Puzzlespiel für Playstation. Der Sentinel beobachtet jede Ihrer Bewegungen. Du bist in ihre Welt eingetreten und sie weiß es. Der Sentinel sinnt auf Rache und ernährt sich von Ihren Fehlern.

Localization.Title: Sentinel Returns
Localization.Description: El Sentinel sabe que has penetrado en su mundo y observa cada uno de tus movimientos. Para vengarse espera a que cometas tu siguiente paso en falso, 650 niveles en total, estrategias de pesadilla, claustrofobia y vértigo. Con la música de John Carpenter.

Localization.Title: Sentinel Returns

Localization.Title: Kick Off World
Localization.Description: The first Kick Off game for Playstation offers the ability to play with teams from Europe, South America and Africa. The game is not just about playing, coaching is equally important as you head for the Reebook DMX Super League.

Localization.Title: Kick Off World
Localization.Description: Le premier jeu Kick Off pour Playstation offre la possibilité de jouer avec des équipes d'Europe, d'Amérique du Sud et d'Afrique. Le but n'est pas seulement de jouer, le coaching est tout aussi important.

Localization.Description: Das erste Kick Off-Spiel für Playstation bietet die Möglichkeit, mit Teams aus Europa, Südamerika und Afrika zu spielen. Bei dem Spiel geht es nicht nur ums Spielen, auch das Coaching ist auf dem Weg zur Reebook DMX Super League wichtig.

Localization.Title: Mega Man 8
Localization.Description: Deux robots de l'espace s'écrasent sur Terre. Envoyé enquêter sur les lieux du crash, Mega Man découvre que le professeur Wily a déjà entrepris des fouilles.

Localization.Title: Mega Man 8
Localization.Description: Eine gigantische Raumexplosion sendet zwei seltsame Meteore, die auf die Erde stürzen. Der Anruf geht aus und Mega Man macht sich bereit. Dort sieht er seinen Erzrivalen, Dr.

Localization.Title: Mega Man 8
Localization.Description: La trama comienza cuando el héroe robótico Mega Man es llamado para investigar una misteriosa lectura de energía proveniente del reciente choque de un meteorito contra una isla. Mega Man descubre que su archienemigo, el Dr.

Localization.Title: Mega Man 8
Localization.Description: La trama inizia quando l'eroe robotico Mega Man viene chiamato per indagare su una misteriosa lettura di energia da una meteora recente che ha colpito un'isola.

Localization.Title: Mega Man 8
Localization.Description: Uma gigantesca explosão espacial envia dois estranhos meteoros para a Terra. Ao chegar no local, Mega Man vê seu arqui-rival, Dr. Wiley, fugindo da cena, segurando um dos misteriosos meteoros metálicos.

Localization.Title: Rushdown
Localization.Description: Travel across the globe to compete in Africa, Europe, America, Asia, and Japan. Choose one of four 3D characters and their equipment for each event.

Localization.Title: Rushdown
Localization.Description: Rushdown sur Playstation est un jeu de sport regroupant 3 disciplines bien connues des amateurs de sensations fortes : le VTT, le kayak et le snowboard.

Localization.Title: Rushdown
Localization.Description: Rushdown auf der Playstation ist ein Sportspiel, das drei Disziplinen kombiniert, die bei Adrenalinjunkies bekannt sind: Mountainbiken, Kajakfahren und Snowboarden.

Localization.Title: Rushdown
Localization.Description: Viaja por todo el mundo para competir en África, Europa, América, Asia y Japón. Elija uno de los cuatro personajes 3D y su equipo para cada evento.

Localization.Title: Kensei: Sacred Fist
Localization.Description: Enter a martial arts tournament in KENSEI: Sacred Fist. Choose from 22 different characters and use the training mode to learn each character?s unique moves and combinations. When you are ready to fight, play the Normal mode and unlock new characters.

Localization.Title: Kensei : Sacred Fist
Localization.Description: Kensei Sacred Fist est un jeu de combat sorti sur Playstation. Dans ce jeu, vous pourrez combattre contre la console ou contre un joueur humain avec 22 personnages différents. Seuls 9 d'entre eux sont accessibles dès le début du jeu.

Localization.Title: Kensei: Sacred Fist
Localization.Description: Nehmen Sie an einem Kampfsportturnier in KENSEI: Sacred Fist teil. Wählen Sie aus 22 verschiedenen Charakteren und nutzen Sie den Trainingsmodus, um die einzigartigen Bewegungen und Kombinationen jedes Charakters zu erlernen.

Localization.Title: Kensei: Sacred Fist
Localization.Description: Kensei Sacred Fist es un juego de lucha para Playstation. En este juego puedes luchar contra la consola o contra un jugador humano con 22 personajes diferentes.

Localization.Title: Kensei: Sacred Fist
Localization.Description: Partecipa a un torneo di arti marziali in KENSEI: Sacred Fist. Scegli tra 22 personaggi diversi e usa la modalità allenamento per imparare le mosse e le combinazioni uniche di ogni personaggio.

Localization.Title: Kensei: Sacred Fist
Localization.Description: Enter a martial arts tournament in KENSEI: Sacred Fist. Choose from 22 different characters and use the training mode to learn each character?s unique moves and combinations. When you are ready to fight, play the Normal mode and unlock new characters.

Localization.Title: Dodgem Arena
Localization.Description: Dodgem Arena is a futuristic racing game that takes place in 2049 AD. In this racing sport four players controlling so-called dodgems hover in huge bowl-shaped arenas, while trying to shoot an ice hockey puck into a goal at the top of the arena.

Localization.Title: Dodgem Arena
Localization.Description: Nous sommes en 2049 après JC. Les matériaux supraconducteurs et l'hydrogène de haute qualité ont changé le monde. Des compétiteurs qualifiés du monde entier participent au sport passionnant de Dodgem.

Localization.Title: Dodgem Arena
Localization.Description: Dodgem Arena ist ein futuristisches Rennspiel, das im Jahr 2049 n. Chr. spielt.

Localization.Title: Forsaken
Localization.Description: Earth has been rendered largely uninhabitable by an explosion caused by a bungled experiment. Few would dare to brave its unstable and searing environments - only those determined to grab a little of its remaining gold.

Localization.Title: Forsaken
Localization.Description: Forsaken est un jeu d'action sur Playstation. Le soft vous plonge dans un univers post-apocalyptique sur la Terre.

Localization.Title: Forsaken
Localization.Description: Die Erde wurde durch eine Explosion, die auf ein misslungenes Experiment zurückzuführen war, weitgehend unbewohnbar gemacht.

Localization.Title: Forsaken
Localization.Description: La Tierra se ha vuelto en gran parte inhabitable por una explosión causada por un experimento fallido. Pocos se atreverían a desafiar sus entornos inestables y abrasadores, solo aquellos decididos a apoderarse de un poco del oro restante.

Localization.Title: Forsaken
Localization.Description: Forsaken è un gioco d'azione su Playstation. Il software vi immerge in un mondo post-apocalittico sulla Terra. Come spazzino su una motocicletta, si viaggia attraverso installazioni militari, centrali nucleari e molti altri ambienti variegati.

Localization.Title: Forsaken
Localization.Description: Forsaken é um jogo de ação para Playstation. O software mergulha você em um universo pós-apocalíptico na Terra. Assim, na pele de um catador de motocicleta, você atravessa instalações militares, usinas nucleares e muitos outros ambientes variados.

Localization.Title: Skullmonkeys
Localization.Description: Skullmonkeys is the successor title to The Neverhood, which came out only on PC (and, in Japan, as "Klaymen Klaymen" on PSX). The game is an old-school jump and run type of game, with a large number of FMVs. The entire game is molded in clay.

Localization.Title: Skullmonkeys
Localization.Description: Rapide et funky, écrasez les Skullmonkeys! Doté d'un postérieur-tueur et d'armes aussi bizarres qu'étranges, vous incarnez Klaymen, le tout dernier héros en pâte à modeler.

Localization.Title: Skullmonkeys
Localization.Description: Bewaffnet mit einem Killer-Hintern und einer Ladung verrückter Waffen kämpfen Sie als Klaymen, dem letzten seiner Art. Sie rennen, springen und schießen, um Ihren geliebten Heimatplaneten vor dem Bösewicht Klogg und seinen Skullmonkeys zu retten.

Localization.Title: Skullmonkeys
Localization.Description: En el lejano planeta Idznak viven los Skull Monkeys, (una raza de humanoides con un coeficiente intelectual de -300).

Localization.Title: Skullmonkeys
Localization.Description: Skullmonkeys è il successore di The Neverhood, uscito solo su PC (e, in Giappone, come "Klaymen Klaymen" su PSX). Il gioco è un tipo di gioco "salta e corri" della vecchia scuola, con un gran numero di FMV. L'intero gioco è modellato in argilla.

Localization.Title: Skullmonkeys
Localization.Description: No distante planeta Idznak vivem os Skull Monkeys, (uma raça de humanóides com um QI de -300).

Localization.Title: Skullmonkeys
Localization.Description: Bewaffnet mit einem Killer-Hintern und einer Ladung verrückter Waffen kämpfen Sie als Klaymen, dem letzten seiner Art. Sie rennen, springen und schießen, um Ihren geliebten Heimatplaneten vor dem Bösewicht Klogg und seinen Skullmonkeys zu retten.

Localization.Title: Skullmonkeys
Localization.Description: En el lejano planeta Idznak viven los Skull Monkeys, (una raza de humanoides con un coeficiente intelectual de -300).

Localization.Title: Skullmonkeys
Localization.Description: Skullmonkeys è il successore di The Neverhood, uscito solo su PC (e, in Giappone, come "Klaymen Klaymen" su PSX). Il gioco è un tipo di gioco "salta e corri" della vecchia scuola, con un gran numero di FMV. L'intero gioco è modellato in argilla.

Localization.Description: No distante planeta Idznak vivem os Skull Monkeys, (uma raça de humanóides com um QI de -300).

Localization.Title: Skullmonkeys

Localization.Title: Riven: The Sequel to Myst (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Riven is a sequel to Myst, and is very similar to its predecessor in gameplay style, controls, and visual presentation. The game world is presented as a series of computer-generated still screens; the player explores it in a point-and-click fashion.

Localization.Description: Riven ist das Sequel zu Myst, und entspricht vom Gameplay eins zu eins dem Vorgänger. Die Welt wurde damals auf SCI Graphics Rechnern generiert, durch die sich der Spieler in Point and Click Manier klickt. Interaktion ist an diversen Hotspots möglich.

Localization.Title: Rat Attack
Localization.Description: Play as one of the Scratch Cats, an elite superhero team, who are out to save the world from Washington and Jefferson, two evil mutant space rats who wish to enslave the world in rats. Explore each puzzle level and wipe out the rat threat.

Localization.Description: Rat Attack est un jeu d'action sur Playstation. Le but : éradiquer les rats de l'espace venus envahir notre belle Terre.

Localization.Description: Steigen Sie auf Ihre Skier oder Ihr Snowboard und rüsten Sie sich gut für das kalte Wetter, denn auf der Piste wird es heiß! Snow Racer 98 ist ein Schnee-Rennspiel für Playstation.

Localization.Title: Alundra
Localization.Description: Alundra is a boy who can step into other people's dreams. His own dreams tell him to go to the village Inoa. The ship on which Alundra is coming to the village goes down, but Alundra himself is washed up on a beach near the village.

Localization.Title: Alundra
Localization.Description: The Adventures of Alundra est un jeu d'action/aventure sur Playstation. Vous incarnez Alundra, un jeune héros qui a le pouvoir d'entrer dans les rêves.

Localization.Title: Alundra
Localization.Description: Dunkle Visionen suchen Alundra heim. Quälende Alpträume, die ihn auf die Spur des Bösen führen - und in ein phantastisches Abenteuer im Kampf gegen die Mächte der Finsternis.

Localization.Title: Alundra
Localization.Description: Alundra, el protagonista, realiza un viaje para salvar a la aldea de Inoa de las garras del malvado Melzas, que penetra en las mentes de las personas mientras éstas duermen.

Localization.Title: Alundra
Localization.Description: Alundra è un ragazzo che può entrare nei sogni degli altri. I suoi stessi sogni gli dicono di andare al villaggio Inoa. La nave su cui Alundra sta arrivando al villaggio affonda, ma Alundra stesso viene trascinato su una spiaggia vicino al villaggio.

Localization.Title: Alundra
Localization.Description: Alundra, a protagonista, faz uma viagem para salvar a aldeia de Inoa das garras de Melzas, que penetra na mente das pessoas enquanto dormem. Combinando aventura gráfica e arcade, ele é embalado com ação e enigmas complicados.

Localization.Title: Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six
Localization.Description: Using a Tom Clancy storyline and characters, Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six for the PlayStation is an original first person 3D shooter where you take control of an elite counter-terrorist organization named Rainbow Six.

Localization.Title: Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six
Localization.Description: Rainbow Six sur Playstation est un jeu d'action tactique dans lequel vous incarnez un membre de l'élite anti-terroriste.

Localization.Title: Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six
Localization.Description: Eine einzigartige Kombination aus Strategie und 3D-Action. In 16 Einsätzen einer Elite-Antiterroreinheit muss der Spieler sowohl taktisches Feingefühl bei der Planung sowie schnelle Reflexe bei der Ausführung unter Beweis stellen.

Localization.Title: Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six
Localization.Description: Rainbow Six se centra en el año 1999. La unidad anti-terrorista está liderada por John Clark y Domingo Chavez.

Localization.Title: Need for Speed III: Hot Pursuit
Localization.Description: Need for Speed returns with all the exotic supercars, tracks, and race modes you've come to expect--but reengineered for higher performance, stunning realism, and fierce competition.

Localization.Title: Need for Speed III : Hot Pursuit
Localization.Description: Need for Speed 3 : Hot Pursuit est un jeu de courses de voitures sur Playstation. Le soft offre un sentiment de vitesse grisant, de beaux graphismes, et de pur plaisir de conduite.

Localization.Title: Need for Speed III: Hot Pursuit
Localization.Description: Genießen Sie es, Ihr Traumauto durch verzwickte und plötzlich auftauchende Haarnadelkurven zu lenken oder rasend schnell einen Canyon zu durchfahren.

Localization.Title: Need for Speed III: Hot Pursuit
Localization.Description: Need For Speed regresa con todos los exoticos super autos, tracks y modos de carrera que esperabas, pero con la reingenieria necesaria para mayor performance, realismo impresionante, y dura competencia.

Localization.Description: Erleben Sie die Hölle auf Erden, wenn Sie versuchen Diablo, den Fürsten der Finsternis, und seine bösen Untergebenen zu besiegen.

Localization.Title: Diablo
Localization.Description: Ambientato nel regno di Khanduras, locato nel mondo di Sanctuary, Diablo lascia controllare al giocatore l'eroe solitario dedito a eradicare La minaccia di Diablo, il signore del terrore.

Localization.Description: Diablo se passa no fictício Reino de Khanduras, localizado no mundo de Sanctuary. O jogador controla o herói solitário que batalha para livrar o mundo de Diablo, Senhor do Terror.

Localization.Description: This sequel to Warhammer: Shadow Of The Horned Rat is an overhead role playing game in which you play Morgan Bernhardt. The game consists of a series of battles where you view the battle from overhead via a rotatable view.

Localization.Title: Warhammer : Dark Omen
Localization.Description: Warhammer : Dark Omen est un jeu de rôle sur Playstation. Ce titre est la suite de Shadow of the Horned Rat. Vous y incarnez Morgan Bernhardt.

Localization.Title: Warhammer: Dark Omen
Localization.Description: Warhammer: Dark Omen ist ein taktisches Echtzeit‑Strategiespiel und die direkte Fortsetzung von Shadow of the Horned Rat.

Localization.Title: Warhammer: Dark Omen
Localization.Description: Warhammer: Dark Omen es un juego de rol para Playstation. Este título es la secuela de Shadow of the Horned Rat. Juegas como Morgan Bernhardt, incluye una parte estrategia, ya que también lideras un ejército y decides cuándo y donde luchar.

Localization.Title: Wayne Gretzky's 3D Hockey '98
Localization.Description: Wayne Gretzky's 3D Hockey '98 is an ice hockey game for the Nintendo 64 and PlayStation, it was released in 1997. The game is endorsed by hockey star, Wayne Gretzky and is the sequel to Wayne Gretzky's 3D Hockey.

Localization.Title: Wayne Gretzky's 3D Hockey '98
Localization.Description: Wayne Gretzky's 3D Hockey '98 sur PS1, propose deux modes jeu jeu : Arcade ou Simulation. La simulation est plus réaliste tandis que le mode arcade ne compte aucune pénalité. Choisissez une des 26 équipes dispos et chaussez vos patins.

Localization.Title: Wayne Gretzky's 3D Hockey '98
Localization.Description: Wayne Gretzkys 3D Hockey '98 für PS1 bietet zwei Spielmodi: Arcade oder Simulation. Die Simulation ist sehr realistisch, da der Arcade-Modus nicht mit Strafen einhergeht. Wählen Sie eines von 26 verfügbaren Geräten und Schuhen für Ihre Füße.

Localization.Title: Wayne Gretzky's 3D Hockey '98
Localization.Description: Wayne Gretzky's 3D Hockey '98 para PS1 ofrece dos modos de juego: Arcade y Simulación. El modo Simulación es más realista, mientras que el modo Arcade no tiene penalizaciones. Elige uno de los 26 equipos disponibles y ponte los patines.
