Localization.Title: Hugo
Localization.Description: The first two Playstation games of Hugo are ports of the old Amiga games. The charming little Troll - Hugo - must fight the evil witch Scylla, who has captured Hugo's family and is trying to steal Hugolina's Beauty (Hugo's wife).

Localization.Title: Hugo
Localization.Description: Hugo sur Playstation est un jeu de plates-formes. Basé sur le célèbre dessin animé, ce titre permet de s'adonner à des mini-jeux dans la peau de notre bien-aimé Hugo.

Localization.Title: Hugo
Localization.Description: Das Original vom Fernsehen - jetzt auf der Playstation. Hugo ist zurück mit mehr Levels als je zuvor! Sie führen durch zahllose Abenteuer, bestehen mit ihm tödliche Herausforderungen, kurzum: Sie haben alle Hände voll zu tun.

Localization.Title: Hugo
Localization.Description: Las aventuras de Hugo ...

Localization.Title: Hugo
Localization.Description: L'originale dalla televisione - ora su Playstation. Hugo è tornato con più livelli che mai! Lo condurrai attraverso innumerevoli avventure, supererai sfide mortali, insomma: hai le mani in pasta.

Localization.Title: Hugo
Localization.Description: O jogador deve ajudar Hugo em cenários tão diferentes como: Avião, no qual Hugo deve se esquivar dos balões com bombas mortais, Skate, no qual Hugo deve se esquivar de pedras e buracos escarpados e muito mais - 7 cenários no total antes de Hugo finalment

Localization.Title: Test Drive 5
Localization.Description: Hear the roar of engines and smell the burnt rubber as you step up to take the challenge of Test Drive 5. Race on 18 different tracks in locations such as Moscow, Honolulu, Tokyo and the winding streets of San Francisco.

Localization.Title: Test Drive 5
Localization.Description: Test Drive 5 est un jeu de courses sur Playstation. Le titre propose 28 voitures différentes, modernes ou anciennes, 17 circuits qui vous emmènent des steppes russes enneigées aux volcans hawaïens.

Localization.Title: Test Drive 5
Localization.Description: Hören Sie das Dröhnen der Motoren und riechen Sie den verbrannten Gummi, wenn Sie sich der Herausforderung von Test Drive 5 stellen. Fahren Sie auf 18 verschiedenen Strecken an Orten wie Moskau, Honolulu, Tokio und den kurvigen Straßen von San Francisco.

Localization.Title: Test Drive 5
Localization.Description: Escucha el rugido de los motores y huele la goma quemada mientras te enfrentas al desafío de Test Drive 5. Corre en 18 pistas diferentes en lugares como Moscú, Honolulu, Tokio y las sinuosas calles de San Francisco.

Localization.Title: Test Drive 5
Localization.Description: Hear the roar of engines and smell the burnt rubber as you step up to take the challenge of Test Drive 5. Race on 18 different tracks in locations such as Moscow, Honolulu, Tokyo and the winding streets of San Francisco.

Localization.Description: Blast Radius est un jeu de tir spatial sur Playstation dans lequel vous incarnez Kayne le seul survivant d'une mythique unité de combat : l'Escouade des Loups.

Localization.Title: Blast Radius
Localization.Description: In Blast Radius sind Sie das letzte Mitglied eines Elite-Jagdgeschwaders und befinden sich mitten im Konflikt zwischen dem bösen Kotan-Kai und dem unterwürfigen Vorn. Die Vorn möchten, dass du sie verteidigst.

Localization.Title: Blast Radius

Localization.Title: Mega Man X4
Localization.Description: It is the year 21XX, following years after the Doppler rebellion and the revelation of the Maverick Virus, a new global Reploid military force, apty-named Repliforce, was founded to combat the ongoing Maverick attacks and uprisings.

Localization.Title: Mega Man X4
Localization.Description: Quelque temps après la crise de Dopplertown vu dans Mega Man X3, le Laboratoire du Dr. Cain reçoit le mandat de concevoir une force militaire complémentaire aux Chasseurs de Mavericks.

Localization.Title: Mega Man X4
Localization.Description: In Mega Man X4 schlüpfen Sie in die Rolle von Mega Man und seinem Freund Zero. Neue farbenprächtige X-Hunter Level mit brillant ausgearbeiteten Details, herausfordernden Spiel-Passagen, Geheimräumen und versteckten Gegenständen.

Localization.Title: Mega Man X4
Localization.Description: lgún tiempo después de la Dopplertown de crisis, Caín laboratorios recibe el mandato de desarrollar una fuerza militar complementarias Hunters Mavericks. Esta fuerza armada en su totalidad de reploides, nacido bajo el nombre de "Repliforce".

Localization.Description: Phat Air Extreme Snowboarding is an snowboarding game that let you choose from five differents characters to compete in six different disciplines which are split into nine different levels.

Localization.Title: Phat Air : Extreme Snowboarding
Localization.Description: Phat Air Extreme Snowboarding est un jeu de snowboard qui vous permet de choisir parmi cinq personnages différents pour vous affronter dans six disciplines différentes réparties sur neuf niveaux.

Localization.Title: Phat Air: Extreme Snowboarding
Localization.Description: Phat Air Extreme Snowboarding ist ein Snowboard-Spiel, bei dem Sie aus fünf verschiedenen Charakteren auswählen können, um in sechs verschiedenen Disziplinen anzutreten, die in neun verschiedene Level unterteilt sind.

Localization.Title: Phat Air: Extreme Snowboarding
Localization.Description: Phat Air Extreme Snowboarding es un juego de snowboard que te permite elegir entre cinco personajes diferentes para competir en seis disciplinas diferentes que se dividen en nueve niveles diferentes.

Localization.Description: Test Drive Off-Road 2 follows the path set by 1997's Test Drive: Off-Road as you drive across twelve courses (based on six locales: Morocco, Hawaii, Mojave, Santa Cruz, Switzerland and Wales) in your quest to win races on the World Tour.

Localization.Title: Test Drive 4x4
Localization.Description: Disponible sur Playstation, Test Drive Off-Road 2 est un jeu de courses de 4x4 dont la particularité est de proposer une simulation jouissive hors des pistes des circuits.

Localization.Title: Test Drive 4x4
Localization.Description: Test Drive Off-Road 2 ist auf der Playstation erhältlich und ein 4x4-Rennspiel, dessen Besonderheit darin besteht, eine unterhaltsame Simulation abseits der Rennstrecken zu bieten.

Localization.Title: Castrol Honda Superbike Racing
Localization.Description: Castrol Honda Superbike Racing is a simulation-style racing game featuring the Honda RVF-RC45 motorbike and 14 real-world venues.

Localization.Title: Castrol Honda Superbike Racing
Localization.Description: Castrol Honda Superbike World Champions est un jeu de courses de motos sur Playstation. Trois modes de jeu sont disponibles au guidon de votre Honda RVF-RC45 : championnat, course libre et entrainement.

Localization.Title: Castrol Honda Superbike Racing
Localization.Description: Castrol Honda Superbike Racing ist ein Rennspiel im Simulationsstil mit dem Motorrad Honda RVF-RC45 und 14 realen Austragungsorten.

Localization.Title: Castrol Honda Superbike Racing
Localization.Description: En Castrol Honda Superbike Raging tendrás las motos más increíbles, los circuitos más difíciles, cientos de detalles técnicos y la sensación de volar por el asfalto a más de 300 km/h.

Localization.Title: Castrol Honda Superbike Racing
Localization.Description: Castrol Honda Superbike Racing is a simulation-style racing game featuring the Honda RVF-RC45 motorbike and 14 real-world venues.

Localization.Title: Moto Racer 2
Localization.Description: Delphine's sequel to their popular Moto Racer, MR2 features more tracks, several different "championship" modes, an enhanced Direct3D graphics engine, and a track editor for creating your own superbike and motocross tracks.

Localization.Title: Moto Racer 2
Localization.Description: Moto Racer 2 sur Playstation est un jeu de courses pour tous les fans de deux-roues. 6 disciplines sont représentées : Superbike, Traffic, Trial, Supercross, Motocross et Freestyle.

Localization.Title: Moto Racer 2
Localization.Description: Erlebe den ultimativen Kick. Fahre Cross- oder Strassenrennen unter schwierigen Wetterbedingungen. Mache atemberaubend hohe Sprünge. Erlebe packende Renn-Action gegen einen Mitspieler und erstelle deine eigenen herausfordernden Rennstrecken.

Localization.Title: Moto Racer 2
Localization.Description: Moto Racer 2 es un juego de carreras para todos los fanáticos de las dos ruedas. Están representadas 6 disciplinas: Superbike, Traffic, Trial, Supercross, Motocross y Freestyle.

Localization.Title: Moto Racer 2
Localization.Description: Moto Racer 2 è un gioco di corse per tutti i fan delle due ruote. Sono rappresentate 6 discipline: Superbike, Traffic, Trial, Supercross, Motocross e Freestyle. Più di 8 motociclette diverse e una moltitudine di circuiti diversi ti aspettano.

Localization.Title: Moto Racer 2
Localization.Description: Moto Racer 2 é um jogo de corrida para todos os fãs de duas rodas. 6 modos estão disponíveis: Superbike, Traffic, Trial, Supercross, Motocross e Freestyle. Mais de 8 motos diferentes e uma infinidade de circuitos estão esperando por você.

Localization.Title: Alundra
Localization.Description: Alundra is a boy who can step into other people's dreams. His own dreams tell him to go to the village Inoa. The ship on which Alundra is coming to the village goes down, but Alundra himself is washed up on a beach near the village.

Localization.Title: Alundra
Localization.Description: The Adventures of Alundra est un jeu d'action/aventure sur Playstation. Vous incarnez Alundra, un jeune héros qui a le pouvoir d'entrer dans les rêves.

Localization.Title: Alundra
Localization.Description: Dunkle Visionen suchen Alundra heim. Quälende Alpträume, die ihn auf die Spur des Bösen führen - und in ein phantastisches Abenteuer im Kampf gegen die Mächte der Finsternis.

Localization.Title: Alundra
Localization.Description: Alundra, el protagonista, realiza un viaje para salvar a la aldea de Inoa de las garras del malvado Melzas, que penetra en las mentes de las personas mientras éstas duermen.

Localization.Title: Alundra
Localization.Description: Alundra è un ragazzo che può entrare nei sogni degli altri. I suoi stessi sogni gli dicono di andare al villaggio Inoa. La nave su cui Alundra sta arrivando al villaggio affonda, ma Alundra stesso viene trascinato su una spiaggia vicino al villaggio.

Localization.Title: Alundra
Localization.Description: Alundra, a protagonista, faz uma viagem para salvar a aldeia de Inoa das garras de Melzas, que penetra na mente das pessoas enquanto dormem. Combinando aventura gráfica e arcade, ele é embalado com ação e enigmas complicados.

Localization.Description: Now It's Your Turn - Men in Black: The Game. Protecting the Earth from the scum of the universe. They are the best kept secret in the universe.

Localization.Description: Men in Black : The Game est un jeu d'action sur Playstation inspiré du célèbre blockbuster américain. Vous incarnez à tour de rôle les personnages interprétés par Will Smith, Tommy Lee Jones et Linda Fiorentino.

Localization.Description: Jetzt sind Sie dran – Men in Black: Das Spiel. Die Erde vor dem Abschaum des Universums schützen. Sie sind das bestgehütete Geheimnis im Universum.

Localization.Description: Es tu turno! Men in Black: The game. Debes proteger la tierra de la escoria del universo.

Localization.Title: Puma Street Soccer
Localization.Description: Puma Street Soccer is a 4-on-4 football game, based on Puma's own version of indoor football. The field is small, surrounded by a hip-height board players can use to bounce the ball.

Localization.Title: Puma Street Soccer
Localization.Description: Puma Street Soccer est un jeu de sport sur Playstation. Le but du jeu : deux équipes de 4 joueurs s'affrontent sur des mini-terrains délimités par des barrières.

Localization.Title: Puma Street Soccer
Localization.Description: Puma Street Soccer ist ein Sportspiel auf der Playstation. Das Ziel des Spiels: Zwei Teams mit je 4 Spielern treten auf durch Absperrungen abgegrenzten Minifeldern gegeneinander an.

Localization.Title: Puma Street Soccer
Localization.Description: Puma Street Soccer es un juego de fútbol 4 contra 4, basado en la propia versión de fútbol indoor de Puma. El campo es pequeño, rodeado por un tablero a la altura de la cadera que los jugadores pueden usar para rebotar la pelota.

Localization.Title: Puma Street Soccer
Localization.Description: Puma Street Soccer is a 4-on-4 football game, based on Puma's own version of indoor football. The field is small, surrounded by a hip-height board players can use to bounce the ball.

Localization.Description: Puma Street Soccer is a 4-on-4 football game, based on Puma's own version of indoor football. The field is small, surrounded by a hip-height board players can use to bounce the ball.

Localization.Title: Colin McRae Rally
Localization.Description: From the makers of Touring Car Championship comes Colin McRae Rally, a rally title hoping to knock V-Rally over. Codemasters has included an collection of fifty two tracks set over five countries including Greece, United Kingdom, Sweden and Australia.

Localization.Title: Colin McRae Rally
Localization.Description: Colin McRae Rally est un jeu de courses sorti sur Playstation. Si les circuits ne sont pas votre fort et que la ville vous agace, alors vous allez adorer les circuits de rallye de ce jeu sponsorisé par le célèbre champion Colin McRae.

Localization.Title: Colin McRae Rally
Localization.Description: Rasen Sie mit halsbrecherischem Tempo durch abwechslungsreichste Landschaften, ihre Gegner sind die Zeit und Naturgewalten.

Localization.Title: Colin McRae Rally
Localization.Description: De los creadores del juego Touring Car Championship viene Colin McRae Rally, un título de rally con la esperanza de destronar a V-Rally.

Localization.Title: Colin McRae Rally
Localization.Description: Dai creatori del Touring Car Championship arriva Colin McRae Rally, un titolo di rally che spera di sconfiggere V-Rally. Codemasters ha incluso una raccolta di cinquantadue brani ambientati in cinque paesi tra cui Grecia, Regno Unito, Svezia e Australia.

Localization.Title: Colin McRae Rally
Localization.Description: Colin McRae Rally é um jogo de corridas que a Codemasters lançou na Playstation, incluiu uma coleção de cinquenta e duas pistas distribuídas por cinco países, incluindo a Grécia, Reino Unido, Suécia e Austrália.

Localization.Title: LEGO Racers
Localization.Description: For the first time, build your favourite Lego carts on your PC using all of the blocks that are available in real life, thanks to the detailed Creation modes.

Localization.Title: LEGO Racers
Localization.Description: Lego Racers est un jeu de courses sorti sur Playstation. Le jeu compte quatre modes de courses : Contre-la-montre, Duel, Course unique et Championnat.

Localization.Title: LEGO Racers
Localization.Description: Rasanter Rennspaß auf vier Rädern! Gestalte Deine individuellen LEGO Autos und Fahrer, und fordere bis zu 5 andere Fahrer heraus. Dann geht es ab durch die Landschaften von 4 LEGO SYSTEM Szenarien.

Localization.Title: LEGO Racers
Localization.Description: Por primera vez, construye tus carritos Lego favoritos en tu PC usando todos los bloques disponibles en la vida real, gracias a los modos de creación detallados.

Localization.Title: LEGO Racers
Localization.Description: Per la prima volta, costruisci i tuoi carrelli Lego preferiti sul tuo PC utilizzando tutti i blocchi disponibili nella vita reale, grazie alle dettagliate modalità di creazione.

Localization.Title: LEGO Racers
Localization.Description: For the first time, build your favourite Lego carts on your PC using all of the blocks that are available in real life, thanks to the detailed Creation modes.

Localization.Title: San Francisco Rush: Extreme Racing
Localization.Description: San Francisco Rush Extreme Racing for the PlayStation is based on the 1996 hit arcade game by Atari Games. Players will race through locations based on San Francisco cities, rural areas, and suburban neighborhoods.

Localization.Title: San Francisco Rush : Extreme Racing
Localization.Description: San Francisco Rush sur Playstation est un jeu de courses futuriste. Il vous faudra franchir l'arrivée en tête tout en évitant des crashs meurtriers. De nombreux raccourcis parsèment les circuits vertigineux, à vous de les découvrir.

Localization.Title: San Francisco Rush: Extreme Racing
Localization.Description: San Francisco Rush auf Playstation ist ein futuristisches Rennspiel. Sie müssen das Ziel als Erster überqueren und dabei tödliche Stürze vermeiden. Auf den schwindelerregenden Rundkursen gibt es viele Abkürzungen, es liegt an Ihnen, sie zu entdecken.

Localization.Title: San Francisco Rush: Extreme Racing
Localization.Description: San Francisco Rush para PlayStation es un juego de carreras futuristas. Debes cruzar la línea de meta por delante de tus adversarios, evitando los accidentes mortales. Dispones de atajos en estos circuitos de vértigo, pero debes descubrirlos.

Localization.Title: San Francisco Rush: Extreme Racing
Localization.Description: San Francisco Rush per PlayStation è un gioco di corse futuristico. Devi tagliare il traguardo davanti ai tuoi avversari, evitando incidenti mortali. Hai delle scorciatoie in questi circuiti vertiginosi, ma devi scoprirle.

Localization.Title: San Francisco Rush: Extreme Racing
Localization.Description: San Francisco Rush Extreme Racing for the PlayStation is based on the 1996 hit arcade game by Atari Games. Players will race through locations based on San Francisco cities, rural areas, and suburban neighborhoods.

Localization.Title: Actua Soccer 3
Localization.Description: Arcade football action is recreated using motion captured graphics. As well as creating a custom tournament, you can play any of 25 leagues, with a total of 450 teams and 10,000 players featured.

Localization.Title: Actua Soccer 3
Localization.Description: Actua Soccer 3 est un jeu de simulation de football sur Playstation. Mettez en place votre stratégie pour votre équipe et en avant pour des matchs de légende.

Localization.Title: Actua Soccer 3
Localization.Description: Arcade-Football-Action wird mithilfe von Motion-Capture-Grafiken nachgebildet. Sie können nicht nur ein individuelles Turnier erstellen, sondern auch in einer von 25 Ligen mit insgesamt 450 Teams und 10.000 Spielern spielen.

Localization.Title: Actua Soccer 3
Localization.Description: Es un simulador de futbol que utiliza captura de movimiento para generar los gráficos. Tienes un torneo personalizado, puedes jugar en cualquiera de las 25 ligas, con un total de 450 equipos y 10,000 jugadores.

Localization.Title: Actua Soccer 3
Localization.Description: Arcade football action is recreated using motion captured graphics. As well as creating a custom tournament, you can play any of 25 leagues, with a total of 450 teams and 10,000 players featured.

Localization.Title: Actua Soccer 3
Localization.Description: A ação de futebol Arcade é recriada usando gráficos capturados em movimento. Além de criar um torneio personalizado, você pode jogar em qualquer uma das 25 ligas, com um total de 450 times e 10.000 jogadores.

Localization.Title: Pro Pinball: Big Race USA
Localization.Description: A whirlwind frenzy of color, sound, and adrenaline-pumping action. Take an exciting ride across the USA for your chance to compete in the big race and win hoards of cash. But watch out for the police car on your tail.

Localization.Title: Pro Pinball : Big Race USA
Localization.Description: Mettez vos sens en éveil en vous lançant dans le flipper le plus sauvage de votre vie, dans un tourbillon de couleurs, de sons et d'adrénaline.

Localization.Title: Pro Pinball: Big Race USA
Localization.Description: Ein Wirbelsturm aus Farben, Sound und adrenalingeladener Action. Machen Sie eine aufregende Fahrt durch die USA und nutzen Sie die Chance, am großen Rennen teilzunehmen und jede Menge Geld zu gewinnen.

Localization.Title: Pro Pinball: Big Race USA
Localization.Description: Un frenesí de color, sonido y acción. Tome un paseo emocionante a través de los EE.UU. con la oportunidad de competir en la gran carrera y ganar tesoros de dinero en efectivo. Pero cuidado con los coches de la policía.

Localization.Title: Pro Pinball: Big Race USA
Localization.Description: A whirlwind frenzy of color, sound, and adrenaline-pumping action. Take an exciting ride across the USA for your chance to compete in the big race and win hoards of cash. But watch out for the police car on your tail.

Localization.Title: Pro Pinball: Big Race USA
Localization.Description: A whirlwind frenzy of color, sound, and adrenaline-pumping action. Take an exciting ride across the USA for your chance to compete in the big race and win hoards of cash. But watch out for the police car on your tail.

Localization.Title: Vigilante 8
Localization.Description: Take the law into your own hands. This game takes place in the Western United States during a time of world-wide oil shortage in 1976. OMAR (Oil Monopoly Alliance Regime) was making money off the shortage, except in the U.S.

Localization.Title: Vigilante 8
Localization.Description: Vigilante 8 est un jeu d'action sur Playstation. Eh oui, vous allez retrouver vos plus bas instincts ! Au volant d'un véhicule des années 70, vous incarnez un membre de gang dont l'unique but est de réduire en poussière les véhicules des gangs rivaux.

Localization.Title: Vigilante 8
Localization.Description: Autokrieg auf den Straßen der USA. Schwingen sie sich ans Steuer von acht (plus vier Bonuswagen) bombastisch ausstaffierten Muscle Cars aus den 70ern. Acht Schauplätze die zerstört werden können.

Localization.Title: Vigilante 8
Localization.Description: Este juego nos sitúa en el oeste de los EE.UU. durante una época de escasez mundial de petróleo en 1976. OMAR (Oil Monopoly Alliance Regime) está haciendo dinero de la escasez de combustible, excepto en los EE.UU, que no dan su brazo a torcer.

Localization.Description: Prendi la legge nelle tue mani. Questo gioco si svolge negli Stati Uniti occidentali durante un periodo di carenza mondiale di petrolio nel 1976.

Localization.Title: International Superstar Soccer Pro '98
Localization.Description: International Superstar Soccer Pro '98 or ISS Pro '98 is a football video game which is a continuation of International Superstar Soccer Pro. Originally released in May, 1998 by Konami Computer Entertainment Tokyo, Inc.

Localization.Title: International Superstar Soccer Pro '98
Localization.Description: International Superstar Soccer Pro 98 est un jeu de foot sur Playstation. Retrouvez les plus grandes équipes internationales ainsi que les différentes équipes nationales des championnats européens.

Localization.Title: International Superstar Soccer Pro '98
Localization.Description: Konamis Meisterserie, die vielfach als die beste Fußballspiel-Reihe bezeichnet wird - ist wieder da.

Localization.Title: International Superstar Soccer Pro '98
Localization.Description: Internacional Superstar Soccer Pro '98 o ISS Pro '98 es un videojuego de fútbol, continuación de Internacional Superstar Soccer Pro, originalmente lanzado en mayo de 1998 por Konami Computer Entertainment Tokyo, Inc.

Localization.Title: International Superstar Soccer Pro '98
Localization.Description: International Superstar Soccer Pro '98 o ISS Pro '98 è un videogioco di calcio che è la continuazione di International Superstar Soccer Pro. Pubblicato originariamente nel maggio 1998 dalla Konami Computer Entertainment Tokyo, Inc.

Localization.Title: International Superstar Soccer Pro '98
Localization.Description: International Superstar Soccer Pro '98 or ISS Pro '98 is a football video game which is a continuation of International Superstar Soccer Pro. Originally released in May, 1998 by Konami Computer Entertainment Tokyo, Inc.

Localization.Title: Azure Dreams
Localization.Description: The huge Monster Tower stands near the village Monsbaiya. It is populated by vicious monsters, and few dare enter it.

Localization.Title: Azure Dreams
Localization.Description: Azure Dreams est un jeu de rôle sur Playstation. Il y a plusieurs années de cela, votre père a disparu en explorant une célèbre tour remplie de trésors, de monstres et de dangers en tout genre.

Localization.Title: Azure Dreams
Localization.Description: Azure Dreams kombiniert traditionelle Rollenspielelemente mit Monsterzucht und Städtebau. Als Sohn des besten Monstertrainers von Monsbaiya besteht Ihre Aufgabe darin, den "Turm der Monster" zu durchsuchen und zahlreiche Aufträge zu erfüllen.

Localization.Title: Azure Dreams
Localization.Description: La enorme Torre Monstruo se encuentra cerca del pueblo de Monsbaiya. Está poblada por monstruos viciosos y pocos se atreven a entrar en ella.

Localization.Title: Azure Dreams
Localization.Description: L'enorme Monster Tower si trova vicino al villaggio Monsbaiya. È popolata da mostri feroci e pochi osano entrarvi.

Localization.Title: Azure Dreams
Localization.Description: The huge Monster Tower stands near the village Monsbaiya. It is populated by vicious monsters, and few dare enter it.

Localization.Title: Batman & Robin
Localization.Description: Batman and Robin the arcade game: The Dynamic Duo from Gotham City finally make their 32-bit debut in the game based on the hit summer movie of 1997. Play as Batman or Robin and help clean up the streets of Gotham City.

Localization.Title: Batman & Robin
Localization.Description: Batman & Robin est un jeu d'action développé par Acclaim sur Playstation. Dans Gotham City entièrement fait en trois dimensions, le soft aura la lourde tâche d'essayer de regrouper toutes les péripéties de l'histoire de Batman.

Localization.Title: Batman & Robin
Localization.Description: Übernimm die Kontrolle über Batman, Robin oder Batgirl, während du versuchst, Gotham City vor dem bösen Mr. Freeze und Poison Ivy zu retten. Mit einer einzigartigen Mischung aus Action, Abenteuer und Fahren in einer kompletten 3-D-Gotham City.

Localization.Title: Batman & Robin
Localization.Description: Las manecillas de un reloj apocalíptico se están moviendo. Quedan 72 horas para que Mr. Freeze convierta a Gotham City en un carámbano gigante. Tú eres el único que puede cambiar el fatal destino de millones de personas inocentes.

Localization.Title: Batman & Robin
Localization.Description: Batman and Robin the arcade game: The Dynamic Duo from Gotham City finally make their 32-bit debut in the game based on the hit summer movie of 1997. Play as Batman or Robin and help clean up the streets of Gotham City.

Localization.Title: Batman & Robin
Localization.Description: Batman & Robin é um jogo de ação e em Gotham City você terá a difícil tarefa de completar todas as aventuras da história do Batman junto ao parceiro Robin e a bonita Batgirl.

Localization.Title: Actua Ice Hockey 2
Localization.Description: Actua Ice Hockey 2 is the follow-up of the official game of the Nagano 1998 Winter Olympics ice hockey tournament, Actua Ice Hockey.

Localization.Title: Actua Ice Hockey 2
Localization.Description: Actua Ice Hockey 2 est une simulation de hockey sur glace sur Playstation. Inspiré des jeux olympiques d'hiver de Nagano en 1998, le jeu se déroule dans une saison en Amérique du Nord inventée de toutes pièces.

Localization.Title: Actua Ice Hockey 2
Localization.Description: Actua Ice Hockey 2 ist der Nachfolger des offiziellen Spiels des Eis Hockey-Turniers der Olympischen Winterspiele 1998 in Nagano, Actua Ice Hockey.

Localization.Title: Actua Ice Hockey 2
Localization.Description: Actua Ice Hockey 2 es una simulación de hockey sobre hielo para Playstation. Inspirado en los Juegos Olímpicos de Invierno de Nagano en 1998, el juego tiene lugar en una temporada ficticia en América del Norte.

Localization.Title: Actua Ice Hockey 2
Localization.Description: Actua Ice Hockey 2 is the follow-up of the official game of the Nagano 1998 Winter Olympics ice hockey tournament, Actua Ice Hockey.

Localization.Title: Actua Ice Hockey 2
Localization.Description: Actua Ice Hockey 2 é o acompanhamento do jogo oficial do torneio de hóquei no gelo dos Jogos Olímpicos de Inverno Nagano 1998, Actua Ice Hockey.

Localization.Title: Adidas Power Soccer 98
Localization.Description: adidas Power Soccer 98 is the fourth and final game in the series. It combines arcade and simulation gameplay and includes twelve tournament types, eleven leagues, 120 national teams and about 30 stadiums.

Localization.Title: Adidas Power Soccer 98
Localization.Description: Adidas Power Soccer 98 sur Playstation est un jeu de football orienté arcade sur Playstation. En tout, 120 équipes et 30 stades sont disponibles.

Localization.Title: Adidas Power Soccer 98
Localization.Description: adidas Power Soccer 98 ist der vierte und letzte Teil der Reihe. Das Spiel kombiniert Arcade‑ und Simulationsansätze und bietet zwölf Turnierarten, elf Ligen, 120 Nationalteams und rund 30 Stadien.

Localization.Title: Adidas Power Soccer 98
Localization.Description: adidas Power Soccer 98 es el cuarto y último título de la serie Psygnosis.

Localization.Title: Gekido: Urban Fighters
Localization.Description: In the time of New Tokyo, a time in which corruption and criminal behavior is at an all time high, a girl named Angela has been kidnapped.

Localization.Title: Gekido : Urban Fighters
Localization.Description: Gekido : Urban Fighters est un jeu d'action et de combat en 3D sur Playstation. Une jeune fille nommée Angela a été kidnappée, ce qui pousse ses parents à engager un détective privé, Travis.

Localization.Title: Gekido: Urban Fighters
Localization.Description: Gekido: Urban Fighters ist ein erstklassiges Videospiel für die PlayStation-Konsole, das vom italienischen Studio NAPS Team erstellt wurde.

Localization.Title: Gekido: Urban Fighters
Localization.Description: "Gekido: Urban Fighters" es un juego de lucha en 3D, inspirado en los clásicos beat-em-ups 2D. El año es 2011 y el antivirus de unos hackers se ha convertido en una entidad independiente.

Localization.Title: Gekido: Urban Fighters
Localization.Description: "Gekido: Urban Fighters" è un gioco di combattimento 3D ispirato ai classici picchiaduro 2D. Siamo nel 2011 e l'antivirus di alcuni hacker è diventato un'entità indipendente.

Localization.Title: Gekido: Urban Fighters
Localization.Description: In the time of New Tokyo, a time in which corruption and criminal behavior is at an all time high, a girl named Angela has been kidnapped.

Localization.Title: Assault
Localization.Description: In 2198, the city of Arcadia is devastated when an alien object crashes into it and releases hostile creatures. Reno and Kelly are deployed to stop the invasion before it can spread further.

Localization.Title: Assault
Localization.Description: En 2198, la ville d'Arcadia est dévastée lorsqu'un objet extraterrestre s'écrase à sa surface et libère des créatures hostiles. Reno et Kelly sont envoyés pour repousser l'invasion avant qu'elle ne se propage.

Localization.Title: Assault
Localization.Description: Assault: Retribution ist ein 3D-Plattform-Shooter, der sich über sieben futuristische Level erstreckt und zwei spielbare Charaktere mit alternativen Routen, analoger Steuerung und Speicherkartenunterstützung umfasst.

Localization.Title: Assault
Localization.Description: Assault - Retribution le proporciona algunos de los mejores poderes de fuego que la tecnología moderna puede proporcionar, así como varias opciones de personalización para asegurar "una mejor vida a través de un rápido desembolso de muerte".

Localization.Title: Assault
Localization.Description: In 2198, the city of Arcadia is devastated when an alien object crashes into it and releases hostile creatures. Reno and Kelly are deployed to stop the invasion before it can spread further.

Localization.Title: Assault
Localization.Description: Assault: Retribution oferece o melhor poder de fogo que a tecnologia moderna pode oferecer, junto com várias opções de personalização para garantir “uma vida melhor através de uma morte rápida”.

Localization.Title: KKND Krossfire
Localization.Description: One hundred years ago, a great nuclear war ravaged the entire planet . . . survivors were few.

Localization.Title: KKND Krossfire
Localization.Description: KKND : Krossfire est un jeu de stratégie sorti sur Playstation. Nous sommes en 2179, la terre a été dévastée par une guerre nucléaire totale.

Localization.Title: KKND Krossfire
Localization.Description: Vor 100 Jahren wurde die Erde durch einen Atomkrieg verwüstet. Nur Zwei Gruppen Überlebten die Katastrophe. Ein Teil der Menschen suchten in unterirdischen Bunkeranlagen Schutz vor der Radioaktivität. Dort gründeten sie die Armee der Überlebenden.

Localization.Title: KKND Krossfire
Localization.Description: Hace cien años, una gran guerra nuclear devastó el planeta entero. . . los supervivientes fueron pocos.

Localization.Title: KKND Krossfire
Localization.Description: Cento anni fa, una grande guerra nucleare devastò l'intero pianeta... i sopravvissuti furono pochi.

Localization.Title: KKND Krossfire
Localization.Description: One hundred years ago, a great nuclear war ravaged the entire planet . . . survivors were few.

Localization.Title: X-Men vs. Street Fighter
Localization.Description: X-Men vs. Street Fighter is a crossover fighting video game developed and published by Capcom. As the title suggests, the game includes characters from Marvel's X-Men franchise and the cast from Capcom's Street Fighter series. X-Men vs.

Localization.Title: X-Men vs. Street Fighter
Localization.Description: X-Men Vs Street Fighter est un jeu de combat sur Playstation. Il est le premier soft à intégrer l'univers de Capcom dans celui de Marvel au travers d'un jeu de combat.

Localization.Title: X-Men vs. Street Fighter
Localization.Description: X-Men vs Street Fighter läßt Marvel's mächtige Mutanten gegen Capcom's legendäre Kämpferriege in einem Gefecht mit epischen Ausmaßen antreten. Verbinden Sie Super Moves, um Super Combo Attacken zu bilden.

Localization.Title: X-Men vs. Street Fighter
Localization.Description: X-Men vs Street Fighter es un videojuego de arcade que mezcla personajes y mecánicas del comic X-Men (más concretamente los diseños del juego X-Men: Children of the Atom) y Street Fighter Alpha 2.

Localization.Title: X-Men vs. Street Fighter
Localization.Description: X-Men vs. Street Fighter is a crossover fighting video game developed and published by Capcom. As the title suggests, the game includes characters from Marvel's X-Men franchise and the cast from Capcom's Street Fighter series. X-Men vs.

Localization.Title: X-Men vs. Street Fighter
Localization.Description: X-Men vs. Street Fighter é um videogame de luta cruzada desenvolvido e publicado pela Capcom. Como o título sugere, o jogo inclui personagens da franquia X-Men da Marvel e o elenco da série Street Fighter da Capcom. X-Men vs.

Localization.Title: Tank Racer
Localization.Description: Tank Racer is a mixed driving and shooting game in which you race tanks through various courses.

Localization.Title: Tank Racer
Localization.Description: Jouable sur Playstation, Tank Racer est comme son nom l'indique un jeu de courses dans lequel des tanks interviennent. Choisissez votre couleur, fermez le sas et faites rouler les chenilles de votre machine de guerre.

Localization.Title: Tank Racer
Localization.Description: Tank Racer auf der Playstation ist, wie der Name schon sagt, ein Rennspiel, an dem Panzer beteiligt sind. Wählen Sie Ihre Farbe, schließen Sie die Luftschleuse und rollen Sie die Ketten Ihrer Kriegsmaschine.

Localization.Title: Tank Racer
Localization.Description: Tank Racer es un juego de carreras diferente. Desarrollado por el equipo Glass Ghost de Simis, Tank Racer ofrece al jugador 50 toneladas de diversión, mientras te abres camino por multitud de pistas. Visto desde una perspectiva de 1.ª y 3.

Localization.Title: Tank Racer
Localization.Description: Tank Racer is a mixed driving and shooting game in which you race tanks through various courses.

Localization.Title: Tank Racer
Localization.Description: Tank Racer is a mixed driving and shooting game in which you race tanks through various courses.

Localization.Title: Alundra
Localization.Description: Alundra is a boy who can step into other people's dreams. His own dreams tell him to go to the village Inoa. The ship on which Alundra is coming to the village goes down, but Alundra himself is washed up on a beach near the village.

Localization.Title: Alundra
Localization.Description: The Adventures of Alundra est un jeu d'action/aventure sur Playstation. Vous incarnez Alundra, un jeune héros qui a le pouvoir d'entrer dans les rêves.

Localization.Title: Alundra
Localization.Description: Dunkle Visionen suchen Alundra heim. Quälende Alpträume, die ihn auf die Spur des Bösen führen - und in ein phantastisches Abenteuer im Kampf gegen die Mächte der Finsternis.

Localization.Title: Alundra
Localization.Description: Alundra, el protagonista, realiza un viaje para salvar a la aldea de Inoa de las garras del malvado Melzas, que penetra en las mentes de las personas mientras éstas duermen.

Localization.Title: Alundra
Localization.Description: Alundra è un ragazzo che può entrare nei sogni degli altri. I suoi stessi sogni gli dicono di andare al villaggio Inoa. La nave su cui Alundra sta arrivando al villaggio affonda, ma Alundra stesso viene trascinato su una spiaggia vicino al villaggio.

Localization.Title: Alundra
Localization.Description: Alundra, a protagonista, faz uma viagem para salvar a aldeia de Inoa das garras de Melzas, que penetra na mente das pessoas enquanto dormem. Combinando aventura gráfica e arcade, ele é embalado com ação e enigmas complicados.

Localization.Description: Alundra, el protagonista, realiza un viaje para salvar a la aldea de Inoa de las garras del malvado Melzas, que penetra en las mentes de las personas mientras éstas duermen.

Localization.Title: Alundra
Localization.Description: Alundra è un ragazzo che può entrare nei sogni degli altri. I suoi stessi sogni gli dicono di andare al villaggio Inoa. La nave su cui Alundra sta arrivando al villaggio affonda, ma Alundra stesso viene trascinato su una spiaggia vicino al villaggio.

Localization.Title: Alundra
Localization.Description: Alundra, a protagonista, faz uma viagem para salvar a aldeia de Inoa das garras de Melzas, que penetra na mente das pessoas enquanto dormem. Combinando aventura gráfica e arcade, ele é embalado com ação e enigmas complicados.

Localization.Title: B-Movie
Localization.Description: The story for Invasion From Beyond is based on the golden age of B-Movie science fiction thrillers, and goes like this: farm workers have been abducted and crop circles were discovered in farmlands outside Washington, D.C..

Localization.Title: B-Movie
Localization.Description: Invasion From Beyond est un jeu d'action sur Playstation. La population est terrorisée, les Martiens débarquent ! Enfourchez un vaisseau et enrayez cette menace extraterrestre tout en veillant à sauver les pauvres dames d'un enlèvement certain.

Localization.Title: B-Movie
Localization.Description: Die Geschichte von Invasion From Beyond basiert auf dem goldenen Zeitalter der B-Movie-Science-Fiction-Thriller und geht so: Landarbeiter wurden entführt und Kornkreise wurden auf Ackerland außerhalb von Washington, D.C. entdeckt.

Localization.Title: B-Movie
Localization.Description: Cosas extrañas se han visto en el cielo, círculos aparecen en el suelo en los campos de cultivo. Esto sólo pueden ser signos de una invasión alienígena. La gente está asustada y el Area-51 ha sido llamada para defender el planeta.

Localization.Title: B-Movie
Localization.Description: La storia di Invasion From Beyond è basata sull'età d'oro dei thriller di fantascienza di B-Movie e va così: i lavoratori agricoli sono stati rapiti e i cerchi nel grano sono stati scoperti nei campi coltivati fuori Washington, DC.

Localization.Title: Akuji the Heartless
Localization.Description: The premise of Akuji the Heartless is not a happy one. Just as Akuji, a voodoo shaman, was about to get married, his bride-to-be was kidnapped and he was then killed by his very own brother.

Localization.Title: Akuji the Heartless
Localization.Description: Akuji The Heartless est un jeu de plates-formes sur Playstation.

Localization.Title: Akuji the Heartless
Localization.Description: In diesem 3D-Action Adventure werden Sie zu Akuji, The Heartless, dem der eigene Bruder am Tage seiner Hochzeit das Herz entriß.

Localization.Title: Akuji the Heartless
Localization.Description: La premisa de Akuji el Despiadado no es feliz. Justo cuando Akuji, un chamán vudú, estaba a punto de casarse, su novia fue secuestrada y luego fue asesinado por su propio hermano.

Localization.Title: Akuji the Heartless
Localization.Description: La premessa di Akuji the Heartless non è felice. Proprio quando Akuji, uno sciamano voodoo, stava per sposarsi, la sua futura sposa fu rapita e lui fu poi ucciso dal suo stesso fratello.

Localization.Title: Akuji the Heartless
Localization.Description: Em Akuji: O Heartless o jogador assume o papel de Akuji, um padre vudu. O título do jogo é suposto ser tomado literalmente como o dia do casamento de Akuji trouxe um problema com ele: seu irmão mata-o e arranca-lhe o coração.

Localization.Title: Gex: Deep Cover Gecko
Localization.Description: When Gex is watching TV one day, he discovers that Rez has kidnapped Agent Xtra (the agent from Gex: Enter the Gecko's backstory), head of the TV Terrorist Defense Unit, to get to him.

Localization.Title: Gex : Deep Cover Gecko
Localization.Description: Gex : Deep Cover Gecko est un jeu de plates-formes sorti sur Playstation. Vous incarnez un Gex, un gecko qui doit sauver les siens d'une terrible menace. Le jeu propose de nombreux environnements variés tels que des paysages enneigés ou des égouts.

Localization.Title: Gex: Deep Cover Gecko
Localization.Description: Crystal Dynamics schickt seinen flinken Geheimagenten Gex in die dritte Runde. Mit verfeinerter Kameraführung, einem enorm ausgeweiteten Bewegungssortiment und einer Fülle frischer Ideen begibt sich der Gecko erneut auf geheime Mission.

Localization.Title: Gex: Deep Cover Gecko
Localization.Description: Cuando Gex está mirando televisión un día, descubre que Rez ha secuestrado al agente Xtra (el agente de Gex: Enter the Gecko's), jefe de la Unidad de Defensa Terrorista de Televisión, para llegar a él.

Localization.Title: Gex: Deep Cover Gecko
Localization.Description: Un giorno, mentre guarda la TV, Gex scopre che Rez ha rapito l'agente Xtra (l'agente di Gex: Enter the Gecko), capo dell'Unità di Difesa Terroristica TV, per arrivare a lui.

Localization.Title: Gex: Deep Cover Gecko
Localization.Description: When Gex is watching TV one day, he discovers that Rez has kidnapped Agent Xtra (the agent from Gex: Enter the Gecko's backstory), head of the TV Terrorist Defense Unit, to get to him.

Localization.Title: The Unholy War
Localization.Description: The Unholy War is 3D strategy game which uses many different weapons and special attacks. In a head to head two player game, players can strategically position their forces, and then fight the opposition in 3D arcade-style combat.

Localization.Title: The Unholy War
Localization.Description: The Unholy War sur Playstation est un jeu de combat/tactique se déroulant dans un univers de science-fiction, les combats en eux-mêmes prenant place dans des arènes avec des déplacements possibles en temps réel dans toutes les directions.

Localization.Title: The Unholy War
Localization.Description: „The Unholy War“ auf der Playstation ist ein Kampf-/Taktikspiel, das in einem Science-Fiction-Universum spielt. Die Kämpfe selbst finden in Arenen statt und können sich in Echtzeit in alle Richtungen bewegen.

Localization.Title: The Unholy War
Localization.Description: Dos poderosas fuerzas están a punto de chocar y debes decidir en qué lado estás. Los Arcanes son los nativos del planeta Xsarra. Los Teknos aterrizan en Xsarra y deciden conquistar el planeta en esta guerra profana de carne contra metal.

Localization.Title: Legacy of Kain: Soul Reaver
Localization.Description: 1500 years after Blood Omen: Legacy of Kain, the vampire Kain's decision at the end of that game has finally defeated the human kingdoms and brought the world of Nosgoth under his control.

Localization.Title: Legacy of Kain : Soul Reaver
Localization.Description: Kain, mon seigneur et maître me faisait une confiance absolue, et j'étais voué à prendre sa succession ainsi que ses fabuleux pouvoirs.

Localization.Title: Legacy of Kain: Soul Reaver
Localization.Description: Raziel, einer der sechs Statthalter des Vampir­fürsten Kain, hat noch vor seinem Herrn eine neue Entwicklungsstufe erreicht und als erster Vampir fledermausartige Flügel bekommen.

Localization.Title: Legacy of Kain: Soul Reaver
Localization.Description: Soul Reaver tiene a lugar en el mundo ficticio de Nosgoth, en el cual la vida está ligada a nueve pilares llamados Los Pilares de Nosgoth, representados por un guardián cada uno.

Localization.Title: Legacy of Kain: Soul Reaver
Localization.Description: Raziel, uno dei sei governatori del signore dei vampiri Cain, raggiunse una nuova fase di sviluppo prima del suo maestro ed è stato il primo vampiro a ricevere ali simili a pipistrelli.

Localization.Title: Legacy of Kain: Soul Reaver
Localization.Description: 1500 anos após Blood Omen: Legacy of Kain, a decisão do vampiro Kain no final do jogo finalmente derrotou os reinos humanos e trouxe o mundo de Nosgoth sob seu controle.

Localization.Title: Viper
Localization.Description: Viper is a 3D helicopter blaster on rails, you take control of one of three choppers and proceed to wade your way through waves of enemies in an effort to free the earth from alien forces attempting to take over.

Localization.Title: Viper
Localization.Description: Le jeu Playstation Viper est un jeu de tir sur rail. Vous contrôlez un hélicoptère qui avance tout seul, et votre objectif est d'exterminer la vermine alien qui a envahi la Terre.

Localization.Title: Viper
Localization.Description: Das Playstation-Viper-Spiel ist ein Rail-Shooter. Sie steuern einen Hubschrauber, der sich selbstständig bewegt, und Ihr Ziel ist es, das außerirdische Ungeziefer auszurotten, das auf der Erde eingedrungen ist.

Localization.Description: Set free by the the workers of Dauna Mine, Ryu of the Brood learns to both understand his power, and to understand the history of his extinct kind.

Localization.Title: Breath of Fire III
Localization.Description: Peuplé d'humains et d'animaux anthropomorphiques, le monde connaît de nombreux progrès scientifiques grâce à la découverte du Chrys, un minerai rare aux propriétés magiques trouvé sur les restes fossilisés de dragons.

Localization.Title: Breath of Fire III
Localization.Description: Ryu, der von den Arbeitern der Dauna-Mine befreit wurde, lernt, sowohl seine Macht als auch die Geschichte seiner ausgestorbenen Art zu verstehen.

Localization.Title: Breath of Fire III
Localization.Description: Situado en un mundo de fantasía, la historia nos habla sobre Ryu, un joven con la misteriosa capacidad de transformarse en poderosos dragones, que debe descubrir la verdad detrás de sus orígenes, así como localizar a sus amigos perdidos y a su familia su

Localization.Title: Breath of Fire III
Localization.Description: Popolato da umani e animali antropomorfi, il mondo sta vivendo molti progressi scientifici grazie alla scoperta del Chrys, un raro minerale dalle proprietà magiche trovato sui resti fossilizzati dei draghi.

Localization.Title: Breath of Fire III
Localization.Description: O jogo começa em uma mina de chrys, localizada em um lugar remoto do mundo onde o mineral raro e poderoso é extraído a partir de restos fossilizados de dragões.

Localization.Description: G-Darius revolves around a conflict between the humanoids of Amnelia and cyborg/chimera biovessels known as the "Thiima" (meant to mean simply "bringers of death"). The Thiima had been aroused by the Amnelian army's use of the weapon A.N.

Localization.Description: G-Darius est un jeu de tir sur Playstation. Vous pouvez apprécier le soft avec ses dessins superbes en 2D ainsi que les décors entièrement réalisés en 3D. Plongez-vous dans un univers d'action non-stop ainsi que 15 niveaux gigantesques.

Localization.Title: G. Darius
Localization.Description: G-Darius dreht sich um einen Konflikt zwischen den Humanoiden von Amnelia und Cyborg/Chimären-Bioschiffen, die als „Thiima“ bekannt sind (was einfach „Todesbringer“ bedeuten soll). Die Thiima waren durch den Einsatz der Waffe A.N.

Localization.Title: G. Darius
Localization.Description: G Darius narra la historia de la estrella Darius y de los héroes que la protegen del mal. Tu mision es luchar contra las fuerzas del mal en una nave tecnologicamente muy avanzada, la unica esperanza de la humanidad en estos momentos. G.

Localization.Title: G. Darius
Localization.Description: G-Darius ruota attorno a un conflitto tra gli umanoidi di Amnelia e i biovascelli cyborg/chimera noti come "Thiima" (che significa semplicemente "portatori di morte").

Localization.Description: In an America devastated by techno-industrial wars, eight cybernetic fighters known as F.R.E.A.K.S. battle inside multi-level futuristic arenas.

Localization.Title: Bio F.R.E.A.K.S.
Localization.Description: Dans une Amérique dévastée par des guerres techno-industrielles, huit combattants cybernétiques appelés F.R.E.A.K.S. s'affrontent dans des arènes futuristes à plusieurs niveaux.

Localization.Title: Bio F.R.E.A.K.S.
Localization.Description: Steuern Sie einen von acht kybernetisch verbesserten Bio-Freaks-Kriegern in diesem einzigartigen 3D-Kämpfer von den Machern des beliebten Mortal Kombat.

Localization.Title: Bio F.R.E.A.K.S.
Localization.Description: Bio FREAKS es un videojuego de lucha en 3D completamente poligonal lanzado por Midway en 1998. Originalmente fue planeado para salas de juegos. Pero luego el juego se lanzó más tarde para PlayStation, Nintendo 64 y PC.

Localization.Title: Bio F.R.E.A.K.S.
Localization.Description: In an America devastated by techno-industrial wars, eight cybernetic fighters known as F.R.E.A.K.S. battle inside multi-level futuristic arenas.

Localization.Description: Set free by the the workers of Dauna Mine, Ryu of the Brood learns to both understand his power, and to understand the history of his extinct kind.

Localization.Description: O jogo começa em uma mina de chrys, localizada em um lugar remoto do mundo onde o mineral raro e poderoso é extraído a partir de restos fossilizados de dragões.

Localization.Title: 007: Tomorrow Never Dies
Localization.Description: In 007: Tomorrow Never Dies, which is based on the movie of the same name, the player takes the role of the famous James Bond who fights against Elliot Carver. Carver tries to increase his TV ratings by creating a war between the British and the Chinese.

Localization.Title: 007 : Tomorrow Never Dies
Localization.Description: Demain Ne Meurt Jamais est un jeu d'action sorti sur Playstation. Retrouvez l'agent le moins secret de Sa Majesté dans cette adaptation du film du même nom. Au programme de l'action, des gadgets, des voitures de rêve et de fabuleuses James Bond Girls.

Localization.Title: 007: Tomorrow Never Dies
Localization.Description: Setze als weltmännischer Geheimagent 007 Dein Köpfchen und Deine High-Tech-Geräte ein, um Dich durch die vielen Spionage-Level zu kämpfen. Die Story beruht auf den spannenden Szenen des erfolgreichen Kinofilms, es gibt z.B. Schieß-, Fahr- und Ski-Modi.

Localization.Title: 007: Tomorrow Never Dies
Localization.Description: En 007: El Mañana Nunca Muere, basado en la película del mismo nombre, el jugador toma el papel del famoso James Bond que lucha contra Elliot Carver.

Localization.Title: 007: Tomorrow Never Dies
Localization.Description: In 007: Il domani non muore mai, basato sull'omonimo film, il giocatore assume il ruolo del famoso James Bond che combatte contro Elliot Carver. Carver cerca di aumentare i suoi ascolti televisivi creando una guerra tra inglesi e cinesi.

Localization.Title: 007: Tomorrow Never Dies
Localization.Description: Em 007: Tomorrow Never Dies, que é baseado no filme de mesmo nome, o jogador assume o papel do famoso James Bond que luta contra Elliot Carver. Carver tenta aumentar sua audiência na TV criando uma guerra entre os britânicos e os chineses.

Localization.Title: VR Baseball 99
Localization.Description: VR Baseball 99 contains all 30 major league baseball teams and stadiums. Each team consists of the 1998 opening day rosters. Play modes include exhibition, season, and home run derby.

Localization.Title: VR Baseball 99

Localization.Title: VR Baseball 99

Localization.Title: Wild 9
Localization.Description: Wild 9 ist ein völlig skurriles Action-/Plattformspiel für Playstation. Ihr Charakter verfügt über eine einzige Waffe, mit der er seine Feinde sowohl töten als auch foltern kann. Das Spiel bietet horizontales Scrollen mit 3D-Hintergründen.

Localization.Description: Jimmy "The Whirlwind" White is a master at the billiards table and a perennial favorite in the game of Snooker, and has been known to make shots that even pool-hall regulars would deem impossible.

Localization.Description: Jimmy White's Cueball sur Playstation est un jeu de billard/snooker. De nombreux modes de jeu sont proposés. Une très grande variété de coups et d'effets est réalisable.

Localization.Description: Jimmy „The Whirlwind“ White ist ein Meister am Billardtisch und ein Dauerbrenner im Snooker-Spiel und ist dafür bekannt, Schläge zu machen, die selbst Billard-Stammgäste für unmöglich halten würden.

Localization.Title: Mortal Kombat 4
Localization.Description: In an attempt to save Earth, Raiden began a war with Shinnok, a fallen Elder God, and his minions; a decision that cost many people their lives.

Localization.Title: Mortal Kombat 4
Localization.Description: Mortal Kombat 4 est un jeu de combat sur Playstation. Combos, fatalités et autres coups spéciaux, tels sont les ingrédients qui fondent le succès d'un jeu réputé pour la violence de ses affrontements.

Localization.Title: Mortal Kombat 4
Localization.Description: Das Gameplay-System von Mortal Kombat 4 ähnelt dem der vorherigen Spiele. Eine der bemerkenswertesten Neuerungen ist der Einsatz von Waffen und Gegenständen während der Kämpfe.

Localization.Title: Mortal Kombat 4
Localization.Description: Similar a los otros juegos de Mortal Kombat. Usando personajes en 3D en un campo de juego 2D, tiene alrededor de 20 combatientes diferentes para elegir, y cada uno tiene secretos mágicos y armas.

Localization.Title: Mortal Kombat 4
Localization.Description: Nel tentativo di salvare la Terra, Raiden iniziò una guerra con Shinnok, un dio anziano caduto, e i suoi servi; una decisione che è costata la vita a molte persone.

Localization.Title: Mortal Kombat 4
Localization.Description: Mortal Kombat 4 é um jogo de luta para Playstation. Combos, fatalities e outros golpes especiais, são os ingredientes que sustentam o sucesso de um jogo conhecido pela violência dos seus confrontos.

Localization.Title: Martian Gothic: Unification
Localization.Description: The events begin in 11,000 BC when a meteorite from Mars strikes the Antarctic ice. It isn't until 1984 that it is discovered by mankind and labeled ALH 84001.

Localization.Title: Martian Gothic : Unification
Localization.Description: Martian Gothic sur Playstation est un jeu d'aventure qui se déroule sur Mars en 2019. Alors qu'aucune tentative de contact avec la station Vita 1 n'a abouti, une mission de reconnaissance est envoyée sur place.

Localization.Title: Martian Gothic: Unification
Localization.Description: Die Ereignisse beginnen im Jahr 11.000 v. Chr., als ein Meteorit vom Mars das antarktische Eis trifft. Erst 1984 wird es von der Menschheit entdeckt und mit ALH 84001 bezeichnet.

Localization.Title: Martian Gothic: Unification

Localization.Title: Eliminator
Localization.Description: The Elimination event was the ultimate in televised arena combat. The participants were prisoners, of course, since no one sane enough would take up the gauntlet without some sort of incentive.

Localization.Description: El evento de eliminación era el último de todos los combates televisados en la arena. Los participantes eran prisioneros, por supuesto, ya que nadie lo bastante sensato aceptaría el desafío sin algún tipo de incentivo.

Localization.Title: Metal Gear Solid (Disc 1)

Localization.Title: Metal Gear Solid (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: FOXHOUND, ein abtrünniges, genetisch verbessertes Spezialkommando, unternimmt einen Putsch auf einem abgelegenen Archipel in Alaska, bei dem es sich in Wahrheit um "Shadow Moses", eine geheime Abrüstungseinrichtung der Regierung, handelt.

Localization.Title: Metal Gear Solid (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Metal Gear Solid es un juego que mezcla varios géneros, como acción aventura, sigilo o espionaje.

Localization.Title: Metal Gear Solid (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: FOXHOUND, un rinnegato, commando speciale geneticamente potenziato, sta compiendo un colpo di stato su un remoto arcipelago dell'Alaska che è in realtà "Shadow Moses", una struttura segreta di disarmo del governo.

Localization.Title: Metal Gear Solid (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Metal Gear Solid é um jogo espionagem lançado para a PlayStation. Nesta obra, Solid Snake deve se infiltrar em Shadow Moses, uma base militar no Alasca, para salvar reféns.

Localization.Description: After firing your grappling hook to the rooftop of a small house, you pull yourself up and notice a guard pacing back and forth on the ground. He doesn't see you as you begin to crawl and sneak around on the roof.

Localization.Title: Tenchu : Stealth Assassins
Localization.Description: Tenchu : Stealth Assassins est un jeu d'infiltration sur Playstation. Vous jouez un Ninja au choix entre Rikimaru et Ayame. Le soft se décompose en 10 étapes où vous devez accomplir les tâches qui sont présentes.

Localization.Title: Tenchu: Stealth Assassins
Localization.Description: Schleichen Sie sich an, und schlagen Sie mit tödlicher Präzision zu. Sie sind Rikimaru oder Ayame, ein Ninja in der dunklen Welt des feudalen Japan. Ausgerüstet mit mystischen Waffen und einem wachen Auge müssen Sie kämpfen, ohne entdeckt zu werden.

Localization.Title: Tenchu: Stealth Assassins
Localization.Description: Atraviesa el Japón de la época feudal controlando a uno de los dos ninjas del clan Azuma: Rikimaru y Ayame. Utiliza técnicas de infiltración, escala murallas y corre por los tejados.

Localization.Title: Tenchu: Stealth Assassins

Localization.Description: Colony Wars : Vengeance est un jeu d'action/simulation sur Playstation. Le soft vous amène aux commandes d'un vaisseau de chasse futuriste. Ainsi vous devez parcourir l'espace en ayant divers ennemis à combattre.

Localization.Description: Es sind 100 Jahre nach den Ereignissen im ersten Kolonialkrieg vergangen, und diesmal ist der Feind die freie Liga der Welten. Der zweite Kolonialkrieg wird ausgelöst als es der Kolonialen Navy gelingt, das versiegelte Sprungtor zu öffnen.

Localization.Title: Colony Wars: Vengeance

Localization.Title: Rogue Trip: Vacation 2012
Localization.Description: In a world destroyed by pollution, nuclear war and poverty, vacationers have become hot property.

Localization.Title: Rogue Trip : Vacation 2012
Localization.Description: Disponible sur Playstation, Rogue Trip est un jeu d'action impliquant des courses de voitures destructrices. Il sera question ici d'affronter de nombreux adversaires dans des arènes dantesques, dans le but de récupérer le seul touriste du niveau.

Localization.Title: Rogue Trip: Vacation 2012
Localization.Description: Rogue Trip ist auf der Playstation erhältlich und ein Actionspiel mit zerstörerischen Autorennen. Hier wird es darum gehen, sich vielen Gegnern in Dantesk-Arenen zu stellen, mit dem Ziel, den einzigen Touristen des Levels zurückzuerobern.

Localization.Title: Rogue Trip: Vacation 2012
Localization.Description: Rogue Trip posee el mismo concepto de jugabilidad que otros títulos como Vigilante 8 o Twisted Metal. Debemos ponernos a los mandos de diferentes vehiculos y destruir a nuestros oponentes en multitud de escenarios.

Localization.Title: Asteroids
Localization.Description: Activision's 1998 Asteroids remake combines the original Atari coin-op game with Atari 2600 features, 3-D graphics, and numerous power-ups.

Localization.Title: Asteroids
Localization.Description: Asteroids est un jeu de tir avec des décors en 3 dimensions sorti sur Playstation qui nous met aux commandes d'un vaisseau qui a pour mission de détruire les extraterrestres et les astéroïdes présents à l'écran.

Localization.Title: Asteroids
Localization.Description: Asteroids ist ein 1998er Shooter, der auf der Playstation 1 veröffentlicht wurde. In Asteroids geht es darum, Asteroiden auszuweichen. In der Mitte des Bildes befindet sich ein kleines dreieckiges Raumschiff.

Localization.Title: Asteroids
Localization.Description: Remake del clásico arcade de Atari. Hay tres tipos de naves para elegir, cada una con diferentes fortalezas y debilidades. También hay tres niveles de destreza. Si ganas el juego en el modo Experto o superior, tendrás acceso a un cuarto tipo de nave.

Localization.Title: Global Domination
Localization.Description: Global Domination is an action-based strategical wargame that is based on the fictional game James Bond plays against Maximillian Largo in the 1983 film Never Say Never again. Elements of this game are combined with the classical board game Risk.

Localization.Title: Global Domination
Localization.Description: Global Domination est un jeu de réflexion sur Playstation. En 2015, le monde est au bord de la crise. Vous êtes embauché par une organisation nommée Ultra.

Localization.Title: T'ai Fu: Wrath of the Tiger
Localization.Description: T'ai Fu - Wrath of the Tiger is a PlayStation game released in 1999. The game is set in an oriental landscape populated by clans of animals, such as Leopards and Snakes.

Localization.Title: T'ai Fu : Wrath of the Tiger
Localization.Description: T'ai Fu est un jeu d'action sur Playstation. Dans la Chine ancienne, celle des Empereurs et des Légendes, le Maître Dragon a déclaré la guerre aux clans des animaux.

Localization.Title: T'ai Fu: Wrath of the Tiger
Localization.Description: Die Rache des Tigers... wetz die Klauen - es ist Kampf angesagt. Nimm Rache für den Tigerklan. Lange Zeit unterdrückte der Drachenmeister die Tiere des Dschungels.

Localization.Title: T'ai Fu: Wrath of the Tiger
Localization.Description: T'ai Fu - Wrath of the Tiger es un juego de PlayStation lanzado en 1999. El juego se desarrolla en un paisaje oriental poblado por clanes de animales, como leopardos y serpientes.

Localization.Description: T'ai Fu - Wrath of the Tiger è un gioco per PlayStation pubblicato nel 1999. Il gioco è ambientato in un paesaggio orientale popolato da clan di animali, come leopardi e serpenti.

Localization.Title: Oddworld: Abe's Exoddus (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Abe's Oddysee begins with the eponymous protagonist as a prisoner in RuptureFarms, from which he narrates his story. He and many other Mudokons are slaves to Molluck the Glukkon, the owner of RuptureFarms: "the biggest meat-processing plant on Oddworld".

Localization.Title: Oddworld : Abe's Exoddus (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Jusqu'ici, vous n'étiez qu'un simple esclave travaillant dans une usine de viande infernale...

Localization.Title: Oddworld: Abe's Exoddus (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Abe ist ein Wesen aus dem Volk der Mudokaner und eigentlich ein Anti-Held. Wie viele seines Volkes ist er ein Sklave des Fleischproduzenten Molluck aus dem Volk der Glukkons.

Localization.Title: Oddworld: Abe's Exoddus (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Abe es un miembro de la raza Mudokon, una de las tantas que habitan el planeta remoto conocido como Oddworld.

Localization.Title: Oddworld: Abe's Exoddus (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Abe è un membro della razza Mudokon, una delle tante che abitano il remoto pianeta noto come Oddworld. Lavora al fianco dei suoi colleghi come operaio e schiavo nelle Rupture Farms, una potente azienda di lavorazione della carne.

Localization.Title: Oddworld: Abe's Exoddus (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Oddworld - Abe's Oddysee é um jogo de ação / aventura no Playstation. Você joga como Abe e você tem que salvar sua pele em um universo cheio de perigos do mal, onde todo mundo tenta te devorar vivo.

Localization.Title: Future Cop: L.A.P.D.
Localization.Description: The city of Los Angeles has a few more problems than usual in 2100 A.D. You see, the future hasn't been exactly kind to urban life and now gangs have overrun the already bleak neighborhoods.

Localization.Title: Future Cop : L.A.P.D.
Localization.Description: Dans le jeu d'action Future Cop L.A.P.D. sur Playstation, votre mission est simple : aux commandes de votre robot de combat, vous devez nettoyer les rues de Los Angeles de toute la vermine hors-la-loi.

Localization.Title: Future Cop: L.A.P.D.
Localization.Description: Im 21. Jahrhundert haben kriminelle Banden die Herrschaft über Los Angeles übernommen. Verteidigen Sie die Straßen mit dem revolutionärsten Angriffsfahrzeug der Welt, das sich von einem schlagkräftigen Walder in ein Hoverkraft verwandeln kann.

Localization.Title: Future Cop: L.A.P.D.
Localization.Description: Future Cop: L.A.P.

Localization.Title: Mega Man Legends
Localization.Description: THE BLUE BOMBER BLASTS INTO A WHOLE NEW DIMENSION Mega Man blasts his way into the third dimension in an amazing new adventure.

Localization.Title: Mega Man Legends
Localization.Description: Mega Man Legends sur Playstation marque le départ d'une nouvelle série Megaman se déroulant bien des années après toutes les autres franchises.

Localization.Title: Mega Man Legends
Localization.Description: Er ist wieder da. Mega Man in seinem ersten 3D-Adventure. Steuern Sie Mega Man in seinem atemberaubenden Action-RPG und erkunden Sie dabei die riesige 3D-Welt.

Localization.Title: Mega Man Legends
Localization.Description: Mega Man Legends es un videojuego de rol de acción puesto a la venta en 1997 por Capcom. Es el primer título de la exitosa franquicia de videojuegos Mega Man en tener gráficos completamente en 3D.

Localization.Title: Mega Man Legends
Localization.Description: THE BLUE BOMBER BLASTS INTO A WHOLE NEW DIMENSION Mega Man blasts his way into the third dimension in an amazing new adventure.

Localization.Title: Mega Man Legends

Localization.Title: Caesars Palace II
Localization.Description: Caesars Palace II features 19 gambling favorites in one of the most world-renowned Las Vegas casinos and resorts.

Localization.Title: Caesars Palace II
Localization.Description: Caesars Palace II présente 19 jeux de hasard favoris dans l'un des casinos et complexes hôteliers les plus réputés de Las Vegas.

Localization.Title: Caesars Palace II
Localization.Description: Herzlich willkommen zu Caesars Palace 2, dem Glücksspiel-Erlebnis erster Klasse, in dem Sie der nächste sein können, der die Bank des weltberühmten Caesars Palace knackt. Testen Sie ihr spielerisches Können in 20 Glücksspielen wie z.B.

Localization.Title: Caesars Palace II
Localization.Description: Caesars Palace II es un famoso casino y resort en Las Vegas que ofrece una variedad de juegos de azar. Además de los juegos clásicos como el blackjack y la ruleta, también hay nuevas máquinas, tragaperras y desafíos de póquer.

Localization.Title: Caesars Palace II
Localization.Description: Caesars Palace II features 19 gambling favorites in one of the most world-renowned Las Vegas casinos and resorts.

Localization.Title: Metal Gear Solid (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Renegade special forces unit FOXHOUND has taken over Shadow Moses Island in Alaska's Fox Archipelago - publicly a nuclear weapons disposal facility but in truth a top secret weapons development site and home to Metal Gear REX.

Localization.Title: Metal Gear Solid (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Infiltrez un complexe militaire terroriste pour faire échouer une conspiration nucléaire. Concentrez vous, alertez vos sens, restez en vie... Metal Gear Solid: Espionnage, stratégie et action.

Localization.Title: Metal Gear Solid (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: FOXHOUND, ein abtrünniges, genetisch verbessertes Spezialkommando, unternimmt einen Putsch auf einem abgelegenen Archipel in Alaska, bei dem es sich in Wahrheit um "Shadow Moses", eine geheime Abrüstungseinrichtung der Regierung, handelt.

Localization.Title: Metal Gear Solid (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Metal Gear Solid es un juego que mezcla varios géneros, como acción aventura, sigilo o espionaje.

Localization.Title: Metal Gear Solid (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: FOXHOUND, un rinnegato, commando speciale geneticamente potenziato, sta compiendo un colpo di stato su un remoto arcipelago dell'Alaska che è in realtà "Shadow Moses", una struttura segreta di disarmo del governo.

Localization.Title: Metal Gear Solid (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Metal Gear Solid é um jogo espionagem lançado para a PlayStation. Nesta obra, Solid Snake deve se infiltrar em Shadow Moses, uma base militar no Alasca, para salvar reféns.

Localization.Title: Silent Hill
Localization.Description: Silent Hill is a 1999 survival horror video game for the PlayStation. The first in a series about a mysterious town of the same name, Silent Hill generated a direct sequel, three indirect sequels, a prequel and a film adaptation.

Localization.Title: Silent Hill
Localization.Description: Un jeune homme à la recherche de sa fille lutte pour survivre dans un monde à cheval entre la réalité et l'enfer, dans une ville renfermant de terribles et sombres secrets.

Localization.Title: Silent Hill
Localization.Description: Harry Mason, ein seit vier Jahren verwitweter Schriftsteller, fährt gemeinsam mit seiner siebenjährigen Tochter Cheryl in den Urlaub, den beide auf Wunsch von Cheryl in der Kleinstadt Silent Hill verbringen wollen.

Localization.Title: Silent Hill
Localization.Description: Un joven hombre busca desesperadamente a su hija debatiéndose por sobrevivir en un lugar entre la realidad y el infierno, una ciudad que esconde oscuros y sangrientos secretos.

Localization.Title: Silent Hill
Localization.Description: Silent Hill è un videogioco survival horror del 1999 per PlayStation. Il primo di una serie su una misteriosa città con lo stesso nome, Silent Hill ha generato un sequel diretto, tre sequel indiretti, un prequel e un adattamento cinematografico.

Localization.Title: Silent Hill
Localization.Description: Silent Hill é um horror de sobrevivência para Playstation. Você joga com Harry Mason e acaba de chegar na pequena cidade de Silent Hill a bordo do seu 4x4 e da sua filha Cheryl. No meio da noite, um acidente interrompe a viagem da família.

Localization.Title: Duke Nukem: Time to Kill
Localization.Description: The game begins not a long time after Duke Nukem 3D. Duke is relaxing in Bootylicious with a few beers and some babes when suddenly Pig Cops start thrashing the place and turn his 1968 custom hog into a chopper bike.

Localization.Title: Duke Nukem : Time to Kill
Localization.Description: Duke Nukem : Time To Kill est un jeu de tir à la première personne sur Playstation. Des extraterrestres ont envahi la Terre et détruisent tout à Los Angeles. C'est à vous de les renvoyer d'où ils viennent à coups de fusil et de répliques cinglantes.

Localization.Title: Duke Nukem: Time to Kill
Localization.Description: Lust auf 'ne Zeitreise? Der größte Action-Held aller Zeiten ist wieder da! In einem Third-Person Ballerfest durch die Jahrhunderte. Kämpfe dich mit Duke Nukem durch verschiedene Epochen, in denen du fiese Aliens in ihre Schranken weist.

Localization.Title: Duke Nukem: Time to Kill
Localization.Description: Duke Nukem: Time To Kill es un juego de disparos en primera persona en Playstation. Los extraterrestres invadieron la Tierra y destruyeron todo en Los Ángeles. Depende de usted enviarlos de regreso con rifles y armas.

Localization.Title: Duke Nukem: Time to Kill
Localization.Description: Il gioco inizia non molto tempo dopo Duke Nukem 3D. Duke si sta rilassando a Bootylicious con alcune birre e alcune ragazze quando improvvisamente Pig Cops inizia a battere il posto e trasforma il suo maiale personalizzato del 1968 in una moto chopper.

Localization.Title: Duke Nukem: Time to Kill
Localization.Description: O jogo começa não muito tempo depois de Duke Nukem 3D.

Localization.Title: Big Air
Localization.Description: Big Air features snowboarding competitions across courses set in six countries. Players choose from several professional snowboarders and compete in events including Big Air, Half Pipe, Boardercross, Freeride Race and Freeride Trick.

Localization.Title: Big Air
Localization.Description: Big Air propose des compétitions de snowboard sur des pistes réparties dans six pays. Le joueur choisit parmi plusieurs snowboardeurs professionnels et participe à différentes épreuves : Big Air, Half Pipe, Boardercross, Freeride Race et Freeride Trick.

Localization.Title: Big Air
Localization.Description: Accolade und Pitbull Syndicate haben sich für Big Air zusammengetan, eine weitere Interpretation des Snowboard-Genres, bei der Sie an dreißig Kursen in sechs verschiedenen Ländern teilnehmen, darunter Frankreich, Japan, Schottland, die Schweiz, die Verei

Localization.Title: Quake II
Localization.Description: A sequel in name only, this follow up to id’s 1996 Quake, is a first-person shooter revolving around the Earth-Strogg war. The Strogg alien race threatens the Earth, but Earth has launched a counter-offensive, Operation Alien Overlord.

Localization.Title: Quake II
Localization.Description: Quake II est un FPS sur Playstation. Votre mission : infiltrer la planète envahie par les extraterrestres et tous les envoyer hors de la galaxie en abaissant leurs défenses afin qu'une attaque aérienne finale puisse être amorcée.

Localization.Title: Quake II
Localization.Description: Das Computerspiel Quake II ist der zweite Teil der Quake-Serie und kam 1999 für die PlayStation auf den Markt. Quake II ist der Nachfolger zu Quake, hat von der Hintergrundgeschichte her jedoch nichts mit seinem Vorgänger zu tun.

Localization.Title: Quake II
Localization.Description: Quake II es un shooter en primera persona que toma lugar en una invasión a la Tierra por la civilización extraterrestre Stroggs.

Localization.Title: Quake II
Localization.Description: Sequel solo di nome, questo seguito di Quake del 1996 di id Software è uno sparatutto in prima persona incentrato sulla guerra tra la Terra e gli Strogg.

Localization.Title: Diver's Dream
Localization.Description: Diver's Dream is a game inspired by Luc Besson's movie The Big Blue. The player meets an old man named Roberto Meyer, who's life long dream is to explore the wreck of the ship Gigantic Matilda.

Localization.Title: Diver's Dream
Localization.Description: Diver's Dream est un jeu d'action sur PC qui s'inspire du film Le Grand Bleu de Luc Besson. Dans ce jeu vous incarnez Roberto Meyer dont le rêve de sa vie est d'explorer l'épave de l'imposant navire Matilda.

Localization.Title: Diver's Dream
Localization.Description: Diver's Dream ist ein Spiel, das von Luc Bessons Film The Big Blue inspiriert wurde. Der Spieler trifft einen alten Mann namens Roberto Meyer, dessen Lebenstraum es ist, das Wrack des Schiffes Gigantic Matilda zu erkunden.

Localization.Title: Diver's Dream
Localization.Description: Diver's Dream es un juego de acción para PC inspirado en la película de Luc Besson Le Grand Bleu. Juegas como Roberto Meyer, cuyo sueño es explorar los restos del imponente barco Matilda.
