Localization.Title: Galaga: Destination Earth
Localization.Description: All the other space pilots have been eliminated. Somehow you survived. The Galaga enemies are on the move. Now, you must fight or doom Earth to extinction. There's no time to plan strategies. Just find your targets and come out blasting.

Localization.Title: Fighting Force 2
Localization.Description: Human cloning was banned by international treaty at the end of the twentieth century. There are those who disobey the law by taking part in the biotechnology and cloning black market.

Localization.Title: Fighting Force 2
Localization.Description: Fighting Force 2 sur Playstation est un beat'em all situé dans un futur proche. Le clonage humain est devenu une réalité, mais reste malgré tout illégal.

Localization.Title: Fighting Force 2
Localization.Description: Sie schlüpfen in die Rolle von Spezialagent Hawk Manson, dessen Auftrag es ist, die Waffe der Zukunft unschädlich zu machen: Den Prototypen eines geklonten Soldaten, der in jeder Umgebung überleben kann, und an den Meistbietenden verkauft werden soll.

Localization.Title: Fighting Force 2
Localization.Description: Conviértete en el agente Hawk Manson para actuar en una serie de misiones secretas de alto nivel. El objetivo es sencillo: investigar y liquidar.

Localization.Title: Tomb Raider: The Last Revelation
Localization.Description: According to Egyptian legend, Horus, son of the light, outwitted the evil God Set and imprisoned him in a secret tomb.

Localization.Title: Tomb Raider : The Last Revelation
Localization.Description: "Il est l'ombre sur le soleil, le porteur des fléaux et sa colère, sans limites, consumera la terre." Une légende de l'ancienne Egypte raconte que Seth, le Dieu de la désolation, fut vaincu et emprisonné dans une tombe secrète.

Localization.Title: Tomb Raider: The Last Revelation
Localization.Description: Eine uralte Legende, ein böser Geist und eine Warnung an die Zukunft: Er ist der Schatten vor der Sonne, der Auslöser aller Seuchen, sein Zorn frißt das ganze Land, und sein Hunger wird unersättlich sein.

Localization.Title: Tomb Raider: The Last Revelation
Localization.Description: Tomb Raider: The Last Revelation (en español Tomb Raider: La última revelación) es el cuarto videojuego de la serie Tomb Raider. La historia comienza con una joven Lara Croft, acompañada por su antiguo mentor, Werner Von Croy.

Localization.Title: Tomb Raider: The Last Revelation
Localization.Description: Secondo la leggenda egizia, Horus, figlio della luce, sconfisse in astuzia il malvagio dio Set e lo imprigionò in una tomba segreta.

Localization.Title: Tomb Raider: The Last Revelation
Localization.Description: De acordo com a lenda egípcia, Hórus, filho da luz, enganou o malvado Deus Set e o aprisionou em uma tumba secreta.

Localization.Title: Mighty Hits Special
Localization.Description: Gun game that features a 2 player mode, light gun support, 4 different difficult modes and 30 different games to play. The game features cartoon graphics and a high score memory card save.

Localization.Title: Mighty Hits Special
Localization.Description: Mighty Hits Special est un jeu d'action sur Playstation.

Localization.Title: Mighty Hits Special
Localization.Description: Waffenspiel mit einem 2-Spieler-Modus, Unterstützung für leichte Waffen, 4 verschiedenen schwierigen Modi und 30 verschiedenen Spielen. Das Spiel verfügt über Cartoon-Grafiken und einen Highscore-Speicherkartenspeicher.

Localization.Title: Mighty Hits Special
Localization.Description: Mighty Hits Special es un juego de disparos que cuenta con un modo para 2 jugadores, soporte para pistolas de luz, 4 modos diferentes de dificultad y 30 partidas diferentes para jugar.

Localization.Title: Mighty Hits Special

Localization.Title: Missile Command
Localization.Description: Prepare for launch! Prepare for defense! Prepare for your potential battle of a lifetime! Welcome to Missile Command from Meyer Glass and Hasbro Interactive. The world needs a Missile Commander and you are the only hope in warding off the alien invasion.

Localization.Title: Missile Command
Localization.Description: Dans Missile Command sur Playstation vous devez défendre la côte contre de mystérieux envahisseurs. Les ennemis arrivent du ciel et vous disposez d'une batterie de trois canons contenant chacun dix missiles pour les repousser.

Localization.Title: Missile Command
Localization.Description: Bereiten Sie sich auf den Start vor! Bereiten Sie sich auf die Verteidigung vor! Bereiten Sie sich auf den potenziellen Kampf Ihres Lebens vor! Willkommen bei Missile Command von Meyer Glass und Hasbro Interactive.

Localization.Title: Missile Command
Localization.Description: ¡Misteriosos invasores están atacando tus ciudades! Como comandante de una base de misiles, es tu responsabilidad defenderlas. Los enemigos llegarán desde el cielo para intentar destruir las ciudades de la parte inferior de la pantalla.

Localization.Title: Missile Command
Localization.Description: Misteriosi invasori stanno attaccando le vostre città! Come comandante di una base missilistica, è vostra responsabilità difenderle. I nemici arriveranno dal cielo per cercare di distruggere le città in fondo allo schermo.

Localization.Title: Missile Command
Localization.Description: Invasores misteriosos estão a atacar as tuas cidades! Como comandante de uma base de mísseis, é da tua responsabilidade defendê-las. Os inimigos virão do céu para tentar destruir as cidades na parte inferior do ecrã.

Localization.Title: Dune 2000
Localization.Description: Dune 2000 is a remake of the classic Dune II updated for Windows. In this Real-Time Strategy game, you can play one of the three houses, the evil Harkonnen, the greed filled Ordos or the noble Atreides.

Localization.Title: Dune 2000
Localization.Description: Disponible sur Playstation, Dune 2000 est un jeu de stratégie en temps réel inspiré des romans de Frank Herbert. Des cinématiques live ponctuent l'avancement du scénario en solo. Trois factions différentes sont jouables : Ordos, Atréide et Harkonnen.

Localization.Title: Dune 2000
Localization.Description: Echtzeitstrategie war noch nie so fesselnd. Erkunden Sie ein völlig neuartiges Umgebungssystem mit detaillierten Einheiten und Strukturen in 3D. Wählen Sie einen von drei möglichen Charakteren aus, als der Sie kämpfen möchten.

Localization.Title: Dune 2000
Localization.Description: Dune 2000 es una nueva versión del clásico Dune II. En este juego de estrategia en tiempo real, puedes jugar en una de las tres casas, la malvada Harkonnen, los Ordos lleno de codicia o la noble Atreides.

Localization.Description: Do you like playing as the "bad guys"? Do you enjoy controlling characters from a movie who cause agony and suffering for the protagonists? Well, if you're looking for some all-out carnage and destruction, try feeding on Warpath: Jurassic Park for the Pl

Localization.Title: Warpath : Jurassic Park
Localization.Description: Warpath : Jurassic Park est un jeu d'action sur Playstation. Incarnez l'un des 14 dinosaures disponibles tels que le T-Rex et le Mega Raptor. Combattez dans plus de 10 zones de combat tirées de Jurassic Park et détruisez tout sur votre passage.

Localization.Title: Warpath: Jurassic Park
Localization.Description: Warpath - Jurassic Park ist ein Spiel von Black Ops Entertainment, das von Electronic Arts vertrieben wird. Es gehört zum Action-Genre, Unterkategorie Prügelspiel und ist am 31.10.1999 erschienen.

Localization.Title: Warpath: Jurassic Park
Localization.Description: El juego ofrece muchos de los Dinosaurios de las dos películas de Jurassic Park, se elige el tipo y luchas contra él en un combate uno-a-uno con otros dinosaurios para así convertirse en el supremo Dino del parque.

Localization.Title: WWF Attitude
Localization.Description: Play as or against more than 40 professional wrestling stars in WWF Attitude on PlayStation. You'll be able to compete in an exhibition match, create, and develop a custom wrestler, or embark on a career.

Localization.Title: WWF Attitude
Localization.Description: WWF Attitude sur Playstation est un jeu de catch proposant plus de 40 combattants pour mettre le feu au ring, sous les commentaires des présentateurs Shane Mc Mahon et Jerry Lawler.

Localization.Title: WWF Attitude
Localization.Description: Spiele in WWF Attitude auf PlayStation als Wrestler gegen mehr als 40 professionelle Wrestling-Stars. Sie können an einem Exhibition Match teilnehmen, einen benutzerdefinierten Wrestler erstellen und entwickeln oder eine Karriere beginnen.

Localization.Title: WWF Attitude
Localization.Description: Juega como o contra más de 40 estrellas de la lucha libre profesional en WWF Attitude para PlayStation. Podrás competir en un combate de exhibición, crear y desarrollar un luchador personalizado o embarcarte en una carrera.

Localization.Title: Xena: Warrior Princess
Localization.Description: Grab your Chakram and sword, because the evil sorceress Kalabrax has broken free after centuries of imprisonment. She will finally get her revenge upon the gods who imprisoned her and the world they created. Only one thing is stopping her.

Localization.Title: Xena : Warrior Princess
Localization.Description: Xena : Princesse Guerrière est un jeu d'action sur Playstation. Vous incarnez Xena, la princesse guerrière, et parcourez le pays des songes dans lequel vous êtes enfermé.

Localization.Title: Xena: Warrior Princess
Localization.Description: Basierend auf der gleichnamigen TV-Serie, schlüpft ihr in diesem Action-Spiel in die Rolle der Kriegerin Xena. Euer böser Gegenspieler, der Zauberer Kalabrax, will die Weltherrschaft an sich reißen.

Localization.Title: Xena: Warrior Princess

Localization.Title: FIFA 2000
Localization.Description: Diese Version der FIFA-Reihe enthielt über 40 „klassische“ Mannschaften, sodass Spieler als pensionierte Fußballlegenden spielen konnten.

Localization.Title: FIFA 2000
Localization.Description: Esta versión de la serie FIFA contiene más de 40 equipos "clásicos", para que los jugadores pudieran jugar como leyendas del fútbol retiradas.

Localization.Title: FIFA 2000
Localization.Description: Questa versione della serie FIFA conteneva oltre 40 squadre “classiche”, consentendo ai giocatori di impersonare leggende del calcio ormai ritirate.

Localization.Title: FIFA 2000
Localization.Description: This version of the FIFA series contained over 40 "classic" teams, so that gamers could play as retired football legends.

Localization.Title: Knockout Kings 2000
Localization.Description: Ever dreamed of fighting in the "Thrilla in Manilla?" Now you can! In Knockout Kings 2000, EA Sports has included a Classic Fights feature. Some of the greatest matches of all time are playable, with no set outcomes.

Localization.Title: Knockout Kings 2000
Localization.Description: Knockout Kings 2000 est un jeu de boxe sur Playstation. Parmi les personnalités disponibles, on retrouve Marvelous Marvin Hagler, Rocky Marciano, Evander Holyfield, Roberto Duran et Mohamed Ali. Il est aussi possible de créer son propre boxeur.

Localization.Title: Knockout Kings 2000
Localization.Description: Haben Sie jemals davon geträumt, im „Thrilla in Manilla“ zu kämpfen? Jetzt kannst du! In Knockout Kings 2000 hat EA Sports eine Classic Fights-Funktion integriert. Einige der größten Spiele aller Zeiten sind spielbar, ohne festgelegte Ergebnisse.

Localization.Title: Knockout Kings 2000
Localization.Description: Juega como algunos de los grandes nombres de la historia del boxeo a través de una carrera completa, o crea tu propio boxeador y lucha hacia el campeonato de peso pesado.

Localization.Title: Knockout Kings 2000
Localization.Description: Hai mai sognato di combattere nel “Thrilla in Manilla”? Ora puoi farlo! In Knockout Kings 2000, EA Sports ha incluso una funzione Classic Fights. Alcuni dei più grandi incontri di tutti i tempi sono giocabili, senza risultati prestabiliti.

Localization.Title: Knockout Kings 2000
Localization.Description: Ever dreamed of fighting in the "Thrilla in Manilla?" Now you can! In Knockout Kings 2000, EA Sports has included a Classic Fights feature. Some of the greatest matches of all time are playable, with no set outcomes.

Localization.Title: Player Manager 2000
Localization.Description: A football management game from the creators of the Kick Off series. Player Manager 2000 lets you coach any team from England, Scotland, Italy and Germany, and there is totally more than 30,000 players.

Localization.Title: Player Manager 2000
Localization.Description: Guy Roux Manager 2000 est un jeu de gestion d'équipes de football sur Playstation. On a droit à quatre nations différentes (Allemagne, Italie, France et Angleterre) et à une base de données de plus de 30000 joueurs.

Localization.Title: Player Manager 2000
Localization.Description: Ein Fußball-Managementspiel von den Machern der Kick Off-Reihe. Mit Player Manager 2000 können Sie jedes Team aus England, Schottland, Italien und Deutschland trainieren, und es gibt insgesamt mehr als 30.000 Spieler.

Localization.Title: Roadsters
Localization.Description: Titus returns to the racing games that they started in Commodore Amiga with the Crazy Cars game series (the first one was released in 1987 and the third and last one in 1992) with Roadsters that features the same great gameplay with enhanced 3d graphics.

Localization.Title: Roadsters
Localization.Description: Roadsters sur Playstation est un jeu de courses composé de trois classes de véhicules (A, B et C) pour autant de tournois que le joueur doit gagner pour débloquer les suivants.

Localization.Title: Roadsters
Localization.Description: Roadsters auf der Playstation ist ein Rennspiel, das aus drei Fahrzeugklassen (A, B und C) für so viele Turniere besteht, wie der Spieler gewinnen muss, um die folgenden freizuschalten.

Localization.Title: Roadsters
Localization.Description: Titus returns to the racing games that they started in Commodore Amiga with the Crazy Cars game series (the first one was released in 1987 and the third and last one in 1992) with Roadsters that features the same great gameplay with enhanced 3d graphics.

Localization.Title: Galerians (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Rion wakes-up in a hospital room, and the only thing he can remember is his name. However, Rion is no ordinary 14-year old. He is a Galerian?a human with special psychic powers.

Localization.Title: Galerians (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Galerians est un jeu d'action/aventure de science-fiction sur Playstation. Dans la peau d'un garçon amnésique de 14 ans, vous devrez tout faire pour retrouver la mémoire, quitte à affronter bon nombre d'adversaires.

Localization.Title: Galerians (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Rion, ein begabter junger Mann mit telekinetischen Fähigkeiten, ist gefangen in einem Strudel von Gewalt, Drogen und Wahnvorstellungen. Der Kampf zwischen Gut und Böse wird in den Häuserschluchten der japanischen Metropole Tokio ausgetragen.

Localization.Title: Galerians (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: 500 años en el futuro, un niño se despierta en un hospital sin ningún recuerdo de quién es o cómo llegó allí. Poco a poco, con el uso de poderes psíquicos, encontrarás pistas para desbloquear tu pasado.

Localization.Title: Galerians (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Galerians è un gioco di azione/avventura di fantascienza per Playstation. Nei panni di un ragazzo di 14 anni affetto da amnesia, dovrai fare di tutto per ritrovare la memoria, anche se ciò significa affrontare numerosi avversari.

Localization.Title: Galerians (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Rion acorda em um quarto de hospital, e a única coisa que consegue se lembrar é o seu nome. No entanto, Rion não é um garoto de 14 anos comum. Ele é um Galerian, um humano com poderes psíquicos especiais.

Localization.Title: Worms Armageddon
Localization.Description: Gameplay is turn-based, with each team moving in sequence (which is determined randomly) across two-dimensional terrain. During a single turn, a team can only move one of its worms (unless the Select Worm item is used).

Localization.Title: Worms Armageddon
Localization.Description: Worms Armageddon sur Playstation est un jeu d'action stratégique mettant en scène des équipes de vers de terre combattant dans un environnement en 2D.

Localization.Title: Worms Armageddon
Localization.Description: Die beliebten Kampfwürmer rüsten auf der PlayStation auf: Neben den althergebrachten Bomben und Raketen machen sie sich nun mit 30 zusätzlichen Waffen wie "Superschaf" oder "Indianischer Nukleartest" gegenseitig das Leben schwer.

Localization.Title: Ready 2 Rumble Boxing
Localization.Description: Ready 2 Rumble is a cartoon style boxing beat 'em up with plenty of strange looking characters to choose from and beat the hell out of.

Localization.Title: Ready 2 Rumble Boxing
Localization.Description: Ready 2 Rumble Boxing sur Playstation est un jeu de boxe où priment le fun et la bonne ambiance. Une vingtaine de boxeurs/boxeuses, plus ou moins funkys sont proposés.

Localization.Title: Ready 2 Rumble Boxing
Localization.Description: Gleich fliegen Fäuste durch die Lüfte, zwingen Uppercuts die Gegenüber in die Knie und bringen knallhart geschlagene Haken die Kontrahenten zum Wanken.

Localization.Title: Ready 2 Rumble Boxing
Localization.Description: Ready 2 Rumble Boxing es un beat 'em up de boxeo con un estilo gráfico de dibujos animados, tiene muchos personajes peculiares para elegir y vencer.

Localization.Title: Ready 2 Rumble Boxing
Localization.Description: Ready 2 Rumble è un picchiaduro di boxe in stile cartone animato con un sacco di personaggi dall'aspetto strano tra cui scegliere e sconfiggere a morte.

Localization.Title: Ready 2 Rumble Boxing

Localization.Description: New edition of Midway's "NFL Jam" action/sports game where the emphasis is on bone-crushing action rather than sport simulation.

Localization.Title: NFL Blitz 2000
Localization.Description: NFL Blitz 2000 sur Playstation est un jeu de football américain très orienté arcade. Vous vous occuperez sûrement peu du ballon et tenterez plutôt de faire les pires crasses à votre adversaire.

Localization.Title: NFL Blitz 2000
Localization.Description: Neuauflage von Midways Action-/Sportspiel „NFL Jam“, bei dem der Schwerpunkt eher auf knallharter Action als auf Sportsimulation liegt.

Localization.Title: NFL Blitz 2000
Localization.Description: Nueva edición del juego de acción/deporte "NFL Jam" de Midway, donde el énfasis esta en en la acción demoledora mas que en la simulación deportiva.

Localization.Title: Hydro Thunder
Localization.Description: Straight out of the Arcade and into your home via the PlayStation is Hydro Thunder by Midway. Only two modes of play exist, race alone or against another player. There are no championships to race for or time trials to beat.

Localization.Title: Hydro Thunder
Localization.Description: Hydro Thunder sur Playstation est un jeu de courses de bateaux survitaminé. Plutôt axé arcade, le soft repose sur un système de checkpoints que vous devez franchir à la suite pour poursuivre la course jusqu'au bout.

Localization.Title: Hydro Thunder
Localization.Description: Direkt aus der Spielhalle und über die PlayStation zu Ihnen nach Hause kommt Hydro Thunder von Midway. Es gibt nur zwei Spielmodi: Rennen alleine oder gegen einen anderen Spieler.

Localization.Title: Hydro Thunder
Localization.Description: Directamente desde el Arcade a tu casa a través de la PlayStation es Hydro Thunder by Midway. Sólo existen dos modos de juego, correr solo o contra otro jugador. No hay campeonatos que disputar ni contrarreloj que batir.

Localization.Title: Mortal Kombat: Special Forces
Localization.Description: Why do people hate? What causes such intense animosity that a person would go to any length to hurt someone, perhaps even destroy them? These are just a few questions posed by the relationship of Jax and Kano.

Localization.Title: Mortal Kombat : Special Forces
Localization.Description: Mortal Kombat Special Forces est un jeu d'action sur Playstation. Kano et toute sa bande de méchants garnements se sont évadés du pénitencier. Jax, le personnage ayant des bras bioniques, est le héros de cette aventure.

Localization.Title: Mortal Kombat: Special Forces
Localization.Description: Sie übernehmen die Rolle des bekannten Mortal-Kombat-Charakters Jax und steigen herab in das Reich der Dunkelheit auf der Suche nach Ihrem Erzfeind Kano.

Localization.Title: Mortal Kombat: Special Forces
Localization.Description: Asumes el papel de Jax, el conocido personaje de Mortal Kombat, en su descenso al reino de la oscuridad en busca de su archienemigo Kano.

Localization.Title: Mortal Kombat: Special Forces
Localization.Description: Assumi il ruolo del noto personaggio di Mortal Kombat Jax e scendi nel regno dell'oscurità alla ricerca del tuo acerrimo nemico Kano.

Localization.Title: Mortal Kombat: Special Forces
Localization.Description: Por que as pessoas odeiam?? O que causa uma animosidade tão intensa que uma pessoa se esforça para machucar alguém, talvez até destruí-la? Estas são apenas algumas perguntas colocadas pelo relacionamento de Jax e Kano.

Localization.Description: Tour the world and ride open and interactive terrain through 12 levels of real-world skate spots from your hometown to New York, Los Angeles, San Francisco and international hotspots in the UK and Germany.

Localization.Title: Thrasher : Skate and Destroy
Localization.Description: Thrasher : Skate And Destroy est un jeu de skateboard sur Playstation. Défiez le skate urbain dans une douzaine de niveaux se déroulant sur des terrains complètement ouverts. Effectuez plus d'une centaine de figures sur des spots extrêmes.

Localization.Title: Thrasher: Skate and Destroy
Localization.Description: Thrasher: Skate And Destroy ist ein Skateboard-Spiel für Playstation. Fordern Sie urbanes Skaten in einem Dutzend Levels heraus, die auf völlig offenem Gelände stattfinden. Führe über hundert Tricks an extremen Stellen aus.

Localization.Title: Thrasher: Skate and Destroy
Localization.Description: Recorre el mundo y recorre un terreno abierto e interactivo a través de 12 niveles de lugares para patinar en el mundo real desde tu ciudad natal hasta Nueva York, Los Ángeles, San Francisco y puntos de acceso internacionales en el Reino Unido y Alemania

Localization.Description: Le deuxième volet de la série Racer de Davilex, une spin-off allemande.

Localization.Title: The Flintstones: Bedrock Bowling
Localization.Description: Prehistoric times, beware -- The Flintstones have invaded the bowling alley! Fred Flintstone, Barney Rubble, Pebbles, Bamm-Bamm, and Dino are taking advantage of a newly transformed Bedrock.

Localization.Title: The Flintstones : Bedrock Bowling
Localization.Description: Dans La Famille Pierrafeu sur Playstation, vous allez participer à un tournoi de bowling grandeur nature. Bien assis dans une boule géante, Fred dévale huit parcours représentants autant de pistes de bowling différentes.

Localization.Title: The Flintstones: Bedrock Bowling
Localization.Description: In „The Flintstones“ auf der Playstation nimmst du an einem lebensgroßen Bowlingturnier teil. Gut sitzend in einer riesigen Kugel saust Fred über acht Bahnen, die ebenso viele verschiedene Bowlingbahnen darstellen.

Localization.Title: The Flintstones: Bedrock Bowling
Localization.Description: Pedro Picapiedra está trabajando duro como siempre en su trabajo de construcción. Cuando es la hora de salir, su jefe le amenaza con despedirle si no termina su tarea de excavación de zanjas para la mañana siguiente.

Localization.Title: The Flintstones: Bedrock Bowling
Localization.Description: Tempi preistorici, attenzione: i Flintstones hanno invaso la pista da bowling! Fred Flintstone, Barney Rubble, Pebbles, Bamm-Bamm e Dino stanno approfittando di un Bedrock appena trasformato.

Localization.Title: The Flintstones: Bedrock Bowling
Localization.Description: Prehistoric times, beware -- The Flintstones have invaded the bowling alley! Fred Flintstone, Barney Rubble, Pebbles, Bamm-Bamm, and Dino are taking advantage of a newly transformed Bedrock.

Localization.Title: L'Amerzone (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: A young journalist meets Alexandre Valembois, an aging explorer haunted by having stolen an egg belonging to the mysterious White Birds. Before dying, Valembois asks the journalist to return the egg to Amerzone.

Localization.Title: L'Amerzone (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Un jeune journaliste rencontre Alexandre Valembois, vieil explorateur rongé par le remords d'avoir autrefois dérobé un œuf des mystérieux Oiseaux Blancs. Avant de mourir, celui-ci lui confie la mission de ramener l'œuf en Amerzone.

Localization.Title: L'Amerzone (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Erleben sie ein Abenteuer außerhalb der Zeit. Er war überzeugend, dieser alte Forschungsreisende:"Bringen sie das Ei der weißen Vögel nach Amerzone, ich bitte sie...Meine Expedition ist bereit, in allen Einzelheiten".

Localization.Title: L'Amerzone (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Amerzone - El Legado del Explorador: Una aventura infinita. Le dijo: "Te lo ruego, trae el huevo de las blancas aves de Amerzone. La expedición está preparada hasta el último detalle". Parecía tan convincente que le creyó.

Localization.Title: L'Amerzone (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Vivi un'avventura fuori dal tempo. Era persuasivo, questo vecchio esploratore: "Porta l'uovo di uccello bianco ad Amerzone, ti prego ... La mia spedizione è pronta in ogni dettaglio". Così convincente che gli credettero.

Localization.Title: L'Amerzone (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Em 1932, Alexandre Valembois era um jovem explorador que, com o seu amigo nativo Antonio Alverez, queria fazer jus ao seu nome, explorando a misteriosa região da Amerzone.

Localization.Title: South Park Rally
Localization.Description: Choose your character from the cast of the popular 'mature' cartoon South Park, and tear through the streets in this racing game. Your character's vehicle may be a little cart, trike, or box, for example.

Localization.Title: South Park Rally
Localization.Description: South Park Rally sur Playstation est un jeu de courses reprenant la licence de la série animée à l'humour corrosif.

Localization.Title: South Park Rally
Localization.Description: South Park Rally für Playstation ist ein Rennspiel, das auf der Lizenz der Zeichentrickserie mit ätzendem Humor basiert.

Localization.Title: South Park Rally
Localization.Description: Elige a tu personaje del elenco del famoso South Park de dibujos animados 'maduros' y lánzate por las calles en este juego de carreras. El vehículo de tu personaje puede ser un pequeño carrito, triciclo o una caja, por ejemplo.

Localization.Title: South Park Rally
Localization.Description: Scegli il tuo personaggio dal cast del famoso cartone animato "maturo" South Park e sfreccia per le strade in questo gioco di corse. Il veicolo del tuo personaggio potrebbe essere un carretto, un trike o una scatola, per esempio.

Localization.Description: MTV Sports: Snowboarding is an extreme sports game where you have to perform tricks on your snowboard. You can opt to play with one of six different boarders, with each their own abilities.

Localization.Description: MTV Snowboarding sur Playstation est une simulation du sport extrême qu'est le Snowboard. Vous pouvez incarner jusqu'à six snowboarders chacun possédant ses propres capacités.

Localization.Description: MTV Sports: Snowboarding ist ein Extremsportspiel, bei dem Sie Tricks auf Ihrem Snowboard ausführen müssen. Sie können mit einem von sechs verschiedenen Boardern spielen, von denen jeder seine eigenen Fähigkeiten hat.

Localization.Title: MTV Sports: Snowboarding

Localization.Title: CyberTiger
Localization.Description: A step back from the Tiger Woods PGA's simulation style, Cyber Tiger Woods has more of an arcade feel to it, with cartoony-style animations, fast gameplay and elements added to make the game of golf more lively than the real-life counterpart.

Localization.Title: CyberTiger
Localization.Description: S'éloignant du style simulation de Tiger Woods PGA, Cyber Tiger Woods offre une expérience plus arcade, avec des animations de style cartoon, un gameplay rapide et des éléments ajoutés pour rendre le jeu de golf plus vivant que dans la réalité.

Localization.Title: CyberTiger
Localization.Description: CyberTiger von Electronic Arts tritt in die Fußstapfen von Hot Shots Golf, NFL Blitz und NBA Jam und bietet eine einzigartige Variante der Sportwelt für den Fan, der sich nicht wirklich an die Regeln halten möchte.

Localization.Title: CyberTiger
Localization.Description: CyberTiger de Electronic Arts sigue los pasos de Hot Shots Golf, NFL Blitz y NBA Jam permitiendo un giro único en el mundo de los deportes, para el aficionado que realmente no quiere «jugar según las reglas».

Localization.Title: Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six
Localization.Description: Using a Tom Clancy storyline and characters, Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six for the PlayStation is an original first person 3D shooter where you take control of an elite counter-terrorist organization named Rainbow Six.

Localization.Title: Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six
Localization.Description: Rainbow Six sur Playstation est un jeu d'action tactique dans lequel vous incarnez un membre de l'élite anti-terroriste.

Localization.Title: Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six
Localization.Description: Eine einzigartige Kombination aus Strategie und 3D-Action. In 16 Einsätzen einer Elite-Antiterroreinheit muss der Spieler sowohl taktisches Feingefühl bei der Planung sowie schnelle Reflexe bei der Ausführung unter Beweis stellen.

Localization.Title: Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six
Localization.Description: Rainbow Six se centra en el año 1999. La unidad anti-terrorista está liderada por John Clark y Domingo Chavez.

Localization.Title: EA Sports Supercross 2000
Localization.Description: You throttle your engine, the bikes beside you are roaring and ready to let fly. The starting light turns green and you hit the gas, sending your bike flying over the initial jump at Bank One Ballpark.

Localization.Title: EA Sports Supercross 2000
Localization.Description: Supercross 2000 est un jeu de courses de motocross sur Playstation. Ce soft vous propose les modes Course rapide, Freestyle, Championnat.

Localization.Title: EA Sports Supercross 2000
Localization.Description: Sie geben den Motor an, die Motorräder neben Ihnen brüllen und sind bereit loszufahren. Die Startampel schaltet auf Grün und Sie geben Gas, sodass Ihr Fahrrad über den ersten Sprung im Bank One Ballpark fliegt.

Localization.Title: Play with the Teletubbies
Localization.Description: Play with the Teletubbies is the first video game based on the popular kids TV series Teletubbies. Players get to choose one of the four Teletubbies, Tinky Winky, Po, Laa-Laa or Dipsy, and have to explore Teletubbyland to find objects.

Localization.Title: Play with the Teletubbies
Localization.Description: Teletubbies est un jeu éducatif sur Playstation. Explorer le monde de Tinky Winky, Dipsi, Laa-laa et Po à travers 11 activités magiques.

Localization.Title: Play with the Teletubbies
Localization.Description: Play with the Teletubbies ist das erste Videospiel, das auf der beliebten Kinderfernsehserie Teletubbies basiert.

Localization.Title: Play with the Teletubbies
Localization.Description: Juega con los Teletubbies es el primer videojuego basado en la popular serie infantil de televisión Teletubbies.

Localization.Title: Play with the Teletubbies
Localization.Description: Play with the Teletubbies é o primeiro videogame baseado na popular série de TV infantil Teletubbies. Os jogadores podem escolher um dos quatro Teletubbies, Tinky Winky, Po, Laa-Laa ou Dipsy, e devem explorar Teletubbyland para encontrar objetos.

Localization.Title: 007: Demain ne Meurt Jamais
Localization.Description: In 007: Tomorrow Never Dies, which is based on the movie of the same name, the player takes the role of the famous James Bond who fights against Elliot Carver. Carver tries to increase his TV ratings by creating a war between the British and the Chinese.

Localization.Title: 007 : Demain ne Meurt Jamais
Localization.Description: Demain Ne Meurt Jamais est un jeu d'action sorti sur Playstation. Retrouvez l'agent le moins secret de Sa Majesté dans cette adaptation du film du même nom. Au programme de l'action, des gadgets, des voitures de rêve et de fabuleuses James Bond Girls.

Localization.Title: 007: Demain ne Meurt Jamais
Localization.Description: Setze als weltmännischer Geheimagent 007 Dein Köpfchen und Deine High-Tech-Geräte ein, um Dich durch die vielen Spionage-Level zu kämpfen. Die Story beruht auf den spannenden Szenen des erfolgreichen Kinofilms, es gibt z.B. Schieß-, Fahr- und Ski-Modi.

Localization.Title: 007: Demain ne Meurt Jamais
Localization.Description: En 007: El Mañana Nunca Muere, basado en la película del mismo nombre, el jugador toma el papel del famoso James Bond que lucha contra Elliot Carver.

Localization.Title: 007: Demain ne Meurt Jamais
Localization.Description: In 007: Il domani non muore mai, basato sull'omonimo film, il giocatore assume il ruolo del famoso James Bond che combatte contro Elliot Carver. Carver cerca di aumentare i suoi ascolti televisivi creando una guerra tra inglesi e cinesi.

Localization.Title: 007: Demain ne Meurt Jamais
Localization.Description: Em 007: Tomorrow Never Dies, que é baseado no filme de mesmo nome, o jogador assume o papel do famoso James Bond que luta contra Elliot Carver. Carver tenta aumentar sua audiência na TV criando uma guerra entre os britânicos e os chineses.

Localization.Title: Army Men 3D
Localization.Description: The little plastic army men you played with as a child are toys no longer! They are now living beings bent on destruction.

Localization.Title: Army Men 3D
Localization.Description: Pour son arrivée sur Playstation, la série Army Men reste toujours attachée au conflit entre les soldats verts et les soldats d'autres couleurs.

Localization.Title: Army Men 3D
Localization.Description: Willkommen in der Welt von Army Men 3D! Zum ersten mal wird die abgefahrene Welt der grünen und braunen Plastiksoldaten in einer echten 3D Umgebung lebendig.

Localization.Title: Army Men 3D
Localization.Description: La serie Army Men sigue unida al conflicto entre soldados verdes y soldados de otros colores. Army Men 3D te sitúa en el campo de batalla donde tendrás que luchar contra enemigos usando las armas a tu disposición.

Localization.Title: Army Men 3D

Localization.Title: Mary King's Riding Star
Localization.Description: Mary King's Riding Star is a managerial simulation set in the equestrian sports business.

Localization.Title: Mary King's Riding Star
Localization.Description: Mary King's Riding Star (Alexandra Ledermann : Equitation Passion en France) est le premier volet de la célèbre série d'équitation sur PSX. Il s'agit d'entretenir son cheval pour qu'il soit opérationnel lors des compétitions.

Localization.Title: Mary King's Riding Star
Localization.Description: Mary King's Riding Star ist eine Managersimulation, die im Pferdesportgeschäft spielt.

Localization.Title: Mary King's Riding Star
Localization.Description: Mary King's Riding Star is a managerial simulation set in the equestrian sports business.

Localization.Title: Mary King's Riding Star
Localization.Description: Mary King's Riding Star is a managerial simulation set in the equestrian sports business.

Localization.Title: Mary King's Riding Star
Localization.Description: Mary King's Riding Star é uma simulação equestre totalmente interactiva. Competir contra amigos, ou o computador em sua busca para se tornar Campeão do Mundo.

Localization.Title: Ruff & Tumble
Localization.Description: The player takes control of either Ruff or Tumble, a brother and sister who are sleeping and trying to free 40 "Winks" from a man named Nitekap and his accomplice, Threadbear.

Localization.Title: Ruff & Tumble
Localization.Description: Dream Story est un jeu de plates-formes sorti sur Playstation. Les Winks sont des petits êtres particulièrement pratiques car ils permettent aux enfants de faire de beaux rêves.

Localization.Title: Ruff & Tumble
Localization.Description: Setze Dich gegen Skelette, Spinnen und Ausserirdische zur Wehr. Bekämpfe Roboter, Zombies, riesige Dinosaurier... In diesem gefährlichen, traum- und alptraumartigen 3D-Adventure ist jeder hinter Dir her.

Localization.Title: Ruff & Tumble
Localization.Description: En el juego se debe tomar el control de Ruff o Tumble, dos niños hermanos que a través de los sueños deben rescatar los "Winks" que son unas pequeñas criaturas blancas y peludas que crean los dulces sueños, y Hoodwinks, son unas criaturas verdes de simil

Localization.Title: Ruff & Tumble
Localization.Description: Lotta come un ninja. Trasformati in un robot... oppure in un mostro! Combatti contro scheletri, ragni e alieni. Lotta con robot, zombie e giganteschi dinosauri... In questo gioco d'avventura 3D, il pericolo è sempre in agguato.

Localization.Title: Ruff & Tumble
Localization.Description: O jogador assume o controle de Ruff ou Tumble, um irmão e irmã que estão dormindo e tentando libertar 40 "Winks" de um homem chamado Nitekap e seu cúmplice, Threadbear.

Localization.Title: Michelin Rally Masters: Race of Champions
Localization.Description: Rally Masters throws you into the Michelin Race of Champions by setting new standards in driving physics, graphical presentation and depth of game play.

Localization.Title: Michelin Rally Masters : Race of Champions
Localization.Description: Rally Masters est, comme son nom l'indique, un jeu de courses de rallye sur Playstation. Ainsi, vous pourrez concourir contre 30 des meilleurs pilotes de rallye actuels comme Colin McRae, Ari Vatannen ou encore Didier Auriol.

Localization.Title: Michelin Rally Masters: Race of Champions
Localization.Description: Rally Masters versetzt Sie in das Michelin Race of Champions, indem es neue Maßstäbe in Sachen Fahrphysik, grafischer Darstellung und Spieltiefe setzt.

Localization.Title: Michelin Rally Masters: Race of Champions
Localization.Description: Rally Masters te sumerge en la Carrera de Campeones Michelin estableciendo nuevos estándares en física de conducción, presentación gráfica y profundidad de juego.

Localization.Title: Michelin Rally Masters: Race of Champions

Localization.Title: PGA European Tour Golf
Localization.Description: European PGA Tour Golf is the latest offering from Infogrames, attempting to nestle itself in an already bloated market of golfing games.

Localization.Title: PGA European Tour Golf
Localization.Description: PGA European Tour Golf est une simulation de golf sur Playstation. Incarnez des légendes de la discipline ou affrontez-les sur des parcours européens.

Localization.Title: PGA European Tour Golf
Localization.Description: „European PGA Tour Golf“ ist ein Golfspiel von Infogrames, das in einem bereits übersättigten Markt bestehen will. Es ist offiziell von der European Tour unterstützt, mit bekannten Spielern wie Nick Faldo.

Localization.Title: Grandia (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Grandia is a Japanese-style console RPG, with big-eyed anime style characters, that was first released on the Sega Saturn in 1997. It centers around the story of a young hero named Justin who possesses a mysterious artifact known as the 'Spirit Stone'.

Localization.Title: Grandia (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Grandia est un jeu de rôle sur Playstation. Le bout du monde, frontière inaccessible qui sépare le monde de Grandia en deux parties, l'une habitée pas les humains, l'autre par une race sauvage préférant la magie à la technologie.

Localization.Title: Grandia (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Begleite Justin und seine Freunde auf einer abenteuerlichen Reise durch gewaltige Polygon-Welten von Grandia.

Localization.Title: Grandia (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Grandia está ambientado en un mundo de fantasía de emergente tecnología y exploración. Un joven chico llamado Justin hereda una piedra mágica que le lleva a tomar un viaje alrededor del mundo para descubrir el misterio que rodea una antigua civilización.

Localization.Title: Grandia (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Grandia è un gioco di ruolo su Playstation. La fine del mondo, il confine inaccessibile che separa il mondo di Grandia in due parti, una abitata dagli umani, l'altra da una razza selvaggia che preferisce la magia alla tecnologia.

Localization.Title: Grandia (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: A trama gira em torno de Justin, um apaixonado por aventuras que decide sair de sua cidade natal em uma jornada para desvendar o mistério do conhecimento herdado de uma civilização antiga.

Localization.Description: Unlike other console football management games at the time which were ports of existing PC titles, LMA Manager was designed exclusively for the PlayStation.

Localization.Title: Mánager de Liga
Localization.Description: Contrairement aux autres jeux de gestion de football sur console de l'époque, qui étaient des portages de titres PC existants, LMA Manager a été conçu exclusivement pour la PlayStation.

Localization.Title: Mánager de Liga
Localization.Description: Im Gegensatz zu anderen Konsolen-Fußballmanagementspielen dieser Zeit, bei denen es sich um Portierungen bestehender PC-Titel handelte, wurde LMA Manager ausschließlich für die PlayStation entwickelt.

Localization.Title: Disney/Pixar Toy Story 2: Buzz Lightyear eilt zur Hilfe!
Localization.Description: Woody has been stolen from the bedroom, ready to be sold to the highest bidder by an evil toy collector.

Localization.Title: Disney/Pixar Toy Story 2 : Buzz Lightyear eilt zur Hilfe!
Localization.Description: Toy Story 2 sur Playstation est un jeu de plates-formes dans lequel vous incarnez Buzz l'éclair, un Ranger de l'espace. Vous avez du pain sur la planche car Woody a été enlevé par un collectionneur de jouets sans scrupules.

Localization.Title: Disney/Pixar Toy Story 2: Buzz Lightyear eilt zur Hilfe!
Localization.Description: Als Spielzeugheld Buzz Lightyear haben Sie alle Hände voll zu tun. Ihr bester Freund Woody muß aus den Fängen eines übereifrigen Spielzeugsammlers gerettet werden - ein Wettlauf mit der Zeit beginnt.

Localization.Title: Disney/Pixar Toy Story 2: Buzz Lightyear eilt zur Hilfe!
Localization.Description: ¡Ya ha empezado la cuenta atrás para la aventura! Vas a manejar al héroe Buzz Lightyear, una tarea que requerirá toda tu atención. Tu mejor amigo, Woody, ha sido secuestrado por un coleccionista de juguetes y tienes que rescatarlo en un tiempo limitado.

Localization.Title: Disney/Pixar Toy Story 2: Buzz Lightyear eilt zur Hilfe!
Localization.Description: Woody è stato rubato dalla camera da letto, pronto per essere venduto al miglior offerente da un malvagio collezionista di giocattoli.

Localization.Title: Disney/Pixar Toy Story 2: Buzz Lightyear eilt zur Hilfe!
Localization.Description: Woody foi roubado do quarto, pronto para ser vendido pelo lance mais alto por um colecionador de brinquedos malvado.

Localization.Title: Front Mission 3
Localization.Description: Front Mission 3 is the third main entry and the fifth entry overall in the Front Mission series.

Localization.Title: Front Mission 3
Localization.Description: Dans Front Mission 3 sur Playstation vous incarnez un fougueux pilote Kazuki Takemura qui va se retrouver à son insu dans une guerre cruelle.

Localization.Title: Front Mission 3
Localization.Description: Wir befinden uns im Jahr 2112. Das Jahr, in dem die Volksrepublik "Da Han Zhong" (DHZ) gegründet wurde. Eines Tages, während einer Waffenlieferung an den Stützpunkt Yokosuka, werden Kazuki und sein Freund Ryogo Kusama Zeugen einer Explosion.

Localization.Title: Front Mission 3
Localization.Description: Estamos en el siglo XII. El mundo cada vez está más unificado y se prepara para vivir una compleja conspiración global, coge tu Wanzer y adéntrate en la mejor entrega de la conocida saga de rol táctico de Squaresoft.

Localization.Title: Front Mission 3
Localization.Description: In Front Mission 3 per PlayStation vesti i panni del focoso pilota Kazuki Takemura che si ritroverà inconsapevolmente in una guerra crudele.

Localization.Title: Front Mission 3
Localization.Description: Front Mission 3 is the third main entry and the fifth entry overall in the Front Mission series.

Localization.Title: ISS Pro Evolution
Localization.Description: ISS Pro Evolution is a third video game in ISS Series produced by Konami specially for Playstation. In Japan it has been released as Winning Eleven 4. The engine has been recreated providing new player movements, animations and improved graphics.

Localization.Title: ISS Pro Evolution
Localization.Description: ISS Pro Evolution est un jeu de football sur Playstation. Si les licences de joueurs sont aux abonnés absents, les équipes nationales sont bien là ainsi que 10 stades fidèlement représentés.

Localization.Title: ISS Pro Evolution
Localization.Description: ISS Pro Evolution ist ein drittes Videospiel der ISS-Serie, das von Konami speziell für Playstation entwickelt wurde. In Japan wurde es als Winning Eleven 4 veröffentlicht.

Localization.Title: ISS Pro Evolution
Localization.Description: ISS Pro Evolution, conocido en Japón como Winning Eleven 4, es la tercera entrega de la saga de videojuegos deportivos ISS Pro.

Localization.Title: Railroad Tycoon II
Localization.Description: Establish yourself as a mogul to be reckoned with as you work your way up the ranks of the railway industry in this strategy game. Expand your domain across continents and a changing global marketplace.

Localization.Title: Railroad Tycoon II
Localization.Description: Railroad Tycoon II sur Playstation vous propose de développer le transport ferroviaire à diverses époques. Bâtissez des lignes mythiques comme le Transsibérien ou l'Orient Express à travers les 20 scénarios du mode Campagne.

Localization.Title: Railroad Tycoon II
Localization.Description: Railroad Tycoon II für Playstation bietet Ihnen die Möglichkeit, den Schienenverkehr in verschiedenen Epochen zu entwickeln. Bauen Sie in den 20 Szenarien des Kampagnenmodus mythische Linien wie die Transsibirische Eisenbahn oder den Orient-Express.

Localization.Title: Railroad Tycoon II
Localization.Description: En Railroad Tycoon II, asume el papel del presidente de una compañía de ferrocarril, intentando obtener ganancias para los inversores y completando diversos objetivos, mientras que se ve obstaculizado por las empresas rivales, averías de trenes y asaltan

Localization.Title: Railroad Tycoon II
Localization.Description: Diventa un magnate di successo scalando le gerarchie dell'industria ferroviaria in questo gioco di strategia. Espandi il tuo dominio attraverso i continenti e un mercato globale in continua evoluzione.

Localization.Title: Railroad Tycoon II
Localization.Description: Establish yourself as a mogul to be reckoned with as you work your way up the ranks of the railway industry in this strategy game. Expand your domain across continents and a changing global marketplace.

Localization.Title: Suikoden II
Localization.Description: Suikoden II est un jeu de rôle sur Playstation. Vous y incarnez un jeune orphelin, adopté par un vieil homme et dont le principal souci est de revoir sa ville natale Kyaro.

Localization.Title: Suikoden II
Localization.Description: Suikoden II erzählt die Geschichte rund um Riou und Jowy zwei Freund aus Kindertagen die in der Armee ihres Heimatlandes dienen.

Localization.Title: Suikoden II

Localization.Title: International Track & Field 2
Localization.Description: International Track and Field 2 from Konami is a one-to-four player game (using the Multi Tap) that features 12 different international events, ranging from weightlifting and bicycling to canoeing.

Localization.Title: International Track & Field 2
Localization.Description: International Track & Field 2 est un jeu de sport sur Playstation qui utilise la capture de mouvements pour ses animations de sportifs.

Localization.Title: International Track & Field 2
Localization.Description: Die Leichtathletik-Legende International Track & Field kehrt zurück.

Localization.Title: International Track & Field 2
Localization.Description: International Track and Field 2 de Konami es un juego de uno a cuatro jugadores (que usa el Multi Tap) que presenta 12 eventos internacionales diferentes, que van desde levantamiento de pesas y ciclismo hasta piragüismo.

Localization.Title: International Track & Field 2
Localization.Description: International Track and Field 2 di Konami è un gioco da uno a quattro giocatori (che utilizza il Multi Tap) che presenta 12 diversi eventi internazionali, che vanno dal sollevamento pesi e dal ciclismo alla canoa.

Localization.Title: International Track & Field 2
Localization.Description: International Track and Field 2 from Konami is a one-to-four player game (using the Multi Tap) that features 12 different international events, ranging from weightlifting and bicycling to canoeing.

Localization.Title: Tenchu 2: Birth of the Stealth Assassins
Localization.Description: Before the events of Tenchu, the House of Gohda is rocked by betrayal. As shadow warriors Rikimaru, Ayame and Tatsumaru, you are called on to restore pride to the name of your master. For you have been born to a life of honor... a life of stealth.

Localization.Title: Tenchu 2 : Birth of the Stealth Assassins
Localization.Description: Tenchu 2 est un jeu d'infiltration sur Playstation qui vous amènera dans le Japon médiéval. Vous avez le choix d'incarner deux assassins.

Localization.Title: Tenchu 2: Birth of the Stealth Assassins
Localization.Description: Lebe in Ehre, kämpfe mit List. Lange vor den Ereignissen des ersten Teils wird das Haus Gohda von einer Intrige erschüttert. Als einer der Schattenkämpfer Rikimaru, Ayame oder Tatsumaru müssen Sie den guten Namen Ihres Herrn bewahren.

Localization.Title: Tenchu 2: Birth of the Stealth Assassins
Localization.Description: Vive una nueva aventura de infiltración de la mano de los dos ninjas protagonistas del clan Azuma, y quizá alguno más... La historia de este juego transcurre antes de la historia de Tenchu: Stealth Assassins.

Localization.Title: Tenchu 2: Birth of the Stealth Assassins
Localization.Description: Prima degli eventi di Tenchu, la Casa di Gohda è scossa dal tradimento. Come guerrieri ombra Rikimaru, Ayame e Tatsumaru, sei chiamato a riportare l'orgoglio al nome del tuo maestro. Perché sei nato per una vita d'onore ... una vita di furtività.

Localization.Title: Tenchu 2: Birth of the Stealth Assassins
Localization.Description: Tenchu ​​2 é um jogo furtivo de playstation que o levará ao Japão medieval. Você tem a opção de jogar como dois assassinos.

rom.name: Tenchu 2 - Birth of the Stealth Assassins (Europe).cue

Localization.Title: Grand Theft Auto 2
Localization.Description: The game takes place at an undisclosed time in the near future.

Localization.Title: Grand Theft Auto 2
Localization.Description: Grand Theft Auto 2 sur Playstation, est un jeu d'action vu du dessus. Le joueur incarne Claude Speed, libéré de prison après un sommeil cryogénique. Vous évoluez librement en ville où tout est permis : voler des voitures, frapper, tuer.

Localization.Title: Grand Theft Auto 2
Localization.Description: Grand Theft Auto ist zurück. Sieben skrupellose Gangs sind in einen brutalen Machtkampf verwickelt. Mach dir einen Namen, aber sei auf der Hut. Respekt gibt es nicht umsonst, man muss ihn sich verdienen.

Localization.Title: Grand Theft Auto 2
Localization.Description: Grand Theft Auto 2 es la cuarta entrega de la saga GTA y la penúltima en sandbox 2 dimensiones.

Localization.Title: Grand Theft Auto 2
Localization.Description: Grand Theft Auto 2 è il quarto capitolo della saga di GTA e il penultimo in sandbox bidimensionale.

Localization.Title: Grand Theft Auto 2
Localization.Description: O jogo se passa em um horário não revelado em um futuro próximo.

Localization.Title: Pro Pinball: Fantastic Journey
Localization.Description: Pro Pinball: Fantastic Journey has many features one would expect to find on a standard pinball machine. You'll see bumpers, buzzers, bells, ramps, flippers, gates and plenty of lights.

Localization.Title: Pro Pinball : Fantastic Journey
Localization.Description: Pro Pinball : Fantastic Journey est un jeu de flipper sur Playstation. Voyagez dans le temps et vivez à l'époque de Jules Verne un périple extraordinaire. Au fil des 5 aventures, utilisez vos flips pour voyager dans les différents récits de l'écrivain.

Localization.Title: Pro Pinball: Fantastic Journey
Localization.Description: Pro Pinball: Fantastic Journey ist ein Flipperspiel für die Playstation. Reisen Sie in die Vergangenheit und erleben Sie eine außergewöhnliche Reise durch die Ära von Jules Verne.

Localization.Title: Pro Pinball: Fantastic Journey
Localization.Description: Pro Pinball: Fantastic Journey tiene muchas características que uno esperaría encontrar en una máquina de pinball estándar. Verás parachoques, timbres, campanas, rampas, aletas, portones y muchas luces.

Localization.Title: Pro Pinball: Fantastic Journey
Localization.Description: Pro Pinball: Fantastic Journey has many features one would expect to find on a standard pinball machine. You'll see bumpers, buzzers, bells, ramps, flippers, gates and plenty of lights.

Localization.Title: Pro Pinball: Fantastic Journey

Localization.Title: Wacky Races
Localization.Description: Wacky Races is a popular cartoon series that's being brought to life in the form of a wild and wacky racing videogame by Infogrames.

Localization.Title: Wacky Races
Localization.Description: Les Fous du Volant est un jeu de courses inspiré de la série du même nom.

Localization.Title: Wacky Races
Localization.Description: Wacky Races ist ein Rennspiel, das von der gleichnamigen Serie inspiriert ist.

Localization.Title: Wacky Races
Localization.Description: Wacky Races es un juego de carreras inspirado en la serie del mismo nombre. Por tanto, encontrarás a todos los protagonistas a bordo de sus vehículos, cada uno más loco que el otro.

Localization.Title: Wacky Races
Localization.Description: Wacky Races è una popolare serie di cartoni animati che prende vita sotto forma di un folle e stravagante videogioco di corse da Infogrames.

Localization.Title: Wacky Races
Localization.Description: Corrida Maluca é uma série popular de desenhos animados que está sendo trazida à vida sob a forma de um videogame de corrida selvagem e maluco da Infogrames.

Localization.Title: Vandal Hearts II
Localization.Description: Vandal Hearts II is a turn based strategic RPG which is comparable to the more famous Fire Emblem series. Most of the gameplay consists of moving your party on 3D grid based maps in a way that will give you a strategic advantage over your enemies.

Localization.Title: Vandal Hearts II
Localization.Description: Vandal Hearts 2 est un jeu de rôle et de stratégie sur Playstation. Vous vous retrouvez en l'an de grâce 986 dans la cité de Natra.

Localization.Title: Vandal Hearts II
Localization.Description: Vandal Hearts 2 ist ein Rollenspiel und Strategiespiel für Playstation. Sie befinden sich im Gnadenjahr 986 in der Stadt Natra.

Localization.Title: Vandal Hearts II
Localization.Description: En el sagrado año 986, Lagore, el Rey del gran imperio de Natra fue asesinado a manos de su esposa, la Reina Agatha, y su amante, el Cardenadl Ladorak. Tras el atentado, la reina Agatha estableció a su hijo Franz en el trono.

Localization.Title: Vandal Hearts II
Localization.Description: Vandal Hearts II is a turn based strategic RPG which is comparable to the more famous Fire Emblem series. Most of the gameplay consists of moving your party on 3D grid based maps in a way that will give you a strategic advantage over your enemies.

Localization.Title: Vandal Hearts II
Localization.Description: Vandal Hearts II é um RPG estratégico baseado em turnos comparável à mais famosa série Fire Emblem.

Localization.Title: Medal of Honor
Localization.Description: FIGHT WWII FOR THE FIRST TIME Tomorrow is D-Day. Tonight you land behind enemy lines. The tide of the war is in your hands. Your are an elite Special Forces agent sent to execute covert operations, search and rescue missions, and commando raids.

Localization.Title: Medal of Honor
Localization.Description: Dans Medal of Honor, un jeu de tir à la première personne sur Playstation, vous incarnez un membre des forces spéciales parachuté derrière les lignes ennemies en 1944.

Localization.Title: Medal of Honor
Localization.Description: Morgen ist D-Day. Heute Nacht landest Du hinter feindlichen Linien. Der Ausgang des Kriegs liegt in Deinen Händen. Du bist ein Elite-Spezialagent, der auf verdeckte Operationen, Such- und Rettungsmissionen geschickt wird.

Localization.Title: Medal of Honor
Localization.Description: Lucha por primera vez en la segunda guerra mundial. Mañana es el Día D. Esta noche aterrizará detrás de las líneas enemigas. El destino de la guerra está en sus manos.

Localization.Title: Medal of Honor
Localization.Description: Medal of Honor è uno sparatutto in prima persona per PlayStation in cui giochi nei panni di un membro delle forze speciali paracadutato dietro le linee nemiche nel 1944.

Localization.Title: Medal of Honor
Localization.Description: Medal of Honor é um jogo de tiro em primeira pessoa no Playstation em que você joga como um membro das Forças Especiais em paraquedas atrás das linhas inimigas em 1944.

Localization.Title: Missile Command
Localization.Description: Invasores misteriosos estão a atacar as tuas cidades! Como comandante de uma base de mísseis, é da tua responsabilidade defendê-las. Os inimigos virão do céu para tentar destruir as cidades na parte inferior do ecrã.

Localization.Title: Resident Evil 3: Nemesis
Localization.Description: Join Jill Valentine, the heroine and amazing survivor of the notorious disaster at the mansion, as her nightmare continues. After resigning from S.T.A.R.S. Jill now prepares to head out of Raccoon City...but it's not going to be easy.

Localization.Title: Resident Evil 3 : Nemesis
Localization.Description: Après avoir survécu à l'horreur du laboratoire secret du manoir, Jill Valentine décide de fuir Raccoon City au plus vite.

Localization.Title: Resident Evil 3: Nemesis
Localization.Description: Nur wenige Tage nach dem Zwischenfall im Gen-Labor den Arclay-Bergen quittiert Jill Valentine Ihren Dienst bei S.T.A.R.S. und will Racoon City so schnell wie möglich verlassen.

Localization.Title: Resident Evil 3: Nemesis

Localization.Description: Thrasher : Skate And Destroy est un jeu de skateboard sur Playstation. Défiez le skate urbain dans une douzaine de niveaux se déroulant sur des terrains complètement ouverts. Effectuez plus d'une centaine de figures sur des spots extrêmes.

Localization.Title: Thrasher: Skate and Destroy
Localization.Description: Thrasher: Skate And Destroy ist ein Skateboard-Spiel für Playstation. Fordern Sie urbanes Skaten in einem Dutzend Levels heraus, die auf völlig offenem Gelände stattfinden. Führe über hundert Tricks an extremen Stellen aus.

Localization.Title: Thrasher: Skate and Destroy
Localization.Description: Recorre el mundo y recorre un terreno abierto e interactivo a través de 12 niveles de lugares para patinar en el mundo real desde tu ciudad natal hasta Nueva York, Los Ángeles, San Francisco y puntos de acceso internacionales en el Reino Unido y Alemania

Localization.Description: Psychic Force is a fighting arcade game created by Taito which was later ported to the PlayStation in 1996. The PlayStation version was released by Acclaim in North America, and in PAL regions.

Localization.Title: Psychic Force 2

Localization.Title: Psychic Force 2
Localization.Description: Psychic Force 2 ist ein Action- und Kampfspiel für Playstation. Sie spielen als Hellseher, Wesen mit kolossalen mentalen Kräften.

Localization.Title: Psychic Force 2
Localization.Description: Se trataba de un juego de lucha en 3D que combinaba las características normales de un arcade de lucha con poderes psíquicos. Se podía elegir entre ocho personajes, todos ellos considerados «maestros psíquicos».

Localization.Title: Parasite Eve II (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Aya Brea is back in a new game. This time there are fewer RPG elements than the first game, and the game plays more like Resident Evil. Battles are now in real-time, and a new range of weapons are available.

Localization.Title: Parasite Eve II (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Parasite Eve II est un jeu d'action sur Playstation. Dans la peau de la belle Aya, le soft ne vous invite pas à un cours de cytologie, mais vous jette sur les traces des affreuses créatures pour mettre à jour une terrible affaire.

Localization.Title: Parasite Eve II (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Eine böse Art von Neo-Mitochondrien-Kreaturen hat den Akropolis-Turm erobert und jeden eliminiert, der sich ihnen in den Weg stellte. Die Situation gerät außer Kontrolle.

Localization.Title: Parasite Eve II (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Una especie malévola de las Criaturas Neomitocondriales ha tomado la Torre Akropolis, eliminando a todos los que se interpongan en su camino. Esta situación amenazante y la Policía de Los Ángeles necesitan tu ayuda desesperadamente.

Localization.Title: Parasite Eve II (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Una specie malevola di Creature Neo mitocondriali ha preso il controllo della Torre di Akropolis, eliminando tutti coloro che si frappongono sulla loro strada.

Localization.Title: Parasite Eve II (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Aya Brea está de volta em um novo jogo. Desta vez, há menos elementos de RPG do que o primeiro jogo, e o jogo é mais parecido com Resident Evil. As batalhas estão agora em tempo real e uma nova gama de armas está disponível.

Localization.Description: Jarrett & Labonte Stock Car Racing is the U.S. version of Codemasters' European TOCA World Touring Cars, modified to feature stock cars in place of the original's touring cars.

Localization.Description: TOCA World Touring Cars est un jeu de simulation de courses sur Playstation. On trouve dans ce soft quatre modes de jeu englobant les courses libres ou aléatoires, les essais et surtout le mode carrière.

Localization.Title: TOCA World Touring Cars
Localization.Description: TOCA World Touring Cars ist ein Rennsimulationsspiel für Playstation. Wir finden in dieser Software vier Spielmodi, darunter kostenlose oder zufällige Rennen, Prüfungen und insbesondere den Karrieremodus.

Localization.Description: The Quest for the Sunstones is a 3D platform jump'n'run game. Like Indiana Jones, Hugo takes on great danger only equipped with a whip. It is a Crash Bandicoot like game - both in graphics style and gameplay.

Localization.Title: Hugo : The Quest for the Sunstones
Localization.Description: Les Kikurians, un peuple vivant heureux au coeur de la jungle, courent un grand danger. Le volcan situé près de leurs villages est sur le point de faire éruption car Don Croco, sur les ordres de Scylla, a bouché son cratère avec un énorme rocher.

Localization.Title: Hugo: The Quest for the Sunstones
Localization.Description: Tief im Dschungel befindet sich das Dorf der sonst so fröhlichen Kikureaner in einer großen Gefahr.

Localization.Title: Hugo: The Quest for the Sunstones
Localization.Description: Hugo: The Quest for the Sunstones es un juego de plataformas en 3D similar a Crash Bandicoot, tanto en estilo gráfico como en jugabilidad.

Localization.Title: Hugo: The Quest for the Sunstones
Localization.Description: The Quest for the Sunstones è un gioco platform 3D jump'n'run. Come Indiana Jones, Hugo affronta grandi pericoli solo con una frusta. È un gioco simile a Crash Bandicoot, sia nello stile grafico che nel gameplay.

Localization.Title: Hugo: The Quest for the Sunstones
Localization.Description: Hugo: The Quest for the Sunstones é um jogo de plataforma 3D semelhante ao Crash Bandicoot, tanto em estilo gráfico quanto em jogabilidade.

Localization.Description: Roswell Conspiracies est un jeu d'action sur Playstation. Vous incarnez Nick Logan et Sh'Lainn Blaze, deux agents fédéraux américains, envoyés dans le laboratoire de recherche secret de Roswell. Bien sûr, ce qui vous attend n'est pas ordinaire...

Localization.Title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths & Legends
Localization.Description: Roswell Conspiracies ist ein Actionspiel für Playstation. Sie spielen als Nick Logan und Sh'Lainn Blaze, zwei amerikanische Bundesagenten, die in das geheime Forschungslabor von Roswell geschickt werden. Was Sie erwartet, ist natürlich nicht alltäglich .

Localization.Title: Fisherman's Bait 2: Big Ol' Bass
Localization.Description: Featuring more than fifteen different kinds of fish, twenty different fishing holes and lots of different lures, Fisherman's Bait 2: Big Ol' Bass is the PlayStation version of the popular Arcade game.

Localization.Title: Fisherman's Bait 2 : Big Ol' Bass
Localization.Description: Toujours sur Playstation, ce second épisode de la série de jeux de pêche vous confronte une nouvelle fois aux plus gros bars du monde. Dans Fisherman's Bait : Big Ol' Bass, vous devrez tout mettre en oeuvre pour sortir de l'eau des bars bien dodus.

Localization.Title: Fisherman's Bait 2: Big Ol' Bass
Localization.Description: Mit mehr als fünfzehn verschiedenen Fischarten, zwanzig verschiedenen Angelstellen und vielen verschiedenen Ködern ist Fisherman's Bait 2: Big Ol' Bass die PlayStation-Version des beliebten Arcade-Spiels.

Localization.Title: Fisherman's Bait 2: Big Ol' Bass
Localization.Description: Fisherman's Bait 2: Big Ol 'Bass es la versión de PlayStation del popular juego Arcade, que presenta más de quince tipos diferentes de peces, veinte pozos de pesca diferentes y muchos señuelos diferentes.

Localization.Title: Fisherman's Bait 2: Big Ol' Bass
Localization.Description: Featuring more than fifteen different kinds of fish, twenty different fishing holes and lots of different lures, Fisherman's Bait 2: Big Ol' Bass is the PlayStation version of the popular Arcade game.

Localization.Title: Street Fighter EX2 Plus
Localization.Description: Capcom's all-time, flagship fighting series once again goes 3-D with Street Fighter EX 2 Plus.

Localization.Title: Street Fighter EX2 Plus
Localization.Description: Street Fighter EX2 Plus est un jeu de Combat sur Playstation. Le soft vous offre 22 personnages de la série Street Fighter modélisés en 3 dimensions.

Localization.Title: Street Fighter EX2 Plus
Localization.Description: 100% harte 3D Kampf-Action. SFEX2 PLUS ist das ultimative Street Fighter-Spiel. Kaufe es und sei glücklich, dass es wohl kaum eine bessere Fortsetzung für die Playstation geben wird, weil wir jetzt schon das Äußerste aus dem Gerät holen.

Localization.Title: Street Fighter EX2 Plus
Localization.Description: Secuela de Street Fighter EX con gráficos mejorados. Elige uno de los 22 luchadores de la saga Street Fighter con modelados en 3D

Localization.Title: Street Fighter EX2 Plus
Localization.Description: La serie di picchiaduro di punta di tutti i tempi di Capcom diventa ancora una volta in 3D con Street Fighter EX 2 Plus.

Localization.Title: Street Fighter EX2 Plus
Localization.Description: Capcom's all-time, flagship fighting series once again goes 3-D with Street Fighter EX 2 Plus.

Localization.Title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure
Localization.Description: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure has its roots in the realm of the comic book. Players will be able to take control of Jotaro Kujo, his friends, and his enemies in this world hopping, globe spanning fighting fest.

Localization.Title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure
Localization.Description: Inspiré du manga du même nom, JoJo's Bizarre Adventure sur Playstation est un jeu de combat en 2D.

Localization.Title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure
Localization.Description: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure hat seine Wurzeln im Bereich der Comics. Spieler können die Kontrolle über Jotaro Kujo, seine Freunde und seine Feinde in diesem weltumspannenden Kampffest übernehmen.

Localization.Title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure
Localization.Description: Basado en el manga/anime japones del mismo nombre, La Aventura Bizarra De JoJo es un juego de peleas en 2D de Capcom, Asume el rol de uno de los 18 personajes y combate a tus amigos en el modo Arcade, o toma el rol de Jotaro "JoJo" Kujo y sus amigos en e

Localization.Title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure
Localization.Description: Le bizzarre avventure di JoJo ha le sue radici nel regno dei fumetti.

Localization.Title: Alundra 2: A New Legend Begins
Localization.Description: In the distant lands of the Vanilla Kingdom; a mysterious being has appeared in the Doru region, who is able to change the evolution of the animal kingdom at will, forcing a magical evolution.

Localization.Title: Alundra 2 : A New Legend Begins
Localization.Description: Alundra 2 est un jeu de rôle/aventure d'inspiration fantasy sur Playstation. Avec l'aide d'un sorcier et de pirates, un diabolique baron a emprisonné le monarque du royaume de Varuna. Un épéiste du nom de Flint décide de s'opposer...

Localization.Title: Alundra 2: A New Legend Begins
Localization.Description: Du bist Flint, ein abtrünniger Schwertkämpfer, der angeheuert wird, um das Königreich Varuna aus den Klauen eines grausamen Herrschers zu befreien.

Localization.Title: Alundra 2: A New Legend Begins
Localization.Description: En las lejanas tierras del reino de Vanilla ha aparecido un misterioso ser en la región de Doru, que es capaz de variar a su antojo la evolución del reino animal, forzando una evolución mágica.

Localization.Title: Alundra 2: A New Legend Begins
Localization.Description: Alundra 2 è un gioco di ruolo/avventura ispirato alla fantasia su Playstation. Con l'aiuto di uno stregone e di pirati, un malvagio barone ha imprigionato il monarca del regno di Varuna. Uno spadaccino di nome Flint decide di opporsi a lui...

Localization.Title: Colin McRae Rally 2.0
Localization.Description: Colin McRae Rally 2.0 is a racing video game developed and published by Codemasters for PlayStation. It is the second game in the Colin McRae Rally series. You get to race in locations around the world, over 60 stages in eight different countries.

Localization.Title: Colin McRae Rally 2.0
Localization.Description: Colin McRae Rally 2.0 sur Playstation est un jeu de courses proposant de prendre les commandes de 13 véhicules (dont la ford Focus, la Subaru Impreza, et la Peugeot 205 turbo) à travers 8 pays et 80 étapes.

Localization.Title: Colin McRae Rally 2.0
Localization.Description: Beim Nachfolger der umjubelten Rallyesimulation wurde der Wunsch vieler Spieler nach einem Modus entsprochen, in dem man nicht nur gegen die Uhr und damit allein auf weiter Flur spielt.

Localization.Title: Colin McRae Rally 2.0
Localization.Description: Colin McRae Rally 2.0 es un videojuego de carreras desarrollado y publicado por Codemasters para PlayStation. Es el segundo juego de la serie Colin McRae Rally.

Localization.Title: Colin McRae Rally 2.0
Localization.Description: Con il successore dell'acclamata simulazione di rally, la richiesta di molti giocatori di una modalità in cui non si gioca solo contro il tempo e quindi da soli nel corridoio è stata soddisfatta.

Localization.Title: Colin McRae Rally 2.0
Localization.Description: Colin McRae Rally 2.0 é um jogo de corridas onde pode-se dirigir 13 veículos (incluindo o ford Focus, Subaru Impreza, e Peugeot 205 Turbo) em 8 países e 80 etapas.

Localization.Title: Armorines: Project S.W.A.R.M.
Localization.Description: An alien insect race, facing extinction on its home world, has secretly established colonies beneath Earth's surface and is preparing an invasion. Humanity responds by deploying the Armorines, soldiers equipped with experimental combat armor.

Localization.Title: Armorines : Project S.W.A.R.M.
Localization.Description: Une race d'insectes extraterrestres, menacée d'extinction sur sa planète, s'est installée secrètement sous la surface de la Terre et prépare son invasion.

Localization.Title: Armorines: Project S.W.A.R.M.
Localization.Description: Die Erde wird bedroht von einer tödlichen Insektenrasse aus dem Weltall. FEATURES: - Kooperations-Modus - Mehrspieler-Modus - Über 30 realistische, selbständig denkende Gegner in ekliger Insektenvorm - Einzigartige Waffensysteme sichern Dein Überleben...

Localization.Title: Armorines: Project S.W.A.R.M.
Localization.Description: ¿Dominio Humano o Plaga de Insectos? La elección es tuya. Eres un Armorine. Cuentas con lo último en trajes de batalla futuristas y un devastador arsenal de armas. Tienes 120 horas para detener una invasión de insectos a escala global.

Localization.Title: Armorines: Project S.W.A.R.M.
Localization.Description: An alien insect race, facing extinction on its home world, has secretly established colonies beneath Earth's surface and is preparing an invasion. Humanity responds by deploying the Armorines, soldiers equipped with experimental combat armor.

Localization.Description: Brunswick Circuit Pro Bowling 2 for the PlayStation is the sequel to the bowling simulation Brunswick Circuit Pro Bowling.

Localization.Title: Brunswick Circuit Pro Bowling 2
Localization.Description: Brunswick Circuit Pro Bowling 2 pour la PlayStation est la suite de la simulation de bowling Brunswick Circuit Pro Bowling.

Localization.Title: Brunswick Circuit Pro Bowling 2
Localization.Description: Brunswick Circuit Pro Bowling 2 für die PlayStation ist die Fortsetzung der Bowling-Simulation Brunswick Circuit Pro Bowling.

Localization.Title: Brunswick Circuit Pro Bowling 2
Localization.Description: Brunswick Circuit Pro Bowling 2 es el segundo de la serie de juegos de bolos de Brunswick Circuit. El juego utiliza muchos aspectos del juego original, los mejora y agrega nuevas funciones.

Localization.Title: WWF SmackDown!
Localization.Description: THQ managed to wrest the WWF license away from Acclaim for no less than ten years (as of 2000). THQ then went to the respected Japanese wrestling game developer Yuke's Co.

Localization.Title: WWF SmackDown!
Localization.Description: WWF Smackdown! est un jeu de catch sur Playstation. Le soft propose de nombreuses stars de WWF ainsi qu'un éditeur de personnages pour créer un catcheur personnalisé.

Localization.Title: WWF SmackDown!
Localization.Description: WWF-Smackdown! ist ein Wrestlingspiel auf der Playstation. Die Software bietet viele WWF-Stars sowie einen Charaktereditor zum Erstellen eines personalisierten Wrestlers.

Localization.Title: WWF SmackDown!
Localization.Description: WWF Smackdown es un juego de lucha libre profesional donde el jugador puede seleccionar entre 36 jugadores para pelear en modos uno contra uno, parejas, areas fuera del ring, lucha extrema, etc.

Localization.Title: WWF SmackDown!
Localization.Description: THQ managed to wrest the WWF license away from Acclaim for no less than ten years (as of 2000). THQ then went to the respected Japanese wrestling game developer Yuke's Co.

Localization.Title: WWF SmackDown!
Localization.Description: A THQ conseguiu arrancar a licença WWF da Acclaim por pelo menos dez anos (em 2000). A THQ então foi até a respeitada desenvolvedora de jogos de luta livre japonesa Yuke's Co.

Localization.Title: Army Men: Air Attack
Localization.Description: The war between the troops of plastic soldiers continues to rage and many soldiers are left wounded on the battlefield. Get on your helicopter, fly over the area to recover your comrades and save their lives.

Localization.Title: Army Men : Air Attack
Localization.Description: La guerre entre les différentes troupes de soldats de plastique continue de faire rage et beaucoup de soldats sont laissés blessés sur le champ de bataille. A bord de votre hélicoptère, survolez les lieux pour récupérer vos camarades et sauvez leur vie.

Localization.Title: Army Men: Air Attack
Localization.Description: Lenken Sie einen von vier Helikoptern durch verräterisches Gebiet im Garten, in Picknickbereichen und nahegelegenen Stränden. Führe Luft- und Luft-Bodenkriege mit Feinden in Form von Kampfschiffen bis Schmetterlingen.

Localization.Title: Army Men: Air Attack
Localization.Description: Muy similar a Army Men: Air Tactics, excepto que es en completo 3D. Debes rescatar cualquier compañero, o derribar helicópteros enemigos y las fuerzas de tierra para permitir que tus compañeros de tropa puedan avanzar en el frente.

Localization.Title: Army Men: Air Attack
Localization.Description: La guerra tra le truppe di soldatini di plastica continua a infuriare e molti soldati restano feriti sul campo di battaglia. Sali sul tuo elicottero, sorvola la zona per recuperare i tuoi compagni e salvare loro la vita.

Localization.Title: Army Men: Air Attack
Localization.Description: The war between the troops of plastic soldiers continues to rage and many soldiers are left wounded on the battlefield. Get on your helicopter, fly over the area to recover your comrades and save their lives.

Localization.Description: Ronaldo V-Football is the pinnacle of soccer experiences for the PSX. Endorsed by international legend, Ronaldo Luis Nazario de Lima, Ronaldo V-Football brings Brazilian soccer traditions to the rest of the world.

Localization.Title: Theme Park World
Localization.Description: Sim Theme Park is the sequel to Theme Park and the second game in the series. It is a theme park management game where players build their own theme park with roller coasters, rides and food stalls.

Localization.Title: Theme Park World
Localization.Description: Theme Park World est un jeu de gestion sur Playstation. Construisez le parc d'attractions de vos rêves dans ses moindres détails, testez vos attractions grâce à la vue subjective.

Localization.Title: Theme Park World
Localization.Description: Theme Park World ist ein Managementspiel für Playstation. Bauen Sie den Vergnügungspark Ihrer Träume bis ins kleinste Detail, testen Sie Ihre Attraktionen aus der subjektiven Sicht.

Localization.Title: Theme Park World
Localization.Description: Theme Park World es la secuela de Theme Park y el segundo juego de la serie. Es un juego de gestión de parques temáticos donde los jugadores construyen su propio parque con montañas rusas, paseos y puestos de comida.

Localization.Title: Theme Park World
Localization.Description: Theme Park World è il sequel di Theme Park e il secondo gioco della serie. È un gioco di gestione di parchi a tema in cui i giocatori costruiscono il proprio parco con montagne russe, giostre e stand gastronomici.

Localization.Title: Theme Park World
Localization.Description: Sim Theme Park é a sequência de Theme Park e o segundo jogo da série. É um jogo de gerenciamento de parque temático onde os jogadores constroem seu próprio parque temático com montanhas-russas, brinquedos e barracas de comida.

Localization.Title: Need for Speed: Porsche 2000
Localization.Description: Need for Speed: Porsche Unleashed tests your driving skills while you test-drive some of Porsche's most popular cars. In the game, you'll compete in levels that feature twists, turns, and various driving conditions.

Localization.Title: Need for Speed : Porsche 2000
Localization.Description: Need For Speed : Porsche 2000 est un jeu de courses sur Playstation.

Localization.Title: Need for Speed: Porsche 2000
Localization.Description: Du kennst deine Grenzen.

Localization.Title: Need for Speed: Porsche 2000
