Localization.Title: FIFA 2001
Localization.Description: FIFA 2001 comes back to the series' fast-paced roots. The gameplay is balanced differently to previous versions, and includes online play as an option. It includes 17 leagues from around the world in addition to over 50 national teams.

Localization.Title: FIFA 2001
Localization.Description: FIFA 2001 est un jeu de football sur Playstation comportant plus de cinquante équipes dont l'Angleterre, la France, l'Allemagne, les Pays-Bas, l'Espagne et les Etats-Unis. Plusieurs stars du ballon rond se sont prêtées au jeu de la capture de mouvements.

Localization.Title: FIFA 2001
Localization.Description: FIFA 2001 kehrt zu den rasanten Wurzeln der Serie zurück. Das Gameplay ist anders ausbalanciert als in früheren Versionen und bietet optional auch Online-Spiele. Es umfasst 17 Ligen aus der ganzen Welt sowie über 50 Nationalmannschaften.

Localization.Title: FIFA 2001
Localization.Description: FIFA 2001 vuelve a las raíces aceleradas de la serie. La jugabilidad está equilibrada de manera diferente a las versiones anteriores e incluye el juego en línea como una opción. Incluye 17 ligas de todo el mundo, además de más de 50 equipos nacionales.

Localization.Title: FIFA 2001
Localization.Description: FIFA 2001 torna alle origini frenetiche della serie. Il gameplay è bilanciato in modo diverso rispetto alle versioni precedenti e include la possibilità di giocare online. Include 17 campionati da tutto il mondo oltre a più di 50 squadre nazionali.

Localization.Title: FIFA 2001
Localization.Description: FIFA 2001 est un jeu de football sur Playstation comportant plus de cinquante équipes dont l'Angleterre, la France, l'Allemagne, les Pays-Bas, l'Espagne et les Etats-Unis. Plusieurs stars du ballon rond se sont prêtées au jeu de la capture de mouvements.

Localization.Title: FIFA 2001
Localization.Description: FIFA 2001 kehrt zu den rasanten Wurzeln der Serie zurück. Das Gameplay ist anders ausbalanciert als in früheren Versionen und bietet optional auch Online-Spiele. Es umfasst 17 Ligen aus der ganzen Welt sowie über 50 Nationalmannschaften.

Localization.Title: FIFA 2001
Localization.Description: FIFA 2001 vuelve a las raíces aceleradas de la serie. La jugabilidad está equilibrada de manera diferente a las versiones anteriores e incluye el juego en línea como una opción. Incluye 17 ligas de todo el mundo, además de más de 50 equipos nacionales.

Localization.Title: FIFA 2001
Localization.Description: FIFA 2001 torna alle origini frenetiche della serie. Il gameplay è bilanciato in modo diverso rispetto alle versioni precedenti e include la possibilità di giocare online. Include 17 campionati da tutto il mondo oltre a più di 50 squadre nazionali.

Localization.Title: Tiger Woods PGA Tour Golf
Localization.Description: EA Sports brings Tiger Woods and the PGA Tour golf series to the PlayStation one last time with their 2001 edition. More than twice as many real golfers are in the 2001 version than the 2000 edition for you to play as or play against.

Localization.Title: Tiger Woods PGA Tour Golf
Localization.Description: Tiger Woods PGA Tour Golf est un jeu de sport sur Playstation qui propose d'incarner Tiger Woods et 7 autres golfeurs professionnels du PGA Tour. Plusieurs modes sont accessibles : Practice, Tournoi, Match à deux.

Localization.Title: Tiger Woods PGA Tour Golf
Localization.Description: Tiger Woods PGA Tour Golf ist ein Sportspiel auf der Playstation, in dem Sie Tiger Woods und 7 weitere professionelle Golfer der PGA Tour verkörpern. Es stehen mehrere Modi zur Verfügung: Training, Turnier, Match für zwei.

Localization.Title: Tiger Woods PGA Tour Golf
Localization.Description: EA Sports trae Tiger Woods y la serie de golf PGA Tour a PlayStation por última vez con su edición de 2001. Más del doble de golfistas reales están en la versión 2001 que en la edición 2000 para que juegues con ellos o contra ellos.

Localization.Title: Tiger Woods PGA Tour Golf
Localization.Description: EA Sports porta Tiger Woods e la serie di golf PGA Tour su PlayStation un'ultima volta con la loro edizione 2001. Nella versione del 2001 ci sono più del doppio dei veri golfisti rispetto all'edizione del 2000 con cui puoi giocare o giocare contro.

Localization.Description: International Superstar Soccer Pro (also known as Winning Eleven '97 in Japan and Goal Storm '97 in USA) is a football simulation game released in June, 1997 by Konami Computer Entertainment Tokyo, Inc.

Localization.Title: International Superstar Soccer
Localization.Description: International Superstar Soccer est un jeu de football sur Playstation. Il reproduit fidèlement les noms et les visages des nombreux sportifs stars de l'année 2000. Parmi les modes de jeu, on retrouve l'Entraînement, le Match simple et la Saison complète.

Localization.Description: Alex Ferguson's Player Manager 2001 puts the player in charge of a club from the English, French or Belgian leagues. Managers must organize tactics and training, handle finances, buy and sell players and meet objectives set by the club.

Localization.Title: Alex Ferguson's Player Manager 2001
Localization.Description: Guy Roux Manager 2001 place le joueur à la tête d'un club des championnats anglais, français ou belge. Il doit préparer les tactiques et entraînements, gérer les finances, recruter ou vendre des joueurs et atteindre les objectifs fixés par la direction.

Localization.Title: Alex Ferguson's Player Manager 2001
Localization.Description: In diesem taktischen Fußball-Managementspiel werden Sie ab 2001 zum Manager einer Mannschaft der englischen, französischen oder belgischen Liga mit unterschiedlichen Unterteilungen.

Localization.Title: Alex Ferguson's Player Manager 2001
Localization.Description: En este juego de gestión de fútbol táctico, te conviertes en el entrenador de un equipo de la liga inglesa, francesa o belga, con diferentes subdivisiones, desde 2001.

Localization.Title: Nicktoons Racing
Localization.Description: Nicktoons Racing is another Mario Kart clone using cartoon characters from Nickelodeon. The gameplay follows the standards closely: the player controls one of the characters to win races on tracks filled with scattered power-ups and ramps.

Localization.Description: Nicktoons Racing est un jeu de courses sur Playstation. Le soft propose 12 héros de l'univers de Nickelodeon de Bob l'éponge au Razmokets en passant par chatchien et Arnold.

Localization.Title: Nicktoons Racing
Localization.Description: Nicktoons Racing ist ein weiterer Mario Kart-Klon, der Nickelodeon-Zeichentrickfiguren verwendet.

Localization.Title: Louvre: The Final Curse (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Morgan Sinclair, a Secret Service Agent, has been charged with the mission to retrieve 4 artifacts, called Satan?s Keys, from the Louvre Museum. These four keys, when joined together, cause complete global annihilation.

Localization.Title: Louvre : The Final Curse (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Louvre : L'Ultime Malédiction est un jeu d'aventure à visée pédagogique et cultuelle sur Playstation.

Localization.Title: Louvre: The Final Curse (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Morgan Sinclair, ein Geheimdienstagent, wurde mit der Mission beauftragt, vier Artefakte namens „Satans Schlüssel“ aus dem Louvre-Museum zu bergen. Wenn diese vier Schlüssel zusammengefügt werden, bewirken sie eine vollständige globale Vernichtung.

Localization.Description: Morgan Sinclair, un Agente del Servicio Secreto, tiene la misión de recuperar 4 artefactos, llamados Satan's Keys, del Museo del Louvre. Estas cuatro claves, cuando se unen, causan la aniquilación global completa.

Localization.Title: The Bombing Islands
Localization.Description: Clown World is in trouble. Mysterious blue bombs have appeared all over the planet, and King Clown needs help. In a royal decree, the king beckons for Kid Clown, a hero of past Kemco games, to clean up these bombs in all six continents.

Localization.Title: The Bombing Islands
Localization.Description: Clown World a des ennuis. De mystérieuses bombes bleues sont apparues partout sur la planète, et le roi Clown a besoin d'aide. Dans un décret royal, le roi invite Kid Clown, un héros des jeux Kemco passés, à nettoyer ces bombes sur les six continents.

Localization.Description: Goofy must explore each a part of his home which consists of 15 distinct rooms. Each room includes elements such as a blender in the kitchen or table saw in the garage that the player can interact with.

Localization.Description: Goofy muss jeden Teil seines Hauses erkunden, das aus 15 verschiedenen Räumen besteht. Jeder Raum verfügt über Elemente wie einen Mixer in der Küche oder eine Tischkreissäge in der Garage, mit denen der Spieler interagieren kann.

Localization.Title: Dino Crisis 2
Localization.Description: Dino Crisis 2 is a third-person shooter video game for the Sony PlayStation, published by Capcom in North America, released on September 13, 2000 and publish by Virgin Interactive in Europe, release on November 4, 2000.

Localization.Title: Dino Crisis 2
Localization.Description: Ils sont de retour... Plus d'angoisse, plus de dinosaures, plus de panique... Un an s'est écoulé depuis la capture du Dr Kirk et la première aventure dans laquelle Régina luttait pour survivre dans un monde infesté de dinosaures.

Localization.Title: Dino Crisis 2
Localization.Description: Ein Jahr ist seit Reginas erstem Kampf auf Leben und Tod gegen die prähistorischen Dinosaurier und seit der Festnahme des verbrecherischen Dr. Kirk vergangen. Die Erforschung der 3. Energie wurde dennoch vehement fortgesetzt.

Localization.Title: Dino Crisis 2
Localization.Description: En el año 2010, (un año después de los acontecimientos de Dino Crisis) la investigación llamada ?Tercera Energía? continúa a manos de una agencia del gobierno.

Localization.Title: Dino Crisis 2
Localization.Description: Dino Crisis 2 è un videogioco sparatutto in terza persona per Sony PlayStation, pubblicato da Capcom in Nord America, rilasciato il 13 settembre 2000 e pubblicato da Virgin Interactive in Europa, in uscita il 4 novembre 2000.

Localization.Title: Dino Crisis 2
Localization.Description: O jogo de ação Dino Crisis 2 é um jogo de ação e aventura no Playstation. Ele permite que você represente Regina ou Dylan em sua luta impiedosa contra dez espécies de dinossauros assassinos.

Localization.Title: Monster Racer
Localization.Description: Choose your favourite monster from 10 fantastic creatures, each with their own ghastly traits. Choose from Mummies, Vampires, Skeletons, Werewolves and more. Confront your competitors over 10 circuits and 10 battle arenas.

Localization.Title: Monster Racer
Localization.Description: Lorsque les monstres s'ennuient le nuit d'Halloween, ils participent tout simplement à un championnat de courses. Le jeu Monster Racer transcrit la compétition sur Playstation.

Localization.Title: Monster Racer
Localization.Description: Wählen Sie Ihr Lieblingsmonster aus 10 fantastischen Kreaturen, jede mit ihren eigenen gruseligen Eigenschaften. Wählen Sie aus Mumien, Vampiren, Skeletten, Werwölfen und mehr. Konfrontieren Sie Ihre Konkurrenten auf 10 Rennstrecken und 10 Kampfarenen.

Localization.Title: Monster Racer
Localization.Description: Elige tu monstruo favorito entre diez fantásticas criaturas, cada una con sus propios rasgos espeluznantes. Podrás elegir entre momias, vampiros, esqueletos, hombres lobo y muchas criaturas más.

Localization.Title: Monster Racer
Localization.Description: Scegli il tuo mostro preferito tra 10 creature fantastiche, ognuna con i propri tratti orribili. Scegli tra mummie, vampiri, scheletri, lupi mannari e altro ancora. Affronta i tuoi concorrenti su 10 circuiti e 10 arene di battaglia.

Localization.Description: WWF Smackdown! 2 Know Your Role follows 2000's highly successful WWF Smackdown! with wrestlers new to the federation (over 50 included) and never before seen Ladder and Tornado Tag Team matches.

Localization.Title: WWF SmackDown! 2 : Know Your Role
Localization.Description: WWF Smackdown! 2 : Know your Role est un jeu de catch sur Playstation. Le soft propose de nombreux catcheurs qui sont prêts à tout pour remporter la victoire du banal coup de poings au coup d'échelle dans les dents.

Localization.Title: WWF SmackDown! 2: Know Your Role
Localization.Description: WWF-Smackdown! 2: Know your Role ist ein Wrestlingspiel für Playstation. Die Software bietet viele Wrestler, die bereit sind, alles zu tun, um den Sieg zu erringen, vom banalen Schlag bis zum Schlag einer Leiter in die Zähne.

Localization.Title: WWF SmackDown! 2: Know Your Role
Localization.Description: WWF Smackdown! 2 Conozca su papel después de la exitosa campaña de 2000 de WWF Smackdown! con luchadores nuevos en la federación (más de 50 incluidos) y nunca antes vistos los partidos de Ladder y Tornado Tag Team.

Localization.Title: WWF SmackDown! 2: Know Your Role
Localization.Description: WWF Smackdown! 2 Know Your Role follows 2000's highly successful WWF Smackdown! with wrestlers new to the federation (over 50 included) and never before seen Ladder and Tornado Tag Team matches.

Localization.Title: WWF SmackDown! 2: Know Your Role
Localization.Description: WWF Smackdown! 2 Know Your Role segue o grande sucesso do WWF Smackdown em 2000! com novos lutadores novos na federação (mais de 50 incluídos) e as partidas nunca vistas antes de Ladder e Tornado Tag Team.

Localization.Title: Championship Motocross 2001 featuring Ricky Carmichael
Localization.Description: Three-time AMA Champion Ricky Carmichael lends his good name and experience to Championship Motocross 2001. The game actually features 28 riders in all, competing on over two-dozen different tracks.

Localization.Title: Championship Motocross 2001 featuring Ricky Carmichael
Localization.Description: Championship Motocross 2001 sur Playstation nous plonge dans l'univers des courses de motocross.

Localization.Title: Championship Motocross 2001 featuring Ricky Carmichael
Localization.Description: Der dreimalige AMA-Champion Ricky Carmichael bringt seinen guten Namen und seine Erfahrung in die Motocross-Meisterschaft 2001 ein. Im Spiel treten insgesamt 28 Fahrer auf über zwei Dutzend verschiedenen Strecken gegeneinander an.

Localization.Title: Championship Motocross 2001 featuring Ricky Carmichael
Localization.Description: Championship Motocross 2001 para Playstation nos sumerge en el mundo de las carreras de motocross.

Localization.Title: Disney Winnie l'Ourson: La Chasse au Miel de Tigrou
Localization.Description: There's simply not enough honey for Pooh to have a proper party, and Tigger's the only animal in the 100 Acre Wood who can help! Control Tigger as he bounces from place to place, collecting as much honey as he can get his paws on.

Localization.Title: Disney Winnie l'Ourson : La Chasse au Miel de Tigrou
Localization.Description: Winnie veut organiser une fête, et a donc besoin de miel ; Tigrou lui promet de l'aider et part à la recherche du précieux nectar.

Localization.Title: Disney Winnie l'Ourson: La Chasse au Miel de Tigrou
Localization.Description: Es gibt einfach nicht genug Honig für Pooh, um eine richtige Party zu veranstalten, und Tigger ist das einzige Tier im 100-Morgen-Wald, das helfen kann! Steuern Sie Tigger, während er von Ort zu Ort hüpft und so viel Honig sammelt, wie er in seine Pfoten

Localization.Title: Disney Winnie l'Ourson: La Chasse au Miel de Tigrou
Localization.Description: Pooh no tiene suficiente miel para celebrar una fiesta en condiciones, y Tigger es el único animal del Bosque de los 100 Acres que puede ayudarle. Controla a Tigger mientras salta de un lugar a otro recogiendo toda la miel que pueda.

Localization.Title: Disney Winnie l'Ourson: La Chasse au Miel de Tigrou
Localization.Description: È un divertimento da Tigro! Winnie the Pooh ha bisogno di te! come potrà mai organizzare la festa per i suoi amici senza miele? Calati nel ruolo di Tigro: corri salta e balza attraverso il BOsco dei 100 Acri alla ricerca del cibo preferito del simpatico

Localization.Description: Warriors of Might and Magic is another entry in the Might and Magic line from 3DO. It is a single-player action-adventure title, in much the same vein of the previous entry in the series, Crusaders of Might and Magic.

Localization.Description: Warriors of Might and Magic es un juego de acción y aventura para PlayStation. Juegas como Alleron, un guerrero misteriosamente enmascarado. Te embarcas en un largo viaje para descubrir el mundo que estás destinado a salvar de la destrucción.

Localization.Title: Disney's The Lion King: Simba's Mighty Adventure
Localization.Description: Before he can become the "King of the Beasts," Simba must first see the world through his own eyes and learn for himself what is noble and important in life.

Localization.Title: Disney's The Lion King : Simba's Mighty Adventure
Localization.Description: Le Roi Lion : La Formidable Aventure de Simba est un jeu de plates-formes sur Playstation. Dans la peau de Simba, le gentil fils du roi Mufasa, vous effectuez un long périple à travers la jungle et les plaines africaines.

Localization.Title: Disney's The Lion King: Simba's Mighty Adventure
Localization.Description: Begleite den jungen Löwenprinz Simba auf seiner Entdeckungsreise und finde heraus, was es heißt, der wahre Herrscher dieses Landes zu sein.

Localization.Title: Disney's The Lion King: Simba's Mighty Adventure
Localization.Description: ¡Apuesto a que estás deseando ser rey! En el papel del joven príncipe león Simba, crecerás para descubrir el significado de ser un legítimo soberano de las Praderas.

Localization.Title: Disney's The Lion King: Simba's Mighty Adventure
Localization.Description: Prima di poter diventare il "Re degli animali", Simba deve prima vedere il mondo attraverso i propri occhi e imparare da solo ciò che è nobile e importante nella vita.

Localization.Title: Ford Racing
Localization.Description: As Ford automobiles have won the NASCAR Winston Cup trophy more often than cars from any other manufacturer, it seems natural to create a game based on this consistent success. Empire Interactive has done just that in Ford Racing.

Localization.Title: Ford Racing
Localization.Description: Ford Racing sur Playstation est un jeu de courses qui vous propose de piloter des bolides de la célèbre marque américain. A votre disposition, des modèles des années 97, 98, 99 et enfin 2000.

Localization.Title: Ford Racing
Localization.Description: Da Ford-Automobile die Trophäe des NASCAR Winston Cup häufiger gewonnen haben als Autos aller anderen Hersteller, liegt es nahe, ein Spiel zu entwickeln, das auf diesem beständigen Erfolg basiert.

Localization.Title: Ford Racing
Localization.Description: Ford Racing presenta 12 vehículos cuidadosamente seleccionados de la línea de Ford de modelos estadounidenses y europeos, incluidos el Taurus, el Mustang, la serie F, el Explorer, el GT90 y varios autos conceptuales.

Localization.Description: Moorhuhn (distributed as Crazy Chicken in English-speaking countries) is a German casual game franchise for PCs and the Nintendo DS.

Localization.Title: Moorhuhn 2 : Die Jagd Geht Weiter
Localization.Description: Dans ce jeu de tir, simple mais efficace, vous devez abattre le plus grand nombre de poulet en 1 minute 30, en solo ou à 2 joueurs.

Localization.Title: Moorhuhn 2: Die Jagd Geht Weiter

Localization.Description: Ginger has seen what will become of her chicken brethren at the Tweedy Farm, and things are looking bleak. She soon realizes a better kind of life is waiting somewhere in the world and vows to assist her friends in escaping the farm.

Localization.Title: Chicken Run
Localization.Description: Chicken Run sur Playstation est un jeu adapté du film d'animation sorti en 2000. Les poules de la ferme ne parviennent plus à pondre suffisamment. Le propriétaire décide donc de se lancer dans la tarte au poulet pour pallier la perte de revenus.

Localization.Title: Chicken Run
Localization.Description: Das Huhn Ginger hat einen Traum: Unter der Anleitung von Gockel Rocky will sie gemeinsam mit ihren geflügelten Leidensgenossen die Flucht von Tweedys Eierfarm wagen. Die Zeit drängt: Die Besitzerin Mrs.

Localization.Title: Chicken Run
Localization.Description: El juego toma lugar en 1950, unos pollos tratan de salir de su granja ya que los dueños de la granja recogían los huevos y el pollo que no ponía huevos lo mataban.

Localization.Title: Saban's Power Rangers: Lightspeed Rescue
Localization.Description: Power Rangers Lightspeed Rescue ist ein Actionspiel für Playstation. Aufruf an alle Rangers. Es gibt Berichte über Kämpfe im Zentrum von Mariner Bay. Die Monster scheinen Magie einzusetzen, um das Eingreifen der Polizei zu verhindern.

Localization.Title: Saban's Power Rangers: Lightspeed Rescue

Localization.Title: LEGO Island 2 : The Brickster's Revenge
Localization.Description: Les célèbres Lego reviennent sur Playstation dans un jeu d'action/aventure L'Ile Lego 2. Dans la peau d'un jeune livreur de pizzas, Pepper, vous partez à la poursuite d'un bandit qui s'est échappé lors d'une de vos livraisons à la prison.

Localization.Title: LEGO Island 2: The Brickster's Revenge
Localization.Description: Als Fortsetzung des ersten LEGO Island-PC-Titels ist in LEGO Island 2: The Brickster's Revenge Pepper Roni zu sehen, ein Pizzabote, den die Spieler steuern und der versucht, LEGO Island vor dem bösen Brickster zu retten.

Localization.Title: LEGO Island 2: The Brickster's Revenge
Localization.Description: Comienzas viajando alrededor de la isla de Lego, para entregar pizzas, y conversando con otros ciudadanos hasta que sucede el evento en que Brickster escapa de la cárcel e intenta destruir todos los edificios en la isla de Lego.

Localization.Title: Disney/Pixar Buzz Lightyear of Star Command
Localization.Description: Buzz Lightyear is out to rid the universe of evil. With the aid of his friends at Star Command Mira, Booster, and X-R Buzz will battle Emperor Zurg, Gravatina, Torque, Skreel, and others in 14 levels that span seven different worlds.

Localization.Title: Disney/Pixar Buzz Lightyear of Star Command
Localization.Description: Les Aventures de Buzz L'Eclair est un jeu d'action sur Playstation. Le méchant Zurg a disposé ses lieutenants sur chaque planète de l'univers. Partez à leurs trousses en compagnie de Buzz, jusqu'à tomber enfin sur Zurg lui-même !

Localization.Title: Disney/Pixar Buzz Lightyear of Star Command
Localization.Description: Er behauptete, er wäre der echte Buzz Lightyear...kein Spielzeug, sondern ein intergalaktischer Space Ranger! Nun, das Raumschiff unseres Weltraum-Helden, Buzz Lightyear, ist gerade gelandet, womit der Beweis geliefert sein sollte.

Localization.Title: Disney/Pixar Buzz Lightyear of Star Command

Localization.Title: Army Men: Sarge's Heroes 2
Localization.Description: When you're only an inch-and-a-half tall, the guest bathroom becomes a huge landscape filled with challenge, mystery, and danger.

Localization.Title: Army Men : Sarge's Heroes 2
Localization.Description: Infatigables, les soldats de plastique déclinent une nouvelle fois leur guerre fratricide opposant les soldats verts aux soldats beiges. Dans le jeu d'action Army Men : Sarge's Heroes 2 sur Playstation, les beiges se sont aussi associés aux bleus.

Localization.Title: Army Men: Sarge's Heroes 2
Localization.Description: Wenn Sie nur eineinhalb Zentimeter groß sind, wird das Gästebad zu einer riesigen Landschaft voller Herausforderungen, Geheimnisse und Gefahren.

Localization.Title: Army Men: Sarge's Heroes 2
Localization.Description: Cuando solo mides una pulgada y media de altura, el cuarto de invitados se convierte en un enorme paisaje lleno de desafíos, misterios y peligros.

Localization.Title: Les Pierrafeu: Bedrock Bowling
Localization.Description: Prehistoric times, beware -- The Flintstones have invaded the bowling alley! Fred Flintstone, Barney Rubble, Pebbles, Bamm-Bamm, and Dino are taking advantage of a newly transformed Bedrock.

Localization.Title: Les Pierrafeu : Bedrock Bowling
Localization.Description: Dans La Famille Pierrafeu sur Playstation, vous allez participer à un tournoi de bowling grandeur nature. Bien assis dans une boule géante, Fred dévale huit parcours représentants autant de pistes de bowling différentes.

Localization.Title: Les Pierrafeu: Bedrock Bowling
Localization.Description: In „The Flintstones“ auf der Playstation nimmst du an einem lebensgroßen Bowlingturnier teil. Gut sitzend in einer riesigen Kugel saust Fred über acht Bahnen, die ebenso viele verschiedene Bowlingbahnen darstellen.

Localization.Title: Les Pierrafeu: Bedrock Bowling
Localization.Description: Pedro Picapiedra está trabajando duro como siempre en su trabajo de construcción. Cuando es la hora de salir, su jefe le amenaza con despedirle si no termina su tarea de excavación de zanjas para la mañana siguiente.

Localization.Title: Les Pierrafeu: Bedrock Bowling
Localization.Description: Tempi preistorici, attenzione: i Flintstones hanno invaso la pista da bowling! Fred Flintstone, Barney Rubble, Pebbles, Bamm-Bamm e Dino stanno approfittando di un Bedrock appena trasformato.

Localization.Title: ISS Pro Evolution 2
Localization.Description: Released in Europe this March, Konami's ISS Pro Evolution 2 is the sequel to ISS Pro Evolution which itself was released in North America and Europe about a year ago.

Localization.Title: ISS Pro Evolution 2
Localization.Description: ISS Pro Evolution 2 est un jeu de simulation de foot développé par Konami sur Playstation. Une multitude d'équipes nationales sont présentes ainsi que les véritables joueurs plus prestigieux les uns que les autres.

Localization.Title: ISS Pro Evolution 2
Localization.Description: Konamis ISS Pro Evolution 2, das diesen März in Europa veröffentlicht wurde, ist die Fortsetzung von ISS Pro Evolution, das selbst vor etwa einem Jahr in Nordamerika und Europa veröffentlicht wurde.

Localization.Title: ISS Pro Evolution 2
Localization.Description: Es el primer juego de ISS Pro con las licencias adecuadas, aunque parcial, algunos jugadores con nombres reales. Ej: Beckham en lugar de Bekham (ISS Pro Evolution).

Localization.Title: ISS Pro Evolution 2
Localization.Description: È il primo gioco ISS Pro con le licenze appropriate, anche se parziali, di alcuni giocatori con nomi reali. Es: Beckham invece di Bekham (ISS Pro Evolution).

Localization.Title: ISS Pro Evolution 2
Localization.Description: Lançado na Europa em Março de 2001, ISS Pro Evolution 2, da Konami, foi a sequência de 'ISS Pro Evolution', que havia sido lançado na América do Norte e Europa cerca de um ano antes.

Localization.Title: Astérix: Mega Madness
Localization.Description: It's party time, and the Gauls are planning to celebrate in style by having one of the biggest parties they've ever seen. The biggest honour of all the Gauls is to sit besides the Chief.

Localization.Title: Astérix : Mega Madness
Localization.Description: Les aventures d'Astérix et Obélix, sorties tout droit de la bande dessinée mythique, sont à l'honneur sur Playstation avec Astérix Maxi-Delirium.

Localization.Title: Astérix: Mega Madness
Localization.Description: Die Gallier planen ein großes Fest mit allem drum und dran. Um zu bestimmen, wer bei der Party neben Ihm sitzen darf, entscheidet ihr Häuptling Majestix, daß einige sportliche Wettbewerbe abgehalten werden sollen.

Localization.Title: Astérix: Mega Madness
Localization.Description: Prepárate para competir en 14 desafíos galos completamente delirantes o ¿qué es si no una carrera de remos alocada a más no poder, una carrera de catapultas absolutamente chiflada o un tiro al blanco totalmente disparatado...

Localization.Title: Astérix: Mega Madness
Localization.Description: È tempo di festa e i Galli stanno pianificando di celebrare in grande stile organizzando una delle feste più grandi mai viste. Il più grande onore di tutti i Galli è sedere accanto al Capo.

Localization.Title: Astérix: Mega Madness
Localization.Description: É hora de festa e os gauleses planejam comemorar em grande estilo com uma das maiores festas que já viram. A maior honra de todos os gauleses é sentar-se ao lado do Chefe.

Localization.Title: Motocross Mania
Localization.Description: Catch big air or eat big dust in this arcade-style dirt bike game from Take 2. In Motocross Mania players choose their machines and fine-tune them to match riding styles, then enter Motocross, Supercross, and freestyle competitions for cash prizes.

Localization.Title: Motocross Mania
Localization.Description: Motocross Mania sur Playstation est un jeu de courses de motos faisant la part belle aux cabrioles et sauts en tout genre. Glissez-vous sous le casque d'un motard et flanquez des coups à vos concurrents.

Localization.Title: Motocross Mania
Localization.Description: Fangen Sie in diesem Dirtbike-Spiel im Arcade-Stil von Take 2 große Sprünge oder fressen Sie großen Staub. In Motocross Mania wählen die Spieler ihre Maschinen aus und stimmen sie auf ihren Fahrstil ab.

Localization.Title: Motocross Mania
Localization.Description: Motocross Mania es un simulador de carreras de motocicletas. Cuenta con trucos al estilo de la serie de juegos Tony Hawk, e incluye las modalidades Motocross, Supercross, Baja y Freestyle modos de juego.

Localization.Title: Warriors of Might and Magic
Localization.Description: Warriors of Might and Magic is another entry in the Might and Magic line from 3DO. It is a single-player action-adventure title, in much the same vein of the previous entry in the series, Crusaders of Might and Magic.

Localization.Title: Warriors of Might and Magic
Localization.Description: Warriors of Might and Magic est un jeu d'action/aventure sur Playstation. Vous incarnez Alleron, un guerrier mystérieusement masqué.

Localization.Title: Warriors of Might and Magic
Localization.Description: Warriors of Might and Magic ist ein Action-/Abenteuerspiel auf der Playstation. Du verkörperst Alleron, einen maskierten, mysteriösen Kämpfer.

Localization.Description: Warriors of Might and Magic es un juego de acción y aventura para PlayStation. Juegas como Alleron, un guerrero misteriosamente enmascarado. Te embarcas en un largo viaje para descubrir el mundo que estás destinado a salvar de la destrucción.

Localization.Title: Tomb Raider Chronicles
Localization.Description: A few days after the events described in Tomb Raider: The Last Revelation, Lara Croft is presumed dead. Her close friends begin to recollect her previous adventures, which occurred during different periods of her life.

Localization.Title: Tomb Raider Chronicles
Localization.Description: Découvrez toute la vérité sur le passé de Lara Croft à travers quatre aventures inédites. Disparue en Egypte, Lara est laissée pour morte. Ses proches amis se retirent pour évoquer ensemble le souvenir de ses aventures passées.

Localization.Title: Tomb Raider Chronicles
Localization.Description: Tomb Raider - Die Chronik, enthält vier brandneue Abenteuer von Lara Croft, die Ihnen neue, aufregende Einblicke in die Vergangenheit unserer Heldin bieten.

Localization.Title: Tomb Raider Chronicles
Localization.Description: Tomb Raider Chronicles es el quinto Tomb Raider de la saga. Tras The Last Revelations, Lara Croft se queda enterrada en el Templo de Horus y es dada por muerta. En su mansión sus amigos recuerdan sus hazañas.

Localization.Title: Tomb Raider Chronicles
Localization.Description: Scopri la verità sul passato di Lara Croft attraverso quattro avventure mai viste prima. Scomparsa in Egitto, Lara è data per morta. I suoi amici più cari si ritirano per rievocare insieme il ricordo delle sue avventure passate.

Localization.Title: Fear Effect 2: Retro Helix (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: In the near future, mankind's tinkering with the science of genetics and the developmental process of genome mapping has resulted in the accidental creation of a new disease known as EINDS.

Localization.Title: Fear Effect 2 : Retro Helix (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Fear Effect 2 : Retro Helix est un jeu d'action/aventure sur Playstation. Amateurs d'ambiances glauques, de scènes sanglantes, ou de chair fraîche, ce titre vous propose de sauver le monde mis en danger par un virus.

Localization.Title: Fear Effect 2: Retro Helix (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: „Fear Effect 2: Retro Helix“ spielt in einer nahen Zukunft, in der genetische Experimente und die Kartierung des Genoms versehentlich zur Entstehung einer tödlichen Krankheit namens EINDS geführt haben.

Localization.Title: Fear Effect 2: Retro Helix (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Retro Helix: una épica aventura sobre el destino de la Humanidad. Profundiza en las pintorescas historias de los auténticos mercenarios y en las extraordinarias circunstancias que los reunieron en Fear Effect.

Localization.Title: Fear Effect 2: Retro Helix (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Nel prossimo futuro, il lavoro dell'umanità con la scienza della genetica e il processo di sviluppo della mappatura del genoma ha portato alla creazione accidentale di una nuova malattia nota come EINDS.

Localization.Title: Fear Effect 2: Retro Helix (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Fear Effect 2: Retro Helix é um jogo de ação / aventura no Playstation. Amantes de atmosferas glaucosas, cenas sangrentas ou carne fresca, este título oferece-lhe para salvar o mundo ameaçado por um vírus.

Localization.Title: Power Diggerz
Localization.Description: Based on Taito's Japanese arcade game, Power Shovel puts players behind the controls of three earthmovers in a variety of construction-oriented events. Three modes of gameplay are available: Arcade King, License Mode, and Level Editor.

Localization.Description: Basé sur le jeu d'arcade japonais de Taito, Power Shovel met les joueurs aux commandes de trois engins de terrassement dans une variété de situations axées sur la construction.

Localization.Title: Power Diggerz
Localization.Description: Power Shovel basiert auf dem japanischen Arcade-Spiel von Taito und versetzt Spieler in die Steuerung von drei Erdbewegungsmaschinen in verschiedenen Situationen, in denen es um den Bau geht.

Localization.Title: Power Diggerz
Localization.Description: Basado en el juego arcade japonés de Taito, Power Shovel pone a los jugadores en control de tres máquinas de movimiento de tierras en una variedad de situaciones centradas en la construcción.

Localization.Description: Grand Theft Auto: Mission Pack #1 - London 1969 is an official expansion pack to Grand Theft Auto. Instead of the fictional interpretations of New York, Miami and Los Angeles of the original, this game opens up the city of London to the player.

Localization.Title: Grand Theft Auto : London 1969
Localization.Description: Grand Theft Auto : London 1969 est un jeu d'action sorti sur Playstation. Il s'agit en fait d'une extension de GTA qui permet de jouer dans les rues de Londres et de profiter de répliques des bâtiments de la capitale britannique.

Localization.Title: Grand Theft Auto: London 1969
Localization.Description: Grand Theft Auto: London 1969 ist eine Erweiterung für Grand Theft Auto 1. Zum Spielen ist der Besitz von GTA 1 erforderlich, das zuerst ins Laufwerk eingelegt werden muss. Die Erweiterung fügt dem Spiel eine neue Stadt (London) hinzu.

Localization.Title: Grand Theft Auto: London 1969
Localization.Description: Grand Theft Auto: London 1969 es un paquete de expansión oficial para Grand Theft Auto. En lugar de las interpretaciones ficticias de Nueva York, Miami y Los Ángeles del original, este juego abre la ciudad de Londres para el jugador.

Localization.Title: Grand Theft Auto: London 1969
Localization.Description: Grand Theft Auto: Mission Pack # 1 - London 1969 è un pacchetto di espansione ufficiale di Grand Theft Auto. Invece delle interpretazioni immaginarie di New York, Miami e Los Angeles dell'originale, questo gioco apre al giocatore la città di Londra.

Localization.Title: Grand Theft Auto: London 1969

Localization.Description: Aqua GT is a powerboat racing game. There are four classes of boats with different characteristics; you must master them all to become a true champ. 20 different boats, all with unique features. Each track is based in real cities from around the world.

Localization.Description: Aqua GT ist ein Motorboot-Rennspiel. Es gibt vier Bootsklassen mit unterschiedlichen Eigenschaften; Sie müssen sie alle meistern, um ein wahrer Champion zu werden. 20 verschiedene Boote, alle mit einzigartigen Eigenschaften.

Localization.Description: Supercross ist die Version von Supercross 2000 aus dem Jahr 2001. Für diese Version hat sich der Entwickler für ein Arcade-artigeres Handling der Dirtbikes entschieden.

Localization.Description: Para esta iteración, los desarrolladores han optado por un manejo más estilo arcade para las motos de cross.

Localization.Title: The Simpsons Wrestling
Localization.Description: Simpsons Wrestling est un jeu de combat sur Playstation mettant en scène tous les personnages de la célèbre série animée américaine éponyme.

Localization.Title: The Simpsons Wrestling
Localization.Description: Wrestling ist nicht gleich Wrestling! Sei bereit für die rasanteste, atemberaubendste, überwältigendste Wrestling-Action. Alle deine Lieblingscharaktere nehmen Teil, um den ultimativen Titel zu gewinnen.

Localization.Title: DSF Fußball Manager 2001
Localization.Description: Alex Ferguson's Player Manager 2001 puts the player in charge of a club from the English, French or Belgian leagues. Managers must organize tactics and training, handle finances, buy and sell players and meet objectives set by the club.

Localization.Title: DSF Fußball Manager 2001
Localization.Description: Guy Roux Manager 2001 place le joueur à la tête d'un club des championnats anglais, français ou belge. Il doit préparer les tactiques et entraînements, gérer les finances, recruter ou vendre des joueurs et atteindre les objectifs fixés par la direction.

Localization.Title: DSF Fußball Manager 2001
Localization.Description: In diesem taktischen Fußball-Managementspiel werden Sie ab 2001 zum Manager einer Mannschaft der englischen, französischen oder belgischen Liga mit unterschiedlichen Unterteilungen.

Localization.Title: DSF Fußball Manager 2001
Localization.Description: En este juego de gestión de fútbol táctico, te conviertes en el entrenador de un equipo de la liga inglesa, francesa o belga, con diferentes subdivisiones, desde 2001.

Localization.Title: DSF Fußball Manager 2001

Localization.Title: Duke Nukem: Land of the Babes
Localization.Description: Aliens have wiped out Earth's men and are now looking to enslave the planet's women for their own hybridization program. Who's going to save the babes of Earth? Duke Nukem, that's who.

Localization.Title: Duke Nukem : Land of the Babes
Localization.Description: La série de jeux d'action Duke Nukem revient sur Playstation avec Duke Nukem : Land of the Babes. Dans cette nouvelle aventure, notre héros doit libérer la Terre où seulement quelques sublimes "nanas" ont survécus aux ravages des Aliens.

Localization.Title: Duke Nukem: Land of the Babes
Localization.Description: Falls Sie ihn schon vermisst haben: Der DUKE ist zurück! Und diesmal geht es um die Rettung eines ganzen Planeten voller hilfloser Babes. DUKE NUKEM versucht das LAND OF THE BABES von seinen Unterdrückern zu befreien.

Localization.Title: Duke Nukem: Land of the Babes
Localization.Description: Los extraterrestres han aniquilado a los hombres de la Tierra y ahora buscan esclavizar a las mujeres del planeta para su propio programa de hibridación. ¿Quién va a salvar a los niños de la Tierra? Duke Nukem, ese es quien.

Localization.Title: Duke Nukem: Land of the Babes
Localization.Description: Gli alieni hanno annientato gli uomini della Terra e ora cercano di schiavizzare le donne del pianeta per il loro programma di ibridazione. Chi salverà i figli della Terra? Duke Nukem, ecco chi.

Localization.Title: Duke Nukem: Land of the Babes
Localization.Description: A série de jogos de ação Duke Nukem retorna ao Playstation com Duke Nukem: Land of the Babes. Nesta nova aventura, nosso herói deve liberar a Terra onde apenas algumas "garotas" sublimes sobreviveram aos estragos dos alienígenas.

Localization.Description: Join Sheriff Jon Bunnell as police chasing is brought to your control. You can freely patrol the vast city environment the game offers, or take on a series of 20 missions.

Localization.Description: Schlüpft in die Rolle eines Polizisten und liefert euch in der fiktiven Stadt Ashland wilde Verfolgungsjagden mit Ganoven. Darüber hinaus stehen weitere Spielmodi wie z.B. Eskortmissionen oder Bombenentschärfungen zur Verfügung.

Localization.Title: World's Scariest Police Chases

Localization.Title: Evil Dead: Hail to the King (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Evil Dead: Hail to the King features a mix of action, puzzles, and suspense. Set eight years after the third film, you are Ash, who is being drawn back to the cabin in the woods.

Localization.Title: Evil Dead : Hail to the King (Disc 1)

Localization.Title: Evil Dead: Hail to the King (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Evil Dead: Hail to the King bietet eine Mischung aus Action, Rätseln und Spannung. Acht Jahre nach dem dritten Film schlüpfst du in die Rolle von Ash, den es zurück in die Hütte im Wald zieht.

Localization.Title: Evil Dead: Hail to the King (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Evil Dead: Hail to the King presenta una combinación de acción en tercera persona, rompecabezas y supervivencia. Ambientada ocho años después de la tercera película, eres Ash, quien regresa a la cabaña en el bosque.

Localization.Title: Evil Dead: Hail to the King (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Si impersona Ash, il protagonista della trilogia di Evil Dead. L'azione si svolge cronologicamente otto anni dopo gli eventi dell'ultimo film.

Localization.Title: Evil Dead: Hail to the King (Disc 1)

Localization.Title: X'treme Roller
Localization.Description: Race in a futuristic tournament of more than 30 stages against up to three computer opponents, experiencing dizzying speeds, acrobatics, and grind stunts. You will earn credits to upgrade your skates by impressing the crowd with your daring.

Localization.Title: X'treme Roller
Localization.Description: X'Treme Roller sur Playstation est un jeu vous mettant dans la peau d'un de ces cascadeurs urbains chaussés de roulettes. Il vous faut parcourir un certain nombre de circuits dans un temps imparti en réalisant le maximum possible de figures.

Localization.Title: X'treme Roller
Localization.Description: 12 Rennstrecken auf der ganzen Welt, plus 10 freispielbare Bonusstrecken. Verbesserte Physik und Spielbarkeit bei erhöhtem Niveau. 23 Computergegner mit voll animierten Fahrern. Fortschrittlicher Meisterschafts Modus über 4 Kontinente.

Localization.Title: X'treme Roller
Localization.Description: X'Treme Roller para PlayStation es un juego que te pone en la piel de un acróbata urbano sobre patines. Tienes que completar un número determinado de circuitos dentro de un límite de tiempo, realizando tantos trucos como sea posible.

Localization.Title: Digimon World
Localization.Description: It is your goal to roam the dangerous countryside with your trained Digimon battling other lost Digimon. A victorious battle permits them to return home to the abandoned File Island.

Localization.Title: Digimon World
Localization.Description: Digimon World est un jeu d'aventure sur Playstation inspiré du célèbre dessin animé. Le chef du village des Digimon a besoin de votre aide pour trouver et apprivoiser ces créatures.

Localization.Title: Digimon World
Localization.Description: Gestrandet in einer digitalen Welt hast Du nur ein Ziel vor Augen: wieder heil nach Hause zu gelangen! Dabei bist du auf die Hilfe der Digimon, kleiner digitaler Monster, angewiesen.

Localization.Title: Digimon World
Localization.Description: El juego consiste en criar a un Digimon desde su etapa bebé hasta hacerlo evolucionar a su forma más poderosa. El Digimon morirá con la edad, revirtiéndose a un Digihuevo y renaciendo de nuevo.

Localization.Title: Digimon World
Localization.Description: Digimon World è un gioco d'avventura su Playstation ispirato al famoso cartone animato. Il capo del villaggio di Digimon ha bisogno del vostro aiuto per trovare e domare queste creature.

Localization.Title: Duke Nukem: Land of the Babes
Localization.Description: Aliens have wiped out Earth's men and are now looking to enslave the planet's women for their own hybridization program. Who's going to save the babes of Earth? Duke Nukem, that's who.

Localization.Title: Duke Nukem : Land of the Babes
Localization.Description: La série de jeux d'action Duke Nukem revient sur Playstation avec Duke Nukem : Land of the Babes. Dans cette nouvelle aventure, notre héros doit libérer la Terre où seulement quelques sublimes "nanas" ont survécus aux ravages des Aliens.

Localization.Title: Duke Nukem: Land of the Babes
Localization.Description: Falls Sie ihn schon vermisst haben: Der DUKE ist zurück! Und diesmal geht es um die Rettung eines ganzen Planeten voller hilfloser Babes. DUKE NUKEM versucht das LAND OF THE BABES von seinen Unterdrückern zu befreien.

Localization.Title: Duke Nukem: Land of the Babes
Localization.Description: Los extraterrestres han aniquilado a los hombres de la Tierra y ahora buscan esclavizar a las mujeres del planeta para su propio programa de hibridación. ¿Quién va a salvar a los niños de la Tierra? Duke Nukem, ese es quien.

Localization.Title: Duke Nukem: Land of the Babes
Localization.Description: Gli alieni hanno annientato gli uomini della Terra e ora cercano di schiavizzare le donne del pianeta per il loro programma di ibridazione. Chi salverà i figli della Terra? Duke Nukem, ecco chi.

Localization.Title: Duke Nukem: Land of the Babes
Localization.Description: A série de jogos de ação Duke Nukem retorna ao Playstation com Duke Nukem: Land of the Babes. Nesta nova aventura, nosso herói deve liberar a Terra onde apenas algumas "garotas" sublimes sobreviveram aos estragos dos alienígenas.

rom.name: Duke Nukem - Land of the Babes (France).cue

Localization.Title: Darkstone
Localization.Description: In “Darkstone,” you are the Chosen One tasked with stopping Draak's plan to plunge the world into darkness.

Localization.Title: Darkstone
Localization.Description: Darkstone est un hack and slash dans un univers médiéval fantastique sur Playstation. Avec plus de 30 types d'armes et 32 sorts à votre disposition, vous partez à la chasse du terrible dragon Draak.

Localization.Title: Darkstone
Localization.Description: In „Darkstone“ bist du der Auserwählte, der Draaks Plan verhindern muss, die Welt in Dunkelheit zu stürzen.

Localization.Title: Darkstone
Localization.Description: En Darkstone, eres el elegido para evitar el plan de Draak de sumergir al mundo en una nueva Era de Oscuridad. Las elecciones de personajes se hacen a partir de cuatro clases (mago/hechicera, asesino/ladrón, guerrero/amazonas o monje/sacerdotisa).

Localization.Title: Darkstone
Localization.Description: In Darkstone, sei tu il prescelto per contrastare il piano di Draak di immergere il mondo in una nuova Age of Darkness.

Localization.Title: Darkstone
Localization.Description: Em Darkstone, você é o escolhido para contrariar o plano de Draak de mergulhar o mundo em uma nova Era das Trevas.

Localization.Description: „In einem Land vor unserer Zeit: Great Valley Racing Adventure“ ist ein Rennspiel im Cartoon-Stil, das Kindern jeden Alters unterhaltsame und gewaltfreie Herausforderungen bietet.

Localization.Description: The French Open is a major tennis tournament held over two weeks between late May and early June in Paris, France, at the Stade Roland Garros.

Localization.Description: Roland Garros 2001 est un jeu de sport sur Playstation. Incarnez l'un des 16 joueurs et joueuses disponibles et affrontez vos adversaires dans l'un des 4 tournois proposés. 8 terrains ainsi que 8 raquettes de grandes marques sont à votre disposition.

Localization.Title: Roland Garros French Open 2001
Localization.Description: Roland Garros 2001 ist ein Sportspiel für Playstation. Spielen Sie als einer der 16 verfügbaren Spieler und treten Sie in einem der 4 angebotenen Turniere gegen Ihre Gegner an. 8 Spielfelder sowie 8 Markenschläger stehen Ihnen zur Verfügung.

Localization.Description: The popular European comic book character, TinTin, has his first game in 3D. TinTin is at a presentation of Professor Calculus' new invention, which isn't working as usual. His dog Snowy falls asleep and dreams about their past wild adventures.

Localization.Title: Rageball
Localization.Description: The futuristic sport of Rageball, inspired by Speedball 2, is fast, violent and deadly, and played by teams of exiled convicts who have nothing to lose. The year is 2612 and sports hit an all-time low.

Localization.Title: Rageball
Localization.Description: Rageball, sport futuriste rapide et agressif est pratiqué par des équipes de condamnés en exil qui n'ont rien à perdre. Ce jeu est diffusé dans le monde entier auprès d'innombrables fans avides de violence.

Localization.Title: Rageball
Localization.Description: Rageball, ein schneller und aggressiver futuristischer Sport, wird von Teams aus Sträflingen im Exil gespielt, die nichts zu verlieren haben. Dieses Spiel wird weltweit an unzählige gewalthungrige Fans gestreamt.

Localization.Title: Rageball

Localization.Title: Duke Nukem: Time to Kill
Localization.Description: The game begins not a long time after Duke Nukem 3D. Duke is relaxing in Bootylicious with a few beers and some babes when suddenly Pig Cops start thrashing the place and turn his 1968 custom hog into a chopper bike.

Localization.Title: Duke Nukem : Time to Kill
Localization.Description: Duke Nukem : Time To Kill est un jeu de tir à la première personne sur Playstation. Des extraterrestres ont envahi la Terre et détruisent tout à Los Angeles. C'est à vous de les renvoyer d'où ils viennent à coups de fusil et de répliques cinglantes.

Localization.Title: Duke Nukem: Time to Kill
Localization.Description: Lust auf 'ne Zeitreise? Der größte Action-Held aller Zeiten ist wieder da! In einem Third-Person Ballerfest durch die Jahrhunderte. Kämpfe dich mit Duke Nukem durch verschiedene Epochen, in denen du fiese Aliens in ihre Schranken weist.

Localization.Title: Duke Nukem: Time to Kill
Localization.Description: Duke Nukem: Time To Kill es un juego de disparos en primera persona en Playstation. Los extraterrestres invadieron la Tierra y destruyeron todo en Los Ángeles. Depende de usted enviarlos de regreso con rifles y armas.

Localization.Title: Duke Nukem: Time to Kill
Localization.Description: Il gioco inizia non molto tempo dopo Duke Nukem 3D. Duke si sta rilassando a Bootylicious con alcune birre e alcune ragazze quando improvvisamente Pig Cops inizia a battere il posto e trasforma il suo maiale personalizzato del 1968 in una moto chopper.

Localization.Title: Duke Nukem: Time to Kill
Localization.Description: O jogo começa não muito tempo depois de Duke Nukem 3D.

Localization.Title: Men in Black: The Series: Crashdown
Localization.Description: Play as agents Jay and Kay as you attempt to foil the plans of the diabolical Alpha and his relentless army of devious Fmecks. With out-of-control aliens seemingly everywhere, you've got your work cut out for you.

Localization.Title: Men in Black : The Series : Crashdown
Localization.Description: Men in Black : The Series : Crashdown est un jeu d'action sur Playstation. Alpha, un ex-agent du MIB s'est échappé de prison et a l'intention d'assassiner le président des Etats-Unis.

Localization.Title: Men in Black: The Series: Crashdown
Localization.Description: Überall lungern sie herum und hinterlassen ihre Schleimspur: Illegale kriminelle Alien-Einwanderer aus den entlegensten Winkeln der Galaxie. Als MIB-Agent ist es deine Aufgabe, die Erde vor dem Abschaum des Universums zu schützen.

Localization.Title: Men in Black: The Series: Crashdown
Localization.Description: Juega como los agentes Jay y Kay mientras intentas frustrar los planes del diabólico Alpha y su ejército implacable de malvados Fmecks. Con alienígenas fuera de control por todos lados, es el trabajo perfecto para ti.

Localization.Title: Men in Black: The Series: Crashdown
Localization.Description: Gioca nei panni degli agenti Jay e Kay mentre cerchi di sventare i piani del diabolico Alpha e del suo implacabile esercito di subdoli Fmeck. Con alieni fuori controllo apparentemente ovunque, hai il tuo bel da fare.

Localization.Title: Men in Black: The Series: Crashdown
Localization.Description: Play as agents Jay and Kay as you attempt to foil the plans of the diabolical Alpha and his relentless army of devious Fmecks. With out-of-control aliens seemingly everywhere, you've got your work cut out for you.

Localization.Title: Dragstars
Localization.Description: Drag racing is a simple sport. Start the engines wait for the lights to go green and then drive very fast in a straight line. No corners no powerslides no outbraking manoeuvres - even the steering wheel is basically useless.

Localization.Title: Dragstars
Localization.Description: Dragstar vous met aux commandes de l'un des 20 dragsters gonflés. Laissez le reste clignoter dans la fumée du caoutchouc brûlé alors que vous devenez une véritable Dragstar!

Localization.Title: Dragstars
Localization.Description: Drag Racing ist ein einfacher Sport. Starten Sie die Motoren, warten Sie, bis die Ampel grün wird, und fahren Sie dann sehr schnell geradeaus. Keine Kurven, keine Powerslides, keine Ausbremsmanöver – selbst das Lenkrad ist im Grunde nutzlos.

Localization.Title: Dragstars
Localization.Description: Drag racing is a simple sport. Start the engines wait for the lights to go green and then drive very fast in a straight line. No corners no powerslides no outbraking manoeuvres - even the steering wheel is basically useless.

Localization.Title: Noddy: Una Aventura Mágica
Localization.Description: Noddy's Magic Adventure offers different skill levels from easy to hard to cater for a range of abilities and ages from three years and up.

Localization.Title: Noddy : Una Aventura Mágica
Localization.Description: Oui-Oui, l'aventure magique propose différents niveaux de compétence, de facile à difficile, pour répondre à une gamme de capacités et d'âges à partir de trois ans.

Localization.Title: Noddy: Una Aventura Mágica
Localization.Description: Noddy's Magic Adventure bietet verschiedene Schwierigkeitsgrade von leicht bis schwer, um unterschiedlichen Fähigkeiten und Altersgruppen ab drei Jahren gerecht zu werden.

Localization.Title: Noddy: Una Aventura Mágica
Localization.Description: Noddy's Magic Adventure offers different skill levels from easy to hard to cater for a range of abilities and ages from three years and up.

Localization.Title: Lucky Luke: Western Fever
Localization.Description: Are you ready to meet challenges of the wild West ? An action-platform game based around an incredible assortment of challenges. The game is based on the famous comics series about good cowboy Lucky Luke.

Localization.Title: Lucky Luke : Western Fever
Localization.Description: Lucky Luke : La Fièvre de L'Ouest est un jeu d'action sur Playstation. Le sorcier indien Pied de Serpent a été capturé par une bande de hors la loi. Dans cet opus, vous incarnez Lucky Luke et devez emprisonner tous les méchants bandits.

Localization.Title: Lucky Luke: Western Fever
Localization.Description: Lucky Luke: Western Fever basiert auf der berühmten Comicserie über den guten Cowboy Lucky Luke.

Localization.Title: Lucky Luke: Western Fever
Localization.Description: ¿Estás listo para enfrentar los desafíos del salvaje oeste? Un juego de acción y plataformas basado en una increíble variedad de desafíos. El juego está basado en la famosa serie de cómics sobre el buen vaquero Lucky Luke.

Localization.Title: Lucky Luke: Western Fever
Localization.Description: Sei pronto ad affrontare le sfide del selvaggio West? Un gioco di piattaforma d'azione basato su un incredibile assortimento di sfide. Il gioco è basato sulla famosa serie di fumetti sul buon cowboy Lucky Luke.

Localization.Title: Lucky Luke: Western Fever
Localization.Description: Você está pronto para enfrentar os desafios do Velho Oeste? Um jogo de ação e plataforma baseado em uma variedade incrível de desafios. O jogo é baseado na famosa série de quadrinhos sobre o bom cowboy Lucas Sortudo.

Localization.Title: Hybrid
Localization.Description: Hybrid is a 3D first-person shooter with a futuristic high-tech theme. Earth is on the the brink of collapse after years of fighting against an alien invasion, and you are among those who remain to fight.

Localization.Title: Hybrid
Localization.Description: Hybrid sur Playstation est un jeu de tir à la première personne en 3D. Choisissez l'un des quatre personnages disponibles aux capacités propres. Frayez-vous un chemin au sein d'un bunker sous la montagne pour enrayer qui s'y terre.

Localization.Title: Hybrid
Localization.Description: Hybrid ist ein 3D-Ego-Shooter mit einem futuristischen High-Tech-Thema. Die Erde steht nach Jahren des Kampfes gegen eine außerirdische Invasion am Rande des Zusammenbruchs, und Sie gehören zu denen, die noch kämpfen müssen.

Localization.Title: Hybrid
Localization.Description: Hybrid is a 3D first-person shooter with a futuristic high-tech theme. Earth is on the the brink of collapse after years of fighting against an alien invasion, and you are among those who remain to fight.

Localization.Title: Castlevania Chronicles
Localization.Description: This Castlevania game was originally released on the Sharp X68000 (a home computer relatively unknown outside of Japan) but never made it to the worldwide audience.

Localization.Title: Castlevania Chronicles
Localization.Description: Castlevania Chronicles est un jeu d'action/plates-formes sur Playstation. Le titre est réparti sur 8 niveaux tous partagés en 3 séquences. Toujours avec Simon Belmont, vous pouvez jouer suivant 3 degrés de difficulté.

Localization.Title: Castlevania Chronicles
Localization.Description: Castlevania Chronicles ist das europäische und nordamerikanische Re-release des Spiels für Sonys PlayStation. Es erschien 2001 und enthält gerenderte Zwischensequenzen, sowie verbesserte Grafiken.

Localization.Title: Castlevania Chronicles
Localization.Description: La trama del juego es la misma del primer Castlevania de NES (también forma parte de la cronología oficial).

Localization.Title: Castlevania Chronicles
Localization.Description: Akumajō Dracula è stato progettato per sfruttare l'hardware Sharp X68000 con un motore di gioco aggiornato e più complesso rispetto all'originale Castlevania.

Localization.Title: Castlevania Chronicles
Localization.Description: This Castlevania game was originally released on the Sharp X68000 (a home computer relatively unknown outside of Japan) but never made it to the worldwide audience.

Localization.Title: Nickelodeon Rugrats: Totally Angelica
Localization.Description: Rugrats: Totally Angelica stars Angelica Pickles as she makes her way through a shopping mall in search of clothes and accessories to assemble an outfit worthy of winning a fashion show.

Localization.Title: Nickelodeon Rugrats : Totally Angelica
Localization.Description: Les Razmoket : 100% Angelica s'inspire de la célèbre série télévisée pour enfants. Comme son nom l'indique, cet épisode sur Playstation propose d'incarner la pénible Couette-Couette et ses rêves de top-modèle.

Localization.Title: Nickelodeon Rugrats: Totally Angelica
Localization.Description: Rugrats: 100 % Angelica ist von der berühmten Kinderfernsehserie inspiriert. Wie der Name schon sagt, soll diese Episode auf Playstation die schmerzhafte Couette-Couette und ihre Träume von einem Supermodel verkörpern.

Localization.Title: Nickelodeon Rugrats: Totally Angelica
Localization.Description: Protagonizada por Angelica Pickles mientras recorre un centro comercial en busca de ropa y accesorios para armar un atuendo digno de ganar un desfile de moda. El juego consta de seis niveles o pisos, cada uno con varios escaparates.

Localization.Title: Nickelodeon Rugrats: Totally Angelica
Localization.Description: Rugrats: Totally Angelica stars Angelica Pickles as she makes her way through a shopping mall in search of clothes and accessories to assemble an outfit worthy of winning a fashion show.

Localization.Title: Nickelodeon Rugrats: Totally Angelica
Localization.Description: Rugrats: Totally Angelica stars Angelica Pickles as she makes her way through a shopping mall in search of clothes and accessories to assemble an outfit worthy of winning a fashion show.

Localization.Title: Folles Poursuites
Localization.Description: Join Sheriff Jon Bunnell as police chasing is brought to your control. You can freely patrol the vast city environment the game offers, or take on a series of 20 missions.

Localization.Title: Folles Poursuites
Localization.Description: Folles Poursuites est un jeu de courses/action sur Playstation. Dans la peau d'un policier vous êtes lancé dans des courses-poursuites infernales entre vous et les malfrats dans la ville fictive d'Ashland.

Localization.Title: Folles Poursuites
Localization.Description: Schlüpft in die Rolle eines Polizisten und liefert euch in der fiktiven Stadt Ashland wilde Verfolgungsjagden mit Ganoven. Darüber hinaus stehen weitere Spielmodi wie z.B. Eskortmissionen oder Bombenentschärfungen zur Verfügung.

Localization.Title: Folles Poursuites
Localization.Description: Únete al sheriff Jon Bunnell a la vez que tomas el control de la persecución policial. Puedes patrullar libremente la gran ciudad que el juego ofrece, o elegir entre las 20 misiones del juego.

Localization.Title: Folles Poursuites
Localization.Description: Join Sheriff Jon Bunnell as police chasing is brought to your control. You can freely patrol the vast city environment the game offers, or take on a series of 20 missions.

Localization.Title: Tiny Toon Adventures: Plucky's Big Adventure
Localization.Description: Players head out for an adventure with the Tiny Toons gang in Tiny Toon Adventures: Plucky's Big Adventure for PlayStation.

Localization.Title: Tiny Toon Adventures : Plucky's Big Adventure
Localization.Description: Tiny Toon Adventures : La Grande Aventure de Plucky est un jeu d'aventure sur Playstation.

Localization.Title: Tiny Toon Adventures: Plucky's Big Adventure
Localization.Description: Plucky hat wieder seine Hausaufgaben nicht gemacht und will mit einer Zeitmaschine zurückreisen, um die Arbeiten zu erledigen. Cartoon-Adventure mit den bekannten Comicfiguren, Dialoge, Puzzles, Inventar, mehrere Charaktere.

Localization.Title: Tiny Toon Adventures: Plucky's Big Adventure
Localization.Description: Los jugadores se embarcan en una aventura con la pandilla de los Tiny Toons en: Tiny Toon Adventures: Plucky's Big Adventure para PlayStation.

Localization.Title: Tiny Toon Adventures: Plucky's Big Adventure
Localization.Description: I giocatori si imbarcano in un'avventura con la banda di Tiny Toons in: Tiny Toon Adventures: Plucky's Big Adventure per PlayStation.

Localization.Title: Tiny Toon Adventures: Plucky's Big Adventure
Localization.Description: Players head out for an adventure with the Tiny Toons gang in Tiny Toon Adventures: Plucky's Big Adventure for PlayStation.

Localization.Title: The Weakest Link
Localization.Description: The Weakest Link is an interactive adaptation of the NBC game show made famous by host Anne Robinson's cold, no-nonsense demeanor and catchphrase, "You are the weakest link.

Localization.Title: The Weakest Link
Localization.Description: Le maillon faible est une adaptation interactive du jeu télévisé de NBC rendu célèbre par l'attitude froide et directe de l'animatrice Anne Robinson et sa phrase d'accroche "Vous êtes le maillon faible".

Localization.Title: The Weakest Link
Localization.Description: „The Weakest Link“ ist eine interaktive Adaption der NBC-Spielshow, die durch Moderatorin Anne Robinsons kaltes, direktes Auftreten und den Slogan „Du bist das schwächste Glied“ berühmt wurde.

Localization.Title: The Weakest Link
Localization.Description: The Weakest Link es una adaptación interactiva del programa de juegos de la NBC, famoso por la actitud fría y sin sentido de la anfitriona, Anne Robinson: "Tú eres el eslabón más débil.

Localization.Title: The Weakest Link
Localization.Description: The Weakest Link is an interactive adaptation of the NBC game show made famous by host Anne Robinson's cold, no-nonsense demeanor and catchphrase, "You are the weakest link.

Localization.Title: The Weakest Link
Localization.Description: The Weakest Link is an interactive adaptation of the NBC game show made famous by host Anne Robinson's cold, no-nonsense demeanor and catchphrase, "You are the weakest link.

Localization.Title: Breath of Fire IV
Localization.Description: Nina, the princess of Wyndia, and Cray, chieftain of the cat-like Woren tribe, are searching for Cray's relatives who disappeared under mysterious circumstances during a diplomatic mission.

Localization.Title: Breath of Fire IV
Localization.Description: L'histoire débute dans le désert, où la princesse du royaume de Wyndia, Nina, et Cray, un homme bête,se font attaquer par un dragon alors qu'ils sont partis à la recherche d'Elina, la sœur ainée de Nina (et accessoirement dulcinée de Cray) qui a mystérie

Localization.Title: Breath of Fire IV
Localization.Description: Eine Prinzessin. Zwei Länder im Krieg. Eine epische Suche nach Frieden. Nach Jahrhunderten voller Kriege haben die beiden Länder, die an ein undurchdringliches Sumpfland grenzen, endlich einen Waffenstillstand vereinbart.

Localization.Title: Breath of Fire IV
Localization.Description: Nina, la princesa de Wyndia, y Cray, jefe de la tribu Woren, buscan a los familiares de Cray que desaparecieron bajo misteriosas circunstancias durante una misión diplomática.

Localization.Title: Breath of Fire IV
Localization.Description: Nina, la principessa di Wyndia, e Cray, capo della tribù dei Woren, cercano i parenti di Cray scomparsi in circostanze misteriose durante una missione diplomatica.

Localization.Title: Breath of Fire IV
Localization.Description: Nina, the princess of Wyndia, and Cray, chieftain of the cat-like Woren tribe, are searching for Cray's relatives who disappeared under mysterious circumstances during a diplomatic mission.

Localization.Title: Mega Man Legends 2
Localization.Description: Mega Man, Roll, and all your favorites are back in an entirely new 3-D adventure! Far away, in an isolated wasteland, a mysterious girl and an infamous treasure have been discovered.

Localization.Title: Mega Man Legends 2
Localization.Description: Le jeu d'action/aventure Mega Man Legends 2 sur Playstation prend place un an après les événements du premier volet. Nous retrouvons la même équipe de personnages menés par Mega Man Volnutt dans une nouvelle histoire remplie d'humour.

Localization.Title: Mega Man Legends 2
Localization.Description: Mega Man, Roll und alle anderen sind zurück in einem brandneuen 3D-Adventure. Ihre Aufgabe ist es den legendären Sealed Key, der dem Besitzer Zugang über das Große Erbe verschafft, zu erlangen.

Localization.Title: Mega Man Legends 2

Localization.Title: Mega Man Legends 2
Localization.Description: Mega Man, Roll e tutti i tuoi preferiti sono tornati in un'avventura 3D completamente nuova! Lontano, in una landa desolata isolata, sono stati scoperti una ragazza misteriosa e un famigerato tesoro.

Localization.Title: Mega Man Legends 2
Localization.Description: Mega Man, Roll, and all your favorites are back in an entirely new 3-D adventure! Far away, in an isolated wasteland, a mysterious girl and an infamous treasure have been discovered.

Localization.Description: Years after the Reploid Wars, all seems peaceful in the world. But peace was not meant to last forever.

Localization.Title: Mega Man X5
Localization.Description: Sigma, le leader des mauvais Mavericks trouve le moyen de revenir à la vie et de propager un virus pour répandre son armée de robots.

Localization.Title: Mega Man X5
Localization.Description: Jahre nach den Reploid-Kriegen, alle fühlt sich friedlich an in der Welt. Aber der Friede sollte nicht ewig dauern.

Localization.Title: Mega Man X5
Localization.Description: Megaman X5 Nos pone de nuevo al borde de la destrucción del a Tierra.

Localization.Title: Mega Man X5
Localization.Description: Anni dopo le Guerre Reploid, tutto sembra pacifico nel mondo. Ma la pace non era destinata a durare per sempre.

Localization.Title: Mega Man X5
Localization.Description: Anos depois das Guerras Reploides, tudo parece pacífico no mundo. Mas a paz não deveria durar para sempre.

Localization.Title: Sabrina the Teenage Witch: A Twitch in Time!

Localization.Title: Metal Slug X

Localization.Title: Metal Slug X
Localization.Description: Em Metal Slug X, você irá escolher entre quatro soldados durões prontos para missões que só os melhores poderiam sobreviver.

Localization.Description: Tony Hawk Pro Skater 3 é um jogo de esportes no Playstation. Jogue como Tony Hawk ou um de seus amigos patinadores e vá conhecer vários pontos e rampas. O jogo tem muitos objetivos a serem preenchidos para ganhar novos personagens, patins ou ambientes.

Localization.Title: The Italian Job
Localization.Description: This PlayStation release is based on the 1969 British feature film of the same title.

Localization.Title: The Italian Job
Localization.Description: The Italian Job est un jeu de courses sur Playstation tiré du film de 1969.

Localization.Title: The Italian Job
Localization.Description: Diese PlayStation-Veröffentlichung basiert auf dem gleichnamigen britischen Spielfilm von 1969.

Localization.Title: The Italian Job
Localization.Description: Basado en la película británica de 1969 The Italian Job protagonizada por Michael Caine, este juego de carreras contiene 16 misiones, 50 niveles, cinco modos de juego, dos niveles de "viaje gratis" y un modo de fiesta para ocho jugadores.

Localization.Title: The Italian Job
Localization.Description: This PlayStation release is based on the 1969 British feature film of the same title.

Localization.Title: The Italian Job
Localization.Description: This PlayStation release is based on the 1969 British feature film of the same title.

Localization.Title: Gundam Battle Assault
Localization.Description: This game is the follow-up to Gundam: The Battle Master. Heero Yuy, the pilot of a Mobile Suit Wing Gundam is on a mission to destroy the remaining enemy Mobile Suits, who are under the command of Treize Khushrenada, in order to stop a war from starting.

Localization.Title: Gundam Battle Assault
Localization.Description: Gundam Battle Assault est un jeu de combat sorti sur Playstation. Tous les personnages du manga Gundam se donnent rendez-vous dans cet épisode spécial sur Playstation pour se mettre joyeusement sur la tronche. Et pour ça, chacun a son petit coup spécial.

Localization.Title: Gundam Battle Assault
Localization.Description: Dieses Spiel ist der Nachfolger von Gundam: The Battle Master.

Localization.Title: Gundam Battle Assault
Localization.Description: Este juego es la secuela de Gundam: The Battle Master. Heero Yuy, el piloto de un traje Gundam está en una misión para destruir al resto de enemigos, que están bajo el mando de Treize Khushrenada, con el fin de evitar una guerra.

Localization.Title: Gundam Battle Assault
Localization.Description: Questo gioco è il seguito di Gundam: The Battle Master. Heero Yuy, il pilota di un Mobile Suit Wing Gundam, è in missione per distruggere i restanti Mobile Suit nemici sotto il comando di Treize Khushrenada per evitare che scoppi la guerra.

Localization.Title: Gundam Battle Assault
Localization.Description: Este jogo é a sequencia de Gundam: The Battle Master.

Localization.Title: Time Bokan: Yattaman
Localization.Description: Time Bokan is a Japanese anime series first aired on Fuji TV from October 4, 1975 to December 25, 1976 throughout Japan every Saturday at 6:30pm, with a total of 61 30-minute episodes.

Localization.Title: Time Bokan : Yattaman
Localization.Description: Un Shoot'em up vertical basé sur la franchise d'anime de Tatsunoko Time Bokan. C'est la suite du jeu Bokan to Ippatsu! Doronbo.

Localization.Title: Time Bokan: Yattaman
Localization.Description: Time Bokan is a Japanese anime series first aired on Fuji TV from October 4, 1975 to December 25, 1976 throughout Japan every Saturday at 6:30pm, with a total of 61 30-minute episodes.

Localization.Title: Time Bokan: Yattaman
Localization.Description: Un shooter de desplazamiento basado en la franquicia de anime Time Bokan de Tatsunoko. ¡Es la secuela de Bokan to Ippatsu! Doronbo.

Localization.Title: Time Bokan: Yattaman
Localization.Description: Time Bokan è una serie anime giapponese trasmessa per la prima volta su Fuji TV dal 4 ottobre 1975 al 25 dicembre 1976 in tutto il Giappone ogni sabato alle 18:30, con un totale di 61 episodi da 30 minuti.

Localization.Title: Time Bokan: Yattaman
Localization.Description: Time Bokan is a Japanese anime series first aired on Fuji TV from October 4, 1975 to December 25, 1976 throughout Japan every Saturday at 6:30pm, with a total of 61 30-minute episodes.

Localization.Title: Popstar Maker
Localization.Description: Look at the charts today, inundated with manufactured bands. The music business is in need of some fresh talent.

Localization.Title: Popstar Maker
Localization.Description: 100% Star sur Playstation permet au joueur de créer un groupe musical depuis le début. Vous endossez alors différents métiers comme producteur, manageur, compositeur... pour créer le groupe de vos rêves.

Localization.Title: Popstar Maker
Localization.Description: "Newcomer: Be a Popstar" auf der Playstation ermöglicht es dem Spieler, von Anfang an eine Musikgruppe zu gründen. Anschließend übernehmen Sie verschiedene Jobs wie Produzent, Manager, Komponist ..., um die Gruppe Ihrer Träume zu gründen.

Localization.Title: Popstar Maker
Localization.Description: Mira las listas de éxitos de hoy, inundadas de bandas fabricadas. La industria musical necesita talento nuevo.

Localization.Title: Popstar Maker
Localization.Description: Look at the charts today, inundated with manufactured bands. The music business is in need of some fresh talent.

Localization.Title: Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone
Localization.Description: Leave the nonmagical world behind and enroll in Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry in Harry Potter and The Sorcerer's Stone.

Localization.Title: Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone
Localization.Description: Harry Potter à l'Ecole des Sorciers vous plonge dans l'univers magique du jeune magicien sur Playstation. Au fil des diverses missions, vous découvrirez les nombreux secrets de Poudlard.

Localization.Title: Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone
Localization.Description: Übernehmen Sie die Rolle Harry Potters und entdecken Sie die Geheimnisse seiner magischen Fähigkeiten. Erleben Sie diese Welt voller Zauberei, Spaß und Gefahr.

Localization.Title: Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone
Localization.Description: Deja el mundo no mágico atrás y matricúlate en el Colegio Hogwarts de Magia y Hechicería en Harry Potter y la Piedra Filosofal.

Localization.Title: Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone
Localization.Description: Lasciati alle spalle il mondo non magico e iscriviti alla Scuola di Magia e Stregoneria di Hogwarts in Harry Potter e La Pietra Filosofale.

Localization.Title: Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone
Localization.Description: Deixe o mundo não mágico para trás e inscreva-se na Escola de Bruxaria e Magia de Hogwarts em Harry Potter e a Pedra Filosofal.

Localization.Title: Kirikou
Localization.Description: Karaba the Sorceress has cast an evil spell on Kirikou's African village: all the men have mysteriously disappeared. Karaba is a haughty and cruel woman who surrounds herself with vile minions who bow to her every command.

Localization.Title: Kirikou
Localization.Description: Le village de Kirikou vit toujours sous l'emprise de la méchante sorcière Karaba. Dans la peau de Kirikou, préparez-vous à affronter Karaba.

Localization.Title: Kirikou
Localization.Description: Karaba, die Zauberin, hat Kirikous afrikanisches Dorf mit einem bösen Zauber belegt: Alle Männer sind auf mysteriöse Weise verschwunden.

Localization.Title: Kirikou
Localization.Description: La bruja Karaba ha lanzado un hechizo malvado sobre la aldea africana de Kirikou: todos los hombres han desaparecido misteriosamente. Karaba es una mujer engreída y despiadada que se rodea de viles secuaces que se arrodillan ante cada una de sus órdenes.

Localization.Title: V.I.P.
Localization.Description: Based on the syndicated series starring Pamela Anderson, V.I.P. for the PlayStation offers a mixture of first-person shooting action and hand-to-hand combat.

Localization.Title: V.I.P.
Localization.Description: VIP sur Playstation est jeu d'action où vous incarnez la belle Pamela et rejoignez son équipe tout droit sortie de la célèbre série télé du même nom. Armé jusqu'au cou, vous parcourez les villes de Los Angeles en quête de criminalité à éradiquer.

Localization.Title: V.I.P.
Localization.Description: VIP auf Playstation ist ein Actionspiel, in dem Sie die schöne Pamela spielen und sich ihrem Team anschließen, direkt aus der berühmten gleichnamigen TV-Serie.

Localization.Title: V.I.P.
Localization.Description: Basado en la serie sindicada protagonizada por Pamela Anderson, V.I.P. para PlayStation ofrece una mezcla de acción de disparos en primera persona y combate cuerpo a cuerpo.

Localization.Title: David Beckham Soccer
Localization.Description: Endorsed by the then England and Manchester United captain and international superstar, David Beckham Soccer is the last of Rage long tradition in developing soccer games.

Localization.Title: David Beckham Soccer
Localization.Description: David Beckham Soccer est un jeu de football sorti sur Playstation. Choisissez votre équipe parmi les 200 présentes dans le jeu et tentez de jouer aussi bien que David Beckham. Pour cela vous pourrez vous entrainer dans un mode prévu à cet effet.

Localization.Title: David Beckham Soccer
Localization.Description: David Beckham Soccer wird vom damaligen Kapitän und internationalen Superstar von England und Manchester United unterstützt und ist der letzte Vertreter der langen Tradition von Rage in der Entwicklung von Fußballspielen.
