Localization.Title: Magical Drop III (Disc 2) (Magical Drop +1)
Localization.Description: The European PSX version of Magical Drop 3 has loads of different modes, including a board game challenge mode you can play with a friend. You take it in turns to roll the dice and attempt challenges and steal money from each other in a race to the end.

Localization.Title: Magical Drop III (Disc 2) (Magical Drop +1)
Localization.Description: Dans Magical Drop III sur Playstation, vous contrôlez un clown qui attrape et lance des ballons. Vous devez les rassembler par couleurs identiques pour qu'ils explosent et libèrent de la place.

Localization.Title: Magical Drop III (Disc 2) (Magical Drop +1)
Localization.Description: Die europäische PSX-Version von Magical Drop 3 verfügt über viele verschiedene Modi, darunter einen Brettspiel-Herausforderungsmodus, den Sie mit einem Freund spielen können.

Localization.Title: Magical Drop III (Disc 2) (Magical Drop +1)
Localization.Description: Data East consiguió en 1996, un enorme éxito con Magical Drop II. De aspecto similar a Bust-A-Move de Taito, ofrecía cambios en la jugabilidad que lo hacían sumamente entretenido.

Localization.Title: Magical Drop III (Disc 2) (Magical Drop +1)
Localization.Description: The European PSX version of Magical Drop 3 has loads of different modes, including a board game challenge mode you can play with a friend. You take it in turns to roll the dice and attempt challenges and steal money from each other in a race to the end.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy IX (Disc 2)
Localization.Description: Corruption -- the root of all evil. Alexandria's Queen Brahne was once presented as a noble and caring ruler, who would throw lavish festivals to show appreciation for her supporters.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy IX (Disc 2)
Localization.Description: Grâce à sa main mise sur un armement magique extrêmement puissant, la reine Branet d'Alexandrie terrorise les royaumes voisins. Sa fille, la princesse Grenat, décide de s'enfuir du château et devient l'arme d'un groupe de bandits au grand cœur.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy IX (Disc 2)
Localization.Description: Zidane, ein Mitglied einer Räuberbande, muss an einem schönen Abend die Prinzessin entführen. Dummerweise schnappt ihr euch auch noch ihren Bodyguard mit.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy IX (Disc 2)
Localization.Description: La reina Brahne de Alexandria ha empezado a utilizar armas mágicas muy avanzadas para aterrorizar los reinos vecinos.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy IX (Disc 2)
Localization.Description: Corruzione: la radice di tutti i mali. La regina Brahne di Alessandria una volta fu presentata come una sovrana nobile e premurosa, che organizzava feste sontuose per mostrare apprezzamento per i suoi sostenitori.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy IX (Disc 2)
Localization.Description: Final Fantasy IX é um RPG. Nona parte da série, distingue-se dos seus predecessores por novos gráficos mais belos, cinemática de tirar o fôlego e um universo pitoresco.

Localization.Title: Driver 2: Back on the Streets (Disc 2)
Localization.Description: You are an undercover driver, trying to survive amidst an international war between American and Brazilian gangs.

Localization.Title: Driver 2 : Back on the Streets (Disc 2)
Localization.Description: Comme son prédécesseur, Driver 2 est un jeu de courses et d'action sur PC. Toujours dans la peau de l'inspecteur Tanner, vous devez infiltrer le monde souterrain des criminels en usant de vos compétences de pilote.

Localization.Title: Driver 2: Back on the Streets (Disc 2)
Localization.Description: Übernehmen Sie die Rolle von Tanner, dem legendären Driver. Diesmal arbeitet Tanner als Undercover-Cop.

Localization.Title: Driver 2: Back on the Streets (Disc 2)
Localization.Description: Driver 2 o también conocido como Driver 2: Back on the Streets y Driver 2: The Wheelman is Back, es la secuela del popular videojuego Driver. Fue lanzado por Infogrames para PlayStation (2000) y para la portátil Game Boy Advance (2002).

Localization.Title: Driver 2: Back on the Streets (Disc 2)
Localization.Description: Sei un autista sotto copertura, che cerca di sopravvivere in una guerra internazionale tra bande americane e brasiliane. L'azione ti porta a Chicago, Las Vegas, Rio e L'Avana, tutte raffigurate in dettaglio, con strade curve aggiunte dal primo gioco.

Localization.Title: Louvre: The Final Curse (Disc 2)
Localization.Description: Morgan Sinclair, a Secret Service Agent, has been charged with the mission to retrieve 4 artifacts, called Satan?s Keys, from the Louvre Museum. These four keys, when joined together, cause complete global annihilation.

Localization.Title: Louvre : The Final Curse (Disc 2)
Localization.Description: Louvre : L'Ultime Malédiction est un jeu d'aventure à visée pédagogique et cultuelle sur Playstation.

Localization.Title: Louvre: The Final Curse (Disc 2)

Localization.Title: Fear Effect 2: Retro Helix (Disc 2)
Localization.Description: In the near future, mankind's tinkering with the science of genetics and the developmental process of genome mapping has resulted in the accidental creation of a new disease known as EINDS.

Localization.Title: Fear Effect 2 : Retro Helix (Disc 2)
Localization.Description: Fear Effect 2 : Retro Helix est un jeu d'action/aventure sur Playstation. Amateurs d'ambiances glauques, de scènes sanglantes, ou de chair fraîche, ce titre vous propose de sauver le monde mis en danger par un virus.

Localization.Title: Fear Effect 2: Retro Helix (Disc 2)
Localization.Description: „Fear Effect 2: Retro Helix“ spielt in einer nahen Zukunft, in der genetische Experimente und die Kartierung des Genoms versehentlich zur Entstehung einer tödlichen Krankheit namens EINDS geführt haben.

Localization.Title: Fear Effect 2: Retro Helix (Disc 2)
Localization.Description: Retro Helix: una épica aventura sobre el destino de la Humanidad. Profundiza en las pintorescas historias de los auténticos mercenarios y en las extraordinarias circunstancias que los reunieron en Fear Effect.

Localization.Title: Fear Effect 2: Retro Helix (Disc 2)
Localization.Description: Nel prossimo futuro, il lavoro dell'umanità con la scienza della genetica e il processo di sviluppo della mappatura del genoma ha portato alla creazione accidentale di una nuova malattia nota come EINDS.

Localization.Title: Fear Effect 2: Retro Helix (Disc 2)
Localization.Description: Fear Effect 2: Retro Helix é um jogo de ação / aventura no Playstation. Amantes de atmosferas glaucosas, cenas sangrentas ou carne fresca, este título oferece-lhe para salvar o mundo ameaçado por um vírus.

Localization.Title: Evil Dead: Hail to the King (Disc 2)
Localization.Description: Evil Dead: Hail to the King features a mix of action, puzzles, and suspense. Set eight years after the third film, you are Ash, who is being drawn back to the cabin in the woods.

Localization.Title: Evil Dead : Hail to the King (Disc 2)
Localization.Description: Vous incarnez Ash, le héros de la trilogie Evil Dead, dans Hail to the King sur Playstation. L'action se déroule chronologiquement huit années après les événements du dernier film.

Localization.Title: Evil Dead: Hail to the King (Disc 2)
Localization.Description: Evil Dead: Hail to the King bietet eine Mischung aus Action, Rätseln und Spannung. Acht Jahre nach dem dritten Film schlüpfst du in die Rolle von Ash, den es zurück in die Hütte im Wald zieht.

Localization.Title: Evil Dead: Hail to the King (Disc 2)
Localization.Description: Evil Dead: Hail to the King presenta una combinación de acción en tercera persona, rompecabezas y supervivencia. Ambientada ocho años después de la tercera película, eres Ash, quien regresa a la cabaña en el bosque.

Localization.Title: Evil Dead: Hail to the King (Disc 2)
Localization.Description: Si impersona Ash, il protagonista della trilogia di Evil Dead. L'azione si svolge cronologicamente otto anni dopo gli eventi dell'ultimo film.

Localization.Title: Evil Dead: Hail to the King (Disc 2)
Localization.Description: O teu papel é o de Ash, o herói da trilogia Evil Dead. A ação decorre cronologicamente oito anos após os acontecimentos do último filme.

Localization.Description: Monte Carlo Games Compendium is a collection of 17 gambling games for the PlayStation from Midas Interactive. With this title, you can experience the highs and lows of winning and losing money without actually losing a penny.

Localization.Title: Monte Carlo Games Compendium (Disc 2)

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy Origins: Final Fantasy II
Localization.Description: Final Fantasy II is a remake of the original game for the NES (Famicom). The original version was only released in Japan, but this PS1 version was made available outside of Japan in Final Fantasy Origins.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy Origins : Final Fantasy II
Localization.Description: Final Fantasy II est un jeu de rôle sur Playstation. Sorti à l'origine sur Nes en 1990, le titre revient pour vous permettre d'arrêter une nouvelle fois le Mal.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy Origins: Final Fantasy II
Localization.Description: Ein machthungriger Imperator schließt einen Pakt mit der Dämonenwelt und überzieht das Land mit Krieg. Tausende von Menschen sterben.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy Origins: Final Fantasy II
Localization.Description: Final Fantasy II es un remake del juego original para la NES (Famicom). La versión original sólo se publicó en Japón, pero esta versión de PS1 se publicó fuera de Japón en Final Fantasy Origins.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy Origins: Final Fantasy II
Localization.Description: Final Fantasy II è un remake del gioco originale per NES (Famicom). La versione originale è stata rilasciata solo in Giappone, ma questa versione per PS1 è stata resa disponibile al di fuori del Giappone in Final Fantasy Origins.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy Origins: Final Fantasy II
Localization.Description: Final Fantasy II é um remake do jogo original para NES (Famicom). A versão original foi lançada apenas no Japão, mas esta versão PS1 foi disponibilizada fora do Japão em Final Fantasy Origins.

Localization.Title: All Star Action (Disc 2)
Localization.Description: All Star Action is a two-disc compilation containing twelve action, racing and sports games. The collection includes car, motorcycle, truck and futuristic robot racing alongside surfing, bodyboarding, windsurfing and jet-ski challenges.

Localization.Title: All Star Action (Disc 2)
Localization.Description: All Star Action est une compilation de douze jeux d'action, de course et de sports répartis sur deux disques. Elle propose des courses de voitures, motos, camions et robots, ainsi que des épreuves de surf, bodyboard, planche à voile et jet-ski.

Localization.Title: All Star Action (Disc 2)
Localization.Description: Mit Highspeed durch Amerika! Drücken Sie das Gaspedal aufs Bodenblech und bereiten Sie sich vor auf ein Hochgeschwindigkeitsrennen durch den Asphaltdschungel amerikanischer Großstädte und die Weiten der Nationalparks.

Localization.Title: All Star Action (Disc 2)
Localization.Description: All Star Action is a two-disc compilation containing twelve action, racing and sports games. The collection includes car, motorcycle, truck and futuristic robot racing alongside surfing, bodyboarding, windsurfing and jet-ski challenges.

Localization.Title: All Star Action (Disc 2)
Localization.Description: All Star Action is a two-disc compilation containing twelve action, racing and sports games. The collection includes car, motorcycle, truck and futuristic robot racing alongside surfing, bodyboarding, windsurfing and jet-ski challenges.

Localization.Title: All Star Action (Disc 2)
Localization.Description: Teste sua força em corridas rápidas e eventos esportivos. O máximo em diversão para ti e para os teus amigos. Um suspense emocionante e intoxicante cheio de ação!

Localization.Title: Bust-A-Move 3 DX
Localization.Description: So you think you've mastered every puzzle game in the universe, eh? Well, think again. Our all-new Bust-a-Move 3 will have you eating humble pie 'til your gut hurts.

Localization.Title: Bust-A-Move 3 DX
Localization.Description: L'objectif est de détruire toutes les bulles à l'écran pour passer au niveau suivant. A l'aide d'un canon, le joueur doit assembler par trois des bulles de couleur identique pour les faire disparaître.

Localization.Title: Bust-A-Move 3 DX
Localization.Description: Nach "Puzzle Bobble" und "Arcade Edition" nun der dritte Streich des Tetris-Klons. Wie gehabt, versuchen ein oder zwei Spieler unter Zeitdruck, Seifenblasen durch geschicktes Zielen auf bereits vorhandene Reihen zum Platzen zu bringen.

Localization.Title: Bust-A-Move 3 DX
Localization.Description: Así que crees que has dominado todos los juegos de rompecabezas del universo, ¿eh? Bueno, piénsalo de nuevo. Bust-a-Move 3 te hará comer un humilde pastel hasta que te duela el estómago.

Localization.Title: Bust-A-Move 3 DX
Localization.Description: Bust-A-Move 3 DX su Playstation è un puzzle-game il cui obiettivo è quello di distruggere tutte le bolle sullo schermo per passare al livello successivo.

Localization.Title: Bust-A-Move 3 DX
Localization.Description: So you think you've mastered every puzzle game in the universe, eh? Well, think again. Our all-new Bust-a-Move 3 will have you eating humble pie 'til your gut hurts.

Localization.Title: Psychic Detective (Disc 3)
Localization.Description: In Psychic Detective you take the role of Eric Fox, a psychic detective who can transmit his psychic self to others, to see through their eyes and hear through their ears. That way you can find out things about the case you couldn't otherwise.

Localization.Title: Psychic Detective (Disc 3)
Localization.Description: Eric Fox est un médium qui vit à San Francisco et gagne sa vie en faisant des spectacles de magie dans des boîtes de nuit miteuses. Cela change quand Eric rencontre Laina, une femme mystérieuse qui l'entraîne à s'aventurer dans l'esprit des autres.

Localization.Title: Psychic Detective (Disc 3)
Localization.Description: In Psychic Detective übernehmen Sie die Rolle von Eric Fox, einem übersinnlichen Detektiv, der sein übersinnliches Selbst auf andere übertragen kann, um durch deren Augen zu sehen und durch deren Ohren zu hören.

Localization.Title: Psychic Detective (Disc 3)

Localization.Description: The story begins in 1997. It's the dead of night in the city of Los Angeles, and there has been a mass murder at a general hospital on the outskirts of downtown. The perpetrator is the director of the hospital, Richter Harris.

Localization.Description: D auf Playstation ist ein First-Person-Abenteuerspiel, bei dem der Spieler in die Rolle von Laura Harris schlüpft und ein seltsames Schloss erkundet.

Localization.Title: Riven: The Sequel to Myst (Disc 3)
Localization.Description: Riven is a sequel to Myst, and is very similar to its predecessor in gameplay style, controls, and visual presentation. The game world is presented as a series of computer-generated still screens; the player explores it in a point-and-click fashion.

Localization.Title: Riven : The Sequel to Myst (Disc 3)
Localization.Description: Riven : La Suite de Myst est un jeu de réflexion/aventure sur Playstation. Vous êtes convoqué par Atrus qui a besoin de vous pour libérer sa femme Catherine.

Localization.Title: Riven: The Sequel to Myst (Disc 3)
Localization.Description: Riven ist das Sequel zu Myst, und entspricht vom Gameplay eins zu eins dem Vorgänger. Die Welt wurde damals auf SCI Graphics Rechnern generiert, durch die sich der Spieler in Point and Click Manier klickt. Interaktion ist an diversen Hotspots möglich.

Localization.Title: Riven: The Sequel to Myst (Disc 3)
Localization.Description: Riven es la secuela de Myst y es muy similar a su predecesor en estilo de juego, controles y presentación visual. El mundo del juego se presenta como una serie de pantallas fijas generadas por computadora; el jugador lo explora apuntando y haciendo clic.

Localization.Description: The advanced city design of Atlantis shows that a fully-fledged society must've functioned there, and this adventure game brings it to life.

Localization.Title: Atlantis : The Lost Tales (Disc 3)
Localization.Description: Atlantis est un jeu d'aventure et de réflexion sur Playstation. Le joueur peut effectuer des rotations dans toutes les directions pour visualiser le monde qui l'entoure et se déplace de point en point dans l'univers d'Atlantis.

Localization.Title: Atlantis: The Lost Tales (Disc 3)
Localization.Description: Atlantis: Das sagenhafte Abenteuer (orig. Atlantis: The Lost Tales) ist der erste Teil einer Reihe, welche von Cryo Interactive Entertainment entwickelt wurde und am 30. September 1997 von Dreamcatcher Interactive veröffentlicht wurde.

Localization.Title: Atlantis: The Lost Tales (Disc 3)
Localization.Description: "En el transcurso de un terrible día y de una terrible noche toda la belicosa estirpe desapareció bajo la tierra, y a la par desapareció la Atlántida en el mar para siempre" Platón. 560 a.C.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy VIII (Disc 3)
Localization.Description: A member of an elite military team, Squall is forced into a conflict beyond imagination. To survive, he must contend with a desperate rival, a powerful sorceress, and his own mysterious dreams.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy VIII (Disc 3)
Localization.Description: Squall fait partie d'un escadron militaire d'élite et se voit obligé de participer à un conflit dépassant les limites de l'imagination.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy VIII (Disc 3)
Localization.Description: In Final Fantasy VIII schlüpfst du in die Rolle von Squall, einem Mitglied einer Elite-Militärtruppe, der in einen Konflikt mit einem rivalisierenden Gegner, einer mächtigen Hexe und seinen eigenen mysteriösen Träumen verwickelt wird.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy VIII (Disc 3)
Localization.Description: Squall, un miembro de un cuerpo de élite del ejército, se ve forzado a entrar en un conflicto que traspasa los límites de la imaginación. Para sobrevivir, debe enfrentarse a un rival desesperado, una poderosa hechicera y a sus propios sueños misteriosos.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy VIII (Disc 3)
Localization.Description: Membro di una squadra militare d'élite, Squall è costretto a un conflitto oltre ogni immaginazione. Per sopravvivere, deve lottare con un rivale disperato, una potente strega e con i suoi sogni misteriosi.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy VIII (Disc 3)
Localization.Description: A história se passa em um mundo que mistura elementos de fantasia e ficção científica, seguindo um grupo de jovens mercenários liderados por Squall Leonhart e que trabalham para uma organização chamada SeeD.

Localization.Title: Fear Effect (Disc 3)
Localization.Description: It starts as a simple assignment for the three mercenaries - the beautiful, mysterious Hana, the former army officer Glas, and the ruthless killer Deke.

Localization.Title: Fear Effect (Disc 3)
Localization.Description: Fear Effect est un jeu d'action/aventure profitant de décors précalculés sur Playstation. Avant de pouvoir fêter ses 18 ans, une certaine Wee Ming Lam disparaît dans de mystérieuses circonstances.

Localization.Title: Fear Effect (Disc 3)
Localization.Description: Hong Kong - die futuristische Metrophole des Ostens in einer fernen Zukunft. Die Söldner Hana, Glas und Deke arbeiten zusammen, um die Tochter des mächtigen Triadenoberhauptes der Stadt aus den Händen einer Erpresserbande freizukaufen.

Localization.Title: Fear Effect (Disc 3)
Localization.Description: Fear Effect es un juego de acción y aventura, que aprovecha toda la potencia de Playstation. Comienza eligiendo a uno de estos tres mercenarios: la hermosa y misteriosa Hana, el ex oficial del ejército Glas y el despiadado asesino Deke.

Localization.Title: Fear Effect (Disc 3)
Localization.Description: Fear Effect è un gioco di azione e avventura che sfrutta tutta la potenza di Playstation. Inizia scegliendo uno di questi tre mercenari: la bellissima e misteriosa Hana, l'ex ufficiale dell'esercito Glas e lo spietato assassino Deke.

Localization.Title: Fear Effect (Disc 3)
Localization.Description: Fear Effect é um jogo de ação / aventura com sets pré-calculados no Playstation. Antes que possamos completar 18 anos, um certo Wee Ming Lam desaparece em circunstâncias misteriosas.

Localization.Title: Galerians (Disc 3)
Localization.Description: Rion wakes-up in a hospital room, and the only thing he can remember is his name. However, Rion is no ordinary 14-year old. He is a Galerian?a human with special psychic powers.

Localization.Title: Galerians (Disc 3)
Localization.Description: Galerians est un jeu d'action/aventure de science-fiction sur Playstation. Dans la peau d'un garçon amnésique de 14 ans, vous devrez tout faire pour retrouver la mémoire, quitte à affronter bon nombre d'adversaires.

Localization.Title: Galerians (Disc 3)
Localization.Description: Rion, ein begabter junger Mann mit telekinetischen Fähigkeiten, ist gefangen in einem Strudel von Gewalt, Drogen und Wahnvorstellungen. Der Kampf zwischen Gut und Böse wird in den Häuserschluchten der japanischen Metropole Tokio ausgetragen.

Localization.Title: Galerians (Disc 3)
Localization.Description: 500 años en el futuro, un niño se despierta en un hospital sin ningún recuerdo de quién es o cómo llegó allí. Poco a poco, con el uso de poderes psíquicos, encontrarás pistas para desbloquear tu pasado.

Localization.Title: Galerians (Disc 3)
Localization.Description: Galerians è un gioco di azione/avventura di fantascienza per Playstation. Nei panni di un ragazzo di 14 anni affetto da amnesia, dovrai fare di tutto per ritrovare la memoria, anche se ciò significa affrontare numerosi avversari.

Localization.Title: Galerians (Disc 3)
Localization.Description: Rion acorda em um quarto de hospital, e a única coisa que consegue se lembrar é o seu nome. No entanto, Rion não é um garoto de 14 anos comum. Ele é um Galerian, um humano com poderes psíquicos especiais.

Localization.Title: Galerians (Disc 3)
Localization.Description: Rion wakes-up in a hospital room, and the only thing he can remember is his name. However, Rion is no ordinary 14-year old. He is a Galerian?a human with special psychic powers.

Localization.Title: Galerians (Disc 3)
Localization.Description: Rion, ein begabter junger Mann mit telekinetischen Fähigkeiten, ist gefangen in einem Strudel von Gewalt, Drogen und Wahnvorstellungen. Der Kampf zwischen Gut und Böse wird in den Häuserschluchten der japanischen Metropole Tokio ausgetragen.

Localization.Title: Galerians (Disc 3)
Localization.Description: 500 años en el futuro, un niño se despierta en un hospital sin ningún recuerdo de quién es o cómo llegó allí. Poco a poco, con el uso de poderes psíquicos, encontrarás pistas para desbloquear tu pasado.

Localization.Title: Koudelka (Disc 3)
Localization.Description: The premise behind Koudelka takes place in Aberyswyth, Wales at a monastery known as Nementon Abbey. Found in a remote location, the abbey was built as a place of worship, learning and teaching; it was a place where scholars found peace.

Localization.Title: Koudelka (Disc 3)
Localization.Description: Koudelka est un jeu de rôle sur Playstation se déroulant en 1889.

Localization.Title: Koudelka (Disc 3)
Localization.Description: Wales, Großbritannien, im Jahre 1898. Mit einer Party von drei Charakteren, unter ihnen das zauberhafte Medium Koudelka. Erkunden Sie das abgelegene, düstere und mysteriöse Kloster Nemeton.

Localization.Title: Koudelka (Disc 3)
Localization.Description: 1898, Monasterio de Aberystwyth. Wales "Vine a este monasterio en busca de fama y pasta. Pero me encontré con muerte y desolación. Este puñetero sitio está abandonado de la mano de dios y los muertos campan a sus anchas.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy IX (Disc 3)
Localization.Description: Corruption -- the root of all evil. Alexandria's Queen Brahne was once presented as a noble and caring ruler, who would throw lavish festivals to show appreciation for her supporters.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy IX (Disc 3)
Localization.Description: Grâce à sa main mise sur un armement magique extrêmement puissant, la reine Branet d'Alexandrie terrorise les royaumes voisins. Sa fille, la princesse Grenat, décide de s'enfuir du château et devient l'arme d'un groupe de bandits au grand cœur.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy IX (Disc 3)
Localization.Description: Zidane, ein Mitglied einer Räuberbande, muss an einem schönen Abend die Prinzessin entführen. Dummerweise schnappt ihr euch auch noch ihren Bodyguard mit.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy IX (Disc 3)
Localization.Description: La reina Brahne de Alexandria ha empezado a utilizar armas mágicas muy avanzadas para aterrorizar los reinos vecinos.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy IX (Disc 3)
Localization.Description: Corruzione: la radice di tutti i mali. La regina Brahne di Alessandria una volta fu presentata come una sovrana nobile e premurosa, che organizzava feste sontuose per mostrare apprezzamento per i suoi sostenitori.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy IX (Disc 3)
Localization.Description: Final Fantasy IX é um RPG. Nona parte da série, distingue-se dos seus predecessores por novos gráficos mais belos, cinemática de tirar o fôlego e um universo pitoresco.

Localization.Title: Fear Effect 2: Retro Helix (Disc 3)
Localization.Description: In the near future, mankind's tinkering with the science of genetics and the developmental process of genome mapping has resulted in the accidental creation of a new disease known as EINDS.

Localization.Title: Fear Effect 2 : Retro Helix (Disc 3)
Localization.Description: Fear Effect 2 : Retro Helix est un jeu d'action/aventure sur Playstation. Amateurs d'ambiances glauques, de scènes sanglantes, ou de chair fraîche, ce titre vous propose de sauver le monde mis en danger par un virus.

Localization.Title: Fear Effect 2: Retro Helix (Disc 3)
Localization.Description: „Fear Effect 2: Retro Helix“ spielt in einer nahen Zukunft, in der genetische Experimente und die Kartierung des Genoms versehentlich zur Entstehung einer tödlichen Krankheit namens EINDS geführt haben.

Localization.Title: Fear Effect 2: Retro Helix (Disc 3)
Localization.Description: Retro Helix: una épica aventura sobre el destino de la Humanidad. Profundiza en las pintorescas historias de los auténticos mercenarios y en las extraordinarias circunstancias que los reunieron en Fear Effect.

Localization.Title: Fear Effect 2: Retro Helix (Disc 3)
Localization.Description: Nel prossimo futuro, il lavoro dell'umanità con la scienza della genetica e il processo di sviluppo della mappatura del genoma ha portato alla creazione accidentale di una nuova malattia nota come EINDS.

Localization.Title: Fear Effect 2: Retro Helix (Disc 3)
Localization.Description: Fear Effect 2: Retro Helix é um jogo de ação / aventura no Playstation. Amantes de atmosferas glaucosas, cenas sangrentas ou carne fresca, este título oferece-lhe para salvar o mundo ameaçado por um vírus.

Localization.Title: Family Games Compendium (Disc 3)
Localization.Description: Midas Interactive re-released some of their games as Family Games Compendium, that is a collection of 20 family games over 3 disks. The gambling games were also released as Vegas Casino & Card Shark.

Localization.Title: Family Games Compendium (Disc 3)
Localization.Description: Midas Interactive a réédité certains de ses jeux sous le nom de Family Games Compendium, une collection de 20 jeux familiaux sur 3 disques. Les jeux de hasard ont également été publiés sous les noms de Vegas Casino et Card Shark.

Localization.Title: Family Games Compendium (Disc 3)
Localization.Description: Midas Interactive hat einige seiner Spiele als Family Games Compendium neu veröffentlicht, eine Sammlung von 20 Familienspielen auf drei CDs. Die Glücksspiele wurden auch als Vegas Casino & Card Shark veröffentlicht.

Localization.Title: Riven: The Sequel to Myst (Disc 4)
Localization.Description: Riven is a sequel to Myst, and is very similar to its predecessor in gameplay style, controls, and visual presentation. The game world is presented as a series of computer-generated still screens; the player explores it in a point-and-click fashion.

Localization.Title: Riven : The Sequel to Myst (Disc 4)
Localization.Description: Riven : La Suite de Myst est un jeu de réflexion/aventure sur Playstation. Vous êtes convoqué par Atrus qui a besoin de vous pour libérer sa femme Catherine.

Localization.Title: Riven: The Sequel to Myst (Disc 4)
Localization.Description: Riven ist das Sequel zu Myst, und entspricht vom Gameplay eins zu eins dem Vorgänger. Die Welt wurde damals auf SCI Graphics Rechnern generiert, durch die sich der Spieler in Point and Click Manier klickt. Interaktion ist an diversen Hotspots möglich.

Localization.Title: Riven: The Sequel to Myst (Disc 4)
Localization.Description: Riven es la secuela de Myst y es muy similar a su predecesor en estilo de juego, controles y presentación visual. El mundo del juego se presenta como una serie de pantallas fijas generadas por computadora; el jugador lo explora apuntando y haciendo clic.

Localization.Title: Capcom Generations (Disc 4) (Blazing Guns)
Localization.Description: This is a compilation of the 4 parts of Capcom Generation series of games, bundled up together in a 4-disc release for the European market. Included are: 1. Disc 1 - "Wings Of Destiny": 1942, 1943 and 1943 Kai.

Localization.Title: Capcom Generations (Disc 4) (Blazing Guns)
Localization.Description: Capcom Generations sur Playstation est une compilation regroupant une multitude de vieux jeux estampillés Capcom. Ces 13 jeux rappelleront des souvenirs aux plus nostalgiques grâce à des titres tels que 1942, Commando, Gun Smoke et Ghouls'n Ghosts.

Localization.Title: Capcom Generations (Disc 4) (Blazing Guns)
Localization.Description: Dies ist eine Zusammenstellung der vier Teile der Capcom Generation-Spielereihe, gebündelt in einer 4-Disc-Veröffentlichung für den europäischen Markt. Enthalten sind: Disc 1 – „Wings Of Destiny“: 1942, 1943 und 1943 Kai.

Localization.Title: Capcom Generations (Disc 4) (Blazing Guns)
Localization.Description: Esta es una compilación de la serie de juegos de Capcom Generation, agrupadas en una versión de 4 discos para el mercado europeo. Se incluyen: Disco 1 - "Wings Of Destiny": 1942, 1943 and 1943 Kai.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy VIII (Disc 4)
Localization.Description: A member of an elite military team, Squall is forced into a conflict beyond imagination. To survive, he must contend with a desperate rival, a powerful sorceress, and his own mysterious dreams.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy VIII (Disc 4)
Localization.Description: Squall fait partie d'un escadron militaire d'élite et se voit obligé de participer à un conflit dépassant les limites de l'imagination.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy VIII (Disc 4)
Localization.Description: In Final Fantasy VIII schlüpfst du in die Rolle von Squall, einem Mitglied einer Elite-Militärtruppe, der in einen Konflikt mit einem rivalisierenden Gegner, einer mächtigen Hexe und seinen eigenen mysteriösen Träumen verwickelt wird.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy VIII (Disc 4)
Localization.Description: Squall, un miembro de un cuerpo de élite del ejército, se ve forzado a entrar en un conflicto que traspasa los límites de la imaginación. Para sobrevivir, debe enfrentarse a un rival desesperado, una poderosa hechicera y a sus propios sueños misteriosos.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy VIII (Disc 4)
Localization.Description: Membro di una squadra militare d'élite, Squall è costretto a un conflitto oltre ogni immaginazione. Per sopravvivere, deve lottare con un rivale disperato, una potente strega e con i suoi sogni misteriosi.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy VIII (Disc 4)
Localization.Description: A história se passa em um mundo que mistura elementos de fantasia e ficção científica, seguindo um grupo de jovens mercenários liderados por Squall Leonhart e que trabalham para uma organização chamada SeeD.

Localization.Title: Fear Effect (Disc 4)
Localization.Description: It starts as a simple assignment for the three mercenaries - the beautiful, mysterious Hana, the former army officer Glas, and the ruthless killer Deke.

Localization.Title: Fear Effect (Disc 4)
Localization.Description: Fear Effect est un jeu d'action/aventure profitant de décors précalculés sur Playstation. Avant de pouvoir fêter ses 18 ans, une certaine Wee Ming Lam disparaît dans de mystérieuses circonstances.

Localization.Title: Fear Effect (Disc 4)
Localization.Description: Hong Kong - die futuristische Metrophole des Ostens in einer fernen Zukunft. Die Söldner Hana, Glas und Deke arbeiten zusammen, um die Tochter des mächtigen Triadenoberhauptes der Stadt aus den Händen einer Erpresserbande freizukaufen.

Localization.Title: Fear Effect (Disc 4)
Localization.Description: Fear Effect es un juego de acción y aventura, que aprovecha toda la potencia de Playstation. Comienza eligiendo a uno de estos tres mercenarios: la hermosa y misteriosa Hana, el ex oficial del ejército Glas y el despiadado asesino Deke.

Localization.Title: Fear Effect (Disc 4)
Localization.Description: Fear Effect è un gioco di azione e avventura che sfrutta tutta la potenza di Playstation. Inizia scegliendo uno di questi tre mercenari: la bellissima e misteriosa Hana, l'ex ufficiale dell'esercito Glas e lo spietato assassino Deke.

Localization.Title: Fear Effect (Disc 4)
Localization.Description: Fear Effect é um jogo de ação / aventura com sets pré-calculados no Playstation. Antes que possamos completar 18 anos, um certo Wee Ming Lam desaparece em circunstâncias misteriosas.

Localization.Title: Koudelka (Disc 4)
Localization.Description: The premise behind Koudelka takes place in Aberyswyth, Wales at a monastery known as Nementon Abbey. Found in a remote location, the abbey was built as a place of worship, learning and teaching; it was a place where scholars found peace.

Localization.Title: Koudelka (Disc 4)
Localization.Description: Koudelka est un jeu de rôle sur Playstation se déroulant en 1889.

Localization.Title: Koudelka (Disc 4)
Localization.Description: Wales, Großbritannien, im Jahre 1898. Mit einer Party von drei Charakteren, unter ihnen das zauberhafte Medium Koudelka. Erkunden Sie das abgelegene, düstere und mysteriöse Kloster Nemeton.

Localization.Title: Koudelka (Disc 4)
Localization.Description: 1898, Monasterio de Aberystwyth. Wales "Vine a este monasterio en busca de fama y pasta. Pero me encontré con muerte y desolación. Este puñetero sitio está abandonado de la mano de dios y los muertos campan a sus anchas.

Localization.Description: Koudelka è un gioco di ruolo per Playstation ambientato nel 1889.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy IX (Disc 4)
Localization.Description: Corruption -- the root of all evil. Alexandria's Queen Brahne was once presented as a noble and caring ruler, who would throw lavish festivals to show appreciation for her supporters.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy IX (Disc 4)
Localization.Description: Grâce à sa main mise sur un armement magique extrêmement puissant, la reine Branet d'Alexandrie terrorise les royaumes voisins. Sa fille, la princesse Grenat, décide de s'enfuir du château et devient l'arme d'un groupe de bandits au grand cœur.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy IX (Disc 4)
Localization.Description: Zidane, ein Mitglied einer Räuberbande, muss an einem schönen Abend die Prinzessin entführen. Dummerweise schnappt ihr euch auch noch ihren Bodyguard mit.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy IX (Disc 4)
Localization.Description: La reina Brahne de Alexandria ha empezado a utilizar armas mágicas muy avanzadas para aterrorizar los reinos vecinos.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy IX (Disc 4)
Localization.Description: Corruzione: la radice di tutti i mali. La regina Brahne di Alessandria una volta fu presentata come una sovrana nobile e premurosa, che organizzava feste sontuose per mostrare apprezzamento per i suoi sostenitori.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy IX (Disc 4)
Localization.Description: Final Fantasy IX é um RPG. Nona parte da série, distingue-se dos seus predecessores por novos gráficos mais belos, cinemática de tirar o fôlego e um universo pitoresco.

Localization.Title: Fear Effect 2: Retro Helix (Disc 4)
Localization.Description: In the near future, mankind's tinkering with the science of genetics and the developmental process of genome mapping has resulted in the accidental creation of a new disease known as EINDS.

Localization.Title: Fear Effect 2 : Retro Helix (Disc 4)
Localization.Description: Fear Effect 2 : Retro Helix est un jeu d'action/aventure sur Playstation. Amateurs d'ambiances glauques, de scènes sanglantes, ou de chair fraîche, ce titre vous propose de sauver le monde mis en danger par un virus.

Localization.Title: Fear Effect 2: Retro Helix (Disc 4)
Localization.Description: „Fear Effect 2: Retro Helix“ spielt in einer nahen Zukunft, in der genetische Experimente und die Kartierung des Genoms versehentlich zur Entstehung einer tödlichen Krankheit namens EINDS geführt haben.

Localization.Title: Fear Effect 2: Retro Helix (Disc 4)
Localization.Description: Retro Helix: una épica aventura sobre el destino de la Humanidad. Profundiza en las pintorescas historias de los auténticos mercenarios y en las extraordinarias circunstancias que los reunieron en Fear Effect.

Localization.Title: Fear Effect 2: Retro Helix (Disc 4)
Localization.Description: Nel prossimo futuro, il lavoro dell'umanità con la scienza della genetica e il processo di sviluppo della mappatura del genoma ha portato alla creazione accidentale di una nuova malattia nota come EINDS.

Localization.Title: Fear Effect 2: Retro Helix (Disc 4)
Localization.Description: Fear Effect 2: Retro Helix é um jogo de ação / aventura no Playstation. Amantes de atmosferas glaucosas, cenas sangrentas ou carne fresca, este título oferece-lhe para salvar o mundo ameaçado por um vírus.

Localization.Title: Riven: The Sequel to Myst (Disc 5)
Localization.Description: Riven is a sequel to Myst, and is very similar to its predecessor in gameplay style, controls, and visual presentation. The game world is presented as a series of computer-generated still screens; the player explores it in a point-and-click fashion.

Localization.Title: Riven : The Sequel to Myst (Disc 5)
Localization.Description: Riven : La Suite de Myst est un jeu de réflexion/aventure sur Playstation. Vous êtes convoqué par Atrus qui a besoin de vous pour libérer sa femme Catherine.

Localization.Title: Riven: The Sequel to Myst (Disc 5)
Localization.Description: Riven ist das Sequel zu Myst, und entspricht vom Gameplay eins zu eins dem Vorgänger. Die Welt wurde damals auf SCI Graphics Rechnern generiert, durch die sich der Spieler in Point and Click Manier klickt. Interaktion ist an diversen Hotspots möglich.

Localization.Title: Riven: The Sequel to Myst (Disc 5)
Localization.Description: Riven es la secuela de Myst y es muy similar a su predecesor en estilo de juego, controles y presentación visual. El mundo del juego se presenta como una serie de pantallas fijas generadas por computadora; el jugador lo explora apuntando y haciendo clic.

Localization.Title: Bio Hazard (Taikenban)
Localization.Description: In Resident Evil, you play the role of either Chris Redfield or Jill Valentine. Your choice of will determine various events and the flow of the storyline.

Localization.Title: Bio Hazard (Taikenban)
Localization.Description: Resident Evil est un survival-horror sur Playstation. L'équipe Bravo a disparu lors d'un crash d'hélicoptère dans les montagnes d'Arklay non loin de la petite ville de Raccoon City.

Localization.Title: Bio Hazard (Taikenban)
Localization.Description: Der Survival Klassiker schlechthin. Man übernimmt Chris Redfield oder Jill Valentine, die auf der Suche nach dem Bravo Team der S.T.A.R.S. Einheit nach einem Angriff in ein Herrenhaus flüchten musste.

Localization.Title: Bio Hazard (Taikenban)
Localization.Description: Enfréntate a tus miedos... En la experiencia de suspense y terror definitiva. Zombies sedientos de sangre. Bestias mutantes. Serpientes monstruosas. Misterios ocultos acechan en cada esquina. La pesadilla reside en este premiado juego de survival horror.

Localization.Title: Bio Hazard (Taikenban)
Localization.Description: Stai morendo di paura Affronta il pericolo! Una serie di attacchi sanguinosi nei dintorni di uno sperduto laboratorio biotecnico hanno fatto iniziare un'investigazione all'unità S.T.A.R.S. (Squadra tattiche speciali e salvataggio).

Localization.Title: Bio Hazard (Taikenban)
Localization.Description: Resident Evil inicia em torno de uma série de casos de homicídio envolvendo canibalismo ocorridos em Arklay Mountaim (Montanhas Arklay), ao norte da cidade fictícia Raccoon City em 1998. O S.T.A.R.

Localization.Title: Battle Arena Toushinden 2: Gyouten Kyougaku no Shishoku-ban
Localization.Description: Himitsu Kessha created the Toshinden, an annual tournament gathering powerful fighters from around the world. After Gaia organized an unauthorized tournament, the corporation arranges another event to lure the rebel into a trap and eliminate him.

Localization.Title: Battle Arena Toushinden 2 : Gyouten Kyougaku no Shishoku-ban
Localization.Description: Himitsu Kessha est à l'origine du Toshinden, un tournoi annuel réunissant de puissants combattants du monde entier.

Localization.Title: Battle Arena Toushinden 2: Gyouten Kyougaku no Shishoku-ban
Localization.Description: Fortsetzung von Battle Arena Toshinden 1. Noch schneller, zusätzliche Kampftechniken, neue Spielfiguren und vollständig überarbeiteten Gameplay. ...

Localization.Title: Battle Arena Toushinden 2: Gyouten Kyougaku no Shishoku-ban
Localization.Description: Himitsu Kessha fundó el Toshinden, que se celebra anualmente y en el que participan fuertes luchadores de todo el mundo.

Localization.Title: Battle Arena Toushinden 2: Gyouten Kyougaku no Shishoku-ban
Localization.Description: Himitsu Kessha ha fondato il Toshinden - tenuto ogni anno, questi tornei presentano forti combattenti da tutto il mondo.

Localization.Title: Battle Arena Toushinden 2: Gyouten Kyougaku no Shishoku-ban
Localization.Description: Seguindo o exemplo da Battle Arena Toshinden primeiro do nome, Battle Arena Toshinden 2 na Playstation é um jogo de combate em que todos os lutadores estão equipados com uma ou mais armas.

Localization.Description: Im "Reich des scharlachroten Mondes" geht der Verrat um. Ist das Imperium korrupt oder verhält sich das Volk illoyal? Nur Sie können das herausfinden. Übernehmen Sie in diesem Epos um Treuebruch, Neid und Ehre die Rolle des Reichwächters.

Localization.Title: Gensou Suikoden
Localization.Description: Suikoden nos pone en la piel de Tir Mc Dohl, hijo del General Teo Mc Dohl del Imperio de la Luna Escarlata. Tir se alista en el ejército siguiendo los pasos de su padre, pero pronto descubrirá que el Imperio esta corrupto y que el pueblo sufre.

Localization.Title: Bushido Blade
Localization.Description: "Bushido" ist die Seele Japans - ein uralter Ehrenkodex, dem Samurai-Krieger seit Jahrhunderten folgen. Tauche in reale Kämpfe in riesigen 3D-Umgebungen ein, die du ausführen, in Scheiben schneiden und durchbrechen kannst.

Localization.Title: Bushido Blade
Localization.Description: El código de honor del Bushido rige las acciones de los samuráis y establece un código de ética para su uso en la lucha.

Localization.Description: As a descendant of Dracula, you must end the vampire bloodline. Can you rid the world of this unspeakable terror? Uncover the mystery of Castlevania and challenge an adventure as legendary as its name.

Localization.Title: Akumajou Dracula X : Gekka no Yasoukyoku
Localization.Description: Retour de la légende. Réveillé de son sommeil éternel par la réapparition de Castlevania, Alucard doit une fois de plus affronter les laquais malfaisants du Prince des ténèbres.

Localization.Title: Akumajou Dracula X: Gekka no Yasoukyoku

Localization.Title: Akumajou Dracula X: Gekka no Yasoukyoku
Localization.Description: Vuelve la leyenda. Despertando de su eterno reposo por la aparición de Castlevania, Alucard debe enfrentarse de nuevo a las malvadas criaturas de la noche.

Localization.Title: Akumajou Dracula X: Gekka no Yasoukyoku
Localization.Description: Come discendente di Dracula, devi porre fine alla stirpe dei vampiri. Riuscirai a liberare il mondo da questo indicibile terrore? Scopri il mistero di Castlevania e sfida un'avventura leggendaria come il suo nome.

Localization.Title: Akumajou Dracula X: Gekka no Yasoukyoku
Localization.Description: Quatro anos após a batalha entre Richter Belmont e Dracula, a escuridão reaparece. O fantasma do sacerdote das trevas Shaft, morto por Richter uma vez, ressurge com um novo plano de ressuscitar seu mestre.

Localization.Description: As a descendant of Dracula, you must end the vampire bloodline. Can you rid the world of this unspeakable terror? Uncover the mystery of Castlevania and challenge an adventure as legendary as its name.

Localization.Title: Akumajou Dracula X: Gekka no Yasoukyoku

Localization.Title: Akumajou Dracula X: Gekka no Yasoukyoku
Localization.Description: Come discendente di Dracula, devi porre fine alla stirpe dei vampiri. Riuscirai a liberare il mondo da questo indicibile terrore? Scopri il mistero di Castlevania e sfida un'avventura leggendaria come il suo nome.

Localization.Title: Akumajou Dracula X: Gekka no Yasoukyoku
Localization.Description: Quatro anos após a batalha entre Richter Belmont e Dracula, a escuridão reaparece. O fantasma do sacerdote das trevas Shaft, morto por Richter uma vez, ressurge com um novo plano de ressuscitar seu mestre.

rom.name: Akumajou Dracula X - Gekka no Yasoukyoku (Japan) (Rev 2).cue

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy V
Localization.Description: The Elemental Crystals...the life source of the planet. With them, gentle winds blow, the seas are active, fire burns bright, and the earth is full of life.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy V
Localization.Description: El ciclo entero de la vida en el mundo es limitado por cuatro cristales, cada uno abastece de su propia fuente energía a la humanidad; del viento que sopla a través de tierras para regar fluyendo a través de los mares, dando vida, dando el fuego caliente

Localization.Title: Star Ocean: The Second Story (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Star Ocean: The Second Story is a world of magic, science, space travel and deadly demons! Enter a world where love knows no bounds, the evil is neverending and good can overcome all if the heart is just and true.

Localization.Title: Star Ocean : The Second Story (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Star Ocean : The Second Story est un jeu de rôle sur Playstation. Téléporté par erreur sur une planète au bord du chaos, le jeune Claude va devoir trouver un moyen de rentrer chez lui tout en venant en aide aux autochtones.

Localization.Title: Star Ocean: The Second Story (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: In einem endlosen Sternenmeer am Rande des Universums steht eine einzelne, schicksalhafte Begegnung bevor.

Localization.Description: De las acciones de dos héroes dependerá el destino del universo. Escoge a Rena o Claude y guíalos a través de diversas aventuras con tal de que no se cumpla la fatal profecía.

Localization.Title: Star Ocean: The Second Story (Disc 1)

Localization.Title: The King of Fighters '96
Localization.Description: Dopo la morte di Omega Rugal, il cui corpo non ha retto alla potenza di Orochi, un nuovo torneo viene organizzato da una certa Chizuru Kagura. Si presenta come la guardiana dello specchio che sigilla il demone Orochi, ma sente che qualcosa non va.

Localization.Title: Silent Hill
Localization.Description: Silent Hill is a 1999 survival horror video game for the PlayStation. The first in a series about a mysterious town of the same name, Silent Hill generated a direct sequel, three indirect sequels, a prequel and a film adaptation.

Localization.Title: Silent Hill
Localization.Description: Un jeune homme à la recherche de sa fille lutte pour survivre dans un monde à cheval entre la réalité et l'enfer, dans une ville renfermant de terribles et sombres secrets.

Localization.Title: Silent Hill
Localization.Description: Harry Mason, ein seit vier Jahren verwitweter Schriftsteller, fährt gemeinsam mit seiner siebenjährigen Tochter Cheryl in den Urlaub, den beide auf Wunsch von Cheryl in der Kleinstadt Silent Hill verbringen wollen.

Localization.Title: Silent Hill
Localization.Description: Un joven hombre busca desesperadamente a su hija debatiéndose por sobrevivir en un lugar entre la realidad y el infierno, una ciudad que esconde oscuros y sangrientos secretos.

Localization.Title: Silent Hill
Localization.Description: Silent Hill è un videogioco survival horror del 1999 per PlayStation. Il primo di una serie su una misteriosa città con lo stesso nome, Silent Hill ha generato un sequel diretto, tre sequel indiretti, un prequel e un adattamento cinematografico.

Localization.Title: Silent Hill
Localization.Description: Silent Hill é um horror de sobrevivência para Playstation. Você joga com Harry Mason e acaba de chegar na pequena cidade de Silent Hill a bordo do seu 4x4 e da sua filha Cheryl. No meio da noite, um acidente interrompe a viagem da família.

Localization.Title: Garou Densetsu: Wild Ambition
Localization.Description: A long standing vendetta culminates with excitement in Fatal Fury: Wild Ambition. With vindictive rage, one fighter searches for truth and redemption against the ruthless crime lord who murdered his father.

Localization.Title: Garou Densetsu : Wild Ambition
Localization.Description: Fatal Fury : Wild Ambition raconte à nouveau l'histoire du combat de Terry et Andy Bogard pour venger la mort de leur père aux mains de Geese Howard.

Localization.Title: Garou Densetsu: Wild Ambition
Localization.Description: In Fatal Fury: Wild Ambition findet ein langjähriger Rachefeldzug seinen Höhepunkt. Mit rachsüchtiger Wut sucht ein Kämpfer nach Wahrheit und Erlösung gegen den skrupellosen Verbrecherboss, der seinen Vater ermordet hat.

Localization.Title: Garou Densetsu: Wild Ambition
Localization.Description: Fatal Fury: Wild Ambition cuenta una vez más la historia de la lucha de Terry y Andy Bogard para vengar la muerte de su padre a manos de Geese Howard.

Localization.Title: Garou Densetsu: Wild Ambition
Localization.Description: Una vendetta di lunga data culmina con grande suspense in Fatal Fury: Wild Ambition. Con rabbia vendicativa, un combattente cerca la verità e la redenzione contro lo spietato signore del crimine che ha ucciso suo padre.

Localization.Title: Garou Densetsu: Wild Ambition

Localization.Title: SuperLite 1500 Series: Asteroids
Localization.Description: Activision's 1998 Asteroids remake combines the original Atari coin-op game with Atari 2600 features, 3-D graphics, and numerous power-ups.

Localization.Title: SuperLite 1500 Series : Asteroids
Localization.Description: Asteroids est un jeu de tir avec des décors en 3 dimensions sorti sur Playstation qui nous met aux commandes d'un vaisseau qui a pour mission de détruire les extraterrestres et les astéroïdes présents à l'écran.

Localization.Title: SuperLite 1500 Series: Asteroids
Localization.Description: Asteroids ist ein 1998er Shooter, der auf der Playstation 1 veröffentlicht wurde. In Asteroids geht es darum, Asteroiden auszuweichen. In der Mitte des Bildes befindet sich ein kleines dreieckiges Raumschiff.

Localization.Title: SuperLite 1500 Series: Asteroids
Localization.Description: Remake del clásico arcade de Atari. Hay tres tipos de naves para elegir, cada una con diferentes fortalezas y debilidades. También hay tres niveles de destreza. Si ganas el juego en el modo Experto o superior, tendrás acceso a un cuarto tipo de nave.

Localization.Title: The King of Fighters '97
Localization.Description: Another year, another KOF. Additions this year come in the form of slightly improved graphics and sounds, new moves and a new game mode. Gameplay is much more plot-driven, as you have middle-bosses that can change depending on what team you select.

Localization.Title: The King of Fighters '97
Localization.Description: The King Of Fighters '97 est un jeu de combat en 2D sur Playstation. Il fait partie de la série des King Of Fighters. Le titre vous permet de choisir entre 29 personnages différents et propose un nouveau mode de jeu, le mode avancé.

Localization.Title: The King of Fighters '97
Localization.Description: The King Of Fighters '97 ist ein 2D-Kampfspiel für Playstation. Es ist Teil der King Of Fighters-Reihe. Der Titel ermöglicht die Auswahl zwischen 29 verschiedenen Charakteren und bietet einen neuen Spielmodus, den erweiterten Modus.

Localization.Title: The King of Fighters '97
Localization.Description: Otro año, otro KOF. Las adiciones de este año vienen en forma de gráficos y sonidos ligeramente mejorados, nuevos movimientos y un nuevo modo de juego.

Localization.Description: Dance Dance Revolution 2ndMix, or 2ndMix, is the 2nd game in the Dance Dance Revolution series of music video games. It has a total of 32 songs: ten from the original Dance Dance Revolution arcade game and 22 all-new songs.

Localization.Description: Dance Dance Revolution 2nd Remix est la suite du jeu qui a lancé la vague des jeux de danse. Vous suivez les flèches qui défilent au rythme de la musique en appuyant sur les directions correspondantes avec vos pieds sur le tapis fourni avec le jeu.

Localization.Description: In preparation for Ragnarok, the final battle between the gods, Odin has commanded Lenneth the Valkyrie to descend to the lower world and gather the souls of fallen heroes to serve as soldiers in the approaching conflict.

Localization.Title: Disney's Tarzan
Localization.Description: Disney's animated film TARZAN gets the videogame treatment and makes his way to the PlayStation. The game follows the plot of the movie: you must help Tarzan grow from a boy to an adult in the span of 14 levels of action.

Localization.Description: G-Darius revolves around a conflict between the humanoids of Amnelia and cyborg/chimera biovessels known as the "Thiima" (meant to mean simply "bringers of death"). The Thiima had been aroused by the Amnelian army's use of the weapon A.N.

Localization.Title: G Darius

Localization.Title: G Darius
Localization.Description: G-Darius dreht sich um einen Konflikt zwischen den Humanoiden von Amnelia und Cyborg/Chimären-Bioschiffen, die als „Thiima“ bekannt sind (was einfach „Todesbringer“ bedeuten soll). Die Thiima waren durch den Einsatz der Waffe A.N.

Localization.Title: G Darius

Localization.Title: G Darius

Localization.Title: SuperLite 1500 Series: Sanvein
Localization.Description: Sanvein is a fast-paced top down shooter where time is of the essence and every moment counts. The main computer of the self-sufficient space colony Utopia, called St. Schutz, has gone haywire. The goal of the game is to escape from Utopia.

Localization.Title: Acid
Localization.Description: Acid is a psychotropic puzzle as players get to fire a pulse of light at the psychedelic conundrums by charging the correct distance and then aim, a little like a golf game gone wrong. Great Tempest style visuals with kanji characters and neon tracers.

Localization.Title: Acid

Localization.Title: Acid

Localization.Title: Dino Crisis 2
Localization.Description: Dino Crisis 2 is a third-person shooter video game for the Sony PlayStation, published by Capcom in North America, released on September 13, 2000 and publish by Virgin Interactive in Europe, release on November 4, 2000.

Localization.Title: OverBlood

Localization.Title: OverBlood
Localization.Description: Quando ti svegli dal tuo sonno in un tubo criogenico, inizi a chiederti chi sei, dove sei e come sei arrivato in questo luogo sconosciuto. Grazie ai gadget che ti circondano, la domanda sulla tua identità avrà una risposta rapida: tu sei Raz Karcy.

Localization.Title: Tomb Raider V: Chronicles
Localization.Description: A few days after the events described in Tomb Raider: The Last Revelation, Lara Croft is presumed dead. Her close friends begin to recollect her previous adventures, which occurred during different periods of her life.

Localization.Title: Tomb Raider V : Chronicles
Localization.Description: Découvrez toute la vérité sur le passé de Lara Croft à travers quatre aventures inédites. Disparue en Egypte, Lara est laissée pour morte. Ses proches amis se retirent pour évoquer ensemble le souvenir de ses aventures passées.

Localization.Title: Tomb Raider V: Chronicles
Localization.Description: Tomb Raider - Die Chronik, enthält vier brandneue Abenteuer von Lara Croft, die Ihnen neue, aufregende Einblicke in die Vergangenheit unserer Heldin bieten.

Localization.Description: Tomb Raider Chronicles es el quinto Tomb Raider de la saga. Tras The Last Revelations, Lara Croft se queda enterrada en el Templo de Horus y es dada por muerta. En su mansión sus amigos recuerdan sus hazañas.

Localization.Title: Tomb Raider V: Chronicles
Localization.Description: Scopri la verità sul passato di Lara Croft attraverso quattro avventure mai viste prima. Scomparsa in Egitto, Lara è data per morta. I suoi amici più cari si ritirano per rievocare insieme il ricordo delle sue avventure passate.

Localization.Title: The King of Fighters '99
Localization.Description: The King of Fighters '99: Millennium Battle is a 1999 head-to-head fighting game by SNK released for the Neo Geo arcade and home platform. It is the sixth installment in the company's The King of Fighters series.

Localization.Title: The King of Fighters '99
Localization.Description: King of Fighters '99 est un jeu de combat sur Playstation. Incarnez l'un des 32 combattants au choix dans un tournoi sanglant. Cet opus permet d'intégrer dans son équipe un quatrième combattant qui prend le rôle de "Striker".

Localization.Title: The King of Fighters '99
Localization.Description: King of Fighters '99 ist ein Kampfspiel für Playstation. Spielen Sie als einer von 32 Kämpfern in einem blutigen Turnier. Dieses Werk ermöglicht die Integration eines vierten Kämpfers in sein Team, der die Rolle des „Stürmers“ übernimmt.

Localization.Title: The King of Fighters '99
Localization.Description: The King of Fighters '99: Millennium Battle es un juego de lucha cuerpo a cuerpo de 1999 de SNK lanzado para Neo Geo arcade y su plataforma de origen. Es la sexta entrega de la serie The King of Fighters de la compañía.

Localization.Title: Tomb Raider IV: The Last Revelation
Localization.Description: According to Egyptian legend, Horus, son of the light, outwitted the evil God Set and imprisoned him in a secret tomb.

Localization.Title: Tomb Raider IV: The Last Revelation
Localization.Description: Secondo la leggenda egizia, Horus, figlio della luce, sconfisse in astuzia il malvagio dio Set e lo imprigionò in una tomba segreta.

Localization.Description: Loosely based on the classic medieval Chinese novel "Water Margins" (Shuihuzhuan) by Shi Nai'an. The game is a fantasy RPG set in an imaginary universe, its main theme being political struggle.

Localization.Title: Gensou Suikoden
Localization.Description: Im "Reich des scharlachroten Mondes" geht der Verrat um. Ist das Imperium korrupt oder verhält sich das Volk illoyal? Nur Sie können das herausfinden. Übernehmen Sie in diesem Epos um Treuebruch, Neid und Ehre die Rolle des Reichwächters.

Localization.Title: Gensou Suikoden
Localization.Description: Suikoden nos pone en la piel de Tir Mc Dohl, hijo del General Teo Mc Dohl del Imperio de la Luna Escarlata. Tir se alista en el ejército siguiendo los pasos de su padre, pero pronto descubrirá que el Imperio esta corrupto y que el pueblo sufre.

Localization.Title: Gensou Suikoden

Localization.Description: Although trains are your primary source of income in the beginning of the game, A-Train is not about building trains exclusively.

Localization.Title: SuperLite 1500 Series : A Ressha de Ikou 4 : Evolution Global

Localization.Title: SuperLite 1500 Series: A Ressha de Ikou 4: Evolution Global
Localization.Description: Obwohl Züge zu Beginn des Spiels Ihre Haupteinnahmequelle sind, geht es bei A-Train nicht ausschließlich um den Bau von Zügen.

Localization.Title: SuperLite 1500 Series: A Ressha de Ikou 4: Evolution Global

Localization.Title: SuperLite 1500 Series: A Ressha de Ikou 4: Evolution Global
Localization.Description: Sebbene i treni siano la tua principale fonte di reddito all'inizio del gioco, A-Train non si occupa esclusivamente di costruire treni.

Localization.Title: SuperLite 1500 Series: A Ressha de Ikou 4: Evolution Global
Localization.Description: Embora os comboios sejam a sua principal fonte de rendimento no início do jogo, o A-Train não se trata de construir comboios exclusivamente.

Localization.Title: Dino Crisis 2
Localization.Description: Dino Crisis 2 is a third-person shooter video game for the Sony PlayStation, published by Capcom in North America, released on September 13, 2000 and publish by Virgin Interactive in Europe, release on November 4, 2000.

Localization.Title: Dino Crisis 2
Localization.Description: Ils sont de retour... Plus d'angoisse, plus de dinosaures, plus de panique... Un an s'est écoulé depuis la capture du Dr Kirk et la première aventure dans laquelle Régina luttait pour survivre dans un monde infesté de dinosaures.

Localization.Title: Dino Crisis 2
Localization.Description: Ein Jahr ist seit Reginas erstem Kampf auf Leben und Tod gegen die prähistorischen Dinosaurier und seit der Festnahme des verbrecherischen Dr. Kirk vergangen. Die Erforschung der 3. Energie wurde dennoch vehement fortgesetzt.

Localization.Title: Dino Crisis 2
Localization.Description: En el año 2010, (un año después de los acontecimientos de Dino Crisis) la investigación llamada ?Tercera Energía? continúa a manos de una agencia del gobierno.

Localization.Title: Dino Crisis 2
Localization.Description: Dino Crisis 2 è un videogioco sparatutto in terza persona per Sony PlayStation, pubblicato da Capcom in Nord America, rilasciato il 13 settembre 2000 e pubblicato da Virgin Interactive in Europa, in uscita il 4 novembre 2000.

Localization.Title: Dino Crisis 2
Localization.Description: O jogo de ação Dino Crisis 2 é um jogo de ação e aventura no Playstation. Ele permite que você represente Regina ou Dylan em sua luta impiedosa contra dez espécies de dinossauros assassinos.

Localization.Title: SuperLite 1500 Series: Carnage Heart
Localization.Description: Carnage Heart is a video game for the PlayStation, developed by Artdink. Its gameplay is a mecha-based, turn-based strategy game, where the player takes the role of a commander in a war fought by robots.

Localization.Title: SuperLite 1500 Series : Carnage Heart
Localization.Description: En 2073, des entreprises géantes se battent sur les lunes de Jupiter pour extraire leurs ressources. Dans ce jeu de stratégie complexe, vous devez concevoir des "OKE" (c'est-à-dire des robots géants), choisir leur matériel et programmer leur logiciel.

Localization.Title: SuperLite 1500 Series: Carnage Heart
Localization.Description: Der Kampf um die Vorherrschaft ist zu einem Spiel geworden, das bis an die Zähne bewaffnete HighTechroboter auf den Jupitermonden austragen. Sie müssen modernste Technnologien einsetzen.

Localization.Description: Front Mission is a strategy RPG set in a futuristic world. This is a remake of Front Mission. Various organizations are trying to gain power through military assaults, piloting huge robots which are the main means of combat in those days.

Localization.Title: Gradius Gaiden
Localization.Description: Evil lurks out there in the universe and only you, aboard your trusty Vic Viper starfighter, can put an end to it. Gradius Gaiden is yet another shooter in the Gradius series.

Localization.Title: Gradius Gaiden
Localization.Description: Gradius Gaiden sur Playstation est un jeu de tir dans l'univers de la série des Gradius. Vous devez éliminer les ennemis qui arrivent à l'écran tout en évitant leurs tirs pour passer au niveau suivant.

Localization.Title: Gradius Gaiden
Localization.Description: Das Böse lauert da draußen im Universum und nur Sie, an Bord Ihres treuen Vic Viper-Raumjägers, können ihm ein Ende setzen. Gradius Gaiden ist ein weiterer Shooter in der Gradius-Reihe.

Localization.Title: Gradius Gaiden
Localization.Description: Gradius Gaiden Los jugadores controlan una nave interdimensional, Vic Viper, y deben combatir contra hordas enemigas a través de diversos escenarios.Este Gradius fue el primero en incorporar tecnología 3D en sus diseños.

Localization.Title: Gradius Gaiden
Localization.Description: O mal espreita lá fora no universo e só você, a bordo do seu fiel caça estelar Vic Viper, pode acabar com isso. Gradius Gaiden é mais um shooter da série Gradius.

Localization.Title: Metal Gear Solid: Integral (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Renegade special forces unit FOXHOUND has taken over Shadow Moses Island in Alaska's Fox Archipelago - publicly a nuclear weapons disposal facility but in truth a top secret weapons development site and home to Metal Gear REX.

Localization.Title: Metal Gear Solid : Integral (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Infiltrez un complexe militaire terroriste pour faire échouer une conspiration nucléaire. Concentrez vous, alertez vos sens, restez en vie... Metal Gear Solid: Espionnage, stratégie et action.

Localization.Title: Metal Gear Solid: Integral (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: FOXHOUND, ein abtrünniges, genetisch verbessertes Spezialkommando, unternimmt einen Putsch auf einem abgelegenen Archipel in Alaska, bei dem es sich in Wahrheit um "Shadow Moses", eine geheime Abrüstungseinrichtung der Regierung, handelt.

Localization.Title: Metal Gear Solid: Integral (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Metal Gear Solid es un juego que mezcla varios géneros, como acción aventura, sigilo o espionaje.

Localization.Title: Metal Gear Solid: Integral (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: FOXHOUND, un rinnegato, commando speciale geneticamente potenziato, sta compiendo un colpo di stato su un remoto arcipelago dell'Alaska che è in realtà "Shadow Moses", una struttura segreta di disarmo del governo.

Localization.Title: Metal Gear Solid: Integral (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Metal Gear Solid é um jogo espionagem lançado para a PlayStation. Nesta obra, Solid Snake deve se infiltrar em Shadow Moses, uma base militar no Alasca, para salvar reféns.

Localization.Title: Metal Gear Solid: Integral (Disc 2)
Localization.Description: A semi-sequel/prequel to the highly acclaimed Metal Gear Solid (MGS), Metal Gear Solid: VR Missions puts you once again in control of the top-level FoxHound field specialist, Solid Snake.

Localization.Title: Metal Gear Solid : Integral (Disc 2)
Localization.Description: Missions Spéciales est une extension du jeu original Metal Gear Solid. On y trouve 300 missions en réalité virtuelle.

Localization.Title: Metal Gear Solid: Integral (Disc 2)
Localization.Description: Mit dieser zusätzlichen Mission-CD für den Knüller "Metal Gear Solid" ist die Legende wieder da. Du mußt 300 VR-Trainingsmissionen bestehen und darfst zum ersten Mal Ninjas steuern. Du bekommst neue Geheimnisse und Bonusstufen.

Localization.Title: Metal Gear Solid: Integral (Disc 2)
Localization.Description: Retorna la leyenda con este disco con misiones adicionales pertenecientes al famosísimo videojuego de éxito sin igual, "Metal Gear Solid".

Localization.Description: Un semi-sequel / prequel dell'acclamato Metal Gear Solid (MGS), Metal Gear Solid: VR Missions ti mette ancora una volta al controllo dello specialista del campo FoxHound di alto livello, Solid Snake.

Localization.Title: Akumajou Dracula X: Gekka no Yasoukyoku
Localization.Description: As a descendant of Dracula, you must end the vampire bloodline. Can you rid the world of this unspeakable terror? Uncover the mystery of Castlevania and challenge an adventure as legendary as its name.

Localization.Title: Akumajou Dracula X : Gekka no Yasoukyoku
Localization.Description: Retour de la légende. Réveillé de son sommeil éternel par la réapparition de Castlevania, Alucard doit une fois de plus affronter les laquais malfaisants du Prince des ténèbres.

Localization.Title: Akumajou Dracula X: Gekka no Yasoukyoku
Localization.Description: Die Legende kehrt zurück Alucard wird durch das Wiedererscheinen von Castlevania aus seinem ewigen Schlummer erweckt und muss wieder einmal gegen die Knechte der Finsternis antreten.

Localization.Title: Akumajou Dracula X: Gekka no Yasoukyoku
Localization.Description: Vuelve la leyenda. Despertando de su eterno reposo por la aparición de Castlevania, Alucard debe enfrentarse de nuevo a las malvadas criaturas de la noche.

Localization.Title: Akumajou Dracula X: Gekka no Yasoukyoku
Localization.Description: Come discendente di Dracula, devi porre fine alla stirpe dei vampiri. Riuscirai a liberare il mondo da questo indicibile terrore? Scopri il mistero di Castlevania e sfida un'avventura leggendaria come il suo nome.

Localization.Title: Akumajou Dracula X: Gekka no Yasoukyoku
Localization.Description: Quatro anos após a batalha entre Richter Belmont e Dracula, a escuridão reaparece. O fantasma do sacerdote das trevas Shaft, morto por Richter uma vez, ressurge com um novo plano de ressuscitar seu mestre.

rom.name: Akumajou Dracula X - Gekka no Yasoukyoku (Japan) (Rev 2).cue

Localization.Title: Dragon Quest VII: Eden no Senshitachi (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: In "Dragon Warrior VII", you are a 16 year old son of a fisherman living on a small island called Estard. There is nothing else on the planet beside this island and the vast ocean surrounding it.

Localization.Title: Dragon Quest VII : Eden no Senshitachi (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Dragon Quest VII sur Playstation est un jeu de rôle dans lequel vous incarnez le fils d'un pêcheur. Âgé de 16 ans, ce dernier cherche à résoudre le mystère de la disparition en voyageant à travers le temps.

Localization.Title: Dragon Quest VII: Eden no Senshitachi (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: In "Dragon Warrior VII" bist du ein 16 Jahre alter Fischerssohn der auf einer kleinen Insel namens Estard lebt. Es gibt nichts anderes auf dem ganzen Planeten außer dieser Insel und dem gewaltigen Ozean, der sie umgiebt.

Localization.Title: Valkyrie Profile (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: In preparation for Ragnarok, the final battle between the gods, Odin has commanded Lenneth the Valkyrie to descend to the lower world and gather the souls of fallen heroes to serve as soldiers in the approaching conflict.

Localization.Title: Valkyrie Profile (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Valkyrie Profile est un jeu de rôle sur Playstation. Inspirée de la mythologie scandinave, l'aventure est divisée en huit chapitres qui conduisent à un final différent selon la manière dont vous menez votre quête.

Localization.Title: Valkyrie Profile (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: In Vorbereitung auf Ragnarok, die letzte Schlacht zwischen den Göttern, hat Odin Lenneth der Walküre befohlen, in die niedere Welt hinabzusteigen und die Seelen der gefallenen Helden zu sammeln, damit Sie als Soldaten in dem sich nähernden Konflikt diene

Localization.Title: Valkyrie Profile (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Valkyrie Profile se inspira profundamente en la mitología nórdica o escandinava, de la que toma numerosos personajes, y que define en buena medida el innovador concepto del juego.

Localization.Title: Valkyrie Profile (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Valkyrie Profile trae profonda ispirazione dalla mitologia norrena o scandinava, da cui riprende numerosi personaggi e che definisce in gran parte il concept innovativo del gioco.

Localization.Title: Valkyrie Profile (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Em preparação para o Ragnarok, a batalha final entre os deuses, Odin ordenou que Lenneth, a Valquíria, descesse ao mundo inferior e reunisse as almas de heróis caídos para servirem como soldados no conflito iminente.

Localization.Title: Star Ocean: The Second Story (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Star Ocean: The Second Story is a world of magic, science, space travel and deadly demons! Enter a world where love knows no bounds, the evil is neverending and good can overcome all if the heart is just and true.

Localization.Title: Star Ocean : The Second Story (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Star Ocean : The Second Story est un jeu de rôle sur Playstation. Téléporté par erreur sur une planète au bord du chaos, le jeune Claude va devoir trouver un moyen de rentrer chez lui tout en venant en aide aux autochtones.

Localization.Title: Star Ocean: The Second Story (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: In einem endlosen Sternenmeer am Rande des Universums steht eine einzelne, schicksalhafte Begegnung bevor.

Localization.Title: Star Ocean: The Second Story (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: De las acciones de dos héroes dependerá el destino del universo. Escoge a Rena o Claude y guíalos a través de diversas aventuras con tal de que no se cumpla la fatal profecía.

Localization.Title: Star Ocean: The Second Story (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Star Ocean: The Second Story è un gioco di ruolo per Playstation. Teletrasportato per errore su un pianeta sull'orlo del caos, il giovane Claude dovrà trovare un modo per tornare a casa aiutando gli indigeni.

Localization.Title: Bomberman Land
Localization.Description: Bomberman receives an invitation to visit Bomberman Land, a large amusement park filled with attractions and familiar characters.

Localization.Title: Bomberman Land
Localization.Description: Bomberman reçoit une invitation pour visiter Bomberman Land, un immense parc d'attractions rempli de jeux et de personnages familiers.

Localization.Title: Bomberman Land
Localization.Description: Bomberman receives an invitation to visit Bomberman Land, a large amusement park filled with attractions and familiar characters.

Localization.Title: Bomberman Land
Localization.Description: Bomberman Land es el primer juego de la serie Bomberman Land, este titulo conmemora los 15 años de la franquicia Bomberman. El objetivo del juego es recolectar las 125 piezas B-CARD a través de las aventuras dentro del parque temático Bomberman Land.

Localization.Title: Bomberman Land
Localization.Description: Bomberman receives an invitation to visit Bomberman Land, a large amusement park filled with attractions and familiar characters.

Localization.Title: Bomberman Land
Localization.Description: Bomberman é uma franquia estratégica de computador e videogame baseada em labirinto, desenvolvida originalmente pela Hudson Soft. O jogo original foi publicado em 1983 e novos jogos da série ainda estão sendo publicados até hoje.

Localization.Title: Valkyrie Profile (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: In preparation for Ragnarok, the final battle between the gods, Odin has commanded Lenneth the Valkyrie to descend to the lower world and gather the souls of fallen heroes to serve as soldiers in the approaching conflict.

Localization.Title: Valkyrie Profile (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Valkyrie Profile est un jeu de rôle sur Playstation. Inspirée de la mythologie scandinave, l'aventure est divisée en huit chapitres qui conduisent à un final différent selon la manière dont vous menez votre quête.

Localization.Title: Valkyrie Profile (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: In Vorbereitung auf Ragnarok, die letzte Schlacht zwischen den Göttern, hat Odin Lenneth der Walküre befohlen, in die niedere Welt hinabzusteigen und die Seelen der gefallenen Helden zu sammeln, damit Sie als Soldaten in dem sich nähernden Konflikt diene

Localization.Title: Valkyrie Profile (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Valkyrie Profile se inspira profundamente en la mitología nórdica o escandinava, de la que toma numerosos personajes, y que define en buena medida el innovador concepto del juego.

Localization.Title: Valkyrie Profile (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Valkyrie Profile trae profonda ispirazione dalla mitologia norrena o scandinava, da cui riprende numerosi personaggi e che definisce in gran parte il concept innovativo del gioco.

Localization.Title: Valkyrie Profile (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Em preparação para o Ragnarok, a batalha final entre os deuses, Odin ordenou que Lenneth, a Valquíria, descesse ao mundo inferior e reunisse as almas de heróis caídos para servirem como soldados no conflito iminente.

Localization.Title: Valkyrie Profile (Disc 2)
Localization.Description: In preparation for Ragnarok, the final battle between the gods, Odin has commanded Lenneth the Valkyrie to descend to the lower world and gather the souls of fallen heroes to serve as soldiers in the approaching conflict.

Localization.Title: Chrono Trigger
Localization.Description: What begins as a carefree day at the Millennial Fair for a young man named Crono turns into a huge adventure.

Localization.Title: Chrono Trigger
Localization.Description: Une journée insouciante à la Foire du Millénaire va se transformer en quête épique pour le jeune Crono.

Localization.Title: Chrono Trigger
Localization.Description: Chrono Trigger ist ein Vertreter der Konsolen-Rollenspiele. Der Spieler steuert die Protagonisten in einer zweidimensional dargestellten fiktiven Welt, welche aus Wäldern, Städten und Dungeons besteht.

Localization.Title: Chrono Trigger
Localization.Description: El milenio. Un portal está abierto. La cadena del tiempo esta rota. Un joven es transportado al pasado, alterando el curso de la historia y el resultado del futuro.

Localization.Title: Chrono Trigger
Localization.Description: Quella che inizia come una giornata spensierata alla Millennial Fair per un giovane di nome Crono si trasforma nella sua ultima avventura.

Localization.Title: Chrono Trigger
Localization.Description: Um dia despreocupado na Feira do Milénio irá transformar-se numa busca épica pelo jovem Crono.

Localization.Title: SaGa Frontier
Localization.Description: Saga Frontier is a fantasy / sci-fi anime style RPG. It's set in a huge world (30 zones).

Localization.Title: SaGa Frontier
Localization.Description: SaGa Frontier est un jeu de rôle sur Playstation qui adopte un système novateur : vous avez le choix entre sept personnages différents au début du jeu, chacun avec leurs propres aptitudes et scénario respectif à suivre.

Localization.Title: SaGa Frontier
Localization.Description: Saga Frontier ist ein Fantasy-/Science-Fiction-Rollenspiel im Anime-Stil. Es spielt in einer riesigen Welt (30 Zonen).

Localization.Title: SaGa Frontier
Localization.Description: Saga Frontier es un RPG de fantasía / ciencia ficción estilo anime. Está ambientado en un mundo enorme (30 zonas).
