Localization.Title: Dragon Quest VII: Eden no Senshitachi (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: In "Dragon Warrior VII", you are a 16 year old son of a fisherman living on a small island called Estard. There is nothing else on the planet beside this island and the vast ocean surrounding it.

Localization.Title: Dragon Quest VII : Eden no Senshitachi (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Dragon Quest VII sur Playstation est un jeu de rôle dans lequel vous incarnez le fils d'un pêcheur. Âgé de 16 ans, ce dernier cherche à résoudre le mystère de la disparition en voyageant à travers le temps.

Localization.Title: Dragon Quest VII: Eden no Senshitachi (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: In "Dragon Warrior VII" bist du ein 16 Jahre alter Fischerssohn der auf einer kleinen Insel namens Estard lebt. Es gibt nichts anderes auf dem ganzen Planeten außer dieser Insel und dem gewaltigen Ozean, der sie umgiebt.

Localization.Title: Dragon Quest VII: Eden no Senshitachi (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: En "Dragon Warrior VII", eres un hijo de 16 años de un pescador que vive en una pequeña isla llamada Estard. No hay nada más en el planeta además de esta isla y el vasto océano que la rodea.

Localization.Title: Dragon Quest VII: Eden no Senshitachi (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: In "Dragon Warrior VII", vesti i panni del figlio sedicenne di un pescatore che vive su una piccola isola chiamata Estard. Non c'è nient'altro sul pianeta se non quest'isola e il vasto oceano che la circonda.

Localization.Title: Dragon Quest VII: Eden no Senshitachi (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Em "Dragon Warrior VII", você é um filho de 16 anos de um pescador que vive em uma pequena ilha chamada Estard. Não há mais nada no planeta além desta ilha e do vasto oceano que a rodeia.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy VII International (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Set in a dystopian world, Final Fantasy VII's story centers on mercenary Cloud Strife who joins with several others to stop the megacorporation Shinra, which is draining the life of the planet to use as an energy source.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy VII International (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: La Corporation Shinra pompe toute l'énergie de notre planète.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy VII International (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Die Shinra Corporation entzieht unserem Planeten alle Lebensenergie. Cloud ein eiskalter Söldner, übernimmt einen Auftrag von einer Gruppe von Öko-Kriegern.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy VII International (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: La corporación Shinra está agotando los recursos vitales de nuestro planeta.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy VII International (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Ambientato in un mondo distopico, la storia di Final Fantasy VII è incentrata sul mercenario Cloud Strife che si unisce ad altri compagni per fermare la Shinra Corporation, che sta prosciugando la vita del pianeta, utilizzato come fonte di energia.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy VII International (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: A história segue Cloud Strife, um mercenário que junta-se a uma organização ecoterrorista a fim de impedir que megacorporação Shinra use a essência vital do planeta como uma fonte de energia.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy VIII (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: A member of an elite military team, Squall is forced into a conflict beyond imagination. To survive, he must contend with a desperate rival, a powerful sorceress, and his own mysterious dreams.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy VIII (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Squall fait partie d'un escadron militaire d'élite et se voit obligé de participer à un conflit dépassant les limites de l'imagination.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy VIII (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: In Final Fantasy VIII schlüpfst du in die Rolle von Squall, einem Mitglied einer Elite-Militärtruppe, der in einen Konflikt mit einem rivalisierenden Gegner, einer mächtigen Hexe und seinen eigenen mysteriösen Träumen verwickelt wird.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy VIII (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Squall, un miembro de un cuerpo de élite del ejército, se ve forzado a entrar en un conflicto que traspasa los límites de la imaginación. Para sobrevivir, debe enfrentarse a un rival desesperado, una poderosa hechicera y a sus propios sueños misteriosos.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy VIII (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Membro di una squadra militare d'élite, Squall è costretto a un conflitto oltre ogni immaginazione. Per sopravvivere, deve lottare con un rivale disperato, una potente strega e con i suoi sogni misteriosi.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy VIII (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: A história se passa em um mundo que mistura elementos de fantasia e ficção científica, seguindo um grupo de jovens mercenários liderados por Squall Leonhart e que trabalham para uma organização chamada SeeD.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy IX (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Corruption -- the root of all evil. Alexandria's Queen Brahne was once presented as a noble and caring ruler, who would throw lavish festivals to show appreciation for her supporters.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy IX (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Grâce à sa main mise sur un armement magique extrêmement puissant, la reine Branet d'Alexandrie terrorise les royaumes voisins. Sa fille, la princesse Grenat, décide de s'enfuir du château et devient l'arme d'un groupe de bandits au grand cœur.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy IX (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Zidane, ein Mitglied einer Räuberbande, muss an einem schönen Abend die Prinzessin entführen. Dummerweise schnappt ihr euch auch noch ihren Bodyguard mit.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy IX (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: La reina Brahne de Alexandria ha empezado a utilizar armas mágicas muy avanzadas para aterrorizar los reinos vecinos.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy IX (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Corruzione: la radice di tutti i mali. La regina Brahne di Alessandria una volta fu presentata come una sovrana nobile e premurosa, che organizzava feste sontuose per mostrare apprezzamento per i suoi sostenitori.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy IX (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Final Fantasy IX é um RPG. Nona parte da série, distingue-se dos seus predecessores por novos gráficos mais belos, cinemática de tirar o fôlego e um universo pitoresco.

Localization.Description: L'UNION SACRÉE... - Incarnez Ashley Riot, agent au service des forces royales et tentez de lever le voile sur les terribles secrets que recèlent la cité maudite de Léa Mundis.

Localization.Title: Vagrant Story
Localization.Description: Als Ashley Lionet, Agent der Spezialeinheit "Riskbreaker", ist es Ihre Aufgabe die Stadt der Schatten, Le Monde, zu infiltrieren.

Localization.Description: Bushido Blade est un jeu de combat réalisé entièrement en 3D sur Playstation. Le soft propose un combat en un contre un armé. Chaque joueur a des caractéristiques de combat différentes et nécessite une parfaite maîtrise.

Localization.Title: Bushido Blade
Localization.Description: "Bushido" ist die Seele Japans - ein uralter Ehrenkodex, dem Samurai-Krieger seit Jahrhunderten folgen. Tauche in reale Kämpfe in riesigen 3D-Umgebungen ein, die du ausführen, in Scheiben schneiden und durchbrechen kannst.

Localization.Title: Bushido Blade

Localization.Description: Tobal No 1 auf der Playstation ist ein Kampfspiel, das in der nahen Zukunft spielt und in dem es um die Kontrolle über eine mächtige und seltene Energie namens Molmoran geht.

Localization.Description: Lucha hasta el final en una arena donde la fuerza bruta se mide contra habilidades salvajes. Ágiles humanos contra formas de vida alienígenas, todos listos para convertirse en el mejor luchador del universo.

Localization.Title: Gakkou no Kowai Uwasa: Hanako-san ga Kita!!

Localization.Title: Zero Divide

Localization.Title: Zero Divide

Localization.Description: Loosely based on the classic medieval Chinese novel "Water Margins" (Shuihuzhuan) by Shi Nai'an. The game is a fantasy RPG set in an imaginary universe, its main theme being political struggle.

Localization.Title: Gensou Suikoden
Localization.Description: Suikoden est un jeu de rôle sur Playstation. Le soft est inspiré du roman chinois au bord de l'eau.

Localization.Title: Gensou Suikoden
Localization.Description: Im "Reich des scharlachroten Mondes" geht der Verrat um. Ist das Imperium korrupt oder verhält sich das Volk illoyal? Nur Sie können das herausfinden. Übernehmen Sie in diesem Epos um Treuebruch, Neid und Ehre die Rolle des Reichwächters.

Localization.Title: Gensou Suikoden
Localization.Description: Suikoden nos pone en la piel de Tir Mc Dohl, hijo del General Teo Mc Dohl del Imperio de la Luna Escarlata. Tir se alista en el ejército siguiendo los pasos de su padre, pero pronto descubrirá que el Imperio esta corrupto y que el pueblo sufre.

Localization.Title: Gensou Suikoden
Localization.Description: Liberamente basato sul classico romanzo cinese medievale "Water Margins" (Shuihuzhuan) di Shi Nai'an. Il gioco è un gioco di ruolo fantasy ambientato in un universo immaginario, il cui tema principale è la lotta politica.

Localization.Title: Gensou Suikoden
Localization.Description: Vagamente baseado no clássico romance medieval chinês "Water Margins" (Shuihuzhuan) de Shi Nai'an. O jogo é um RPG de fantasia ambientado em um universo imaginário, cujo tema principal é a luta política.

Localization.Title: Ray Tracers
Localization.Description: Ray Tracers is an arcade racing game where you have crash into others cars to destroy them. It is a spiritual successor to Chase H.Q. with some differences like a nitro boost system, four cars to choose from and more variety in end bosses.

Localization.Title: Ray Tracers
Localization.Description: Ray Tracers sur Playstation est un jeu de voiture orienté arcade où vous devez vous crasher dans d'autres véhicules pour les détruire. Plusieurs modes de jeu sont proposés et des gros boss de fin de niveau sont présents.

Localization.Description: A number of legends exist throughout the planets of our galaxy that say the Divine Being appears once every millennium. The time is upon us now, and many have converged on the Denius system to greet the Divine Being.

Localization.Description: Brandneue Wagen, brandneue Strecken! Hier werden umwerfende Geschwindigkeit und schwindelerregend realistische Grafiken geboten. Stelle Dich zum Zweikampf um das intensivste Erlebnis im aktionreichsten Spiel aller Zeiten!

Localization.Title: Magical Drop

Localization.Title: Magical Drop

Localization.Title: Doom
Localization.Description: All Hell's Breaking Loose! This is it! The gaming addiction that's been played by an estimated 10 million fanatics on the PC. And now it's out in a sweat-soaked, pulse-pounding, adrenaline-wrenching version for the PlayStation game console. It's DOOM.

Localization.Title: Doom

Localization.Title: Doom
Localization.Description: Von der Union Aerospace Corporation (UAC) durchgeführte Teleportationsexperimente auf den beiden Marsmonden Phobos und Deimos öffnen ungewollt ein Portal zur Hölle.

Localization.Title: Doom
Localization.Description: Doom es un videojuego de acción en primera persona creado por iD Software en 1993 por un grupo dirigido por John Carmack. Deberás controlar a un marine, que se encuentra de rutina en una estación en Fobos, una de las lunas de Marte.

Localization.Title: Doom
Localization.Description: Doom è un videogioco d'azione in prima persona creato da iD Software nel 1993 da un gruppo guidato da John Carmack. Dovrai controllare un marine, che si trova abitualmente in una stazione su Phobos, una delle lune di Marte.

Localization.Title: Doom
Localization.Description: Todo o inferno está se soltando! É isso! O vício em jogos jogado por cerca de 10 milhões de fanáticos no PC. E agora está disponível numa versão suada, pulsante e cheia de adrenalina para a consola de jogos PlayStation. É DOOM.

Localization.Title: OverBlood
Localization.Description: As you wake up from your slumber in a cryogenic tube, you begin to wonder who you are, where you are, and how you arrived at this unknown place.

Localization.Title: OverBlood
Localization.Description: OverBlood est considéré comme l'un des tout premiers survival horror utilisant des décors et un environnement en trois dimensions. Lars Karcy se réveille d'un caisson cryogénique sans savoir qui il est ni où il se trouve.

Localization.Title: OverBlood
Localization.Description: Wenn Sie aus Ihrem Schlaf in einer Kryoröhre erwachen, beginnen Sie sich zu fragen, wer Sie sind, wo Sie sind und wie Sie an diesen unbekannten Ort gelangt sind.

Localization.Title: OverBlood
Localization.Description: Te despiertas de un sueño criogénico sin memoria, comienzas a preguntarte quién eres, dónde estás y cómo llegaste a este lugar desconocido, a través de una base subterránea, descubres que un virus maligno corre por tus venas. Debes encontrar un antídoto.

Localization.Title: OverBlood
Localization.Description: Quando ti svegli dal tuo sonno in un tubo criogenico, inizi a chiederti chi sei, dove sei e come sei arrivato in questo luogo sconosciuto. Grazie ai gadget che ti circondano, la domanda sulla tua identità avrà una risposta rapida: tu sei Raz Karcy.

Localization.Title: CyberSpeed
Localization.Description: Cyberspeed is the World Television event of the future. Spread throughout the galaxy, there are ten tracks, each of which consists of a looped force beam, with other force beams branching off it.

Localization.Title: CyberSpeed

Localization.Title: CyberSpeed
Localization.Description: Cyberspeed ist das Weltfernsehereignis der Zukunft. Über die gesamte Galaxie verteilt gibt es zehn Spuren, von denen jede aus einem geschlungenen Kraftstrahl besteht, von dem andere Kraftstrahlen abzweigen.

Localization.Title: CyberSpeed

Localization.Title: Tobal No. 1

Localization.Description: Lucha hasta el final en una arena donde la fuerza bruta se mide contra habilidades salvajes. Ágiles humanos contra formas de vida alienígenas, todos listos para convertirse en el mejor luchador del universo.

Localization.Description: Ha llegado el momento de revivir eventos históricos. Panzer General fue uno de los primeros juegos (si no el primero) que realmente te permitió jugar con los nazis y, aun así, tener éxito donde Hitler fracasó.

Localization.Title: Panzer General
Localization.Description: The time for resurrecting historical events has come. Panzer General was one of the first games (if not the first) that actually gave you the ability to play for the Nazis, and yet succeed where Hitler failed.

Localization.Title: Soul Edge
Localization.Description: In the 16th century, a sword surfaces that is so powerful, so evil that warriors from all over the globe seek it out. It is Soul Edge, a demon blade. From America to Europe to Japan, these warriors fight each other for the chance to obtain it.

Localization.Title: Soul Edge
Localization.Description: Soul Blade sur Playstation est un jeu de combat en 3D dans lequel chaque combattant utilise une arme différente.

Localization.Title: Soul Edge
Localization.Description: Namco, Schöpfer der Tekken-Serie, präsentiert die fortschrittlichste Waffen-Kampfsimulation aller Zeiten! Wilde Schwertkämpfe mit Teilnehmern aus der ganzen Welt – ein episches Spiel exklusiv für die PlayStation!

Localization.Title: Soul Edge
Localization.Description: La historia se centra en la mítica espada maldita Soul Edge, que promete un gran poder a quien la blanda, pero que también domina las mentes de sus portadores y se alimenta de las almas de sus vencidos.

Localization.Title: Soul Edge
Localization.Description: Nel XVI secolo emerge una spada così potente, così malvagia che i guerrieri di tutto il mondo la cercano. È Soul Edge, una lama demoniaca. Dall'America all'Europa al Giappone, questi guerrieri si combattono per avere la possibilità di ottenerlo.

Localization.Title: Soul Edge
Localization.Description: No século 16, uma espada surge tão poderosa, tão má que os guerreiros de todo o mundo a procuram. É Soul Edge, uma lâmina demoníaca. Da América à Europa e ao Japão, esses guerreiros lutam entre si pela chance de obtê-lo.

Localization.Title: Time Commando
Localization.Description: Part side-scroller, part action combat, Time Commando fuses together different gameplay elements into a wicked whole. In order to stop a computer virus that threatens the very fabric of time itself, you must travel through history to save the future.

Localization.Title: Time Commando
Localization.Description: Time Commando sur Playstation vous invite à jouer à un jeu d'action qui vous embarque dans une virée temporelle. Vous êtes Stanley Opar et devez réparer un super-ordinateur qui change la réalité.

Localization.Title: Time Commando
Localization.Description: Time Commando auf der Playstation lädt Sie zu einem Actionspiel ein, das Sie auf eine Zeitreise mitnimmt. Sie sind Stanley Opar und müssen einen Supercomputer reparieren, der die Realität verändert.

Localization.Title: Time Commando
Localization.Description: Parte side-scroller y parte combate, Time Commando fusiona diferentes elementos de estos tipos de juegos. Debes buscar la manera de detener un virus informático que amenaza el futuro.

Localization.Title: Time Commando
Localization.Description: In parte a scorrimento laterale, in parte in combattimento d'azione, Time Commando fonde insieme diversi elementi di gioco in un insieme malvagio.

Localization.Title: Vermin Kids
Localization.Description: Vermin Kids is a mix between Space Invaders and a puzzle game. In this game the player have to destroy aliens joining some of them with the same colour in the same line or lines. To do that he can rotate his bullets to find the proper colour to fire.

Localization.Title: Vermin Kids
Localization.Description: Vermin Kids est un mélange entre Space Invaders et un jeu de puzzle. Dans ce jeu, le joueur doit détruire des aliens en joignant certains d'entre eux de la même couleur dans une ou plusieurs lignes.

Localization.Title: AirGrave
Localization.Description: Airgrave that was pretty much the same game as Stahlfeder but with more futuristic looking playable ships. The gameplay is the classic vertical shooter in the tradition of other shooter games like Flying Shark.

Localization.Title: AirGrave
Localization.Description: Dans ce Shoot'em up vous aurez le choix entre quatre vaisseaux aux caractéristiques différentes, mais tous basés sur deux armes : la première est le tir classique, la seconde est un tir au sol, avec un système de verrouillage de cibles multiples.

Localization.Title: AirGrave
Localization.Description: Airgrave ist fast das gleiche Spiel wie Stahlfeder aber mit futuristischeren Schiffen. Das Spiel ist ein klassischer Vertical Shooter in der Tradition von Spielen wie Flying Shark. Der Spieler hat die Wahl aus vier Figuren und Schiffen.

Localization.Title: AirGrave
Localization.Description: En este shoot'em up puedes elegir entre cuatro naves con características diferentes, pero todas basadas en dos armas: la primera es de disparo clásico, la segunda es de disparo terrestre, con un sistema de bloqueo de objetivos múltiples.

Localization.Title: AirGrave
Localization.Description: In questo shoot'em up si può scegliere tra quattro navi con caratteristiche diverse, ma tutte basate su due armi: la prima è di tipo classico, la seconda è di tipo terrestre, con un sistema di blocco dei bersagli multipli.

Localization.Title: AirGrave
Localization.Description: Airgrave é quase o mesmo jogo que a mola de aço, mas com navios mais futuristas. O jogo é um shooter vertical clássico na tradição de jogos como Flying Shark. O jogador pode escolher entre quatro figuras e naves.

Localization.Title: Tecmo Super Bowl
Localization.Description: The original Tecmo Bowl was an instant hit on the Nintendo Entertainment System. The game combined simple, easy to grasp arcade action, insanely catchy music and real NFL players.

Localization.Title: Tecmo Super Bowl
Localization.Description: Tecmo reprend à l'identique le nom de son jeu de football américain paru sur NES tout juste cinq ans auparavant.

Localization.Title: Tecmo Super Bowl
Localization.Description: Tecmo trägt den identischen Namen seines American-Football-Spiels, das erst vor fünf Jahren auf dem NES erschien.

Localization.Title: Tecmo Super Bowl
Localization.Description: El Tecmo Bowl original fue un éxito instantáneo en la consola Nintendo Entertainment System. El juego combinaba acción arcade simple y fácil de entender, música locamente pegadiza y jugadores reales de la NFL.

Localization.Title: Dragon Knight 4

Localization.Title: Dragon Knight 4

Localization.Title: Dragon Knight 4

Localization.Title: Dragon Knight 4

Localization.Title: Dragon Knight 4

Localization.Description: 3D Baseball is a 3-D polygon baseball game with over 700 actual Major League players and their previous years stats to choose from.

Localization.Description: 3D Baseball est un jeu de baseball avec plus de 700 joueurs de league Majeure. Le jeu a été conçu via une technologie de capture de mouvements avec 5 angles de caméras.

Localization.Description: 3D Baseball ist ein 3D-Polygon-Baseballspiel mit über 700 echten Major-League-Spielern und ihren Vorjahresstatistiken zur Auswahl.

Localization.Title: 3D Baseball: The Majors

Localization.Title: 3D Baseball: The Majors
Localization.Description: 3D Baseball é um jogo de beisebol polígono 3-D com mais de 700 jogadores reais da Major League e suas estatísticas dos anos anteriores para escolher.

Localization.Title: WWF In Your House
Localization.Description: WWF In Your House follows in the long line tradition of wrestling games with the objective being to totally dominate your opponent with bone-crunching blows and crushing moves, then pin him to the mat and be declared victor.

Localization.Title: WWF In Your House
Localization.Description: WWF In Your House est un jeu de catch sorti en 1996 sur Playstation.

Localization.Title: WWF In Your House
Localization.Description: WWF In Your House folgt der langen Tradition der Wrestling-Spiele mit dem Ziel, Ihren Gegner mit knochenbrechenden Schlägen und vernichtenden Moves vollständig zu dominieren, ihn dann auf die Matte zu nageln und zum Sieger erklärt zu werden.

Localization.Title: WWF In Your House
Localization.Description: WWF In Your House sigue la larga tradición de los juegos de lucha libre con el objetivo de dominar totalmente a tu oponente con golpes demoledores y movimientos aplastantes, luego inmovilizarlo contra la lona y ser declarado vencedor.

Localization.Description: Pachinko is a Japanese gaming device used for amusement and gambling. A pachinko machine resembles a vertical pinball machine, but with no flippers and a large number of relatively small balls.

Localization.Title: Gekiretsu Pachinkers

Localization.Title: Space Jam
Localization.Description: Based on the movie of the same name, Space Jam centres around an invasion of Looney Tunes land by tiny aliens. The fate of the Tunes is to be decided by a basketball game, and for this the aliens turn into the huge, evil Monstars.

Localization.Title: Space Jam

Localization.Title: Space Jam
Localization.Description: Bugs, Schweinchen Dick, Daffy, Lola und Michael Jordan gegen ein Team aus fiesen außerirdischen Monstars. Intergalaktisches Basketball und zusätzlich ein Haufen Minispiele voll irrem Cartoon-Chaos.

Localization.Title: Space Jam

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy VII (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Set in a dystopian world, Final Fantasy VII's story centers on mercenary Cloud Strife who joins with several others to stop the megacorporation Shinra, which is draining the life of the planet to use as an energy source.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy VII (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: La Corporation Shinra pompe toute l'énergie de notre planète.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy VII (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Die Shinra Corporation entzieht unserem Planeten alle Lebensenergie. Cloud ein eiskalter Söldner, übernimmt einen Auftrag von einer Gruppe von Öko-Kriegern.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy VII (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: La corporación Shinra está agotando los recursos vitales de nuestro planeta.

Localization.Description: Ambientato in un mondo distopico, la storia di Final Fantasy VII è incentrata sul mercenario Cloud Strife che si unisce ad altri compagni per fermare la Shinra Corporation, che sta prosciugando la vita del pianeta, utilizzato come fonte di energia.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy VII (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: A história segue Cloud Strife, um mercenário que junta-se a uma organização ecoterrorista a fim de impedir que megacorporação Shinra use a essência vital do planeta como uma fonte de energia.

Localization.Description: X2 is the sequel only released on Playstation of one of the best shooters on Commodore Amiga: Project-X. Project-X is a scrolling shooter game for the Amiga computer released in 1992. It was also ported to DOS.

Localization.Description: X2 sur Playstation est un jeu de tir avec défilement horizontal, parfois vertical. Le soft ne comporte aucun scénario, le but est de détruire un maximum d'aliens avant qu'ils ne vous écrasent.

Localization.Title: X2: No Relief

Localization.Title: Dark Seed II
Localization.Description: Dark Seed II is a sequel to the adventure game Dark Seed. Mike Dawson saved the world from the 'Ancients' in Dark Seed, but the experience causes him to have a mental breakdown.

Localization.Description: L'histoire se déroule un an après les faits qui s'étaient produits dans le premier opus. Mike Dawson, traumatisé par son expérience vécue à Woodland Hills, a quitté la Californie pour s'installer dans la ville texane de son enfance, à Crowley.

Localization.Title: Dark Seed II

Localization.Title: Dark Seed II

Localization.Title: Whizz

Localization.Title: Bio Hazard: Director's Cut
Localization.Description: After receiving a distress call from the Bravo Team, an elite group from S.T.A.R.S (Special Tactics And Rescue Squad) flew into the desolate Raccoon City.

Localization.Title: Bio Hazard : Director's Cut
Localization.Description: Maîtrisez votre peur... et lancez vous dans l'expérience la plus terrifiante de votre vie. Zombies assoiffés de sang. Animaux mutants. Serpents monstrueux. De dangereux mystères vous menacent à chaque tournant.

Localization.Title: Bio Hazard: Director's Cut
Localization.Description: Umbrella Corporation, ein geheimnisumwobener Pharmakonzern in der Nähe der Kleinstadt Raccoon City.

Localization.Title: Bio Hazard: Director's Cut
Localization.Description: Enfréntate a tus miedos... En la experiencia de suspense y terror definitiva. Zombies sedientos de sangre. Bestias mutantes. Serpientes monstruosas. Misterios ocultos acechan en cada esquina. La pesadilla reside en este premiado juego de survival horror.

Localization.Title: Bio Hazard: Director's Cut
Localization.Description: Dopo aver ricevuto una chiamata di soccorso dal Bravo Team, un gruppo d'élite di S.T.A.R.S (Special Tactics And Rescue Squad) è volato nella desolata Raccoon City.

Localization.Title: Bio Hazard: Director's Cut
Localization.Description: Resident Evil: Director's Cut é um horror de sobrevivência no Playstation. Esta é uma versão sem censura do Resident Evil 1. Comparado com o último, o aplicativo é diferenciado por novas cenas, novos ângulos de visão, cenas adicionais e novos trajes.

Localization.Title: Biohazard 2
Localization.Description: Resident Evil 2 takes place two months after the events of the first game and is set in Raccoon City, a Midwestern mountain community whose residents have been turned into zombies by the T-virus, a biological weapon developed by the pharmaceutical compan

Localization.Title: Biohazard 2
Localization.Description: Souvenez-vous, tout avait commencé dans le laboratoire d'un sinistre manoir, lieu de développement du Virus-T, une toxine capable de faire muter des gènes et qui devait servir à la fabrication d'armes biologiques.

Localization.Title: Biohazard 2
Localization.Description: Der Anfang allen Übels war ein Unfall im Versuchslabor eines Herrenhauses. Dieser Unfall hatte zur Folge, daß der T-Virus, ein bilogischer Kampfstoff der Umbrella Corporation, freigesetzt wurde.

Localization.Title: Biohazard 2
Localization.Description: ¿Podrás sobrevivir al horror? Primero fue el desastre en la mansión. Umbrella Corp. desarrolló el T-Virus, una toxina de mutación genética destinada al armamento biológico. Después de su liberación, seres vivientes mutaron en criaturas putrefactas.

Localization.Title: Biohazard 2
Localization.Description: Resident Evil 2 è ambientato due mesi dopo gli eventi del primo gioco ed è ambientato a Raccoon City, una comunità montana del Midwest i cui residenti sono stati trasformati in zombi dal T-virus, un'arma biologica sviluppata dalla società farmaceutica Um

Localization.Title: Biohazard 2
Localization.Description: O jogo se passa dois meses após os acontecimentos de Resident Evil, na cidade de Raccon City, localizada na região centro-oeste dos Estados Unidos.

Localization.Title: Front Mission 2
Localization.Description: The player assumes the role of an OCU Wanzer squad in 22nd century Aroldesh. One night while on routine patrol, the OCU base is infiltrated and attacked. Civil war is now loosed upon the nation of Aroldesh as a coup d'etat is staged.

Localization.Title: Front Mission 2
Localization.Description: Front Mission 2 est un jeu de rôle tactique sur Playstation. L'action se déroule 12 ans après le premier volet, c'est-à-dire en 2102. La République populaire d'Alordesh est frappée par la pauvreté.

Localization.Description: Lagnacure is a 3d RPG game with cartoon character and an isometric view. In which the player controls a group of characters that will begin a big adventure. The game got a sequel a few years later called Lagnacure Legend.

Localization.Title: Kaze no Klonoa: Door to Phantomile
Localization.Description: Klonoa: Door to Phantomile is a side-scrolling platform game viewed from a "2.5D" perspective. The player moves the protagonist, Klonoa, along a path in a two-dimensional fashion, but the game is rendered in three dimensions.

Localization.Title: Kaze no Klonoa : Door to Phantomile
Localization.Description: Klonoa : Door to Phantomile sur Playstation est un titre de plates-formes dans lequel vous contrôlez Klonoa, un être aux oreilles ailées dans un monde où personne ne peut se souvenir de ses rêves, sauf vous.

Localization.Title: Kaze no Klonoa: Door to Phantomile
Localization.Description: Machen Sie sich mit Klonoa auf zu einer abenteuerlichen Reise durch eine magische Welt, in der Träume und Realität auf wundersame Art eins werden.

Localization.Title: Kaze no Klonoa: Door to Phantomile
Localization.Description: Un día, una nave, se estrella contra una montaña cerca de la aldea de Klonoa. En él viaja un espíritu malvado llamado Ghadius, que planea formar la pesadilla perfecta y para ello rapta a la Diva Lefisa (Lephise).

Localization.Title: Kaze no Klonoa: Door to Phantomile
Localization.Description: Klonoa: Door to Phantomile è un gioco di piattaforme a scorrimento laterale visto da una prospettiva "2.5D". Il giocatore muove il protagonista, Klonoa, lungo un percorso bidimensionale, ma il gioco è reso in tre dimensioni.

Localization.Title: Kaze no Klonoa: Door to Phantomile

Localization.Title: Cyberbots: Fullmetal Madness
Localization.Description: Cyberbots: Fullmetal Madness is a fighting game produced by Capcom in 1994 where the pilots of mecha battle each other. The mecha, officially known as "Variant Armors", in this game are the same ones featured in the fighting action game Armored Warriors.

Localization.Title: Tomb Raider 2
Localization.Description: The story of Tomb Raider II surrounds the mythical Dagger of Xian, a weapon which was used by an Emperor of China to command his army. By plunging the weapon into its owner's heart, the weapon has the power to turn its bearer into a dragon.

Localization.Title: Tomb Raider 2
Localization.Description: Lara Croft est de retour. Elle part à la découverte du secret de la Dague de Xian. D'après une mystérieuse légende, celui qui découvrira cette dague mythique gagnera le pouvoir du dragon... à condition qu'il ait le courage de la plonger dans son cœur.

Localization.Title: Tomb Raider 2
Localization.Description: Lara Croft ist zurück! In ihrem neuesten Abenteuer begibt sich die Archäologin auf die Spur des Dolches von Xian. Wer diese mystische Waffe entdeckt, bekommt einem alten chinesischen Glauben zufolge eine unvorstellbare Macht verliehen...

Localization.Title: Tomb Raider 2
Localization.Description: Lara croft regresa en Tomb Raider II para descubrir los secretos de la Daga de Xian.

Localization.Title: Tomb Raider 2
Localization.Description: Lara Croft è tornata. Va a scoprire il segreto del Pugnale di Xian. Secondo una misteriosa leggenda, chi scopre questo mitico pugnale otterrà il potere del drago... purché abbia il coraggio di affondarlo nel suo cuore.

Localization.Title: Tomb Raider 2
Localization.Description: Tomb Raider II, estrelado por Lara Croft é um jogo de ação / aventura no Playstation. A bela Lara Croft está de volta. Ao seu lado você está fora para descobrir o segredo da Adaga de Xian.

Localization.Title: '98 Koushien: Koukou Yakyuu Simulation
Localization.Description: '98 Koshien is a 3D baseball game with different game modes that includes vs and story mode. The game focus in the high school baseball tournaments and got data of more than 4129 japanese high schools.

Localization.Title: '98 Koushien : Koukou Yakyuu Simulation
Localization.Description: '98 Koshien est un jeu de baseball 3D avec différents modes de jeu qui comprend le mode vs et le mode histoire. Le jeu s'est concentré sur les tournois de baseball au lycée et a obtenu des données de plus de 4 129 lycées japonais.

Localization.Title: '98 Koushien: Koukou Yakyuu Simulation
Localization.Description: '98 Koshien ist ein 3D-Baseballspiel mit verschiedenen Spielmodi, darunter Vs- und Story-Modus. Das Spiel konzentriert sich auf die High School Baseball Turniere und hat Daten von mehr als 4129 japanischen High Schools.

Localization.Title: '98 Koushien: Koukou Yakyuu Simulation
Localization.Description: '98 Koshien es un juego de béisbol 3D con diferentes modos de juego que incluye vs y modo de historia. El juego se centra en los torneos de béisbol de la escuela secundaria y obtuvo datos de más de 4129 escuelas secundarias japonesas.

Localization.Title: '98 Koushien: Koukou Yakyuu Simulation
Localization.Description: '98 Koshien è un gioco di baseball in 3D con diverse modalità di gioco che includono la modalità vs e la modalità storia. Il gioco si concentra sui tornei di baseball delle scuole superiori e ha ottenuto dati di oltre 4129 scuole superiori giapponesi.

Localization.Title: '98 Koushien: Koukou Yakyuu Simulation

Localization.Title: Rittai Ninja Katsugeki: Tenchu

Localization.Title: Rittai Ninja Katsugeki: Tenchu

Localization.Description: Durch umfangreiche Wahlmöglichkeiten der Kämpfer, tausende von Schlag- und Bewegungskombinationen und hohe Spielschnelligkeit, hat Dead or Alive eine hohe Langzeitmotivation.

Localization.Description: Dead or Alive es un videojuego de lucha de 1996 de Tecmo y el primero de la serie Dead or Alive (DoA) de Team Ninja. Fue lanzado primero en salas recreativas, y luego porteado para Sega Saturn en Japón, y más tarde para PlayStation en todas las regiones.

Localization.Title: Dead or Alive
Localization.Description: Il primo della serie Dead or Alive e presenta molte delle stesse funzionalità che hanno reso la serie DoA così popolare oggi; Combattimenti un po' realistici, buon design dei personaggi e donne seminude i cui seni rimbalzano molto.

Localization.Title: Dead or Alive
Localization.Description: O primeiro da série Dead or Alive e apresenta muitos dos mesmos recursos que tornaram a série DoA tão popular hoje em dia; Lutas um tanto realistas, bom design de personagens e mulheres seminuas cujos seios saltam muito.

Localization.Title: Bushido Blade 2
Localization.Description: Two samurai families who date back over eight hundred years have been feuding ever since the Gempei War, where the Kagami family sided with the Minamoto and ensured themselves a victory over their rivals, the Sue.

Localization.Title: Bushido Blade 2
Localization.Description: Bushido Blade 2 sur Playstation est un jeu de combat à l'arme blanche qui propose des affrontements très réalistes à l'ère du Japon médiéval.

Localization.Title: Bushido Blade 2
Localization.Description: Zwei Samurai-Familien, die mehr als achthundert Jahre alt sind, haben sich seit dem Gempei-Krieg gestritten, als die Kagami-Familie auf der Seite der Minamoto stand und sich einen Sieg über ihre Rivalen, die Sue, sicherte.

Localization.Title: Bushido Blade 2
Localization.Description: Dos familias de samuráis que se remontan a más de ochocientos años han estado enfrentadas desde la Guerra de Gempei, en la que la familia Kagami se puso del lado de los Minamoto y se aseguró la victoria sobre sus rivales, los Sue.

Localization.Title: Bushido Blade 2

Localization.Title: NASCAR 98
Localization.Description: Racing at a speed of over 200 miles per hour isn't legal on the interstate. But you can do it all you want on your television screen in NASCAR 98. There are 24 top NASCAR drivers present in this game, each driving his signature car.

Localization.Title: NASCAR 98
Localization.Description: Nascar Racing 98 sur Playstation permet de revivre la compétition automobile "Nascar" célèbre aux Etats-Unis, où de puissants bolides s'affrontent sur des circuits ovales à des vitesses vertigineuses. Le jeu retrace la saison 1998 de ce sport.

Localization.Title: NASCAR 98
Localization.Description: Rennen mit einer Geschwindigkeit von mehr als 200 Meilen pro Stunde sind auf der Autobahn nicht erlaubt. Aber Sie können in NASCAR 98 auf Ihrem Fernsehbildschirm alles tun, was Sie wollen.

Localization.Title: NASCAR 98
Localization.Description: Correr a una velocidad de más de 200 millas por hora no es legal en la interestatal. Pero puede hacerlo todo lo que quiera en la pantalla de su televisor en NASCAR 98. Elije 24 pilotos de NASCAR en este juego, cada uno conduciendo su auto característico.

Localization.Description: NBA Live '98 brings the furious action of 5 on 5 basketball to the Playstation. A fully licensed product, this title includes all 29 NBA teams from the 1997-'98 season.

Localization.Title: NBA Live 98
Localization.Description: NBA Live 98 ist ein Basketball-Videospiel, das auf der National Basketball Association und dem vierten Teil der NBA Live-Serie basiert. Das Cover zeigt Tim Hardaway von der Miami Heat. Das Spiel wurde von EA Sports entwickelt und 1997 veröffentlicht.

Localization.Title: Tekken 3
Localization.Description: An ancient evil force has reawakened, attacking in secret and feeding on the souls of mighty warriors. To lure it out of hiding will take the greatest fighting contest the world has ever seen... Tekken 3.

Localization.Title: Tekken 3
Localization.Description: Fin du King of Iron Fist Tournament 2. Heihachi a vaincu Kazuya et reprend la tête de Mishima Zaibatsu. Un jour, il entend parler d'un ancien dieu mexicain, Ogre, qui serait attiré par les âmes fortes.

Localization.Title: Tekken 3
Localization.Description: Eine uralte böse Macht ist erwacht, die heimlich angreift und sich von den Seelen mächtiger Kriegern ernährt. Um Sie aus dem Versteck zu locken, wird es das größte Kampfturnier geben, das die Welt je gesehen hat ... Tekken 3.

Localization.Title: Tekken 3
Localization.Description: Una vez más, el destino une a todos aquellos dispuestos a escuchar la llamada... Una nueva generación de guerreros. Gráficos alucinantes de alta resolución. Modalidades Tekken Force y Tekken Ball completamente nuevas.

Localization.Title: Tekken 3
Localization.Description: Fine del Torneo del Pugno del Re di Ferro 2. Heihachi ha sconfitto Kazuya ed è tornato in vantaggio per Mishima Zaibatsu. Un giorno, sente parlare di un antico dio messicano, Ogre, che si dice sia attratto da anime forti.

Localization.Title: Tekken 3
Localization.Description: Lute por Sua Vida! A força ancestral do mal acordou, atacando em segredo e se alimentando das almas de bravos heróis. Para ser libertada, participará do maior torneio de luta que o mundo já viu... Tekken 3. Alguns lutam por vingança, outros por honra.

Localization.Title: Lucky Luke
Localization.Description: You, as Lucky Luke, have to stop the Dalton gang from making another crime. Walking around town you have to solve puzzles, shoot criminals and collect money. After finishing the level you have a chance to buy an extra life with the money collected.

Localization.Title: Lucky Luke
Localization.Description: Apprenez à tirer plus vite que votre ombre avec cette adaptation sur Playstation de la bande dessinée Lucky Luke. En incarnant le célèbre cow-boy, vous parcourez les saloons et déserts du Far West en compagnie de votre cheval Jolly Jumper.

Localization.Title: Lucky Luke

Localization.Description: Você, como Lucky Luke, tem que impedir a gangue de Dalton de cometer outro crime. Andando pela cidade você tem que resolver quebra-cabeças, atirar em criminosos e coletar dinheiro.

Localization.Title: R-Type Delta
Localization.Description: The Bydo Empire has returned to Earth with a vengeance. This time, they will not accept defeat so easily. Earth however, is ready for them... Three R-Class ships: the R-9, the R-13, and the prototype R-X, are your weapons in this war.

Localization.Title: R-Type Delta
Localization.Description: R-Type Delta est un jeu de tir sur Playstation. Les aliens décident que notre vieille Terre est intéressante et ils y construisent un camp de vacances permanent.

Localization.Title: R-Type Delta
Localization.Description: R-Type Delta ist die letzte Folge von Irem's Klassiker Serie der Weltraum Shoot'em up's. Durch die hervorragende 3D-Engine der Play Station kommt dieser Klassiker in einer Brillanz auf den Schirm, die ihresgleichen sucht.

Localization.Title: R-Type Delta
Localization.Description: El Imperio Bydo ha regresado a la Tierra con ganas de venganza. Esta vez, no van a aceptar la derrota tan fácilmente. Sin embargo, en la Tierra, están preparados para ellos ...

Localization.Title: R-Type Delta
Localization.Description: L'Impero Bydo è tornato sulla Terra con una vendetta. Questa volta non accetteranno la sconfitta così facilmente. La Terra, tuttavia, è pronta per loro... Tre navi di Classe R: la R-9, la R-13 e il prototipo R-X, saranno le tue armi in questa guerra.

Localization.Description: Powering beyond RIDGE and RAGE RACER, high-speed control and advanced dynamics accekerate the rush of a first class victory.

Localization.Title: R4 : Ridge Racer Type 4
Localization.Description: Ridge Racer Type 4 sur Playstation est un jeu de courses totalement arcade. Vous démarrez avec 8 voitures au choix mais pouvez en débloquer beaucoup plus (un peu plus de 300) en tournant sur les 8 circuits présents et sur leur 8 versions miroir.

Localization.Title: R4: Ridge Racer Type 4

Localization.Description: Disfruta todavía más de la alta velocidad y la avanzada dinámica de Ridge Racer y Rage Racer, para conseguir victorias aún más emocionantes. El juego se basa en competir en el Real Racing Roots '99 (RRR), que consta de ocho carreras entre Japón y los EE.

Localization.Title: R4: Ridge Racer Type 4
Localization.Description: Superando RIDGE e RAGE RACER, il controllo ad alta velocità e le dinamiche avanzate accekerano l'entusiasmo di una vittoria di prima classe.

Localization.Title: Luftwaffe: Deutsch Kuugun o Shiki seyo
Localization.Description: Luftwaffe is a generic German term for an air force. It is also the official name for two of the four historic German air forces, the Wehrmacht air arm founded in 1933 and disbanded in 1946; and the current Bundeswehr air arm founded in 1956.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy VIII (Disc 3)
Localization.Description: A member of an elite military team, Squall is forced into a conflict beyond imagination. To survive, he must contend with a desperate rival, a powerful sorceress, and his own mysterious dreams.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy IV
Localization.Description: This classic adventure includes 18 towns and castles, dozens of magical spells, and hundreds of monsters, weapons, and items to help players on their quests.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy IV
Localization.Description: Final Fantasy IV est la réédition sur Playstation du jeu de rôle sorti sur Super Nintendo. De puissants cristaux ont été cachés pour éviter qu'ils ne tombent entre de mauvaises mains.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy IV
Localization.Description: Der Dunkle Ritter Cecil hat von seinem König den Befehl erhalten, dessen fiese Pläne umzusetzen. Cecil jedoch legt seine Loyalität ab, um dem wahnsinnigen Treiben des Monarchen ein Ende zu setzen.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy IV
Localization.Description: Esta aventura clásica incluye 18 pueblos y castillos, docenas de hechizos mágicos, y cientos de monstruos, armas, e itemes que ayudaran al jugador en su aventura.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy IV
Localization.Description: Il cavaliere oscuro Cecil ha ricevuto un ordine dal suo re per attuare i suoi cattivi piani. Cecil, tuttavia, rinuncia alla sua lealtà per porre fine alle folli vicende del monarca.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy IV
Localization.Description: This classic adventure includes 18 towns and castles, dozens of magical spells, and hundreds of monsters, weapons, and items to help players on their quests.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy V
Localization.Description: The Elemental Crystals...the life source of the planet. With them, gentle winds blow, the seas are active, fire burns bright, and the earth is full of life.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy V
Localization.Description: Final Fantasy V est la réédition sur Playstation du deuxième épisode de la célèbre saga de Squaresoft à être sorti sur Super Nintendo.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy V
Localization.Description: Begleite Bartz, seinen befreundeten Choboco, die junge Prinzessin Lenna, den amnesiekranken Galuf und den Piratenkapitän Faris auf eine spannende Abenteuerreise. Es gilt, die Zerstörung der vier Kristalle zu verhindern, die ihre Welt zusammen halten.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy V
Localization.Description: El ciclo entero de la vida en el mundo es limitado por cuatro cristales, cada uno abastece de su propia fuente energía a la humanidad; del viento que sopla a través de tierras para regar fluyendo a través de los mares, dando vida, dando el fuego caliente

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy V
Localization.Description: I cristalli elementali ... la fonte di vita del pianeta. Con loro soffiano venti gentili, i mari sono attivi, il fuoco arde luminoso e la terra è piena di vita.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy V
Localization.Description: Final Fantasy V é a reedição para Playstation do segundo episódio da famosa saga Squaresoft a ser lançado no Super Nintendo. Os quatro cristais que representam os quatro elementos governam o equilíbrio do mundo, até que um meteorito chegue à Terra.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy VI
Localization.Description: Set in a fantasy world with a technology level equivalent to that of the Second Industrial Revolution, the game's story focuses on a group of rebels as they seek to overthrow an imperial dictatorship.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy VI
Localization.Description: Comprendre l'héritage du passé. Plusieurs siècles se sont écoulés depuis la guerre de la magie. Le monde s'est reconstruit et a donné naissance à la civilisation de l'acier, des machines et de la technologie.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy VI

Localization.Title: 70's Robot Anime : Geppy-X : The Super Boosted Armor (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Hommage aux animes des années 70 mettant en scène des robots géants, Geppy-X est quasi inconnu car il n'a jamais été localisé. Ce shoot'em up comprend un véritable scénario développé à travers de nombreuses scènes cinématiques reparties sur plusieurs CD.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy IX (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Corruption -- the root of all evil. Alexandria's Queen Brahne was once presented as a noble and caring ruler, who would throw lavish festivals to show appreciation for her supporters.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy IX (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Grâce à sa main mise sur un armement magique extrêmement puissant, la reine Branet d'Alexandrie terrorise les royaumes voisins. Sa fille, la princesse Grenat, décide de s'enfuir du château et devient l'arme d'un groupe de bandits au grand cœur.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy IX (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Zidane, ein Mitglied einer Räuberbande, muss an einem schönen Abend die Prinzessin entführen. Dummerweise schnappt ihr euch auch noch ihren Bodyguard mit.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy IX (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: La reina Brahne de Alexandria ha empezado a utilizar armas mágicas muy avanzadas para aterrorizar los reinos vecinos.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy IX (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Corruzione: la radice di tutti i mali. La regina Brahne di Alessandria una volta fu presentata come una sovrana nobile e premurosa, che organizzava feste sontuose per mostrare apprezzamento per i suoi sostenitori.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy IX (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Final Fantasy IX é um RPG. Nona parte da série, distingue-se dos seus predecessores por novos gráficos mais belos, cinemática de tirar o fôlego e um universo pitoresco.

Localization.Description: Macross was a very popular mecha show made in the 1980s. It is better known in the states as Robotech. Macross, do you remember love is based on the movie version of the show. It is a compressed version made in the 1990.

Localization.Title: Chou Jikuu Yousai Macross : Ai Oboete Imasu ka (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Qui ne connaît pas Macross, série d'animation incontournable créée par le studio Nue et Shoji Kawamori. Plus connue sous le nom de Robotech chez nous, Macross est en fait le nom d'un vaisseau spatial « Macross, super dimentionnal fortress » (SDF1)?..

Localization.Title: Taiyo no Otsuge
Localization.Description: Taiyou no Otsuge is a tarot game in which the player provide the data and the game make a tarot diagnosis about love, study, work, health, luck, etc. The game features also some mini games.

Localization.Description: Billiards offers several cue-sport variants in a 3D simulation. Players can face the computer or another player in games including 8-ball, 9-ball, rotation and 14.1 continuous.

Localization.Title: Star Wars: Episode I: The Phantom Menace
Localization.Description: There is a disturbance in the force, and the Jedi are there to find its source. There is a whole Armada of Battleships and troops besieging a planet and two Jedi knights come to protect the planet.

Localization.Title: Star Wars: Episode I: The Phantom Menace

Localization.Title: Star Wars: Episode I: The Phantom Menace

Localization.Title: Tomb Raider IV: The Last Revelation
Localization.Description: According to Egyptian legend, Horus, son of the light, outwitted the evil God Set and imprisoned him in a secret tomb.

Localization.Title: Tomb Raider IV : The Last Revelation
Localization.Description: "Il est l'ombre sur le soleil, le porteur des fléaux et sa colère, sans limites, consumera la terre." Une légende de l'ancienne Egypte raconte que Seth, le Dieu de la désolation, fut vaincu et emprisonné dans une tombe secrète.

Localization.Title: Tomb Raider IV: The Last Revelation
Localization.Description: Eine uralte Legende, ein böser Geist und eine Warnung an die Zukunft: Er ist der Schatten vor der Sonne, der Auslöser aller Seuchen, sein Zorn frißt das ganze Land, und sein Hunger wird unersättlich sein.

Localization.Title: Tomb Raider IV: The Last Revelation

Localization.Title: Tomb Raider IV: The Last Revelation
Localization.Description: Secondo la leggenda egizia, Horus, figlio della luce, sconfisse in astuzia il malvagio dio Set e lo imprigionò in una tomba segreta.

Localization.Title: Tomb Raider IV: The Last Revelation
Localization.Description: De acordo com a lenda egípcia, Hórus, filho da luz, enganou o malvado Deus Set e o aprisionou em uma tumba secreta.

Localization.Title: Bokujou Monogatari: Harvest Moon for Girl

Localization.Title: Syphon Filter

Localization.Title: Syphon Filter
Localization.Description: Syphon Filter é um jogo de ação e aventura no Playstation. O terrorista Eric Rhoemer decidiu erradicar os humanos espalhando no planeta um vírus mortal, o Syphon Filter. Apenas dois agentes antiterrorismo podem detê-lo: Gabe Logan e Lian Xing.

Localization.Title: Raamen-bashi
Localization.Description: Ramen is a Japanese noodle dish that originated in China. It is served in a meat- or fish-based broth, often flavored with soy sauce or miso, and uses toppings such as sliced pork, dried seaweed , kamaboko, green onions, and occasionally corn.

Localization.Title: R-Type Delta
Localization.Description: The Bydo Empire has returned to Earth with a vengeance. This time, they will not accept defeat so easily. Earth however, is ready for them... Three R-Class ships: the R-9, the R-13, and the prototype R-X, are your weapons in this war.

Localization.Description: The pachinko machines are japanese slot gambling machines used for amusement and prizes. Although pachinko machines were originally strictly mechanical, modern pachinko machines are a cross between a pinball machine and a video slot machine.

Localization.Title: Helix: Fear Effect (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: In the near future, mankind's tinkering with the science of genetics and the developmental process of genome mapping has resulted in the accidental creation of a new disease known as EINDS.

Localization.Title: Helix : Fear Effect (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Fear Effect 2 : Retro Helix est un jeu d'action/aventure sur Playstation. Amateurs d'ambiances glauques, de scènes sanglantes, ou de chair fraîche, ce titre vous propose de sauver le monde mis en danger par un virus.

Localization.Title: Helix: Fear Effect (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: „Fear Effect 2: Retro Helix“ spielt in einer nahen Zukunft, in der genetische Experimente und die Kartierung des Genoms versehentlich zur Entstehung einer tödlichen Krankheit namens EINDS geführt haben.

Localization.Title: Helix: Fear Effect (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Retro Helix: una épica aventura sobre el destino de la Humanidad. Profundiza en las pintorescas historias de los auténticos mercenarios y en las extraordinarias circunstancias que los reunieron en Fear Effect.

Localization.Title: Helix: Fear Effect (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Nel prossimo futuro, il lavoro dell'umanità con la scienza della genetica e il processo di sviluppo della mappatura del genoma ha portato alla creazione accidentale di una nuova malattia nota come EINDS.

Localization.Title: Helix: Fear Effect (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Fear Effect 2: Retro Helix é um jogo de ação / aventura no Playstation. Amantes de atmosferas glaucosas, cenas sangrentas ou carne fresca, este título oferece-lhe para salvar o mundo ameaçado por um vírus.

Localization.Title: Ridge Racer Revolution

Localization.Title: Ridge Racer Revolution
Localization.Description: ¡Todas las pistas y los coches son totalmente nuevos! Siente la velocidad vertiginosa y vive el realismo alucinante. Juega contra un amigo en el juego de carreras con mayor octanos de la historia.

Localization.Title: Ridge Racer Revolution
Localization.Description: Tutte le piste e le auto sono nuove di zecca! Senti la velocità vertiginosa e sperimenta un realismo strabiliante. Gioca contro un amico nel gioco di corse con il numero di ottani più alto di sempre.

Localization.Title: Ridge Racer Revolution

Localization.Title: Megami Ibunroku: Persona: Be Your True Mind

Localization.Title: Megami Ibunroku : Persona : Be Your True Mind

Localization.Title: Megami Ibunroku: Persona: Be Your True Mind

Localization.Title: Megami Ibunroku: Persona: Be Your True Mind

Localization.Title: Megami Ibunroku: Persona: Be Your True Mind

Localization.Title: Megami Ibunroku: Persona: Be Your True Mind

Localization.Title: SimCity 2000

Localization.Title: Vigilante 8
Localization.Description: Take the law into your own hands. This game takes place in the Western United States during a time of world-wide oil shortage in 1976. OMAR (Oil Monopoly Alliance Regime) was making money off the shortage, except in the U.S.

Localization.Title: Vigilante 8
Localization.Description: Vigilante 8 est un jeu d'action sur Playstation. Eh oui, vous allez retrouver vos plus bas instincts ! Au volant d'un véhicule des années 70, vous incarnez un membre de gang dont l'unique but est de réduire en poussière les véhicules des gangs rivaux.

Localization.Title: Vigilante 8
Localization.Description: Autokrieg auf den Straßen der USA. Schwingen sie sich ans Steuer von acht (plus vier Bonuswagen) bombastisch ausstaffierten Muscle Cars aus den 70ern. Acht Schauplätze die zerstört werden können.

Localization.Title: Vigilante 8
Localization.Description: Este juego nos sitúa en el oeste de los EE.UU. durante una época de escasez mundial de petróleo en 1976. OMAR (Oil Monopoly Alliance Regime) está haciendo dinero de la escasez de combustible, excepto en los EE.UU, que no dan su brazo a torcer.

Localization.Title: Vigilante 8
Localization.Description: Prendi la legge nelle tue mani. Questo gioco si svolge negli Stati Uniti occidentali durante un periodo di carenza mondiale di petrolio nel 1976.

Localization.Title: Vigilante 8

Localization.Title: Dokapon! Ikari no Tekken
Localization.Description: Dokapon is a game that lead you to the world of fantasy. The king dared to ask 3-4 people (the players) to subdue the enemy. If you can defeat them you will get a treasure such as money, village, or anything.

Localization.Title: Dokapon! Ikari no Tekken
Localization.Description: Dokapon est un jeu qui vous emmène dans le monde de la fantaisie. Le roi a osé demander à 3-4 personnes (les joueurs) de soumettre l'ennemi. Si vous parvenez à les vaincre, vous obtiendrez un trésor tel que de l'argent, un village ou autre.

Localization.Title: Rockman X3
Localization.Description: Mega Man X3 revolves around a Reploid scientist named Dr. Doppler. In the year 21XX, the threat of the Mavericks had been neutralized thanks to Doppler's technology, which prevented the Mavericks from going berserk.

Localization.Title: Rockman X3
Localization.Description: Après la défaite des Mavericks dans les épisodes précédents, les robots vivent en paix avec les humains. Mais les Mavericks d'origine reviennent à la charge et menacent l'équilibre.

Localization.Title: Rockman X3
Localization.Description: Der bekannteste Superheld der Roboter-Geschichte ist zurück - begleiten Sie ihn in dem dritten Teil der Capcom Action Serie! Machen Sie sichauf den Weg, um zusammen mit "Zero" Ihrem kraftvollen Begleiter, die vielen neuen Spieloptionen, Waffen und Gegner

Localization.Title: Rockman X3
Localization.Description: Mega Man X3 tiene lugar en un futuro ficticio en el que el mundo está poblado por humanos y robots inteligentes llamados "Reploids".

Localization.Title: Rockman X3
Localization.Description: Uno scienziato Reploid di nome Dr. Doppler inizia la creazione di una nuova città per Reploid, che porterà una nuova era di pace per i Reploidi e gli umani.

Localization.Title: Rockman X3
Localization.Description: Após a derrota dos Mavericks em episódios anteriores, os robôs vivem em paz com os humanos. Mas os Mavericks originais voltam e ameaçam o equilíbrio. Mega Man e Zero são chamados para a frente do palco para combater o novo ataque.

Localization.Title: Momotarou Dentetsu 7
Localization.Description: The Momotarou Densetsu games are based on a fairy tale that is about a boy that is born from a peach and is raised by an old couple. The game series begun in NES, X68000 and PC Engine with versions in SNES and Playstation.

Localization.Title: Puyo Puyo Tsuu: Ketteiban
Localization.Description: This sequel to Puyo Puyo is, like its predecessor, a game of falling blocks, in which the aim is to combine four or more blocks (Puyos) of the same colour, which then disappear.

Localization.Title: Puyo Puyo Tsuu : Ketteiban
Localization.Description: Cette suite de Puyo Puyo est comme son prédécesseur un jeu de blocs tombants, dans lequel le but est de combiner quatre blocs (Puyos) ou plus de la même couleur, qui disparaissent ensuite.

Localization.Title: Puyo Puyo Tsuu: Ketteiban
Localization.Description: Diese Fortsetzung von Puyo Puyo ist wie sein Vorgänger ein Fallblockspiel, bei dem das Ziel darin besteht, vier oder mehr Blöcke (Puyos) derselben Farbe zu kombinieren, die dann verschwinden.

Localization.Title: Puyo Puyo Tsuu: Ketteiban
Localization.Description: Esta secuela de Puyo Puyo es, como su predecesor, un juego de bloques que caen, en el que el objetivo es combinar cuatro o más bloques (Puyos) del mismo color, que luego desaparecen.

Localization.Title: Puyo Puyo Tsuu: Ketteiban
Localization.Description: Questo sequel di Puyo Puyo è, come il suo predecessore, un gioco di blocchi che cadono, in cui lo scopo è combinare quattro o più blocchi (Puyo) dello stesso colore, che poi scompaiono.

Localization.Title: Puyo Puyo Tsuu: Ketteiban
Localization.Description: Esta sequela do Puyo Puyo é, tal como o seu antecessor, um jogo de blocos em queda, em que o objetivo é combinar quatro ou mais blocos (Puyos) da mesma cor, que depois desaparecem.

Localization.Title: Monster Farm 2
Localization.Description: Monster Rancher 2 is at heart an arena fighting game with a lot of ancillary game play thrown in. As a trainer of a fighting monster you have to train, reward, punish, cajole and bribe your minion to build up its statistics.

Localization.Title: Monster Farm 2
Localization.Description: Monster Rancher 2 est au fond un jeu de combat d'arène avec beaucoup de jeux auxiliaires.

Localization.Title: Monster Farm 2
Localization.Description: Monster Rancher 2 ist im Grunde ein Arena-Kampfspiel mit viel Zusatzspiel. Als Trainer eines kämpfenden Monsters musst du sie trainieren, belohnen, bestrafen, beschwören und bestechen, um seine Statistiken aufzubauen.

Localization.Title: Monster Farm 2
Localization.Description: Monster Rancher 2 es, en esencia, un juego de lucha en una arena con un montón de elementos de juego adicionales.

Localization.Title: Tekken 3
Localization.Description: An ancient evil force has reawakened, attacking in secret and feeding on the souls of mighty warriors. To lure it out of hiding will take the greatest fighting contest the world has ever seen... Tekken 3.

Localization.Title: Tekken 3
Localization.Description: Fin du King of Iron Fist Tournament 2. Heihachi a vaincu Kazuya et reprend la tête de Mishima Zaibatsu. Un jour, il entend parler d'un ancien dieu mexicain, Ogre, qui serait attiré par les âmes fortes.

Localization.Title: Tekken 3
Localization.Description: Eine uralte böse Macht ist erwacht, die heimlich angreift und sich von den Seelen mächtiger Kriegern ernährt. Um Sie aus dem Versteck zu locken, wird es das größte Kampfturnier geben, das die Welt je gesehen hat ... Tekken 3.

Localization.Title: Tekken 3
Localization.Description: Una vez más, el destino une a todos aquellos dispuestos a escuchar la llamada... Una nueva generación de guerreros. Gráficos alucinantes de alta resolución. Modalidades Tekken Force y Tekken Ball completamente nuevas.

Localization.Title: Tekken 3
Localization.Description: Fine del Torneo del Pugno del Re di Ferro 2. Heihachi ha sconfitto Kazuya ed è tornato in vantaggio per Mishima Zaibatsu. Un giorno, sente parlare di un antico dio messicano, Ogre, che si dice sia attratto da anime forti.

Localization.Title: Tekken 3
Localization.Description: Lute por Sua Vida! A força ancestral do mal acordou, atacando em segredo e se alimentando das almas de bravos heróis. Para ser libertada, participará do maior torneio de luta que o mundo já viu... Tekken 3. Alguns lutam por vingança, outros por honra.

Localization.Title: Tron ni Kobun
Localization.Description: Rather than focusing on the heroic protagonists of Mega Man Legends series, the game follows series anti-hero Tron Bonne, sister of the criminal Bonne family of air pirates.

Localization.Title: Tron ni Kobun
Localization.Description: The Misadventures of Tron Bonne est un jeu d'action qui fait partie de la série Mega Man Legends mais qui se situe chronologiquement en amont de tous les autres épisodes.

Localization.Title: Tron ni Kobun
Localization.Description: „The Misadventures of Tron Bonne“ ist ein Actionspiel, das Teil der Mega Man Legends-Reihe ist, aber chronologisch allen anderen Episoden vorgelagert ist.

Localization.Title: Tron ni Kobun
Localization.Description: En lugar de centrarse en los heroicos protagonistas de la serie Mega Man Legends, el juego sigue a la serie antihéroe Tron Bonne, hermana de la familia criminal de piratas aéreos Bonne.

Localization.Title: Tomb Raider 2
Localization.Description: The story of Tomb Raider II surrounds the mythical Dagger of Xian, a weapon which was used by an Emperor of China to command his army. By plunging the weapon into its owner's heart, the weapon has the power to turn its bearer into a dragon.

Localization.Title: Tomb Raider 2
Localization.Description: Lara Croft est de retour. Elle part à la découverte du secret de la Dague de Xian. D'après une mystérieuse légende, celui qui découvrira cette dague mythique gagnera le pouvoir du dragon... à condition qu'il ait le courage de la plonger dans son cœur.

Localization.Title: Tomb Raider 2
Localization.Description: Lara Croft ist zurück! In ihrem neuesten Abenteuer begibt sich die Archäologin auf die Spur des Dolches von Xian. Wer diese mystische Waffe entdeckt, bekommt einem alten chinesischen Glauben zufolge eine unvorstellbare Macht verliehen...

Localization.Title: Tomb Raider 2
Localization.Description: Lara croft regresa en Tomb Raider II para descubrir los secretos de la Daga de Xian.

Localization.Title: Tomb Raider 2

Localization.Title: Tomb Raider 2
Localization.Description: Tomb Raider II, estrelado por Lara Croft é um jogo de ação / aventura no Playstation. A bela Lara Croft está de volta. Ao seu lado você está fora para descobrir o segredo da Adaga de Xian.

Localization.Description: After losing his memory, Fei Fong Wong found himself in the small town of Lahan. Because he couldn't remember who he really was or where he came from, he decided to stay there and teach martial arts and paint -- one of his personal hobbies.

Localization.Title: Xenogears (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Xenogears est un jeu de rôle sur Playstation. Un des points forts du jeu est le double système de combat qu'il présente.

Localization.Title: Xenogears (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Eine geheimnisvolle Organisation wendet das Blatt eines jahrhundertelangen Krieges mit uralter Technologie - riesigen Kampfrobotern.

Localization.Title: Xenogears (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Xenogears posee unos de los argumentos mas cuidados, adultos y complejos jamas escritos para un videojuego.

Localization.Title: Xenogears (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Dopo aver perso la memoria, Fei Fong Wong si ritrovò nella piccola città di Lahan. Poiché non riusciva a ricordare chi fosse veramente o da dove venisse, decise di rimanere lì e insegnare arti marziali e pittura, uno dei suoi hobby personali.

Localization.Title: Xenogears (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Uma organização misteriosa está mudando o rumo de uma guerra que dura séculos com o uso de tecnologia antiga - robôs de combate gigantes conhecidos como Gears.

Localization.Title: Chocobo Racing: Genkai e no Road
Localization.Description: Based on one of Squaresoft's most famous Final Fantasy characters, the chicken-like Chocobo, Chocobo Racing marks a departure from the company's trademark role-playing titles.

Localization.Title: Chocobo Racing : Genkai e no Road
Localization.Description: Chocobo Racing est un jeu de courses sorti sur Playstation. Les mignons petits Chocobos de la série des Final Fantasy se livrent à des courses déjantées.

Localization.Title: Chocobo Racing: Genkai e no Road
Localization.Description: Chocobo Racing ist ein Rennspiel basierend auf dem Hühnervogel, der bei Final Fantasy VII eine wichtige Rolle spielt. Um herauszufinden, wer der König der Rennstrecke ist, fahren sie gegen fantastische Monster und niedliche Tierchen.

Localization.Description: Chocobo Racing es un videojuego del género de carreras para la videoconsola PlayStation, creado por la compañía de software japonesa Squaresoft, creadores de la aclamada saga Final Fantasy, lanzado en 1999 La forma del juego es similar a la impuesta por

Localization.Title: Chocobo Racing: Genkai e no Road

Localization.Description: Behind the scenes in Isaac City, two corporations are embroiled in a vicious fight for control and supremacy over the general populace.

Localization.Description: Dans les coulisses d'Isaac City, deux sociétés sont impliquées dans une lutte acharnée pour le contrôle et la suprématie de la population en général.

Localization.Title: Chrono Trigger
Localization.Description: What begins as a carefree day at the Millennial Fair for a young man named Crono turns into a huge adventure.

Localization.Title: Chrono Trigger
Localization.Description: Une journée insouciante à la Foire du Millénaire va se transformer en quête épique pour le jeune Crono.

Localization.Title: Chrono Trigger
Localization.Description: Chrono Trigger ist ein Vertreter der Konsolen-Rollenspiele. Der Spieler steuert die Protagonisten in einer zweidimensional dargestellten fiktiven Welt, welche aus Wäldern, Städten und Dungeons besteht.

Localization.Title: Chrono Trigger
Localization.Description: El milenio. Un portal está abierto. La cadena del tiempo esta rota. Un joven es transportado al pasado, alterando el curso de la historia y el resultado del futuro.

Localization.Title: Chrono Trigger
Localization.Description: Quella che inizia come una giornata spensierata alla Millennial Fair per un giovane di nome Crono si trasforma nella sua ultima avventura.

Localization.Title: Chrono Trigger
Localization.Description: Um dia despreocupado na Feira do Milénio irá transformar-se numa busca épica pelo jovem Crono.

Localization.Title: Front Mission 3
Localization.Description: Front Mission 3 is the third main entry and the fifth entry overall in the Front Mission series.

Localization.Title: Front Mission 3
Localization.Description: Dans Front Mission 3 sur Playstation vous incarnez un fougueux pilote Kazuki Takemura qui va se retrouver à son insu dans une guerre cruelle.

Localization.Title: Front Mission 3
Localization.Description: Wir befinden uns im Jahr 2112. Das Jahr, in dem die Volksrepublik "Da Han Zhong" (DHZ) gegründet wurde. Eines Tages, während einer Waffenlieferung an den Stützpunkt Yokosuka, werden Kazuki und sein Freund Ryogo Kusama Zeugen einer Explosion.

Localization.Title: Front Mission 3
Localization.Description: Estamos en el siglo XII. El mundo cada vez está más unificado y se prepara para vivir una compleja conspiración global, coge tu Wanzer y adéntrate en la mejor entrega de la conocida saga de rol táctico de Squaresoft.

Localization.Title: Front Mission 3
Localization.Description: In Front Mission 3 per PlayStation vesti i panni del focoso pilota Kazuki Takemura che si ritroverà inconsapevolmente in una guerra crudele.

Localization.Title: Front Mission 3
Localization.Description: Front Mission 3 is the third main entry and the fifth entry overall in the Front Mission series.

Localization.Title: Ehrgeiz: God Bless the Ring
Localization.Description: An ancient weapon of unknown origin was found in a German castle some fifty years ago. Since it was obviously something of value, it was decided that it would be awarded to the best fighter in the world.

Localization.Title: Ehrgeiz : God Bless the Ring
Localization.Description: Ehrgeiz est un jeu de combat en arène sur Playstation. Il y a 50 ans, la découverte de l'épée Ehrgeiz entraîna la mise en place d'un tournoi pour s'en emparer.

Localization.Title: Ehrgeiz: God Bless the Ring
Localization.Description: Kämpfe um die ultimative Trophäe – Ehrgeiz, eine Waffe, die das Geheimnis der Unsterblichkeit enthält. Mit Charakteren aus Final Fantasy VII treten Sie in mehrstufigen Kampfarenen an, wobei Sie Waffen und gefährliche Nahkampftechniken einsetzen.

Localization.Title: Ehrgeiz: God Bless the Ring
Localization.Description: En esta versión, Cloud, Tifa, Yuffie, Vincent, Zack, Red XIII y Sephiroth de Final Fantasy VII se unen a los numerosos personajes de la versión arcade lanzada en Japón.

Localization.Title: Ehrgeiz: God Bless the Ring
Localization.Description: Un'antica arma di origine sconosciuta è stata ritrovata in un castello tedesco una cinquantina di anni fa. Poiché era ovviamente qualcosa di valore, è stato deciso che sarebbe stato assegnato al miglior combattente del mondo.

Localization.Title: Ehrgeiz: God Bless the Ring
Localization.Description: Uma arma antiga de origem desconhecida foi encontrada em um castelo alemão há cerca de cinquenta anos. Como era obviamente algo de valor, foi decidido que seria concedido ao melhor lutador do mundo.

Localization.Title: The Bombing Islands
Localization.Description: Clown World is in trouble. Mysterious blue bombs have appeared all over the planet, and King Clown needs help. In a royal decree, the king beckons for Kid Clown, a hero of past Kemco games, to clean up these bombs in all six continents.

Localization.Title: The Bombing Islands
Localization.Description: Clown World a des ennuis. De mystérieuses bombes bleues sont apparues partout sur la planète, et le roi Clown a besoin d'aide. Dans un décret royal, le roi invite Kid Clown, un héros des jeux Kemco passés, à nettoyer ces bombes sur les six continents.

Localization.Title: The Bombing Islands

Localization.Title: Soul Edge
Localization.Description: In the 16th century, a sword surfaces that is so powerful, so evil that warriors from all over the globe seek it out. It is Soul Edge, a demon blade. From America to Europe to Japan, these warriors fight each other for the chance to obtain it.

Localization.Title: Soul Edge
Localization.Description: Soul Blade sur Playstation est un jeu de combat en 3D dans lequel chaque combattant utilise une arme différente.

Localization.Title: Soul Edge
Localization.Description: Namco, Schöpfer der Tekken-Serie, präsentiert die fortschrittlichste Waffen-Kampfsimulation aller Zeiten! Wilde Schwertkämpfe mit Teilnehmern aus der ganzen Welt – ein episches Spiel exklusiv für die PlayStation!

Localization.Title: Soul Edge
Localization.Description: La historia se centra en la mítica espada maldita Soul Edge, que promete un gran poder a quien la blanda, pero que también domina las mentes de sus portadores y se alimenta de las almas de sus vencidos.

Localization.Title: Soul Edge
Localization.Description: Nel XVI secolo emerge una spada così potente, così malvagia che i guerrieri di tutto il mondo la cercano. È Soul Edge, una lama demoniaca. Dall'America all'Europa al Giappone, questi guerrieri si combattono per avere la possibilità di ottenerlo.

Localization.Title: Soul Edge
Localization.Description: No século 16, uma espada surge tão poderosa, tão má que os guerreiros de todo o mundo a procuram. É Soul Edge, uma lâmina demoníaca. Da América à Europa e ao Japão, esses guerreiros lutam entre si pela chance de obtê-lo.

Localization.Title: DewPrism
Localization.Description: Threads of Fate combines the gameplay of a real-time 3d adventure with an RPG typical character-system. The game provides two different main characters and two different storylines.

Localization.Title: DewPrism
Localization.Description: Disponible sur Playstation, Threads of Fate est un jeu de rôle et d'action qui vous invite à vivre deux grandes quêtes à travers une seule aventure. Que ce soit avec Mint ou Rue, vous êtes à la quête d'une ancienne relique.

Localization.Title: DewPrism
Localization.Description: Threads of Fate ist auf der Playstation erhältlich und ein Action-Rollenspiel, das Sie dazu einlädt, zwei großartige Quests in einem einzigen Abenteuer zu erleben. Ob Mint oder Rue, Sie sind auf der Suche nach einem antiken Relikt.

Localization.Title: DewPrism
Localization.Description: Threads of Fate combina la jugabilidad de una aventura en 3D en tiempo real con un sistema de personajes típico de los juegos de rol. El juego ofrece dos personajes principales diferentes y dos historias diferentes.

Localization.Description: L'UNION SACRÉE... - Incarnez Ashley Riot, agent au service des forces royales et tentez de lever le voile sur les terribles secrets que recèlent la cité maudite de Léa Mundis.

Localization.Title: Vagrant Story
Localization.Description: Als Ashley Lionet, Agent der Spezialeinheit "Riskbreaker", ist es Ihre Aufgabe die Stadt der Schatten, Le Monde, zu infiltrieren.

Localization.Title: Vagrant Story
Localization.Description: Como el agente especial Ashley Riot, tu misión es infiltrartte en la ciudad de la maldad, Leá monde.

Localization.Description: Reel Fishing is designed to create a realistic angling experience in the comfort of the gamer's living room. Strategy comes in choosing the right lure for the circumstance and it takes skill to hook the big ones and reel them in successfully.

Localization.Description: The story of Twilight Syndrome: Saikai focuses on four Japanese teenagers: Yuri, her sister Masa, and their friends Atsushi and Aya. It all begins when the youngsters hear rumors about spirits contained in the school building.

Localization.Description: V-Rally 2 is a game based on the world of rally racing. Here precision-driving skill is most important. In each car there are two people, a driver and a navigator. There are 84 races to compete in with tracks all across the world.

Localization.Title: V-Rally : Championship Edition 2
Localization.Description: V-Rally 2 Expert Edition sur Playstation est un jeu de courses proposant 16 voitures officielles du Championnat du Monde des rallyes et 10 voitures bonus à débloquer, jouables sur plus de 80 spéciales réparties dans 12 pays différents.

Localization.Title: V-Rally: Championship Edition 2
Localization.Description: V-Rally 2 ist ein Spiel, das auf der Welt des Rallye-Rennsports basiert. Hier kommt es auf präzises Fahrkönnen an. In jedem Auto sitzen zwei Personen, ein Fahrer und ein Navigator. Es gibt 84 Rennen auf Strecken auf der ganzen Welt.

Localization.Title: V-Rally: Championship Edition 2
Localization.Description: V-Rally 2 es un juego basado en el mundo de las carreras de rally. Aquí la habilidad de conducción precisa es lo más importante. En cada coche hay dos personas, un conductor y un navegador. Hay 84 carreras para competir en pistas de todo el mundo.

Localization.Title: V-Rally: Championship Edition 2
Localization.Description: V-Rally 2 è un gioco basato sul mondo delle corse di rally. Qui l'abilità di guida di precisione è più importante. In ogni macchina ci sono due persone, un autista e un navigatore. Ci sono 84 gare in cui competere con piste in tutto il mondo.

Localization.Title: V-Rally: Championship Edition 2

Localization.Title: Darkstalkers: The Night Warriors
