Localization.Description: Darkstalkers: The Night Warriors, llamado Vampire: The Night Warriors originalmente en Japón, es el primer videojuego en la saga Darkstalkers. Cuenta con diez personajes disponibles y dos personajes jefes no disponibles.

Localization.Title: Descent
Localization.Description: The Post-Terran Minerals Corporation (PTMC) digs up minerals on all nine planets of the solar system, employing humans and robots to do its job.

Localization.Title: Gex
Localization.Description: Gex is a wise cracking gecko with one passion in life: to watch television. One night as he was feeding his addiction, the television went blank and a large hand grabbed the gecko, sucking him into the Media Dimension.

Localization.Title: Soviet Strike
Localization.Description: In 1991, the U.S.S.R. (Union of Soviet Socialist Republics) boasting the largest military force in history, suddenly and unexpectedly collapsed. Since that time the fallen empire has lain lifeless -- a rich corpse waiting to be picked clean.

Localization.Description: Retour de la légende. Réveillé de son sommeil éternel par la réapparition de Castlevania, Alucard doit une fois de plus affronter les laquais malfaisants du Prince des ténèbres.

Localization.Title: Castlevania: Symphony of the Night
Localization.Description: Die Legende kehrt zurück Alucard wird durch das Wiedererscheinen von Castlevania aus seinem ewigen Schlummer erweckt und muss wieder einmal gegen die Knechte der Finsternis antreten.

Localization.Title: Castlevania: Symphony of the Night
Localization.Description: Vuelve la leyenda. Despertando de su eterno reposo por la aparición de Castlevania, Alucard debe enfrentarse de nuevo a las malvadas criaturas de la noche.

Localization.Title: Castlevania: Symphony of the Night
Localization.Description: Come discendente di Dracula, devi porre fine alla stirpe dei vampiri. Riuscirai a liberare il mondo da questo indicibile terrore? Scopri il mistero di Castlevania e sfida un'avventura leggendaria come il suo nome.

Localization.Title: Castlevania: Symphony of the Night
Localization.Description: Quatro anos após a batalha entre Richter Belmont e Dracula, a escuridão reaparece. O fantasma do sacerdote das trevas Shaft, morto por Richter uma vez, ressurge com um novo plano de ressuscitar seu mestre.

Localization.Title: Doom
Localization.Description: All Hell's Breaking Loose! This is it! The gaming addiction that's been played by an estimated 10 million fanatics on the PC. And now it's out in a sweat-soaked, pulse-pounding, adrenaline-wrenching version for the PlayStation game console. It's DOOM.

Localization.Title: Doom

Localization.Title: Doom
Localization.Description: Von der Union Aerospace Corporation (UAC) durchgeführte Teleportationsexperimente auf den beiden Marsmonden Phobos und Deimos öffnen ungewollt ein Portal zur Hölle.

Localization.Title: Doom
Localization.Description: Doom es un videojuego de acción en primera persona creado por iD Software en 1993 por un grupo dirigido por John Carmack. Deberás controlar a un marine, que se encuentra de rutina en una estación en Fobos, una de las lunas de Marte.

Localization.Title: Doom

Localization.Title: Doom
Localization.Description: Todo o inferno está se soltando! É isso! O vício em jogos jogado por cerca de 10 milhões de fanáticos no PC. E agora está disponível numa versão suada, pulsante e cheia de adrenalina para a consola de jogos PlayStation. É DOOM.

Localization.Title: Pitball
Localization.Description: Set in the 23rd century, Pitball is the only sport left in existence. There are no rules in this violent battle -- your objective is simply to score as many goals as possible while destroying the other team.

Localization.Title: Wayne Gretzky's 3D Hockey '98
Localization.Description: Wayne Gretzky's 3D Hockey '98 sur PS1, propose deux modes jeu jeu : Arcade ou Simulation. La simulation est plus réaliste tandis que le mode arcade ne compte aucune pénalité. Choisissez une des 26 équipes dispos et chaussez vos patins.

Localization.Title: Wayne Gretzky's 3D Hockey '98
Localization.Description: Wayne Gretzkys 3D Hockey '98 für PS1 bietet zwei Spielmodi: Arcade oder Simulation. Die Simulation ist sehr realistisch, da der Arcade-Modus nicht mit Strafen einhergeht. Wählen Sie eines von 26 verfügbaren Geräten und Schuhen für Ihre Füße.

Localization.Title: Wayne Gretzky's 3D Hockey '98
Localization.Description: Wayne Gretzky's 3D Hockey '98 para PS1 ofrece dos modos de juego: Arcade y Simulación. El modo Simulación es más realista, mientras que el modo Arcade no tiene penalizaciones. Elige uno de los 26 equipos disponibles y ponte los patines.

Localization.Description: Created by Jack Kirby and Stan Lee for Marvel Comics in 1962, The Incredible Hulk has appeared in hundreds of comic books, a television series, a cartoon series, and a handful of made-for-television movies.

Localization.Description: Créé par Jack Kirby et Stan Lee pour Marvel Comics en 1962, The Incredible Hulk est apparu dans des centaines de bandes dessinées, une série télévisée, une série de dessins animés et quelques téléfilms.

Localization.Title: The Incredible Hulk: The Pantheon Saga
Localization.Description: Der unglaubliche Hulk wurde 1962 von Jack Kirby und Stan Lee für Marvel Comics kreiert und erschien in Hunderten von Comics, einer Fernsehserie, einer Zeichentrickserie und einigen Fernsehfilmen.

Localization.Title: Swagman
Localization.Description: That Swagman sure has a lot of nerve! He's another evil, demented fellow who's planning to take over the world for his own personal gain. And this guy means business.

Localization.Title: Swagman
Localization.Description: Disponible sur Playstation, Swagman est un jeu d'aventure dans lequel vous contrôlez Zac, un jeune garçon prisonnier de son cauchemar par la faute du Swagman.

Localization.Title: Swagman
Localization.Description: Swagman ist auf der Playstation erhältlich und ein Abenteuerspiel, in dem Sie Zac steuern, einen kleinen Jungen, der durch Swagmans Schuld in seinem Albtraum gefangen ist.

Localization.Title: Swagman
Localization.Description: Swagman es un juego de aventuras en el que controlas a Zac, un niño atrapado en su pesadilla por culpa de Swagman. De hecho, este último ha capturado a todas las hadas de Dreamlight y planea invadir el mundo con criaturas malvadas a su lado.

Localization.Title: Tomb Raider
Localization.Description: In Tomb Raider, you assume the role of a beautiful archaeologist, Lara Croft. She is a thrill seeker and is willing to do almost anything that puts her life in danger -- she enjoys it.

Localization.Title: Tomb Raider
Localization.Description: L'aventurière Lara Croft vient d'être engagée par un puissant syndicat pour retrouver les fragments d'une ancienne relique connue sous le nom du Scion.

Localization.Title: Tomb Raider
Localization.Description: Auf der Suche nach einem geheimnisvollen Artefakt führen Sie die Abenteurerin Lara Croft durch die vielleicht faszinierendsten 3D-Welten, die es je auf Ihrem Bildschirm zu sehen gab.

Localization.Title: Tomb Raider
Localization.Description: Tomb Raider es un videojuego de aventura de acción y plataformas, uno de los primeros en 3D aparecidos para la generación de 32 bits, desarrollado por Core Design y distribuido por Eidos Interactive.

Localization.Title: Tomb Raider
Localization.Description: L'avventuriera Lara Croft è stata appena assunta da un potente sindacato per recuperare frammenti di un'antica reliquia nota come Scion.

Localization.Title: Tomb Raider
Localization.Description: A aventureira Lara Croft acaba de ser contratada por um poderoso sindicato para recuperar fragmentos de uma antiga relíquia conhecida como o Scion.

Localization.Description: You are Kid, the key member of the investigative AMC army, leading five of your comrades in the armored Space Griffon VF9. It is up to you to discover what has happened to the moon?s largest structure...Hamlet.

Localization.Title: Space Griffon VF-9
Localization.Description: Space Griffon VF-9 est un jeu de tir à la première personne mâtiné de jeu de rôle. La Terre a perdu le contact avec une colonie établie sur la Lune. Celle-ci a probablement été envahie par des aliens.

Localization.Title: Space Griffon VF-9
Localization.Description: Space Griffon VF-9 ist ein Ego-Shooter gemischt mit Rollenspiel. Die Erde hat den Kontakt zu einer auf dem Mond gegründeten Kolonie verloren. Es wurde wahrscheinlich von Außerirdischen überfallen.

Localization.Title: Olympic Soccer
Localization.Description: Welcome to The 1996 Atlanta Olympic Games, where you'll suit up against the world's top international teams in an attempt to grab a hold of the gold. The crowd roars as your team hits the field and all eyes turn towards you as you drive towards the goal.

Localization.Title: Olympic Soccer
Localization.Description: Bienvenue aux Jeux olympiques de 1996 à Atlanta, où vous affronterez les meilleures équipes internationales pour tenter de décrocher l'or.

Localization.Title: Olympic Soccer
Localization.Description: Willkommen bei den Olympischen Spielen 1996 in Atlanta, wo Sie gegen die besten internationalen Teams der Welt antreten und versuchen, Gold zu ergattern.

Localization.Title: Olympic Soccer
Localization.Description: Puede elegir uno de los 33 equipos y participar en partidos de exhibición, arcade (una copa de 32 equipos), Olímpico (el torneo de 16 equipos simulando el torneo real) o jugar en una liga de todos-contra-todos (a partir de 3 a 16 equipos).

Localization.Title: Olympic Soccer

Localization.Description: Hi-Octane est un jeu de course futuriste en 3D qui met en scène six voitures volantes uniques. Comme dans de nombreux jeux de course, chaque véhicule varie en termes de vitesse, de puissance d'attaque et de maniabilité.

Localization.Title: Casper
Localization.Description: Basierend auf dem Casper-Film trittst du in der Rolle des freundlichen Geistes auf, der versucht, einen Freund und eine zweite Chance im Leben zu finden, anstatt alle zu verscheuchen.

Localization.Title: Casper

Localization.Title: Area 51
Localization.Description: This is the home port of the popular arcade light gun game. This home version has special bonuses and additional secret levels not found in the arcade.

Localization.Title: Area 51
Localization.Description: Area 51 est l'adaptation sur Playstation de la borne d'arcade du même nom. Armé de votre manette, vous devez explorer les couloirs de la zone 51 et la débarrasser de ses occupants venus de l'espace.

Localization.Title: Area 51
Localization.Description: In Area 51 wurden durch einen Virenausbruch alle für die Forschung benötigten Einrichtungen lahm gelegt. Die U.S. Army hat infolgedessen ein Signal von der Anlage erhalten, das den Verdacht begründet sich berechtigte Sorgen zu machen.

Localization.Title: Area 51
Localization.Description: Esta es la versión doméstica del popular juego de pistola de luz de las máquinas recreativas. Esta versión doméstica tiene bonificaciones especiales y niveles secretos adicionales que no se encuentran en la recreativa.

Localization.Description: In Psychic Detective you take the role of Eric Fox, a psychic detective who can transmit his psychic self to others, to see through their eyes and hear through their ears. That way you can find out things about the case you couldn't otherwise.

Localization.Title: Psychic Detective (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Eric Fox est un médium qui vit à San Francisco et gagne sa vie en faisant des spectacles de magie dans des boîtes de nuit miteuses. Cela change quand Eric rencontre Laina, une femme mystérieuse qui l'entraîne à s'aventurer dans l'esprit des autres.

Localization.Title: Resident Evil
Localization.Description: After receiving a distress call from the Bravo Team, an elite group from S.T.A.R.S (Special Tactics And Rescue Squad) flew into the desolate Raccoon City.

Localization.Title: Resident Evil
Localization.Description: Maîtrisez votre peur... et lancez vous dans l'expérience la plus terrifiante de votre vie. Zombies assoiffés de sang. Animaux mutants. Serpents monstrueux. De dangereux mystères vous menacent à chaque tournant.

Localization.Title: Resident Evil
Localization.Description: Umbrella Corporation, ein geheimnisumwobener Pharmakonzern in der Nähe der Kleinstadt Raccoon City.

Localization.Title: Resident Evil
Localization.Description: Enfréntate a tus miedos... En la experiencia de suspense y terror definitiva. Zombies sedientos de sangre. Bestias mutantes. Serpientes monstruosas. Misterios ocultos acechan en cada esquina. La pesadilla reside en este premiado juego de survival horror.

Localization.Title: Resident Evil
Localization.Description: Dopo aver ricevuto una chiamata di soccorso dal Bravo Team, un gruppo d'élite di S.T.A.R.S (Special Tactics And Rescue Squad) è volato nella desolata Raccoon City.

Localization.Title: Resident Evil
Localization.Description: Resident Evil: Director's Cut é um horror de sobrevivência no Playstation. Esta é uma versão sem censura do Resident Evil 1. Comparado com o último, o aplicativo é diferenciado por novas cenas, novos ângulos de visão, cenas adicionais e novos trajes.

Localization.Title: In the Hunt
Localization.Description: The Dark Anarchy Society is taking over the world, destroying Earth's biggest cities in the process. As captain of an attack sub, you must seek and destroy the D.A.S.

Localization.Title: In the Hunt
Localization.Description: In the Hunt (ou Kaitei Daisensou en japonais) est un shoot'em up 2D à défilement horizontal sur Playstation. La société Sombre Anarchie menace de détruire les plus importantes villes du globe. La noble tâche de sauver tout ce beau monde vous incombe.

Localization.Title: In the Hunt
Localization.Description: Die Dark Anarchy Society übernimmt die Welt und zerstört dabei die größten Städte der Erde. Als Kapitän eines Angriffs-U-Boots müssen Sie das Unterwasserhauptquartier der D.A.S.

Localization.Title: In the Hunt
Localization.Description: In the Hunt (Kaitei Daisensou en japonés) es un shoot'em up de desplazamiento lateral en 2D para PlayStation. La sociedad Dark Anarchy amenaza con destruir las ciudades más importantes del globo.

Localization.Title: In the Hunt

Localization.Title: D (Disc 2)
Localization.Description: The story begins in 1997. It's the dead of night in the city of Los Angeles, and there has been a mass murder at a general hospital on the outskirts of downtown. The perpetrator is the director of the hospital, Richter Harris.

Localization.Title: Fox Hunt (Disc 2)
Localization.Description: Jack Fremont was planning to enjoy his day doing the things he loved -- reading comics, ignoring the eviction notices, and heading down to the bar to play '70s television trivia. That was until CIA agents kidnapped him.

Localization.Title: Fox Hunt (Disc 2)
Localization.Description: Jack Fremont est un homme ordinaire avec un seul talent unique : sa connaissance des émissions de télévision. Autrement, sa vie ne va pas très bien et il est sur le point d'être expulsé de chez lui.

Localization.Title: Fox Hunt (Disc 2)
Localization.Description: Jack Fremont wollte seinen Tag mit den Dingen genießen, die er liebte – Comics lesen, die Räumungsbescheide ignorieren und in die Bar gehen, um 70er-Jahre-Quiz im Fernsehen zu spielen. Bis ihn CIA-Agenten entführten.

Localization.Title: Jupiter Strike
Localization.Description: Jupiter Strike is a 3D shooter where you control a ship flying through space and have to battle multiple waves of aliens, asteroids, fly across planets, inside space stations and battle huge enemy bosses.

Localization.Title: Jupiter Strike
Localization.Description: Invasion terrestre ! Invasion terrestre ! L'anéantissement est imminent ! Déployez Jupiter Strike ! Transmission finale.... La survie de la race humaine ne dépend que de vous.

Localization.Title: Jupiter Strike
Localization.Description: Jupiter Strike ist ein 3D-Shooter, in dem Sie ein durch den Weltraum fliegendes Schiff steuern und gegen mehrere Wellen von Außerirdischen und Asteroiden kämpfen, über Planeten fliegen, in Raumstationen fliegen und gegen riesige feindliche Bosse kämpfen

Localization.Title: Zero Divide
Localization.Description: In Zero Divide, you play as a computer caretaker who must fight off members from the group XTAL and crash the system before the time runs out and critical information is leaked to the world.

Localization.Title: Zero Divide
Localization.Description: Zero Divide sur Playstation met en scène des combats de robots, le tout en 3D. Le jeu comprend un mode multijoueur pour affronter un ami. Et en bonus, on peut même débloquer un jeu de tir à défilement horizontal !

Localization.Title: Zero Divide
Localization.Description: Zero Divide auf der Playstation bietet Roboterkämpfe, alles in 3D. Das Spiel beinhaltet einen Mehrspielermodus, um gegen einen Freund anzutreten. Und als Bonus können Sie sogar einen Side-Scrolling-Shooter freischalten!

Localization.Title: Zero Divide
Localization.Description: En un fatídico día en un futuro próximo, una base de datos en línea conocida como XTAL Tower ha salido a la superficie. Los hackers afirmaron que la base de datos contenía los secretos de seguridad nacional de todos los países del mundo.

Localization.Title: Zero Divide
Localization.Description: In Zero Divide, vesti i panni di un amministratore di sistema che deve combattere i membri del gruppo XTAL e mandare in crash il sistema prima che scada il tempo e informazioni critiche vengano divulgate al mondo.

Localization.Title: Zero Divide
Localization.Description: In Zero Divide, you play as a computer caretaker who must fight off members from the group XTAL and crash the system before the time runs out and critical information is leaked to the world.

Localization.Title: Return Fire
Localization.Description: Return Fire is the spiritual successor to Fire Power and it fits in both the strategy and action genres.

Localization.Title: Return Fire
Localization.Description: Return Fire est un jeu de stratégie/action sur Playstation. Le joueur peut prendre le contrôle d'un des quatre véhicules disponibles (jeep, hélicoptère, tank ou véhicule lance-missiles). Il existe deux façons de remporter la victoire dans Return Fire.

Localization.Title: Return Fire
Localization.Description: Return Fire ist der geistige Nachfolger von Fire Power und passt sowohl in das Strategie- als auch in das Action-Genre.

Localization.Title: Return Fire
Localization.Description: Return Fire es un juego de estrategia y acción, sucesor espiritual de Fire Power. Eres un comandante militar encargado de liderar una serie de misiones contra el enemigo.

Localization.Title: Rise 2: Resurrection
Localization.Description: After Coton the Cyborg (ECO 35-2) defeated the liquid metal Supervisor in the previous game, she used her morphing ability to assimilate him into her own consciousness.

Localization.Title: Rise 2 : Resurrection
Localization.Description: Après que Coton le cyborg (ECO 35-2) ait vaincu le Superviseur en métal liquide dans le jeu précédent, elle a utilisé sa capacité de morphing pour l'assimiler à sa conscience.

Localization.Title: Rise 2: Resurrection
Localization.Description: Rise 2: Resurrection ist ein Kampfspiel für Playstation. Spielen Sie als einer von 18 Charakteren mit Dutzenden verschiedener Kombinationen und kämpfen Sie in der Arena.

Localization.Title: Rise 2: Resurrection
Localization.Description: Rise 2 Resurrection para Sony PlayStation, la secuela de Rise of the Robots, mejora los aspectos positivos del juego original y soluciona algunos de sus problemas.

Localization.Description: Prepare yourself for dangerous underground combat action in TUNNEL B1 for the PlayStation.

Localization.Title: Tunnel B1
Localization.Description: Tunnel B1 est un jeu d'action sur Playstation. Le soft vous plonge, à une vitesse vertigineuse, dans un univers de sensations rarement atteintes. Au bout du tunnel, un enfer entièrement en 3D vous attend boosté par des effets lumineux hallucinants.

Localization.Title: Tunnel B1
Localization.Description: Tunnel B1 ist ein Actionspiel für Playstation. Die Software lässt Sie mit rasender Geschwindigkeit in ein Universum von Empfindungen eintauchen, die selten erreicht werden.

Localization.Title: Tunnel B1
Localization.Description: Tienes la misión de destruir el arma definitiva de tu enemigo. Esto implica viajar a través de un conjunto de túneles precarios en un aerodeslizador de alta tecnología.

Localization.Title: Oddworld: Abe's Oddysee
Localization.Description: Abe's Oddysee begins with the eponymous protagonist as a prisoner in RuptureFarms, from which he narrates his story. He and many other Mudokons are slaves to Molluck the Glukkon, the owner of RuptureFarms: "the biggest meat-processing plant on Oddworld".

Localization.Description: Jusqu'ici, vous n'étiez qu'un simple esclave travaillant dans une usine de viande infernale...

Localization.Title: Oddworld: Abe's Oddysee
Localization.Description: Abe ist ein Wesen aus dem Volk der Mudokaner und eigentlich ein Anti-Held. Wie viele seines Volkes ist er ein Sklave des Fleischproduzenten Molluck aus dem Volk der Glukkons.

Localization.Title: Oddworld: Abe's Oddysee
Localization.Description: Abe es un miembro de la raza Mudokon, una de las tantas que habitan el planeta remoto conocido como Oddworld.

Localization.Description: College Slam graduates to the Sony Playstation with forty top college teams, head-to-head play and three different play modes: Semi-Finals, Tournament and a twenty-game Season.

Localization.Description: College Slam est un jeu de basketball sur Playstation. Le jeu reprend la licence officielle des équipes universitaires américaines de basket. Bien que les stades et même les chants des supporters soient réels, les matches sont à tendance arcade.

Localization.Title: College Slam
Localization.Description: In College Slam wirst Du zum Basketball-Profi! Wähle eines der 40 realen College-Teams und nimm an spannenden Turnieren teil. Erstelle eigene Spieler, passe ihre Fähigkeiten an und speichere sie ab.

Localization.Title: Street Fighter Alpha: Warriors' Dreams
Localization.Description: It's Street Fighter as you always remember it, with some new moves, characters and combo systems, as well as a more polished look and feel. The new moves available for each fighter, called Super moves, allow them to fire off very powerful moves.

Localization.Title: Street Fighter Alpha : Warriors' Dreams
Localization.Description: Street Fighter Alpha : Warriors' Dreams sur Playstation est un jeu de combat en 2D qui réunit bon nombre de personnages connus de la série. Choisissez parmi une trentaine de combattants et débloquez-en plusieurs autres totalement inédits.

Localization.Title: Street Fighter Alpha: Warriors' Dreams
Localization.Description: Es ist Street Fighter, wie Sie es immer in Erinnerung haben, mit einigen neuen Moves, Charakteren und Combo-Systemen sowie einem ausgefeilteren Look and Feel.

Localization.Title: Street Fighter Alpha: Warriors' Dreams
Localization.Description: Street Fighter Alpha: Warriors' Dreams, llamado originalmente Street Fighter Zero para la región de Japón y el resto de Asia, es un videojuego de lucha desarrollado y publicado por Capcom.

Localization.Title: Street Fighter Alpha: Warriors' Dreams
Localization.Description: It's Street Fighter as you always remember it, with some new moves, characters and combo systems, as well as a more polished look and feel. The new moves available for each fighter, called Super moves, allow them to fire off very powerful moves.

Localization.Title: Street Fighter Alpha: Warriors' Dreams
Localization.Description: É o Street Fighter como você sempre se lembra, com alguns novos movimentos, personagens e sistemas combinados, além de uma aparência mais polida.

Localization.Title: VR Golf '97
Localization.Description: nterplay's second golf game on PlayStation features six 3D courses and a customizable camera that will show your player or ball from a number of different perspectives.

Localization.Title: VR Golf '97
Localization.Description: Actua Golf sur Playstation est une simulation de golf en 3 dimensions. Le titre fonctionne avec une gestion de jauge qu'il vous faudra calibrer avant de frapper la balle. Le titre possède un mode multijoueur jouable à 4.

Localization.Title: VR Golf '97
Localization.Description: Das zweite PlayStation-Golfspiel von Interplay bietet sechs 3D-Kurse und eine anpassbare Kamera, die den Spieler oder den Ball aus verschiedenen Perspektiven zeigt.

Localization.Title: VR Golf '97
Localization.Description: El segundo juego de golf de Interplay para PlayStation cuenta con seis campos en 3D y una cámara personalizable que mostrará a tu jugador o pelota desde varias perspectivas diferentes.

Localization.Title: VR Golf '97
Localization.Description: Il secondo gioco di golf di Interplay per PlayStation presenta sei percorsi 3D e una telecamera personalizzabile che mostrerà il tuo giocatore o la tua pallina da diverse prospettive.

Localization.Description: O segundo jogo de golfe PlayStation da Interplay apresenta seis campos 3D e uma câmara fotográfica personalizável que mostrará o seu jogador ou bola a partir de várias perspectivas diferentes.

Localization.Title: VR Soccer '96
Localization.Description: A 3D simulation of the number-one participation sport in the world, VR Soccer '96 pits you against the computer or a friend in virtual soccer action. There are 44 international teams to choose from with 22 players on each squad.

Localization.Title: VR Soccer '96
Localization.Description: Actua Soccer est un jeu de football sur Playstation. Le jeu vous propose de choisir une formation parmi de nombreuses équipes internationales. Les règles sont respectées pour une immersion plus réaliste. Actua Soccer est jouable à deux sur le même écran.

Localization.Title: VR Soccer '96
Localization.Description: VR Soccer '96 ist eine 3D-Simulation des beliebtesten Beteiligungssports der Welt und lässt Sie in virtueller Fußball-Action gegen den Computer oder einen Freund antreten. Es stehen 44 internationale Teams mit 22 Spielern in jedem Kader zur Auswahl.

Localization.Title: VR Soccer '96

Localization.Title: NBA Live 97

Localization.Title: NBA Live 97

Localization.Description: As No Remorse opens, a trio of Silencers enigmatic super-soldiers are returning from a botched mission in which they disobeyed an order to fire upon civilians who were (mistakenly) believed to be rebels.

Localization.Title: Crusader : No Remorse
Localization.Description: Crusaders : No Remorse est un jeu d'action sur Playstation. Vous incarnez un Silencer, l'élite des soldats du consortium économique mondial.

Localization.Title: Crusader: No Remorse
Localization.Description: Sie sind der Silencer – einer der gefährlichsten Kämpfer des World Economic Consortium – und Sie kennen keine Gnade. Doch bald wird klar, dass Sie einem korrupten System dienen. Was können Sie tun?

Localization.Title: Crusader: No Remorse
Localization.Description: Crusader: No Remorse es un juego de acción desarrollado por Origin Systems y publicado por Electronic Arts. Fue lanzado para Sony PlayStation y Sega Saturn en 1997.

Localization.Title: Crusader: No Remorse
Localization.Description: All'inizio di No Remorse, un trio di enigmatici super soldati di Silencers sta tornando da una missione fallita in cui hanno disobbedito a un ordine di sparare su civili che erano (erroneamente) ritenuti ribelli.

Localization.Title: Crusader: No Remorse
Localization.Description: Crusaders: No Remorse é um jogo de ação no Playstation. Você joga como um Silencer, os soldados de elite do consórcio econômico global.

Localization.Title: FIFA Soccer 97
Localization.Description: After an impressive outing with FIFA Soccer, EA is back this season with their continuous soccer lineup, FIFA Soccer 97. Everything has been redone to make sure that gamers get the most for their money.

Localization.Title: FIFA Soccer 97
Localization.Description: FIFA 97 est un jeu de football sur Playstation. Cette version amène une animation plus poussée, basée sur la façon de bouger de David Ginola. Il est possible de choisir un mode Arcade ou Simulation et de jouer à six contre six en intérieur.

Localization.Title: FIFA Soccer 97
Localization.Description: FIFA 97 ist ein Videospiel, das von EA Canada entwickelt und von Electronic Arts basierend auf dem Fußballspiel veröffentlicht wurde. 4 Spielarten, Passwort-Möglichkeit, verbesserte Grafik und detaillierte Spieler-, Mannschafts- und Spielstatistiken.

Localization.Title: FIFA Soccer 97
Localization.Description: Después de una salida impresionante con FIFA Soccer, EA está de regreso esta temporada con su alineación continua de fútbol, FIFA Soccer 97. Todo se ha rehecho para asegurar que los jugadores aprovechen al máximo su dinero.

Localization.Title: FIFA Soccer 97
Localization.Description: Dopo un'impressionante uscita con FIFA Soccer, EA torna in questa stagione con la sua linea calcistica continua, FIFA Soccer 97. Tutto è stato rifatto per garantire ai giocatori il massimo dal loro investimento.

Localization.Title: FIFA Soccer 97

Localization.Title: Ninja: Shadow of Darkness
Localization.Description: In NINJA: Shadow of Darkness, players assume the role of Kurosawa, a young but powerful ninja. Unlike many ninjas before him, he is able to summon powers of the arcane; magical spells that do great damage to those cast upon.

Localization.Description: Ninja : L'Ombre des Ténèbres est un jeu d'action/aventure sur Playstation. Vous incarnez un jeune ninja, de retour chez lui après des années d'absence.

Localization.Title: Ninja: Shadow of Darkness

Localization.Title: Ninja: Shadow of Darkness

Localization.Title: Tomb Raider II: Starring Lara Croft
Localization.Description: The story of Tomb Raider II surrounds the mythical Dagger of Xian, a weapon which was used by an Emperor of China to command his army. By plunging the weapon into its owner's heart, the weapon has the power to turn its bearer into a dragon.

Localization.Title: Tomb Raider II : Starring Lara Croft
Localization.Description: Lara Croft est de retour. Elle part à la découverte du secret de la Dague de Xian. D'après une mystérieuse légende, celui qui découvrira cette dague mythique gagnera le pouvoir du dragon... à condition qu'il ait le courage de la plonger dans son cœur.

Localization.Title: Tomb Raider II: Starring Lara Croft
Localization.Description: Lara Croft ist zurück! In ihrem neuesten Abenteuer begibt sich die Archäologin auf die Spur des Dolches von Xian. Wer diese mystische Waffe entdeckt, bekommt einem alten chinesischen Glauben zufolge eine unvorstellbare Macht verliehen...

Localization.Title: Tomb Raider II: Starring Lara Croft
Localization.Description: Lara croft regresa en Tomb Raider II para descubrir los secretos de la Daga de Xian.

Localization.Title: Tomb Raider II: Starring Lara Croft
Localization.Description: Lara Croft è tornata. Va a scoprire il segreto del Pugnale di Xian. Secondo una misteriosa leggenda, chi scopre questo mitico pugnale otterrà il potere del drago... purché abbia il coraggio di affondarlo nel suo cuore.

Localization.Title: Tomb Raider II: Starring Lara Croft
Localization.Description: Tomb Raider II, estrelado por Lara Croft é um jogo de ação / aventura no Playstation. A bela Lara Croft está de volta. Ao seu lado você está fora para descobrir o segredo da Adaga de Xian.

Localization.Title: Street Fighter EX Plus Alpha

Localization.Title: Rampage: World Tour

Localization.Title: Resident Evil: Director's Cut

Localization.Description: Maîtrisez votre peur... et lancez vous dans l'expérience la plus terrifiante de votre vie. Zombies assoiffés de sang. Animaux mutants. Serpents monstrueux. De dangereux mystères vous menacent à chaque tournant.

Localization.Title: Resident Evil: Director's Cut

Localization.Title: Resident Evil: Director's Cut

Localization.Title: Resident Evil: Director's Cut
Localization.Description: Dopo aver ricevuto una chiamata di soccorso dal Bravo Team, un gruppo d'élite di S.T.A.R.S (Special Tactics And Rescue Squad) è volato nella desolata Raccoon City.

Localization.Title: Resident Evil: Director's Cut
Localization.Description: Resident Evil: Director's Cut é um horror de sobrevivência no Playstation. Esta é uma versão sem censura do Resident Evil 1. Comparado com o último, o aplicativo é diferenciado por novas cenas, novos ângulos de visão, cenas adicionais e novos trajes.

Localization.Title: Ghost in the Shell
Localization.Description: 3rd person action game based on the Ghost in the Shell original comic by Masamune Shirow rather than Mamoru Oshi's film.

Localization.Title: Ghost in the Shell
Localization.Description: Ghost In The Shell est un jeu d'action à la troisième personne sur Playstation tiré du film d'animation japonais de Mamoru Oshii.

Localization.Title: Alundra
Localization.Description: Alundra is a boy who can step into other people's dreams. His own dreams tell him to go to the village Inoa. The ship on which Alundra is coming to the village goes down, but Alundra himself is washed up on a beach near the village.

Localization.Title: Alundra
Localization.Description: The Adventures of Alundra est un jeu d'action/aventure sur Playstation. Vous incarnez Alundra, un jeune héros qui a le pouvoir d'entrer dans les rêves.

Localization.Title: Alundra
Localization.Description: Dunkle Visionen suchen Alundra heim. Quälende Alpträume, die ihn auf die Spur des Bösen führen - und in ein phantastisches Abenteuer im Kampf gegen die Mächte der Finsternis.

Localization.Title: Alundra
Localization.Description: Alundra, el protagonista, realiza un viaje para salvar a la aldea de Inoa de las garras del malvado Melzas, que penetra en las mentes de las personas mientras éstas duermen.

Localization.Title: Alundra
Localization.Description: Alundra è un ragazzo che può entrare nei sogni degli altri. I suoi stessi sogni gli dicono di andare al villaggio Inoa. La nave su cui Alundra sta arrivando al villaggio affonda, ma Alundra stesso viene trascinato su una spiaggia vicino al villaggio.

Localization.Title: Alundra
Localization.Description: Alundra, a protagonista, faz uma viagem para salvar a aldeia de Inoa das garras de Melzas, que penetra na mente das pessoas enquanto dormem. Combinando aventura gráfica e arcade, ele é embalado com ação e enigmas complicados.

Localization.Title: Colony Wars (Disc 2)
Localization.Description: Since 3095, the Earth Empire has spread throughout the universe, taking what it wants and destroying the rest - all in the name of sustaining life on Earth. To the Empire, expansion is of the utmost importance, even above famine, drought and death.

Localization.Title: Colony Wars (Disc 2)
Localization.Description: Colony Wars est un jeu d'action sur Playstation. Vous voilà aux commandes d'un vaisseau spatial pour livrer de nombreuses batailles et mener à bien beaucoup de missions dans l'espace.

Localization.Title: Colony Wars (Disc 2)
Localization.Description: Seit dem Jahr 3095 hat die Koloniale Navy damit begonnen, sich alles im Universum zunehmen was sie wollen und den Rest zu vernichten - und dass alles zum Wohle der Menschheit.

Localization.Title: Colony Wars (Disc 2)
Localization.Description: Desde el año 3095, el Imperio de la Tierra se ha extendido por el universo, tomando todo lo que quiere y destruyendo el resto, todo por mantener la vida en la Tierra.

Localization.Description: Get out the virtual ATM card and head on over to virtual Vegas in Golden Nugget for the PlayStation console system. Featuring stills from the actual Golden Nugget Casino in Las Vegas, Nevada and some authentic-looking 3D graphics of the tables and slots.

Localization.Title: G-Police (Disc 2)
Localization.Description: After a violent interstellar resource war, mega-corporations seize power from the remnants of Earth's governments and lead humanity's way into the colonization of space.

Localization.Description: G-police est un jeu Playstation dans lequel vous incarnez un agent de police dans un monde futuriste. Votre but est de combattre la criminalité dans les villes et les colonies, et ce à bord d'un hélicoptère de combat.

Localization.Title: G-Police (Disc 2)
Localization.Description: Im Jahr 2089 versinken die Städte auf der Erde und ihre Außenposten auf anderen Planeten in einem Sumpf aus Habgier, Korruption und Gewalt.

Localization.Title: G-Police (Disc 2)
Localization.Description: Despega con tu helicóptero de combate Destructor perfectamente equipado. Vuela 35 formidables misiones por las ciudades corruptas de Callisto y demuestra tu destreza en este increíble juego estratégico de acción en tres dimensiones

Localization.Title: G-Police (Disc 2)
Localization.Description: G-Police è uno sparatutto in stile arcade ambientato all'interno delle cupole coloniali di Callisto.

Localization.Title: Shipwreckers!
Localization.Description: Overboard! (Shipwreckers! in North America) is a top-down adventure game, released by Psygnosis in October 1997. The player controls a pirate ship, shown to be manned by three pirates in cutscenes.

Localization.Title: Shipwreckers!
Localization.Description: Overboard ! est un jeu d'action sur Playstation.

Localization.Title: Shipwreckers!
Localization.Description: In Overboard sucht Ihr gezielt nach Flaschenpost mit den darin enthaltenen Bruchstücken von insgesamt fünf verschollenen Weltkarten.

Localization.Title: Shipwreckers!
Localization.Description: Publicado en 1997 nada menos que por Psygnosis, 'Overboard!' nos ofrecía una propuesta totalmente original, tanto que probablemente no haya habido otro juego igual en toda la historia.

Localization.Title: Shipwreckers!

Localization.Description: Micro Machines V3 is the first 3D instalment in the tiny top down racing franchise based on the popular toys. Developed by Codemasters, V3 was known for its wide selection of party modes including an 8 player controller share option.

Localization.Title: Micro Machines V3
Localization.Description: Les mini-bolides les plus rapides s'affrontent sur les circuits les plus délirants. Courses folles semée de power-ups explosifs et circuits à dévaler à fond la caisse. C'est géant.

Localization.Title: Micro Machines V3
Localization.Description: Halsbrecherische Rennen in Minifahrzeugen, Supertempo, explosive Waffen-Powerups auf den verrücktesten 3D-Strecken.

Localization.Title: Micro Machines V3
Localization.Description: MicroMachines V3 es un juego de carreras para PlayStation, donde cada objeto cotidiano puede llegar a ser extremadamente peligroso.

Localization.Title: Micro Machines V3
Localization.Description: Corse a rotta di collo in mini veicoli, super velocità, potenziamenti di armi esplosive sulle piste 3D più folli.

Localization.Title: Tactics Ogre
Localization.Description: After generations of war between the various ethnic groups, King Dogare brought peace to the land of Valeria. When the king dies Valeria is split into three different groups, each claiming the throne.

Localization.Title: Tactics Ogre
Localization.Description: Tactics Ogre est un jeu de rôle tactique sur Playstation. Basé sur une stratégie au tour par tour avec une vue en 3D isométrique, Tactics Ogre vous met au commande d'une troupe d'aventuriers et de guerriers.

Localization.Title: Tactics Ogre
Localization.Description: Tactics Ogre ist ein taktisches Rollenspiel für Playstation. Basierend auf einer rundenbasierten Strategie mit einer isometrischen 3D-Ansicht überlässt Ihnen Tactics Ogre das Kommando über eine Truppe von Abenteurern und Kriegern.

Localization.Title: Tactics Ogre
Localization.Description: Después de generaciones de guerra entre los diversos grupos étnicos, el rey Dogare trajo la paz a la tierra de Valeria. Cuando el rey muere, Valeria se divide en tres grupos diferentes, cada uno reclamando el trono.

Localization.Title: Tactics Ogre
Localization.Description: Dopo generazioni di guerre tra le varie etnie, Re Dogare portò la pace nella terra di Valeria. Quando il re muore, Valeria viene divisa in tre gruppi diversi, ciascuno dei quali rivendica il trono.

Localization.Title: Riven: The Sequel to Myst (Disc 2)
Localization.Description: Riven is a sequel to Myst, and is very similar to its predecessor in gameplay style, controls, and visual presentation. The game world is presented as a series of computer-generated still screens; the player explores it in a point-and-click fashion.

Localization.Description: Riven : La Suite de Myst est un jeu de réflexion/aventure sur Playstation. Vous êtes convoqué par Atrus qui a besoin de vous pour libérer sa femme Catherine.

Localization.Description: Riven ist das Sequel zu Myst, und entspricht vom Gameplay eins zu eins dem Vorgänger. Die Welt wurde damals auf SCI Graphics Rechnern generiert, durch die sich der Spieler in Point and Click Manier klickt. Interaktion ist an diversen Hotspots möglich.

Localization.Title: Ian Livingstone's Deathtrap Dungeon
Localization.Description: Deathtrap Dungeon is an action-adventure game released in 1998 for the PlayStation and Microsoft Windows. It is based on the adventure gamebook of the same name.

Localization.Description: Deathtrap Dungeon est un jeu d'action sur Playstation. L'ignoble baron Sukumvit a construit un gigantesque labyrinthe au coeur de la montagne.

Localization.Description: Riven is a sequel to Myst, and is very similar to its predecessor in gameplay style, controls, and visual presentation. The game world is presented as a series of computer-generated still screens; the player explores it in a point-and-click fashion.

Localization.Title: LEGO Racers

Localization.Title: Nightmare Creatures

Localization.Title: Nightmare Creatures
Localization.Description: Nightmare Creatures est un survival-horror sur Playstation. Le monde entier semble avoir sombré dans l'obscurité et l'horreur. A vous donc de défier le sorcier maléfique afin de l'empêcher de mener à bien ses plans machiavéliques.

Localization.Title: Nightmare Creatures
Localization.Description: Adam Crowley, ein einstmals respektierter Wissenschaftler, hat sich der schwarzen Magie zugewandt und eine höllische Brut an Monstern und Dämonen erschaffen und diese auf die Straßen Londons von 1834 losgelassen.

Localization.Title: Nightmare Creatures
Localization.Description: Nightmare Creatures es una aventura de acción situada en tercera persona con temas de horror, esto te permite elegir entre dos personajes para luchar contra el mal que está corrompiendo a la ciudad de Londres gracias a los experimentos del alquimista Adá

Localization.Title: Nightmare Creatures
Localization.Description: Adam Crowley, uno scienziato un tempo rispettato, ora rivolto alla magia nera, ha rilasciato un contagio demoniaco nelle strade della Londra del 1834.

Localization.Title: Nightmare Creatures
Localization.Description: Adam Crowley, a once-respected scientist, now turned to black magic, has released a demonic contagion onto the streets of 1834 London.

Localization.Title: Duke Nukem: Time to Kill
Localization.Description: The game begins not a long time after Duke Nukem 3D. Duke is relaxing in Bootylicious with a few beers and some babes when suddenly Pig Cops start thrashing the place and turn his 1968 custom hog into a chopper bike.

Localization.Title: Duke Nukem : Time to Kill
Localization.Description: Duke Nukem : Time To Kill est un jeu de tir à la première personne sur Playstation. Des extraterrestres ont envahi la Terre et détruisent tout à Los Angeles. C'est à vous de les renvoyer d'où ils viennent à coups de fusil et de répliques cinglantes.

Localization.Title: Duke Nukem: Time to Kill
Localization.Description: Lust auf 'ne Zeitreise? Der größte Action-Held aller Zeiten ist wieder da! In einem Third-Person Ballerfest durch die Jahrhunderte. Kämpfe dich mit Duke Nukem durch verschiedene Epochen, in denen du fiese Aliens in ihre Schranken weist.

Localization.Title: Duke Nukem: Time to Kill
Localization.Description: Duke Nukem: Time To Kill es un juego de disparos en primera persona en Playstation. Los extraterrestres invadieron la Tierra y destruyeron todo en Los Ángeles. Depende de usted enviarlos de regreso con rifles y armas.

Localization.Title: Duke Nukem: Time to Kill
Localization.Description: Il gioco inizia non molto tempo dopo Duke Nukem 3D. Duke si sta rilassando a Bootylicious con alcune birre e alcune ragazze quando improvvisamente Pig Cops inizia a battere il posto e trasforma il suo maiale personalizzato del 1968 in una moto chopper.

Localization.Title: Duke Nukem: Time to Kill
Localization.Description: O jogo começa não muito tempo depois de Duke Nukem 3D.

Localization.Title: Klonoa: Door to Phantomile

Localization.Title: Klonoa: Door to Phantomile

Localization.Title: Klonoa: Door to Phantomile

Localization.Title: Resident Evil 2 (Disc 2)
Localization.Description: Resident Evil 2 takes place two months after the events of the first game and is set in Raccoon City, a Midwestern mountain community whose residents have been turned into zombies by the T-virus, a biological weapon developed by the pharmaceutical compan

Localization.Title: Resident Evil 2 (Disc 2)
Localization.Description: Souvenez-vous, tout avait commencé dans le laboratoire d'un sinistre manoir, lieu de développement du Virus-T, une toxine capable de faire muter des gènes et qui devait servir à la fabrication d'armes biologiques.

Localization.Title: Resident Evil 2 (Disc 2)
Localization.Description: Der Anfang allen Übels war ein Unfall im Versuchslabor eines Herrenhauses. Dieser Unfall hatte zur Folge, daß der T-Virus, ein bilogischer Kampfstoff der Umbrella Corporation, freigesetzt wurde.

Localization.Title: Resident Evil 2 (Disc 2)
Localization.Description: ¿Podrás sobrevivir al horror? Primero fue el desastre en la mansión. Umbrella Corp. desarrolló el T-Virus, una toxina de mutación genética destinada al armamento biológico. Después de su liberación, seres vivientes mutaron en criaturas putrefactas.

Localization.Title: Resident Evil 2 (Disc 2)
Localization.Description: Resident Evil 2 è ambientato due mesi dopo gli eventi del primo gioco ed è ambientato a Raccoon City, una comunità montana del Midwest i cui residenti sono stati trasformati in zombi dal T-virus, un'arma biologica sviluppata dalla società farmaceutica Um

Localization.Title: Resident Evil 2 (Disc 2)
Localization.Description: O jogo se passa dois meses após os acontecimentos de Resident Evil, na cidade de Raccon City, localizada na região centro-oeste dos Estados Unidos.

Localization.Title: Metal Gear Solid (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Renegade special forces unit FOXHOUND has taken over Shadow Moses Island in Alaska's Fox Archipelago - publicly a nuclear weapons disposal facility but in truth a top secret weapons development site and home to Metal Gear REX.

Localization.Title: Metal Gear Solid (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Infiltrez un complexe militaire terroriste pour faire échouer une conspiration nucléaire. Concentrez vous, alertez vos sens, restez en vie... Metal Gear Solid: Espionnage, stratégie et action.

Localization.Title: Metal Gear Solid (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: FOXHOUND, ein abtrünniges, genetisch verbessertes Spezialkommando, unternimmt einen Putsch auf einem abgelegenen Archipel in Alaska, bei dem es sich in Wahrheit um "Shadow Moses", eine geheime Abrüstungseinrichtung der Regierung, handelt.

Localization.Title: Metal Gear Solid (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Metal Gear Solid es un juego que mezcla varios géneros, como acción aventura, sigilo o espionaje.

Localization.Title: Metal Gear Solid (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: FOXHOUND, un rinnegato, commando speciale geneticamente potenziato, sta compiendo un colpo di stato su un remoto arcipelago dell'Alaska che è in realtà "Shadow Moses", una struttura segreta di disarmo del governo.

Localization.Title: Metal Gear Solid (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Metal Gear Solid é um jogo espionagem lançado para a PlayStation. Nesta obra, Solid Snake deve se infiltrar em Shadow Moses, uma base militar no Alasca, para salvar reféns.

Localization.Title: Tennis Arena
Localization.Description: With no stat tweaking and no licenses, Tennis Arena is arcade-style tennis at its most fundamental. What you have here is single-match or tournament play for up to four players with wacky characters and a few different courts to play on.

Localization.Description: Disponible sur Playstation, Tennis Arena vous plongera dans le monde de la balle jaune, de façon fun et intuitive. Au lieu de trouver des joueurs connus, vous pourrez choisir des personnages originaux et hauts en couleur aux techniques délirantes.

Localization.Title: Tennis Arena

Localization.Title: Tennis Arena
Localization.Description: Lo que tienes aquí es un juego de tenis para un jugador o un torneo para un máximo de cuatro jugadores con personajes y pistas de lo más extravagantes.

Localization.Title: The Granstream Saga
Localization.Description: One hundred years ago, the planet of Granstream was ravaged by a war between the Imperial Wizardry and the Allied Spirit Army.

Localization.Title: The Granstream Saga
Localization.Description: Als die Polkappen schmelzten und die Welt kurz vor dem Untergang war. Haben 4 Weise Männer einen Weg gefunden ihre Heimatkontinente mit Hilfe von Magie zum Schweben zu bringen. So waren Sie vorerst vor dem steigenden Wasserspiegel sicher.

Localization.Title: The Granstream Saga

Localization.Title: Gex: Enter the Gecko
Localization.Description: "Is it just me, or am I engulfed in flames?" is one of the many one-liners uttered by Gex, a wise cracking gecko who should check himself into television rehab; he's addicted to it.

Localization.Title: Gex : Enter the Gecko
Localization.Description: Gex : Enter the Gecko est un jeu de plates-formes en 3D sur Playstation. Le terrible Rez est sur le point de détruire le royaume de la télévision et Gex est le seul à pouvoir l'en empêcher.

Localization.Title: Gex: Enter the Gecko

Localization.Description: Enter a martial arts tournament in KENSEI: Sacred Fist. Choose from 22 different characters and use the training mode to learn each character?s unique moves and combinations. When you are ready to fight, play the Normal mode and unlock new characters.

Localization.Title: Kensei : Sacred Fist
Localization.Description: Kensei Sacred Fist est un jeu de combat sorti sur Playstation. Dans ce jeu, vous pourrez combattre contre la console ou contre un joueur humain avec 22 personnages différents. Seuls 9 d'entre eux sont accessibles dès le début du jeu.

Localization.Title: Kensei: Sacred Fist
Localization.Description: Nehmen Sie an einem Kampfsportturnier in KENSEI: Sacred Fist teil. Wählen Sie aus 22 verschiedenen Charakteren und nutzen Sie den Trainingsmodus, um die einzigartigen Bewegungen und Kombinationen jedes Charakters zu erlernen.

Localization.Title: Kensei: Sacred Fist

Localization.Title: Kensei: Sacred Fist

Localization.Title: Kensei: Sacred Fist

Localization.Title: Skullmonkeys
Localization.Description: Skullmonkeys is the successor title to The Neverhood, which came out only on PC (and, in Japan, as "Klaymen Klaymen" on PSX). The game is an old-school jump and run type of game, with a large number of FMVs. The entire game is molded in clay.

Localization.Title: Skullmonkeys
Localization.Description: Rapide et funky, écrasez les Skullmonkeys! Doté d'un postérieur-tueur et d'armes aussi bizarres qu'étranges, vous incarnez Klaymen, le tout dernier héros en pâte à modeler.

Localization.Title: Skullmonkeys
Localization.Description: Bewaffnet mit einem Killer-Hintern und einer Ladung verrückter Waffen kämpfen Sie als Klaymen, dem letzten seiner Art. Sie rennen, springen und schießen, um Ihren geliebten Heimatplaneten vor dem Bösewicht Klogg und seinen Skullmonkeys zu retten.

Localization.Title: Skullmonkeys
Localization.Description: En el lejano planeta Idznak viven los Skull Monkeys, (una raza de humanoides con un coeficiente intelectual de -300).

Localization.Description: Mortal Kombat 4 est un jeu de combat sur Playstation. Combos, fatalités et autres coups spéciaux, tels sont les ingrédients qui fondent le succès d'un jeu réputé pour la violence de ses affrontements.

Localization.Title: Mortal Kombat 4
Localization.Description: Das Gameplay-System von Mortal Kombat 4 ähnelt dem der vorherigen Spiele. Eine der bemerkenswertesten Neuerungen ist der Einsatz von Waffen und Gegenständen während der Kämpfe.

Localization.Title: Mortal Kombat 4
Localization.Description: Similar a los otros juegos de Mortal Kombat. Usando personajes en 3D en un campo de juego 2D, tiene alrededor de 20 combatientes diferentes para elegir, y cada uno tiene secretos mágicos y armas.

Localization.Title: Mortal Kombat 4
Localization.Description: Nel tentativo di salvare la Terra, Raiden iniziò una guerra con Shinnok, un dio anziano caduto, e i suoi servi; una decisione che è costata la vita a molte persone.

Localization.Title: Mortal Kombat 4
Localization.Description: Mortal Kombat 4 é um jogo de luta para Playstation. Combos, fatalities e outros golpes especiais, são os ingredientes que sustentam o sucesso de um jogo conhecido pela violência dos seus confrontos.

Localization.Title: Dead or Alive
Localization.Description: The first in the Dead or Alive series, and features many of the same features that has made the DoA series so popular today; somewhat realistic combat, good character design, and scantily clad women whose breasts bounce a lot.

Localization.Title: Dead or Alive
Localization.Description: Plastique généreuse des combattantes, technicité, intensité des affrontements. Voici ce qui caractérise Dead or Alive sur Playstation, jeu de baston faisant office de figure de proue du genre.

Localization.Title: Dead or Alive
Localization.Description: Durch umfangreiche Wahlmöglichkeiten der Kämpfer, tausende von Schlag- und Bewegungskombinationen und hohe Spielschnelligkeit, hat Dead or Alive eine hohe Langzeitmotivation.

Localization.Title: Dead or Alive
Localization.Description: Dead or Alive es un videojuego de lucha de 1996 de Tecmo y el primero de la serie Dead or Alive (DoA) de Team Ninja. Fue lanzado primero en salas recreativas, y luego porteado para Sega Saturn en Japón, y más tarde para PlayStation en todas las regiones.

Localization.Title: Dead or Alive
Localization.Description: Il primo della serie Dead or Alive e presenta molte delle stesse funzionalità che hanno reso la serie DoA così popolare oggi; Combattimenti un po' realistici, buon design dei personaggi e donne seminude i cui seni rimbalzano molto.

Localization.Title: Dead or Alive
Localization.Description: O primeiro da série Dead or Alive e apresenta muitos dos mesmos recursos que tornaram a série DoA tão popular hoje em dia; Lutas um tanto realistas, bom design de personagens e mulheres seminuas cujos seios saltam muito.

Localization.Title: Alien Resurrection

Localization.Title: Alien Resurrection

Localization.Title: Alien Resurrection

Localization.Description: Clock Tower II: The Struggle Within, released in Japan as Clock Tower Ghost Head, was released in 1998 for the PlayStation. While sharing the gameplay mechanics of the first two, the game could be considered a spin-off from the main series.

Localization.Title: Clock Tower II : The Struggle Within
Localization.Description: Clock Tower II : The Struggle Within sur PlayStation est un jeu d'aventure/horreur dans lequel vous incarnez une jeune fille possédant une double personnalité qui cherche à découvrir les mystères tournant autour de sa personne et de sa famille.

Localization.Title: Clock Tower II: The Struggle Within
Localization.Description: lock Tower II: The Struggle Within erschien 1998 in Japan unter dem Namen Clock Tower Ghost Head. Die Gameplay Mechanik entspricht den beiden Vorgängern. Das Spiel selbst ist eine Art Spin-Off.

Localization.Title: Clock Tower II: The Struggle Within
Localization.Description: Clock Tower II: The Struggle Within, lanzado en Japón como Clock Tower Ghost Head, fue lanzado en 1998 para PlayStation. Si bien comparte la mecánica de juego con sus dos predecesores, el juego podría considerarse un spin-off de la serie principal.

Localization.Title: Clock Tower II: The Struggle Within
Localization.Description: Clock Tower II: The Struggle Within, pubblicato in Giappone come Clock Tower Ghost Head, è stato pubblicato nel 1998 per PlayStation.

Localization.Title: Heart of Darkness (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: The eternally delayed Heart of Darkness has finally made its way to the PlayStation gaming console! One day, as Andy was in the park with his dog Whiskey, strange things started to happen.

Localization.Title: Heart of Darkness (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Heart of Darkness est un jeu de plates-formes sur Playstation. Dans un univers ténébreux et terrifiant le jeune Andy est venu délivrer son chien Whisky qui est retenu prisonnier par le méchant Maître qui règne sur les Ténèbres.

Localization.Title: Heart of Darkness (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Der junge Andy ist ein typischer Junge, er hasst die Schule, hat sein eigenes Baumhaus und will am liebsten seine Freizeit mit seinem Hund Whisky verbringen.

Localization.Title: Heart of Darkness (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: En el corazón de las Tinieblas se esconde un mundo aterrador. En él reina el Señor del Mal con un poder y una crueldad sin límites.

Localization.Title: Heart of Darkness (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: L'eternamente ritardato Heart of Darkness è finalmente arrivato sulla console di gioco PlayStation! Un giorno, mentre Andy era nel parco con il suo cane Whisky, iniziarono a succedere cose strane.

Localization.Title: Heart of Darkness (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: O eternamente adiado Heart of Darkness finalmente chegou ao console de jogos PlayStation! Um dia, enquanto Andy estava no parque com seu cachorro Whisky, coisas estranhas começaram a acontecer.

Localization.Title: Circuit Breakers
Localization.Description: Circuit Breakers is a racing game similar to Micro Machines and Ignition, where the vehicles resemble toys viewed from above. The game lets the player control cars (of various models), boats and submarines that change according to the track.

Localization.Title: Circuit Breakers
Localization.Description: Circuit Breakers est un jeu de courses dans lequel vous jouez avec des voitures miniatures mais aussi des bateaux et sous-marins de la même taille.

Localization.Title: Circuit Breakers
Localization.Description: Circuit Breakers ist ein Rennspiel ähnlich wie Micro Machines und Ignition, bei dem die Fahrzeuge von oben betrachtet wie Spielzeug aussehen.

Localization.Title: Circuit Breakers
Localization.Description: Circuit Breakers es un juego de carreras con coches, barcos y submarinos en miniatura.

Localization.Description: O.D.T. is an action role-playing game with some platforming and puzzle-solving elements. The player can choose to control any of the four characters.

Localization.Title: O.D.T.
Localization.Description: O.D.T. est un jeu de rôle d'action qui comporte des éléments de plateforme et de résolution d'énigmes. Le joueur peut choisir de contrôler l'un des quatre personnages.

Localization.Title: O.D.T.
Localization.Description: O.D.T. ist ein Action-/Abenteuerspiel für Playstation. Unmittelbar nach dem Absturz befinden Sie sich oben auf dem Turm und haben das Kommando über eines der vier Besatzungsmitglieder des Schiffes, aus denen Sie auswählen können (plus zwei versteckte).

Localization.Title: O.D.T.
Localization.Description: O.D.T. (siglas de "Or Die Trying") es un videojuego de acción y aventura que se ambienta en una futurista ciudad flotante llamada Termite, ubicada en un planeta alienígena. En O.D.T.

Localization.Title: O.D.T.
Localization.Description: O.D.T. è un gioco di ruolo d'azione con alcuni elementi platform e di risoluzione di enigmi. Il giocatore può scegliere di controllare uno qualsiasi dei quattro personaggi.

Localization.Title: O.D.T.
Localization.Description: O.D.T. is an action role-playing game with some platforming and puzzle-solving elements. The player can choose to control any of the four characters.

Localization.Title: Eliminator
Localization.Description: The Elimination event was the ultimate in televised arena combat. The participants were prisoners, of course, since no one sane enough would take up the gauntlet without some sort of incentive.

Localization.Title: Eliminator
Localization.Description: Eliminator est un jeu de tir sur Playstation. Vous pilotez un vaisseau futuriste lourdement armé grâce auquel vous devez abattre le plus de bombes possible, tout en évitant les divers obstacles et en arrivant premier.

Localization.Title: Eliminator
Localization.Description: Das Elimination-Event war das Nonplusultra aller im Fernsehen übertragenen Arenakämpfe. Die Teilnehmer waren natürlich Gefangene, denn niemand, der vernünftig genug war, würde den Fehdehandschuh ohne irgendeinen Anreiz auf sich nehmen.

Localization.Title: Eliminator
Localization.Description: El evento de eliminación era el último de todos los combates televisados en la arena. Los participantes eran prisioneros, por supuesto, ya que nadie lo bastante sensato aceptaría el desafío sin algún tipo de incentivo.

Localization.Title: Eliminator

Localization.Title: X Games Pro Boarder
Localization.Description: X-Games: Pro Boarder is a snowboarding game with several game modes including downhill and half pipe.

Localization.Title: X Games Pro Boarder
Localization.Description: X-Games : Pro Boarder sur PSone est un jeu de snowboard dans lequel, il vous est offert de rider à la fois dans des half pipe, mais aussi sur pistes.

Localization.Title: X Games Pro Boarder
Localization.Description: Leben Sie wie einer der weltbesten Profi-Snowboarder. Messen Sie sich mit den Snowboardern, die diesen Sport beherrschen und geprägt haben. Stellen Sie sich der enormen Herausforderung von XGAMESPROBOARDER

Localization.Title: X Games Pro Boarder
Localization.Description: X-Games: Pro Boarder para PSone es un juego de snowboard donde puedes deslizarte por halfpipes y pistas. En las pistas, tu objetivo es terminar la carrera lo más rápido posible mientras recolectas diversos objetos repartidos por el recorrido.

Localization.Title: X Games Pro Boarder
Localization.Description: X-Games: Pro Boarder is a snowboarding game with several game modes including downhill and half pipe.

Localization.Title: Tenchu: Stealth Assassins
Localization.Description: After firing your grappling hook to the rooftop of a small house, you pull yourself up and notice a guard pacing back and forth on the ground. He doesn't see you as you begin to crawl and sneak around on the roof.

Localization.Title: Tenchu : Stealth Assassins
Localization.Description: Tenchu : Stealth Assassins est un jeu d'infiltration sur Playstation. Vous jouez un Ninja au choix entre Rikimaru et Ayame. Le soft se décompose en 10 étapes où vous devez accomplir les tâches qui sont présentes.

Localization.Title: Tenchu: Stealth Assassins
Localization.Description: Schleichen Sie sich an, und schlagen Sie mit tödlicher Präzision zu. Sie sind Rikimaru oder Ayame, ein Ninja in der dunklen Welt des feudalen Japan. Ausgerüstet mit mystischen Waffen und einem wachen Auge müssen Sie kämpfen, ohne entdeckt zu werden.

Localization.Title: Tenchu: Stealth Assassins
Localization.Description: Atraviesa el Japón de la época feudal controlando a uno de los dos ninjas del clan Azuma: Rikimaru y Ayame. Utiliza técnicas de infiltración, escala murallas y corre por los tejados.

Localization.Title: Tenchu: Stealth Assassins
Localization.Description: Attraversa il Giappone dei tempi feudali controllando uno dei due ninja del clan Azuma: Rikimaru e Ayame. Usa tecniche di infiltrazione, scala muri e corri sui tetti. Tutto va bene in un mondo in cui non devi essere visto né puoi lasciare traccia.

Localization.Title: Tenchu: Stealth Assassins
Localization.Description: Tenchu: Stealth Assassins é um jogo furtivo para Playstation. Você joga com um Ninja de sua escolha entre Rikimaru e Ayame. O jogo é dividido em 10 etapas onde você deve realizar as tarefas que estão presentes.

Localization.Title: Silent Hill
Localization.Description: Silent Hill is a 1999 survival horror video game for the PlayStation. The first in a series about a mysterious town of the same name, Silent Hill generated a direct sequel, three indirect sequels, a prequel and a film adaptation.

Localization.Title: Silent Hill
Localization.Description: Un jeune homme à la recherche de sa fille lutte pour survivre dans un monde à cheval entre la réalité et l'enfer, dans une ville renfermant de terribles et sombres secrets.

Localization.Title: Silent Hill
Localization.Description: Harry Mason, ein seit vier Jahren verwitweter Schriftsteller, fährt gemeinsam mit seiner siebenjährigen Tochter Cheryl in den Urlaub, den beide auf Wunsch von Cheryl in der Kleinstadt Silent Hill verbringen wollen.

Localization.Title: Silent Hill
Localization.Description: Un joven hombre busca desesperadamente a su hija debatiéndose por sobrevivir en un lugar entre la realidad y el infierno, una ciudad que esconde oscuros y sangrientos secretos.

Localization.Title: Silent Hill
Localization.Description: Silent Hill è un videogioco survival horror del 1999 per PlayStation. Il primo di una serie su una misteriosa città con lo stesso nome, Silent Hill ha generato un sequel diretto, tre sequel indiretti, un prequel e un adattamento cinematografico.

Localization.Title: Silent Hill
Localization.Description: Silent Hill é um horror de sobrevivência para Playstation. Você joga com Harry Mason e acaba de chegar na pequena cidade de Silent Hill a bordo do seu 4x4 e da sua filha Cheryl. No meio da noite, um acidente interrompe a viagem da família.

Localization.Title: Legacy of Kain: Soul Reaver
Localization.Description: 1500 years after Blood Omen: Legacy of Kain, the vampire Kain's decision at the end of that game has finally defeated the human kingdoms and brought the world of Nosgoth under his control.

Localization.Title: Legacy of Kain : Soul Reaver
Localization.Description: Kain, mon seigneur et maître me faisait une confiance absolue, et j'étais voué à prendre sa succession ainsi que ses fabuleux pouvoirs.

Localization.Title: Legacy of Kain: Soul Reaver
Localization.Description: Raziel, einer der sechs Statthalter des Vampir­fürsten Kain, hat noch vor seinem Herrn eine neue Entwicklungsstufe erreicht und als erster Vampir fledermausartige Flügel bekommen.

Localization.Title: Legacy of Kain: Soul Reaver
Localization.Description: Soul Reaver tiene a lugar en el mundo ficticio de Nosgoth, en el cual la vida está ligada a nueve pilares llamados Los Pilares de Nosgoth, representados por un guardián cada uno.

Localization.Title: Legacy of Kain: Soul Reaver
Localization.Description: Raziel, uno dei sei governatori del signore dei vampiri Cain, raggiunse una nuova fase di sviluppo prima del suo maestro ed è stato il primo vampiro a ricevere ali simili a pipistrelli.

Localization.Title: Legacy of Kain: Soul Reaver
Localization.Description: 1500 anos após Blood Omen: Legacy of Kain, a decisão do vampiro Kain no final do jogo finalmente derrotou os reinos humanos e trouxe o mundo de Nosgoth sob seu controle.

Localization.Title: Invasion from Beyond
Localization.Description: The story for Invasion From Beyond is based on the golden age of B-Movie science fiction thrillers, and goes like this: farm workers have been abducted and crop circles were discovered in farmlands outside Washington, D.C..

Localization.Title: Invasion from Beyond
Localization.Description: Invasion From Beyond est un jeu d'action sur Playstation. La population est terrorisée, les Martiens débarquent ! Enfourchez un vaisseau et enrayez cette menace extraterrestre tout en veillant à sauver les pauvres dames d'un enlèvement certain.

Localization.Title: Invasion from Beyond
Localization.Description: Die Geschichte von Invasion From Beyond basiert auf dem goldenen Zeitalter der B-Movie-Science-Fiction-Thriller und geht so: Landarbeiter wurden entführt und Kornkreise wurden auf Ackerland außerhalb von Washington, D.C. entdeckt.

Localization.Title: Invasion from Beyond
Localization.Description: Cosas extrañas se han visto en el cielo, círculos aparecen en el suelo en los campos de cultivo. Esto sólo pueden ser signos de una invasión alienígena. La gente está asustada y el Area-51 ha sido llamada para defender el planeta.

Localization.Title: Invasion from Beyond
Localization.Description: La storia di Invasion From Beyond è basata sull'età d'oro dei thriller di fantascienza di B-Movie e va così: i lavoratori agricoli sono stati rapiti e i cerchi nel grano sono stati scoperti nei campi coltivati fuori Washington, DC.

Localization.Title: Invasion from Beyond
Localization.Description: The story for Invasion From Beyond is based on the golden age of B-Movie science fiction thrillers, and goes like this: farm workers have been abducted and crop circles were discovered in farmlands outside Washington, D.C..

Localization.Title: Oddworld: Abe's Exoddus (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Abe's Oddysee begins with the eponymous protagonist as a prisoner in RuptureFarms, from which he narrates his story. He and many other Mudokons are slaves to Molluck the Glukkon, the owner of RuptureFarms: "the biggest meat-processing plant on Oddworld".

Localization.Title: Oddworld : Abe's Exoddus (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Jusqu'ici, vous n'étiez qu'un simple esclave travaillant dans une usine de viande infernale...

Localization.Title: Oddworld: Abe's Exoddus (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Abe ist ein Wesen aus dem Volk der Mudokaner und eigentlich ein Anti-Held. Wie viele seines Volkes ist er ein Sklave des Fleischproduzenten Molluck aus dem Volk der Glukkons.

Localization.Title: Oddworld: Abe's Exoddus (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Abe es un miembro de la raza Mudokon, una de las tantas que habitan el planeta remoto conocido como Oddworld.

Localization.Title: Oddworld: Abe's Exoddus (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Abe è un membro della razza Mudokon, una delle tante che abitano il remoto pianeta noto come Oddworld. Lavora al fianco dei suoi colleghi come operaio e schiavo nelle Rupture Farms, una potente azienda di lavorazione della carne.

Localization.Title: Oddworld: Abe's Exoddus (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Oddworld - Abe's Oddysee é um jogo de ação / aventura no Playstation. Você joga como Abe e você tem que salvar sua pele em um universo cheio de perigos do mal, onde todo mundo tenta te devorar vivo.

Localization.Title: The Fifth Element
Localization.Description: Based on a movie by the same name, The Fifth Element is a third-person adventure wherein you take on the persona of one of two characters.

Localization.Title: The Fifth Element
Localization.Description: Le Cinquième Elément est un jeu d'action sur Playstation. Vous incarnez tour à tour Korben ou Leeloo, dans pas moins de 16 niveaux dans lesquels vous aurez l'occasion de rechercher des indices ou de combattre des ennemis.

Localization.Title: The Fifth Element
Localization.Description: Endlich gibt es Luc Bessons atemberaubendes futuristisches Abenteuer für die Playstation. Übernehmen Sie in dieser actiongeladenen Rolle des Taxifahrers Korben Dallas oder der mysteriösen Leeloo.

Localization.Title: The Fifth Element
Localization.Description: Basada en la película del mismo nombre de 1997.

Localization.Title: The Fifth Element
Localization.Description: Tratto dall'omonimo film, The Fifth Element è un'avventura in terza persona in cui si assume la personalità di uno dei due personaggi.

Localization.Title: The Fifth Element
Localization.Description: Baseado em um filme de mesmo nome, O Quinto Elemento é uma aventura em terceira pessoa onde você assume a personalidade de um dos dois personagens.

Localization.Title: Assault: Retribution
Localization.Description: In 2198, the city of Arcadia is devastated when an alien object crashes into it and releases hostile creatures. Reno and Kelly are deployed to stop the invasion before it can spread further.

Localization.Title: Assault : Retribution
Localization.Description: En 2198, la ville d'Arcadia est dévastée lorsqu'un objet extraterrestre s'écrase à sa surface et libère des créatures hostiles. Reno et Kelly sont envoyés pour repousser l'invasion avant qu'elle ne se propage.

Localization.Title: Assault: Retribution
Localization.Description: Assault: Retribution ist ein 3D-Plattform-Shooter, der sich über sieben futuristische Level erstreckt und zwei spielbare Charaktere mit alternativen Routen, analoger Steuerung und Speicherkartenunterstützung umfasst.

Localization.Title: Assault: Retribution
Localization.Description: Assault - Retribution le proporciona algunos de los mejores poderes de fuego que la tecnología moderna puede proporcionar, así como varias opciones de personalización para asegurar "una mejor vida a través de un rápido desembolso de muerte".

Localization.Title: Assault: Retribution
Localization.Description: In 2198, the city of Arcadia is devastated when an alien object crashes into it and releases hostile creatures. Reno and Kelly are deployed to stop the invasion before it can spread further.

Localization.Title: Assault: Retribution
Localization.Description: Assault: Retribution oferece o melhor poder de fogo que a tecnologia moderna pode oferecer, junto com várias opções de personalização para garantir “uma vida melhor através de uma morte rápida”.

Localization.Title: Akuji the Heartless
Localization.Description: The premise of Akuji the Heartless is not a happy one. Just as Akuji, a voodoo shaman, was about to get married, his bride-to-be was kidnapped and he was then killed by his very own brother.

Localization.Title: Akuji the Heartless
Localization.Description: Akuji The Heartless est un jeu de plates-formes sur Playstation.

Localization.Title: Akuji the Heartless
Localization.Description: In diesem 3D-Action Adventure werden Sie zu Akuji, The Heartless, dem der eigene Bruder am Tage seiner Hochzeit das Herz entriß.

Localization.Title: Akuji the Heartless
Localization.Description: La premisa de Akuji el Despiadado no es feliz. Justo cuando Akuji, un chamán vudú, estaba a punto de casarse, su novia fue secuestrada y luego fue asesinado por su propio hermano.

Localization.Title: Akuji the Heartless
Localization.Description: La premessa di Akuji the Heartless non è felice. Proprio quando Akuji, uno sciamano voodoo, stava per sposarsi, la sua futura sposa fu rapita e lui fu poi ucciso dal suo stesso fratello.

Localization.Title: Akuji the Heartless
Localization.Description: Em Akuji: O Heartless o jogador assume o papel de Akuji, um padre vudu. O título do jogo é suposto ser tomado literalmente como o dia do casamento de Akuji trouxe um problema com ele: seu irmão mata-o e arranca-lhe o coração.

Localization.Title: You Don't Know Jack (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: You Don't Know Jack est un jeu de questions/réponses sur Playstation. L'objectif est similaire à un quiz télévisé. Tous les joueurs présents sont en compétition pour gagner un maximum d'argent et pour valider les questions.

Localization.Title: You Don't Know Jack (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Das ultimative Partyspiel jetzt endlich auch für die Playstation: You don't know Jack bringt garantiert Leben in jede langweilig gewordene Party.

Localization.Title: You Don't Know Jack (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: "You Don´t Know Jack" es un juego de humor y sarcasmo basado juego de trivia para hasta tres jugadores. No sólo puedes ser insultado y menospreciado por el anfitrión, puedes reírte de tus amigos cuando es su turno.
