Localization.Title: Motorhead
Localization.Description: Motorhead is a futuristic racing title featuring a total of ten playable cars on eight twisting courses, ranging from an industrial area to a desert. Each vehicle is individually rated in speed, acceleration, and grip.

Localization.Title: Motorhead
Localization.Description: Motorhead est un jeu de courses sur Playstation. Dans un univers futuriste, prenez place à bord d'une des 10 voitures proposées et affrontez 7 adversaires sur 8 pistes différentes. En remportant des courses, vous débloquez des voitures plus puissantes.

Localization.Title: Motorhead
Localization.Description: Motorhead ist ein futuristischer Renntitel mit insgesamt zehn spielbaren Autos auf acht kurvenreichen Kursen, die von einem Industriegebiet bis zu einer Wüste reichen.

Localization.Title: Motorhead
Localization.Description: Motorhead es un título de carreras futurista que presenta un total de diez vehículos en ocho circuitos sinuosos, que van desde un área industrial hasta un desierto. Cada vehículo se diferencia en velocidad, aceleración y agarre.

Localization.Title: Motorhead
Localization.Description: Motorhead is a futuristic racing title featuring a total of ten playable cars on eight twisting courses, ranging from an industrial area to a desert. Each vehicle is individually rated in speed, acceleration, and grip.

Localization.Title: Motorhead
Localization.Description: Motorhead is a futuristic racing title featuring a total of ten playable cars on eight twisting courses, ranging from an industrial area to a desert. Each vehicle is individually rated in speed, acceleration, and grip.

Localization.Title: Shadow Madness (Disc 2)
Localization.Description: Something is going wrong in the land of Arkose: cities destroy themselves, monsters attack innocent citizens, diseases spread among the people. A giant blast has destroyed a whole town, only a young guy named Stinger narrowly escaped death.

Localization.Title: Shadow Madness (Disc 2)
Localization.Description: Shadow Madness est un jeu de rôle sur Playstation. Vous êtes Stinger, un jeune garçon qui a échappé à la destruction de sa ville dans une gigantesque explosion. Avec l'aide de la femme elfe Widleaf et du robot Harv-5, il tente de se venger.

Localization.Title: Shadow Madness (Disc 2)
Localization.Description: Shadow Madness ist ein Rollenspiel für Playstation. Du bist Stinger, ein kleiner Junge, der der Zerstörung seiner Stadt durch eine gigantische Explosion entkommen ist. Mit Hilfe der Elfenfrau Widleaf und des Roboters Harv-5 versucht er sich zu rächen.

Localization.Title: Shadow Madness (Disc 2)
Localization.Description: Algo anda mal en la tierra de Arkose: las ciudades se destruyen a sí mismas, los monstruos atacan a ciudadanos inocentes, las enfermedades se propagan entre la gente.

Localization.Title: Shadow Madness (Disc 2)
Localization.Description: Qualcosa non va nella terra di Arkose: le città si distruggono da sole, i mostri attaccano cittadini innocenti, le malattie si diffondono tra la gente.

Localization.Title: Shadow Madness (Disc 2)
Localization.Description: Something is going wrong in the land of Arkose: cities destroy themselves, monsters attack innocent citizens, diseases spread among the people. A giant blast has destroyed a whole town, only a young guy named Stinger narrowly escaped death.

Localization.Title: Lucky Luke
Localization.Description: You, as Lucky Luke, have to stop the Dalton gang from making another crime. Walking around town you have to solve puzzles, shoot criminals and collect money. After finishing the level you have a chance to buy an extra life with the money collected.

Localization.Title: Lucky Luke
Localization.Description: Apprenez à tirer plus vite que votre ombre avec cette adaptation sur Playstation de la bande dessinée Lucky Luke. En incarnant le célèbre cow-boy, vous parcourez les saloons et déserts du Far West en compagnie de votre cheval Jolly Jumper.

Localization.Title: Lucky Luke
Localization.Description: Zum 50jährigen Jubiläum der Comicserie von Maurice de Bévere soll der coole Cowboy nun auf digitaler Ebene die Dalton-Bande dingfest machen.

Localization.Title: Lucky Luke
Localization.Description: Tú, como Lucky Luke, debes evitar que la banda de Dalton cometa otro crimen. Caminando por la ciudad tienes que resolver acertijos, disparar a criminales y recolectar dinero.

Localization.Title: Lucky Luke
Localization.Description: Tu, nei panni di Lucky Luke, devi impedire alla banda Dalton di commettere un altro crimine. Camminando per la città devi risolvere enigmi, sparare ai criminali e raccogliere denaro.

Localization.Title: Lucky Luke
Localization.Description: Você, como Lucky Luke, tem que impedir a gangue de Dalton de cometer outro crime. Andando pela cidade você tem que resolver quebra-cabeças, atirar em criminosos e coletar dinheiro.

Localization.Title: Colony Wars: Vengeance
Localization.Description: Colony Wars: Vengeance is a space combat simulator video game developed and released by Psygnosis for the PlayStation in 1998, and sequel to the original Colony Wars, released the previous year.

Localization.Title: Colony Wars : Vengeance

Localization.Title: The Next Tetris
Localization.Description: The Next Tetris sur Playstation est un puzzle-game combinant stratégie et réflexion dans lequel vous devez organiser les blocs qui tombent du haut de l'écran afin de réaliser des lignes horizontales.

Localization.Title: The Next Tetris
Localization.Description: The Next Tetris für Playstation ist ein Puzzlespiel, das Strategie und Reflexion kombiniert und bei dem Sie die Blöcke, die vom oberen Bildschirmrand fallen, so anordnen müssen, dass horizontale Linien entstehen.

Localization.Title: The Next Tetris
Localization.Description: The Next Tetris para Playstation es un juego de puzzles que combina estrategia y pensamiento en el que tienes que organizar los bloques que caen desde la parte superior de la pantalla para hacer líneas horizontales.

Localization.Title: The Next Tetris
Localization.Description: It's Tetris, only... new. The Tetris series returns to its roots, eschewing the Disney characters, 3D pieces, hats, and letters that have been tacked on previous entries. Contains the standard Tetris game, as well as some variants.

Localization.Title: Shadow Tower
Localization.Description: The dark shadow of the single-eyed crown reigned over the holy land of Zepter. The sealed, once-proud tower protecting the crown and and the Demon King is about to disappear into the earth, taking what remains of the town with it.

Localization.Title: Shadow Tower
Localization.Description: Le jeu se déroule sur le continent d'Eclipse, en Terre Sainte de Zeptar. Le joueur prend le rôle d'un mercenaire nommé Ruus Hardy. De retour à Zeptar, il découvre que toute la ville, ainsi que la tour centrale, ont été aspirées dans le monde souterrain.

Localization.Title: Shadow Tower
Localization.Description: Das Spiel findet auf dem Kontinent Eclipse im Heiligen Land Zeptar statt. Der Spieler übernimmt die Rolle eines Söldners namens Ruus Hardy.

Localization.Title: Shadow Tower
Localization.Description: La oscura sombra de la corona de un solo ojo reinaba sobre la tierra sagrada de Zepter. La torre sellada y antaño orgullosa que protegía la corona y al Rey Demonio está a punto de desaparecer en la tierra, llevándose consigo lo que queda de la ciudad.

Localization.Title: Shadow Tower
Localization.Description: L'ombra scura della corona con un occhio solo regnava sulla terra santa di Zepter. La torre sigillata, un tempo orgogliosa che protegge la corona e il Re Demone, sta per scomparire nella terra, portando con sé ciò che resta della città.

Localization.Title: Shadow Tower
Localization.Description: O jogo se passa no continente de Eclipse, na Terra Sagrada de Zeptar. O jogador assume o papel de um mercenário chamado Ruus Hardy.

Localization.Title: Ultimate 8 Ball
Localization.Description: With Ultimate 8 Ball, the designers at Mirage Technologies have created an option-filled and comprehensive pool simulation with features ranging from pool rules (learning) to pool school (execution).

Localization.Title: Ultimate 8 Ball
Localization.Description: Les meilleures tables de billard vous attendent sur Playstation avec Actua Pool. Préparez-vous à affronter seize adversaires dans les huit clubs les plus élitistes de la ville. Jouez au Jeu de la 8 et au Jeu de la 9 avec les règles officielles.

Localization.Title: Ultimate 8 Ball
Localization.Description: Kreiden Sie Ihre Queue ein - jetzt kommt Actua Pool, die unterhaltsame und umwerfend realistische 3D- Simulation von Gremlin Interactive. Spielen Sie auf phantastischen dreidimensionalen Tischen in verrauchten Bars, Casinos, Poolhallen und Nachtclubs.

Localization.Title: Ultimate 8 Ball
Localization.Description: Actua Pool es un juego de simulación de billar. Los modos de juego incluyen una partida de dos jugadores, modo hustle, tiros con trucos, torneos y un tutorial interactivo. Los torneos ganadores desbloquean nuevos oponentes para jugar.

Localization.Title: Ultimate 8 Ball
Localization.Description: With Ultimate 8 Ball, the designers at Mirage Technologies have created an option-filled and comprehensive pool simulation with features ranging from pool rules (learning) to pool school (execution).

Localization.Title: Ultimate 8 Ball
Localization.Description: Actua Pool é um jogo de simulação de bilhar. Os modos de jogo incluem um jogo de dois jogadores, modo hustle, truques, torneios e um tutorial interativo. Torneios vencedores desbloqueiam novos NPCs para jogar contra.

Localization.Title: Wipeout 3
Localization.Description: A futuristic racing game where the player pilots a high speed hover craft around a series of themed circuits, competing against a number of aggressive opponents.

Localization.Title: Wipeout 3
Localization.Description: Avec Wip3out sur Playstation faites monter votre adrénaline au plus haut sur des circuits complètement déjantés à bord de vaisseaux défiant les lois de la gravité et de la vitesse. Les premières places du podium se gagnent grâce à un arsenal dévastateur.

Localization.Title: Wipeout 3
Localization.Description: Das atemberaubende Anti-Gravitations-Rennen geht in die dritte Runde. Noch schneller, noch spannender und noch adrenalintreibender als je zuvor.

Localization.Title: Wipeout 3
Localization.Description: Juego de carreras futurista donde el jugador pilota una nave a alta velocidad a través de diferentes circuitos, compitiendo con agresivos oponentes.

Localization.Title: Wipeout 3
Localization.Description: Com o Wip3out em Playstation, ponha a sua adrenalina a bombear em pistas loucas a bordo de navios que desafiam as leis da gravidade e da velocidade. Os primeiros lugares no pódio são conquistados graças a um arsenal devastador.

Localization.Title: Colony Wars: Red Sun
Localization.Description: Colony Wars: Red Sun (called Colony Wars III: Red Sun in North America) is a space combat simulator video game for the PlayStation developed and released by Psygnosis in 2000.

Localization.Description: Colony Wars : Red Sun est un jeu d'action sur Playstation. Aux commandes d'un vaisseau spatial, vous avez le choix entre une vue à la première ou à la troisième personne.

Localization.Title: Colony Wars: Red Sun
Localization.Description: In Colony Wars: Red Sun geht es erneut in den Weltraum. Doch diesmal ist mein kein Pilot der Navy oder der Liga. Sondern ein Söldner namens Alexander Valdemar, der als Minenarbeiter sein Geld verdient.

Localization.Title: Colony Wars: Red Sun
Localization.Description: La lucha por salvar a la humanidad ha empezado... Con Vengeance Wars el combate está en pleno apogeo en los lugares más recónditos de la galaxia.

Localization.Description: Setze Dich gegen Skelette, Spinnen und Ausserirdische zur Wehr. Bekämpfe Roboter, Zombies, riesige Dinosaurier... In diesem gefährlichen, traum- und alptraumartigen 3D-Adventure ist jeder hinter Dir her.

Localization.Description: En el juego se debe tomar el control de Ruff o Tumble, dos niños hermanos que a través de los sueños deben rescatar los "Winks" que son unas pequeñas criaturas blancas y peludas que crean los dulces sueños, y Hoodwinks, son unas criaturas verdes de simil

Localization.Title: 40 Winks
Localization.Description: Lotta come un ninja. Trasformati in un robot... oppure in un mostro! Combatti contro scheletri, ragni e alieni. Lotta con robot, zombie e giganteschi dinosauri... In questo gioco d'avventura 3D, il pericolo è sempre in agguato.

Localization.Title: 40 Winks
Localization.Description: O jogador assume o controle de Ruff ou Tumble, um irmão e irmã que estão dormindo e tentando libertar 40 "Winks" de um homem chamado Nitekap e seu cúmplice, Threadbear.

Localization.Title: Spider-Man
Localization.Description: Spider-Man is the first 3D game to star the popular web-slinger. It is loosely based on Spider-Man: The Animated Series and Spider-Man Unlimited and features some of the voice cast from each and similar character designs.

Localization.Title: Spider-Man
Localization.Description: Spider-Man est un jeu d'action et de plates-formes sur Playstation. Vous incarnez l'homme araignée et vous êtes accusé d'avoir dérobé la découverte d'Octavius, aussi connu sous le nom de Docteur Octopus.

Localization.Title: Spider-Man
Localization.Description: Spider-Man ist das erste freibewegliche 3D-Action-Adventure, in dem Du Spider-Man in voller Montur spielst.

Localization.Title: Spider-Man
Localization.Description: No te limites a jugar... ¡Vívelo! Nuestro héroe puede lanzar una telaraña, balancearse por el aire, ejecutar un salto mortal y aterrizar tras una espectacular voltereta en la azotea del Daily Bugle.

Localization.Title: Spider-Man

Localization.Description: Spider-Man é um jogo de ação e plataforma no Playstation. Você é o homem aranha e é acusado de roubar a descoberta de Octavius, também conhecido como Dr. Octopus.

Localization.Title: R-Type Delta
Localization.Description: The Bydo Empire has returned to Earth with a vengeance. This time, they will not accept defeat so easily. Earth however, is ready for them... Three R-Class ships: the R-9, the R-13, and the prototype R-X, are your weapons in this war.

Localization.Title: R-Type Delta
Localization.Description: R-Type Delta est un jeu de tir sur Playstation. Les aliens décident que notre vieille Terre est intéressante et ils y construisent un camp de vacances permanent.

Localization.Title: R-Type Delta
Localization.Description: R-Type Delta ist die letzte Folge von Irem's Klassiker Serie der Weltraum Shoot'em up's. Durch die hervorragende 3D-Engine der Play Station kommt dieser Klassiker in einer Brillanz auf den Schirm, die ihresgleichen sucht.

Localization.Title: R-Type Delta
Localization.Description: El Imperio Bydo ha regresado a la Tierra con ganas de venganza. Esta vez, no van a aceptar la derrota tan fácilmente. Sin embargo, en la Tierra, están preparados para ellos ...

Localization.Title: R-Type Delta
Localization.Description: L'Impero Bydo è tornato sulla Terra con una vendetta. Questa volta non accetteranno la sconfitta così facilmente. La Terra, tuttavia, è pronta per loro... Tre navi di Classe R: la R-9, la R-13 e il prototipo R-X, saranno le tue armi in questa guerra.

Localization.Title: R-Type Delta
Localization.Description: O Império Bydo retornou à Terra com uma vingança. Desta vez, eles não aceitarão a derrota tão facilmente. Terra, no entanto, está pronta para eles ... Três navios da classe R: o R-9, o R-13 e o protótipo R-X são suas armas nesta guerra.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy Anthology: Final Fantasy V
Localization.Description: Set in a fantasy world with a technology level equivalent to that of the Second Industrial Revolution, the game's story focuses on a group of rebels as they seek to overthrow an imperial dictatorship.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy Anthology : Final Fantasy V
Localization.Description: Comprendre l'héritage du passé. Plusieurs siècles se sont écoulés depuis la guerre de la magie. Le monde s'est reconstruit et a donné naissance à la civilisation de l'acier, des machines et de la technologie.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy Anthology: Final Fantasy V
Localization.Description: Der Kampf der Zauberer liegt viele Jahrhunderte zurück. Mit Eisen, Maschinen und moderner Technik wurden Zivilisationen wiederaufgebaut.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy Anthology: Final Fantasy V
Localization.Description: Miles de años atrás, convivían en un mismo mundo dos razas: los humanos y los Espers, seres dotados de grandes poderes mágicos, pues su propia esencia tenía origen en la magia.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy Anthology: Final Fantasy V
Localization.Description: Ambientato in un mondo fantastico con un livello tecnologico equivalente a quello della Seconda Rivoluzione Industriale, la storia del gioco si concentra su un gruppo di ribelli che cercano di rovesciare una dittatura imperiale.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy Anthology: Final Fantasy V
Localization.Description: Situado num mundo de fantasia com um nível de tecnologia equivalente ao da Segunda Revolução Industrial, a história do jogo se concentra em um grupo de rebeldes que procuram derrubar uma ditadura imperial.

Localization.Title: Star Wars: Episode I: The Phantom Menace
Localization.Description: There is a disturbance in the force, and the Jedi are there to find its source. There is a whole Armada of Battleships and troops besieging a planet and two Jedi knights come to protect the planet.

Localization.Title: Star Wars : Episode I : The Phantom Menace
Localization.Description: Star Wars Episode 1 : La Menace Fantôme est un jeu d'action et d'aventure sur Playstation. Nos deux Jedi, le jeune Obi Wan et Qui Gonn, sont sur la station orbitale de la fédération du commerce, qui s'apprête à envahir la petite planète de Naboo.

Localization.Title: Star Wars: Episode I: The Phantom Menace
Localization.Description: In weiten Teilen der Galaktischen Republik herrscht Aufruhr. Die Besteuerung der Handelsrouten zu den äußeren Systemen ist heftig umstritten.

Localization.Title: Star Wars: Episode I: The Phantom Menace
Localization.Description: El caos envuelve la República Galáctica. Los impuestos de las rutas comerciales de los sistemas más remotos están en disputa.

Localization.Title: Star Wars: Episode I: The Phantom Menace
Localization.Description: C'è un disturbo nella forza e i Jedi sono lì per trovare la sua fonte. C'è un'intera armata di corazzate e truppe che assediano un pianeta e due cavalieri Jedi vengono a proteggere il pianeta.

Localization.Title: Star Wars: Episode I: The Phantom Menace
Localization.Description: Há uma perturbação na força e os Jedi estão lá para encontrar sua fonte. Há toda uma armada de navios de guerra e tropas sitiando um planeta e dois cavaleiros Jedi vêm para proteger o planeta.

rom.name: Star Wars - Episode I - The Phantom Menace (USA).cue

Localization.Title: Tomb Raider: The Last Revelation
Localization.Description: According to Egyptian legend, Horus, son of the light, outwitted the evil God Set and imprisoned him in a secret tomb.

Localization.Title: Tomb Raider : The Last Revelation
Localization.Description: "Il est l'ombre sur le soleil, le porteur des fléaux et sa colère, sans limites, consumera la terre." Une légende de l'ancienne Egypte raconte que Seth, le Dieu de la désolation, fut vaincu et emprisonné dans une tombe secrète.

Localization.Title: Tomb Raider: The Last Revelation
Localization.Description: Eine uralte Legende, ein böser Geist und eine Warnung an die Zukunft: Er ist der Schatten vor der Sonne, der Auslöser aller Seuchen, sein Zorn frißt das ganze Land, und sein Hunger wird unersättlich sein.

Localization.Title: Tomb Raider: The Last Revelation
Localization.Description: Tomb Raider: The Last Revelation (en español Tomb Raider: La última revelación) es el cuarto videojuego de la serie Tomb Raider. La historia comienza con una joven Lara Croft, acompañada por su antiguo mentor, Werner Von Croy.

Localization.Title: Tomb Raider: The Last Revelation
Localization.Description: Secondo la leggenda egizia, Horus, figlio della luce, sconfisse in astuzia il malvagio dio Set e lo imprigionò in una tomba segreta.

Localization.Title: Tomb Raider: The Last Revelation
Localization.Description: De acordo com a lenda egípcia, Hórus, filho da luz, enganou o malvado Deus Set e o aprisionou em uma tumba secreta.

Localization.Title: Chessmaster II
Localization.Description: Starsphere Interactive and Mindscape presents Chessmaster II for the PlayStation, the second edition of the popular original that many chess fans favored no matter what platform it was developed on.

Localization.Title: Chessmaster II
Localization.Description: Le jeu d'échecs le plus complet et le plus impressionnant disponible sur Playstation.

Localization.Title: Chessmaster II
Localization.Description: Starsphere Interactive und Mindscape präsentieren Chessmaster II für die PlayStation, die zweite Ausgabe des beliebten Originals, das viele Schachfans bevorzugten, egal auf welcher Plattform es entwickelt wurde.

Localization.Title: Chessmaster II
Localization.Description: Starsphere Interactive y Mindscape presentan Chessmaster II para la PlayStation, la segunda edición de la popular original que muchos aficionados al ajedrez favorecieron sin importar en qué plataforma se desarrolló.

Localization.Title: Chessmaster II
Localization.Description: Starsphere Interactive and Mindscape presents Chessmaster II for the PlayStation, the second edition of the popular original that many chess fans favored no matter what platform it was developed on.

Localization.Title: Chessmaster II

Localization.Title: Action Man: Operation Extreme
Localization.Description: Action Man: Operation Extreme features two different gameplay modes that you switch back and forth from during the course of play.

Localization.Title: Action Man : Operation Extreme
Localization.Description: Inspiré des jouets et de la série télé du même nom, Action Man : Mission Extrême sur Playstation met en scène le plus grand de tous les héros en route pour l'île du Dr X.

Localization.Title: Action Man: Operation Extreme
Localization.Description: Action Man: Operation Extreme bietet zwei Spielmodi, zwischen denen im Verlauf gewechselt wird. Der erste ist ein Top‑Down‑Fahrzeugmodus, dessen Perspektive und Steuerung der GTA‑Reihe ähnelt.

Localization.Title: Action Man: Operation Extreme
Localization.Description: Juguetes inspirados y la serie de televisión del mismo nombre, hombre de acción: Misión Lejano Playstation pone el escenario más grande de todos los héroes en el camino a la isla del Dr. X.

Localization.Title: Action Man: Operation Extreme
Localization.Description: Gioco ispirato e l'omonima serie televisiva, Action Man: Mission Far Away Playstation mette il palcoscenico più grande di tutti gli eroi sulla strada per l'isola del Dr. X.

Localization.Title: Action Man: Operation Extreme
Localization.Description: Inspired Toys e a série de TV com o mesmo nome, Man of Action: Mission Far Playstation define o maior palco para todos os heróis a caminho da ilha do Dr. X. Os planos finais para destruir o planeta, fazendo múltiplas experiências na natureza.

Localization.Title: Worms Armageddon
Localization.Description: Gameplay is turn-based, with each team moving in sequence (which is determined randomly) across two-dimensional terrain. During a single turn, a team can only move one of its worms (unless the Select Worm item is used).

Localization.Title: Worms Armageddon
Localization.Description: Worms Armageddon sur Playstation est un jeu d'action stratégique mettant en scène des équipes de vers de terre combattant dans un environnement en 2D.

Localization.Title: Worms Armageddon
Localization.Description: Die beliebten Kampfwürmer rüsten auf der PlayStation auf: Neben den althergebrachten Bomben und Raketen machen sie sich nun mit 30 zusätzlichen Waffen wie "Superschaf" oder "Indianischer Nukleartest" gegenseitig das Leben schwer.

Localization.Title: Worms Armageddon
Localization.Description: Worms Armageddon es un videojuego de estrategia por turnos desarrollado por Team17 y parte de la serie Worms.

Localization.Title: Worms Armageddon
Localization.Description: Gameplay is turn-based, with each team moving in sequence (which is determined randomly) across two-dimensional terrain. During a single turn, a team can only move one of its worms (unless the Select Worm item is used).

Localization.Title: Worms Armageddon
Localization.Description: Worms Armageddon é um jogo eletrônico de Estratégia por turnos e artilharia desenvolvido pela Team17 no qual o objetivo do modo de jogo convencional é acabar com as minhocas do(s) oponente(s).

Localization.Title: Pong: The Next Level
Localization.Description: The classic videogame PONG is getting a 32-bit update. Players control a long, flat rectangular rod and maneuver it up and down the screen to defend their goal.

Localization.Title: Pong : The Next Level
Localization.Description: Disponible sur Playstation, Pong revient sous une nouvelle forme aux graphismes entièrement modélisés en 3D. De nombreux modes de jeu accompagnent cette version comme le Jungle Pong ou le Football Pong.

Localization.Title: Pong: The Next Level
Localization.Description: Das klassische Videospiel PONG erhält ein 32-Bit-Update. Die Spieler steuern einen langen, flachen, rechteckigen Stab und manövrieren ihn auf dem Bildschirm auf und ab, um ihr Tor zu verteidigen.

Localization.Title: Pong: The Next Level
Localization.Description: El juego que empezó todo es ahora una experiencia 3D increíble. La premisa es la misma, evitar que tu oponente marque puntos.

Localization.Title: Pong: The Next Level
Localization.Description: The classic videogame PONG is getting a 32-bit update. Players control a long, flat rectangular rod and maneuver it up and down the screen to defend their goal.

Localization.Title: Pong: The Next Level
Localization.Description: O videogame clássico PONG está recebendo uma atualização de 32 bits. Os jogadores controlam uma haste retangular longa e plana e manobram-na para cima e para baixo na tela para defender seu objetivo.

Localization.Title: Glover
Localization.Description: The single-handed hero Glover and his trusty rubber ball has come to the PlayStation console with an adventure that spans over thirty levels set throughout six unique worlds! Taking place in the Crystal Kingdom, a well-natured wizard was mixing a new pot

Localization.Title: Glover
Localization.Description: Glover est un jeu de réflexion/plates-formes sur Playstation. Vous jouez le rôle de Glover, un gant qui évolue dans un univers en 3D. A votre disposition vous avez une balle, et à vous deux réunis, une grande panoplie de mouvements vous est offerte.

Localization.Title: Glover
Localization.Description: Alle Hände voll zu tun! Nichts für Grobmotoriker oder Liebhaber einer ruhigen Kugel ist Ataris neuester Geschicklichkeitsspaß. Feinmotorik und echte Handarbeit sind bei Glover unbedingte Voraussetzung.

Localization.Title: Glover
Localization.Description: Un mago está mezclando un lote de pociones mágicas, cuando una explosión envía sus guantes al aire. Uno aterriza fuera del castillo, pero el otro aterriza en una mezcla malvada de pociones. Es este malvado guante el que decide tomar el castillo.

Localization.Title: Glover
Localization.Description: The single-handed hero Glover and his trusty rubber ball has come to the PlayStation console with an adventure that spans over thirty levels set throughout six unique worlds! Taking place in the Crystal Kingdom, a well-natured wizard was mixing a new pot

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy VIII (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: A member of an elite military team, Squall is forced into a conflict beyond imagination. To survive, he must contend with a desperate rival, a powerful sorceress, and his own mysterious dreams.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy VIII (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Squall fait partie d'un escadron militaire d'élite et se voit obligé de participer à un conflit dépassant les limites de l'imagination.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy VIII (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: In Final Fantasy VIII schlüpfst du in die Rolle von Squall, einem Mitglied einer Elite-Militärtruppe, der in einen Konflikt mit einem rivalisierenden Gegner, einer mächtigen Hexe und seinen eigenen mysteriösen Träumen verwickelt wird.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy VIII (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Squall, un miembro de un cuerpo de élite del ejército, se ve forzado a entrar en un conflicto que traspasa los límites de la imaginación. Para sobrevivir, debe enfrentarse a un rival desesperado, una poderosa hechicera y a sus propios sueños misteriosos.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy VIII (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Membro di una squadra militare d'élite, Squall è costretto a un conflitto oltre ogni immaginazione. Per sopravvivere, deve lottare con un rivale disperato, una potente strega e con i suoi sogni misteriosi.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy VIII (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: A história se passa em um mundo que mistura elementos de fantasia e ficção científica, seguindo um grupo de jovens mercenários liderados por Squall Leonhart e que trabalham para uma organização chamada SeeD.

Localization.Title: Disney/Pixar Toy Story 2: Buzz Lightyear to the Rescue!
Localization.Description: Woody has been stolen from the bedroom, ready to be sold to the highest bidder by an evil toy collector.

Localization.Title: Disney/Pixar Toy Story 2 : Buzz Lightyear to the Rescue!
Localization.Description: Toy Story 2 sur Playstation est un jeu de plates-formes dans lequel vous incarnez Buzz l'éclair, un Ranger de l'espace. Vous avez du pain sur la planche car Woody a été enlevé par un collectionneur de jouets sans scrupules.

Localization.Title: Disney/Pixar Toy Story 2: Buzz Lightyear to the Rescue!
Localization.Description: Als Spielzeugheld Buzz Lightyear haben Sie alle Hände voll zu tun. Ihr bester Freund Woody muß aus den Fängen eines übereifrigen Spielzeugsammlers gerettet werden - ein Wettlauf mit der Zeit beginnt.

Localization.Title: Disney/Pixar Toy Story 2: Buzz Lightyear to the Rescue!
Localization.Description: ¡Ya ha empezado la cuenta atrás para la aventura! Vas a manejar al héroe Buzz Lightyear, una tarea que requerirá toda tu atención. Tu mejor amigo, Woody, ha sido secuestrado por un coleccionista de juguetes y tienes que rescatarlo en un tiempo limitado.

Localization.Title: Disney/Pixar Toy Story 2: Buzz Lightyear to the Rescue!
Localization.Description: Woody è stato rubato dalla camera da letto, pronto per essere venduto al miglior offerente da un malvagio collezionista di giocattoli.

Localization.Title: Disney/Pixar Toy Story 2: Buzz Lightyear to the Rescue!
Localization.Description: Woody foi roubado do quarto, pronto para ser vendido pelo lance mais alto por um colecionador de brinquedos malvado.

rom.name: Disney-Pixar Toy Story 2 - Buzz Lightyear to the Rescue! (USA).cue

Localization.Title: Juggernaut (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Juggernaut is a slow-paced, point-and-click adventure in the same vein as the PC title Myst.

Localization.Title: Juggernaut (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Juggernaut emmène le joueur dans un étrange voyage à travers la possession démoniaque et le pouvoir du mal.

Localization.Title: Juggernaut (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Juggernaut ist ein langsames Point-and-Click-Adventure im Stil des PC-Titels Myst.

Localization.Title: Juggernaut (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Juggernaut es una aventura point-and-click de ritmo lento, en la misma línea que el título para PC Myst.

Localization.Title: Shadow Man
Localization.Description: You're the Shadow Man, a person who can switch between the world of the dead and of the living. In Shadow Man your mission is to prevent 5 serial killers from bringing the total armageddon.

Localization.Title: Shadow Man
Localization.Description: Vous êtes Shadow Man et avez la capacité de passer du monde des vivants au monde des morts en un claquement de doigts. Dans ce jeu sur Playstation, vous devez empêcher des tueurs en série de plonger le monde dans le chaos.

Localization.Title: Shadow Man
Localization.Description: Durch den kaltblütigen Mord an seinem kleinen Bruder Luke ist Professor Mike LeRoi zu einem gewissenlosen Rächer geworden.

Localization.Title: Shadow Man
Localization.Description: Hace mucho tiempo, el caos reinaba en la Tierra. Criaturas malignas descendieronen ambos mundos (vivos y muertos). A estos se les llamaron "Los Amos Obscuros" y que eran dirigidos por "El Que son Muchos" "El Que es Todos".

Localization.Title: Shadow Man
Localization.Description: Sei l'Uomo Ombra, una persona che può passare dal mondo dei morti a quello dei vivi. In Shadow Man la tua missione è impedire a 5 serial killer di portare l'armageddon totale. Nel mondo dei vivi, sei mortale e hai armi convenzionali.

Localization.Title: Shadow Man
Localization.Description: You're the Shadow Man, a person who can switch between the world of the dead and of the living. In Shadow Man your mission is to prevent 5 serial killers from bringing the total armageddon.

Localization.Title: The Misadventures of Tron Bonne
Localization.Description: Rather than focusing on the heroic protagonists of Mega Man Legends series, the game follows series anti-hero Tron Bonne, sister of the criminal Bonne family of air pirates.

Localization.Title: The Misadventures of Tron Bonne
Localization.Description: The Misadventures of Tron Bonne est un jeu d'action qui fait partie de la série Mega Man Legends mais qui se situe chronologiquement en amont de tous les autres épisodes.

Localization.Title: The Misadventures of Tron Bonne
Localization.Description: „The Misadventures of Tron Bonne“ ist ein Actionspiel, das Teil der Mega Man Legends-Reihe ist, aber chronologisch allen anderen Episoden vorgelagert ist.

Localization.Title: The Misadventures of Tron Bonne
Localization.Description: En lugar de centrarse en los heroicos protagonistas de la serie Mega Man Legends, el juego sigue a la serie antihéroe Tron Bonne, hermana de la familia criminal de piratas aéreos Bonne.

Localization.Title: The Misadventures of Tron Bonne
Localization.Description: Rather than focusing on the heroic protagonists of Mega Man Legends series, the game follows series anti-hero Tron Bonne, sister of the criminal Bonne family of air pirates.

Localization.Title: The Misadventures of Tron Bonne
Localization.Description: Em vez de focar nos protagonistas heróicos da série Mega Man Legends, o jogo segue o anti-herói da série Tron Bonne, irmã da família de piratas aéreos criminosos Bonne.

Localization.Title: Countdown Vampires (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Keith J. Snyder is a policeman hired to provide security for a new horror-themed casino called the Desert Moon. Suddenly a fire breaks out and a mysterious black liquid starts to pour out of the water sprinklers, turning people into vampires.

Localization.Title: Countdown Vampires (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Countdown Vampires est un survival-horror sur Playstation dans lequel vous incarnez Keitte à un incendie.

Localization.Title: Countdown Vampires (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Keith J. Snyder ist ein Polizist, der angeheuert wurde, um für die Sicherheit eines neuen Horror-Casinos namens Desert Moon zu sorgen.

Localization.Title: Countdown Vampires (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Keith J. Snyder es un policía contratado para brindar seguridad en un casino con temática de horror llamado Desert Moon.

Localization.Title: Lunar: Silver Star Story Complete (Disc 2) (Collector's Edition)
Localization.Description: Alex, a young boy from a small humble town, enters a life of adventure and intrigue after being chosen as the heir-apparent to the title of "Dragonmaster", guardian of the forces of the planet.

Localization.Title: Lunar : Silver Star Story Complete (Disc 2) (Collector's Edition)
Localization.Description: Lunar : Silver Star Story Complete est un remake sur Playstation du classique jeu de rôle japonais sur Sega CD, Lunar : Silver Star. Vous incarnez un jeune garçon du nom d'Alex qui rêve de devenir un Dragon Master comme son idole, Dyne.

Localization.Title: Lunar: Silver Star Story Complete (Disc 2) (Collector's Edition)
Localization.Description: Lunar: Silver Star Story Complete ist eine Neuauflage des Spiels Lunar: The Silver Star, welches erstmals im Jahre 1992 auf dem Sega CD in Japan erschien.

Localization.Title: Lunar: Silver Star Story Complete (Disc 2) (Collector's Edition)
Localization.Description: Lunar - Silver Star Story fue originalmente lanzado en Sega CD. En su momento, fue uno de los juegos de rol más apreciados y cosechó una enorme aclamación de la crítica y los jugadores.

Localization.Title: Lunar: Silver Star Story Complete (Disc 2) (Collector's Edition)
Localization.Description: Lunar: Silver Star Story Complete è un remake per PlayStation del classico gioco di ruolo giapponese per Sega CD, Lunar: Silver Star. Giocherai nei panni di un giovane ragazzo di nome Alex che sogna di diventare un Maestro Drago come il suo idolo, Dyne.

Localization.Title: Lunar: Silver Star Story Complete (Disc 2) (Collector's Edition)
Localization.Description: Lunar: Silver Star Story foi originalmente lançado no Sega CD. Em sua época, foi um dos jogos de RPG mais queridos e recebeu grande aclamação da crítica de críticos e jogadores.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy Anthology: Final Fantasy VI
Localization.Description: Set in a fantasy world with a technology level equivalent to that of the Second Industrial Revolution, the game's story focuses on a group of rebels as they seek to overthrow an imperial dictatorship.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy Anthology : Final Fantasy VI
Localization.Description: Comprendre l'héritage du passé. Plusieurs siècles se sont écoulés depuis la guerre de la magie. Le monde s'est reconstruit et a donné naissance à la civilisation de l'acier, des machines et de la technologie.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy Anthology: Final Fantasy VI
Localization.Description: Der Kampf der Zauberer liegt viele Jahrhunderte zurück. Mit Eisen, Maschinen und moderner Technik wurden Zivilisationen wiederaufgebaut.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy Anthology: Final Fantasy VI
Localization.Description: Miles de años atrás, convivían en un mismo mundo dos razas: los humanos y los Espers, seres dotados de grandes poderes mágicos, pues su propia esencia tenía origen en la magia.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy Anthology: Final Fantasy VI
Localization.Description: Ambientato in un mondo fantastico con un livello tecnologico equivalente a quello della Seconda Rivoluzione Industriale, la storia del gioco si concentra su un gruppo di ribelli che cercano di rovesciare una dittatura imperiale.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy Anthology: Final Fantasy VI
Localization.Description: Situado num mundo de fantasia com um nível de tecnologia equivalente ao da Segunda Revolução Industrial, a história do jogo se concentra em um grupo de rebeldes que procuram derrubar uma ditadura imperial.

rom.name: Final Fantasy Anthology - Final Fantasy VI (USA).cue

Localization.Title: Silent Bomber
Localization.Description: Silent Bomber is an old school style game which takes place in the future. You play as a character named Jutah Fate, a genetically engineered man created by the government. You're an expert at using bombs.

Localization.Title: Silent Bomber
Localization.Description: Silent Bomber est un jeu d'action sur Playstation. Vous voici donc dans la peau de Jutah, un Silent Bomber, pour tenter de libérer l'humanité de l'emprise des androïdes. Pour ce faire, vous disposerez d'un arsenal impressionnant.

Localization.Title: Silent Bomber
Localization.Description: Silent Bomber ist ein Actionspiel für Playstation. Hier schlüpfen Sie also in die Rolle von Jutah, einem stillen Bomber, der versucht, die Menschheit aus dem Griff der Androiden zu befreien. Dafür verfügen Sie über ein beeindruckendes Arsenal.

Localization.Title: Silent Bomber
Localization.Description: Juega como un personaje llamado Jutah Fate, un hombre genéticamente creado por el gobierno. Eres un experto en usar bombas.

Localization.Title: Scrabble
Localization.Description: Hasbro Interactive's best-selling computer title based on one of the world's most famous word games has made the translation to the PlayStation with real-time 3D graphics and support for up to four players.

Localization.Title: Scrabble
Localization.Description: Scrabble est un jeu de société sur Playstation. Vous devez former des mots sur un plateau pour récolter le plus de points possible. A chaque lettre est en effet associée une valeur inversement proportionnelle à sa fréquence dans la langue française.

Localization.Title: Scrabble
Localization.Description: Scrabble ist ein Brettspiel auf der Playstation. Sie müssen Wörter auf einer Tafel bilden, um so viele Punkte wie möglich zu sammeln.

Localization.Title: Scrabble
Localization.Description: El superventas para ordenador de Hasbro Interactive, basado en uno de los juegos de palabras más famosos del mundo, se ha trasladado a la PlayStation con gráficos en 3D en tiempo real y soporte para hasta cuatro jugadores.

Localization.Title: Q*bert
Localization.Description: Hasbro Interactive continues their series of classic Arcade game remakes with Q*bert for the PlayStation. In this disc you'll find the original game, a new Adventure mode and a special Head-To-Head contest.

Localization.Title: Q*bert
Localization.Description: Q*bert est un jeu de réflexion sur Playstation. Aidez Q*bert à sauver ses amis au moyen de puzzles 3D plus difficiles les uns que les autres. Le soft propose 4 mondes divisés chacun en 6 niveaux, avec 3 modes de jeu : classique, aventure et un contre un.

Localization.Title: Q*bert
Localization.Description: Die Schlange King Coily hat Q-Bert's Freunde entführt und in andere Dimensionen gebracht. Q-Bert muss die Tore zu den Dimensionen öffnen und seine Freunde befreien.

Localization.Description: Hasbro Interactive continúa su serie de clásicos remakes de juegos Arcade con Q*bert para la PlayStation. En este disco encontrarás el juego original, un nuevo modo de aventura y un concurso especial de cara a cara.

Localization.Description: "Gekido: Urban Fighters" es un juego de lucha en 3D, inspirado en los clásicos beat-em-ups 2D. El año es 2011 y el antivirus de unos hackers se ha convertido en una entidad independiente.

Localization.Description: "Gekido: Urban Fighters" è un gioco di combattimento 3D ispirato ai classici picchiaduro 2D. Siamo nel 2011 e l'antivirus di alcuni hacker è diventato un'entità indipendente.

Localization.Description: In der gar nicht weit entfernten Zukunft liegt die Macht in den Händen zweier Unternehmen. Militär und Technologie stehen einander gegenüber. In Ihrer Rolle als Pilot einer Friedenssicherungsorganisation müssen Sie diesen Konflikt eindämmen.

Localization.Description: Em Ace Combat 3: Electrosphere o jogador toma o lugar de um piloto de caça ace que trabalha para uma organização chamada "UPEO" e tem que realizar várias missões, por exemplo, tirar um porta-aviões especial ou tirar sistemas de satélite inimigos em órbit

Localization.Title: Dune 2000
Localization.Description: Dune 2000 is a remake of the classic Dune II updated for Windows. In this Real-Time Strategy game, you can play one of the three houses, the evil Harkonnen, the greed filled Ordos or the noble Atreides.

Localization.Title: Dune 2000
Localization.Description: Disponible sur Playstation, Dune 2000 est un jeu de stratégie en temps réel inspiré des romans de Frank Herbert. Des cinématiques live ponctuent l'avancement du scénario en solo. Trois factions différentes sont jouables : Ordos, Atréide et Harkonnen.

Localization.Title: Dune 2000
Localization.Description: Echtzeitstrategie war noch nie so fesselnd. Erkunden Sie ein völlig neuartiges Umgebungssystem mit detaillierten Einheiten und Strukturen in 3D. Wählen Sie einen von drei möglichen Charakteren aus, als der Sie kämpfen möchten.

Localization.Title: Dune 2000
Localization.Description: Dune 2000 es una nueva versión del clásico Dune II. En este juego de estrategia en tiempo real, puedes jugar en una de las tres casas, la malvada Harkonnen, los Ordos lleno de codicia o la noble Atreides.

Localization.Title: Dune 2000
Localization.Description: Dune 2000 is a remake of the classic Dune II updated for Windows. In this Real-Time Strategy game, you can play one of the three houses, the evil Harkonnen, the greed filled Ordos or the noble Atreides.

Localization.Title: Dune 2000
Localization.Description: Dune 2000 é um remake do clássico Dune II atualizado para Windows. Neste jogo de estratégia em tempo real, você pode jogar em uma das três casas, o malvado Harkonnen, o ganancioso Ordos ou o nobre Atreides.

Localization.Title: Medal of Honor
Localization.Description: FIGHT WWII FOR THE FIRST TIME Tomorrow is D-Day. Tonight you land behind enemy lines. The tide of the war is in your hands. Your are an elite Special Forces agent sent to execute covert operations, search and rescue missions, and commando raids.

Localization.Title: Medal of Honor
Localization.Description: Dans Medal of Honor, un jeu de tir à la première personne sur Playstation, vous incarnez un membre des forces spéciales parachuté derrière les lignes ennemies en 1944.

Localization.Title: Medal of Honor
Localization.Description: Morgen ist D-Day. Heute Nacht landest Du hinter feindlichen Linien. Der Ausgang des Kriegs liegt in Deinen Händen. Du bist ein Elite-Spezialagent, der auf verdeckte Operationen, Such- und Rettungsmissionen geschickt wird.

Localization.Title: Medal of Honor
Localization.Description: Lucha por primera vez en la segunda guerra mundial. Mañana es el Día D. Esta noche aterrizará detrás de las líneas enemigas. El destino de la guerra está en sus manos.

Localization.Title: Medal of Honor
Localization.Description: Medal of Honor è uno sparatutto in prima persona per PlayStation in cui giochi nei panni di un membro delle forze speciali paracadutato dietro le linee nemiche nel 1944.

Localization.Title: Medal of Honor
Localization.Description: Medal of Honor é um jogo de tiro em primeira pessoa no Playstation em que você joga como um membro das Forças Especiais em paraquedas atrás das linhas inimigas em 1944.

Localization.Title: 007: Tomorrow Never Dies
Localization.Description: In 007: Tomorrow Never Dies, which is based on the movie of the same name, the player takes the role of the famous James Bond who fights against Elliot Carver. Carver tries to increase his TV ratings by creating a war between the British and the Chinese.

Localization.Title: 007 : Tomorrow Never Dies
Localization.Description: Demain Ne Meurt Jamais est un jeu d'action sorti sur Playstation. Retrouvez l'agent le moins secret de Sa Majesté dans cette adaptation du film du même nom. Au programme de l'action, des gadgets, des voitures de rêve et de fabuleuses James Bond Girls.

Localization.Title: 007: Tomorrow Never Dies
Localization.Description: Setze als weltmännischer Geheimagent 007 Dein Köpfchen und Deine High-Tech-Geräte ein, um Dich durch die vielen Spionage-Level zu kämpfen. Die Story beruht auf den spannenden Szenen des erfolgreichen Kinofilms, es gibt z.B. Schieß-, Fahr- und Ski-Modi.

Localization.Title: 007: Tomorrow Never Dies
Localization.Description: En 007: El Mañana Nunca Muere, basado en la película del mismo nombre, el jugador toma el papel del famoso James Bond que lucha contra Elliot Carver.

Localization.Title: 007: Tomorrow Never Dies
Localization.Description: In 007: Il domani non muore mai, basato sull'omonimo film, il giocatore assume il ruolo del famoso James Bond che combatte contro Elliot Carver. Carver cerca di aumentare i suoi ascolti televisivi creando una guerra tra inglesi e cinesi.

Localization.Title: 007: Tomorrow Never Dies
Localization.Description: Em 007: Tomorrow Never Dies, que é baseado no filme de mesmo nome, o jogador assume o papel do famoso James Bond que luta contra Elliot Carver. Carver tenta aumentar sua audiência na TV criando uma guerra entre os britânicos e os chineses.

Localization.Description: Warpath : Jurassic Park est un jeu d'action sur Playstation. Incarnez l'un des 14 dinosaures disponibles tels que le T-Rex et le Mega Raptor. Combattez dans plus de 10 zones de combat tirées de Jurassic Park et détruisez tout sur votre passage.

Localization.Title: Warpath: Jurassic Park
Localization.Description: Warpath - Jurassic Park ist ein Spiel von Black Ops Entertainment, das von Electronic Arts vertrieben wird. Es gehört zum Action-Genre, Unterkategorie Prügelspiel und ist am 31.10.1999 erschienen.

Localization.Title: Warpath: Jurassic Park
Localization.Description: El juego ofrece muchos de los Dinosaurios de las dos películas de Jurassic Park, se elige el tipo y luchas contra él en un combate uno-a-uno con otros dinosaurios para así convertirse en el supremo Dino del parque.

Localization.Title: Xena: Warrior Princess
Localization.Description: Grab your Chakram and sword, because the evil sorceress Kalabrax has broken free after centuries of imprisonment. She will finally get her revenge upon the gods who imprisoned her and the world they created. Only one thing is stopping her.

Localization.Title: Xena : Warrior Princess
Localization.Description: Xena : Princesse Guerrière est un jeu d'action sur Playstation. Vous incarnez Xena, la princesse guerrière, et parcourez le pays des songes dans lequel vous êtes enfermé.

Localization.Title: Xena: Warrior Princess
Localization.Description: Basierend auf der gleichnamigen TV-Serie, schlüpft ihr in diesem Action-Spiel in die Rolle der Kriegerin Xena. Euer böser Gegenspieler, der Zauberer Kalabrax, will die Weltherrschaft an sich reißen.

Localization.Title: Xena: Warrior Princess
Localization.Description: Xena: Warrior Princess es un juego que combina acción, aventura y elementos de lucha en tercera persona. Manejas a Xena, una guerrera poderosa que recorre el mundo antiguo en busca de aventuras y justicia.

Localization.Title: Xena: Warrior Princess
Localization.Description: Afferra il tuo Chakram e la tua spada, perché la malvagia maga Kalabrax si è liberata dopo secoli di prigionia. Finalmente si vendicherà degli dei che l'hanno imprigionata e del mondo che hanno creato. Solo una cosa la ferma.

Localization.Title: Xena: Warrior Princess
Localization.Description: Grab your Chakram and sword, because the evil sorceress Kalabrax has broken free after centuries of imprisonment. She will finally get her revenge upon the gods who imprisoned her and the world they created. Only one thing is stopping her.

Localization.Description: Barbie makes her first appearance on the PlayStation with BARBIE RACE AND RIDE. Help Barbie take care of a stable of horses; groom the horses or feed them a variety of foods including apples, carrots, strawberries, and sugar cubes.

Localization.Title: Barbie : Race & Ride
Localization.Description: Dans Barbie : Aventure Equestre sur Playstation, aidez la poupée à s'occuper d'un haras. Apportez les soins quotidiens aux cheveux, nourrissez-les et profitez d'eux pour vous promener.

Localization.Title: Barbie: Race & Ride
Localization.Description: Barbie hat ihren ersten Auftritt auf der PlayStation mit BARBIE RACE AND RIDE. Hilf Barbie dabei, sich um einen Pferdestall zu kümmern.

Localization.Description: Barbie hace su primera aparición en PlayStation con BARBIE RACE AND RIDE. Ayuda a Barbie a cuidar un establo de caballos; Acicale a los caballos o aliméntelos con una variedad de alimentos, incluyendo manzanas, zanahorias, fresas y terrones de azúcar.

Localization.Title: Barbie: Race & Ride

Localization.Title: Barbie: Race & Ride
Localization.Description: Barbie faz sua primeira aparição no PlayStation com BARBIE RACE AND RIDE. Ajude Barbie a cuidar de um estábulo de cavalos; escove os cavalos ou alimente-os com uma variedade de alimentos, incluindo maçãs, cenouras, morangos e cubos de açúcar.

Localization.Title: South Park Rally
Localization.Description: Choose your character from the cast of the popular 'mature' cartoon South Park, and tear through the streets in this racing game. Your character's vehicle may be a little cart, trike, or box, for example.

Localization.Title: South Park Rally
Localization.Description: South Park Rally sur Playstation est un jeu de courses reprenant la licence de la série animée à l'humour corrosif.

Localization.Title: South Park Rally
Localization.Description: South Park Rally für Playstation ist ein Rennspiel, das auf der Lizenz der Zeichentrickserie mit ätzendem Humor basiert.

Localization.Title: South Park Rally
Localization.Description: Elige a tu personaje del elenco del famoso South Park de dibujos animados 'maduros' y lánzate por las calles en este juego de carreras. El vehículo de tu personaje puede ser un pequeño carrito, triciclo o una caja, por ejemplo.

Localization.Title: South Park Rally
Localization.Description: Scegli il tuo personaggio dal cast del famoso cartone animato "maturo" South Park e sfreccia per le strade in questo gioco di corse. Il veicolo del tuo personaggio potrebbe essere un carretto, un trike o una scatola, per esempio.

Localization.Title: Galerians (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Rion wakes-up in a hospital room, and the only thing he can remember is his name. However, Rion is no ordinary 14-year old. He is a Galerian?a human with special psychic powers.

Localization.Title: Galerians (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Galerians est un jeu d'action/aventure de science-fiction sur Playstation. Dans la peau d'un garçon amnésique de 14 ans, vous devrez tout faire pour retrouver la mémoire, quitte à affronter bon nombre d'adversaires.

Localization.Title: Galerians (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Rion, ein begabter junger Mann mit telekinetischen Fähigkeiten, ist gefangen in einem Strudel von Gewalt, Drogen und Wahnvorstellungen. Der Kampf zwischen Gut und Böse wird in den Häuserschluchten der japanischen Metropole Tokio ausgetragen.

Localization.Title: Galerians (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: 500 años en el futuro, un niño se despierta en un hospital sin ningún recuerdo de quién es o cómo llegó allí. Poco a poco, con el uso de poderes psíquicos, encontrarás pistas para desbloquear tu pasado.

Localization.Title: Galerians (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Galerians è un gioco di azione/avventura di fantascienza per Playstation. Nei panni di un ragazzo di 14 anni affetto da amnesia, dovrai fare di tutto per ritrovare la memoria, anche se ciò significa affrontare numerosi avversari.

Localization.Title: Galerians (Disc 1)
Localization.Description: Rion acorda em um quarto de hospital, e a única coisa que consegue se lembrar é o seu nome. No entanto, Rion não é um garoto de 14 anos comum. Ele é um Galerian, um humano com poderes psíquicos especiais.

Localization.Description: International Track and Field 2 from Konami is a one-to-four player game (using the Multi Tap) that features 12 different international events, ranging from weightlifting and bicycling to canoeing.

Localization.Description: MTV Sports: Snowboarding ist ein Extremsportspiel, bei dem Sie Tricks auf Ihrem Snowboard ausführen müssen. Sie können mit einem von sechs verschiedenen Boardern spielen, von denen jeder seine eigenen Fähigkeiten hat.

Localization.Title: Missile Command
Localization.Description: Prepare for launch! Prepare for defense! Prepare for your potential battle of a lifetime! Welcome to Missile Command from Meyer Glass and Hasbro Interactive. The world needs a Missile Commander and you are the only hope in warding off the alien invasion.

Localization.Title: Missile Command
Localization.Description: Dans Missile Command sur Playstation vous devez défendre la côte contre de mystérieux envahisseurs. Les ennemis arrivent du ciel et vous disposez d'une batterie de trois canons contenant chacun dix missiles pour les repousser.

Localization.Title: Missile Command
Localization.Description: Bereiten Sie sich auf den Start vor! Bereiten Sie sich auf die Verteidigung vor! Bereiten Sie sich auf den potenziellen Kampf Ihres Lebens vor! Willkommen bei Missile Command von Meyer Glass und Hasbro Interactive.

Localization.Title: Missile Command
Localization.Description: ¡Misteriosos invasores están atacando tus ciudades! Como comandante de una base de misiles, es tu responsabilidad defenderlas. Los enemigos llegarán desde el cielo para intentar destruir las ciudades de la parte inferior de la pantalla.

Localization.Title: Missile Command
Localization.Description: Misteriosi invasori stanno attaccando le vostre città! Come comandante di una base missilistica, è vostra responsabilità difenderle. I nemici arriveranno dal cielo per cercare di distruggere le città in fondo allo schermo.

Localization.Title: Missile Command
Localization.Description: Invasores misteriosos estão a atacar as tuas cidades! Como comandante de uma base de mísseis, é da tua responsabilidade defendê-las. Os inimigos virão do céu para tentar destruir as cidades na parte inferior do ecrã.

Localization.Title: Knockout Kings 2000
Localization.Description: Ever dreamed of fighting in the "Thrilla in Manilla?" Now you can! In Knockout Kings 2000, EA Sports has included a Classic Fights feature. Some of the greatest matches of all time are playable, with no set outcomes.

Localization.Title: Knockout Kings 2000
Localization.Description: Knockout Kings 2000 est un jeu de boxe sur Playstation. Parmi les personnalités disponibles, on retrouve Marvelous Marvin Hagler, Rocky Marciano, Evander Holyfield, Roberto Duran et Mohamed Ali. Il est aussi possible de créer son propre boxeur.

Localization.Title: Knockout Kings 2000
Localization.Description: Haben Sie jemals davon geträumt, im „Thrilla in Manilla“ zu kämpfen? Jetzt kannst du! In Knockout Kings 2000 hat EA Sports eine Classic Fights-Funktion integriert. Einige der größten Spiele aller Zeiten sind spielbar, ohne festgelegte Ergebnisse.

Localization.Title: Knockout Kings 2000
Localization.Description: Juega como algunos de los grandes nombres de la historia del boxeo a través de una carrera completa, o crea tu propio boxeador y lucha hacia el campeonato de peso pesado.

Localization.Title: Knockout Kings 2000
Localization.Description: Hai mai sognato di combattere nel “Thrilla in Manilla”? Ora puoi farlo! In Knockout Kings 2000, EA Sports ha incluso una funzione Classic Fights. Alcuni dei più grandi incontri di tutti i tempi sono giocabili, senza risultati prestabiliti.

Localization.Description: This version of the FIFA series contained over 40 "classic" teams, so that gamers could play as retired football legends.

Localization.Title: FIFA 2000: Major League Soccer
Localization.Description: Diese Version der FIFA-Reihe enthielt über 40 „klassische“ Mannschaften, sodass Spieler als pensionierte Fußballlegenden spielen konnten.

Localization.Title: Fisherman's Bait 2: Big Ol' Bass

Localization.Title: No Fear Downhill Mountain Bike Racing
Localization.Description: Pedal power meets polygons in this no-holds-barred cycling experience. Not just another racing game, this title successfully captures the essence and devil-may-care style of competition mountain bike racing.

Localization.Title: No Fear Downhill Mountain Bike Racing
Localization.Description: No Fear Downhill Mountain Biking est un jeu de courses sorti sur Playstation.

Localization.Title: No Fear Downhill Mountain Bike Racing
Localization.Description: Vergiss deine Ängste! Deine Fähigkeiten, Deine Balance und Deine Nerven werden auf eine Zerreißprobe gestellt. Rase im Kamikaze Style dem Tal entgegen. Shredde hart am Abgrund entlang. Du bist allein auf Dich gestellt, gegen die Natur und Deine Gegner.

Localization.Title: No Fear Downhill Mountain Bike Racing
Localization.Description: No Fear Downhill Mountain Biking es un juego de simulador de carreras de bicicletas de montaña en la que gráficos, sonido y jugabilidad son las claves para conseguir una experiencia de simulación muy conseguida.

Localization.Title: No Fear Downhill Mountain Bike Racing
Localization.Description: Dimentica le tue paure! Le tue capacità, il tuo equilibrio ei tuoi nervi saranno messi a dura prova. Corri verso la valle in stile kamikaze. Taglia forte lungo il bordo. Sei da solo, contro la natura e contro i tuoi avversari. Devi farlo.

Localization.Title: No Fear Downhill Mountain Bike Racing

Localization.Title: Fatal Fury: Wild Ambition
Localization.Description: A long standing vendetta culminates with excitement in Fatal Fury: Wild Ambition. With vindictive rage, one fighter searches for truth and redemption against the ruthless crime lord who murdered his father.

Localization.Title: Fatal Fury : Wild Ambition
Localization.Description: Fatal Fury : Wild Ambition raconte à nouveau l'histoire du combat de Terry et Andy Bogard pour venger la mort de leur père aux mains de Geese Howard.

Localization.Title: Fatal Fury: Wild Ambition
Localization.Description: In Fatal Fury: Wild Ambition findet ein langjähriger Rachefeldzug seinen Höhepunkt. Mit rachsüchtiger Wut sucht ein Kämpfer nach Wahrheit und Erlösung gegen den skrupellosen Verbrecherboss, der seinen Vater ermordet hat.

Localization.Title: Fatal Fury: Wild Ambition

Localization.Title: Duke Nukem: Land of the Babes
Localization.Description: Aliens have wiped out Earth's men and are now looking to enslave the planet's women for their own hybridization program. Who's going to save the babes of Earth? Duke Nukem, that's who.

Localization.Title: Duke Nukem : Land of the Babes
Localization.Description: La série de jeux d'action Duke Nukem revient sur Playstation avec Duke Nukem : Land of the Babes. Dans cette nouvelle aventure, notre héros doit libérer la Terre où seulement quelques sublimes "nanas" ont survécus aux ravages des Aliens.

Localization.Title: Duke Nukem: Land of the Babes
Localization.Description: Falls Sie ihn schon vermisst haben: Der DUKE ist zurück! Und diesmal geht es um die Rettung eines ganzen Planeten voller hilfloser Babes. DUKE NUKEM versucht das LAND OF THE BABES von seinen Unterdrückern zu befreien.

Localization.Title: Duke Nukem: Land of the Babes
Localization.Description: Los extraterrestres han aniquilado a los hombres de la Tierra y ahora buscan esclavizar a las mujeres del planeta para su propio programa de hibridación. ¿Quién va a salvar a los niños de la Tierra? Duke Nukem, ese es quien.

Localization.Title: Duke Nukem: Land of the Babes
Localization.Description: Gli alieni hanno annientato gli uomini della Terra e ora cercano di schiavizzare le donne del pianeta per il loro programma di ibridazione. Chi salverà i figli della Terra? Duke Nukem, ecco chi.

Localization.Title: Duke Nukem: Land of the Babes
Localization.Description: A série de jogos de ação Duke Nukem retorna ao Playstation com Duke Nukem: Land of the Babes. Nesta nova aventura, nosso herói deve liberar a Terra onde apenas algumas "garotas" sublimes sobreviveram aos estragos dos alienígenas.

Localization.Title: CyberTiger

Localization.Title: Front Mission 3
Localization.Description: Wir befinden uns im Jahr 2112. Das Jahr, in dem die Volksrepublik "Da Han Zhong" (DHZ) gegründet wurde. Eines Tages, während einer Waffenlieferung an den Stützpunkt Yokosuka, werden Kazuki und sein Freund Ryogo Kusama Zeugen einer Explosion.

Localization.Description: A twinkling consciousness became a star that sparkled in the night and banished the darkness. The Mana Goddess acquired consciousness by gazing into the light of that sun. She made Fa´Diel, a great land, but so far an empty one.

Localization.Title: Legend of Mana
Localization.Description: Legend of Mana est un jeu de rôle sur Playstation. Vous incarnez un héros ou une héroïne à travers le monde de Fa'Diel. Le jeu repose sur la modification du monde.

Localization.Title: Legend of Mana
Localization.Description: Die Welt befindet sich in einem Umschwung - viele Gefahren lauern und ein uraltes Volk droht nun auszusterben.

Localization.Title: Legend of Mana
Localization.Description: Nueve siglos atrás, el árbol del Maná se quemó hasta hacerse cenizas. El poder del Maná vivía dentro de las piedras del Maná, instrumentos encantados, y artefactos.

Localization.Title: Legend of Mana
Localization.Description: Legend of Mana è un gioco di ruolo in cui si impersona un eroe o un'eroina nel mondo di Fa'Diel. Il gioco si basa sul cambiamento del mondo. Più si avanza nella storia, più artefatti si raccolgono, attraverso incontri più o meno amichevoli.

Localization.Title: Legend of Mana
Localization.Description: Legend of Mana é um jogo de role-playing no qual se joga como herói ou heroína no mundo de Fa'Diel. O jogo é baseado na mudança do mundo. Quanto mais progredir na história, mais artefactos recolherá, através de encontros mais ou menos amigáveis.

Localization.Title: Galaga: Destination Earth
Localization.Description: All the other space pilots have been eliminated. Somehow you survived. The Galaga enemies are on the move. Now, you must fight or doom Earth to extinction. There's no time to plan strategies. Just find your targets and come out blasting.

Localization.Title: Galaga : Destination Earth
Localization.Description: Tous les autres pilotes spatiaux ont été éliminés. D'une façon ou d'une autre, vous avez survécu. Les ennemis de Galaga sont en mouvement. Maintenant, vous devez combattre ou condamner la Terre à l'extinction.

Localization.Title: Galaga: Destination Earth
Localization.Description: Alle anderen Weltraumpiloten wurden eliminiert. Irgendwie hast du überlebt. Die Galaga-Feinde sind in Bewegung. Jetzt musst du kämpfen oder die Erde zum Aussterben bringen. Es ist keine Zeit, Strategien zu planen.

Localization.Title: Galaga: Destination Earth

Localization.Description: Ein Wirbelsturm aus Farben, Sound und adrenalingeladener Action. Machen Sie eine aufregende Fahrt durch die USA und nutzen Sie die Chance, am großen Rennen teilzunehmen und jede Menge Geld zu gewinnen.

Localization.Title: Pro Pinball: Big Race USA

Localization.Description: Pro Pinball : Fantastic Journey est un jeu de flipper sur Playstation. Voyagez dans le temps et vivez à l'époque de Jules Verne un périple extraordinaire. Au fil des 5 aventures, utilisez vos flips pour voyager dans les différents récits de l'écrivain.

Localization.Description: FIFA 2001 comes back to the series' fast-paced roots. The gameplay is balanced differently to previous versions, and includes online play as an option. It includes 17 leagues from around the world in addition to over 50 national teams.

Localization.Title: FIFA 2001
Localization.Description: FIFA 2001 kehrt zu den rasanten Wurzeln der Serie zurück. Das Gameplay ist anders ausbalanciert als in früheren Versionen und bietet optional auch Online-Spiele. Es umfasst 17 Ligen aus der ganzen Welt sowie über 50 Nationalmannschaften.

Localization.Description: Fear Effect 2 : Retro Helix est un jeu d'action/aventure sur Playstation. Amateurs d'ambiances glauques, de scènes sanglantes, ou de chair fraîche, ce titre vous propose de sauver le monde mis en danger par un virus.

Localization.Description: Men aren't the only ones looking for a fight in Knockout Kings 2001, the first boxing game from EA SPORTS to feature women boxers. The best male fighters are also on hand to settle who's the greatest of all time.

Localization.Title: Knockout Kings 2001
Localization.Description: Knockout Kings 2001 est un jeu de combat de boxe sur Playstation. Contrôlez tous vos coups et enchaînements pour mettre KO vos adversaires. Chaque boxeur a des mouvements spéciaux et des caractéristiques qui lui sont propres.

Localization.Description: In Knockout Kings 2001, dem ersten Boxspiel von EA SPORTS mit Boxerinnen, sind nicht nur Männer auf der Suche nach einem Kampf. Auch die besten männlichen Kämpfer sind vor Ort, um herauszufinden, wer der Größte aller Zeiten ist.

Localization.Title: Knockout Kings 2001
Localization.Description: Gli uomini non sono gli unici a cercare lo scontro in Knockout Kings 2001, il primo gioco di boxe di EA SPORTS che include pugili donne. Anche i migliori pugili maschi sono pronti a sfidarsi per stabilire chi è il più grande di tutti i tempi.

Localization.Title: Knockout Kings 2001
Localization.Description: Men aren't the only ones looking for a fight in Knockout Kings 2001, the first boxing game from EA SPORTS to feature women boxers. The best male fighters are also on hand to settle who's the greatest of all time.

Localization.Title: Medal of Honor: Underground
Localization.Description: The year is 1940, and the conquering force of the Third Reich has invaded France. Nazi Germany has marched into Paris and claimed the once proud nation as its own in its further quest for domination of Europe.

Localization.Title: Medal of Honor : Underground
Localization.Description: Dans Medal of Honor, un jeu de tir à la première personne sur Playstation, vous incarnez un membre de la Résistance française pendant la Seconde Guerre mondiale.

Localization.Title: Medal of Honor: Underground
Localization.Description: Dein Land wurde besetzt, die Staatsoberhäupter kapitulierten und haben sich nun mit dem Feind verbündet. Schließe dich der Widerstandsbewegung an und bekämpfe die Deutschen von Paris bis nach Nordafrika. Das Schicksal deines Landes liegt in deiner Hand.

Localization.Title: Medal of Honor: Underground
Localization.Description: Medal of Honor: Underground es un videojuego de disparos en primera persona desarrollado por DreamWorks y distribuido por Electronic Arts. Fue lanzado para las consolas PlayStation y Game Boy Advance en 2000.

Localization.Title: Medal of Honor: Underground
Localization.Description: The year is 1940, and the conquering force of the Third Reich has invaded France. Nazi Germany has marched into Paris and claimed the once proud nation as its own in its further quest for domination of Europe.

Localization.Title: Medal of Honor: Underground
Localization.Description: O ano é 1940, e a força conquistadora do Terceiro Reich invadiu a França. A Alemanha Nazista marchou até Paris e reivindicou para si a nação outrora orgulhosa em sua busca por dominar a Europa.

Localization.Title: NBA Live 2001
Localization.Description: NBA Live is back! Enhanced Chat & Match-up with the fast, easy-to-use Match-up System. Improved trade system can involve up to 3 teams and 15 players.

Localization.Title: NBA Live 2001
Localization.Description: NBA Live 2001 sur Playstation est une simulation de basket mettant en scène les plus grandes équipes de la ligue américaine ainsi que des équipes nationales.

Localization.Title: NBA Live 2001
Localization.Description: NBA Live ist zurück! Verbesserter Chat und Matchup mit dem schnellen, benutzerfreundlichen Matchup-System. Das verbesserte Handelssystem kann bis zu 3 Teams und 15 Spieler umfassen.

Localization.Title: NBA Live 2001
Localization.Description: NBA Live 2001 en Playstation es una simulación de baloncesto con los equipos más grandes de la liga estadounidense, así como equipos nacionales. Participa en el campeonato y avanza en tu equipo reclutando a los mejores jugadores del momento.

Localization.Title: NBA Live 2001
Localization.Description: NBA Live is back! Enhanced Chat & Match-up with the fast, easy-to-use Match-up System. Improved trade system can involve up to 3 teams and 15 players.

Localization.Title: NBA Live 2001

Localization.Title: 007: The World Is Not Enough
Localization.Description: Based on the 1999 film, 007: The World is Not Enough follows Pierce Brosnan's Bond as he investigates the murder of an oil tycoon and a pipeline conspiracy. This version differs significantly from the Nintendo 64 release.

Localization.Title: 007 : The World Is Not Enough
Localization.Description: 007 : Le monde ne suffit pas est basé sur le film de James Bond de 1999 portant le même nom.

Localization.Title: 007: The World Is Not Enough
Localization.Description: Schlüpfe in die spannende Rolle einer der weltbesten Top-Agenten.

Localization.Title: 007: The World Is Not Enough
Localization.Description: Experimenta la intensidad de ser el agente secreto más importante del mundo.

Localization.Title: 007: The World Is Not Enough
Localization.Description: The World Is Not Enough su Playstation è uno sparatutto in prima persona basato sul mondo dell'omonimo film. Nel costume di 007, dovrai svelare le trame, ripulire il casino e mettere le mani sulla misteriosa Volpe.

Localization.Title: 007: The World Is Not Enough
Localization.Description: Em 007 Racing você pode ficar atrás do volante do carro de James Bond. Você deve completar missões que variam de coletar um objeto e sair vivo, para coisas muito mais difíceis e mais complicadas.

Localization.Title: Tiger Woods PGA Tour Golf
Localization.Description: EA Sports brings Tiger Woods and the PGA Tour golf series to the PlayStation one last time with their 2001 edition. More than twice as many real golfers are in the 2001 version than the 2000 edition for you to play as or play against.

Localization.Title: Tiger Woods PGA Tour Golf
Localization.Description: Tiger Woods PGA Tour Golf est un jeu de sport sur Playstation qui propose d'incarner Tiger Woods et 7 autres golfeurs professionnels du PGA Tour. Plusieurs modes sont accessibles : Practice, Tournoi, Match à deux.

Localization.Title: Tiger Woods PGA Tour Golf
Localization.Description: Tiger Woods PGA Tour Golf ist ein Sportspiel auf der Playstation, in dem Sie Tiger Woods und 7 weitere professionelle Golfer der PGA Tour verkörpern. Es stehen mehrere Modi zur Verfügung: Training, Turnier, Match für zwei.

Localization.Title: Tiger Woods PGA Tour Golf
Localization.Description: EA Sports trae Tiger Woods y la serie de golf PGA Tour a PlayStation por última vez con su edición de 2001. Más del doble de golfistas reales están en la versión 2001 que en la edición 2000 para que juegues con ellos o contra ellos.

Localization.Title: Tiger Woods PGA Tour Golf
Localization.Description: EA Sports porta Tiger Woods e la serie di golf PGA Tour su PlayStation un'ultima volta con la loro edizione 2001. Nella versione del 2001 ci sono più del doppio dei veri golfisti rispetto all'edizione del 2000 con cui puoi giocare o giocare contro.

Localization.Title: Tiger Woods PGA Tour Golf
Localization.Description: EA Sports brings Tiger Woods and the PGA Tour golf series to the PlayStation one last time with their 2001 edition. More than twice as many real golfers are in the 2001 version than the 2000 edition for you to play as or play against.

Localization.Title: WCW Backstage Assault
Localization.Description: World Championship Wrestling, Inc. (WCW) was an American professional wrestling promotion which existed from 1988 to 2001. WCW Backstage Assault is a professional wrestling video game by Electronic Arts.

Localization.Title: WCW Backstage Assault
Localization.Description: WCW Backstage Assault est un jeu de catch sur Playstation avec plus de cinquante personnages dans la base de données.

Localization.Title: WCW Backstage Assault
Localization.Description: WCW Backstage Assault ist ein Spiel auf der Playstation mit mehr als fünf Spielern in der Basis. Sie entdecken sowohl die Klassiker als auch die kleinen Neulinge der Rennstrecke oder die großen und schönen Donzellen der Disziplin.

Localization.Title: WCW Backstage Assault
Localization.Description: WCW Backstage Assault es un juego de lucha libre para Playstation con más de cincuenta personajes en la base de datos. Allí encontrarás tanto los clásicos como las nuevas incorporaciones al circuito así como a las grandes y bellas damas de la disciplina.

Localization.Title: Fear Effect 2: Retro Helix (Disc 2)
Localization.Description: In the near future, mankind's tinkering with the science of genetics and the developmental process of genome mapping has resulted in the accidental creation of a new disease known as EINDS.

Localization.Title: Fear Effect 2 : Retro Helix (Disc 2)
Localization.Description: Fear Effect 2 : Retro Helix est un jeu d'action/aventure sur Playstation. Amateurs d'ambiances glauques, de scènes sanglantes, ou de chair fraîche, ce titre vous propose de sauver le monde mis en danger par un virus.

Localization.Title: Fear Effect 2: Retro Helix (Disc 2)
Localization.Description: „Fear Effect 2: Retro Helix“ spielt in einer nahen Zukunft, in der genetische Experimente und die Kartierung des Genoms versehentlich zur Entstehung einer tödlichen Krankheit namens EINDS geführt haben.

Localization.Title: Fear Effect 2: Retro Helix (Disc 2)
Localization.Description: Retro Helix: una épica aventura sobre el destino de la Humanidad. Profundiza en las pintorescas historias de los auténticos mercenarios y en las extraordinarias circunstancias que los reunieron en Fear Effect.

Localization.Title: Fear Effect 2: Retro Helix (Disc 2)
Localization.Description: Nel prossimo futuro, il lavoro dell'umanità con la scienza della genetica e il processo di sviluppo della mappatura del genoma ha portato alla creazione accidentale di una nuova malattia nota come EINDS.

Localization.Description: Disney's The Jungle Book Groove Party known in North American markets The Jungle Book Rhythm N'Groove is a music video game of Disney's The Jungle Book. It stars many characters from the film.

Localization.Description: Le Livre de la Jungle : Groove Party est un jeu de danse/rythme sur Playstation. Montrez votre sens du rythme et de l'équilibre avec le tapis de danse prévu à cet effet durant 36 niveaux.

Localization.Title: Walt Disney's The Jungle Book: Rhythm n' Groove
Localization.Description: The Jungle Book: Groove Party ist ein Tanz-/Rhythmusspiel für Playstation. Zeigen Sie in 36 Levels Ihren Rhythmus- und Gleichgewichtssinn mit der dafür vorgesehenen Tanzmatte. Außerdem können Sie im Zwei-Spieler-Modus mit einem Freund Spaß haben.

Localization.Title: Walt Disney's The Jungle Book: Rhythm n' Groove
Localization.Description: El Libro de la Selva - Muévete con ritmo de Disney es un videojuego musical basado en la película. Está protagonizado por muchos personajes de dicha cinta.
